    · refine Or.inl fun r hr => ?_
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (hS hr) with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd ⟨r, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hr, h⟩⟩ hYne
  · refine Or.inr fun r hr => ?_
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (hS hr) with h | h
    · exact absurd ⟨r, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hr, h⟩⟩ hXne
    · exact h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.exists_grandCliques_pair
statement:
theorem exists_grandCliques_pair (x : P) :
    ∃ K₁ K₂ : Finset P, K₁ ∈ E.grandCliques ∧ K₂ ∈ E.grandCliques ∧
      x ∈ K₁ ∧ x ∈ K₂ ∧ K₁ ∩ K₂ = {x} ∧
      ∀ K ∈ E.grandCliques, x ∈ K → K = K₁ ∨ K = K₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hXY, hdisj, hX, hY, hXc, hYc, hcross, hcross'⟩ := E.local_split_matching x
  have hXsub : X ⊆ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x := hXY ▸ Finset.subset_union_left
  have hYsub : Y ⊆ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x := hXY ▸ Finset.subset_union_right
  refine ⟨insert x X, insert x Y, E.insert_mem_grandCliques hXsub hX hXc,
    E.insert_mem_grandCliques hYsub hY hYc, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,
    Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext q
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩
      by_contra hqx
      rcases hq₁ with rfl | hq₁
      · exact hqx rfl
      rcases hq₂ with rfl | hq₂
      · exact hqx rfl
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hq₁ hq₂
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
  · intro K hK hxK
    have hKcard := E.card_of_mem_grandCliques hK
    have hKc := E.isClique_of_mem_grandCliques hK
    have hScard : (K.erase x).card = 9 := by
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hxK, hKcard]
    have hSsub : K.erase x ⊆ X ∪ Y := by
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨hrx, hrK⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hr
      rw [hXY]
      exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr
        (E.adj_of_mem_grandClique hK hxK hrK (Ne.symm hrx))
    have hSc : E.blockGraph.IsClique ((K.erase x : Finset P) : Set P) :=
      SimpleGraph.IsClique.subset (Finset.coe_subset.mpr (Finset.erase_subset _ _)) hKc
    rcases E.subset_of_isClique_local hdisj hcross hcross' hSsub (by omega) hSc with h | h
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      have heq : K.erase x = X := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le h (by omega)
      rw [← Finset.insert_erase hxK, heq]
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      have heq : K.erase x = Y := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le h (by omega)
      rw [← Finset.insert_erase hxK, heq]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_filter_grandCliques
statement:
theorem card_filter_grandCliques (x : P) :
    (E.grandCliques.filter fun K => x ∈ K).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨K₁, K₂, h₁, h₂, hx₁, hx₂, hinter, hall⟩ := E.exists_grandCliques_pair x
  have hne : K₁ ≠ K₂ := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [Finset.inter_self] at hinter
    have hcard := E.card_of_mem_grandCliques h₁
    rw [hinter, Finset.card_singleton] at hcard
    exact absurd hcard (by norm_num)
  have hset : (E.grandCliques.filter fun K => x ∈ K) = {K₁, K₂} := by
    ext K
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hK, hxK⟩
      exact hall K hK hxK
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      exacts [⟨h₁, hx₁⟩, ⟨h₂, hx₂⟩]
  rw [hset, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simpa using hne), Finset.card_singleton]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.exists_grandClique_of_adj
statement:
theorem exists_grandClique_of_adj {p q : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj p q) :
    ∃ K ∈ E.grandCliques, p ∈ K ∧ q ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hXY, -, hX, hY, hXc, hYc⟩ := E.local_split p
  have hXsub : X ⊆ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset p := hXY ▸ Finset.subset_union_left
  have hYsub : Y ⊆ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset p := hXY ▸ Finset.subset_union_right
  have hq : q ∈ X ∪ Y := by
    rw [hXY]
    exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).mpr h
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hq with hq | hq
  · exact ⟨insert p X, E.insert_mem_grandCliques hXsub hX hXc,
      Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq⟩
  · exact ⟨insert p Y, E.insert_mem_grandCliques hYsub hY hYc,
      Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_grandCliques
statement: theorem card_grandCliques : E.grandCliques.card = 11
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcol : ∀ K : Finset P, K.card = ∑ p : P, if p ∈ K then 1 else 0 := by
    intro K
    rw [← Finset.card_filter, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
  have hrow : ∀ p : P, (E.grandCliques.filter fun K => p ∈ K).card
      = ∑ K ∈ E.grandCliques, if p ∈ K then 1 else 0 := fun p => Finset.card_filter _ _
  have hdouble : (∑ K ∈ E.grandCliques, K.card)
      = ∑ p : P, (E.grandCliques.filter fun K => p ∈ K).card := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun K _ => hcol K,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => hrow p, Finset.sum_comm]
  have hleft : (∑ K ∈ E.grandCliques, K.card) = E.grandCliques.card * 10 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun K hK => E.card_of_mem_grandCliques hK,
      Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
  have hright : (∑ p : P, (E.grandCliques.filter fun K => p ∈ K).card) = 110 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => E.card_filter_grandCliques p, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, E.point_card, smul_eq_mul]
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.cliqueIndex_of_mem
statement:
theorem cliqueIndex_of_mem {K : Finset P} (hK : K ∈ E.grandCliques) :
    E.cliqueIndex ψ K = ψ ⟨K, hK⟩
proof: := dif_pos hK

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.cliqueIndex_injOn
statement:
theorem cliqueIndex_injOn :
    Set.InjOn (E.cliqueIndex ψ) (E.grandCliques : Set (Finset P))
proof:
:= by
  intro K hK K' hK' h
  rw [E.cliqueIndex_of_mem ψ (Finset.mem_coe.mp hK),
    E.cliqueIndex_of_mem ψ (Finset.mem_coe.mp hK')] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (ψ.injective h)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.mem_cliquePair
statement:
theorem mem_cliquePair {p : P} {i : Fin 11} :
    i ∈ E.cliquePair ψ p ↔ ∃ K ∈ E.grandCliques, p ∈ K ∧ E.cliqueIndex ψ K = i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cliquePair, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, ⟨hK, hpK⟩, hidx⟩
    exact ⟨K, hK, hpK, hidx⟩
  · rintro ⟨K, hK, hpK, hidx⟩
    exact ⟨K, ⟨hK, hpK⟩, hidx⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_cliquePair
statement: theorem card_cliquePair (p : P) : (E.cliquePair ψ p).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [cliquePair,
    Finset.card_image_of_injOn ((E.cliqueIndex_injOn ψ).mono
      (Finset.coe_subset.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ _))),
    E.card_filter_grandCliques p]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pointEdge_vertices
statement: theorem pointEdge_vertices (p : P) : (E.pointEdge ψ p).vertices = E.cliquePair ψ p
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (Edge11.exists_vertices_eq (E.card_cliquePair ψ p))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.cliquePair_injective
statement: theorem cliquePair_injective : Function.Injective (E.cliquePair ψ)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  obtain ⟨K₁, K₂, h₁, h₂, hp₁, hp₂, hinter, -⟩ := E.exists_grandCliques_pair p
  have hcarry : ∀ K ∈ E.grandCliques, p ∈ K → q ∈ K := by
    intro K hK hpK
    have hi : E.cliqueIndex ψ K ∈ E.cliquePair ψ p :=
      (E.mem_cliquePair ψ).mpr ⟨K, hK, hpK, rfl⟩
    rw [hpq] at hi
    obtain ⟨K', hK', hqK', hidx⟩ := (E.mem_cliquePair ψ).mp hi
    have heq : K' = K := E.cliqueIndex_injOn ψ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hK')
      (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hK) hidx
    exact heq ▸ hqK'
  have hmem : q ∈ K₁ ∩ K₂ :=
    Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hcarry K₁ h₁ hp₁, hcarry K₂ h₂ hp₂⟩
  rw [hinter, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
  exact hmem.symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pointEdge_injective
statement: theorem pointEdge_injective : Function.Injective (E.pointEdge ψ)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  refine E.cliquePair_injective ψ ?_
  rw [← E.pointEdge_vertices ψ p, ← E.pointEdge_vertices ψ q, h]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pointEdge_bijective
statement: theorem pointEdge_bijective : Function.Bijective (E.pointEdge ψ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr ⟨E.pointEdge_injective ψ, ?_⟩
  rw [E.point_card, Edge11.card_edge11]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.adj_iff_vmeet_pointEdge
statement:
theorem adj_iff_vmeet_pointEdge (p q : P) :
    E.blockGraph.Adj p q ↔ Edge11.vmeet (E.pointEdge ψ p) (E.pointEdge ψ q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hpK, hqK⟩ := E.exists_grandClique_of_adj h
    have hmem : E.cliqueIndex ψ K ∈
        (E.pointEdge ψ p).vertices ∩ (E.pointEdge ψ q).vertices := by
      rw [E.pointEdge_vertices ψ p, E.pointEdge_vertices ψ q]
      exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr
        ⟨(E.mem_cliquePair ψ).mpr ⟨K, hK, hpK, rfl⟩, (E.mem_cliquePair ψ).mpr ⟨K, hK, hqK, rfl⟩⟩
    have hne : E.pointEdge ψ p ≠ E.pointEdge ψ q := fun heq =>
      h.ne (E.pointEdge_injective ψ heq)
    have hle := Edge11.vmeet_le_one hne
    have hpos : 0 < Edge11.vmeet (E.pointEdge ψ p) (E.pointEdge ψ q) :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨_, hmem⟩
    omega
  · intro h
    have hpos : 0 < ((E.pointEdge ψ p).vertices ∩ (E.pointEdge ψ q).vertices).card := by
      rw [← Edge11.vmeet, h]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpos
    rw [E.pointEdge_vertices ψ p, E.pointEdge_vertices ψ q, Finset.mem_inter] at hi
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hpK, hidx⟩ := (E.mem_cliquePair ψ).mp hi.1
    obtain ⟨K', hK', hqK', hidx'⟩ := (E.mem_cliquePair ψ).mp hi.2
    have heq : K' = K := E.cliqueIndex_injOn ψ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hK')
      (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hK) (hidx'.trans hidx.symm)
    have hpq : p ≠ q := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [Edge11.vmeet_self] at h
      exact absurd h (by norm_num)
    exact E.adj_of_mem_grandClique hK hpK (heq ▸ hqK') hpq

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pairMult_add_vmeet_pointEdge
statement:
theorem pairMult_add_vmeet_pointEdge (p q : P) :
    E.pairMult p q + Edge11.vmeet (E.pointEdge ψ p) (E.pointEdge ψ q)
      = 2 + if p = q then 9 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst hpq
    rw [E.pairMult_self, Edge11.vmeet_self, if_pos rfl]
  · rw [if_neg hpq]
    have hne : E.pointEdge ψ p ≠ E.pointEdge ψ q := fun heq =>
      hpq (E.pointEdge_injective ψ heq)
    by_cases hadj : E.blockGraph.Adj p q
    · rw [hadj.2, (E.adj_iff_vmeet_pointEdge ψ p q).mp hadj]
    · have hv : Edge11.vmeet (E.pointEdge ψ p) (E.pointEdge ψ q) = 0 := by
        have hle := Edge11.vmeet_le_one hne
        have hne1 : Edge11.vmeet (E.pointEdge ψ p) (E.pointEdge ψ q) ≠ 1 := fun hone =>
          hadj ((E.adj_iff_vmeet_pointEdge ψ p q).mpr hone)
        omega
      rw [E.pairMult_of_not_adj hpq hadj, hv]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.blockGraph_iso_T11
statement:
theorem blockGraph_iso_T11 :
    ∃ φ : P ≃ Edge11, ∀ p q, E.blockGraph.Adj p q ↔ Edge11.vmeet (φ p) (φ q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ⟩ : Nonempty ({K : Finset P // K ∈ E.grandCliques} ≃ Fin 11) :=
    ⟨Finset.equivFinOfCardEq E.card_grandCliques⟩
  exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective _ (E.pointEdge_bijective ψ), E.adj_iff_vmeet_pointEdge ψ⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.exists_equiv_edge11
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_edge11 :
    ∃ φ : P ≃ Edge11,
      (∀ p q, E.blockGraph.Adj p q ↔ Edge11.vmeet (φ p) (φ q) = 1) ∧
      ∀ p q, E.pairMult p q + Edge11.vmeet (φ p) (φ q) = 2 + if p = q then 9 else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ⟩ : Nonempty ({K : Finset P // K ∈ E.grandCliques} ≃ Fin 11) :=
    ⟨Finset.equivFinOfCardEq E.card_grandCliques⟩
  exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective _ (E.pointEdge_bijective ψ), E.adj_iff_vmeet_pointEdge ψ,
    E.pairMult_add_vmeet_pointEdge ψ⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.three_iff_parity
statement:
theorem three_iff_parity (A B C : Prop) :
    ((A ↔ B) ↔ ((A ↔ C) ↔ (B ↔ C)))
proof: := by tauto

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.arcDegree_star_ne
statement:
theorem arcDegree_star_ne {a b : Fin 11} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    arcDegree (star a) b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcDegree, Finset.card_eq_one]
  refine ⟨mk' hab, ?_⟩
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_star, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact eq_of_mem_mem hab h.1 h.2
  · rintro rfl
    simp [vertices_mk']

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.degree_le_two_of_meets
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hc⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp (card_vertices c)
  have hwu : w ≠ u := by intro h; subst w; simp [hc] at hw
  have hwv : w ≠ v := by intro h; subst w; simp [hc] at hw
  have hsub : (T.filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices) ⊆
      {mk' hwu, mk' hwv} := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨heT, hwe⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp he
    rcases htouch e heT with rfl | hmeet
    · exact False.elim (hw hwe)
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (show 0 < vmeet c e by omega)
      have hxx := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
      rw [hc] at hxx
      have hxuv : x = u ∨ x = v := by simpa using hxx.1
      rcases hxuv with rfl | rfl
      · simp [eq_of_mem_mem hwu hwe hxx.2]
      · simp [eq_of_mem_mem hwv hwe hxx.2]
  have hcard : ({mk' hwu, mk' hwv} : Finset Edge11).card ≤ 2 := by
    exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp)
  exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans hcard

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.common_endpoint_mem_central
statement:
theorem common_endpoint_mem_central {T : Finset Edge11} {c e f : Edge11}
    (htouch : ∀ e ∈ T, e = c ∨ vmeet c e = 1)
    (hdegree : ∀ w, (arcDegree T w : ZMod 3) = 1)
    (he : e ∈ T) (hf : f ∈ T) (hef : e ≠ f)
    {w : Fin 11} (hwe : w ∈ e.vertices) (hwf : w ∈ f.vertices) :
    w ∈ c.vertices
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hw
  have hle := degree_le_two_of_meets htouch hw
  have hge : 2 ≤ arcDegree T w := by
    apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
    apply Finset.one_lt_card.mpr
    exact ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hwe⟩,
      f, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf, hwf⟩, hef⟩
  have hn : arcDegree T w = 2 := by omega
  have h := hdegree w
  rw [hn] at h
  exact (by decide : (2 : ZMod 3) ≠ 1) h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vmeet_eq_one_iff_same_side
statement:
theorem vmeet_eq_one_iff_same_side {T : Finset Edge11} {c e f : Edge11}
    (htouch : ∀ e ∈ T, e = c ∨ vmeet c e = 1)
    (hdegree : ∀ w, (arcDegree T w : ZMod 3) = 1)
    (he : e ∈ T) (hf : f ∈ T) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (hec : e ≠ c) (hfc : f ≠ c)
    {u v : Fin 11} (huv : u ≠ v) (hc : c.vertices = {u,v}) :
    vmeet e f = 1 ↔ (u ∈ e.vertices ↔ u ∈ f.vertices)
proof:
:= by
  have hnotboth : ∀ g : Edge11, g ≠ c → u ∈ g.vertices → v ∉ g.vertices := by
    intro g hgc hgu hgv
    apply hgc
    exact (eq_of_mem_mem huv hgu hgv).trans
      (eq_of_mem_mem huv (by simp [hc]) (by simp [hc])).symm
  have hone : ∀ g ∈ T, g ≠ c → u ∈ g.vertices ∨ v ∈ g.vertices := by
    intro g hg hgc
    have hcg := (htouch g hg).resolve_left hgc
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (show 0 < vmeet c g by omega)
    have hww := Finset.mem_inter.mp hw
    rw [hc] at hww
    have hwuv : w = u ∨ w = v := by simpa using hww.1
    rcases hwuv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl hww.2
    · exact Or.inr hww.2
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (show 0 < vmeet e f by omega)
    obtain ⟨hwe, hwf⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hw
    have hwc := common_endpoint_mem_central htouch hdegree he hf hef hwe hwf
    rw [hc] at hwc
    have hwuv : w = u ∨ w = v := by simpa using hwc
    rcases hwuv with rfl | rfl
    · exact iff_of_true hwe hwf
    · exact iff_of_false (fun h => hnotboth e hec h hwe)
        (fun h => hnotboth f hfc h hwf)
  · intro h
    by_cases hue : u ∈ e.vertices
    · exact vmeet_eq_one hef hue (h.mp hue)
    · have huf : u ∉ f.vertices := fun hf => hue (h.mpr hf)
      exact vmeet_eq_one hef ((hone e he hec).resolve_left hue)
        ((hone f hf hfc).resolve_left huf)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.exists_star_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem exists_star_of_pairwise {T : Finset Edge11} (hcard : 3 < T.card)
    (hpair : ∀ e ∈ T, ∀ f ∈ T, e ≠ f → vmeet e f = 1) :
    ∃ w : Fin 11, T ⊆ star w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hcT⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (show 0 < T.card by omega)
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hc⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp (card_vertices c)
  have hsum : arcDegree T u + arcDegree T v = T.card + 1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ f ∈ T, vmeet c f := by
        rw [sum_vmeet_left, hc, Finset.sum_pair huv]
      _ = ∑ f ∈ T, (1 + if f = c then 1 else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro f hf
        by_cases hfc : f = c
        · simp [hfc, vmeet_self]
        · simp [hfc, hpair c hcT f hf (Ne.symm hfc)]
      _ = T.card + 1 := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hcT]
  have hhigh : 3 ≤ arcDegree T u ∨ 3 ≤ arcDegree T v := by omega
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, 3 ≤ arcDegree T w := by
    rcases hhigh with hu | hv
    · exact ⟨u, hu⟩
    · exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  apply mem_star.mpr
  by_contra hwe
  have htouch : ∀ f ∈ T, f = e ∨ vmeet e f = 1 := by
    intro f hf
    by_cases hfe : f = e
    · exact Or.inl hfe
    · exact Or.inr (hpair e he f hf (Ne.symm hfe))
  have hlow := degree_le_two_of_meets htouch hwe
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.localEdges_closedStar
statement:
theorem localEdges_closedStar (p : P) (a : Fin 11) :
    K.localEdges (K.closedStar p a) p = Edge11.star a
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  have h := K.coordinate_mem_closedStar p ((K.coordinate p).symm e) a
  simpa [localEdges] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.closedStar_injective
statement: theorem closedStar_injective (p : P) : Function.Injective (K.closedStar p)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Fin 11, c ≠ a ∧ c ≠ b := by
    have hlt : ({a,b} : Finset (Fin 11)).card < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).card := by
      have hle := Finset.card_le_two (a := a) (b := b)
      simpa using (show ({a,b} : Finset (Fin 11)).card < 11 by omega)
    obtain ⟨c, _, hc⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hlt
    exact ⟨c, by simpa using hc⟩
  let q := (K.coordinate p).symm (Edge11.mk' hc.1.symm)
  have hqa : q.val ∈ K.closedStar p a := by
    apply (K.coordinate_mem_closedStar p q a).mpr
    simp [q, Edge11.vertices_mk']
  rw [hab] at hqa
  have hqb := (K.coordinate_mem_closedStar p q b).mp hqa
  simp [q, Edge11.vertices_mk', Ne.symm hne, Ne.symm hc.2] at hqb

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.card_inter_closedStar
statement:
theorem card_inter_closedStar {S : Finset P} {q : P} (hq : q ∈ S) (v : Fin 11) :
    (S ∩ K.closedStar q v).card = arcDegree (K.localEdges S q) v + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : arcDegree (K.localEdges S q) v =
      ((S ∩ K.closedStar q v).erase q).card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij
      (fun e _ => ((K.coordinate q).symm e).val) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro e he
      obtain ⟨heT, hve⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp he
      have heroot := ((K.coordinate q).symm e).property
      refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨heroot, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp heT).2
      · apply (K.coordinate_mem_closedStar q ((K.coordinate q).symm e) v).mpr
        simpa using hve
    · intro e he f hf h
      exact (K.coordinate q).symm.injective (Subtype.ext h)
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hxq, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx
      obtain ⟨hxS, hxstar⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
      let x' : {x : P // x ≠ q} := ⟨x, hxq⟩
      refine ⟨K.coordinate q x', Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact (K.coordinate_mem_localEdges S q x').mpr hxS
      · exact (K.coordinate_mem_closedStar q x' v).mp hxstar
      · simp [x']
  rw [hcard, Finset.card_erase_of_mem
    (Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hq, K.root_mem_closedStar q v⟩)]
  have hpos : 0 < (S ∩ K.closedStar q v).card :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨q, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hq, K.root_mem_closedStar q v⟩⟩
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.localEdges_closedStar_meets
statement:
theorem localEdges_closedStar_meets {p : P} {a : Fin 11}
    (q : {q : P // q ≠ p}) (hq : q.val ∈ K.closedStar p a) :
    ∀ e ∈ K.localEdges (K.closedStar p a) q.val,
      e = K.coordinate q.val ⟨p, q.property.symm⟩ ∨
      Edge11.vmeet (K.coordinate q.val ⟨p, q.property.symm⟩) e = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  let r := (K.coordinate q.val).symm e
  have hre : K.coordinate q.val r = e := (K.coordinate q.val).apply_symm_apply e
  have hrS : r.val ∈ K.closedStar p a := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
  by_cases hrp : r.val = p
  · left
    rw [← hre]
    exact congrArg (K.coordinate q.val) (Subtype.ext hrp)
  · right
    rw [← hre]
    apply (K.coherent q.property hrp r.property).mp
    apply Edge11.vmeet_eq_one
      (fun h => r.property (congrArg Subtype.val ((K.coordinate p).injective h)).symm)
      ((K.coordinate_mem_closedStar p q a).mp hq)
      ((K.coordinate_mem_closedStar p ⟨r.val, hrp⟩ a).mp hrS)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.closedStar_inter_card
statement:
theorem closedStar_inter_card (p : P) {a b : Fin 11} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (K.closedStar p a ∩ K.closedStar p b).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.card_inter_closedStar (K.root_mem_closedStar p a),
    K.localEdges_closedStar, Edge11.arcDegree_star_ne hab]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_degree_mod_three
statement:
theorem closedStar_degree_mod_three {p q : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}
    (hq : q ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) (w : Fin 11) :
    (arcDegree (Q.toCoherentK11System.localEdges
      (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) q) w : ZMod 3) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.closedStar_overlap_mod_three p q a w
  rw [Q.toCoherentK11System.card_inter_closedStar hq, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h
  linear_combination h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_link_has_two_sides
statement:
theorem closedStar_link_has_two_sides {p q : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}
    (hqp : q ≠ p) (hq : q ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) :
    ∃ u : Fin 11, ∀ r s : {x : Fin 56 // x ≠ q},
      r.val ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a →
      s.val ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a →
      r.val ≠ p → s.val ≠ p → r ≠ s →
      (Q.sparseTriple q r s ↔
        (u ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate q r).vertices ↔
          u ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate q s).vertices))
proof:
:= by
  let K := Q.toCoherentK11System
  let c := K.coordinate q ⟨p, hqp.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hc⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp (Edge11.card_vertices c)
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  intro r s hr hs hrp hsp hrs
  rw [← Q.coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse q r s]
  apply Edge11.vmeet_eq_one_iff_same_side
    (K.localEdges_closedStar_meets ⟨q, hqp⟩ hq)
    (Q.closedStar_degree_mod_three hq)
    ((K.coordinate_mem_localEdges _ q r).mpr hr)
    ((K.coordinate_mem_localEdges _ q s).mpr hs)
    (fun h => hrs ((K.coordinate q).injective h))
    (fun h => hrp (congrArg Subtype.val ((K.coordinate q).injective h)))
    (fun h => hsp (congrArg Subtype.val ((K.coordinate q).injective h))) huv hc

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_root_sparse
statement:
theorem closedStar_root_sparse {p q r : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}
    (hq : q ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a)
    (hr : r ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a)
    (hqp : q ≠ p) (hrp : r ≠ p) (hqr : q ≠ r) : Q.sparseTriple p q r
proof:
:= by
  apply (Q.coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse p ⟨q, hqp⟩ ⟨r, hrp⟩).mp
  exact Edge11.vmeet_eq_one
    (fun h => hqr (congrArg Subtype.val ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).injective h)))
    ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar p ⟨q,hqp⟩ a).mp hq)
    ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar p ⟨r,hrp⟩ a).mp hr)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_link_parity
statement:
theorem closedStar_link_parity {p q x y z : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}
    (hq : q ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a).erase p)
    (hx : x ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a).erase p)
    (hy : y ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a).erase p)
    (hz : z ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a).erase p)
    (hxq : x ≠ q) (hyq : y ≠ q) (hzq : z ≠ q)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    (Q.sparseTriple q x y ↔ (Q.sparseTriple q x z ↔ Q.sparseTriple q y z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hqp, hq⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hq
  obtain ⟨hxp, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hx
  obtain ⟨hyp, hy⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hy
  obtain ⟨hzp, hz⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hz
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Q.closedStar_link_has_two_sides hqp hq
  have h₁ := hu ⟨x,hxq⟩ ⟨y,hyq⟩ hx hy hxp hyp
    (fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have h₂ := hu ⟨x,hxq⟩ ⟨z,hzq⟩ hx hz hxp hzp
    (fun h => hxz (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have h₃ := hu ⟨y,hyq⟩ ⟨z,hzq⟩ hy hz hyp hzp
    (fun h => hyz (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  change (Q.sparseTriple q x y ↔ _) at h₁
  change (Q.sparseTriple q x z ↔ _) at h₂
  change (Q.sparseTriple q y z ↔ _) at h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  exact three_iff_parity _ _ _

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_triple_sparse
statement:
theorem closedStar_triple_sparse {p x y z : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}
    (hx : x ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a)
    (hy : y ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a)
    (hz : z ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) : Q.sparseTriple x y z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxp : x = p
  · subst x
    exact Q.closedStar_root_sparse hy hz hxy.symm hxz.symm hyz
  by_cases hyp : y = p
  · subst y
    exact (Q.sparseTriple_swap p x z).mp
      (Q.closedStar_root_sparse hx hz hxp hyz.symm hxz)
  by_cases hzp : z = p
  · subst z
    exact (Q.sparseTriple_rotate p x y).mp
      (Q.closedStar_root_sparse hx hy hxp hyp hxy)
  let X := (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a).erase p
  have hX : X.card = 10 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Q.toCoherentK11System.root_mem_closedStar p a),
      Q.toCoherentK11System.card_closedStar]
  have hsmall : ({x,y,z} : Finset (Fin 56)).card < X.card := by
    have hle := Finset.card_le_three (a := x) (b := y) (c := z)
    omega
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdnot⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp
    (show ¬ X ⊆ {x,y,z} from fun h => Nat.not_le_of_gt hsmall (Finset.card_le_card h))
  have hdx : d ≠ x := by intro h; subst d; simp at hdnot
  have hdy : d ≠ y := by intro h; subst d; simp at hdnot
  have hdz : d ≠ z := by intro h; subst d; simp at hdnot
  have hxX : x ∈ X := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hxp,hx⟩
  have hyX : y ∈ X := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hyp,hy⟩
  have hzX : z ∈ X := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hzp,hz⟩
  exact triple_of_four_point_link_parity Q.sparseTriple Q.sparseTriple_swap
    Q.sparseTriple_rotate x y z d
    (Q.closedStar_link_parity hxX hyX hzX hd hxy.symm hxz.symm hdx hyz hdy.symm hdz.symm)
    (Q.closedStar_link_parity hyX hxX hzX hd hxy hyz.symm hdy hxz hdx.symm hdz.symm)
    (Q.closedStar_link_parity hzX hxX hyX hd hxz hyz hdz hxy hdx.symm hdy.symm)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.eq_closedStar_of_triple_clique
statement:
theorem eq_closedStar_of_triple_clique {S : Finset (Fin 56)} {q : Fin 56}
    (hcard : S.card = 11)
    (hclique : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ z ∈ S,
      x ≠ y → x ≠ z → y ≠ z → Q.sparseTriple x y z)
    (hq : q ∈ S) : ∃ b : Fin 11, S = Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar q b
proof:
:= by
  let K := Q.toCoherentK11System
  let T := K.localEdges S q
  have hT : T.card = 10 := by
    rw [K.card_localEdges, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hq, hcard]
  have hpair : ∀ e ∈ T, ∀ f ∈ T, e ≠ f → Edge11.vmeet e f = 1 := by
    intro e he f hf hef
    let r := (K.coordinate q).symm e
    let s := (K.coordinate q).symm f
    have hr : r.val ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
    have hs : s.val ∈ S := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).2
    have hrs : r.val ≠ s.val := fun h => hef
      ((K.coordinate q).symm.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    have h := hclique q hq r.val hr s.val hs r.property.symm s.property.symm hrs
    have hmeet := (Q.coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse q r s).mpr h
    simpa [r, s, K] using hmeet
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Edge11.exists_star_of_pairwise (by omega : 3 < T.card) hpair
  have heq : T = Edge11.star b := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hb
    (by rw [Edge11.card_star, hT])
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  ext x
  by_cases hxq : x = q
  · subst x
    exact iff_of_true hq (K.root_mem_closedStar q b)
  · have h₁ := K.coordinate_mem_localEdges S q ⟨x,hxq⟩
    have h₂ := K.coordinate_mem_closedStar q ⟨x,hxq⟩ b
    change K.coordinate q ⟨x,hxq⟩ ∈ T ↔ x ∈ S at h₁
    rw [heq, Edge11.mem_star] at h₁
    exact h₁.symm.trans h₂.symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_reroot
statement:
theorem closedStar_reroot {p q : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}
    (hq : q ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) :
    ∃ b : Fin 11, Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a =
      Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar q b
proof:
:=
  Q.eq_closedStar_of_triple_clique (Q.toCoherentK11System.card_closedStar p a)
    (fun _ hx _ hy _ hz => Q.closedStar_triple_sparse hx hy hz) hq

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.mem_vertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_vertices {v : Fin 11} {e : Edge11} :
    v ∈ e.vertices ↔ v ∈ (e : Sym2 (Fin 11))
proof: := Sym2.mem_toFinset

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.card_vertices
statement: theorem card_vertices (e : Edge11) : e.vertices.card = 2
proof:
:=
  Sym2.card_toFinset_of_not_isDiag _ e.2

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vertices_mk'
statement: theorem vertices_mk' {v a : Fin 11} (h : v ≠ a) : (mk' h).vertices = {v, a}
proof:
:=
  Sym2.toFinset_mk_eq

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.eq_of_mem_mem
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_mem {e : Edge11} {v a : Fin 11} (hva : v ≠ a)
    (hv : v ∈ e.vertices) (ha : a ∈ e.vertices) : e = mk' hva
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (Sym2.mem_and_mem_iff hva).mp ⟨mem_vertices.mp hv, mem_vertices.mp ha⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.exists_mem_vertices
statement: theorem exists_mem_vertices (e : Edge11) : ∃ v, v ∈ e.vertices
proof:
:= by
  have h : e.vertices.card ≠ 0 := by rw [card_vertices]; norm_num
  exact Finset.card_ne_zero.mp h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vmeet_comm
statement: theorem vmeet_comm (e f : Edge11) : vmeet e f = vmeet f e
proof:
:= by
  rw [vmeet, vmeet, Finset.inter_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vmeet_self
statement: theorem vmeet_self (e : Edge11) : vmeet e e = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [vmeet, Finset.inter_self, card_vertices]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vmeet_le_one
statement: theorem vmeet_le_one {e f : Edge11} (h : e ≠ f) : vmeet e f ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  obtain ⟨v, hv, a, ha, hva⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp (by omega : 1 < vmeet e f)
  rw [Finset.mem_inter] at hv ha
  exact h ((eq_of_mem_mem hva hv.1 ha.1).trans (eq_of_mem_mem hva hv.2 ha.2).symm)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vmeet_eq_one
statement:
theorem vmeet_eq_one {e f : Edge11} (hef : e ≠ f) {v : Fin 11} (hv : v ∈ e.vertices)
    (hvf : v ∈ f.vertices) : vmeet e f = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hge : 1 ≤ vmeet e f :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨v, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hv, hvf⟩⟩
  have hle := vmeet_le_one hef
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.mem_star
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_star {v : Fin 11} {e : Edge11} : e ∈ star v ↔ v ∈ e.vertices
proof:
:= by
  simp [star]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.card_star
statement: theorem card_star (v : Fin 11) : (star v).card = 10
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).erase v).card = 10 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← hcard]
  refine (Finset.card_bij (fun a ha => mk' (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha).1))
    ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  · intro a ha
    rw [mem_star, vertices_mk']
    simp
  · intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ hEq
    have h₁ : a₁ ∈ (mk' (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha₁).1)).vertices := by
      rw [vertices_mk']; simp
    rw [hEq, vertices_mk'] at h₁
    have hne : a₁ ≠ v := (Finset.mem_erase.mp ha₁).1
    simpa [hne] using h₁
  · intro e he
    rw [mem_star] at he
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ : ∃ a ∈ e.vertices, a ≠ v := by
      have hlt : 1 < e.vertices.card := by rw [card_vertices]; norm_num
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hlt
      by_cases hxv : x = v
      · exact ⟨y, hy, fun h => hxy (hxv.trans h.symm)⟩
      · exact ⟨x, hx, hxv⟩
    refine ⟨a, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hav, Finset.mem_univ a⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (eq_of_mem_mem (Ne.symm hav) he ha).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.card_edge11
statement: theorem card_edge11 : Fintype.card Edge11 = 55
proof:
:= by
  rw [Sym2.card_subtype_not_diag, Fintype.card_fin]
  rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.sum_star_card
statement:
theorem sum_star_card (s : Finset Edge11) :
    (∑ v : Fin 11, (s.filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card) = ∑ e ∈ s, e.vertices.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hl : ∀ v : Fin 11, (s.filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card =
      ∑ e ∈ s, if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0 := fun v => Finset.card_filter _ _
  have hr : ∀ e : Edge11, (∑ v : Fin 11, if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) =
      e.vertices.card := by
    intro e
    rw [← Finset.card_filter, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => hl v, ← Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => hr e,
    Finset.sum_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.sum_vmeet
statement:
theorem sum_vmeet (s : Finset Edge11) :
    (∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s, vmeet e f) =
      ∑ v : Fin 11, (s.filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hl : ∀ e f : Edge11, vmeet e f =
      ∑ v : Fin 11, (if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) * (if v ∈ f.vertices then 1 else 0) := by
    intro e f
    have hsub : ∀ v : Fin 11, (if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) *
        (if v ∈ f.vertices then 1 else 0) =
          if v ∈ e.vertices ∩ f.vertices then 1 else 0 := by
      intro v
      by_cases h1 : v ∈ e.vertices <;> by_cases h2 : v ∈ f.vertices <;> simp [h1, h2]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => hsub v, ← Finset.card_filter,
      Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
    rfl
  have hr : ∀ v : Fin 11, (s.filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card ^ 2 =
      ∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s, (if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) *
        (if v ∈ f.vertices then 1 else 0) := by
    intro v
    rw [sq, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  calc (∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s, vmeet e f)
      = ∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s, ∑ v : Fin 11,
          (if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) * (if v ∈ f.vertices then 1 else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun f _ => hl e f
    _ = ∑ e ∈ s, ∑ v : Fin 11, ∑ f ∈ s,
          (if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) * (if v ∈ f.vertices then 1 else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ v : Fin 11, ∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s,
          (if v ∈ e.vertices then 1 else 0) * (if v ∈ f.vertices then 1 else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ v : Fin 11, (s.filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card ^ 2 :=
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => hr v).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.coe_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_map (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) (e : Edge11) :
    ((map σ e : Edge11) : Sym2 (Fin 11)) = Sym2.map σ (e : Sym2 (Fin 11))
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) : Function.Injective (map σ)
proof:
:=
  (mapEquiv σ).injective

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.map_surjective
statement: theorem map_surjective (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) : Function.Surjective (map σ)
proof:
:=
  (mapEquiv σ).surjective

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vertices_map
statement:
theorem vertices_map (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) (e : Edge11) :
    (map σ e).vertices = e.vertices.image σ
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [mem_vertices, coe_map, Sym2.mem_map, Finset.mem_image]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.mem_vertices_map
statement:
theorem mem_vertices_map {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)} {v : Fin 11} {e : Edge11} :
    v ∈ (map σ e).vertices ↔ σ.symm v ∈ e.vertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertices_map]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    simpa using ha
  · intro h
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨σ.symm v, h, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Edge11.vmeet_map
statement:
theorem vmeet_map (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) (e f : Edge11) :
    vmeet (map σ e) (map σ f) = vmeet e f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [vmeet, vmeet, vertices_map, vertices_map,
    ← Finset.image_inter _ _ σ.injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ σ.injective]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.edge_rep
statement: theorem edge_rep (e : Edge11) : pairCount C.g e e = 9
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Edge11.exists_mem_vertices e
  have hemem : e ∈ Edge11.star v := Edge11.mem_star.mpr hv
  set F : Finset Edge11 := (Edge11.star v).erase e with hF
  have hFcard : F.card = 9 := by
    rw [hF, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hemem, Edge11.card_star]

  have hone : ∀ f ∈ F, pairCount C.g e f = 1 := by
    intro f hf
    have hfe : f ≠ e := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hf).1
    have hvf : v ∈ f.vertices :=
      Edge11.mem_star.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hf)
    exact C.cherry_exact e f (Ne.symm hfe) (Edge11.vmeet_eq_one (Ne.symm hfe) hv hvf)

  have hother : ∀ i ∈ starFinset C.g e, (F ∩ C.g i).card = 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hei : e ∈ C.g i := by simpa [starFinset] using hi
    have hset : F ∩ C.g i = ((C.g i).filter fun f => v ∈ f.vertices).erase e := by
      ext f
      simp only [hF, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_filter,
        Edge11.mem_star]
      tauto
    rw [hset, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hei, hv⟩),
      C.two_regular i v]
  have hsum := sum_star_inter_card C.g e F
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hother, Finset.sum_congr rfl hone, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.sum_const, hFcard] at hsum
  rw [pairCount_self]
  simpa using hsum

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.pairCount_add_vmeet
statement:
theorem pairCount_add_vmeet (e f : Edge11) :
    pairCount C.g e f + Edge11.vmeet e f = 2 + if e = f then 9 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hef : e = f
  · subst hef
    rw [C.edge_rep e, Edge11.vmeet_self]
    simp
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Edge11.vmeet e f) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [C.disjoint_twice e f h0, h0]
      simp [hef]
    · have h1 : Edge11.vmeet e f = 1 := le_antisymm (Edge11.vmeet_le_one hef) hpos
      rw [C.cherry_exact e f hef h1, h1]
      simp [hef]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.block_card
statement: theorem block_card (i : Fin 45) : (C.g i).card = 11
proof:
:= by
  have h := Edge11.sum_star_card (C.g i)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => C.two_regular i v,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => Edge11.card_vertices e, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.sum_inter_block
statement:
theorem sum_inter_block (i : Fin 45) :
    (∑ j, ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card) = 99
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_inter_card C.g (C.g i)
  have hstar : ∀ e ∈ C.g i, (starFinset C.g e).card = 9 := by
    intro e _
    rw [← pairCount_self, C.edge_rep e]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hstar, Finset.sum_const, C.block_card i] at h
  simpa using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.sum_inter_block_sq
statement:
theorem sum_inter_block_sq (i : Fin 45) :
    (∑ j, ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card ^ 2) = 297
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := sum_inter_card_sq C.g (C.g i)

  have hvm : (∑ e ∈ C.g i, ∑ f ∈ C.g i, Edge11.vmeet e f) = 44 := by
    rw [Edge11.sum_vmeet, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => by
      rw [C.two_regular i v], Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    norm_num

  have htot : (∑ e ∈ C.g i, ∑ f ∈ C.g i,
      (pairCount C.g e f + Edge11.vmeet e f)) = 341 := by
    have hcell : ∀ e ∈ C.g i,
        (∑ f ∈ C.g i, (pairCount C.g e f + Edge11.vmeet e f)) = 31 := by
      intro e he
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun f _ => C.pairCount_add_vmeet e f,
        Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, C.block_card i,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq (C.g i) e (fun _ => 9), if_pos he]
      norm_num
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcell, Finset.sum_const, C.block_card i]
    norm_num
  have hsplit : (∑ e ∈ C.g i, ∑ f ∈ C.g i, (pairCount C.g e f + Edge11.vmeet e f)) =
      (∑ e ∈ C.g i, ∑ f ∈ C.g i, pairCount C.g e f) +
        ∑ e ∈ C.g i, ∑ f ∈ C.g i, Edge11.vmeet e f := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib
  rw [hsplit, hvm] at htot
  rw [h]
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.pair_meet
statement: theorem pair_meet (i j : Fin 45) (hij : i ≠ j) : ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdiag : ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g i)).card = 11 := by
    rw [Finset.inter_self, C.block_card i]
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card) = 88 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
      (fun j => ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [C.sum_inter_block i, hdiag] at h
    omega
  have hsq : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card ^ 2) = 176 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
      (fun j => ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card ^ 2) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [C.sum_inter_block_sq i, hdiag] at h
    omega
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.erase i).card = 44 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      4 * ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g k)).card ≤ ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g k)).card ^ 2 + 4 :=
    fun k _ => four_mul_le_sq_add_four _
  have heq : (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, 4 * ((C.g i) ∩ (C.g k)).card) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (((C.g i) ∩ (C.g k)).card ^ 2 + 4) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsq, Finset.sum_const, hcard]
    norm_num
  have hpt := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le hle).mp heq j
    (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hij, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)
  have hz : ((((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card : ℤ) - 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have hcast : (4 : ℤ) * (((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card : ℤ) =
        (((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card : ℤ) ^ 2 + 4 := by exact_mod_cast hpt
    linear_combination -hcast
  have htwo : (((C.g i) ∩ (C.g j)).card : ℤ) = 2 := by
    have := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hz
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast htwo

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.pairCount_image
statement:
theorem pairCount_image (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) (g : Fin 45 → Finset Edge11)
    (e f : Edge11) :
    pairCount (fun i => (g i).image (Edge11.map σ)) (Edge11.map σ e) (Edge11.map σ f) =
      pairCount g e f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj := Edge11.map_injective σ
  refine congrArg Finset.card (Finset.filter_congr fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [hinj.mem_finset_image, hinj.mem_finset_image]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CherryCover.relabel_g
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabel_g (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 11)) (C : CherryCover) (i : Fin 45) :
    (C.relabel σ).g i = (C.g i).image (Edge11.map σ)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.cherryCover_toDerived45
statement: theorem cherryCover_toDerived45 (C : CherryCover) : C.toDerived45.block = C.g
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.adj_iff_vmeet_edgeEquiv
statement:
theorem adj_iff_vmeet_edgeEquiv (p q : P) :
    E.blockGraph.Adj p q ↔ Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q) = 1
proof:
:=
  E.exists_equiv_edge11.choose_spec.1 p q

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv
statement:
theorem pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv (p q : P) :
    E.pairMult p q + Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q)
      = 2 + if p = q then 9 else 0
proof:
:=
  E.exists_equiv_edge11.choose_spec.2 p q

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.mem_coverMember
statement:
theorem mem_coverMember {i : Fin 45} {e : Edge11} :
    e ∈ E.coverMember i ↔ E.edgeEquiv.symm e ∈ E.block i
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverMember]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    simpa using hp
  · intro h
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨E.edgeEquiv.symm e, h, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_coverMember
statement: theorem card_coverMember (i : Fin 45) : (E.coverMember i).card = 11
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverMember, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ E.edgeEquiv.injective, E.block_card i]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pairCount_coverMember
statement:
theorem pairCount_coverMember (e f : Edge11) :
    pairCount E.coverMember e f = E.pairMult (E.edgeEquiv.symm e) (E.edgeEquiv.symm f)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => e ∈ E.coverMember i ∧ f ∈ E.coverMember i)
      = Finset.univ.filter fun i =>
          E.edgeEquiv.symm e ∈ E.block i ∧ E.edgeEquiv.symm f ∈ E.block i := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, E.mem_coverMember]
  exact congrArg Finset.card hset

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_coverMember
statement:
theorem sum_coverMember {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (i : Fin 45) (F : Edge11 → M) :
    (∑ e ∈ E.coverMember i, F e) = ∑ p ∈ E.block i, F (E.edgeEquiv p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coverMember, Finset.sum_image]
  exact fun x _ y _ h => E.edgeEquiv.injective h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_inter_block_sq
statement:
theorem sum_inter_block_sq (i : Fin 45) :
    (∑ j, ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card ^ 2) = 297
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  have hoff : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 45)).erase i,
      ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card ^ 2 = 4 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [E.pair_meet i j (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)]
    norm_num
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hoff, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    Finset.inter_self, E.block_card i]
  norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult_block
statement:
theorem sum_pairMult_block (i : Fin 45) :
    (∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i, E.pairMult p q) = 297
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i, E.pairMult p q)
      = ∑ j, ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card ^ 2 :=
    (sum_inter_card_sq E.block (E.block i)).symm
  rw [h, E.sum_inter_block_sq i]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_vmeet_coverMember
statement:
theorem sum_vmeet_coverMember (i : Fin 45) :
    (∑ e ∈ E.coverMember i, ∑ f ∈ E.coverMember i, Edge11.vmeet e f) = 44
proof:
:= by
  have hdouble : (∑ e ∈ E.coverMember i, ∑ f ∈ E.coverMember i, Edge11.vmeet e f)
      = ∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i,
          Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q) := by
    rw [E.sum_coverMember i fun e => ∑ f ∈ E.coverMember i, Edge11.vmeet e f]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => E.sum_coverMember i _
  have htot : (∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i,
      (E.pairMult p q + Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q))) = 341 := by
    have hcell : ∀ p ∈ E.block i, (∑ q ∈ E.block i,
        (E.pairMult p q + Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q))) = 31 := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => E.pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv p q,
        Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, E.block_card i,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq (E.block i) p (fun _ => 9), if_pos hp]
      norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcell, Finset.sum_const, E.block_card i]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hsplit : (∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i,
      (E.pairMult p q + Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q)))
      = (∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i, E.pairMult p q)
        + ∑ p ∈ E.block i, ∑ q ∈ E.block i,
            Edge11.vmeet (E.edgeEquiv p) (E.edgeEquiv q) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib
  rw [hsplit, E.sum_pairMult_block i] at htot
  rw [hdouble]
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.two_regular_coverMember
statement:
theorem two_regular_coverMember (i : Fin 45) (v : Fin 11) :
    ((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ w : Fin 11,
      ((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices).card) = 22 := by
    have h := Edge11.sum_star_card (E.coverMember i)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => Edge11.card_vertices e, Finset.sum_const,
      E.card_coverMember i] at h
    simpa using h
  have hsq : (∑ w : Fin 11,
      ((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices).card ^ 2) = 44 := by
    rw [← Edge11.sum_vmeet (E.coverMember i), E.sum_vmeet_coverMember i]
  have hle : ∀ w ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)),
      4 * ((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices).card
        ≤ ((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices).card ^ 2 + 4 :=
    fun w _ => four_mul_le_sq_add_four _
  have heq : (∑ w : Fin 11,
      4 * ((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices).card)
      = ∑ w : Fin 11,
          (((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => w ∈ e.vertices).card ^ 2 + 4) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsq, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hpt := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le hle).mp heq v (Finset.mem_univ v)
  have hz : ((((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card : ℤ) - 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have hcast : (4 : ℤ) *
        ((((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card : ℤ))
        = (((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card : ℤ) ^ 2 + 4 := by
      exact_mod_cast hpt
    linear_combination -hcast
  have htwo : ((((E.coverMember i).filter fun e => v ∈ e.vertices).card : ℤ)) = 2 := by
    have := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hz
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast htwo

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.cherry_exact_coverMember
statement:
theorem cherry_exact_coverMember (e f : Edge11) (hef : e ≠ f)
    (hvm : Edge11.vmeet e f = 1) : pairCount E.coverMember e f = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : E.edgeEquiv.symm e ≠ E.edgeEquiv.symm f := fun hcon =>
    hef (E.edgeEquiv.symm.injective hcon)
  have h := E.pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv (E.edgeEquiv.symm e) (E.edgeEquiv.symm f)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hvm, if_neg hne] at h
  rw [E.pairCount_coverMember]
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.disjoint_twice_coverMember
statement:
theorem disjoint_twice_coverMember (e f : Edge11) (hvm : Edge11.vmeet e f = 0) :
    pairCount E.coverMember e f = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hef : e ≠ f := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [Edge11.vmeet_self] at hvm
    exact absurd hvm (by norm_num)
  have hne : E.edgeEquiv.symm e ≠ E.edgeEquiv.symm f := fun hcon =>
    hef (E.edgeEquiv.symm.injective hcon)
  have h := E.pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv (E.edgeEquiv.symm e) (E.edgeEquiv.symm f)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hvm, if_neg hne] at h
  rw [E.pairCount_coverMember]
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.toCherryCover_g
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCherryCover_g (i : Fin 45) :
    E.toCherryCover.g i = (E.block i).image E.edgeEquiv
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.isEmpty_residual165_of_toCherryCover
statement:
theorem isEmpty_residual165_of_toCherryCover
    (h : IsEmpty (Residual165 E.toCherryCover.toDerived45)) : IsEmpty (Residual165 E)
proof:
:=
  isEmpty_residual165_of_iso E.isoToCherryCover h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_localEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinate_mem_localEdges (S : Finset P) (p : P)
    (q : {q : P // q ≠ p}) :
    K.coordinate p q ∈ K.localEdges S p ↔ (q : P) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  simp [localEdges]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.card_localEdges
statement:
theorem card_localEdges (S : Finset P) (p : P) :
    (K.localEdges S p).card = (S.erase p).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.card_bij
    (fun e _ => ((K.coordinate p).symm e : P)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro e he
    rw [Finset.mem_erase]
    exact ⟨((K.coordinate p).symm e).property,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2⟩
  · intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ h
    have hsub : (K.coordinate p).symm e₁ = (K.coordinate p).symm e₂ :=
      Subtype.ext h
    exact (K.coordinate p).symm.injective hsub
  · intro q hq
    let q' : {r : P // r ≠ p} := ⟨q, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).1⟩
    refine ⟨K.coordinate p q', ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [K.coordinate_mem_localEdges]
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).2
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val ((K.coordinate p).symm_apply_apply q')

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.odd_vmeet_iff_eq_one
statement:
theorem odd_vmeet_iff_eq_one (e f : Edge11) :
    Odd (Edge11.vmeet e f) ↔ Edge11.vmeet e f = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hef : e = f
  · subst f
    rw [Edge11.vmeet_self]
    norm_num
  · have hle := Edge11.vmeet_le_one hef
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      omega
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.IsInAdjacencyKernel.isInLineKernel
statement:
theorem IsInAdjacencyKernel.isInLineKernel {S : Finset P}
    (hS : K.IsInAdjacencyKernel S) : K.IsInLineKernel S
proof:
:= by
  intro p e
  rw [Finset.even_sum_iff_even_card_odd]
  simpa [odd_vmeet_iff_eq_one] using hS p e

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.IsInLineKernel.isLocallyEulerian
statement:
theorem IsInLineKernel.isLocallyEulerian {S : Finset P}
    (hS : K.IsInLineKernel S) : K.IsLocallyEulerian S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro p v
  let T := K.localEdges S p
  have hsumEven : Even (∑ u : Fin 11, arcDegree T u) := by
    rw [sum_arcDegree]
    exact ⟨T.card, by omega⟩
  by_contra hv
  have hvodd : Odd (arcDegree T v) := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hv
  have hallOdd : ∀ u : Fin 11, Odd (arcDegree T u) := by
    intro u
    by_cases huv : u = v
    · simpa [huv] using hvodd
    · have hpairsum : Even (arcDegree T u + arcDegree T v) := by
        have hline := hS p (Edge11.mk' huv)
        rw [sum_vmeet_left, Edge11.vertices_mk',
          Finset.sum_pair huv] at hline
        exact hline
      have hparity : Even (arcDegree T u) ↔ Even (arcDegree T v) :=
        Nat.even_add.mp hpairsum
      exact Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp fun hu => hv (hparity.mp hu)
  have hoddSet :
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).filter fun u =>
        Odd (arcDegree T u)).card = 11 := by
    simp [hallOdd, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hoddCardEven : Even
      (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).filter fun u =>
        Odd (arcDegree T u)).card) := by
    rw [← Finset.even_sum_iff_even_card_odd]
    simpa using hsumEven
  rw [hoddSet] at hoddCardEven
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hoddCardEven
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.exists_companion_of_even_degree
statement:
theorem exists_companion_of_even_degree {T : Finset Edge11} {e : Edge11}
    {v : Fin 11} (he : e ∈ T) (hv : v ∈ e.vertices)
    (heven : Even (arcDegree T v)) :
    ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ e ∧ v ∈ f.vertices
proof:
:= by
  have hefilter : e ∈ T.filter fun f => v ∈ f.vertices :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hv⟩
  have hpos : 0 < arcDegree T v := by
    rw [arcDegree]
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨e, hefilter⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := heven
  have htwo : 2 ≤ arcDegree T v := by omega
  have hcard : 1 < (T.filter fun f => v ∈ f.vertices).card := by
    rw [arcDegree] at htwo
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfe⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_ne hcard e
  exact ⟨f, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).1, hfe, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).2⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.vmeet_eq_zero_of_endpoint_degrees_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hpos : 0 < Edge11.vmeet (Edge11.mk' huv) f := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
  have hinter : 0 < ((Edge11.mk' huv).vertices ∩ f.vertices).card := by
    simpa [Edge11.vmeet] using hpos
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hinter
  rw [Finset.mem_inter, Edge11.vertices_mk'] at hw
  have hwdeg : 0 < arcDegree T w := by
    rw [arcDegree]
    exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨f, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf, hw.2⟩⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hw.1 with rfl | hwv
  · omega
  · have : w = v := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hwv
    subst this
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.unusedVertices_card_le_one
statement:
theorem unusedVertices_card_le_one {S : Finset P}
    (hS : K.IsLocallyEulerian S) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).filter fun v =>
      arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v = 0).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hcard
  have htwo : 1 < ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).filter fun v =>
      arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v = 0).card := by omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp htwo
  have hu0 : arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) u = 0 :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2
  have hv0 : arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v = 0 :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2

  let e : Edge11 := Edge11.mk' huv
  let x' : {q : P // q ≠ p} := (K.coordinate p).symm e
  let x : P := x'
  have hxp : x ≠ p := x'.property
  have hxcoord : K.coordinate p x' = e := (K.coordinate p).apply_symm_apply e

  have hxS : x ∉ S := by
    intro hxmem
    have hemem : e ∈ K.localEdges S p := by
      rw [← hxcoord, K.coordinate_mem_localEdges]
      exact hxmem
    have hupos : 0 < arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) u := by
      rw [arcDegree]
      exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨e, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hemem, by
        simp [e, Edge11.vertices_mk']⟩⟩
    omega

  let p' : {q : P // q ≠ x} := ⟨p, hxp.symm⟩
  let ep : Edge11 := K.coordinate x p'
  have hepmem : ep ∈ K.localEdges S x := by
    change K.coordinate x p' ∈ K.localEdges S x
    rw [K.coordinate_mem_localEdges]
    exact hp
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Edge11.exists_mem_vertices ep
  obtain ⟨f, hfmem, hfne, hwf⟩ :=
    exists_companion_of_even_degree hepmem hw (hS x w)

  let r' : {q : P // q ≠ x} := (K.coordinate x).symm f
  let r : P := r'
  have hrx : r ≠ x := r'.property
  have hrcoord : K.coordinate x r' = f := (K.coordinate x).apply_symm_apply f
  have hrS : r ∈ S := by
    rw [← K.coordinate_mem_localEdges S x r', hrcoord]
    exact hfmem
  have hrp : r ≠ p := by
    intro hrp
    apply hfne
    rw [← hrcoord]
    exact congrArg (K.coordinate x) (Subtype.ext hrp)

  let rAtP : {q : P // q ≠ p} := ⟨r, hrp⟩
  have hrmem : K.coordinate p rAtP ∈ K.localEdges S p := by
    rw [K.coordinate_mem_localEdges]
    exact hrS
  have hxmeet : Edge11.vmeet ep f = 1 :=
    Edge11.vmeet_eq_one hfne.symm hw hwf
  have hpmeet : Edge11.vmeet e (K.coordinate p rAtP) = 1 := by
    have hr'eq : (⟨r, hrx⟩ : {q : P // q ≠ x}) = r' := Subtype.ext rfl
    have hxmeet' :
        Edge11.vmeet (K.coordinate x ⟨p, hxp.symm⟩)
          (K.coordinate x ⟨r, hrx⟩) = 1 := by
      simpa [ep, p', hr'eq, hrcoord] using hxmeet
    have hcoh := (K.coherent hxp.symm hrx hrp).mp hxmeet'
    have hx'eq : (⟨x, hxp⟩ : {q : P // q ≠ p}) = x' := Subtype.ext rfl
    simpa [rAtP, hx'eq, hxcoord] using hcoh
  have hpzero : Edge11.vmeet e (K.coordinate p rAtP) = 0 :=
    vmeet_eq_zero_of_endpoint_degrees_zero huv hu0 hv0 hrmem
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.ten_le_card_localEdges
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let used : Finset (Fin 11) :=
    Finset.univ.filter fun v => arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v ≠ 0
  let unused : Finset (Fin 11) :=
    Finset.univ.filter fun v => arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v = 0
  have hunused : unused.card ≤ 1 := by
    simpa [unused] using K.unusedVertices_card_le_one hS hp
  have hsplit : unused.card + used.card = 11 := by
    have h := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)))
      (p := fun v => arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v = 0)
    simpa [unused, used, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using h
  have hused : 10 ≤ used.card := by omega
  have hdegree : ∀ v ∈ used, 2 ≤ arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v := by
    intro v hv
    have hne : arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v ≠ 0 :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hS p v
    omega
  have hsumUsed : 2 * used.card ≤
      ∑ v ∈ used, arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v := by
    calc
      2 * used.card = ∑ v ∈ used, 2 := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ used, arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun v hv => hdegree v hv
  have hsumAll : (∑ v ∈ used, arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v) ≤
      ∑ v : Fin 11, arcDegree (K.localEdges S p) v := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hincidence := sum_arcDegree (K.localEdges S p)
  rw [hincidence] at hsumAll
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.eleven_le_card
statement:
theorem eleven_le_card {S : Finset P} (hS : K.IsLocallyEulerian S)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ S) : 11 ≤ S.card
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal := K.ten_le_card_localEdges hS hp
  rw [K.card_localEdges, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hp] at hlocal
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse
statement:
theorem coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse (p : Fin 56)
    (q r : {x : Fin 56 // x ≠ p}) :
    Edge11.vmeet (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p q)
        (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p r) = 1 ↔
      Q.sparseTriple p q r
proof:
:= by
  let qp : Punctured p := neEquivPunctured p q
  let rp : Punctured p := neEquivPunctured p r
  change Edge11.vmeet ((Q.derived45 p).edgeEquiv qp)
      ((Q.derived45 p).edgeEquiv rp) = 1 ↔ Q.sparseTriple p q r
  calc
    _ ↔ (Q.derived45 p).blockGraph.Adj qp rp :=
      ((Q.derived45 p).adj_iff_vmeet_edgeEquiv qp rp).symm
    _ ↔ _ := by
      change (Q.tripleLink p).Adj qp rp ↔ Q.sparseTriple p q r
      simpa [qp, rp, neEquivPunctured] using
        (@Q.tripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple p qp rp)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.ambientTripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple
statement:
theorem ambientTripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple {p q r : Fin 56} :
    (Q.ambientTripleLink p).Adj q r ↔ Q.sparseTriple p q r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [ambientTripleLink, SimpleGraph.map_adj]
    rintro ⟨q', r', hqr, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Q.tripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple.mp hqr
  · intro h
    have hqp : q ≠ p := h.1.symm
    have hrp : r ≠ p := h.2.1.symm
    let q' : Punctured p :=
      ⟨q, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hqp, Finset.mem_univ q⟩⟩
    let r' : Punctured p :=
      ⟨r, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hrp, Finset.mem_univ r⟩⟩
    have hlink : (Q.tripleLink p).Adj q' r' := by
      apply Q.tripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple.mpr
      simpa [q', r'] using h
    rw [ambientTripleLink, SimpleGraph.map_adj]
    exact ⟨q', r', hlink, rfl, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_tripleLink_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem card_tripleLink_edgeFinset (p : Fin 56) :
    (Q.tripleLink p).edgeFinset.card = 495
proof:
:= by
  have hdegree := (Q.tripleLink_isSRGWith p).regular
  have hsum := (Q.tripleLink p).sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  simp_rw [hdegree.degree_eq] at hsum
  simp at hsum
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_ambientTripleLink_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem card_ambientTripleLink_edgeFinset (p : Fin 56) :
    (Q.ambientTripleLink p).edgeFinset.card = 495
proof:
:= by
  change ((Q.tripleLink p).map (puncturedEmbedding p)).edgeFinset.card = 495
  rw [SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_map, Q.card_tripleLink_edgeFinset]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.sparsePairColumnCount_mk
statement:
theorem sparsePairColumnCount_mk (S : Finset (Fin 56)) (q r : Fin 56) :
    Q.sparsePairColumnCount S s(q, r) =
      Q.sparseCompletionCount S q r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold sparsePairColumnCount sparseCompletionCount
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  ext p
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
  rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet,
    Q.ambientTripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple]
  exact and_congr_right fun _ => Q.sparseTriple_rotate p q r

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.sparseKernel_column_even
proof:
:= by
  induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
  | _ q r =>
      rw [Q.sparsePairColumnCount_mk]
      exact hS q r

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.sum_sparsePairColumnCount
statement:
theorem sum_sparsePairColumnCount (S : Finset (Fin 56)) :
    (∑ e : Sym2 (Fin 56), Q.sparsePairColumnCount S e) =
      495 * S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let rel : Sym2 (Fin 56) → Fin 56 → Prop := fun e p =>
    e ∈ (Q.ambientTripleLink p).edgeFinset
  have hdouble := Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow
    (r := rel) (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Sym2 (Fin 56)))) (t := S)
  calc
    _ = ∑ p ∈ S,
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Sym2 (Fin 56))).filter fun e =>
          rel e p).card := by
      simpa only [sparsePairColumnCount, rel,
        Finset.bipartiteAbove, Finset.bipartiteBelow] using hdouble
    _ = ∑ p ∈ S, (Q.ambientTripleLink p).edgeFinset.card := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      apply congrArg Finset.card
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, rel]
    _ = 495 * S.card := by
      simp [card_tripleLink_edgeFinset Q, mul_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.sparseKernelSupport_card_even
statement:
theorem sparseKernelSupport_card_even {S : Finset (Fin 56)}
    (hS : Q.IsSparseKernelSupport S) : Even S.card
proof:
:= by
  have htotal : Even
      (∑ e : Sym2 (Fin 56), Q.sparsePairColumnCount S e) := by
    exact Finset.even_sum _ fun e _ => Q.sparseKernel_column_even hS e
  rw [Q.sum_sparsePairColumnCount] at htotal
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := htotal
  use k - 247 * S.card
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.pairThirdMatrix_transpose_mulVec_support_apply
statement:
theorem pairThirdMatrix_transpose_mulVec_support_apply
    (S : Finset (Fin 56)) (e : Sym2 (Fin 56)) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.transpose Q.pairThirdMatrix) (supportVector S) e =
      (Q.sparsePairColumnCount S e : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, pairThirdMatrix, supportVector]
  calc
    (∑ p : Fin 56,
        (if e ∈ (Q.ambientTripleLink p).edgeFinset then 1 else 0) *
          if p ∈ S then 1 else 0) =
        ∑ p : Fin 56,
          if p ∈ S ∧ e ∈ (Q.ambientTripleLink p).edgeFinset
          then 1 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      by_cases hpS : p ∈ S <;> simp [hpS]
    _ = (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 56)).filter fun p =>
          p ∈ S ∧
            e ∈ (Q.ambientTripleLink p).edgeFinset).card : ZMod 2) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_boole]
    _ = (Q.sparsePairColumnCount S e : ZMod 2) := by
      congr 1
      unfold sparsePairColumnCount
      apply congrArg Finset.card
      ext p
      simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.isPairThirdKernelSupport_iff_columns_even
statement:
theorem isPairThirdKernelSupport_iff_columns_even
    (S : Finset (Fin 56)) :
    Q.IsPairThirdKernelSupport S ↔
      ∀ e : Sym2 (Fin 56), Even (Q.sparsePairColumnCount S e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e
    have he := congrFun h e
    rw [Q.pairThirdMatrix_transpose_mulVec_support_apply] at he
    simpa using (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even.mp he)
  · intro h
    funext e
    rw [Q.pairThirdMatrix_transpose_mulVec_support_apply]
    exact ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even.mpr (h e)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.isPairThirdKernelSupport_iff_sparseKernelSupport
statement:
theorem isPairThirdKernelSupport_iff_sparseKernelSupport
    (S : Finset (Fin 56)) :
    Q.IsPairThirdKernelSupport S ↔ Q.IsSparseKernelSupport S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q.isPairThirdKernelSupport_iff_columns_even]
  constructor
  · intro h p q
    rw [← Q.sparsePairColumnCount_mk]
    exact h s(p, q)
  · intro h e
    exact Q.sparseKernel_column_even h e

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_filter_vmeet_eq_card_filter_sparse
statement:
theorem card_filter_vmeet_eq_card_filter_sparse (S : Finset (Fin 56))
    (p : Fin 56) (e : Edge11) :
    ((Q.toCoherentK11System.localEdges S p).filter fun f =>
      Edge11.vmeet e f = 1).card =
      Q.sparseCompletionCount S p
        ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm e : Fin 56)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold sparseCompletionCount
  let q' : {q : Fin 56 // q ≠ p} :=
    (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm e
  have hqcoord : Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p q' = e :=
    (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).apply_symm_apply e
  refine Finset.card_bij
    (fun f _ => ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm f : Fin 56)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro f hf
    let r' : {r : Fin 56 // r ≠ p} :=
      (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm f
    have hrcoord : Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p r' = f :=
      (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).apply_symm_apply f
    have hfparts := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hfparts.1).2
    · apply (Q.coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse p q' r').mp
      simpa [hqcoord, hrcoord] using hfparts.2
  · intro f₁ hf₁ f₂ hf₂ hval
    have hsub :
        (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm f₁ =
          (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm f₂ := Subtype.ext hval
    exact (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm.injective hsub
  · intro r hr
    have hrp : r ≠ p := by
      have hsparse := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
      exact hsparse.2.1.symm
    let r' : {x : Fin 56 // x ≠ p} := ⟨r, hrp⟩
    refine ⟨Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p r', ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_localEdges]
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1
      · rw [← hqcoord]
        apply (Q.coordinate_vmeet_iff_sparse p q' r').mpr
        simpa [q'] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val
        ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm_apply_apply r')

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.sparseKernel_isInAdjacencyKernel
proof:
:= by
  intro p e
  rw [Q.card_filter_vmeet_eq_card_filter_sparse S p e]
  exact hS p ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm e : Fin 56)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.kernelSupport_unusedVertices_card_le_one
statement:
theorem kernelSupport_unusedVertices_card_le_one {S : Finset (Fin 56)}
    (hS : Q.IsEulerianKernelSupport S) {p : Fin 56} (hp : p ∈ S) :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 11)).filter fun v =>
      arcDegree (Q.toCoherentK11System.localEdges S p) v = 0).card ≤ 1

  Q.toCoherentK11System.unusedVertices_card_le_one hS hp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.eleven_le_card_kernelSupport

:=
  Q.toCoherentK11System.eleven_le_card hS hp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.twelve_le_card_kernelSupport
proof:
:= by

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TernaryStarRecovery.complement_mem_of_three_columns
statement:
theorem complement_mem_of_three_columns
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 3) V]
    (C : Submodule (ZMod 3) V) (u a b c : V)
    (hab : (2 : ZMod 3) • u - a - b ∈ C)
    (hac : (2 : ZMod 3) • u - a - c ∈ C)
    (hbc : (2 : ZMod 3) • u - b - c ∈ C) :
    u - a ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.add_mem (C.sub_mem (C.neg_mem hab) hac) hbc
  have heq : u - a =
      -((2 : ZMod 3) • u - a - b) -
        ((2 : ZMod 3) • u - a - c) +
        ((2 : ZMod 3) • u - b - c) := by
    match_scalars <;> decide
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TernaryStarRecovery.complement_dotProduct
statement:
theorem complement_dotProduct (B D : Finset (Fin 56)) :
    dotProduct (complementVector B) (complementVector D) =
      ((Bᶜ ∩ Dᶜ).card : ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold dotProduct complementVector
  calc
    (∑ p : Fin 56, (if p ∈ B then 0 else 1) *
        (if p ∈ D then 0 else 1) : ZMod 3) =
        ∑ p : Fin 56, if p ∈ Bᶜ ∩ Dᶜ then 1 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      by_cases hB : p ∈ B <;> by_cases hD : p ∈ D <;> simp [hB, hD]
    _ = _ := by
      simp
      congr 1
      apply congrArg Finset.card
      ext p
      simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TernaryStarRecovery.overlap_eq_two_mod_three
statement:
theorem overlap_eq_two_mod_three
    (B D : Finset (Fin 56)) (hB : B.card = 11) (hD : D.card = 11)
    (horth : dotProduct (complementVector B) (complementVector D) = 0) :
    ((B ∩ D).card : ZMod 3) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : (Bᶜ ∩ Dᶜ).card = 34 + (B ∩ D).card := by
    have hc := Finset.card_compl (B ∪ D)
    have hu := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter B D
    have hle := Finset.card_le_univ (B ∪ D)
    rw [Finset.compl_union] at hc
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hc hle
    omega
  rw [complement_dotProduct, hsize, Nat.cast_add,
    show ((34 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = 1 by decide] at horth
  calc
    ((B ∩ D).card : ZMod 3) = (1 + ((B ∩ D).card : ZMod 3)) - 1 := by ring
    _ = -1 := by rw [horth]; simp
    _ = 2 := by decide

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.derived_pairMult_eq_tripleMultiplicity
statement:
theorem derived_pairMult_eq_tripleMultiplicity (z : Fin 56)
    (p q : Punctured z) :
    (Q.derived45 z).pairMult p q = Q.tripleMultiplicity z p.val q.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Derived45.pairMult, pairCount]
  simp only [ConcreteQSD56.derived45, mem_restrictedBlock]
  have hcard :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin 45 =>
        Q.matrix (p : Fin 56) (Q.derivedEnum z i) = 1 ∧
          Q.matrix (q : Fin 56) (Q.derivedEnum z i) = 1).card =
      ((Q.derivedIndex z).filter fun B =>
        Q.matrix (p : Fin 56) B = 1 ∧ Q.matrix (q : Fin 56) B = 1).card :=
    card_filter_of_enum (Q.derivedEnum z) (Q.derivedIndex z)
      derivedEnum_injective derivedEnum_range
        (fun B : Fin 210 =>
          Q.matrix (p : Fin 56) B = 1 ∧ Q.matrix (q : Fin 56) B = 1)
  rw [hcard]
  unfold tripleMultiplicity
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  ext B
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_derivedIndex, blocksThroughTriple,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.tripleMultiplicity_cases
proof:
:= by
  let q' : Punctured p :=
    ⟨q, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hpq.symm, Finset.mem_univ q⟩⟩
  let r' : Punctured p :=
    ⟨r, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hpr.symm, Finset.mem_univ r⟩⟩
  have hne : q' ≠ r' := fun h => hqr (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have h := (Q.derived45 p).pairMult_cases hne
  rw [Q.derived_pairMult_eq_tripleMultiplicity p q' r'] at h
  exact h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.tripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple
statement:
theorem tripleLink_adj_iff_sparseTriple {z : Fin 56} {p q : Punctured z} :

proof:
:= by
  rw [tripleLink, Derived45.blockGraph_adj,
    Q.derived_pairMult_eq_tripleMultiplicity z p q]
  have hpz : p.val ≠ z := (Finset.mem_erase.mp p.2).1
  have hqz : q.val ≠ z := (Finset.mem_erase.mp q.2).1
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hpq, hmult⟩
    exact ⟨hpz.symm, hqz.symm, fun h => hpq (Subtype.ext h), hmult⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, -, hpq, hmult⟩
    exact ⟨fun h => hpq (congrArg Subtype.val h), hmult⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.pairCount_self
statement:
theorem pairCount_self {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Finset P) (p : P) :

proof:
:= by

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.pairCount_comm
statement:
theorem pairCount_comm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Finset P) (p q : P) :
    pairCount f p q = pairCount f q p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairCount]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact and_comm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_pairCount_univ
statement:
theorem sum_pairCount_univ [Fintype P] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → Finset P)
    (p : P) :
    (∑ q : P, pairCount f p q) = ∑ i ∈ starFinset f p, (f i).card
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ q : P,
      pairCount f p q = ∑ i : ι, if p ∈ f i ∧ q ∈ f i then 1 else 0 := fun q =>
    Finset.card_filter _ _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => hterm q, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [starFinset, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hpi : p ∈ f i <;> simp [hpi]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_pairCount_mul_univ₂
statement:
theorem sum_pairCount_mul_univ₂ [Fintype P] {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (f : ι → Finset P) (g : κ → Finset P) (p q : P) :
    (∑ r : P, pairCount f p r * pairCount g q r) =
      ∑ i ∈ starFinset f p, ∑ n ∈ starFinset g q, ((f i) ∩ (g n)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ r : P, pairCount f p r * pairCount g q r =
      ∑ i : ι, ∑ n : κ, (if p ∈ f i ∧ r ∈ f i then 1 else 0) *
        (if q ∈ g n ∧ r ∈ g n then 1 else 0) := by
    intro r
    rw [pairCount, pairCount, Finset.card_filter, Finset.card_filter,
      Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => hterm r, Finset.sum_comm]
  have hswap : ∀ i : ι,
      (∑ r : P, ∑ n : κ, (if p ∈ f i ∧ r ∈ f i then 1 else 0) *
          (if q ∈ g n ∧ r ∈ g n then 1 else 0)) =
        ∑ n : κ, ∑ r : P, (if p ∈ f i ∧ r ∈ f i then 1 else 0) *
          (if q ∈ g n ∧ r ∈ g n then 1 else 0) := fun _ => Finset.sum_comm
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hswap i]
  have hcell : ∀ (i : ι) (n : κ),
      (∑ r : P, (if p ∈ f i ∧ r ∈ f i then 1 else 0) *
          (if q ∈ g n ∧ r ∈ g n then 1 else 0)) =
        if p ∈ f i ∧ q ∈ g n then ((f i) ∩ (g n)).card else 0 := by
    intro i n
    by_cases hA : p ∈ f i
    · by_cases hB : q ∈ g n
      · simp only [hA, hB, true_and, and_true, if_true]
        have hpt : ∀ r : P, (if r ∈ f i then (1 : ℕ) else 0) *
            (if r ∈ g n then (1 : ℕ) else 0) =
              if r ∈ f i ∧ r ∈ g n then 1 else 0 := by
          intro r
          by_cases h1 : r ∈ f i <;> by_cases h2 : r ∈ g n <;> simp [h1, h2]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => hpt r, ← Finset.card_filter]
        congr 1
        ext r
        simp
      · simp [hB]
    · simp [hA]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => hcell i n]
  simp only [starFinset, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hA : p ∈ f i
  · simp only [hA, true_and, if_true]
  · simp [hA]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_pairCount_mul_univ
statement:
theorem sum_pairCount_mul_univ [Fintype P] {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (f : ι → Finset P) (g : κ → Finset P) (p : P) :
    (∑ q : P, pairCount f p q * pairCount g p q) =
      ∑ i ∈ starFinset f p, ∑ n ∈ starFinset g p, ((f i) ∩ (g n)).card
proof:
:=
  sum_pairCount_mul_univ₂ f g p p

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_inter_card
statement:
theorem sum_inter_card (g : ι → Finset P) (s : Finset P) :
    (∑ i, (s ∩ g i).card) = ∑ e ∈ s, (starFinset g e).card
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : ∀ i : ι, (s ∩ g i).card = ∑ e ∈ s, if e ∈ g i then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.card_filter]
  have hright : ∀ e : P, (starFinset g e).card = ∑ i : ι, if e ∈ g i then 1 else 0 := by
    intro e
    rw [starFinset, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hleft i,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => hright e, Finset.sum_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_inter_card_sq
statement:
theorem sum_inter_card_sq (g : ι → Finset P) (s : Finset P) :
    (∑ i, (s ∩ g i).card ^ 2) = ∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s, pairCount g e f
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : ∀ i : ι, (s ∩ g i).card ^ 2 =
      ∑ e ∈ s, ∑ f ∈ s, (if e ∈ g i then 1 else 0) * (if f ∈ g i then 1 else 0) := by
    intro i
    rw [sq, ← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  have hright : ∀ e f : P, pairCount g e f =
      ∑ i : ι, (if e ∈ g i then 1 else 0) * (if f ∈ g i then 1 else 0) := by
    intro e f
    rw [pairCount, Finset.card_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases h1 : e ∈ g i <;> by_cases h2 : f ∈ g i <;> simp [h1, h2]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hleft i,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun f _ => hright e f,
    Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => Finset.sum_comm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_star_inter_card
statement:
theorem sum_star_inter_card (g : ι → Finset P) (e : P) (s : Finset P) :
    (∑ i ∈ starFinset g e, (s ∩ g i).card) = ∑ f ∈ s, pairCount g e f
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : ∀ i : ι, (s ∩ g i).card = ∑ f ∈ s, if f ∈ g i then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.card_filter]
  have hright : ∀ f : P, pairCount g e f = ∑ i ∈ starFinset g e,
      if f ∈ g i then 1 else 0 := by
    intro f
    rw [pairCount, starFinset, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.card_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases h1 : e ∈ g i <;> simp [h1]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hleft i,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun f _ => hright f, Finset.sum_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.three_mul_le_sq_add_two
statement: theorem three_mul_le_sq_add_two (t : ℕ) : 3 * t ≤ t ^ 2 + 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 3 with h | h
  · interval_cases t <;> norm_num
  · nlinarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.four_mul_le_sq_add_four

  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((x : ℤ) - 2), Int.ofNat_le.mpr (Nat.zero_le x)]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.eighteen_mul_le_sq_add
statement: theorem eighteen_mul_le_sq_add (x : ℕ) : 18 * x ≤ x ^ 2 + 81
proof:
