  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((x : ℤ) - 9), Int.ofNat_le.mpr (Nat.zero_le x)]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.two_mul_choose_two_add
statement: theorem two_mul_choose_two_add (n : ℕ) : 2 * n.choose 2 + n = n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.choose_one_right]
    have hexp : (n + 1) ^ 2 = n ^ 2 + 2 * n + 1 := by ring
    rw [hexp, ← ih]
    ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_erase_univ
statement: theorem card_erase_univ (p : P) : (Finset.univ.erase p).card = 54

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult_univ
statement: theorem sum_pairMult_univ (p : P) : (∑ q : P, E.pairMult p q) = 99
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ q : P, E.pairMult p q) = ∑ i ∈ starFinset E.block p, (E.block i).card :=
    sum_pairCount_univ E.block p
  rw [h, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => E.block_card i, Finset.sum_const,
    E.card_star p]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult
statement:
theorem sum_pairMult (p : P) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, E.pairMult p q) = 90
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :=
    Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun q => E.pairMult p q) (Finset.mem_univ p)
  rw [E.sum_pairMult_univ p, E.pairMult_self p] at hsplit
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult_sq_univ
statement: theorem sum_pairMult_sq_univ (p : P) : (∑ q : P, E.pairMult p q ^ 2) = 243
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ∀ q : P, E.pairMult p q ^ 2 = E.pairMult p q * E.pairMult p q :=
    fun q => sq (E.pairMult p q)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => hsq q]
  have h : (∑ q : P, pairCount E.block p q * pairCount E.block p q) =
      ∑ i ∈ starFinset E.block p, ∑ j ∈ starFinset E.block p,
        ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card :=
    sum_pairCount_mul_univ E.block E.block p
  rw [show (∑ q : P, E.pairMult p q * E.pairMult p q) =
      ∑ q : P, pairCount E.block p q * pairCount E.block p q from rfl, h]
  have hinner : ∀ i ∈ starFinset E.block p,
      (∑ j ∈ starFinset E.block p, ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card) = 27 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hi]
    have hoff : ∀ j ∈ (starFinset E.block p).erase i,
        ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card = 2 := fun j hj =>
      E.pair_meet i j (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hoff, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi, E.card_star p, Finset.inter_self, E.block_card i]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner, Finset.sum_const, E.card_star p]
  norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult_sq
statement:
theorem sum_pairMult_sq (p : P) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, E.pairMult p q ^ 2) = 162
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :=
    Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun q => E.pairMult p q ^ 2) (Finset.mem_univ p)
  rw [E.sum_pairMult_sq_univ p, E.pairMult_self p] at hsplit
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pairMult_cases
statement:
theorem pairMult_cases {p q : P} (h : p ≠ q) :
    E.pairMult p q = 1 ∨ E.pairMult p q = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, 3 * E.pairMult p r ≤ E.pairMult p r ^ 2 + 2 :=
    fun r _ => three_mul_le_sq_add_two _
  have hsum : (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, 3 * E.pairMult p r) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, (E.pairMult p r ^ 2 + 2) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, E.sum_pairMult p, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      E.sum_pairMult_sq p, Finset.sum_const, E.card_erase_univ p]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hpt := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le hle).mp hsum q
    (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm h, Finset.mem_univ q⟩)
  have hz : ((E.pairMult p q : ℤ) - 1) * ((E.pairMult p q : ℤ) - 2) = 0 := by
    have hcast : (3 : ℤ) * (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) = (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) ^ 2 + 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast hpt
    linear_combination -hcast
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hone | htwo
  · left
    have : (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) = 1 := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  · right
    have : (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) = 2 := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult_choose
statement:
theorem sum_pairMult_choose (p : P) :

proof:

      E.pairMult p r ^ 2 = 2 * (E.pairMult p r).choose 2 + E.pairMult p r :=

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_pairMult_eq_one
statement:
theorem card_pairMult_eq_one (p : P) :
    ((Finset.univ.erase p).filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 1).card = 18
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s : Finset P := Finset.univ.erase p with hs
  set n₁ : ℕ := (s.filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 1).card with hn₁
  set n₂ : ℕ := (s.filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 2).card with hn₂
  have hpartition : n₁ + n₂ = 54 := by
    have hnot : (s.filter fun q => ¬ E.pairMult p q = 1) =
        s.filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 2 := by
      refine Finset.filter_congr fun q hq => ?_
      have hne : p ≠ q := Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hs ▸ hq)).1
      rcases E.pairMult_cases hne with h | h <;> simp [h]
    have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := s)
      (p := fun q => E.pairMult p q = 1)
    rw [hnot, ← hn₁, ← hn₂, E.card_erase_univ p] at hsplit
    exact hsplit
  have hweighted : n₁ + 2 * n₂ = 90 := by
    have hsum := E.sum_pairMult p
    have hsplit :
        (∑ q ∈ s, E.pairMult p q) =
          (∑ q ∈ s.filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 1, E.pairMult p q) +
            ∑ q ∈ s.filter fun q => ¬ E.pairMult p q = 1, E.pairMult p q :=
      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not s _ _).symm
    have hone : (∑ q ∈ s.filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 1, E.pairMult p q) = n₁ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2,
        Finset.sum_const, ← hn₁]
      simp
    have htwo :
        (∑ q ∈ s.filter fun q => ¬ E.pairMult p q = 1, E.pairMult p q) = 2 * n₂ := by
      have hnot : (s.filter fun q => ¬ E.pairMult p q = 1) =
          s.filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 2 := by
        refine Finset.filter_congr fun q hq => ?_
        have hne : p ≠ q := Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hs ▸ hq)).1
        rcases E.pairMult_cases hne with h | h <;> simp [h]
      rw [hnot, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2,
        Finset.sum_const, hn₂]
      ring
    rw [hone, htwo, hsum] at hsplit
    omega
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Residual165.sum_pairMult_univ
statement: theorem sum_pairMult_univ (p : P) : (∑ q : P, R.pairMult p q) = 432

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Residual165.sum_pairMult
statement:

    (∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, R.pairMult p q) = 396
proof:

    Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun q => R.pairMult p q) (Finset.mem_univ p)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Residual165.sum_pairMult_sq_univ
statement: theorem sum_pairMult_sq_univ (p : P) : (∑ q : P, R.pairMult p q ^ 2) = 4212
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ∀ q : P, R.pairMult p q ^ 2 = R.pairMult p q * R.pairMult p q :=
    fun q => sq (R.pairMult p q)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => hsq q]
  have h : (∑ q : P, pairCount R.res p q * pairCount R.res p q) =
      ∑ m ∈ starFinset R.res p, ∑ n ∈ starFinset R.res p,
        ((R.res m) ∩ (R.res n)).card :=
    sum_pairCount_mul_univ R.res R.res p
  rw [show (∑ q : P, R.pairMult p q * R.pairMult p q) =
      ∑ q : P, pairCount R.res p q * pairCount R.res p q from rfl, h]
  have hmem : ∀ n ∈ starFinset R.res p, p ∈ R.res n := by
    intro n hn
    simpa [starFinset] using hn
  have hinner : ∀ m ∈ starFinset R.res p,
      (∑ n ∈ starFinset R.res p, ((R.res m) ∩ (R.res n)).card) = 117 := by
    intro m hm
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hm]
    have hoff : ∀ n ∈ (starFinset R.res p).erase m,
        ((R.res m) ∩ (R.res n)).card = 3 := by
      intro n hn
      have hnm : m ≠ n := Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hn).1
      exact R.res_meet_of_common hnm (hmem m hm)
        (hmem n (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hn))
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hoff, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem hm, R.card_star p, Finset.inter_self, R.res_card m]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner, Finset.sum_const, R.card_star p]
  norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Residual165.sum_cross_univ
statement:
theorem sum_cross_univ (p : P) :
    (∑ q : P, E.pairMult p q * R.pairMult p q) = 972
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ q : P, pairCount E.block p q * pairCount R.res p q) =
      ∑ i ∈ starFinset E.block p, ∑ n ∈ starFinset R.res p,
        ((E.block i) ∩ (R.res n)).card :=
    sum_pairCount_mul_univ E.block R.res p
  rw [show (∑ q : P, E.pairMult p q * R.pairMult p q) =
      ∑ q : P, pairCount E.block p q * pairCount R.res p q from rfl, h]
  have hmemE : ∀ i ∈ starFinset E.block p, p ∈ E.block i := by
    intro i hi
    simpa [starFinset] using hi
  have hmemR : ∀ n ∈ starFinset R.res p, p ∈ R.res n := by
    intro n hn
    simpa [starFinset] using hn
  have hinner : ∀ i ∈ starFinset E.block p,
      (∑ n ∈ starFinset R.res p, ((E.block i) ∩ (R.res n)).card) = 108 := by
    intro i hi
    have hcell : ∀ n ∈ starFinset R.res p, ((E.block i) ∩ (R.res n)).card = 3 :=
      fun n hn => R.cross_meet_of_common i n (hmemE i hi) (hmemR n hn)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcell, Finset.sum_const, R.card_star p]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner, Finset.sum_const, E.card_star p]
  norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Residual165.sum_cross

    Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
      (fun q => E.pairMult p q * R.pairMult p q) (Finset.mem_univ p)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_total_pairMult

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_total_pairMult_sq
statement:
theorem sum_total_pairMult_sq (p : P) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, (E.pairMult p q + R.pairMult p q) ^ 2) = 4374
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : ∀ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase p,
      (E.pairMult p q + R.pairMult p q) ^ 2 =
        E.pairMult p q ^ 2 + 2 * (E.pairMult p q * R.pairMult p q) +
          R.pairMult p q ^ 2 := fun q _ => by ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hexp, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, E.sum_pairMult_sq p, R.sum_cross p, R.sum_pairMult_sq p]
  norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.residual_pairMult_add
statement:
theorem residual_pairMult_add {p q : P} (h : p ≠ q) :
    E.pairMult p q + R.pairMult p q = 9
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase p,
      18 * (E.pairMult p r + R.pairMult p r) ≤
        (E.pairMult p r + R.pairMult p r) ^ 2 + 81 :=
    fun r _ => eighteen_mul_le_sq_add _
  have hsum : (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, 18 * (E.pairMult p r + R.pairMult p r)) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, ((E.pairMult p r + R.pairMult p r) ^ 2 + 81) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_total_pairMult R p, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      sum_total_pairMult_sq R p, Finset.sum_const, E.card_erase_univ p]
    norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hpt := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le hle).mp hsum q
    (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm h, Finset.mem_univ q⟩)
  have hcast : (18 : ℤ) * ((E.pairMult p q : ℤ) + (R.pairMult p q : ℤ)) =
      ((E.pairMult p q : ℤ) + (R.pairMult p q : ℤ)) ^ 2 + 81 := by
    exact_mod_cast hpt
  have hz : ((E.pairMult p q : ℤ) + (R.pairMult p q : ℤ) - 9) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    linear_combination -hcast
  have hnine : (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) + (R.pairMult p q : ℤ) = 9 := by
    have := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hz
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast hnine

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_filter_adj_le_one_of_isNClique
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [Nat.not_le] at hlt
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hlt
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx hy
  obtain ⟨hxC, hxz⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨hyC, hyz⟩ := hy

  have hsub : (C.erase x).erase y ⊆
      E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y := by
    intro w hw
    have hwy : w ≠ y := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hw).1
    have hw' := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw
    have hwx : w ≠ x := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hw').1
    have hwC : w ∈ C := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw'
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    exact ⟨hC.isClique (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hxC) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hwC) (Ne.symm hwx),
      hC.isClique (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hyC) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hwC) (Ne.symm hwy)⟩

  have hycard : y ∈ C.erase x := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hxy, hyC⟩
  have hcard : ((C.erase x).erase y).card = 9 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hycard, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hxC, hC.card_eq]
  have hadj : E.blockGraph.Adj x y :=
    hC.isClique (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hxC) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hyC) hxy
  have heq : (C.erase x).erase y =
      E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
      (by rw [E.card_neighborFinset_inter_of_adj hadj, hcard])

  have hzmem : z ∈ (C.erase x).erase y := by
    rw [heq]
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    exact ⟨hxz, hyz⟩
  exact hz (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hzmem))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.no_clique_eleven
statement: theorem no_clique_eleven : E.blockGraph.CliqueFree 11
proof:
:= by
  intro C hC
  classical

  have hDcard : ((Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C).card = 44 := by
    have h := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter (Finset.univ : Finset P) C
    rw [Finset.univ_inter, Finset.card_univ, E.point_card, hC.card_eq] at h
    omega

  have hin : ∀ x ∈ C, E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ C = C.erase x := by
    intro x hx
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_erase]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1.ne', h.2⟩, fun h =>
      ⟨hC.isClique (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hx) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h.2) (Ne.symm h.1), h.2⟩⟩

  have houter : ∀ x ∈ C,
      (((Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C).filter fun z => E.blockGraph.Adj x z).card = 8 := by
    intro x hx
    have hset : (((Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C).filter fun z => E.blockGraph.Adj x z) =
        E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x \ C := by
      ext z
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩
    have h1 := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x) C
    rw [hin x hx, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx, hC.card_eq, E.card_neighborFinset x] at h1
    rw [hset]
    omega

  have hswap : (∑ x ∈ C,
        (((Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C).filter fun z => E.blockGraph.Adj x z).card) =
      ∑ z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C,
        (C.filter fun x => E.blockGraph.Adj x z).card := by
    simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  have hleft : (∑ x ∈ C,
      (((Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C).filter fun z => E.blockGraph.Adj x z).card) = 88 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl houter, Finset.sum_const, hC.card_eq, smul_eq_mul]
  have hright : (∑ z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C,
      (C.filter fun x => E.blockGraph.Adj x z).card) ≤ 44 := by
    calc (∑ z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C,
            (C.filter fun x => E.blockGraph.Adj x z).card)
        ≤ ∑ _z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset P) \ C, 1 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun z hz => E.card_filter_adj_le_one_of_isNClique hC
            (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hz).2
      _ = 44 := by rw [Finset.sum_const, hDcard, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_local_inter_le_three
statement:
theorem card_local_inter_le_three {x u v : P} (hu : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (hv : E.blockGraph.Adj x v) (huv : u ≠ v) (hnadj : ¬ E.blockGraph.Adj u v) :
    ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset u) ∩
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset v)).card ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hxmem : x ∈ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset u ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset v := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    exact ⟨hu.symm, hv.symm⟩
  have hsub : ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset u) ∩
      (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset v)) ⊆
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset u ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset v).erase x := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] at hw
    refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro rfl
      exact hw.1.1.ne rfl
    · simp only [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
      exact ⟨hw.1.2, hw.2.2⟩
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hxmem,
    E.card_neighborFinset_inter_of_not_adj huv hnadj] at hle
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.blockGraph_clawFree
statement:
theorem blockGraph_clawFree {x y₁ y₂ y₃ : P}
    (h₁ : E.blockGraph.Adj x y₁) (h₂ : E.blockGraph.Adj x y₂) (h₃ : E.blockGraph.Adj x y₃)
    (n₁₂ : y₁ ≠ y₂) (n₁₃ : y₁ ≠ y₃) (n₂₃ : y₂ ≠ y₃)
    (a₁₂ : ¬ E.blockGraph.Adj y₁ y₂) (a₁₃ : ¬ E.blockGraph.Adj y₁ y₃)
    (a₂₃ : ¬ E.blockGraph.Adj y₂ y₃) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical

  have c₁ := E.card_neighborFinset_inter_of_adj h₁
  have c₂ := E.card_neighborFinset_inter_of_adj h₂
  have c₃ := E.card_neighborFinset_inter_of_adj h₃

  have b₁₂ := E.card_local_inter_le_three h₁ h₂ n₁₂ a₁₂
  have b₁₃ := E.card_local_inter_le_three h₁ h₃ n₁₃ a₁₃
  have b₂₃ := E.card_local_inter_le_three h₂ h₃ n₂₃ a₂₃

  have hsub : ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₁) ∪
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₂)) ∪
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₃) ⊆
      (((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x).erase y₁).erase y₂).erase y₃ := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] at hw
    have hwx : E.blockGraph.Adj x w := by rcases hw with (h | h) | h <;> exact h.1
    have key : w ≠ y₁ ∧ w ≠ y₂ ∧ w ≠ y₃ := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rintro rfl <;> rcases hw with (h | h) | h
      · exact h.2.ne rfl
      · exact a₁₂ h.2.symm
      · exact a₁₃ h.2.symm
      · exact a₁₂ h.2
      · exact h.2.ne rfl
      · exact a₂₃ h.2.symm
      · exact a₁₃ h.2
      · exact a₂₃ h.2
      · exact h.2.ne rfl
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    exact ⟨key.2.2, key.2.1, key.1, hwx⟩
  have h₁mem : y₁ ∈ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x :=
    SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _ |>.mpr h₁
  have h₂mem : y₂ ∈ (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x).erase y₁ :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm n₁₂, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _ |>.mpr h₂⟩
  have h₃mem : y₃ ∈ ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x).erase y₁).erase y₂ :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm n₂₃, Finset.mem_erase.mpr
      ⟨Ne.symm n₁₃, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _ |>.mpr h₃⟩⟩
  have hbig : ((((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x).erase y₁).erase y₂).erase y₃).card = 15 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem h₃mem, Finset.card_erase_of_mem h₂mem,
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem h₁mem, E.card_neighborFinset x]
  have hunion := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [hbig] at hunion

  have e₁₂ := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter
    (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₁)
    (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₂)
  have e₃ := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter
    ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₁) ∪
      (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₂))
    (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₃)
  have hdist : (((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₁) ∪
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₂)) ∩
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₃)).card ≤
      ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₁) ∩
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₃)).card +
      ((E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₂) ∩
        (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∩ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset y₃)).card := by
    rw [Finset.union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.mem_localNbr
statement:
theorem mem_localNbr {q : P} :
    q ∈ E.localNbr x u ↔ E.blockGraph.Adj x q ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj u q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localNbr, Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.mem_localNonNbr
statement:
theorem mem_localNonNbr {q : P} :
    q ∈ E.localNonNbr x u ↔
      E.blockGraph.Adj x q ∧ q ≠ u ∧ ¬ E.blockGraph.Adj u q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localNonNbr, Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_localNbr
statement: theorem card_localNbr (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u) : (E.localNbr x u).card = 9
proof:
:=
  E.card_neighborFinset_inter_of_adj h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.localNbr_union_localNonNbr
statement:
theorem localNbr_union_localNonNbr :
    E.localNbr x u ∪ E.localNonNbr x u = (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x).erase u
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_erase, E.mem_localNbr, E.mem_localNonNbr,
    SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hxq, huq⟩ | ⟨hxq, hqu, -⟩)
    · exact ⟨huq.ne', hxq⟩
    · exact ⟨hqu, hxq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hqu, hxq⟩
    by_cases huq : E.blockGraph.Adj u q
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hxq, huq⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxq, hqu, huq⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.disjoint_localNbr_localNonNbr
statement:
theorem disjoint_localNbr_localNonNbr :
    Disjoint (E.localNbr x u) (E.localNonNbr x u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro q hq hq'
  exact (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq').2.2 (E.mem_localNbr.1 hq).2

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_localNonNbr
statement: theorem card_localNonNbr (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u) : (E.localNonNbr x u).card = 8
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : u ∈ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x := (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).2 h
  have hcard := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (E.disjoint_localNbr_localNonNbr (x := x) (u := u))
  rw [E.localNbr_union_localNonNbr, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem, E.card_neighborFinset x,
    E.card_localNbr h] at hcard
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.localNonNbr_symm
statement:
theorem localNonNbr_symm {q : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (hq : q ∈ E.localNonNbr x u) : u ∈ E.localNonNbr x q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hqu, hnadj⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq
  exact E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨h, Ne.symm hqu, fun hadj => hnadj hadj.symm⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.localNonNbr_triangle
statement:
theorem localNonNbr_triangle {p q : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (hp : p ∈ E.localNonNbr x u) (hq : q ∈ E.localNonNbr x u)
    (hpq : q ∈ E.localNonNbr x p) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxp, hpu, hup⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hp
  obtain ⟨hxq, hqu, huq⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq
  obtain ⟨-, hqp, hpq'⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hpq
  exact E.blockGraph_clawFree h hxp hxq (Ne.symm hpu) (Ne.symm hqu) (Ne.symm hqp) hup huq hpq'

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.localNonNbr_isClique
statement:
theorem localNonNbr_isClique (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u) :
    E.blockGraph.IsClique (E.localNonNbr x u : Set P)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  by_contra hnadj
  exact E.localNonNbr_triangle h (Finset.mem_coe.1 ha) (Finset.mem_coe.1 hb)
    (E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨(E.mem_localNonNbr.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hb)).1, Ne.symm hab, hnadj⟩)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr
statement:
theorem card_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr {a : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (ha : a ∈ E.localNonNbr x u) :
    (E.localNonNbr x a ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 7
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxa, hau, hua⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 ha
  have humem : u ∈ E.localNonNbr x a := E.localNonNbr_symm h ha
  have hnot : u ∉ E.localNonNbr x a ∩ E.localNbr x u := fun hmem =>
    (E.mem_localNbr.1 (Finset.mem_inter.1 hmem).2).2.ne rfl
  have hins : insert u (E.localNonNbr x a ∩ E.localNbr x u) = E.localNonNbr x a := by
    refine Finset.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
    · intro q hq
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq
      · exact humem
      · exact (Finset.mem_inter.1 hq).1
    · intro q hq
      by_cases hqu : q = u
      · exact hqu ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
      refine Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hq, ?_⟩)
      obtain ⟨hxq, hqa, haq⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq
      refine E.mem_localNbr.2 ⟨hxq, ?_⟩
      by_contra huq
      exact haq (E.localNonNbr_isClique h (Finset.mem_coe.2 ha)
        (Finset.mem_coe.2 (E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨hxq, hqu, huq⟩)) fun hea => hqa hea.symm)
  have hcard := Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnot
  rw [hins, E.card_localNonNbr hxa] at hcard
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_localNonNbr_inter_add
statement:
theorem card_localNonNbr_inter_add {b : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (hb : b ∈ E.localNbr x u) :
    (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNonNbr x u).card
      + (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 8
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxb, hub⟩ := E.mem_localNbr.1 hb
  have hdisj : Disjoint (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNonNbr x u)
      (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro q hq hq'
    exact (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 (Finset.mem_inter.1 hq).2).2.2
      (E.mem_localNbr.1 (Finset.mem_inter.1 hq').2).2
  have hsub : E.localNonNbr x b ⊆ E.localNonNbr x u ∪ E.localNbr x u := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hxq, hqb, hbq⟩ := E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq
    by_cases huq : E.blockGraph.Adj u q
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (E.mem_localNbr.2 ⟨hxq, huq⟩)
    · refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨hxq, ?_, huq⟩)
      rintro rfl
      exact hbq hub.symm
  have hunion : E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNonNbr x u
      ∪ E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u = E.localNonNbr x b := by
    rw [← Finset.inter_union_distrib_left, Finset.inter_eq_left.2 hsub]
  rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hunion, E.card_localNonNbr hxb]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr
statement:
theorem sum_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u) :
    ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 16
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrow : ∀ a ∈ E.localNonNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x a ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 7 :=
    fun a ha => E.card_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr h ha
  have hA : ∑ a ∈ E.localNonNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x a ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 56 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hrow]
    simp [E.card_localNonNbr h]
  have hcard : ∀ (s : Finset P) (a : P), (E.localNonNbr x a ∩ s).card
      = ∑ b ∈ s, if b ∈ E.localNonNbr x a then 1 else 0 := by
    intro s a
    rw [← Finset.card_filter]
    congr 1
    ext b
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_inter]
    exact ⟨fun hb => ⟨hb.2, hb.1⟩, fun hb => ⟨hb.2, hb.1⟩⟩
  have hswap : ∑ a ∈ E.localNonNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x a ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
      = ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNonNbr x u).card := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hcard (E.localNbr x u) a,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hcard (E.localNonNbr x u) b, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
    have hxa : E.blockGraph.Adj x a := (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 ha).1
    have hxb : E.blockGraph.Adj x b := (E.mem_localNbr.1 hb).1
    by_cases hmem : b ∈ E.localNonNbr x a
    · rw [if_pos hmem, if_pos (E.localNonNbr_symm hxa hmem)]
    · rw [if_neg hmem, if_neg fun hmem' => hmem (E.localNonNbr_symm hxb hmem')]
  have hrow' : ∀ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNonNbr x u).card
      + (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 8 :=
    fun b hb => E.card_localNonNbr_inter_add h hb
  have hB : ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, ((E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNonNbr x u).card
      + (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card) = 72 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hrow']
    simp [E.card_localNbr h]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hB
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.le_card_add_card_of_edge
statement:
theorem le_card_add_card_of_edge {b₁ b₂ : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (h₁ : b₁ ∈ E.localNbr x u) (h₂ : b₂ ∈ E.localNbr x u)
    (he : b₂ ∈ E.localNonNbr x b₁) :
    8 ≤ (E.localNonNbr x b₁ ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
      + (E.localNonNbr x b₂ ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
proof:
:= by
  have hs₁ := E.card_localNonNbr_inter_add h h₁
  have hs₂ := E.card_localNonNbr_inter_add h h₂
  have hdisj : Disjoint (E.localNonNbr x b₁ ∩ E.localNonNbr x u)
      (E.localNonNbr x b₂ ∩ E.localNonNbr x u) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro a ha ha'
    exact E.localNonNbr_triangle (E.mem_localNbr.1 h₁).1 (Finset.mem_inter.1 ha).1 he
      (E.localNonNbr_symm (E.mem_localNbr.1 h₂).1 (Finset.mem_inter.1 ha').1)
  have hsub : E.localNonNbr x b₁ ∩ E.localNonNbr x u
      ∪ E.localNonNbr x b₂ ∩ E.localNonNbr x u ⊆ E.localNonNbr x u := by
    intro q hq
    rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hq with hq' | hq' <;> exact (Finset.mem_inter.1 hq').2
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, E.card_localNonNbr h] at hle
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.no_two_disjoint_edges
statement:
theorem no_two_disjoint_edges {b₁ b₂ b₃ b₄ : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u)
    (h₁ : b₁ ∈ E.localNbr x u) (h₂ : b₂ ∈ E.localNbr x u)
    (h₃ : b₃ ∈ E.localNbr x u) (h₄ : b₄ ∈ E.localNbr x u)
    (e₁ : b₂ ∈ E.localNonNbr x b₁) (e₂ : b₄ ∈ E.localNonNbr x b₃)
    (n₁₃ : b₁ ≠ b₃) (n₁₄ : b₁ ≠ b₄) (n₂₃ : b₂ ≠ b₃) (n₂₄ : b₂ ≠ b₄) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have n₁₂ : b₁ ≠ b₂ := fun heq => (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 e₁).2.1 heq.symm
  have n₃₄ : b₃ ≠ b₄ := fun heq => (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 e₂).2.1 heq.symm
  set T : Finset P := {b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄} with hT
  have hm₁ : b₁ ∉ ({b₂, b₃, b₄} : Finset P) := by simp [n₁₂, n₁₃, n₁₄]
  have hm₂ : b₂ ∉ ({b₃, b₄} : Finset P) := by simp [n₂₃, n₂₄]
  have hm₃ : b₃ ∉ ({b₄} : Finset P) := by simp [n₃₄]
  have hTB : T ⊆ E.localNbr x u := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [hT, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hq
    rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    exacts [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  have hTcard : T.card = 4 := by
    rw [hT, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hm₁, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hm₂,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hm₃]
    simp
  have hTsum : ∑ b ∈ T, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
      = (E.localNonNbr x b₁ ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
        + (E.localNonNbr x b₂ ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
        + (E.localNonNbr x b₃ ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
        + (E.localNonNbr x b₄ ∩ E.localNbr x u).card := by
    rw [hT, Finset.sum_insert hm₁, Finset.sum_insert hm₂, Finset.sum_insert hm₃,
      Finset.sum_singleton]
    ring
  have hsum : ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 16 :=
    E.sum_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr h
  have hsplit : (∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u \ T, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card)
      + ∑ b ∈ T, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
      = ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card :=
    Finset.sum_sdiff hTB
  have hlow₁ := E.le_card_add_card_of_edge h h₁ h₂ e₁
  have hlow₂ := E.le_card_add_card_of_edge h h₃ h₄ e₂
  have hzero : ∀ b ∈ E.localNbr x u \ T,
      (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 0 := by
    intro b hb
    by_contra hne
    have hle : (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
        ≤ ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u \ T, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card)
        (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _) hb
    omega
  have hsubT : ∀ b ∈ T, E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u ⊆ T.erase b := by
    intro b hbT q hq
    obtain ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.1 hq
    refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq₁).2.1, ?_⟩
    by_contra hqT
    have hbq : b ∈ E.localNonNbr x q :=
      E.localNonNbr_symm (E.mem_localNbr.1 (hTB hbT)).1 hq₁
    have hzq := hzero q (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hq₂, hqT⟩)
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at hzq
    exact hzq b (Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hbq, hTB hbT⟩)
  have hbound : ∀ b ∈ T, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card ≤ 3 := by
    intro b hbT
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card (hsubT b hbT)
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hbT, hTcard] at hle
    omega
  have hb₁ := hbound b₁ (by simp [hT])
  have hb₂ := hbound b₂ (by simp [hT])
  have hb₃ := hbound b₃ (by simp [hT])
  have hb₄ := hbound b₄ (by simp [hT])
  have hout : ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u \ T, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 0 :=
    Finset.sum_eq_zero hzero
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.exists_star_centre
statement:
theorem exists_star_centre (h : E.blockGraph.Adj x u) :
    ∃ c ∈ E.localNbr x u, ∀ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, ∀ b' ∈ E.localNbr x u,
      b' ∈ E.localNonNbr x b → b = c ∨ b' = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁, hpos⟩ : ∃ b ∈ E.localNbr x u,
      0 < (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hz : ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb => Nat.le_zero.1 (hcon b hb)
    rw [E.sum_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr h] at hz
    exact absurd hz (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨b₂, hb₂⟩ := Finset.card_pos.1 hpos
  obtain ⟨he₁, hb₂B⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.1 hb₂
  by_cases hall : ∀ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, ∀ b' ∈ E.localNbr x u,
      b' ∈ E.localNonNbr x b → b = b₁ ∨ b' = b₁
  · exact ⟨b₁, hb₁, hall⟩
  push Not at hall
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq, hpb₁, hqb₁⟩ := hall
  have hmeet : b₂ = p ∨ b₂ = q := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    exact E.no_two_disjoint_edges h hb₁ hb₂B hp hq he₁ hpq
      (Ne.symm hpb₁) (Ne.symm hqb₁) hcon.1 hcon.2
  obtain ⟨r, hrB, hr, hrb₁, hrb₂⟩ : ∃ r ∈ E.localNbr x u,
      r ∈ E.localNonNbr x b₂ ∧ r ≠ b₁ ∧ r ≠ b₂ := by
    rcases hmeet with heq | heq
    · refine ⟨q, hq, ?_, hqb₁, ?_⟩
      · rw [heq]; exact hpq
      · rw [heq]; exact (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hpq).2.1
    · refine ⟨p, hp, ?_, hpb₁, ?_⟩
      · rw [heq]; exact E.localNonNbr_symm (E.mem_localNbr.1 hp).1 hpq
      · rw [heq]; exact fun heq' => (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hpq).2.1 heq'.symm
  have hb₁c : b₁ ∈ E.localNonNbr x b₂ :=
    E.localNonNbr_symm (E.mem_localNbr.1 hb₁).1 he₁
  have hxb₂ : E.blockGraph.Adj x b₂ := (E.mem_localNbr.1 hb₂B).1
  refine ⟨b₂, hb₂B, ?_⟩
  intro b hbB b' hb'B hedge
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  obtain ⟨hbne, hb'ne⟩ := hcon
  have hone : b = b₁ ∨ b' = b₁ := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact E.no_two_disjoint_edges h hb₁ hb₂B hbB hb'B he₁ hedge
      (Ne.symm hc.1) (Ne.symm hc.2) (Ne.symm hbne) (Ne.symm hb'ne)
  have htwo : b = r ∨ b' = r := by
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact E.no_two_disjoint_edges h hb₂B hrB hbB hb'B hr hedge
      (Ne.symm hbne) (Ne.symm hb'ne) (Ne.symm hc.1) (Ne.symm hc.2)
  rcases hone with hone | hone <;> rcases htwo with htwo | htwo
  · exact hrb₁ (by rw [← htwo]; exact hone)
  · exact E.localNonNbr_triangle hxb₂ hb₁c hr (by rw [← htwo, ← hone]; exact hedge)
  · refine E.localNonNbr_triangle hxb₂ hb₁c hr ?_
    exact E.localNonNbr_symm (E.mem_localNbr.1 hrB).1 (by rw [← htwo, ← hone]; exact hedge)
  · exact hrb₁ (by rw [← htwo]; exact hone)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.local_split
statement:
theorem local_split (x : P) :
    ∃ X Y : Finset P, X ∪ Y = E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∧ Disjoint X Y ∧
      X.card = 9 ∧ Y.card = 9 ∧
      E.blockGraph.IsClique (X : Set P) ∧ E.blockGraph.IsClique (Y : Set P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, E.blockGraph.Adj x u := by
    have hpos : 0 < (E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x).card := by
      rw [E.card_neighborFinset x]; norm_num
    obtain ⟨u, hmem⟩ := Finset.card_pos.1 hpos
    exact ⟨u, (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).1 hmem⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hstar⟩ := E.exists_star_centre hu
  obtain ⟨hxc, huc⟩ := E.mem_localNbr.1 hc
  have hunotB : u ∉ E.localNbr x u := fun hmem => (E.mem_localNbr.1 hmem).2.ne rfl
  have hunotA : u ∉ E.localNonNbr x u := fun hmem => (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hmem).2.1 rfl
  have hcnotA : c ∉ E.localNonNbr x u := fun hmem => (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hmem).2.2 huc
  have hucne : u ≠ c := fun heq => hunotB (heq ▸ hc)

  have hleaf : ∀ b ∈ (E.localNbr x u).erase c,
      (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
        = if b ∈ E.localNonNbr x c then 1 else 0 := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨hbc, hbB⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hb
    have hxb : E.blockGraph.Adj x b := (E.mem_localNbr.1 hbB).1
    have hsub : E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u ⊆ {c} := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.1 hq
      rcases hstar b hbB q hq₂ hq₁ with heq | heq
      · exact absurd heq hbc
      · exact Finset.mem_singleton.2 heq
    by_cases hbc' : b ∈ E.localNonNbr x c
    · rw [if_pos hbc']
      have heq : E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u = {c} := by
        refine Finset.Subset.antisymm hsub ?_
        intro q hq
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hq
        subst hq
        exact Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨E.localNonNbr_symm hxc hbc', hc⟩
      rw [heq, Finset.card_singleton]
    · rw [if_neg hbc']
      have heq : E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u = ∅ := by
        rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro q hq
        have hqc : q = c := Finset.mem_singleton.1 (hsub hq)
        subst hqc
        exact hbc' (E.localNonNbr_symm hxb (Finset.mem_inter.1 hq).1)
      rw [heq, Finset.card_empty]
  have hsum : ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 16 :=
    E.sum_localNonNbr_inter_localNbr hu
  have hsplit : (∑ b ∈ (E.localNbr x u).erase c, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card)
      + (E.localNonNbr x c ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
      = ∑ b ∈ E.localNbr x u, (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card :=
    Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hc
  have hfilter : ((E.localNbr x u).erase c).filter (fun b => b ∈ E.localNonNbr x c)
      = E.localNonNbr x c ∩ E.localNbr x u := by
    ext b
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_inter]
    exact ⟨fun hb => ⟨hb.2, hb.1.2⟩,
      fun hb => ⟨⟨(E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hb.1).2.1, hb.2⟩, hb.1⟩⟩
  have herase : ∑ b ∈ (E.localNbr x u).erase c,
      (E.localNonNbr x b ∩ E.localNbr x u).card
        = (E.localNonNbr x c ∩ E.localNbr x u).card := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hleaf, ← Finset.card_filter, hfilter]
  have hdc : (E.localNonNbr x c ∩ E.localNbr x u).card = 8 := by omega
  have hcA : E.localNonNbr x c ∩ E.localNonNbr x u = ∅ := by
    have hadd := E.card_localNonNbr_inter_add hu hc
    rw [hdc] at hadd
    exact Finset.card_eq_zero.1 (by omega)
  refine ⟨insert u ((E.localNbr x u).erase c), insert c (E.localNonNbr x u), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext q
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_erase,
      SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro ((rfl | ⟨-, hq⟩) | (rfl | hq))
      · exact hu
      · exact (E.mem_localNbr.1 hq).1
      · exact hxc
      · exact (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq).1
    · intro hq
      by_cases hqu : q = u
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hqu)
      by_cases huq : E.blockGraph.Adj u q
      · by_cases hqc : q = c
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hqc)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hqc, E.mem_localNbr.2 ⟨hq, huq⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨hq, hqu, huq⟩))
  · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro q hq hq'
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq₁
    · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq' with heq | hmem
      · exact hucne heq
      · exact hunotA hmem
    · obtain ⟨hqc, hqB⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hq₁
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq' with heq | hmem
      · exact hqc heq
      · exact (E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hmem).2.2 (E.mem_localNbr.1 hqB).2
  · have herasecard : ((E.localNbr x u).erase c).card = 8 := by
      have hcard := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hc
      rw [E.card_localNbr hu] at hcard
      omega
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem fun hmem => hunotB (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hmem),
      herasecard]
  · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hcnotA, E.card_localNonNbr hu]
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_erase] at hp hq
    rcases hp with rfl | hp <;> rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · exact absurd rfl hpq
    · exact (E.mem_localNbr.1 hq.2).2
    · exact ((E.mem_localNbr.1 hp.2).2).symm
    · by_contra hnadj
      have hqp : q ∈ E.localNonNbr x p :=
        E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨(E.mem_localNbr.1 hq.2).1, Ne.symm hpq, hnadj⟩
      rcases hstar p hp.2 q hq.2 hqp with heq | heq
      · exact hp.1 heq
      · exact hq.1 heq
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe] at hp hq
    rcases hp with rfl | hp <;> rcases hq with rfl | hq
    · exact absurd rfl hpq
    · by_contra hnadj
      refine (Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.1 hcA) q (Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨?_, hq⟩)
      exact E.mem_localNonNbr.2 ⟨(E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hq).1, Ne.symm hpq, hnadj⟩
    · by_contra hnadj
      refine (Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.1 hcA) p (Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨?_, hp⟩)
      exact E.mem_localNonNbr.2
        ⟨(E.mem_localNonNbr.1 hp).1, hpq, fun hadj => hnadj hadj.symm⟩
    · exact E.localNonNbr_isClique hu (Finset.mem_coe.2 hp) (Finset.mem_coe.2 hq) hpq

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_cross_eq_one
statement:
theorem card_cross_eq_one {p : P} {X Y : Finset P}
    (hXY : X ∪ Y = E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x) (hdisj : Disjoint X Y)
    (hX : X.card = 9) (hXc : E.blockGraph.IsClique (X : Set P)) (hp : p ∈ X) :
    (Y.filter fun q => E.blockGraph.Adj p q).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxp : E.blockGraph.Adj x p := by
    have hmem : p ∈ E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x := hXY ▸ Finset.mem_union_left _ hp
    exact (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset _ _ _).1 hmem
  have hXp : (X.filter fun q => E.blockGraph.Adj p q) = X.erase p := by
    ext q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase]
    exact ⟨fun hq => ⟨hq.2.ne', hq.1⟩, fun hq =>
      ⟨hq.2, hXc (Finset.mem_coe.2 hp) (Finset.mem_coe.2 hq.2) (Ne.symm hq.1)⟩⟩
  have hlocal : ((X ∪ Y).filter fun q => E.blockGraph.Adj p q) = E.localNbr x p := by
    rw [hXY]
    ext q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, E.mem_localNbr]
  have hfd : Disjoint (X.filter fun q => E.blockGraph.Adj p q)
      (Y.filter fun q => E.blockGraph.Adj p q) := Finset.disjoint_filter_filter hdisj
  have hcard := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hfd
  rw [← Finset.filter_union, hlocal, E.card_localNbr hxp, hXp,
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem hp, hX] at hcard
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.local_split_matching
statement:
theorem local_split_matching (x : P) :
    ∃ X Y : Finset P, X ∪ Y = E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x ∧ Disjoint X Y ∧
      X.card = 9 ∧ Y.card = 9 ∧
      E.blockGraph.IsClique (X : Set P) ∧ E.blockGraph.IsClique (Y : Set P) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ X, (Y.filter fun q => E.blockGraph.Adj p q).card = 1) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Y, (X.filter fun p => E.blockGraph.Adj q p).card = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hXY, hdisj, hX, hY, hXc, hYc⟩ := E.local_split x
  have hYX : Y ∪ X = E.blockGraph.neighborFinset x := by rw [Finset.union_comm]; exact hXY
  exact ⟨X, Y, hXY, hdisj, hX, hY, hXc, hYc,
    fun p hp => E.card_cross_eq_one hXY hdisj hX hXc hp,
    fun q hq => E.card_cross_eq_one hYX hdisj.symm hY hYc hq⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks
statement:
theorem mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks {S : Finset (Fin 56)} :
    S ∈ Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks ↔ ∃ p a, Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a = S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalBiplaneBlocks, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Prod.exists]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_block_card
statement:
theorem canonicalBiplane_block_card {S : Finset (Fin 56)}
    (hS : S ∈ Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks) : S.card = 11
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,a,rfl⟩ := Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mp hS
  exact Q.toCoherentK11System.card_closedStar p a

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks_iff_triple_clique
statement:
theorem mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks_iff_triple_clique {S : Finset (Fin 56)} :
    S ∈ Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks ↔ S.card = 11 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ z ∈ S,
        x ≠ y → x ≠ z → y ≠ z → Q.sparseTriple x y z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hS
    refine ⟨Q.canonicalBiplane_block_card hS, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨p,a,rfl⟩ := Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mp hS
    exact fun _ hx _ hy _ hz => Q.closedStar_triple_sparse hx hy hz
  · rintro ⟨hcard,hclique⟩
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (show 0 < S.card by omega)
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Q.eq_closedStar_of_triple_clique hcard hclique hp
    exact Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mpr ⟨p,a,ha.symm⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_filter_canonicalBiplane_at
statement:
theorem card_filter_canonicalBiplane_at (p : Fin 56) (R : Finset (Fin 56) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] :
    (Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks.filter fun S => p ∈ S ∧ R S).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun a : Fin 11 => R (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  symm
  refine Finset.card_bij (fun a _ => Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro a ha
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mpr ⟨p,a,rfl⟩,
      Q.toCoherentK11System.root_mem_closedStar p a, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩
  · intro a ha b hb h
    exact Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar_injective p h
  · intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hS,hp,hR⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hS
    obtain ⟨q,b,rfl⟩ := Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mp hS
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Q.closedStar_reroot hp
    exact ⟨a, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ a, ha ▸ hR⟩, ha.symm⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_replication
statement:
theorem canonicalBiplane_replication (p : Fin 56) :
    (Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks.filter fun S => p ∈ S).card = 11
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.card_filter_canonicalBiplane_at p (fun _ => True)
  simpa using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_point_pair
statement:
theorem canonicalBiplane_point_pair {p q : Fin 56} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    (Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks.filter fun S => p ∈ S ∧ q ∈ S).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q.card_filter_canonicalBiplane_at]
  have heq : (Finset.univ.filter fun a => q ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) =
      (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨q,hpq.symm⟩).vertices := by
    ext a
    simp [Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar p ⟨q,hpq.symm⟩ a]
  rw [heq, Edge11.card_vertices]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_card
statement: theorem canonicalBiplane_card : Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks.card = 56
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 56))) (t := Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks)
    (fun p S => p ∈ S)
  simp only [Finset.bipartiteAbove, Finset.bipartiteBelow] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => Q.canonicalBiplane_replication p)] at h
  have hright : ∀ S ∈ Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks,
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p => p ∈ S).card = 11 := by
    intro S hS
    simpa using Q.canonicalBiplane_block_card hS
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hright] at h
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_block_pair
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,a,rfl⟩ := Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mp hS
  obtain ⟨q,b,rfl⟩ := Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mp hT
  have hmod := Q.closedStar_overlap_mod_three p q a b
  have hpos : 0 < (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a ∩
      Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar q b).card := by
    by_contra hz
    have hz' : (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a ∩
        Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar q b).card = 0 := by omega
    rw [hz'] at hmod
    exact (by decide : (0 : ZMod 3) ≠ 2) hmod
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨hxS,hxT⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := Q.closedStar_reroot hxS
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := Q.closedStar_reroot hxT
  have hcd : c ≠ d := fun h => hST (hc.trans ((congrArg _ h).trans hd.symm))
  rw [hc, hd, Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar_inter_card x hcd]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_triple_card
statement:
theorem canonicalBiplane_triple_card (p : Fin 56)
    (q r : {x : Fin 56 // x ≠ p}) :
    (Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks.filter fun S => p ∈ S ∧ q.val ∈ S ∧ r.val ∈ S).card =
      Edge11.vmeet (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p q)
        (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q.card_filter_canonicalBiplane_at]
  congr 1
  ext a
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_inter,
    Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar p q a,
    Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar p r a]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_triple_complement
statement:
theorem canonicalBiplane_triple_complement {p q r : Fin 56}
    (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpr : p ≠ r) (hqr : q ≠ r) :
    Q.tripleMultiplicity p q r +
      (Q.canonicalBiplaneBlocks.filter fun S => p ∈ S ∧ q ∈ S ∧ r ∈ S).card = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q.canonicalBiplane_triple_card p ⟨q,hpq.symm⟩ ⟨r,hpr.symm⟩]
  let q' := neEquivPunctured p ⟨q,hpq.symm⟩
  let r' := neEquivPunctured p ⟨r,hpr.symm⟩
  have h := (Q.derived45 p).pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv q' r'
  have hne : q' ≠ r' := fun h => hqr (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  rw [Q.derived_pairMult_eq_tripleMultiplicity, if_neg hne, add_zero] at h
  exact h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.localEdges_pointsOn_derived
statement:
theorem localEdges_pointsOn_derived (p : Fin 56) (i : Fin 45) :
    Q.toCoherentK11System.localEdges (Q.pointsOn (Q.derivedEnum p i)) p =
      (Q.derived45 p).coverMember i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext e
  simp only [CoherentK11System.localEdges, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
    true_and, mem_pointsOn, Derived45.mem_coverMember]
  change _ ↔ (Q.derived45 p).edgeEquiv.symm e ∈ Q.restrictedBlock p (Q.derivedEnum p i)
  rw [mem_restrictedBlock]
  rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.canonicalBiplane_old_block_intersections
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : (Q.pointsOn B ∩ S).card = 0
  · exact Or.inl hz
  right
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz)
  obtain ⟨hpB,hpS⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hp
  obtain ⟨q,a,rfl⟩ := Q.mem_canonicalBiplaneBlocks.mp hS
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := Q.closedStar_reroot hpS
  rw [hb, Q.toCoherentK11System.card_inter_closedStar hpB]
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := (derivedEnum_range (Q := Q) (z := p) B).mp
    (Q.mem_derivedIndex.mpr (Q.mem_pointsOn.mp hpB))
  rw [← hi, Q.localEdges_pointsOn_derived]
  change ((Q.derived45 p).coverMember i |>.filter fun e => b ∈ e.vertices).card + 1 = 3
  rw [(Q.derived45 p).two_regular_coverMember]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_eq_card_filter
statement:
theorem sum_eq_card_filter [Fintype α] (a : α → ℤ) (ha : ∀ x, a x = 0 ∨ a x = 1) :
    (∑ x, a x) = ((Finset.univ.filter fun x => a x = 1).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ x, a x = if a x = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0 := by
    intro x
    rcases ha x with h | h <;> simp [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hpoint x]
  simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.sum_mul_eq_card_filter
statement:
theorem sum_mul_eq_card_filter [Fintype α] (a b : α → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ x, a x = 0 ∨ a x = 1) (hb : ∀ x, b x = 0 ∨ b x = 1) :
    (∑ x, a x * b x) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun x => a x = 1 ∧ b x = 1).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ x, a x * b x = if a x = 1 ∧ b x = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0 := by
    intro x
    rcases ha x with h | h <;> rcases hb x with h' | h' <;> simp [h, h']
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hpoint x]
  simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.card_filter_subtype
statement:
theorem card_filter_subtype [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (p : α → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : ↥s => p x.val).card = (s.filter p).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (Subtype.val_injective (p := (· ∈ s)))]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hpx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hpx, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.card_filter_of_enum
statement:
theorem card_filter_of_enum [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → α) (s : Finset α)
    (hinj : Function.Injective b) (hrange : ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ∃ i, b i = x)
    (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun i => p (b i)).card = (s.filter p).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(hrange _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩, hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hpx⟩
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (hrange x).mp hx
    exact ⟨i, hpx, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_pointsOn
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pointsOn {B : Fin 210} {p : Fin 56} :
    p ∈ Q.pointsOn B ↔ Q.matrix p B = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [pointsOn]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_blocksThrough
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_blocksThrough {p : Fin 56} {B : Fin 210} :
    B ∈ Q.blocksThrough p ↔ Q.matrix p B = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [blocksThrough]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_pointsOn
statement: theorem card_pointsOn (B : Fin 210) : (Q.pointsOn B).card = 12
proof:
:= by
  have hcol := Q.block_size B
  rw [incidenceColumnSum,
    sum_eq_card_filter (fun p => Q.matrix p B) fun p => Q.entry_cases p B] at hcol
  exact_mod_cast hcol

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_blocksThrough
statement: theorem card_blocksThrough (p : Fin 56) : (Q.blocksThrough p).card = 45
proof:
:= by
  have hrow := Q.row_sum p
  rw [sum_eq_card_filter (fun B => Q.matrix p B) fun B => Q.entry_cases p B] at hrow
  exact_mod_cast hrow

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_blocksThroughPair
statement:
theorem card_blocksThroughPair {p q : Fin 56} (h : p ≠ q) :
    (Q.blocksThroughPair p q).card = 9
proof:
:= by
  have hgram := Q.point_gram p q
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at hgram
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at hgram
  rw [sum_mul_eq_card_filter (fun B => Q.matrix p B) (fun B => Q.matrix q B)
    (fun B => Q.entry_cases p B) fun B => Q.entry_cases q B, if_neg h] at hgram
  exact_mod_cast hgram

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_pointsOnPair
statement:
theorem card_pointsOnPair {B D : Fin 210} (h : B ≠ D) :
    (Q.pointsOnPair B D).card = 0 ∨ (Q.pointsOnPair B D).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hinter := Q.block_intersections h
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at hinter
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at hinter
  rw [sum_mul_eq_card_filter (fun p => Q.matrix p B) (fun p => Q.matrix p D)
    (fun p => Q.entry_cases p B) fun p => Q.entry_cases p D] at hinter
  rcases hinter with h' | h'
  · exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast h')
  · exact Or.inr (by exact_mod_cast h')

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.card_punctured
statement: theorem card_punctured (z : Fin 56) : Fintype.card (Punctured z) = 55
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_coe, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ z)]
  simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_derivedIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_derivedIndex {B : Fin 210} :
    B ∈ Q.derivedIndex z ↔ Q.matrix z B = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [derivedIndex]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_residualIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_residualIndex {B : Fin 210} :
    B ∈ Q.residualIndex z ↔ Q.matrix z B = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [residualIndex]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.mem_restrictedBlock
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_restrictedBlock {B : Fin 210} {p : Punctured z} :
    p ∈ Q.restrictedBlock z B ↔ Q.matrix p.val B = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictedBlock]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_derivedIndex
statement: theorem card_derivedIndex : (Q.derivedIndex z).card = 45
proof:
:=
  Q.card_blocksThrough z

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_residualIndex
statement: theorem card_residualIndex : (Q.residualIndex z).card = 165
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :=
    Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 210)))
      (p := fun B => Q.matrix z B = 1)
  have hneg : (Finset.univ.filter fun B => ¬ Q.matrix z B = 1) = Q.residualIndex z := by
    ext B
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, mem_residualIndex]
    rcases Q.entry_cases z B with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hpos : (Finset.univ.filter fun B => Q.matrix z B = 1) = Q.derivedIndex z := rfl
  rw [hpos, hneg, card_derivedIndex] at hsplit
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hsplit
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.restrictedBlock_card
statement:
theorem restrictedBlock_card (B : Fin 210) :
    (Q.restrictedBlock z B).card = ((Q.pointsOn B).erase z).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictedBlock,
    card_filter_subtype (Finset.univ.erase z) fun p => Q.matrix p B = 1,
    Finset.filter_erase]
  rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.restrictedBlock_inter_card
statement:
theorem restrictedBlock_inter_card (B D : Fin 210) :
    (Q.restrictedBlock z B ∩ Q.restrictedBlock z D).card =
      ((Q.pointsOnPair B D).erase z).card
proof:
:= by
  have hand :
      Q.restrictedBlock z B ∩ Q.restrictedBlock z D =
        Finset.univ.filter fun p : Punctured z =>
          Q.matrix p.val B = 1 ∧ Q.matrix p.val D = 1 := by
    ext p
    simp [restrictedBlock]
  rw [hand,
    card_filter_subtype (Finset.univ.erase z)
      fun p => Q.matrix p B = 1 ∧ Q.matrix p D = 1,
    Finset.filter_erase]
  rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_restrictedBlock_of_through
statement:
theorem card_restrictedBlock_of_through {B : Fin 210} (h : Q.matrix z B = 1) :
    (Q.restrictedBlock z B).card = 11
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : z ∈ Q.pointsOn B := Q.mem_pointsOn.mpr h
  rw [restrictedBlock_card, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem, Q.card_pointsOn B]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_restrictedBlock_of_missing
statement:
theorem card_restrictedBlock_of_missing {B : Fin 210} (h : Q.matrix z B = 0) :
    (Q.restrictedBlock z B).card = 12
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : z ∉ Q.pointsOn B := by
    simp only [ConcreteQSD56.mem_pointsOn, h]
    norm_num
  rw [restrictedBlock_card, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hmem, Q.card_pointsOn B]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_restrictedBlock_inter_of_through
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : z ∈ Q.pointsOnPair B D := by
    simp only [pointsOnPair, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨hB, hD⟩
  have hpos : (Q.pointsOnPair B D).card ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at hzero
    exact absurd hmem (by simp [hzero])
  have hthree : (Q.pointsOnPair B D).card = 3 :=
    (Q.card_pointsOnPair hBD).resolve_left hpos
  rw [restrictedBlock_inter_card, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem, hthree]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_restrictedBlock_inter_of_missing
statement:
theorem card_restrictedBlock_inter_of_missing {B D : Fin 210}
    (hD : Q.matrix z D = 0) (hBD : B ≠ D) :
    (Q.restrictedBlock z B ∩ Q.restrictedBlock z D).card = 0 ∨
      (Q.restrictedBlock z B ∩ Q.restrictedBlock z D).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : z ∉ Q.pointsOnPair B D := by
    simp only [pointsOnPair, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hD,
      not_and]
    intro _
    norm_num
  rw [restrictedBlock_inter_card, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hmem]
  exact Q.card_pointsOnPair hBD

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_derivedIndex_filter
statement:
theorem card_derivedIndex_filter {p : Fin 56} (hp : p ≠ z) :
    ((Q.derivedIndex z).filter fun B => Q.matrix p B = 1).card = 9
proof:
:= by
  have hfilter :
      (Q.derivedIndex z).filter (fun B => Q.matrix p B = 1) =
        Q.blocksThroughPair z p := by
    ext B
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_derivedIndex, blocksThroughPair,
      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  rw [hfilter]
  exact Q.card_blocksThroughPair (Ne.symm hp)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.card_residualIndex_filter
statement:
theorem card_residualIndex_filter {p : Fin 56} (hp : p ≠ z) :
    ((Q.residualIndex z).filter fun B => Q.matrix p B = 1).card = 36
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :=
    Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Q.blocksThrough p)
      (p := fun B => Q.matrix z B = 1)
  have hpos :
      ((Q.blocksThrough p).filter fun B => Q.matrix z B = 1) =
        (Q.derivedIndex z).filter fun B => Q.matrix p B = 1 := by
    ext B
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_blocksThrough, mem_derivedIndex]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2, h.1⟩⟩
  have hneg :
      ((Q.blocksThrough p).filter fun B => ¬ Q.matrix z B = 1) =
        (Q.residualIndex z).filter fun B => Q.matrix p B = 1 := by
    ext B
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_blocksThrough, mem_residualIndex]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨(Q.entry_cases z B).resolve_right h2, h1⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
      rw [h1]
      norm_num
  rw [hpos, hneg, card_derivedIndex_filter hp, Q.card_blocksThrough p] at hsplit
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.derivedEnum_mem
statement: theorem derivedEnum_mem (i : Fin 45) : Q.derivedEnum z i ∈ Q.derivedIndex z
proof:
:=
  ((Finset.equivFinOfCardEq (card_derivedIndex Q z)).symm i).2

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.residualEnum_mem
statement: theorem residualEnum_mem (n : Fin 165) : Q.residualEnum z n ∈ Q.residualIndex z
proof:
:=
  ((Finset.equivFinOfCardEq (card_residualIndex Q z)).symm n).2

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.derivedEnum_one
statement: theorem derivedEnum_one (i : Fin 45) : Q.matrix z (Q.derivedEnum z i) = 1
proof:
:=
  mem_derivedIndex.mp (derivedEnum_mem i)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.residualEnum_zero
statement: theorem residualEnum_zero (n : Fin 165) : Q.matrix z (Q.residualEnum z n) = 0
proof:
:=
  mem_residualIndex.mp (residualEnum_mem n)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.derivedEnum_injective
statement: theorem derivedEnum_injective : Function.Injective (Q.derivedEnum z)
proof:
:= fun _ _ hij =>
  (Finset.equivFinOfCardEq (card_derivedIndex Q z)).symm.injective (Subtype.ext hij)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.residualEnum_injective
statement: theorem residualEnum_injective : Function.Injective (Q.residualEnum z)
proof:
:= fun _ _ hmn =>
  (Finset.equivFinOfCardEq (card_residualIndex Q z)).symm.injective (Subtype.ext hmn)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.derivedEnum_range
statement:
theorem derivedEnum_range (B : Fin 210) :
    B ∈ Q.derivedIndex z ↔ ∃ i, Q.derivedEnum z i = B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB
    exact ⟨Finset.equivFinOfCardEq (card_derivedIndex Q z) ⟨B, hB⟩, by simp [derivedEnum]⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact derivedEnum_mem i

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.residualEnum_range
statement:
theorem residualEnum_range (B : Fin 210) :
    B ∈ Q.residualIndex z ↔ ∃ n, Q.residualEnum z n = B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB
    exact ⟨Finset.equivFinOfCardEq (card_residualIndex Q z) ⟨B, hB⟩, by simp [residualEnum]⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact residualEnum_mem n

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.derivedEnum_ne_residualEnum
statement:
theorem derivedEnum_ne_residualEnum (i : Fin 45) (n : Fin 165) :
    Q.derivedEnum z i ≠ Q.residualEnum z n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := derivedEnum_one (Q := Q) (z := z) i
  rw [h, residualEnum_zero (Q := Q) (z := z) n] at h1
  norm_num at h1

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.exists_derived_residual_at
statement:
theorem exists_derived_residual_at (Q : ConcreteQSD56) (z : Fin 56) :
    ∃ (P : Type) (instF : Fintype P) (instD : DecidableEq P)
      (E : @Derived45 P instF instD), Nonempty (@Residual165 P instF instD E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Punctured z, inferInstance, inferInstance, Q.derived45 z, ⟨Q.residual165 z⟩⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.exists_derived_residual
statement:
theorem exists_derived_residual (Q : ConcreteQSD56) :
    ∃ (P : Type) (instF : Fintype P) (instD : DecidableEq P)
      (E : @Derived45 P instF instD), Nonempty (@Residual165 P instF instD E)
proof:
:=
  exists_derived_residual_at Q 0

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.binary
statement:
theorem binary (p : Fin 56) (B : Fin 210) :
    Q.matrix p B * Q.matrix p B = Q.matrix p B

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.point_gram
statement:
theorem point_gram (p q : Fin 56) :
    (Q.matrix * Q.matrix.transpose) p q = if p = q then 45 else 9

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.block_size
statement: theorem block_size (B : Fin 210) : incidenceColumnSum Q.matrix B = 12

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.block_intersections
statement:
theorem block_intersections {B D : Fin 210} (h : B ≠ D) :
    (Q.matrix.transpose * Q.matrix) B D = 0 ∨
      (Q.matrix.transpose * Q.matrix) B D = 3

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.entry_cases
statement:
theorem entry_cases (p : Fin 56) (B : Fin 210) :
    Q.matrix p B = 0 ∨ Q.matrix p B = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.binary p B
  have hfactor : Q.matrix p B * (Q.matrix p B - 1) = 0 := by linear_combination h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with h0 | h1
  · exact Or.inl h0
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.row_sum
statement: theorem row_sum (p : Fin 56) : ∑ B, Q.matrix p B = 45
proof:
:=
  incidence_row_sum_eq_forty_five Q.matrix Q.binary Q.point_gram p

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.noQuasiSymmetricDesign56_of_concrete
statement:
theorem noQuasiSymmetricDesign56_of_concrete (h : IsEmpty ConcreteQSD56) :
    NoQuasiSymmetricDesign56.{u}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun design => h.false ?_⟩
  let : Fintype design.Point := design.pointFintype
  let : Fintype design.Block := design.blockFintype
  let : DecidableEq design.Point := design.pointDecidableEq
  let : DecidableEq design.Block := design.blockDecidableEq
  classical
  set ep : design.Point ≃ Fin 56 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq design.point_card with hep
  set eb : design.Block ≃ Fin 210 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq design.block_card with heb
  clear_value ep eb
  clear hep heb
  refine ⟨fun p B => design.incidence (ep.symm p) (eb.symm B), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p B
    exact design.binary (ep.symm p) (eb.symm B)
  · intro p q
    have hsum :
        (∑ B : Fin 210,
            design.incidence (ep.symm p) (eb.symm B) *
              design.incidence (ep.symm q) (eb.symm B)) =
          ∑ D : design.Block,
            design.incidence (ep.symm p) D * design.incidence (ep.symm q) D :=
      Equiv.sum_comp eb.symm
        (fun D => design.incidence (ep.symm p) D * design.incidence (ep.symm q) D)
    have hgram := design.point_gram (ep.symm p) (ep.symm q)
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at hgram ⊢
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at hgram ⊢
    rw [hsum, hgram]
    by_cases hpq : p = q
    · subst hpq
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hpq, if_neg fun hcontra => hpq (ep.symm.injective hcontra)]
  · intro B
    have hsum :
        (∑ p : Fin 56, design.incidence (ep.symm p) (eb.symm B)) =
          ∑ P : design.Point, design.incidence P (eb.symm B) :=
      Equiv.sum_comp ep.symm (fun P => design.incidence P (eb.symm B))
    have hcol := design.block_size (eb.symm B)
    simp only [incidenceColumnSum] at hcol ⊢
    rw [hsum, hcol]
  · intro B D hBD
    have hne : eb.symm B ≠ eb.symm D := fun hcontra => hBD (eb.symm.injective hcontra)
    have hsum :
        (∑ p : Fin 56,
            design.incidence (ep.symm p) (eb.symm B) *
              design.incidence (ep.symm p) (eb.symm D)) =
          ∑ P : design.Point,
            design.incidence P (eb.symm B) * design.incidence P (eb.symm D) :=
      Equiv.sum_comp ep.symm
        (fun P => design.incidence P (eb.symm B) * design.incidence P (eb.symm D))
    have hinter := design.block_intersections hne
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at hinter ⊢
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at hinter ⊢
    rw [hsum]
    exact hinter

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.root_mem_closedStar
statement: theorem root_mem_closedStar (p : P) (a : Fin 11) : p ∈ K.closedStar p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.card_closedStar
statement: theorem card_closedStar (p : P) (a : Fin 11) : (K.closedStar p a).card = 11
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun e => ((K.coordinate p).symm e).val) :=
    Subtype.val_injective.comp (K.coordinate p).symm.injective
  have hn : p ∉ (Edge11.star a).image (fun e => ((K.coordinate p).symm e).val) := by
    rintro h
    obtain ⟨e, _, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact ((K.coordinate p).symm e).property he
  rw [closedStar, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hn,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hi, Edge11.card_star]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.CoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar
statement:
theorem coordinate_mem_closedStar (p : P) (q : {q : P // q ≠ p}) (a : Fin 11) :
    q.val ∈ K.closedStar p a ↔ a ∈ (K.coordinate p q).vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [closedStar, Finset.mem_insert, q.property, false_or]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨e, he, hval⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    have heq : e = K.coordinate p q := by
      apply (K.coordinate p).symm.injective
      simpa using (Subtype.ext hval : (K.coordinate p).symm e = q)
    subst e
    exact Edge11.mem_star.mp he
  · intro h
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨K.coordinate p q, Edge11.mem_star.mpr h, ?_⟩
    simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.ternaryColumn_mem
statement: theorem ternaryColumn_mem (B : Fin 210) : Q.ternaryColumn B ∈ Q.ternaryCode
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨B, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.ternaryColumn_apply
statement:
theorem ternaryColumn_apply (B : Fin 210) (p : Fin 56) :
    Q.ternaryColumn B p = if Q.matrix p B = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Q.entry_cases p B with h | h <;> simp [ternaryColumn, h]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.ternaryColumn_dot_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ternaryColumn_dot_eq_zero (B D : Fin 210) :
    dotProduct (Q.ternaryColumn B) (Q.ternaryColumn D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have heq : dotProduct (Q.ternaryColumn B) (Q.ternaryColumn D) =
      ((∑ p, Q.matrix p B * Q.matrix p D : ℤ) : ZMod 3) := by
    simp [dotProduct, ternaryColumn]
  rw [heq]
  by_cases h : B = D
  · subst D
    simp_rw [Q.binary]
    have hb := Q.block_size B
    change ∑ p, Q.matrix p B = 12 at hb
    rw [hb]
    decide
  · have hi := Q.block_intersections h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hi
    rcases hi with hi | hi <;> rw [hi] <;> decide

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.ternaryCode_selfOrthogonal
statement:
theorem ternaryCode_selfOrthogonal
    {u v : Fin 56 → ZMod 3} (hu : u ∈ Q.ternaryCode) (hv : v ∈ Q.ternaryCode) :
    dotProduct u v = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂
    (p := fun u v _ _ => dotProduct u v = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hu hv
  · rintro _ _ ⟨B, rfl⟩ ⟨D, rfl⟩
    exact Q.ternaryColumn_dot_eq_zero B D
  · intro v _; exact zero_dotProduct v
  · intro u _; exact dotProduct_zero u
  · intro u v w _ _ _ hu hv; simp [add_dotProduct, hu, hv]
  · intro u v w _ _ _ hv hw; simp [dotProduct_add, hv, hw]
  · intro a u v _ _ h; simp [smul_dotProduct, h]
  · intro a u v _ _ h; simp [dotProduct_smul, h]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.pairGramWord_mem
statement: theorem pairGramWord_mem (p q : Fin 56) : Q.pairGramWord p q ∈ Q.ternaryCode
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sum_mem _ fun B _ => Q.ternaryColumn_mem B

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.pairGramWord_apply
statement:
theorem pairGramWord_apply (p q x : Fin 56) :
    Q.pairGramWord p q x = (Q.tripleMultiplicity p q x : ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [pairGramWord, Finset.sum_apply, Q.ternaryColumn_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  congr 1
  unfold tripleMultiplicity
  congr 1
  ext B
  simp [blocksThroughPair, blocksThroughTriple, and_assoc]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.pairGramWord_at_root
statement:
theorem pairGramWord_at_root (p : Fin 56) (q : {q : Fin 56 // q ≠ p}) :
    Q.pairGramWord p q p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Q.pairGramWord_apply]
  have heq : Q.tripleMultiplicity p q p = (Q.blocksThroughPair p q).card := by
    unfold tripleMultiplicity
    congr 1
    ext B
    simp [blocksThroughPair, blocksThroughTriple]
    tauto
  rw [heq, Q.card_blocksThroughPair q.property.symm]
  decide

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.pairGramWord_add_vmeet
statement:
theorem pairGramWord_add_vmeet (p : Fin 56)
    (q x : {q : Fin 56 // q ≠ p}) :
    Q.pairGramWord p q x +
      (Edge11.vmeet (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p q)
        (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p x) : ZMod 3) = 2
proof:
:= by
  let q' := neEquivPunctured p q
  let x' := neEquivPunctured p x
  have h := (Q.derived45 p).pairMult_add_vmeet_edgeEquiv q' x'
  have hc := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ZMod 3)) h
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add] at hc
  have hdiag : ((if q' = x' then 9 else 0 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = 0 := by
    split <;> decide
  rw [hdiag, add_zero] at hc
  rw [Q.derived_pairMult_eq_tripleMultiplicity] at hc
  rw [Q.pairGramWord_apply]
  exact hc

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.edgePairGram_identity
statement:
theorem edgePairGram_identity (p : Fin 56) (a b : Fin 11) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Q.pairGramWord p ((Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm (Edge11.mk' hab)) =
      (2 : ZMod 3) • outsideOne p - Q.localStarVector p a - Q.localStarVector p b
proof:
:= by
  let q := (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).symm (Edge11.mk' hab)
  have hq : Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p q = Edge11.mk' hab :=
    (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p).apply_symm_apply _
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = p
  · subst x
    simp [Q.pairGramWord_at_root, outsideOne, localStarVector]
  · have h := Q.pairGramWord_add_vmeet p q ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [hq] at h
    have hmeet : Edge11.vmeet (Edge11.mk' hab)
        (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩) =
        (if a ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices then 1 else 0) +
        (if b ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices then 1 else 0) := by
      rw [Edge11.vmeet, Edge11.vertices_mk', ← Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter,
        Finset.card_filter]
      rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simpa using hab), Finset.sum_singleton]
    rw [hmeet, Nat.cast_add] at h
    change Q.pairGramWord p q x = _
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, outsideOne,
      localStarVector, dif_neg hx, if_neg hx, mul_one]
    have ha : ((if a ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices
        then 1 else 0 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) =
        if a ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices then 1 else 0 := by
      split <;> rfl
    have hb : ((if b ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices
        then 1 else 0 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) =
        if b ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices then 1 else 0 := by
      split <;> rfl
    rw [ha, hb] at h
    linear_combination h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.complementedStar_mem_ternaryCode
statement:
theorem complementedStar_mem_ternaryCode (p : Fin 56) (a : Fin 11) :
    outsideOne p - Q.localStarVector p a ∈ Q.ternaryCode
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hba, hca, hbc⟩ := exists_two_ne a
  apply TernaryStarRecovery.complement_mem_of_three_columns
    Q.ternaryCode (outsideOne p) (Q.localStarVector p a)
      (Q.localStarVector p b) (Q.localStarVector p c)
  · rw [← Q.edgePairGram_identity p a b hba.symm]
    exact Q.pairGramWord_mem _ _
  · rw [← Q.edgePairGram_identity p a c hca.symm]
    exact Q.pairGramWord_mem _ _
  · rw [← Q.edgePairGram_identity p b c hbc]
    exact Q.pairGramWord_mem _ _

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.complementVector_closedStar
statement:
theorem complementVector_closedStar (p : Fin 56) (a : Fin 11) :
    TernaryStarRecovery.complementVector (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a) =
      outsideOne p - Q.localStarVector p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = p
  · subst x
    simp [TernaryStarRecovery.complementVector, outsideOne, localStarVector,
      Q.toCoherentK11System.root_mem_closedStar]
  · have hm := Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate_mem_closedStar p ⟨x, hx⟩ a
    simp only [TernaryStarRecovery.complementVector, outsideOne, localStarVector,
      Pi.sub_apply, if_neg hx, dif_neg hx]
    change (if x ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a then 0 else 1) =
      1 - (if a ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate p ⟨x, hx⟩).vertices then 1 else 0)
    simp only [hm]
    split <;> simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.closedStar_overlap_mod_three
statement:
theorem closedStar_overlap_mod_three (p q : Fin 56) (a b : Fin 11) :
    (((Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a ∩
      Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar q b).card : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply TernaryStarRecovery.overlap_eq_two_mod_three
    _ _ (Q.toCoherentK11System.card_closedStar p a)
      (Q.toCoherentK11System.card_closedStar q b)
  rw [Q.complementVector_closedStar, Q.complementVector_closedStar]
  exact Q.ternaryCode_selfOrthogonal (Q.complementedStar_mem_ternaryCode p a)
    (Q.complementedStar_mem_ternaryCode q b)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.blockGraph_adj

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.pairMult_of_not_adj

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.blockGraph_degree
statement: theorem blockGraph_degree (p : P) : E.blockGraph.degree p = 18
proof:
:= by

      (Finset.univ.erase p).filter fun q => E.pairMult p q = 1 := by
    ext q
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase,
      E.blockGraph_adj]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨Ne.symm h.1, Finset.mem_univ q⟩, h.2⟩,
