name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_star_inter
statement:
theorem card_star_inter (p q : P) :
    ((starFinset E.block p) ∩ (starFinset E.block q)).card = E.pairMult p q
proof:
:= by
  have hset : (starFinset E.block p) ∩ (starFinset E.block q) =
      Finset.univ.filter fun i => p ∈ E.block i ∧ q ∈ E.block i := by
    ext i
    simp [starFinset]
  rw [hset]
  rfl

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.sum_pairMult_mul
statement:
theorem sum_pairMult_mul (p q : P) :
    (∑ r : P, E.pairMult p r * E.pairMult q r) = 162 + 9 * E.pairMult p q
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ r : P, pairCount E.block p r * pairCount E.block q r) =
      ∑ i ∈ starFinset E.block p, ∑ j ∈ starFinset E.block q,
        ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card :=
    sum_pairCount_mul_univ₂ E.block E.block p q
  rw [show (∑ r : P, E.pairMult p r * E.pairMult q r) =
      ∑ r : P, pairCount E.block p r * pairCount E.block q r from rfl, h]
  have hcell : ∀ i : Fin 45, ∀ j : Fin 45,
      ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card = 2 + (if i = j then 9 else 0) := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [Finset.inter_self, E.block_card i]
      simp
    · rw [E.pair_meet i j hij]
      simp [hij]
  have hinner : ∀ i : Fin 45,
      (∑ j ∈ starFinset E.block q, ((E.block i) ∩ (E.block j)).card) =
        18 + (if i ∈ starFinset E.block q then 9 else 0) := by
    intro i
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hcell i j, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_const, E.card_star q, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    norm_num
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hinner i, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, E.card_star p, ← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, E.card_star_inter p q, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_commonNeighbors_finset
statement:
theorem card_commonNeighbors_finset {p q : P} (hne : p ≠ q) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter fun r => E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r).card : ℤ)
      + 5 * E.pairMult p q = 14
proof:
:= by
  classical

  set w : P → ℤ := fun r => ((E.pairMult p r : ℤ) - 2) * ((E.pairMult q r : ℤ) - 2)
    with hw
  have hp1 : (∑ r : P, ((E.pairMult p r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 99 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, E.sum_pairMult_univ p]
    norm_num
  have hq1 : (∑ r : P, ((E.pairMult q r : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 99 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, E.sum_pairMult_univ q]
    norm_num
  have hpq : (∑ r : P, ((E.pairMult p r * E.pairMult q r : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
      162 + 9 * (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, E.sum_pairMult_mul p q]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hcard : (Finset.univ : Finset P).card = 55 := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, E.point_card]

  have htotal : (∑ r : P, w r) = 9 * (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) - 14 := by
    have hexp : ∀ r : P, w r = ((E.pairMult p r * E.pairMult q r : ℕ) : ℤ)
        - 2 * ((E.pairMult p r : ℕ) : ℤ) - 2 * ((E.pairMult q r : ℕ) : ℤ) + 4 := by
      intro r
      simp only [hw]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => hexp r, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      hp1, hq1, hpq, Finset.sum_const, hcard]
    push_cast
    ring

  have hwp : w p = 7 * (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) - 14 := by
    simp only [hw, E.pairMult_self p, E.pairMult_comm q p]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hwq : w q = 7 * (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) - 14 := by
    simp only [hw, E.pairMult_self q]
    push_cast
    ring

  have hstep1 := Finset.sum_erase_add (Finset.univ : Finset P) w (Finset.mem_univ p)
  have hqmem : q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset P).erase p :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, Finset.mem_univ q⟩
  have hstep2 := Finset.sum_erase_add ((Finset.univ : Finset P).erase p) w hqmem
  have hrest : (∑ r ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset P).erase p).erase q, w r) =
      14 - 5 * (E.pairMult p q : ℤ) := by
    rw [htotal] at hstep1
    rw [hwp] at hstep1
    rw [hwq] at hstep2
    linarith

  have hind : ∀ r ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset P).erase p).erase q,
      w r = if E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r then 1 else 0 := by
    intro r hr
    have hrq : r ≠ q := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hr).1
    have hrp : r ≠ p := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hr)).1
    have hpr : p ≠ r := Ne.symm hrp
    have hqr : q ≠ r := Ne.symm hrq
    rcases E.pairMult_cases hpr with h1 | h1 <;> rcases E.pairMult_cases hqr with h2 | h2 <;>
      simp [hw, h1, h2, E.blockGraph_adj, hpr, hqr]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hind, Finset.sum_boole] at hrest
  have hfilter : (((Finset.univ : Finset P).erase p).erase q).filter
      (fun r => E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r) =
      Finset.univ.filter fun r => E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r := by
    ext r
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_true]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, hadj⟩
      exact hadj
    · intro hadj
      exact ⟨⟨hadj.2.ne', hadj.1.ne'⟩, hadj⟩
  rw [hfilter] at hrest
  linarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_commonNeighbors_eq
statement:
theorem card_commonNeighbors_eq (p q : P) :
    Fintype.card (E.blockGraph.commonNeighbors p q) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun r => E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r).card
proof:
:= by

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_commonNeighbors_of_adj
statement:
theorem card_commonNeighbors_of_adj {p q : P} (h : E.blockGraph.Adj p q) :
    Fintype.card (E.blockGraph.commonNeighbors p q) = 9
proof:
:= by
  have hcount := E.card_commonNeighbors_finset h.ne
  rw [h.2] at hcount
  push_cast at hcount
  have hz : ((Finset.univ.filter fun r =>
      E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r).card : ℤ) = 9 := by linarith
  rw [E.card_commonNeighbors_eq p q]
  exact_mod_cast hz

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.card_commonNeighbors_of_not_adj
statement:
theorem card_commonNeighbors_of_not_adj {p q : P} (hne : p ≠ q)
    (h : ¬ E.blockGraph.Adj p q) :
    Fintype.card (E.blockGraph.commonNeighbors p q) = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hcount := E.card_commonNeighbors_finset hne
  rw [E.pairMult_of_not_adj hne h] at hcount
  push_cast at hcount
  have hz : ((Finset.univ.filter fun r =>
      E.blockGraph.Adj p r ∧ E.blockGraph.Adj q r).card : ℤ) = 4 := by linarith
  rw [E.card_commonNeighbors_eq p q]
  exact_mod_cast hz

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.blockGraph_isSRGWith
statement:
theorem blockGraph_isSRGWith : E.blockGraph.IsSRGWith 55 18 9 4 where
  card
proof:
:= E.point_card
  regular := E.blockGraph_isRegular
  of_adj := fun _ _ h => E.card_commonNeighbors_of_adj h
  of_not_adj := fun {_ _} hne h => E.card_commonNeighbors_of_not_adj hne h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.compl_adjMatrix
statement:
theorem compl_adjMatrix :
    (E.blockGraph)ᶜ.adjMatrix ℤ =
      (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P P ℤ) - 1 - E.blockGraph.adjMatrix ℤ
proof:
:= by
  ext p q
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst hpq
    simp [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  · by_cases hadj : E.blockGraph.Adj p q <;>

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.Derived45.blockGraph_srg
statement:
theorem blockGraph_srg :
    (E.blockGraph.adjMatrix ℤ) ^ 2 =
      5 • E.blockGraph.adjMatrix ℤ + 4 • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P P ℤ) +
        14 • (1 : Matrix P P ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := E.blockGraph_isSRGWith.matrix_eq (α := ℤ)
  rw [E.compl_adjMatrix] at h
  rw [h]
  ext p q
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    allOnesMatrix_apply, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst hpq
    simp
  · by_cases hadj : E.blockGraph.Adj p q <;> simp [hpq, hadj]

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_oriented_frame
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_oriented_frame (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) ∧
                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                      ((v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧
                        ∃ m : ℤ, E6Cartan.form v v = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨
                       (v ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧
                          E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ)))) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 →
                        v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
                          F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2) ∧
                    (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v) ∧
                    (∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                        let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                        let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                        ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                          (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                          (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                          (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_short_frame G hG x B
  let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
  let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
  have hint : IsIntegral F L := by
    change L ≤ F.dualSubmodule L
    rw [hself]
  have hshort₀ := hshort
  choose a z hz hcoord hbinary htype using hshort
  have hlabels (D : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
      ∃ cE : ℤ, ShortFrameLabel (a D) cE ∧
        ∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6,
          a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) =
            w+cE • E6Cartan.weight :=
    (htype D).exists_label (hE _ (hframe D).1).1
  choose cE hcLabel hcCoset using hlabels
  have hcompat (D1 D2 : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
      12 ∣ 21-a D1*a D2+16*cE D1*cE D2 := by
    apply a11D7E6_pair_congruence (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      ψ hψpair hmarked
      (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D1, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
      (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D2, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
      (hint (hframe D1).1 _ (hframe D2).1)
      (by change standardRatForm 7 (coordinateSpinor 7) (coordinateSpinor 7) = 7/4
          simpa using coordinateSpinor_norm 7)
      (a D1) (a D2) (cE D1) (cE D2) (z D1) (z D2)
      (hz D1) (hz D2) (hcoord D1) (hcoord D2) (hcCoset D1) (hcCoset D2)
  obtain ⟨ε, δ, hε, hδ, hglobal⟩ :=
    shortFrameLabel_global_orientation B a cE hcLabel hcompat
  have horiented (D : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
        (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v := by
    have hco := a11_centered_orientation ε (a D) (z D) hε (hz D) (hbinary D)
    refine ⟨orientedALabel ε (a D), orientedBinaryCoordinates ε (z D), hco.1, ?_, hco.2.2, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [hcoord D i]
      exact hco.2.1 i
    · exact a11E6_normalized_type hδ (htype D) (hcLabel D) (hcCoset D) (hglobal D)
        (a11D7E6_E6_zero F ψ hψpair hpd _)
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
    ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
    coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort₀, ε, δ, hε, hδ, horiented⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzian_frame_mass_of_A_chain
statement:
theorem lorentzian_frame_mass_of_A_chain
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) (k : RankSixKind)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k) (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (ε δ : ℤ)
    (horiented : ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ), (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
        (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v)
    (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k)
    (hr : ∀ i, ψ.symm ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) ∈
      coordinateIntegerLattice 24)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ))
    (hE : ∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
      ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) :
    LorentzianFrameMass G hG x c hc k ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hroot, hrootgram, horth⟩ := a11D7E6_complement_A4_coordinates
    (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k) ψ hpair hmarked
    (fun i : Fin 4 => r (i.castAdd n)) (fun i => hr _)
    (fun i j => hgram (i.castAdd n) (j.castAdd n)) (fun i => hE _)
  choose a z hsum hcoord hbinary htype using horiented
  have hfirst := (a11D7E6_frame_first_moments ψ hmarked
    (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc) (coordinateSpinor 7)
    (lorentzPerpGenerator_sum G hG x c hc)).1
  have hcounts := a11_A4_first_moment_counts _ ε a z
    (secondSubconstituent_card G hG x) hfirst hsum hcoord hbinary
    (fun D => (htype D).elim (fun h => Or.inl h.1) (fun h => Or.inr h.1))
    _ hroot hrootgram (fun i D => horth i (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc D) (coordinateSpinor 7))
  exact normalized_frame_counts_energy a δ _ _ htype hcounts.1 hcounts.2

name: SRG266.lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map
statement:
theorem lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P) (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (p : ℕ) :
    torsionPart (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) p =
      lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ⊔
        (torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P p).map
          ((lorentzD7OddLift G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ)
proof:
:=
  torsionPart_eq_sup_map_of_dual_transport ((lorentzD7OddLift G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ)
    (lorentzD7Glue_isIntegral G hG x c hc hle hint B)
    (lorentzD7_dual_eq_sup_map G hG x c hc hle hint B)
    (fun _ hv => lorentzD7OddLift_mem_iff G hG x c hc hle hint B hv) p

name: SRG266.lorentzD7OddLift_pair_integral
statement:
theorem lorentzD7OddLift_pair_integral (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {u v : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hu : u ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P)
    (hv : v ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P)
    (huv : lorentzGramForm G x c u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) :
    lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7OddLift G x c B u) (lorentzD7OddLift G x c B v) ∈
      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B u)
    (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B v) + standardRatForm 7 0 0 ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
  simpa only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using
    lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_integral G hG x c hc hle B hu hv huv

name: SRG266.lorentzD7_hasPrimaryNormalForm
statement:
theorem lorentzD7_hasPrimaryNormalForm (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P) (B : SecondSubconstituent G x)
    {p : ℕ} {r : ℤ} (h : HasPrimaryNormalForm (lorentzGramForm G x c) P p r) :
    HasPrimaryNormalForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) p r
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : P.map ((lorentzD7OddLift G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ) ≤
      lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B := by
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact (lorentzD7OddLift_mem_iff G hG x c hc hle hint B (hint hv)).mpr hv
  exact h.map ((lorentzD7OddLift G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ) hmap
    (lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map G hG x c hc hle hint B p)
    (fun _ hu => lorentzD7OddLift_norm_mod_even G hG x c hc hle B (mem_torsionPart.mp hu).1)
    (fun _ hu _ hv huv => lorentzD7OddLift_pair_integral G hG x c hc hle B
      (mem_torsionPart.mp hu).1 (mem_torsionPart.mp hv).1 huv)

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzD7_normal_forms_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzD7_normal_forms_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsEven (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) = 18 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < lorentzD7Form G x c z z) ∧
      (∀ D, lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ∧
        lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D)
          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D) = 4) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) =
        torsionPart (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 3 ⊔
          torsionPart (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 5 ∧
      HasPrimaryNormalForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 3 2 ∧
      HasPrimaryNormalForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 5 4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, P, hc, hle, hlat, hmax, heven, hsplit, hthree, hfive⟩ :=
    exists_lorentzMarked_normal_forms_from_graph G hG x
  refine ⟨c, hc, P, hle, hmax,
    cyclicGlueLattice_isLattice
      (lorentzPerpLattice_isLattice G hG x c hc hle hlat hmax.integral)
      (evenCoordinateLattice_isLattice 7),
    lorentzD7Glue_isEven G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral (lorentzPerpLattice_isEven G x c heven) B,
    finrank_lorentzD7Space G hG x c hc,
    prodForm_posDef (lorentzPerpForm_posDef G hG x c) (standardRatForm_posDef 7),
    fun D => ⟨lorentzD7FrameVector_mem G hG x c hc hle B D,
      lorentzD7FrameVector_norm G hG x c hc D⟩,
    lorentzD7Glue_mem_left_iff G hG x c hc hle B,
    lorentzD7Glue_mem_right_iff G hG x c hc hle (lorentzPerpLattice_isEven G x c heven) B, ?_,
    lorentzD7_hasPrimaryNormalForm G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B hthree,
    lorentzD7_hasPrimaryNormalForm G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B hfive⟩
  rw [lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B 3,
    lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B 5,
    lorentzD7_dual_eq_sup_map G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B, hsplit, Submodule.map_sup]
  exact sup_sup_distrib_left _ _ _

name: SRG266.centroidHeight_integral_of_marked_le

    (hle (lorentzWeylVector_mem_markedLattice G x c))

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpLattice_isIntegral
statement:

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpGenerator_mem_dual
statement:
theorem lorentzPerpGenerator_mem_dual (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B ∈
      (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  change lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B) y ∈ _
  rw [(lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq,
    lorentzProjectedGenerator_pair G hG x c hc y y.2,
    (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq]
  exact hint (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _))) y hy

name: SRG266.four_zsmul_lorentzPerpGenerator_mem
statement:
theorem four_zsmul_lorentzPerpGenerator_mem (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    (4 : ℤ) • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
proof:
:= by
  change (4 : ℤ) • lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B ∈ P
  have heq : (4 : ℤ) • lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B =
      (4 : ℤ) • toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B) - lorentzWeylVector G x c := by
    simp only [lorentzProjectedGenerator, lorentzHeightZeroPart,
      centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc]
    module
  rw [heq]
  exact P.sub_mem (P.smul_mem _ (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _)))) (hle (lorentzWeylVector_mem_markedLattice G x c))

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpGenerator_sub_mem
statement:
theorem lorentzPerpGenerator_sub_mem (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B C : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B - lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc C ∈
      lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B - lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c C ∈ P
  have heq : lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B - lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c C =
      toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B) -
        toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C) := by
    simp only [lorentzProjectedGenerator, lorentzHeightZeroPart,
      centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc]
    module
  rw [heq]
  exact P.sub_mem (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _))) (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _)))

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpGenerator_zsmul_mem_iff
statement:
theorem lorentzPerpGenerator_zsmul_mem_iff (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)

    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (heven : Lattice.IsEven (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (m : ℤ) :
    m • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ↔ 4 ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  exact Lattice.zsmul_mem_iff_four_dvd_of_odd_quarter_norm
    (lorentzPerpLattice_isEven G x c heven) (a := 9) ⟨4, by norm_num⟩
    (lorentzPerpGenerator_norm G hG x c hc B)
    (four_zsmul_lorentzPerpGenerator_mem G hG x c hc hle B) m

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_two_remaining_complements
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_two_remaining_complements (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) ∧
                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                      ((v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧
                        ∃ m : ℤ, E6Cartan.form v v = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨
                       (v ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧
                          E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ)))) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 →
                        v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
                          F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2) ∧
                    (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v) ∧
                    (∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                        let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                        let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                        ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                          (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                          (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                          (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) →
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) →
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
                      ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 → r.1.2 = 0 →
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 ∨ a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n+1) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) →
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (n+1) i j : ℚ)) →
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) ∨
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨
                      (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∨
                      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
                        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
                        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
                        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (∃ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) ≠ 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) →
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) →
                      ∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨
                      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
                        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
                        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
                        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨ LorentzianFrameMass G hG x c hc k ψ) ∧
                    LorentzianComponentFrameBound G hG x c hc k ψ ∧
                    (k = .fifteenMinus ∨ k = .seventyFive))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort,
      horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill, hroot, hside, hchain, hfork, hnonzero, hforce, hfinal, hmass⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_frame_mass G hG x B
  have hbound := lorentzian_component_frame_bounds G hG x c hc k ψ hψpair hmarked
  have hexclude (hk : k = .ternary ∨ k = .fifteenPlus) : False := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hg⟩ := rankSix_has_A5_chain k hk
    have hmasses : LorentzianFrameMass G hG x c hc k ψ := hmass.resolve_left (by
      intro h75
      rcases hk with hk | hk <;> rw [hk] at h75 <;> cases h75)
    exact lorentzian_no_complementary_A5 G hG x c hc k ψ hψpair hmarked
      hmasses r hg (hforce 1 r hr hg)
  have hremaining : k = .fifteenMinus ∨ k = .seventyFive := by
    cases k
    · exact (hexclude (Or.inl rfl)).elim
    · exact (hexclude (Or.inr rfl)).elim
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
    ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
    coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort, horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill,
    hroot, hside, hchain, hfork, hnonzero, hforce, hfinal, hmass, hbound, hremaining⟩

name: SRG266.gramLattice_eq_span_generators
statement:
theorem gramLattice_eq_span_generators (x : V) :
    gramLattice G x = Submodule.span ℤ
      (Set.range fun B => toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ a
    rw [mk_eq_sum_smul_generator, map_sum]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun B _ => by
      rw [map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨B, rfl⟩)
  · exact Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
      rintro _ ⟨B, rfl⟩
      exact toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _)

name: SRG266.centroidHeight_integral
statement:
theorem centroidHeight_integral (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {z : ratGramSpace G x} (hz : z ∈ gramLattice G x) :
    centroidHeight G x c z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ a
  rw [mk_eq_sum_smul_generator, map_sum, map_sum]
  simp only [map_zsmul, centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc,
    zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun B _ => Submodule.mem_one.mpr ⟨a B, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzGramLattice_isIntegral
statement:
theorem lorentzGramLattice_isIntegral (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) :
    Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) (gramLattice G x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lattice.isIntegral_iff_forall]
  intro u hu v hv
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (centroidHeight_integral G hG x c hc hu)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (centroidHeight_integral G hG x c hc hv)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (gramLattice_isIntegral G x hu v hv)
  have ha' : (a : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c u := by simpa using ha
  have hb' : (b : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c v := by simpa using hb
  have hk' : (k : ℚ) = ratGramForm G x u v := by simpa using hk
  rw [lorentzGramForm_apply, ← ha', ← hb', ← hk']
  exact Submodule.mem_one.mpr ⟨k - a * b, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzGramLattice_isEven
statement:
theorem lorentzGramLattice_isEven (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) :
    Lattice.IsEven (lorentzGramForm G x c) (gramLattice G x)
proof:
:= by
  have hint := lorentzGramLattice_isIntegral G hG x c hc
  rw [gramLattice_eq_span_generators] at hint ⊢
  apply Lattice.isEven_of_span _ (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c) hint

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_short_frame
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_short_frame (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) ∧
                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                      ((v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧
                        ∃ m : ℤ, E6Cartan.form v v = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨
                       (v ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧
                          E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ)))) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 →
                        v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
                          F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2) ∧
                    (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_E6_dual G hG x B
  let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
  let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
  have hint : IsIntegral F L := by
    change L ≤ F.dualSubmodule L
    rw [hself]
  have hmem (z : Fin 24 → ℤ) : ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L := by
    change ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) ∈ L
    rw [hψ]
    exact (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z)).property
  have hshort (D : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v := by
    let r := (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
    have hr : r ∈ L := (hframe D).1
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha11, z, hz, hcoord, hmin, heq, hcong⟩ :=
      a11D7E6_A11_minimum F L ψ hψpair hmem hint hr
    have hremaining := a11D7E6_remaining_energy (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      ψ hψpair hmarked r (hframe D).2
      (by change standardRatForm 7 (coordinateSpinor 7) (coordinateSpinor 7) = 7/4
          simpa using coordinateSpinor_norm 7)
    have he6 := hE r hr
    have htypes := a11E6_short_type_of_energy _ _ a z ha0 ha11 hmin heq hcong
      he6.1 he6.2.1 hremaining
    exact ⟨a, z, hz, hcoord, htypes⟩
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
    ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
    coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzD7FrameVector_norm

name: SRG266.lorentzD7FrameVector_mem
statement:
theorem lorentzD7FrameVector_mem (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B C : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc B ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hdiff : (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc C -
      lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)) ∈
      lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨lorentzPerpGenerator_sub_mem G hG x c hc hle C B,
      (evenCoordinateLattice 7).zero_mem⟩
  have heq : lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C =
      (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc C - lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B,
        (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)) + lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc B := by
    ext <;> simp [lorentzD7FrameVector]
  rw [heq]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ hdiff hbase

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzD7Glue_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzD7Glue_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      IsLattice ℚ (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsIntegral (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsEven (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) = 18 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < lorentzD7Form G x c z z) ∧
      (∀ C, lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ∧
        lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C)
          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C) = 4) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔

proof:
:= by

    lorentzD7Glue_isIntegral G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B,
    lorentzD7Glue_isEven G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral heven B,
    finrank_lorentzD7Space G hG x c hc, prodForm_posDef hpd (standardRatForm_posDef 7),
    fun C => ⟨lorentzD7FrameVector_mem G hG x c hc hle B C,
      lorentzD7FrameVector_norm G hG x c hc C⟩,

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_root_moment
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_root_moment (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_isolated_d7 G hG x B
  have hs := prodForm_isSymm
    (prodForm_isSymm (lorentzPerpForm_isSymm G x c) (standardRatForm_isSymm 7))
    (rankSixForm_isSymm k)
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hmoment⟩ := exists_root_finset_and_moment hs hpd hrank hl hself he
  let a : Fin 7 → ℤ := Pi.single 0 1 + Pi.single 1 1
  have ha : intCoordsToRat a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7 := by
    apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
    refine ⟨a, rfl, ?_⟩
    simp [a, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hn : standardRatForm 7 (intCoordsToRat a) (intCoordsToRat a) = 2 := by
    norm_num [standardRatForm_apply, intCoordsToRat_apply, a, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Pi.single_apply]
  have hroot : (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), intCoordsToRat a), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ R := by
    apply (hR _).mpr
    refine ⟨(hD7 _).mpr ha, ?_⟩
    simpa only [prodForm_apply, lorentzD7Form, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      zero_add, add_zero] using hn
  have hcard : (R.card : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨_, hroot⟩)
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hmoment,
    span_eq_top_of_bilinear_moment R 12 (R.card : ℚ) hpd hcard hmoment⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzD7FrameVector_pair_localGram
statement:
theorem lorentzD7FrameVector_pair_localGram
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (D E : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D)
      (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc E) = (localGramMatrix G x D E : ℚ)+1
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc D)
    (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc E) +
      standardRatForm 7 (coordinateSpinor 7) (coordinateSpinor 7) = _
  rw [coordinateSpinor_norm]
  have h := lorentzHeightZeroPart_generator_generator G hG x c hc D E
  change lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc D)
    (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc E) = (localKMatrix G x D E : ℚ)+1/4 at h
  rw [h]
  simp [localKMatrix]
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzian_type_A_binary_factorization
statement:
theorem lorentzian_type_A_binary_factorization
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) (k : RankSixKind)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k) (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (ε δ : ℤ) (hε : ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1)
    (horiented : ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ), (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
        (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v)
    (hzero : ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) :
    ∃ W : Matrix (Fin 12) (SecondSubconstituent G x) ℤ,
      (∀ i D, W i D = 0 ∨ W i D = 1) ∧ (∀ D, (∑ i, W i D) = 3) ∧
        W.transpose * W = localGramMatrix G x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoords (D) := a11_type_A_binary_coordinates (hzero D) (horiented D)
  choose z hz hcoord hbinary using hcoords
  refine ⟨fun i D => z D i, fun i D => hbinary D i, hz, ?_⟩
  ext D E
  change (∑ i, z D i*z E i) = localGramMatrix G x D E
  have hp := a11D7E6_type_A_binary_pair (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
    ψ hpair hmarked
    (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
    (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc E, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
    (by change standardRatForm 7 (coordinateSpinor 7) (coordinateSpinor 7) = 7/4
        simpa using coordinateSpinor_norm 7)
    (hzero D) (-(ε : ℚ)) (by rcases hε with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num)
    (z D) (z E) (hz D) (hz E) (hcoord D) (hcoord E)
  have hQ : ((∑ i, z D i*z E i : ℤ) : ℚ) = (localGramMatrix G x D E : ℚ) := by
    rw [prodForm_apply, map_zero, add_zero] at hp
    change ((∑ i, z D i*z E i : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D)
        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc E)-1 at hp
    rw [lorentzD7FrameVector_pair_localGram G hG x c hc] at hp
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hp
  exact_mod_cast hQ

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_order75_projection_data

theorem exists_rank24_order75_projection_data (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)

      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T

      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔

      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔

      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧

      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧

          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →

            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧

              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =

                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →

                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →

                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧

                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧

                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q

                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v) ∧
                    (∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                        let u := a11D7E6A11Part q

                        ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                          (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                          (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                          (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),

                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) →
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
                      ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 → r.1.2 = 0 →
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 ∨ a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n+1) → rankSixSpace k),

                      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,

                          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨ LorentzianFrameMass G hG x c hc k ψ) ∧

                    (k = .fifteenMinus ∨ k = .seventyFive) ∧ k = .seventyFive ∧
                    LorentzianFrameMass G hG x c hc k ψ ∧
                    LorentzianQ15ProjectionData G x c k ψ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort,
      horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill, hroot, hside, hchain, hfork, hnonzero, hforce,
      hfinal, hmass, hbound, hremaining, h75, hmasses⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_order75_frame_mass G hG x B
  have hdata : LorentzianQ15ProjectionData G x c k ψ := by
    subst k
    let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm .seventyFive)
    let L := rankSixCompletionLattice .seventyFive S T
    have hmem (z : Fin 24 → ℤ) : ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L := by
      change ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) ∈ L
      rw [hψ z]
      exact (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z)).property
    have hint : IsIntegral F L := by rw [Lattice.IsIntegral, hself]
    have hnonneg (t) : 0 ≤ F t t := by
      by_cases ht : t = 0
      · subst t
        simp only [map_zero, le_refl]
      · exact le_of_lt (hpd t ht)
    let v := fun i : Fin 2 => a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
      ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), rankSixOrder75Q15Vector i))
    have hrmem (i : Fin 2) :
        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), rankSixOrder75Q15Vector i) ∈ L :=
      (hright _).mpr (rankSixOrder75Q15Vector_mem i)
    have hrnorm (i : Fin 2) :
        F ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), rankSixOrder75Q15Vector i)
          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), rankSixOrder75Q15Vector i) = 4 := by
      simp only [F, prodForm_apply, map_zero, zero_add]

    have hvdual (i : Fin 2) :

name: SRG266.lorentzD7OddLift_mem_dual
statement:
theorem lorentzD7OddLift_mem_dual (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {v : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hv : v ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    lorentzD7OddLift G x c B v ∈
      (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B)
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ≤
    rightIntegral (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7OddLift G x c B v)
  refine sup_le (fun z hz => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · change lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B v) z.1 +
      standardRatForm 7 0 z.2 ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    simpa only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using
      lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B hv z.1 hz.1
  · rintro _ (rfl : _ = (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B, coordinateSpinor 7))
    change lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B v)
      (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) + standardRatForm 7 0 (coordinateSpinor 7) ∈
        (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    simpa only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using
      lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked_integral G hG x c hc hle B hv

name: SRG266.lorentzD7_dual_eq_sup_map
statement:
theorem lorentzD7_dual_eq_sup_map (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P) (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) =
      lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ⊔
        ((lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P).map
          ((lorentzD7OddLift G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hp : z ∈ (prodForm (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (standardRatForm 7)).dualSubmodule
        ((lorentzPerpLattice G x c P).prod (evenCoordinateLattice 7)) :=
      fun w hw => hz w (Submodule.mem_sup_left hw)
    rw [dualSubmodule_prodForm] at hp
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hp
    rw [lorentzPerp_dual_eq_map_sup_marked G hG x c hc hle hint B] at hx
    obtain ⟨jv, hjv, au, hau, hxeq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hjv
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hau
    change lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B v +
      a • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B = z.1 at hxeq
    rw [d7_dual] at hy
    obtain ⟨d, hd, bs, hbs, hyeq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hbs
    have hj := lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked_integral G hG x c hc hle B hv
    have hs : standardRatForm 7 d (coordinateSpinor 7) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
      rw [(standardRatForm_isSymm 7).eq]
      exact coordinateSpinor_mem_dual 7 d hd
    have hg := hz (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc B)
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
    have he : lorentzD7Form G x c z (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc B) =
        lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B v)
          (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) +
        standardRatForm 7 d (coordinateSpinor 7) +
        (a : ℚ) * (9 / 4) + (b : ℚ) * (7 / 4) := by
      change lorentzPerpForm G x c z.1 (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) +
        standardRatForm 7 z.2 (coordinateSpinor 7) = _
      rw [← hxeq, ← hyeq]
      have ha : a • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B =
          (a : ℚ) • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B := by module
      have hb : b • coordinateSpinor 7 = (b : ℚ) • coordinateSpinor 7 := by module
      rw [ha, hb]
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, lorentzPerpGenerator_norm, coordinateSpinor_norm]
      norm_num
      ring
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hj
    obtain ⟨s, hs'⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hs
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hg
    have hlinQ : (9 : ℚ) * a + 7 * b = 4 * ((t : ℚ) - r - s) := by
      rw [he, ← hr, ← hs'] at ht
      linarith
    have hlin : 9 * a + 7 * b = 4 * (t - r - s) := by exact_mod_cast hlinQ
    have hdvd : (4 : ℤ) ∣ a - b := ⟨t - r - s - 2 * a - 2 * b, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
    have hres : d - k • ((4 : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7) ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7 :=
      Submodule.sub_mem _ hd (Submodule.smul_mem _ k (four_smul_coordinateSpinor_mem 7))
    have hdecomp : z = lorentzD7OddLift G x c B v +
        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), d - k • ((4 : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7)) +
        a • lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc B := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · change z.1 = lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B v + 0 +
          a • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B
        simpa only [add_zero] using hxeq.symm
      · change z.2 = 0 + (d - k • ((4 : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7)) +
          a • coordinateSpinor 7
        rw [← hyeq]
        have hb : b = a - 4 * k := by omega
        rw [hb]
        module
    rw [hdecomp]
    apply Submodule.add_mem
    · apply Submodule.add_mem
      · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left
          ⟨(lorentzPerpLattice G x c P).zero_mem, hres⟩)
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.smul_mem _ a
        (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
  · refine sup_le (lorentzD7Glue_isIntegral G hG x c hc hle hint B) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact lorentzD7OddLift_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B hv

name: SRG266.lorentzD7OddLift_norm_mod_even
statement:
theorem lorentzD7OddLift_norm_mod_even (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)

    lorentzIntegralProjection_norm_mod_even G hG x c hc hle B hv

name: SRG266.lorentzD7_dual_denominator
statement:
theorem lorentzD7_dual_denominator (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (hden : ∀ v ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P, (15 : ℤ) • v ∈ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B)) :
    (15 : ℤ) • z ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B
proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨a, ha, jv, hjv, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hjv
  rw [smul_add]
  apply Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha)
  exact (lorentzD7OddLift_zsmul_mem_iff G hG x c hc hle hint B hv 15).mpr (hden v hv)

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzD7_discriminant_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzD7_discriminant_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsEven (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) =
        lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ⊔
          ((lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P).map
            ((lorentzD7OddLift G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B),
        (15 : ℤ) • z ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_integral_centroid G hG x
  obtain ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, heven, hden⟩ :=
    exists_lorentzMarked_maximal_even_extension G hG x c hc
