    cyclicGlueLattice_isLattice (lorentzPerpLattice_isLattice G hG x c hc hle hlat hmax.integral)
      (evenCoordinateLattice_isLattice 7),
    lorentzD7Glue_isEven G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral
      (lorentzPerpLattice_isEven G x c heven) B,
    lorentzD7_dual_eq_sup_map G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B, ?_⟩
  exact fun _ hz => lorentzD7_dual_denominator G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral hden B hz

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_frame_mass
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_frame_mass (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) ∧
                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                      ((v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧
                        ∃ m : ℤ, E6Cartan.form v v = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨
                       (v ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧
                          E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ)))) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 →
                        v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
                          F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2) ∧
                    (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v) ∧
                    (∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                        let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                        let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                        ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                          (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                          (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                          (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzMarked_normal_forms_from_graph

      (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x ∧

      Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧

        Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3 ⊔

    T.normalForm_five (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c) hmax heven⟩

name: SRG266.MomentBounds.card_le_four_mul_bound
statement:
theorem card_le_four_mul_bound {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → ℚ) (d bound : ℚ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hgap : ∀ i ∈ s, d / 4 ≤ f i ^ 2)
    (hupper : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2 ≤ bound * d) :
    (s.card : ℚ) ≤ 4 * bound
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hgap
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hd).mp
  nlinarith

name: SRG266.MomentBounds.no_gap_of_moment_upper

proof:
:= by

  rw [hs] at hcard
  norm_num at hcard

name: SRG266.MomentBounds.no_q15_projection_trace

    (hy : y = 0 ∨ y = 4 ∨ y = 6 ∨ y = 12)
    (hcs : z ^ 2 ≤ x * y)

    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hroots rfl rfl

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_ADE_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_ADE_coordinates (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,

                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheight⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_simple_roots G hG x B

    positiveCartan_ADECoordinates_unbounded hposS
  have hts24 : ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 := hts.trans hcardS
  refine ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheight,
    ts, hregular, hts24, coord, hgram,
    coordinateRootMap_injective hf coord, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact coordinateRootMap_pairing hf coord (adeGram ts).2 hgram
  · exact coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots hf coord
  · exact coordinateRootMap_dominant_height coord 11 hheight

statement:
theorem no_q15_projection_data

    a, b, z, hx, hy, hz, hxval, hyval, hcs, hroots⟩ := hdata
  have hpos := (a11D7E6_component_forms_pos _ ψ hpair
    (prodForm_posDef (prodForm_posDef (lorentzPerpForm_posDef G hG x c)

  have hself (t) (ht : rankSixForm k t t = 0) : t = 0 := by

    linarith
  have hs : LinearIndependent ℚ s :=

  have hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (rankSixSpace k) = Fintype.card (Fin 4)+2 := by
    rw [rankSixSpace_finrank]
    rfl
  have htrace := a11D7E6_binary_complement_frame_mass
    (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
    (lorentzPerpForm_isSymm G x c) (rankSixForm_isSymm k) hself ψ hpair hmarked
    E6Cartan.form E6Cartan.form_isSymm hpos
    a11D7E6E6Part a11D7E6E6Lift
    a11D7E6E6Part_lift a11D7E6E6Lift_pair a11D7E6D7Projection_E6Lift
    (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc) (coordinateSpinor 7) 45

  dsimp only at htrace
  have henergy := hmass.2.2.2

  rw [henergy] at htrace
  norm_num at htrace
  have hQ : 4*(a : ℚ)+4*(b : ℚ)-2*(z : ℚ) = 50 := by
    rw [← hx, ← hy, ← hz]
    linarith
  exact MomentBounds.no_q15_projection_trace a b z

      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧

      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_apply
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_apply (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (z : ratGramSpace G x) :
    (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z : ratGramSpace G x) =
      z - centroidHeight G x c z • toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)
proof:
:= by
  change centroidHeight G x c (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) • z -
    centroidHeight G x c z • toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B) = _
  rw [centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc, one_smul]

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_apply_perp
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_apply_perp (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (y : lorentzPerpSpace G x c) :
    lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B (y : ratGramSpace G x) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc]
  have hy : centroidHeight G x c (y : ratGramSpace G x) = 0 := y.2
  rw [hy, zero_smul, sub_zero]

name: SRG266.centroidHeight_integral_on_dual
statement:
theorem centroidHeight_integral_on_dual (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    {z : ratGramSpace G x} (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    centroidHeight G x c z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hz _ (hle (lorentzWeylVector_mem_markedLattice G x c))
  rw [(lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq, lorentzWeylVector_pair G hG x c hc] at h
  simpa only [neg_neg] using (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).neg_mem h

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_mem
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_mem (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x} (hz : z ∈ P) :
    lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp
    (centroidHeight_integral_of_marked_le G hG x c hc hle hint hz)
  have ha' : (a : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c z := by simpa using ha
  rw [mem_lorentzPerpLattice, lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc,
    ← ha', Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  exact P.sub_mem hz (P.smul_mem _ (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _))))

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_map_lattice
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_map_lattice (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    P.map ((lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ) =
      lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact lorentzIntegralProjection_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B hz
  · intro y hy
    exact ⟨y, hy, lorentzIntegralProjection_apply_perp G hG x c hc B y⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_dual
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_dual (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈
      (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hz)
  have ha' : (a : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c z := by simpa using ha
  intro y hy
  change lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z) y ∈ _
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc, ← ha', Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul,
    map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  exact (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).sub_mem (hz y hy) ((1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem a
    (hint (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
      (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _))) y hy))

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_iff
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_iff (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ↔ z ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hz)
    have ha' : (a : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c z := by simpa using ha
    rw [mem_lorentzPerpLattice, lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc,
      ← ha', Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] at hj
    have hg := P.smul_mem a (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
      (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x (integralGramGenerator G x B))))
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using P.add_mem hj hg
  · exact lorentzIntegralProjection_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpDualLift_pair
statement:
theorem lorentzPerpDualLift_pair (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (y : lorentzPerpSpace G x c) (z : ratGramSpace G x) :
    lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) z =
      lorentzPerpForm G x c y (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) z =
    lorentzGramForm G x c y (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc, lorentzPerpDualLift]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, map_sub]
  rw [lorentzWeylVector_pair G hG x c hc]
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpDualLift_mem_dual
statement:
theorem lorentzPerpDualLift_mem_dual (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {y : lorentzPerpSpace G x c}
    (hy : y ∈ (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P)) :
    lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [lorentzPerpDualLift_pair G hG x c hc]
  exact hy _ (lorentzIntegralProjection_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B hz)

name: SRG266.lorentzPerpDualLift_decomposition
statement:
theorem lorentzPerpDualLift_decomposition (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (y : lorentzPerpSpace G x c) :
    y = lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) +
      centroidHeight G x c (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) •
        lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hy : centroidHeight G x c (y : ratGramSpace G x) = 0 := y.2
  change (y : ratGramSpace G x) =
    (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) : ratGramSpace G x) +
      centroidHeight G x c (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) • lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc]
  simp only [lorentzPerpDualLift, lorentzProjectedGenerator, lorentzHeightZeroPart,
    map_add, map_smul, hy, centroidHeight_weylVector G hG x c hc,
    centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc, smul_eq_mul, zero_add]
  module

name: SRG266.lorentzPerp_dual_eq_map_sup_marked
statement:
theorem lorentzPerp_dual_eq_map_sup_marked (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) =
      ((lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P).map
        ((lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B).restrictScalars ℤ) ⊔
      Submodule.span ℤ {lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    have hz := lorentzPerpDualLift_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hz)
    have ha' : (a : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c (lorentzPerpDualLift G x c B y) := by
      simpa using ha
    have hsmul : (a : ℚ) • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B =
        (a : ℤ) • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B := by module
    rw [lorentzPerpDualLift_decomposition G hG x c hc B y, ← ha', hsmul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩)
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
  · apply sup_le
    · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B hz
    · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro z (rfl : z = _)
      exact lorentzPerpGenerator_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_pair
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_pair (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (z w : ratGramSpace G x) :
    lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
        (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B w) =
      lorentzGramForm G x c z w - centroidHeight G x c z *
        lorentzGramForm G x c (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) w -
      centroidHeight G x c w * lorentzGramForm G x c z
        (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) +
      2 * centroidHeight G x c z * centroidHeight G x c w
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
    (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B w) = _
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc, lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc]
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [lorentzGramForm_generator_generator G hG x c hc, localKMatrix_diagonal G hG x B]
  norm_num
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_norm_mod_even
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_norm_mod_even (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
        (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z) = lorentzGramForm G x c z z + 2 * (n : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hz)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (hz _ (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)))))
  have ha' : (a : ℚ) = centroidHeight G x c z := by simpa using ha
  have hb' : (b : ℚ) = lorentzGramForm G x c z
      (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) := by simpa using hb
  refine ⟨a ^ 2 - a * b, ?_⟩
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_pair G hG x c hc,
    (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) z,
    ← ha', ← hb']
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (z : ratGramSpace G x) :
    lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
        (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) =
      lorentzGramForm G x c z (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) -
        2 * centroidHeight G x c z
proof:
:= by
  change lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
    (lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B) = _
  rw [lorentzProjectedGenerator_pair G hG x c hc _ (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z).2,
    lorentzIntegralProjection_apply G hG x c hc]
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [lorentzGramForm_generator_generator G hG x c hc, localKMatrix_diagonal G hG x B]
  norm_num
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_integral
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_integral (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z w : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P)
    (hw : w ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P)
    (hzw : lorentzGramForm G x c z w ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) :
    lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
      (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B w) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
    (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Lattice.mem_one_iff.mp (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hz)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Lattice.mem_one_iff.mp (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hw)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Lattice.mem_one_iff.mp (hz _ hg)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Lattice.mem_one_iff.mp (hw _ hg)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Lattice.mem_one_iff.mp hzw
  refine Lattice.mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨k - a * e - b * d + 2 * a * b, ?_⟩
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_pair G hG x c hc,
    (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) w,
    ← ha, ← hb, ← hd, ← he, ← hk]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked_integral
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked_integral (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
      (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lorentzIntegralProjection_pair_marked G hG x c hc]
  apply (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).sub_mem
  · exact hz _ (hle (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c
      (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x _)))
  · simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_ofNat] using
      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem (2 : ℤ)
        (centroidHeight_integral_on_dual G hG x c hc hle hz)

name: SRG266.lorentzPerp_dual_eq_sup_span
statement:
theorem lorentzPerp_dual_eq_sup_span (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (s : Set (ratGramSpace G x))
    (hdual : (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P = P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s) :
    (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) =
      lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
        ({lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B} ∪ (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lorentzPerp_dual_eq_map_sup_marked G hG x c hc hle hint B, hdual,
    Submodule.map_sup, lorentzIntegralProjection_map_lattice G hG x c hc hle hint B,
    Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_union]
  ac_rfl

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x} {m : ℤ} (hz : m • z ∈ P) :
    m • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
proof:
:= by
  have h := lorentzIntegralProjection_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B hz
  rwa [map_zsmul] at h

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_torsionPart
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_torsionPart (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x} {p : ℕ}
    (hz : z ∈ Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P p) :
    lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈
      Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := Lattice.mem_torsionPart.mp hz
  exact Lattice.mem_torsionPart.mpr
    ⟨lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B hd,
      lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B hm⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem_iff
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem_iff (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) (m : ℤ) :
    m • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ↔ m • z ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  have h := lorentzIntegralProjection_mem_iff G hG x c hc hle hint B
    (((lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P).smul_mem m hz)
  rwa [map_zsmul] at h

name: SRG266.lorentzPerp_dual_denominator
statement:
theorem lorentzPerp_dual_denominator (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (hden : ∀ z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P, (15 : ℤ) • z ∈ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∀ y ∈ (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P),
      (60 : ℤ) • y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [lorentzPerp_dual_eq_map_sup_marked G hG x c hc hle hint B] at hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
  have h15 := lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B (hden z hz)
  have h4 := four_zsmul_lorentzPerpGenerator_mem G hG x c hc hle B
  have heq : (60 : ℤ) • (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z +
      m • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) =
      (4 : ℤ) • ((15 : ℤ) • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z) +
      (15 * m) • ((4 : ℤ) • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) := by module
  change (60 : ℤ) • (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z +
    m • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P
  rw [heq]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h15) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h4)

name: SRG266.lorentzPerp_four_torsion_eq_span_marked
statement:
theorem lorentzPerp_four_torsion_eq_span_marked (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : Lattice.IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P)
    (hden : ∀ z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P, (15 : ℤ) • z ∈ P)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) 4 =
      lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hyd, hy4⟩ := Lattice.mem_torsionPart.mp hy
    rw [lorentzPerp_dual_eq_map_sup_marked G hG x c hc hle hint B] at hyd
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hyd
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
    have h15 := lorentzIntegralProjection_zsmul_mem G hG x c hc hle hint B (hden z hz)
    have h4 := four_zsmul_lorentzPerpGenerator_mem G hG x c hc hle B
    have heq : (4 : ℤ) • (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z +
        m • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) -
        m • ((4 : ℤ) • lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B) =
        (4 : ℤ) • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z := by module
    have hj4 : (4 : ℤ) • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P := by
      rw [← heq]
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ hy4 (Submodule.smul_mem _ m h4)
    have heq' : (4 : ℤ) • ((4 : ℤ) • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z) -
        (15 : ℤ) • lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z = lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z := by module
    have hj : lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P := by
      rw [← heq']
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hj4) h15
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left hj)
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
  · apply sup_le (Lattice.le_torsionPart (lorentzPerpLattice_isIntegral G x c hint) 4)
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro y (rfl : y = _)
    exact Lattice.mem_torsionPart.mpr
      ⟨lorentzPerpGenerator_mem_dual G hG x c hc hle hint B,
        four_zsmul_lorentzPerpGenerator_mem G hG x c hc hle B⟩

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzPerp_discriminant_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzPerp_discriminant_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧
      Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      Lattice.IsLattice ℚ (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      Lattice.IsEven (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (lorentzPerpSpace G x c) = 11 ∧
      (∀ y : lorentzPerpSpace G x c, y ≠ 0 → 0 < lorentzPerpForm G x c y y) ∧
      ∃ (S : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3)
        (T : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 5),
      (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) =
        lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
          ({lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B} ∪
            (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B) '' (Set.range S.vec ∪ Set.range T.vec))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_integral_centroid G hG x
  obtain ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, heven, S, T, hdual⟩ :=
    exists_lorentzMarked_orthogonal_glue G hG x c hc
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, hle, hmax, lorentzPerpLattice_isLattice G hG x c hc hle hlat hmax.integral,
    lorentzPerpLattice_isEven G x c heven, finrank_lorentzPerpSpace G hG x c hc,
    lorentzPerpForm_posDef G hG x c, S, T,
    lorentzPerp_dual_eq_sup_span G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B _ hdual⟩

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_completion
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_completion (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, hle, hmax, hl, he, hr, hpd, hframe, hleft, hright, hd, h3, h5⟩ :=
    exists_lorentzD7_normal_forms_from_graph G hG x B
  have hs : (lorentzD7Form G x c).IsSymm :=
    prodForm_isSymm (lorentzPerpForm_isSymm G x c) (standardRatForm_isSymm 7)
  have hi := lorentzD7Glue_isIntegral G hG x c hc hle hmax.integral B
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨S⟩⟩ := HasPrimaryNormalForm.exists_family (p := .three) hs h3
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨T⟩⟩ := HasPrimaryNormalForm.exists_family (p := .five) hs h5
  obtain ⟨hlAux, heAux, hdAux⟩ := complete_mixed_primary S T hs hl hi he hd
  have hsAux := prodForm_isSymm hs
    (prodForm_isSymm (primaryModel_isSymm .three s) (primaryModel_isSymm .five t))
  have h8 := eight_dvd_finrank_of_even_selfdual hsAux
    (mixedPrimaryLattice_posDef hpd) hlAux hdAux heAux
  rw [mixedPrimaryLattice_finrank, hr] at h8
  obtain ⟨k, hks, hkt⟩ := exists_rankSixKind s t h8
  subst s
  subst t
  obtain ⟨hlL, heL, hdL⟩ := complete_rankSix k S T hs hl hi he hd
  have hiL : IsIntegral (prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k))
      (rankSixCompletionLattice k S T) := by rw [Lattice.IsIntegral, hdL]
  have hleftL (y) : (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ rankSixCompletionLattice k S T ↔
      y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B :=
    mem_glueLattice_left_iff_of_complete_dual hs (nondegenerate_of_posDef hs hpd) hl hiL
      (mixedPrimarySource_dual S T hd) y
  have hpair (y z) : prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z := by
    simp only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, add_zero]
  refine ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hlL, heL, hdL, ?_,
    rankSixCompletion_posDef k hpd, hleftL, ?_, ?_, ?_, hpair, ?_⟩
  · rw [rankSixCompletion_finrank, hr]
  · exact mem_glueLattice_right_iff_of_complete_dual (rankSixForm_isSymm k)
      (nondegenerate_of_posDef (rankSixForm_isSymm k) (rankSixForm_posDef k))
      (rankSixBase_isLattice k) hiL (rankSixBase_dual k)
  · intro y
    exact (hleftL (y, 0)).trans (hleft y)
  · intro z
    exact (hleftL (0, z)).trans (hright z)
  · intro D
    refine ⟨(hleftL _).mpr (hframe D).1, ?_⟩
    rw [hpair]
    exact (hframe D).2

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_simple_roots
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_simple_roots (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            ∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_root_288 G hG x B
  have hs := prodForm_isSymm
    (prodForm_isSymm (lorentzPerpForm_isSymm G x c) (standardRatForm_isSymm 7))
    (rankSixForm_isSymm k)
  obtain ⟨N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheight⟩ :=
    exists_integral_simple_root_data hs hpd hrank hl hself R hR 24 (by norm_num) hnorm
  refine ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, ?_, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hcount] using hcardN
  · intro θ z hz hθ hd
    have h := hheight θ z hz hθ hd
    omega

  have hlayout' : ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] := by

    · exact hgood
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,

name: SRG266.lorentzian_no_complementary_A5
statement:
theorem lorentzian_no_complementary_A5
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) (k : RankSixKind)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k) (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (hmass : LorentzianFrameMass G hG x c hc k ψ)
    (r : Fin 5 → rankSixSpace k)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA 5 i j : ℚ))
    (hE : ∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
      ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := (a11D7E6_component_forms_pos _ ψ hpair
    (prodForm_posDef (prodForm_posDef (lorentzPerpForm_posDef G hG x c)
      (standardRatForm_posDef 7)) (rankSixForm_posDef k))).1
  have hbound := (lorentzian_component_frame_bounds G hG x c hc k ψ hpair hmarked).1
  let v := fun D => a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
    (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))
  let ar := fun i => a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
    ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i))
  have hp (i : Fin 5) (s) :
      cartanARatForm 11 (ar i) (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) =
        prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) s := by
    have h := a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      ψ hpair hmarked ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) s rfl
    rw [hE i, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  apply no_A11_mass_275_orthogonal_A5 hpos v hbound hmass.2.2.1 ar
  · intro i j
    rw [show cartanARatForm 11 (ar i) (ar j) = _ from hp i
      ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r j)]
    simpa only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, zero_add] using hgram i j
  · intro j D
    change cartanARatForm 11 (ar j) (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm _)) = 0
    rw [hp]
    simp only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_marked_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_marked_coordinates (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_standard_coordinates G hG x B
  have hψbasis (i : Fin 24) : ψ (Pi.single i 1) =
      (e.symm (coord₀ i).1.1 :
        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) := by
    have hcast : (fun j => ((Pi.single i 1 : Fin 24 → ℤ) j : ℚ)) =
        (Pi.single i 1 : Fin 24 → ℚ) := by
      ext j
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    have h := hψ (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [hcast] at h
    simpa [coordinateRootMap, normTwoRootVal] using h
  have hψsep (i : Fin 24) : (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2 = 0 ∨
      ((ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.1 = 0 ∧ (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).2 = 0) := by
    rw [hψbasis]
    have hn := hpairN (e.symm (coord₀ i).1.1) (e.symm (coord₀ i).1.1)
    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, (coord₀ i).1.property, Int.cast_ofNat] at hn
    rcases hsep _ (e.symm (coord₀ i).1.1).property hn.symm with h | ⟨hw, hu, _⟩
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hw, hu⟩
  have hψgram (i j : Fin 24) :
      prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
        (ψ (Pi.single i 1)) (ψ (Pi.single j 1)) =
        ((adeGram a11D7E6Types).2 i j : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.toBilin'_single, a11D7E6Types] using
      hψpair (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)
  have hmarked := a11D7E6_marked_projection
    (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k) ψ hψgram hψsep
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
    ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
    coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked⟩

name: SRG266.lorentz_integral_frame_identity
statement:
theorem lorentz_integral_frame_identity
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∑ C, localKMatrix G x B C • integralGramGenerator G x C =
      (45 : ℤ) • integralGramGenerator G x B - (5 : ℤ) • c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ C, localKMatrix G x B C • integralGramGenerator G x C) =
        ∑ C, (localGramMatrix G x B C - 1) •
          integralGramGenerator G x C := by rfl
    _ = (∑ C, localGramMatrix G x B C • integralGramGenerator G x C) -
          integralGramGeneratorSum G x := by
      rw [integralGramGeneratorSum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro C _
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
    _ = (45 : ℤ) • integralGramGenerator G x B + (6 : ℤ) • c -
          (11 : ℤ) • c := by
      rw [gram_frame_identity G hG x c hc B, hc]
    _ = (45 : ℤ) • integralGramGenerator G x B - (5 : ℤ) • c := by
      module

name: SRG266.lorentzGramForm_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem lorentzGramForm_nondegenerate
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) :
    (lorentzGramForm G x c).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : (lorentzGramForm G x c).SeparatingLeft := by
    intro z hz
    have hheight : centroidHeight G x c z = 0 := by
      have hrho := hz (lorentzWeylVector G x c)
      rw [(lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq z (lorentzWeylVector G x c),
        lorentzWeylVector_pair G hG x c hc z] at hrho
      linarith
    apply (ratGramForm_nondegenerate G hG x).1 z
    intro w
    have hw := hz w
    rw [lorentzGramForm_apply, hheight, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hw
    exact hw
  refine ⟨hleft, fun z hz => hleft z fun w => ?_⟩
  rw [(lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq z w]
  exact hz w

name: SRG266.lorentzGramForm_pair_centroid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lorentzGramForm_pair_centroid
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (z : ratGramSpace G x) :
    lorentzGramForm G x c z (toRatSpace G x c) =
      -5 * centroidHeight G x c z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lorentzGramForm_apply, centroidHeight_centroid G hG x c hc,
    (ratGramForm_isSymm G x).eq z (toRatSpace G x c),
    centroidHeight_apply]
  ring

name: SRG266.eq_zero_of_lorentzPairing_generators_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_lorentzPairing_generators_eq_zero
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (z : ratGramSpace G x)
    (hz : ∀ B, lorentzGramForm G x c
      (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) z = 0) :
    z = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (lorentzGramForm_nondegenerate G hG x c hc).2 z fun w => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ w
  rw [ratGramSpace_mk_eq_sum_smul_generator, map_sum,
    LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun B _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hz B, mul_zero]

name: SRG266.lorentz_rat_frame_identity
statement:
theorem lorentz_rat_frame_identity
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (y : ratGramSpace G x) :
    ∑ C, lorentzGramForm G x c y
        (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C)) •
          toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C) =
      (45 : ℚ) • y -
        (5 * centroidHeight G x c y) • toRatSpace G x c
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_lorentzPairing_generators_eq_zero G hG x c hc
  intro D
  have hframe := congrArg (toRatSpace G x)
    (lorentz_integral_frame_identity G hG x c hc D)
  have hpair := congrArg (fun z => lorentzGramForm G x c y z) hframe
  simp only [map_sum, map_zsmul, map_sub, zsmul_eq_mul] at hpair
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [lorentzGramForm_generator_generator G hG x c hc D]
  rw [(lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq
      (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x D)) y,
    lorentzGramForm_pair_centroid G hG x c hc,
    centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc D]
  rw [lorentzGramForm_pair_centroid G hG x c hc] at hpair
  have hpair' :
      ∑ C, lorentzGramForm G x c y
          (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C)) *
            (localKMatrix G x D C : ℚ) =
        (45 : ℚ) * lorentzGramForm G x c y
            (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x D)) -
          (5 : ℚ) * (-5 * centroidHeight G x c y) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ C, (localKMatrix G x D C : ℚ) *
          lorentzGramForm G x c y
            (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro C _
        ring
      _ = _ := hpair
  linear_combination hpair'

name: SRG266.lorentz_dual_denominator
statement:
theorem lorentz_dual_denominator
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) :
    ∀ y ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule (gramLattice G x),
      (45 : ℤ) • y ∈ gramLattice G x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y hy
  have hint : ∀ a : IntegralGramLattice G x,
      ∃ n : ℤ, (n : ℚ) = lorentzGramForm G x c y (toRatSpace G x a) := by
    intro a
    exact Submodule.mem_one.mp
      (hy _ (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x a))
  choose n hn using fun B => hint (integralGramGenerator G x B)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hint c
  set z : IntegralGramLattice G x :=
    ∑ B, n B • integralGramGenerator G x B with hzdef
  refine ⟨z - m • c, ?_⟩
  have hframe := lorentz_rat_frame_identity G hG x c hc y
  calc
    toRatSpace G x (z - m • c) =
        (∑ B, (n B : ℚ) •
          toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) -
            (m : ℚ) • toRatSpace G x c := by
      simp only [map_sub, hzdef, map_sum, map_zsmul,
        ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ]
    _ = (∑ B, lorentzGramForm G x c y
          (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) •
            toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) -
          lorentzGramForm G x c y (toRatSpace G x c) •
            toRatSpace G x c := by
      simp only [hn, hm]
    _ = ((45 : ℚ) • y -
          (5 * centroidHeight G x c y) • toRatSpace G x c) -
          (-5 * centroidHeight G x c y) • toRatSpace G x c := by
      rw [hframe, lorentzGramForm_pair_centroid G hG x c hc]
    _ = (45 : ℤ) • y := by
      module

name: SRG266.centroidHeight_heightZeroPart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centroidHeight_heightZeroPart
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (z : ratGramSpace G x) :
    centroidHeight G x c (lorentzHeightZeroPart G x c z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lorentzHeightZeroPart, map_sub, map_smul,
    centroidHeight_weylVector G hG x c hc]
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzGramForm_heightZeroPart
statement:
theorem lorentzGramForm_heightZeroPart
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (z w : ratGramSpace G x) :
    lorentzGramForm G x c (lorentzHeightZeroPart G x c z)
        (lorentzHeightZeroPart G x c w) =
      lorentzGramForm G x c z w +
        centroidHeight G x c z * centroidHeight G x c w / 4
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lorentzHeightZeroPart, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [lorentzWeylVector_pair G hG x c hc w,
    (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq z (lorentzWeylVector G x c),
    lorentzWeylVector_pair G hG x c hc z,
    lorentzWeylVector_norm G hG x c hc]
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzHeightZeroPart_generator_generator
statement:
theorem lorentzHeightZeroPart_generator_generator
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B C : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    lorentzGramForm G x c
        (lorentzHeightZeroPart G x c
          (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)))
        (lorentzHeightZeroPart G x c
          (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C))) =
      (localKMatrix G x B C : ℚ) + 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [lorentzGramForm_heightZeroPart G hG x c hc,
    lorentzGramForm_generator_generator G hG x c hc B C,
    centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc B,
    centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc C]
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzHeightZeroPart_generator_norm
statement:

          (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)))

name: SRG266.lorentz_height_decomposition
statement:
theorem lorentz_height_decomposition
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (z : ratGramSpace G x) :
    let a : ℚ := centroidHeight G x c z / 4
    let z₀ := z - a • lorentzWeylVector G x c
    centroidHeight G x c z₀ = 0 ∧
      z = z₀ + a • lorentzWeylVector G x c
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · rw [map_sub, map_smul, centroidHeight_weylVector G hG x c hc]
    ring
  · module

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzMarked_orthogonal_glue
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzMarked_orthogonal_glue (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) :
    ∃ P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x),
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ Lattice.IsLattice ℚ P ∧
      Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      Lattice.IsEven (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      ∃ (S : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3)
        (T : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 5),
      (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P =
        P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range S.vec ∪ Set.range T.vec)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, heven, hden⟩ :=
    exists_lorentzMarked_maximal_even_extension G hG x c hc
  have hsplit : (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P =
      Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3 ⊔
      Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 5 :=
    Lattice.dual_eq_torsionPart_sup (by norm_num) (by simpa using hden)
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := Lattice.exists_orthogonal_glue_basis (B := lorentzGramForm G x c)
    (Ñ := P) (p := 3) (by norm_num) (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c)
    (lorentzGramForm_nondegenerate G hG x c hc) hlat hmax (by norm_num) hsplit
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := Lattice.exists_orthogonal_glue_basis (B := lorentzGramForm G x c)
    (Ñ := P) (p := 5) (q := 3) (by norm_num) (lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c)
    (lorentzGramForm_nondegenerate G hG x c hc) hlat hmax (by norm_num)
    (hsplit.trans (sup_comm _ _))
  exact ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, heven, S, T, Lattice.dual_eq_sup_span_glue S T hsplit⟩

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzMarked_discriminant_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzMarked_discriminant_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x ∧
      gramLattice G x ≤ P ∧ lorentzWeylVector G x c ∈ P ∧
      Lattice.IsLattice ℚ P ∧ Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      Lattice.IsEven (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      ∃ (S : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3)
        (T : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 5),
      (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P =
        P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range S.vec ∪ Set.range T.vec)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_integral_centroid G hG x
  obtain ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, heven, S, T, hdual⟩ :=
    exists_lorentzMarked_orthogonal_glue G hG x c hc
  exact ⟨c, P, hc, (gramLattice_le_lorentzMarkedLattice G x c).trans hle,
    hle (lorentzWeylVector_mem_markedLattice G x c), hlat, hmax, heven, S, T, hdual⟩

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_residual_root_chain
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_residual_root_chain (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)) (k : RankSixKind)
      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) ∧
                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                      ((v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧
                        ∃ m : ℤ, E6Cartan.form v v = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨
                       (v ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧
                          E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ)))) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 →
                        v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
                          F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2) ∧
                    (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v) ∧
                    (∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                        let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                        let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                        ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                          (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                          (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                          (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) →
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) →
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
                      ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 → r.1.2 = 0 →
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 ∨ a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n+1) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) →
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (n+1) i j : ℚ)) →
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) ∨
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨
                      (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∨
                      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
                        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
                        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
                        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (∃ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) ≠ 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) →
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) →
                      ∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨
                      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
                        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
                        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
                        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort,
      horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill, hroot, hside, hchain, hfork⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_root_placement G hG x B
  have hnonzero : ¬ ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0 := by
    intro hz
    obtain ⟨ε, δ, hε, _, horiented⟩ := horient
    obtain ⟨W, _, _, hW⟩ := lorentzian_type_A_binary_factorization
      G hG x c hc k ψ hψpair hmarked ε δ hε horiented hz
    exact localGram_not_oneIntegrable_of_noQuasiSymmetricDesign G
      QuasiSymmetric.no_quasi_symmetric_design hG x ⟨12, W, hW⟩
  have hforce (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k)
      (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k)
      (hgram : ∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) :
      ∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0 := by
    have hchains := hchain (3+n) (fun i => r (Fin.cast (by omega) i))
      (fun i => hr _) (fun i j => hgram _ _)
    rcases hchains with hA | hE
    · exact (hnonzero (hkill n r hgram (fun i => hA (Fin.cast (by omega) i)))).elim
    · exact fun i => hE (Fin.cast (by omega) i)
  have hfinal : k = .seventyFive ∨
      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) := by
    rcases hfork with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact (hnonzero h).elim
    · exact Or.inr h
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
    ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
    coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort, horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill,
    hroot, hside, hchain, hfork, by simpa only [not_forall] using hnonzero, hforce, hfinal⟩

name: SRG266.exists_rank24_root_placement
statement:
theorem exists_rank24_root_placement (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
