      (S : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .three k.threeShape)
      (T : PrimaryFamily (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) .five k.fiveShape),
      let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
      let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ L ∧ IsEven F L ∧ F.dualSubmodule L = L ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k) = 24 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < F z z) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔ y ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), z) ∈ L ↔ z ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ y, ((y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, (((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z), (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (∀ y z, F (y, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) (z, 0) = lorentzD7Form G x c y z) ∧
      (∀ D, (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)) ∈ L ∧
        F (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, 0) = 4) ∧
      (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
        r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0 ∧ r.1.2 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)) ∧
      (∃ R : Finset ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
        (∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2) ∧
        (∀ y z, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = (R.card : ℚ) * F y z) ∧
        Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) = ⊤ ∧
        R.card = 288 ∧
        (∀ y z, (∑ r ∈ R, F r y * F r z) = 24 * F y z) ∧
        (∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24) (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
          (∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v) ∧
          Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = 288 ∧
          RootSecondMomentIdentity N 24 ∧
          ∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
            (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
            Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = 24 ∧
            IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
            (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
              simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
              (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
              (∑ s, z s) = 11) ∧
            ∃ ts : List ADEType, (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
              (∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) ∧
              ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6] ∧
              ADEType.rankSum ts = 24 ∧
              ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
                  (adeGram ts).2 i j) ∧
                Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord) ∧
                (∀ u v, N.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord u) (coordinateRootMap coord v) =
                  Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 u v) ∧
                (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, ∃ z, coordinateRootMap coord z = r.1) ∧
                (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
                  coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
                  (∀ i, 0 ≤ N.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) →
                  (∑ i, z i) = 11) ∧
                (∃ coord₀ : Fin 24 ≃ simpleRootSet f,
                  (∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord₀ i) (coord₀ j) =
                    (adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j) ∧
                  ∃ ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
                      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k),
                    (∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
                      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z) :
                        (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k)) ∧
                    (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
                      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 24 =>
                        ((adeGram [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]).2 i j : ℚ)) u v) ∧
                    (∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
                      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) ∧
                      0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                      ((v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧
                        ∃ m : ℤ, E6Cartan.form v v = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨
                       (v ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v ∧
                        ∃ (a m : ℤ), (a = -1 ∨ a = 1) ∧
                          (∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+a • E6Cartan.weight) ∧
                          E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ)))) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L →
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
                      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 →
                        v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
                          F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2) ∧
                    (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                      let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                      let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                      ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                        (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                        (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                        (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v) ∧
                    (∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        let q := ψ.symm (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))
                        let u := a11D7E6A11Part q
                        let v := a11D7E6E6Part q
                        ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ),
                          (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
                          (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
                          (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    ((∑ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k)))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) →
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) →
                      ∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 →
                      ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24) ∧
                    (∀ r, r ∈ L → F r r = 2 → r.1.2 = 0 →
                      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 ∨ a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n+1) → rankSixSpace k),
                      (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) →
                      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (n+1) i j : ℚ)) →
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) ∨
                      (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)) ∧
                    (k = .seventyFive ∨
                      (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
                        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∨
                      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
                        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
                        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
                        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
                          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
      hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
      N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
      ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
      coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort,
      horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill⟩ :=
    exists_rank24_E6_pair_firewall G hG x B
  let L := rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
  let F := prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k)
  have hmem (z : Fin 24 → ℤ) : ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L := by
    change ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) ∈ L
    rw [hψ]
    exact (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord₀ z)).property
  have hroot (r) (hr : r ∈ L) (hn : F r r = 2) :
      ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24 :=
    normTwo_integer_coordinates F L N e hpairN hf coord₀ ψ hψ hr hn
  have hside (r) (hr : r ∈ L) (hn : F r r = 2) (hd : r.1.2 = 0) :
      a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 ∨ a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 :=
    a11D7E6_root_in_one_component (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      L ψ hψpair hmarked hmem he hpd r (hroot r hr hn) hn hd
  have hchain (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n+1) → rankSixSpace k)
      (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k)
      (hgram : ∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (n+1) i j : ℚ)) :
      (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm
        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) ∨
      (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
        ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) := by
    apply a11D7E6_A_chain_in_one_component (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      L ψ hψpair hmarked hmem he hpd n
      (fun i => ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i))
    · intro i
      apply hroot _ ((hright (r i)).mpr (hr i))
      simp only [F, prodForm_apply, map_zero, zero_add, hgram]
      norm_num [gramA, gramAEntry]
    · intro i
      rfl
    · intro i j
      simpa only [prodForm_apply, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero, map_zero,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add] using hgram i j
  have hfork : k = .seventyFive ∨
      (∀ D : SecondSubconstituent G x,
        a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D, (0 : rankSixSpace k))) = 0) ∨
      ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
        (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
        (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ)) ∧
        (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm
          ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) := by
    by_cases hk : k = .seventyFive
    · exact Or.inl hk
    · obtain ⟨n, hn, r, hr, hgram⟩ := rankSix_has_large_A_chain k hk
      have hchains := hchain (3+n) (fun i => r (Fin.cast (by omega) i))
        (fun i => hr _) (fun i j => hgram _ _)
      rcases hchains with hA | hE
      · right
        left
        apply hkill n r hgram
        intro i
        exact hA (Fin.cast (by omega) i)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n, hn, r, hr, hgram,
          fun i => hE (Fin.cast (by omega) i)⟩)
  exact ⟨c, hc, P, k, S, T, hle, hmax, hl, he, hself, hrank, hpd,
    hleft, hright, hT, hD7, hpair, hframe, hsep, R, hR, hm, hspan, hcount, hnorm,
    N, e, hpairN, hcardN, hmN, f, hf, hcardS, hposS, hheightS,
    ts, hregular, hall, hlayout, hts24, coord, hgram, hinj, hpairC, hcover, hheightC,
    coord₀, hgram₀, ψ, hψ, hψpair, hmarked, hE, hEr, hshort, horient, hAfirst, hEfirst, hkill,
    hroot, hside, hchain, hfork⟩

name: SRG266.lorentzProjectedGenerator_pair
statement:
theorem lorentzProjectedGenerator_pair (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (y : ratGramSpace G x) (hy : centroidHeight G x c y = 0)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    lorentzGramForm G x c y (lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B) =
      lorentzGramForm G x c y (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lorentzProjectedGenerator, lorentzHeightZeroPart, map_sub, map_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [(lorentzGramForm_isSymm G x c).eq y (lorentzWeylVector G x c),
    lorentzWeylVector_pair G hG x c hc y, hy]
  ring

name: SRG266.lorentzProjectedGenerator_sum
statement:
theorem lorentzProjectedGenerator_sum (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) :
    ∑ B, lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ B, toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) =
      (11 : ℚ) • toRatSpace G x c := by
    have h := congrArg (toRatSpace G x) hc
    simp only [map_zsmul, integralGramGeneratorSum, map_sum,
      ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ] at h
    exact h.symm
  simp only [lorentzProjectedGenerator, lorentzHeightZeroPart,
    centroidHeight_generator G hG x c hc]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    secondSubconstituent_card G hG x]
  simp only [lorentzWeylVector]
  module

name: SRG266.lorentzProjectedGenerator_secondMoment
statement:
theorem lorentzProjectedGenerator_secondMoment (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (y : ratGramSpace G x) (hy : centroidHeight G x c y = 0) :
    ∑ B, (lorentzGramForm G x c y (lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B)) ^ 2 =
      45 * lorentzGramForm G x c y y
proof:
:= by
  have hf := congrArg (fun z => lorentzGramForm G x c y z)
    (lorentz_rat_frame_identity G hG x c hc y)
  simp only [hy, mul_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hf
  calc
    _ = ∑ B, lorentzGramForm G x c y (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) *
        lorentzGramForm G x c y (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      rw [lorentzProjectedGenerator_pair G hG x c hc y hy B]
      ring
    _ = _ := hf

name: SRG266.lorentzProjectedGenerator_exists_small_score
statement:
theorem lorentzProjectedGenerator_exists_small_score (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (y : ratGramSpace G x) (hy : centroidHeight G x c y = 0)
    (hypos : 0 < lorentzGramForm G x c y y) :
    ∃ B : SecondSubconstituent G x,
      (lorentzGramForm G x c y (lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B)) ^ 2 <
        lorentzGramForm G x c y y / 4
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  apply MomentBounds.no_gap_of_moment_upper Finset.univ
    (by simpa using secondSubconstituent_card G hG x)
    (fun B => lorentzGramForm G x c y (lorentzProjectedGenerator G x c B))
    (lorentzGramForm G x c y y) hypos
  · intro B _
    exact hn B
  · exact le_of_eq (lorentzProjectedGenerator_secondMoment G hG x c hc y hy)

name: SRG266.lorentzian_component_frame_bounds
statement:
theorem lorentzian_component_frame_bounds
    (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x) (k : RankSixKind)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ]
      ((lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × rankSixSpace k))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (rankSixForm k) (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) :
    LorentzianComponentFrameBound G hG x c hc k ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg (r : rankSixSpace k) : 0 ≤ rankSixForm k r r := by
    by_cases hr : r = 0
    · simp [hr]
    · exact (rankSixForm_posDef k r hr).le
  have hm := fun w => (lorentzPerpGenerator_secondMoment G hG x c hc w).le
  constructor
  · exact a11D7E6_component_moment_bound (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      (lorentzPerpForm_isSymm G x c) (rankSixForm_isSymm k) ψ hpair hmarked
      (cartanARatForm 11) (cartanARatForm_isSymm 11) a11D7E6A11Part a11D7E6A11Lift
      a11D7E6A11Part_lift a11D7E6A11Lift_pair a11D7E6D7Projection_A11Lift
      (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc) (coordinateSpinor 7) 45 (by norm_num) hnonneg hm
  · exact a11D7E6_component_moment_bound (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (rankSixForm k)
      (lorentzPerpForm_isSymm G x c) (rankSixForm_isSymm k) ψ hpair hmarked
      E6Cartan.form E6Cartan.form_isSymm a11D7E6E6Part a11D7E6E6Lift
      a11D7E6E6Part_lift a11D7E6E6Lift_pair a11D7E6D7Projection_E6Lift
      (lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc) (coordinateSpinor 7) 45 (by norm_num) hnonneg hm

name: SRG266.Lattice.eight_dvd_finrank_of_even_selfdual
statement:
theorem eight_dvd_finrank_of_even_selfdual
    (hs : F.IsSymm) (hpd : ∀ v : X, v ≠ 0 → 0 < F v v)
    (hl : IsLattice ℚ H) (hself : F.dualSubmodule H = H) (he : IsEven F H) :
    8 ∣ Module.finrank ℚ X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, e, hpair⟩ := exists_pdUnimodularLattice hs hpd rfl hl hself
  apply eight_dvd_rank_of_even_unimodular L
  intro x
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := he (e.symm x : X) (e.symm x).property
  have hval : ((L.pairing x x : ℤ) : ℚ) = 2 * (k : ℚ) := by
    have hp := hpair (e.symm x) (e.symm x)
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hk] using hp
  have hvalZ : L.pairing x x = 2 * k := by exact_mod_cast hval
  exact ⟨k, by omega⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_E6_dual
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_E6_dual
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (hint : IsIntegral F L) {r : X} (hr : r ∈ L) :
    a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hm : ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift (intCoordsToRat z)) ∈ L := by
    rw [a11D7E6E6Lift_intCast]
    exact hmem _
  have h := hint hr _ hm
  have hp := hpair (ψ.symm r) (a11D7E6E6Lift (intCoordsToRat z))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, a11D7E6E6Lift_pair] at hp
  rwa [hp] at h

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_E6_nonneg
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_E6_nonneg
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x x) (r : X) :
    0 ≤ E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hpos (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r))))
  rwa [hpair, a11D7E6E6Lift_norm] at h

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_E6_root
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_E6_root
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (hint : IsIntegral F L) {r : X} (hr : r ∈ L)
    (hnorm : E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) = 2) :
    let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
    v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) ∈ L ∧
      F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hv := E6Cartan.integral_of_dual_norm_two
    (a11D7E6_E6_dual F L ψ hpair hmem hint hr) hnorm
  refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hv
    rw [← hz, a11D7E6E6Lift_intCast]
    exact hmem _
  · rwa [hpair, a11D7E6E6Lift_norm]

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_E6_root_pair_integral
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_E6_root_pair_integral
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (hint : IsIntegral F L) {r s : X} (hr : r ∈ L) (hs : s ∈ L)
    (hrnorm : E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) = 2)
    (hsnorm : E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm s)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm s)) = 2) :
    E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm s)) ∈
      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hrl := (a11D7E6_E6_root F L ψ hpair hmem hint hr hrnorm).2.1
  have hsl := (a11D7E6_E6_root F L ψ hpair hmem hint hs hsnorm).2.1
  have h := hint hrl _ hsl
  rwa [hpair, a11D7E6E6Lift_pair, a11D7E6E6Part_lift] at h

name: SRG266.Lattice.hessian_fourier_realGaussian
statement:
theorem hessian_fourier_realGaussian {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w x y : V) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (𝓕 (realGaussian (V := V) t)) w ![x, y] =
      (-4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) *
        𝓕 (fun v : V =>
          ((inner ℝ v x * inner ℝ v y : ℝ) : ℂ) * realGaussian t v) w
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (realGaussian (V := V) t) :=
    (realGaussian_continuous t).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hmom (n : ℕ) : Integrable fun v : V =>
      ‖v‖ ^ n * ‖realGaussian t v‖ :=
    realGaussian_moment_integrable n ht
  have hderiv := Real.iteratedFDeriv_fourier
    (f := realGaussian (V := V) t) (N := (2 : ℕ∞))
    (fun n _ => hmom n) hmeas (n := 2) (by norm_num)
  have h := congrArg
    (fun F : V → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => V) ℂ => F w ![x, y])
    hderiv
  rw [Real.fourier_continuousMultilinearMap_apply
    (VectorFourier.integrable_fourierPowSMulRight (innerSL ℝ) (hmom 2) hmeas)] at h
  simp only [VectorFourier.fourierPowSMulRight_apply, Fin.prod_univ_two,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at h
  rw [h]
  have hfun : (fun v : V =>
      (-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ 2 •
        (((innerSL ℝ) v) x * ((innerSL ℝ) v) y) • realGaussian t v) =
      (-4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) •
        (fun v : V =>
          ((inner ℝ v x * inner ℝ v y : ℝ) : ℂ) * realGaussian t v) := by
    funext v
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul]
    rw [innerSL_apply_apply, innerSL_apply_apply]
    have hscalar : (-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ 2 =
        -4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_two]
      calc
        -(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            -(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
            4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Complex.I * Complex.I) := by ring
        _ = -4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; ring
    rw [hscalar]
  rw [hfun, Real.fourier_eq, Real.fourier_eq]
  simp_rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_comm _ (-4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2)]
  rw [integral_smul]
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_realGaussian_eq_prefactor_mul_radialExp
statement:
theorem fourier_realGaussian_eq_prefactor_mul_radialExp {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    𝓕 (realGaussian (V := V) t) = fun w =>
      gaussianFourierPrefactor V t * radialExp (gaussianFourierRate t) w
proof:
:= by
  funext w
  have hb : 0 < (((Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)).re := by
    simpa using mul_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  change 𝓕 (fun v : V =>
      Complex.exp (-((Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) w = _
  rw [fourier_gaussian_innerProductSpace hb]
  unfold gaussianFourierPrefactor gaussianFourierRate radialExp
  congr 2
  have hpow : (‖w‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_cast
  rw [hpow]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.hessian_fourier_realGaussian_explicit
statement:
theorem hessian_fourier_realGaussian_explicit {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (w x y : V) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (𝓕 (realGaussian (V := V) t)) w ![x, y] =
      gaussianFourierPrefactor V t *
        (Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) *
          (4 * gaussianFourierRate t ^ 2 * inner ℝ w x * inner ℝ w y +
            2 * gaussianFourierRate t * inner ℝ x y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_realGaussian_eq_prefactor_mul_radialExp ht]
  have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (radialExp (gaussianFourierRate t) : V → ℂ) w := by
    have hnorm : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z : V => ‖z‖ ^ 2) := contDiff_norm_sq ℝ
    exact (Complex.contDiff_exp.comp
      (contDiff_const.mul (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hnorm))).contDiffAt
  change iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2
      ((gaussianFourierPrefactor V t) • radialExp (gaussianFourierRate t)) w ![x, y] = _
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hsmooth]
  change gaussianFourierPrefactor V t *
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (radialExp (gaussianFourierRate t)) w ![x, y] = _
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_radialExp_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_inner_mul_inner_realGaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_inner_mul_inner_realGaussian {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (w x y : V) :
    𝓕 (fun v : V =>
      ((inner ℝ v x * inner ℝ v y : ℝ) : ℂ) * realGaussian t v) w =
      (-1 / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2)) * gaussianFourierPrefactor V t *
        (Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) *
          (4 * gaussianFourierRate t ^ 2 * inner ℝ w x * inner ℝ w y +
            2 * gaussianFourierRate t * inner ℝ x y))
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := hessian_fourier_realGaussian ht w x y
  have h₂ := hessian_fourier_realGaussian_explicit ht w x y
  have h := h₁.symm.trans h₂
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hc : (-4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 hpi)
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hc)
  rw [h]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

name: SRG266.Lattice.innerMulGaussian_integrable
statement:
theorem innerMulGaussian_integrable {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x y : V) :
    Integrable (innerMulGaussian t x y)
proof:
:= by
  let C := ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
  have hmom := realGaussian_moment_integrable (V := V) 2 ht
  apply Integrable.mono' (hmom.const_mul C)
  · have hreal : Continuous (fun v : V => inner ℝ v x * inner ℝ v y) := by
      fun_prop
    exact ((Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp hreal).mul
      (realGaussian_continuous t)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with v
    rw [innerMulGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hx := abs_real_inner_le_norm v x
    have hy := abs_real_inner_le_norm v y
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc
      |inner ℝ v x| * |inner ℝ v y| * ‖realGaussian t v‖ ≤
          (‖v‖ * ‖x‖) * (‖v‖ * ‖y‖) * ‖realGaussian t v‖ := by
        gcongr
      _ = C * (‖v‖ ^ 2 * ‖realGaussian t v‖) := by ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.normSqGaussian_integrable
statement:
theorem normSqGaussian_integrable {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (normSqGaussian (V := V) t)
proof:
:= by
  have hmom := realGaussian_moment_integrable (V := V) 2 ht
  apply Integrable.mono' hmom
  · unfold normSqGaussian
    have hnorm : Continuous (fun v : V => ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by fun_prop
    exact ((Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp hnorm).mul
      (realGaussian_continuous t)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with v
    rw [normSqGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖v‖)]

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_inner_self_orthonormalBasis
statement:
theorem sum_inner_self_orthonormalBasis
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V) (v : V) :
    ∑ i, inner ℝ v (b i) * inner ℝ v (b i) = ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [real_inner_comm v, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using
    sum_orthonormalBasis_inner_mul_inner b v v

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_normSqGaussian_eq_sum
statement:
theorem fourier_normSqGaussian_eq_sum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w : V) :
    𝓕 (normSqGaussian (V := V) t) w =
      ∑ i, 𝓕 (innerMulGaussian t (b i) (b i)) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq]
  have hfun : (fun v : V => 𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w) • normSqGaussian t v) =
      fun v => ∑ i, 𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w) • innerMulGaussian t (b i) (b i) v := by
    funext v
    unfold normSqGaussian innerMulGaussian
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    congr 1
    norm_cast
    exact (sum_inner_self_orthonormalBasis b v).symm
  rw [hfun, integral_finsetSum]
  · congr 1
  · intro i hi
    exact (Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).2
      (innerMulGaussian_integrable ht (b i) (b i))

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_harmonicGaussian_decompose
statement:
theorem fourier_harmonicGaussian_decompose
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w x y : V) :
    𝓕 (harmonicGaussian t x y) w =
      (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℂ) * 𝓕 (innerMulGaussian t x y) w -
        (inner ℝ x y : ℂ) * 𝓕 (normSqGaussian (V := V) t) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq, Real.fourier_eq, Real.fourier_eq]
  have hprod := (Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).2
    (innerMulGaussian_integrable ht x y)
  have hnorm := (Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).2
    (normSqGaussian_integrable (V := V) ht)
  have hfun : (fun v : V => 𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w) • harmonicGaussian t x y v) =
      fun v =>
        (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℂ) •
          (𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w) • innerMulGaussian t x y v) -
        (inner ℝ x y : ℂ) •
          (𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w) • normSqGaussian t v) := by
    funext v
    have hcore : harmonicGaussian t x y v =
        (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℂ) • innerMulGaussian t x y v -
          (inner ℝ x y : ℂ) • normSqGaussian t v := by
      unfold harmonicGaussian harmonicQuadratic innerMulGaussian normSqGaussian
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hcore, smul_sub, smul_comm (𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w))
      (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℂ), smul_comm (𝐞 (-inner ℝ v w)) (inner ℝ x y : ℂ)]
  rw [hfun, integral_sub, integral_smul, integral_smul]
  · rfl
  · exact hprod.smul (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℂ)
  · exact hnorm.smul (inner ℝ x y : ℂ)

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_innerMulGaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_innerMulGaussian {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w x y : V) :
    𝓕 (innerMulGaussian t x y) w =
      (-1 / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2)) * gaussianFourierPrefactor V t *
        (Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) *
          (4 * gaussianFourierRate t ^ 2 * inner ℝ w x * inner ℝ w y +
            2 * gaussianFourierRate t * inner ℝ x y))
proof:
:= by
  exact fourier_inner_mul_inner_realGaussian ht w x y

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_normSqGaussian_explicit
statement:
theorem fourier_normSqGaussian_explicit
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w : V) :
    𝓕 (normSqGaussian (V := V) t) w =
      (-1 / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2)) * gaussianFourierPrefactor V t *
        (Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) *
          (4 * gaussianFourierRate t ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 +
            2 * gaussianFourierRate t * Module.finrank ℝ V))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_normSqGaussian_eq_sum b ht w]
  simp_rw [fourier_innerMulGaussian ht w]
  let C : ℂ := (-1 / (4 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2)) * gaussianFourierPrefactor V t
  let E : ℂ := Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ))
  let q : ℂ := gaussianFourierRate t
  have hself : ∀ i, inner ℝ (b i) (b i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, b.norm_eq_one]
    norm_num
  simp_rw [hself]
  have hsum : ∑ i, inner ℝ w (b i) * inner ℝ w (b i) = ‖w‖ ^ 2 :=
    sum_inner_self_orthonormalBasis b w
  have hsumC : ∑ i, (inner ℝ w (b i) : ℂ) * (inner ℝ w (b i) : ℂ) =
      ((‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hcard : Fintype.card ι = Module.finrank ℝ V :=
    (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b.toBasis).symm
  have hfirst :
      (∑ i, 4 * q ^ 2 * (inner ℝ w (b i) : ℂ) * (inner ℝ w (b i) : ℂ)) =
        4 * q ^ 2 * ((‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← hsumC, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  change (∑ i, C * (E * (4 * q ^ 2 * inner ℝ w (b i) *
      inner ℝ w (b i) + 2 * q * 1))) =
    C * (E * (4 * q ^ 2 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 + 2 * q * Module.finrank ℝ V))
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hfirst]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hcard]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_harmonicGaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_harmonicGaussian
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w x y : V) :
    𝓕 (harmonicGaussian t x y) w =
      (-gaussianFourierRate t ^ 2 / (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2) *
        gaussianFourierPrefactor V t *
        ((harmonicQuadratic x y w : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_harmonicGaussian_decompose ht w x y,
    fourier_innerMulGaussian ht w x y,
    fourier_normSqGaussian_explicit b ht w]
  unfold harmonicQuadratic
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  push_cast
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  field_simp [hpi]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.gaussianFourierRate_eq
statement:
theorem gaussianFourierRate_eq {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    gaussianFourierRate t = -((Real.pi / t : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianFourierRate
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  have htC : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ht
  push_cast
  field_simp [hpi, htC]

name: SRG266.Lattice.gaussianFourierPrefactor_rank24
statement:
theorem gaussianFourierPrefactor_rank24 {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ V = 24) :
    gaussianFourierPrefactor V t = ((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 12
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianFourierPrefactor
  rw [hdim]
  norm_num
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  have htC : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ht
  field_simp [hpi, htC]

name: SRG266.Lattice.radialExp_rate_eq_realGaussian_inv
statement:
theorem radialExp_rate_eq_realGaussian_inv {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (w : V) :
    Complex.exp (gaussianFourierRate t * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) =
      realGaussian (V := V) t⁻¹ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianFourierRate_eq ht]
  unfold realGaussian
  congr 1
  have htC : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ht
  push_cast
  field_simp [htC]

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_harmonicGaussian_rank24
statement:
theorem fourier_harmonicGaussian_rank24
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ V = 24) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (w x y : V) :
    𝓕 (harmonicGaussian t x y) w =
      -((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 14 * harmonicGaussian t⁻¹ x y w
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourier_harmonicGaussian b ht w x y]
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  rw [gaussianFourierPrefactor_rank24 ht0 hdim,
    radialExp_rate_eq_realGaussian_inv ht0 w]
  unfold harmonicGaussian
  rw [gaussianFourierRate_eq ht0]
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  have htC : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ht0
  push_cast
  field_simp [hpi, htC]

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_glueLattice_left_iff_of_complete_dual
statement:
theorem mem_glueLattice_left_iff_of_complete_dual
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) (hl : IsLattice ℚ N)
    (hi : IsIntegral (prodForm B C) (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))))
    (hd : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range u)) (x : W) :
    (x, (0 : U)) ∈ glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i)) ↔ x ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hle : B.dualSubmodule N ≤ rightIntegral B x := by
      rw [hd]
      refine sup_le ?_ (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
      · intro z hz
        change B x z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
        have hpair := hi hx (z, 0) (prod_le_glueLattice ⟨hz, zero_mem _⟩)
        simpa [prodForm_apply] using hpair
      · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        change B x (u i) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
        have hpair := hi hx (u i, v i) (gen_mem_glueLattice i)
        simpa [prodForm_apply] using hpair
    have hdd : x ∈ B.dualSubmodule (B.dualSubmodule N) := fun _ hz => hle hz
    rwa [dual_dual B hl hnd hs] at hdd
  · intro hx
    exact prod_le_glueLattice ⟨hx, zero_mem _⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_glueLattice_right_iff_of_complete_dual
statement:
theorem mem_glueLattice_right_iff_of_complete_dual
    (hs : C.IsSymm) (hnd : C.Nondegenerate) (hl : IsLattice ℚ M)
    (hi : IsIntegral (prodForm B C) (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))))
    (hd : C.dualSubmodule M = M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v)) (x : U) :
    ((0 : W), x) ∈ glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i)) ↔ x ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hle : C.dualSubmodule M ≤ rightIntegral C x := by
      rw [hd]
      refine sup_le ?_ (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
      · intro z hz
        change C x z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
        have hpair := hi hx (0, z) (prod_le_glueLattice ⟨zero_mem _, hz⟩)
        simpa [prodForm_apply] using hpair
      · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        change C x (v i) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
        have hpair := hi hx (u i, v i) (gen_mem_glueLattice i)
        simpa [prodForm_apply] using hpair
    have hdd : x ∈ C.dualSubmodule (C.dualSubmodule M) := fun _ hz => hle hz
    rwa [dual_dual C hl hnd hs] at hdd
  · intro hx
    exact prod_le_glueLattice ⟨zero_mem _, hx⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.zero_or_zero_of_even_sum_two
statement:
theorem zero_or_zero_of_even_sum_two
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y)
    (hB : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < B x x) (hC : ∀ y, y ≠ 0 → 0 < C y y)
    (x : X) (y : Y) (hx : ∃ m : ℤ, B x x = 2*(m : ℚ))
    (hsum : B x x+C y y = 2) : x = 0 ∨ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact Or.inl hx0
  · right
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx
    have hmQ : (0 : ℚ) < m := by linarith [hB x hx0]
    have hmZ : (0 : ℤ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hmQ
    have hm1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (show (1 : ℤ) ≤ m by omega)
    by_contra hy0
    linarith [hC y hy0]

name: SRG266.Lattice.same_zero_side_of_pair_ne_zero
statement:
theorem same_zero_side_of_pair_ne_zero
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y)
    {x u : X} {y v : Y} (hx : x = 0 ∨ y = 0) (hu : u = 0 ∨ v = 0)
    (hp : B x u+C y v ≠ 0) : x = 0 ↔ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx0
    rcases hu with hu0 | hv0
    · exact hu0
    · exact (hp (by simp only [hx0, hv0, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero])).elim
  · intro hu0
    rcases hx with hx0 | hy0
    · exact hx0
    · exact (hp (by simp only [hu0, hy0, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add])).elim

name: SRG266.Lattice.A_chain_in_one_component
statement:
theorem A_chain_in_one_component
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n+1) → X) (y : Fin (n+1) → Y)
    (hside : ∀ i, x i = 0 ∨ y i = 0)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, B (x i) (x j)+C (y i) (y j) = (gramA (n+1) i j : ℚ)) :
    (∀ i, x i = 0) ∨ (∀ i, y i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := gramA_scalar_constant n (fun i => x i = 0) (by
    intro i j hij
    apply propext
    apply same_zero_side_of_pair_ne_zero B C (hside i) (hside j)
    rw [hgram]
    exact_mod_cast hij)
  by_cases h0 : x 0 = 0
  · exact Or.inl (fun i => (hc i).mpr h0)
  · right
    intro i
    exact (hside i).resolve_left (fun hi => h0 ((hc i).mp hi))

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_basis_of_isLattice
statement:
theorem exists_basis_of_isLattice {N : Submodule ℤ W} (hN : IsLattice ℚ N) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : Basis (Fin n) ℚ W), N = Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Module.Finite ℤ N := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hN.fg
  have hnzW : NoZeroSMulDivisors ℤ W := by
    refine ⟨fun {c x} h => ?_⟩
    rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with hc | hc
    · exact Or.inl hc
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      have hq : ((c : ℚ)) • x = 0 := by
        rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ c x]
        exact h
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hq).resolve_left (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hc)
  have hnzN : NoZeroSMulDivisors ℤ (N : Type _) :=
    Function.Injective.noZeroSMulDivisors (N.subtype) Subtype.val_injective rfl
      (fun _ _ => rfl)
  obtain ⟨n, b0⟩ := Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree' (R := ℤ) (M := N)
  set v : Fin n → W := fun i => ((b0 i : N) : W) with hv
  have hspanN : Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v) = N := by
    have hmap : Submodule.map N.subtype (Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range b0)) =
        Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v) := by
      rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
      rfl
    rw [← hmap, b0.span_eq, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hindepZ : LinearIndependent ℤ v :=
    b0.linearIndependent.map' N.subtype (Submodule.ker_subtype N)
  have hindep : LinearIndependent ℚ v :=
    (LinearIndependent.iff_fractionRing ℤ ℚ).mp hindepZ
  have hspanQ : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
    refine top_unique ?_
    rw [← hN.spans, Submodule.span_le, ← hspanN]
    intro x hx
    refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      exact Submodule.subset_span hy
    · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · intro y z _ _ hy hz
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
    · intro a y _ hy
      have hcast : a • y = ((a : ℚ)) • y := by
        rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ a y]
      rw [hcast]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  refine ⟨n, Basis.mk hindep (by rw [hspanQ]), ?_⟩
  rw [← hspanN]
  congr 1
  simp [Basis.coe_mk]

name: SRG266.Lattice.dual_dual
statement:
theorem dual_dual {N : Submodule ℤ W} (hN : IsLattice ℚ N)
    (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) (hsymm : B.IsSymm) :
    B.dualSubmodule (B.dualSubmodule N) = N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, b, rfl⟩ := exists_basis_of_isLattice hN
  exact B.dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_of_basis hnd hsymm b

name: SRG266.Lattice.dual_isLattice
statement:
theorem dual_isLattice {N : Submodule ℤ W} (hN : IsLattice ℚ N)
    (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) :
    IsLattice ℚ (B.dualSubmodule N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, b, rfl⟩ := exists_basis_of_isLattice hN
  have : Module.Finite ℚ W := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  rw [B.dualSubmodule_span_of_basis hnd b]
  refine ⟨⟨Finset.image (B.dualBasis hnd b) Finset.univ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ]
  · rw [Submodule.span_span_of_tower ℤ]
    exact (B.dualBasis hnd b).span_eq

name: SRG266.Lattice.finite_of_nsmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finite_of_nsmul_eq_zero {Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module.Finite ℤ Q]
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (h : ∀ q : Q, n • q = 0) : Finite Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Module (ZMod n) Q := AddCommGroup.zmodModule h
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := ℤ) (M := Q)
  have hspan : Submodule.span (ZMod n) (S : Set Q) = ⊤ := by
    refine top_unique fun q _ => ?_
    have hq : q ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (S : Set Q) := by rw [hS]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hq
    · exact fun y hy => Submodule.subset_span hy
    · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · exact fun y z _ _ hy hz => Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
    · intro a y _ hy
      rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (ZMod n) a y]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  have : Module.Finite (ZMod n) Q := ⟨⟨S, hspan⟩⟩
  exact Module.finite_of_finite (ZMod n)

name: SRG266.Lattice.quotient_nsmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem quotient_nsmul_eq_zero {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W]
    {N P : Submodule ℤ W} {n : ℕ} (hsmul : ∀ y ∈ P, (n : ℤ) • y ∈ N)
    (q : P ⧸ N.comap P.subtype) : n • q = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
  rw [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, ← map_nsmul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero,
    Submodule.mem_comap]
  have hy := hsmul (y : W) y.2
  rwa [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ] at hy

name: SRG266.Lattice.finite_quotient_of_nsmul_le
statement:
theorem finite_quotient_of_nsmul_le {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W]
    {N P : Submodule ℤ W} (hP : P.FG) {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hsmul : ∀ y ∈ P, (n : ℤ) • y ∈ N) :
    Finite (P ⧸ N.comap P.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Finite ℤ P := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hP
  have : Module.Finite ℤ (P ⧸ N.comap P.subtype) := Module.Finite.quotient ℤ _
  exact finite_of_nsmul_eq_zero (n := n) (quotient_nsmul_eq_zero hsmul)

name: SRG266.Lattice.integerTranslateSum_add_int
statement:

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_intVector_add_eq_of_euclideanToUnitTorus_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin n, ((y i - x i : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) = 0 := by
    intro i

    change (↑(x i) : UnitAddCircle) = (↑(y i) : UnitAddCircle) at hi
    change (↑(y i - x i) : UnitAddCircle) = 0

name: SRG266.Lattice.torusPeriodization_zero
statement:
theorem torusPeriodization_zero {n : ℕ}

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairing_self_eq_zero_iff_of_maximal
