name: SRG266.Lattice.a11_type_A_binary_coordinates
statement:
theorem a11_type_A_binary_coordinates
    {ε δ : ℤ} {u : Fin 11 → ℚ} {v : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (hv : v = 0)
    (h : ∃ (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ), (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
      (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
      (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6NormalizedType a δ u v) :
    ∃ z : Fin 12 → ℤ, (∑ i, z i) = 3 ∧
      (∀ i, (-(ε : ℚ))*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-3/12) ∧
      (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, z, hz, hc, hb, ht⟩ := h
  have ha := ht.label_nine_of_zero hv
  rw [ha] at hz hc
  norm_num only at hc
  refine ⟨fun i => 1-z i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hz]
    norm_num
  · intro i
    push_cast
    linarith [hc i]
  · intro i
    rcases hb i with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_type_A_binary_pair
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_type_A_binary_pair
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (r s : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U)
    (hdpair : standardRatForm 7 r.1.2 s.1.2 = 7/4)
    (hrE : a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0)
    (t : ℚ) (ht : t*t = 1) (z w : Fin 12 → ℤ)
    (hz : (∑ i, z i) = 3) (hw : (∑ i, w i) = 3)
    (hrcoord : ∀ i, t*cartanAZeroSum 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)) i =
      (z i : ℚ)-3/12)
    (hscoord : ∀ i, t*cartanAZeroSum 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) i =
      (w i : ℚ)-3/12) :
    ((∑ i, z i*w i : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r s-1
proof:
:= by
  have hA := cartanA_signed_centered_pair 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r))
    (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) t ht z w 3 3 hz hw
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using hrcoord)
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using hscoord)
  norm_num only at hA
  have hD : adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types (a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm r))
      (a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm s)) = 7/4 := by
    rw [← hpair, ← hmarked, ← hmarked, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simpa [middleCoordinateInclusion, middleCoordinateProjection, prodForm_apply] using hdpair
  have hp := hpair (ψ.symm r) (ψ.symm s)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    a11D7E6_pair_decomposition, hA, hD, hrE] at hp
  simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] at hp
  linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.cyclicGlueLattice_dual_eq_self
statement:
theorem cyclicGlueLattice_dual_eq_self (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hsC : C.IsSymm)
    (hN : IsIntegral B N) (hM : IsIntegral C M)
    (hdN : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u})
    (hdM : C.dualSubmodule M = M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {v})
    {p : ℤ} (hpv : p • v ∈ M)
    (hdiag : B u u + C v v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hunit : ∀ a : ℤ, (a : ℚ) * B u u ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) → p ∣ a) :
    (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v) =
      cyclicGlueLattice N M u v
proof:
:= by
  let S : GlueSystem B C N M Unit := {
    y := fun _ => u
    m := fun _ => v
    pr := fun _ => p
    symmB := hsB
    symmC := hsC
    intN := hN
    intM := hM
    dualN := by simpa using hdN
    dualM := by simpa using hdM
    smul_mem := fun _ => hpv
    crossW := fun i j hij => False.elim (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j))
    crossU := fun i j hij => False.elim (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j))
    diag := fun _ => hdiag
    unit := by
      intro _ a b hab
      apply hunit (a - b)
      have heq : ((a - b : ℤ) : ℚ) * B u u =
          ((a : ℚ) * B u u + (b : ℚ) * C v v) -
          (b : ℚ) * (B u u + C v v) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [heq]
      apply sub_mem hab
      simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem b hdiag }
  have heq : glueLattice N M S.gen = cyclicGlueLattice N M u v := by
    change N.prod M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (fun _ : Unit => (u, v))) =
      N.prod M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {(u, v)}
    rw [Set.range_const]
  rw [← heq]
  exact S.glue_dual_eq_self

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_even_cyclic_glue
statement:
theorem complete_even_cyclic_glue (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hsC : C.IsSymm)
    (hlN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hlM : IsLattice ℚ M)
    (hiN : IsIntegral B N) (hiM : IsIntegral C M)
    (heN : IsEven B N) (heM : IsEven C M)
    (hdN : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u})
    (hdM : C.dualSubmodule M = M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {v})
    {p : ℤ} (hpv : p • v ∈ M)
    (hdiag : ∃ k : ℤ, B u u + C v v = 2 * (k : ℚ))
    (hunit : ∀ a : ℤ, (a : ℚ) * B u u ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) → p ∣ a) :
    IsLattice ℚ (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B C) (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v) ∧
      (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v) =
        cyclicGlueLattice N M u v
proof:
:= by
  have hd : B u u + C v v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiag
    exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨2 * k, by rw [hk]; push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hu : u ∈ B.dualSubmodule N := by
    rw [hdN]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hv : v ∈ C.dualSubmodule M := by
    rw [hdM]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  exact ⟨cyclicGlueLattice_isLattice hlN hlM,
    cyclicGlueLattice_isEven hsB hsC (cyclicGlueLattice_isIntegral hsB hsC hiN hiM hu hv hd)
      heN heM hdiag,
    cyclicGlueLattice_dual_eq_self hsB hsC hiN hiM hdN hdM hpv hd hunit⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine sup_le le_sup_left (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = a • u)
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ a (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · refine sup_le le_sup_left (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro z (hz : z = u)
    subst z
    have heq : (a * b + p * k) • u = b • (a • u) + k • (p • u) := by module
    rw [hab, one_smul] at heq
    have hmem : b • (a • u) + k • (p • u) ∈ N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {a • u} :=
      Submodule.add_mem _
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ b (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.smul_mem _ k hp))
    exact (congrArg (fun w : W => w ∈ N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {a • u}) heq).mpr hmem

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_comp_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem fourier_comp_linearEquiv (A : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V) (f : V → ℂ) (w : V) :
    𝓕 (f ∘ A) w =
      |LinearMap.det (A : V →ₗ[ℝ] V)|⁻¹ •
        𝓕 f ((A.symm : V →ₗ[ℝ] V).adjoint w)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ENNReal := ENNReal.ofReal |(LinearMap.det (A : V →ₗ[ℝ] V))⁻¹|
  have hdet : LinearMap.det (A : V →ₗ[ℝ] V) ≠ 0 :=
    A.isUnit_det'.ne_zero
  have hmap : Measure.map (A : V →ₗ[ℝ] V) volume = c • volume := by
    simpa [c] using
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar volume hdet)
  let g : V → ℂ := fun u ↦
    𝐞 (-⟪u, (A.symm : V →ₗ[ℝ] V).adjoint w⟫) • f u
  have hgA : ∀ v : V,
      g (A v) = 𝐞 (-⟪v, w⟫) • (f ∘ A) v := by
    intro v
    have hinner :
        inner ℝ (A v) ((A.symm : V →ₗ[ℝ] V).adjoint w) = inner ℝ v w := by
      rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
      simp
    simp only [g, Function.comp_apply, hinner]
  have hchange :
      ∫ u, g u ∂(c • volume) = ∫ v, g (A v) := by
    rw [← hmap]
    exact integral_map_equiv
      A.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv g
  rw [Real.fourier_eq, Real.fourier_eq]
  simp_rw [← hgA]
  rw [← hchange, integral_smul_measure]
  simp only [c, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal, abs_nonneg, g]
  rw [abs_inv]

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_rightIntegral
statement:
theorem mem_rightIntegral {F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X} {z w : X} :
    w ∈ rightIntegral F z ↔ F z w ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.isIntegral_sup_span
statement:
theorem isIntegral_sup_span {F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X} (hsymm : F.IsSymm)
    {N : Submodule ℤ X} {s : Set X} (hN : IsIntegral F N)
    (hNs : ∀ z ∈ N, ∀ w ∈ s, F z w ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hss : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, F z w ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) :
    IsIntegral F (N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : ∀ z ∈ N, N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s ≤ rightIntegral F z := by
    intro z hz
    refine sup_le (fun w hw => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr fun w hw => ?_)
    · exact mem_rightIntegral.mpr (hN hz w hw)
    · exact mem_rightIntegral.mpr (hNs z hz w hw)
  have hB : ∀ z ∈ s, N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s ≤ rightIntegral F z := by
    intro z hz
    refine sup_le (fun w hw => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr fun w hw => ?_)
    · refine mem_rightIntegral.mpr ?_
      rw [hsymm.eq z w]
      exact hNs w hw z hz
    · exact mem_rightIntegral.mpr (hss z hz w hw)
  refine sup_le (fun z hz => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr fun z hz => ?_)
  · exact fun w hw => hA z hz hw
  · exact fun w hw => hB z hz hw

name: SRG266.Lattice.inner_mem_one_of_coprime
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_one_of_coprime hab ?_ ?_
  · have hcalc : ((a : ℚ)) * F y z = F z (a • y) := by
      rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul, hsymm.eq z y]
    rw [hcalc]
    exact hz _ hya
  · have hcalc : ((b : ℚ)) * F y z = F y (b • z) := by
      rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hcalc]
    exact hy _ hzb

name: SRG266.Lattice.prodForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodForm_apply (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (z w : W × U) : prodForm B C z w = B z.1 w.1 + C z.2 w.2
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.prodForm_isSymm
statement:
theorem prodForm_isSymm {B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W} {C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U}
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hC : C.IsSymm) : (prodForm B C).IsSymm
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun z w => by rw [prodForm_apply, prodForm_apply, hB.eq z.1 w.1, hC.eq z.2 w.2]⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.prodForm_posDef
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B z.1 z.1 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne z.1 0 with h | h
    · rw [h, map_zero]
    · exact (hB z.1 h).le
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C z.2 z.2 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne z.2 0 with h | h
    · rw [h, map_zero]
    · exact (hC z.2 h).le
  rw [prodForm_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne z.1 0 with h1 | h1
  · have h2 : z.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h2
      exact hz (Prod.ext h1 h2)
    exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hB0 (hC z.2 h2)
  · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (hB z.1 h1) hC0

name: SRG266.Lattice.ratNonneg_of_posDef
statement:
theorem ratNonneg_of_posDef {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    {F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X} (hpd : ∀ v : X, v ≠ 0 → 0 < F v v) (v : X) :
    0 ≤ F v v
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with rfl | h
  · rw [map_zero]
  · exact (hpd v h).le

name: SRG266.Lattice.nondegenerate_of_posDef
statement:
theorem nondegenerate_of_posDef {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    {F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X} (hsymm : F.IsSymm)
    (hpd : ∀ v : X, v ≠ 0 → 0 < F v v) : F.Nondegenerate
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff' F (ratNonneg_of_posDef hpd)
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp hsymm)).mpr hpd

name: SRG266.Lattice.dualSubmodule_prodForm
statement:
theorem dualSubmodule_prodForm (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (N : Submodule ℤ W) (M : Submodule ℤ U) :
    (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (N.prod M) =
      (B.dualSubmodule N).prod (C.dualSubmodule M)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨fun y hy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · have hmem := h (y, 0) (Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨hy, M.zero_mem⟩)
      simpa using hmem
    · have hmem := h (0, y) (Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨N.zero_mem, hy⟩)
      simpa using hmem
  · intro h w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Submodule.mem_prod.mp h
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := Submodule.mem_prod.mp hw
    rw [prodForm_apply]
    exact add_mem (h1 w.1 hw1) (h2 w.2 hw2)

name: SRG266.Lattice.isIntegral_prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsIntegral, dualSubmodule_prodForm]
  exact Submodule.prod_mono hN hM

name: SRG266.Lattice.isLattice_prod
statement:
theorem isLattice_prod {N : Submodule ℤ W} {M : Submodule ℤ U}
    (hN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hM : IsLattice ℚ M) : IsLattice ℚ (N.prod M)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.FG.prod hN.fg hM.fg, ?_⟩
  have h1 : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.inl ℚ W U) ≤
      Submodule.span ℚ ((N.prod M : Submodule ℤ (W × U)) : Set (W × U)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_top, ← hN.spans, Submodule.map_span]
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨hx, M.zero_mem⟩
  have h2 : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.inr ℚ W U) ≤
      Submodule.span ℚ ((N.prod M : Submodule ℤ (W × U)) : Set (W × U)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.map_top, ← hM.spans, Submodule.map_span]
    refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨N.zero_mem, hx⟩
  refine top_unique fun z _ => ?_
  have hz : z = (z.1, (0 : U)) + ((0 : W), z.2) := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp
  rw [hz]
  exact add_mem (h1 ⟨z.1, rfl⟩) (h2 ⟨z.2, rfl⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.gen_mem_glueLattice
statement:
theorem gen_mem_glueLattice {ι : Type*} {N : Submodule ℤ W} {M : Submodule ℤ U}
    {g : ι → W × U} (i : ι) : g i ∈ glueLattice N M g
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.prod_le_glueLattice
statement:
theorem prod_le_glueLattice {ι : Type*} {N : Submodule ℤ W} {M : Submodule ℤ U}
    {g : ι → W × U} : N.prod M ≤ glueLattice N M g
proof: := le_sup_left

name: SRG266.Lattice.inclLeft_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inclLeft_coe {ι : Type*} (N : Submodule ℤ W) (M : Submodule ℤ U) (g : ι → W × U)
    (x : N) : ((inclLeft N M g x : glueLattice N M g) : W × U) = ((x : W), 0)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.inclLeft_injective
statement:
theorem inclLeft_injective {ι : Type*} (N : Submodule ℤ W) (M : Submodule ℤ U)
    (g : ι → W × U) : Function.Injective (inclLeft N M g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have h := congrArg (fun z => ((z : W × U)).1) (Subtype.ext_iff.mp hxy)
  exact Subtype.ext h

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.gen_fst
statement: @[simp] theorem gen_fst (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) (i : ι) : (S.gen i).1 = S.y i
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.gen_snd
statement: @[simp] theorem gen_snd (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) (i : ι) : (S.gen i).2 = S.m i
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.y_mem_dual
statement: theorem y_mem_dual (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) (i : ι) : S.y i ∈ B.dualSubmodule N
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.dualN]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.m_mem_dual
statement: theorem m_mem_dual (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) (i : ι) : S.m i ∈ C.dualSubmodule M
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.dualM]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.pairing_lattice_gen
statement:
theorem pairing_lattice_gen (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) {z : W × U}
    (hz : z ∈ N.prod M) (j : ι) : prodForm B C z (S.gen j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := Submodule.mem_prod.mp hz
  simp only [prodForm_apply, gen_fst, gen_snd]
  refine add_mem ?_ ?_
  · rw [S.symmB.eq z.1 (S.y j)]
    exact S.y_mem_dual j z.1 hz1
  · rw [S.symmC.eq z.2 (S.m j)]
    exact S.m_mem_dual j z.2 hz2

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.pairing_gen_gen
statement:
theorem pairing_gen_gen (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) (i j : ι) :
    prodForm B C (S.gen i) (S.gen j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prodForm_apply, gen_fst, gen_snd]
  rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
  · exact S.diag i
  · exact add_mem (S.crossW i j hij) (S.crossU i j hij)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.glue_isIntegral
statement:
theorem glue_isIntegral (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) :
    IsIntegral (prodForm B C) (glueLattice N M S.gen)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_sup_span (prodForm_isSymm S.symmB S.symmC)
    (isIntegral_prod S.intN S.intM) ?_ ?_
  · rintro z hz _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact S.pairing_lattice_gen hz j
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact S.pairing_gen_gen i j

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.glue_isLattice
statement:
theorem glue_isLattice (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) [Finite ι]
    (hN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hM : IsLattice ℚ M) :
    IsLattice ℚ (glueLattice N M S.gen)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.FG.sup (isLattice_prod hN hM).fg
    (Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)), ?_⟩
  refine top_unique ?_
  rw [← (isLattice_prod hN hM).spans]
  exact Submodule.span_mono (fun z hz => prod_le_glueLattice hz)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.glue_dual_eq_self
statement:
theorem GlueSystem.glue_dual_eq_self (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι) :
    (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (glueLattice N M S.gen) = glueLattice N M S.gen
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ S.glue_isIntegral
  intro z hz

  have hz' : z ∈ (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (N.prod M) :=
    fun w hw => hz w (prod_le_glueLattice hw)
  rw [dualSubmodule_prodForm] at hz'
  obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := Submodule.mem_prod.mp hz'
  rw [S.dualN] at hz1
  rw [S.dualM] at hz2
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam, t1, ht1, hsum1⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz1
  obtain ⟨mu, hmu, t2, ht2, hsum2⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp ht1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp ht2

  have hz1eq : z.1 = lam + ∑ i, a i • S.y i := by rw [← hsum1, ha]
  have hz2eq : z.2 = mu + ∑ i, b i • S.m i := by rw [← hsum2, hb]
  have hdvd : ∀ j, S.pr j ∣ a j - b j := by
    intro j
    refine S.unit j (a j) (b j) ?_
    have hzj : prodForm B C z (S.gen j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) :=
      hz _ (gen_mem_glueLattice j)
    have e1 : B z.1 (S.y j) = B lam (S.y j) + ∑ i, (a i : ℚ) * B (S.y i) (S.y j) := by
      rw [hz1eq, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
      refine congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul]
    have e2 : C z.2 (S.m j) = C mu (S.m j) + ∑ i, (b i : ℚ) * C (S.m i) (S.m j) := by
      rw [hz2eq, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
      refine congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul]
    have hsplitW : ∀ f : ι → ℚ, ∑ i, f i = f j + ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, f i :=
      fun f => (Finset.add_sum_erase _ f (Finset.mem_univ j)).symm
    have key : (a j : ℚ) * B (S.y j) (S.y j) + (b j : ℚ) * C (S.m j) (S.m j)
        = prodForm B C z (S.gen j) - (B lam (S.y j) + C mu (S.m j))
          - ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j,
              ((a i : ℚ) * B (S.y i) (S.y j) + (b i : ℚ) * C (S.m i) (S.m j)) := by
      simp only [prodForm_apply, GlueSystem.gen_fst, GlueSystem.gen_snd]
      rw [e1, e2,
        hsplitW (fun i => (a i : ℚ) * B (S.y i) (S.y j)),
        hsplitW (fun i => (b i : ℚ) * C (S.m i) (S.m j)), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    rw [key]
    refine sub_mem (sub_mem hzj (add_mem ?_ ?_)) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_)
    · rw [S.symmB.eq lam (S.y j)]
      exact S.y_mem_dual j lam hlam
    · rw [S.symmC.eq mu (S.m j)]
      exact S.m_mem_dual j mu hmu
    · have hij : i ≠ j := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi
      refine add_mem ?_ ?_
      · rw [← zsmul_eq_mul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (S.crossW i j hij)
      · rw [← zsmul_eq_mul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (S.crossU i j hij)

  choose c hc using hdvd
  have hfst : (z - ∑ i, a i • S.gen i).1 = lam := by
    rw [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.fst_sum, hz1eq]
    simp only [Prod.smul_fst, GlueSystem.gen_fst]
    abel
  have hsnd : (z - ∑ i, a i • S.gen i).2 = mu + ∑ i, (-(c i)) • (S.pr i • S.m i) := by
    rw [Prod.snd_sub, Prod.snd_sum, hz2eq]
    simp only [Prod.smul_snd, GlueSystem.gen_snd]
    have hterm : ∀ i, b i • S.m i - a i • S.m i = (-(c i)) • (S.pr i • S.m i) := by
      intro i
      rw [smul_smul, ← sub_smul]
      congr 1
      have := hc i
      linarith [this]
    rw [add_sub_assoc, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm i)
  have hmem : z - ∑ i, a i • S.gen i ∈ N.prod M := by
    refine Submodule.mem_prod.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hfst]; exact hlam
    · rw [hsnd]
      exact M.add_mem hmu
        (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (S.smul_mem i))
  have hz'' : z = (z - ∑ i, a i • S.gen i) + ∑ i, a i • S.gen i := by abel
  rw [hz'']
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ (prod_le_glueLattice hmem) ?_
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gen_mem_glueLattice i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GramDivisibilityDescent.reindex
statement:
theorem GramDivisibilityDescent.reindex
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {p : ℤ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} (h : GramDivisibilityDescent p A)
    (e : κ ≃ ι) {B : Matrix κ κ ℤ} (hB : ∀ i j, B i j = A (e i) (e j)) :
    GramDivisibilityDescent p B
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz i
  have hrow (j : κ) : (A *ᵥ (z ∘ e.symm)) (e j) = (B *ᵥ z) j := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hB]
  have hall (j : ι) : p ∣ (A *ᵥ (z ∘ e.symm)) j := by
    have hj := hz (e.symm j)
    rw [← hrow (e.symm j)] at hj
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hj
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h _ hall (e i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GramDivisibilityDescent.block
statement:
theorem GramDivisibilityDescent.block
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {p : ℤ} {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℤ}
    (hA : GramDivisibilityDescent p A) (hB : GramDivisibilityDescent p B) :
    GramDivisibilityDescent p (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz i
  cases i with
  | inl i =>
      apply hA (z ∘ Sum.inl) _ i
      intro j
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type] using hz (Sum.inl j)
  | inr i =>
      apply hB (z ∘ Sum.inr) _ i
      intro j
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type] using hz (Sum.inr j)

name: SRG266.Lattice.gramE6_two_divisibility
statement: theorem gramE6_two_divisibility : GramDivisibilityDescent 2 (gramE 6)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz i
  obtain ⟨k0, h0⟩ := hz 0
  obtain ⟨k1, h1⟩ := hz 1
  obtain ⟨k2, h2⟩ := hz 2
  obtain ⟨k3, h3⟩ := hz 3
  obtain ⟨k4, h4⟩ := hz 4
  obtain ⟨k5, h5⟩ := hz 5
  norm_num [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, gramE, gramEEntry, Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  change -z 1 + (2 * z 2 + (-z 3 + -z 5)) = 2 * k2 at h2
  change -z 2 + (2 * z 3 + -z 4) = 2 * k3 at h3
  change -z 3 + 2 * z 4 = 2 * k4 at h4
  change -z 2 + 2 * z 5 = 2 * k5 at h5
  fin_cases i <;> dsimp only at *
  · refine ⟨z 1 - z 5 + k5 - k1, ?_⟩
    change z 0 = 2 * (z 1 - z 5 + k5 - k1)
    linear_combination -h1 + h5
  · refine ⟨z 0 - k0, ?_⟩
    change z 1 = 2 * (z 0 - k0)
    linear_combination -h0
  · refine ⟨z 5 - k5, ?_⟩
    change z 2 = 2 * (z 5 - k5)
    linear_combination -h5
  · refine ⟨z 4 - k4, ?_⟩
    change z 3 = 2 * (z 4 - k4)
    linear_combination -h4
  · refine ⟨z 3 - z 5 + k5 - k3, ?_⟩
    change z 4 = 2 * (z 3 - z 5 + k5 - k3)
    linear_combination -h3 + h5
  · refine ⟨z 2 - z 0 + k0 - z 4 + k4 - k2, ?_⟩
    change z 5 = 2 * (z 2 - z 0 + k0 - z 4 + k4 - k2)
    linear_combination -h2 + h0 + h4

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeBlock_divisibility_of_components
statement:
theorem adeBlock_divisibility_of_components
    (p : ℤ) (ts : List ADEType)
    (h : ∀ t ∈ ts, GramDivisibilityDescent p t.gram) :
    GramDivisibilityDescent p (adeBlockPairing ts)
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with
  | nil => intro z hz i; exact Empty.elim i
  | cons t ts ih =>
      have hhead := h t (by simp)
      have htail := ih (fun s hs => h s (by simp [hs]))
      have heq : adeBlockPairing (t :: ts) =
          Matrix.fromBlocks t.gram 0 0 (adeBlockPairing ts) := by
        ext i j
        cases i <;> cases j <;> rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact hhead.block htail

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeGram_divisibility_of_components
statement:
theorem adeGram_divisibility_of_components
    (p : ℤ) (ts : List ADEType)
    (h : ∀ t ∈ ts, GramDivisibilityDescent p t.gram) :
    GramDivisibilityDescent p (adeGram ts).2
proof:
:=
  (adeBlock_divisibility_of_components p ts h).reindex (finADEBlockEquiv ts)
    (adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing ts)

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeGram_two_divisibility_of_all_E6
statement:
theorem adeGram_two_divisibility_of_all_E6
    (ts : List ADEType) (h : ∀ t ∈ ts, t = .E6) :
    GramDivisibilityDescent 2 (adeGram ts).2
proof:
:= by
  apply adeGram_divisibility_of_components
  intro t ht
  rw [h t ht]
  exact gramE6_two_divisibility

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_spanning_path_of_degree_le_two
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_path_of_degree_le_two
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2) :
    ∃ (u v : V) (p : G.Walk u v), p.IsPath ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty V := hconn.nonempty
  obtain ⟨u, v, p, hp, hmax⟩ :=
    Walk.exists_isPath_forall_isPath_length_le_length G
  refine ⟨u, v, p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro x
  by_contra hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath u x
  obtain ⟨d, _hdq, hdy, hdz⟩ :=
    q.exists_boundary_dart {x | x ∈ p.support} p.start_mem_support hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hil⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp hdy
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    have hadj : G.Adj u d.snd := by
      rw [← p.getVert_zero]
      exact hi.symm ▸ d.adj
    have hpath : (p.reverse.concat hadj).IsPath := by
      apply hp.reverse.concat
      simpa using hdz
    have hle := hmax _ _ _ hpath
    simp at hle
  by_cases hiend : i = p.length
  · subst i
    have hadj : G.Adj v d.snd := by
      rw [← p.getVert_length]
      exact hi.symm ▸ d.adj
    have hpath : (p.concat hadj).IsPath := hp.concat (by simpa using hdz) hadj
    have hle := hmax _ _ _ hpath
    simp at hle
  have hi_pos : 0 < i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi0
  have hi_lt : i < p.length := lt_of_le_of_ne hil hiend
  let l : V := p.getVert (i - 1)
  let r : V := p.getVert (i + 1)
  let y : V := p.getVert i
  let z : V := d.snd
  have hly : G.Adj y l := by
    have h := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := i - 1) (by omega)
    simpa [l, y, Nat.sub_add_cancel hi_pos] using h.symm
  have hyr : G.Adj y r := by
    simpa [y, r] using p.adj_getVert_succ hi_lt
  have hyz : G.Adj y z := by
    change G.Adj (p.getVert i) d.snd
    exact hi.symm ▸ d.adj
  have hlr : l ≠ r := by
    intro hlr
    have hind := hp.getVert_injOn
      (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; omega)
      (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; omega) hlr
    omega
  have hlz : l ≠ z := by
    intro hlz
    apply hdz
    change l = d.snd at hlz
    change d.snd ∈ p.support
    rw [← hlz]
    exact p.getVert_mem_support _
  have hrz : r ≠ z := by
    intro hrz
    apply hdz
    change r = d.snd at hrz
    change d.snd ∈ p.support
    rw [← hrz]
    exact p.getVert_mem_support _
  let nl : ↑(G.neighborFinset y) := ⟨l, by simpa using hly⟩
  let nr : ↑(G.neighborFinset y) := ⟨r, by simpa using hyr⟩
  let nz : ↑(G.neighborFinset y) := ⟨z, by simpa using hyz⟩
  let emb : Fin 3 ↪ ↑(G.neighborFinset y) :=
    ⟨![nl, nr, nz], by
      intro a b hab
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
        simp [nl, nr, nz, hlr, Ne.symm hlr, hlz, Ne.symm hlz, hrz, Ne.symm hrz] at hab ⊢⟩
  have hthree := Fintype.card_le_of_embedding emb
  have hdegree : 3 ≤ G.degree y := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_coe,
      G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] using hthree
  have hydeg := hdeg y
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_iso_pathGraph_of_degree_le_two
statement:
theorem exists_iso_pathGraph_of_degree_le_two
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hacyc : G.IsAcyclic)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n = Fintype.card V ∧ Nonempty (pathGraph n ≃g G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, v, p, hp, hspan⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_path_of_degree_le_two hconn hdeg
  let n := p.length + 1
  let e : Fin n → V := fun i ↦ p.getVert i
  have he_injective : Function.Injective e := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hp.getVert_injOn
      (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; omega)
      (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; omega) hij
  have he_surjective : Function.Surjective e := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hil⟩ := Walk.mem_support_iff_exists_getVert.mp (hspan x)
    refine ⟨⟨i, by simp only [n]; omega⟩, ?_⟩
    exact hi
  let f : Fin n ≃ V := Equiv.ofBijective e ⟨he_injective, he_surjective⟩
  let H : SimpleGraph V := (pathGraph n).map f
  have hpath_edge {i j : Fin n} (hij : (pathGraph n).Adj i j) :
      G.Adj (f i) (f j) := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj] at hij
    rcases hij with hij | hij
    · have hadj := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := i.1) (by omega)
      change G.Adj (p.getVert i.1) (p.getVert j.1)
      rw [← hij]
      exact hadj
    · have hadj := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := j.1) (by omega)
      change G.Adj (p.getVert i.1) (p.getVert j.1)
      rw [← hij]
      exact hadj.symm
  have hHG : H ≤ G := by
    intro x y hxy
    change ((pathGraph n).map f).Adj x y at hxy
    rw [SimpleGraph.map_adj'] at hxy
    obtain ⟨_, i, j, hij, rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy
    exact hpath_edge hij
  have hHconn : H.Connected := by
    exact (SimpleGraph.Iso.map f (pathGraph n)).connected_iff.mp
      (by simpa only [n] using SimpleGraph.pathGraph_connected p.length)
  have hHacyc : H.IsAcyclic := SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic.anti hHG hacyc
  let : DecidableRel H.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  have hHtree : H.IsTree := ⟨hHconn, hHacyc⟩
  have hGtree : G.IsTree := ⟨hconn, hacyc⟩
  have hedge_card : H.edgeFinset.card = G.edgeFinset.card := by
    have hHcard := hHtree.card_edgeFinset
    have hGcard := hGtree.card_edgeFinset
    omega
  have hedge : H.edgeFinset = G.edgeFinset := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_mono hHG)
    simpa only [hedge_card] using le_rfl
  have hH_eq_G : H = G := SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_inj.mp hedge
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_congr f
  · refine ⟨?_⟩
    simpa only [H, hH_eq_G] using SimpleGraph.Iso.map f (pathGraph n)

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_pathGraph
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_pathGraph (n : ℕ) :
    graphCartanMatrix (pathGraph n) = gramA n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [graphCartanMatrix, gramA, gramAEntry,
    SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.pathGraph_eq_endpoint
statement:
theorem pathGraph_eq_endpoint {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n)
    (hunique : ∀ {l r}, (pathGraph n).Adj k l →
      (pathGraph n).Adj k r → l = r) :
    k.1 = 0 ∨ k.1 + 1 = n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hk
  simp only [not_or] at hk
  have hkpos : 0 < k.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk.1
  have hklt : k.1 + 1 < n := lt_of_le_of_ne k.2 hk.2
  let l : Fin n := ⟨k.1 - 1, by omega⟩
  let r : Fin n := ⟨k.1 + 1, hklt⟩
  have hl : (pathGraph n).Adj k l := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj]
    right
    simp only [l]
    omega
  have hr : (pathGraph n).Adj k r := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj]
    left
    rfl
  have hlr : l ≠ r := by
    intro h
    have := congr_arg Fin.val h
    simp only [l, r] at this
    omega
  exact hlr (hunique hl hr)

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_pathGraph_iso_apply_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pathGraph_iso_apply_zero
    {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {H : SimpleGraph W} [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    {n : ℕ} (e : pathGraph n ≃g H) (x : W)
    (hx : H.degree x ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (e' : pathGraph n ≃g H) (i : Fin n), i.1 = 0 ∧ e' i = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    have hc := Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv
    have hw : 0 < Fintype.card W := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨x⟩
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hc
    omega
  let : DecidableRel (pathGraph n).Adj := Classical.decRel _
  let k : Fin n := e.symm x
  have hek : e k = x := by simp [k]
  have hkdeg : (pathGraph n).degree k ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← e.degree_eq k, hek]
    exact hx
  have hkunique : ∀ {l r}, (pathGraph n).Adj k l →
      (pathGraph n).Adj k r → l = r := by
    intro l r hl hr
    apply Finset.card_le_one_iff.mp hkdeg
    · simpa using hl
    · simpa using hr
  rcases pathGraph_eq_endpoint k hkunique with hk0 | hklast
  · have hk : k = ⟨0, hn⟩ := Fin.ext hk0
    refine ⟨e, ⟨0, hn⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [← hk, hek]
  · have hrev : Fin.rev ⟨0, hn⟩ = k := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_rev]
      omega
    refine ⟨(pathGraphRevIso n).trans e, ⟨0, hn⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    change e (Fin.rev ⟨0, hn⟩) = x
    rw [hrev, hek]

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_A_coordinates_of_degree_le_two
statement:
theorem exists_A_coordinates_of_degree_le_two
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hacyc : G.IsAcyclic)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2) :
    ∃ (e : Fin (Fintype.card V) ≃ V),
      ∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix G (e i) (e j) = gramA (Fintype.card V) i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    exists_iso_pathGraph_of_degree_le_two hconn hacyc hdeg
  subst n
  refine ⟨e.toEquiv, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩
  change graphCartanMatrix G (e i) (e j) = gramA (Fintype.card V) i j
  calc
    _ = graphCartanMatrix (pathGraph (Fintype.card V)) i j :=
      graphCartanMatrix_apply_iso e i j
    _ = gramA (Fintype.card V) i j := by rw [graphCartanMatrix_pathGraph]

name: SRG266.Lattice.centered_integer_norm_identity
statement:
theorem centered_integer_norm_identity (z : ι → ℤ) (a : ℤ) (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = a) :
    (∑ i, ((z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)^2) =
      (a : ℚ)*(Fintype.card ι-a)/Fintype.card ι +
        ∑ i, (z i : ℚ)*((z i : ℚ)-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (Fintype.card ι : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hs : (∑ i, (z i : ℚ)) = (a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hpoint (t : ℚ) : (t-(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)^2 =
      t*(t-1)+(1-2*(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)*t+((a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)^2 := by ring
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [hs, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.integer_mul_pred_nonneg
statement: theorem integer_mul_pred_nonneg (z : ℤ) : 0 ≤ (z : ℚ)*((z : ℚ)-1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : z ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ z := by omega
  rcases h with h | h
  · have hQ : (z : ℚ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos hQ (by linarith)
  · have hQ : (1 : ℚ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: SRG266.Lattice.centered_integer_norm_minimum
statement:
theorem centered_integer_norm_minimum (z : ι → ℤ) (a : ℤ) (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = a) :
    (a : ℚ)*(Fintype.card ι-a)/Fintype.card ι ≤
      ∑ i, ((z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [centered_integer_norm_identity z a hsum]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => integer_mul_pred_nonneg (z i)))

name: SRG266.Lattice.centered_integer_norm_eq_iff
statement:
theorem centered_integer_norm_eq_iff (z : ι → ℤ) (a : ℤ) (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = a) :
    (∑ i, ((z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)^2) =
      (a : ℚ)*(Fintype.card ι-a)/Fintype.card ι ↔ ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [centered_integer_norm_identity z a hsum, add_eq_left]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => integer_mul_pred_nonneg (z i))]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_const]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (h i) with h0 | h1
    · exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast h0)
    · have hQ : (z i : ℚ) = 1 := by linarith
      exact Or.inr (by exact_mod_cast hQ)
  · intro h i
    rcases h i with h | h <;> simp [h]

name: SRG266.Lattice.aSimpleVector_pair
statement:
theorem aSimpleVector_pair {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℚ) :
    standardRatForm (n+1) (aSimpleVector i) x = x i.castSucc-x i.succ
proof:
:= by
  simp [aSimpleVector, standardRatForm_apply, Pi.single_apply, ite_mul]

name: SRG266.Lattice.aSimpleVector_gram
statement:
theorem aSimpleVector_gram {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :
    standardRatForm (n+1) (aSimpleVector i) (aSimpleVector j) = (gramA n i j : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aSimpleVector_pair]
  simp only [aSimpleVector, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff,
    Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, gramA, gramAEntry]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num <;> omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.aSimpleVector_sum
statement: theorem aSimpleVector_sum {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : (∑ j, aSimpleVector i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [aSimpleVector, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanAZeroSum_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cartanAZeroSum_single {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    cartanAZeroSum n (Pi.single i 1) = aSimpleVector i
proof:
:= by
  simp [cartanAZeroSum]

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanAZeroSum_pair
statement:
theorem cartanAZeroSum_pair (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin n → ℚ) :
    standardRatForm (n+1) (cartanAZeroSum n u) (cartanAZeroSum n v) =
      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j => (gramA n i j : ℚ)) u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  change standardRatForm (n+1) (∑ i, u i • aSimpleVector i) (cartanAZeroSum n v) = _
  rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change u i * standardRatForm (n+1) (aSimpleVector i) (∑ j, v j • aSimpleVector j) = _
  rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, aSimpleVector_gram]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanAZeroSum_sum
statement:
theorem cartanAZeroSum_sum (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) :
    (∑ j, cartanAZeroSum n u j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ j, (∑ i, u i • aSimpleVector i) j) = 0
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, aSimpleVector_sum, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanAZeroSum_adjacent_pair
statement:
theorem cartanAZeroSum_adjacent_pair (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) (i : Fin n) :
    cartanAZeroSum n u i.castSucc-cartanAZeroSum n u i.succ =
      Matrix.toBilin' (fun j k => (gramA n j k : ℚ)) u (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cartanAZeroSum_pair, cartanAZeroSum_single,
    (standardRatForm_isSymm (n+1)).eq, aSimpleVector_pair]

name: SRG266.Lattice.orientedArms_are_D_or_E
statement:
theorem orientedArms_are_D_or_E
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) {z : V}
    (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩)
    (h₀₁ : A₀.component ≠ A₁.component)
    (h₀₂ : A₀.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₁₂ : A₁.component ≠ A₂.component) :
    IsDArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
      IsE6ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
      IsE7ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
      IsE8ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length
proof:
:= by
  let outcome := three_arm_arithmetic_classification
    A₀.length_pos A₁.length_pos A₂.length_pos
  cases outcome with
  | d01 ha hb => exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ha, hb⟩)
  | d02 ha hc => exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha, hc⟩))
  | d12 hb hc => exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hb, hc⟩))
  | e6_012 ha hb hc => exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩))
  | e6_102 hb ha hc => exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hb, ha, hc⟩)))
  | e6_201 hc ha hb => exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hc, ha, hb⟩)))
  | e7_012 ha hb hc => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩)))
  | e7_021 ha hc hb => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha, hc, hb⟩))))
  | e7_102 hb ha hc => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hb, ha, hc⟩)))))
  | e7_120 hb hc ha => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hb, hc, ha⟩))))))
  | e7_201 hc ha hb => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hc, ha, hb⟩)))))))
  | e7_210 hc hb ha => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hc, hb, ha⟩)))))))
  | e8_012 ha hb hc => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩)))
  | e8_021 ha hc hb => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha, hc, hb⟩))))
  | e8_102 hb ha hc => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hb, ha, hc⟩)))))
  | e8_120 hb hc ha => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hb, hc, ha⟩))))))
  | e8_201 hc ha hb => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hc, ha, hb⟩)))))))
  | e8_210 hc hb ha => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hc, hb, ha⟩)))))))
  | affineE6 ha hb hc => exact (not_all_three_arms_length_two
      hpos hconn A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂ ha hb hc).elim
  | affineE7_0 ha hb hc => exact (not_arms_length_one_three_three
      hpos hconn A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂ ha hb hc).elim
  | affineE7_1 hb ha hc => exact (not_arms_length_one_three_three
      hpos hconn A₁ A₀ A₂ h₀₁.symm h₁₂ h₀₂ hb ha hc).elim
  | affineE7_2 hc ha hb => exact (not_arms_length_one_three_three
      hpos hconn A₂ A₀ A₁ h₀₂.symm h₁₂.symm h₀₁ hc ha hb).elim
  | affineE8_012 ha hb hc => exact (not_arms_length_one_two_five
      hpos hconn A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂ ha hb hc).elim
  | affineE8_021 ha hc hb => exact (not_arms_length_one_two_five
      hpos hconn A₀ A₂ A₁ h₀₂ h₀₁ h₁₂.symm ha hc hb).elim
  | affineE8_102 hb ha hc => exact (not_arms_length_one_two_five
      hpos hconn A₁ A₀ A₂ h₀₁.symm h₁₂ h₀₂ hb ha hc).elim
  | affineE8_120 hb hc ha => exact (not_arms_length_one_two_five
      hpos hconn A₁ A₂ A₀ h₁₂ h₀₁.symm h₀₂.symm hb hc ha).elim
  | affineE8_201 hc ha hb => exact (not_arms_length_one_two_five
      hpos hconn A₂ A₀ A₁ h₀₂.symm h₁₂.symm h₀₁ hc ha hb).elim
  | affineE8_210 hc hb ha => exact (not_arms_length_one_two_five
      hpos hconn A₂ A₁ A₀ h₁₂.symm h₀₂.symm h₀₁.symm hc hb ha).elim

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_orientedArms_D_or_E_unbounded
statement:
theorem exists_orientedArms_D_or_E_unbounded
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected)
    {z : V} (hz : G.degree z = 3) :
    ∃ (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩),
      A₀.component ≠ A₁.component ∧ A₀.component ≠ A₂.component ∧
      A₁.component ≠ A₂.component ∧
      (IsDArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
        IsE6ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
        IsE7ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
        IsE8ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := (G.induce {x | x ≠ z}).ConnectedComponent
  have hKcard : Fintype.card K = 3 :=
    card_puncturedComponents_eq_three hpos hconn hz
  let e : K ≃ Fin 3 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hKcard
  let C₀ : K := e.symm 0
  let C₁ : K := e.symm 1
  let C₂ : K := e.symm 2
  have hC₀₁ : C₀ ≠ C₁ := e.symm.injective.ne (by decide)
  have hC₀₂ : C₀ ≠ C₂ := e.symm.injective.ne (by decide)
  have hC₁₂ : C₁ ≠ C₂ := e.symm.injective.ne (by decide)
  let A₀ := orientedPuncturedArm_unbounded hpos hconn hz C₀
  let A₁ := orientedPuncturedArm_unbounded hpos hconn hz C₁
  let A₂ := orientedPuncturedArm_unbounded hpos hconn hz C₂
  have hA₀₁ : A₀.component ≠ A₁.component := hC₀₁
  have hA₀₂ : A₀.component ≠ A₂.component := hC₀₂
  have hA₁₂ : A₁.component ≠ A₂.component := hC₁₂
  exact ⟨A₀, A₁, A₂, hA₀₁, hA₀₂, hA₁₂,
    orientedArms_are_D_or_E hpos hconn A₀ A₁ A₂ hA₀₁ hA₀₂ hA₁₂⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_orientedArms_D_or_E
statement:
theorem exists_orientedArms_D_or_E
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected)
    (_hcard : Fintype.card V ≤ 15) {z : V} (hz : G.degree z = 3) :
    ∃ (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩),
      A₀.component ≠ A₁.component ∧ A₀.component ≠ A₂.component ∧
      A₁.component ≠ A₂.component ∧
      (IsDArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
        IsE6ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
        IsE7ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ∨
        IsE8ArmTriple A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length)
proof:
:=
  exists_orientedArms_D_or_E_unbounded hpos hconn hz

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSixOrder75A4Root_mem
statement:

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSixOrder75A4Root_gram

theorem rankSixOrder75A4Root_gram (i j : Fin 4) :

theorem rankSixOrder75Q15Inclusion_pair (x y : Q15Coordinates.Space) :

theorem rankSixOrder75Q15Inclusion_mem (x : Q15Coordinates.Space)

name: SRG266.Lattice.even_numerator_of_odd_multiple
statement:
theorem even_numerator_of_odd_multiple {p m : ℤ} (hp : Odd p)
    (hN : IsEven B N) {u : W} (hu : p • u ∈ N)
    (hnorm : (p : ℚ) * B u u = (m : ℚ)) : Even m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hN _ hu
  have hQ : (p : ℚ) * m = 2 * (k : ℚ) := by
    simp only [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul] at hk
    rwa [hnorm] at hk
  have hZ : p * m = 2 * k := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  exact even_iff_two_dvd.mpr
    ((Int.isCoprime_two_left.mpr hp).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ⟨k, hZ⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueBasis.exists_even_diag
statement:
theorem GlueBasis.exists_even_diag {p : ℕ} (S : GlueBasis B N p)
    (hp : Odd (p : ℤ)) (hN : IsEven B N) (i : Fin S.rank) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, Even m ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ m ∧ (p : ℚ) * B (S.vec i) (S.vec i) = (m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hndiv, hm⟩ := S.diag i
  exact ⟨m, even_numerator_of_odd_multiple hp hN
    (mem_torsionPart.mp (S.mem i)).2 hm, hndiv, hm⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_mod_two_three
statement:
theorem norm_mod_two_three {q : ℚ} {m : ℤ} (hm : Even m) (hunit : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ m)
    (hq : 3 * q = (m : ℚ)) :
    ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧ q = (r : ℚ) / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : m % 6 = 2 ∨ m % 6 = 4 := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hm
    omega
  refine ⟨m % 6, m / 6, hr, ?_⟩
  have hZ : m = 6 * (m / 6) + m % 6 := by omega
  have hQ : (m : ℚ) = 6 * ((m / 6 : ℤ) : ℚ) + ((m % 6 : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hZ
  linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_mod_two_five
statement:
theorem norm_mod_two_five {q : ℚ} {m : ℤ} (hm : Even m) (hunit : ¬ (5 : ℤ) ∣ m)
    (hq : 5 * q = (m : ℚ)) :
    ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4 ∨ r = 6 ∨ r = 8) ∧
      q = (r : ℚ) / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : m % 10 = 2 ∨ m % 10 = 4 ∨ m % 10 = 6 ∨ m % 10 = 8 := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hm
    omega
  refine ⟨m % 10, m / 10, hr, ?_⟩
  have hZ : m = 10 * (m / 10) + m % 10 := by omega
  have hQ : (m : ℚ) = 10 * ((m / 10 : ℤ) : ℚ) + ((m % 10 : ℤ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hZ
  linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.normalized_norm_five
statement:
theorem normalized_norm_five {q : ℚ} {m : ℤ} (hm : Even m) (hunit : ¬ (5 : ℤ) ∣ m)
    (hq : 5 * q = (m : ℚ)) :
    ∃ a r k : ℤ, (a = 1 ∨ a = 2) ∧ (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧
      (a : ℚ) ^ 2 * q = (r : ℚ) / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, k, hr, hk⟩ := norm_mod_two_five hm hunit hq
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨1, 2, k, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl, by simpa using hk⟩
  · exact ⟨1, 4, k, Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl, by simpa using hk⟩
  · refine ⟨2, 4, 2 + 4 * k, Or.inr rfl, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    linarith
  · refine ⟨2, 2, 3 + 4 * k, Or.inr rfl, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_denominator_unit
statement:
theorem norm_denominator_unit {p r k : ℤ} {q : ℚ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hcop : IsCoprime p r) (hq : q = (r : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 2 * (k : ℚ))
    (a : ℤ) (ha : (a : ℚ) * q ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) : p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp ha
  have hpQ : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hQ : (a : ℚ) * r = (p : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) - 2 * a * k) := by
    rw [hq] at hb
    field_simp at hb
    nlinarith [hb]
  have hZ : a * r = p * (b - 2 * a * k) := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨b - 2 * a * k, hZ⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdPairing_toMatrix
statement:
theorem pdPairing_toMatrix (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (pdFinBasis L) (pdFinBasis L).dualBasis
        L.pairing =
      pdGram L
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Module.Basis.dualBasis_repr,
    pdGram, LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_apply]
  exact L.symmetric.eq (pdFinBasis L j) (pdFinBasis L i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdGram_det_isUnit
statement:
theorem pdGram_det_isUnit (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    IsUnit (pdGram L).det
proof:
:= by
  have he := (pdPairingEquiv L).isUnit_det
    (pdFinBasis L) (pdFinBasis L).dualBasis
  change IsUnit (LinearMap.toMatrix (pdFinBasis L)
    (pdFinBasis L).dualBasis L.pairing).det at he
  rw [pdPairing_toMatrix] at he
  exact he

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdGramCoordEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem pdGramCoordEquiv_apply (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    pdGramCoordEquiv L x = Matrix.mulVec (pdGram L) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr (pdFinBasis L)
    (pdFinBasis L).dualBasis L.pairing ((pdFinBasis L).equivFun.symm x)
  rw [pdPairing_toMatrix] at h
  have hx :
      ⇑((pdFinBasis L).repr ((pdFinBasis L).equivFun.symm x)) = x := by
    simpa only [Module.Basis.equivFun_apply] using
      (pdFinBasis L).equivFun.apply_symm_apply x
  rw [hx] at h
  simpa [pdGramCoordEquiv, pdPairingEquiv] using h.symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdGram_mulVec_equiv_symm
statement:
theorem pdGram_mulVec_equiv_symm (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    Matrix.mulVec (pdGram L) ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pdGramCoordEquiv_apply]
  exact (pdGramCoordEquiv L).apply_symm_apply x

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pdRealGram_apply (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (i j : Fin n) :
    pdRealGram L i j = (pdGram L i j : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_det_ne_zero (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRealGram L).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((pdGram L).map (fun x : ℤ => (x : ℝ))).det ≠ 0
  rw [← Int.cast_det]
  exact_mod_cast (pdGram_det_isUnit L).ne_zero

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_isUnit
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_isUnit (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    IsUnit (pdRealGram L)
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (pdRealGram L)).mpr
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pdRealGram_det_ne_zero L))

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_isHermitian
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_isHermitian (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRealGram L).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
  rw [Matrix.IsSymm.ext_iff]
  intro i j
  simp only [pdRealGram_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℝ)) <| by
    simpa only [pdGram, LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_apply] using
      L.symmetric.eq (pdFinBasis L j) (pdFinBasis L i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.denseRange_ratPiCast
statement:
theorem denseRange_ratPiCast :
    DenseRange (fun q : Fin n → ℚ => fun i => (q i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let f : (Fin n → ℚ) → (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    Pi.map fun _ : Fin n => ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)
  have hf : DenseRange f :=
    DenseRange.piMap (fun _ : Fin n => Rat.denseRange_cast)
  have hfun : f = (fun q : Fin n → ℚ => fun i => (q i : ℝ)) := by
    funext q i
    rfl
  rwa [← hfun]

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_ratCast
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_ratCast (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (q : Fin n → ℚ) :
    dotProduct (fun i => (q i : ℝ))
        (Matrix.mulVec (pdRealGram L) (fun i => (q i : ℝ))) =
      (pdRatForm L q q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, pdRealGram_apply,
    pdRatForm, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  push_cast
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_posSemidef
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_posSemidef (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRealGram L).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  refine ⟨pdRealGram_isHermitian L, ?_⟩
  simp only [star_trivial]
  intro x
  refine denseRange_ratPiCast.induction_on x ?_ ?_
  · have hcont : Continuous (fun b : Fin n → ℝ =>
        dotProduct b (Matrix.mulVec (pdRealGram L) b)) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
      fun_prop
    have hset :
        {b : Fin n → ℝ | 0 ≤ dotProduct b (Matrix.mulVec (pdRealGram L) b)} =
          (fun b => dotProduct b (Matrix.mulVec (pdRealGram L) b)) ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0 := by
      ext b
      rfl
    rw [hset]
    exact isClosed_Ici.preimage hcont
  · intro q
    rw [pdRealGram_ratCast]
    by_cases hq : q = 0
    · simp [hq]
    · exact_mod_cast (pdRatForm_posDef L q hq).le

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_posDef
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_posDef (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRealGram L).PosDef
proof:
:=
  (pdRealGram_posSemidef L).posDef_iff_isUnit.mpr (pdRealGram_isUnit L)

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_det_eq_one (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRealGram L).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := (pdRealGram_posDef L).det_pos
  rcases Int.isUnit_iff.mp (pdGram_det_isUnit L) with hdet | hdet
  · change ((pdGram L).map (fun x : ℤ => (x : ℝ))).det = 1
    rw [← Int.cast_det, hdet]
    norm_num
  · exfalso
    change 0 < ((pdGram L).map (fun x : ℤ => (x : ℝ))).det at hpos
    rw [← Int.cast_det, hdet] at hpos
    norm_num at hpos

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtGram_sq
statement:
theorem pdSqrtGram_sq (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    pdSqrtGram L * pdSqrtGram L = pdRealGram L
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pdSqrtGram, pow_two] using
    CFC.sq_sqrt (pdRealGram L) (pdRealGram_posSemidef L).nonneg

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtGram_isSymm
statement:
theorem pdSqrtGram_isSymm (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdSqrtGram L).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
  exact (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (pdRealGram L)).isSelfAdjoint

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtGram_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem pdSqrtGram_det_eq_one (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdSqrtGram L).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdet := (pdRealGram_posSemidef L).det_sqrt
  simpa [pdSqrtGram, pdRealGram_det_eq_one] using hdet

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtGram_isUnit
statement:
theorem pdSqrtGram_isUnit (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    IsUnit (pdSqrtGram L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pdSqrtGram,
    CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff (pdRealGram L) (pdRealGram_posSemidef L).nonneg]
  exact pdRealGram_isUnit L

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pdSqrtEquiv_apply (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    pdSqrtEquiv L x = Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L) x
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.toLin (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)) (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))
      (pdSqrtGram L) x = Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L) x
  rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin']
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtEquiv_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem pdSqrtEquiv_det_eq_one (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    LinearMap.det (pdSqrtEquiv L : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.det
      (Matrix.toLin (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)) (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))
        (pdSqrtGram L)) = 1
  rw [LinearMap.det_toLin, pdSqrtGram_det_eq_one]

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRealGram_mulVec_equiv_symm_cast
statement:
theorem pdRealGram_mulVec_equiv_symm_cast (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    Matrix.mulVec (pdRealGram L)
        (fun i => (((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x i : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
      (fun i => (x i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  have hi := congrFun (pdGram_mulVec_equiv_symm L x) i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, pdRealGram_apply] at *
  exact_mod_cast hi

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdSqrtGram_mulVec_mulVec_equiv_symm_cast
statement:
theorem pdSqrtGram_mulVec_mulVec_equiv_symm_cast
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L)
        (Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L)
          (fun i => (((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x i : ℤ) : ℝ))) =
      (fun i => (x i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pdSqrtGram_sq]
  exact pdRealGram_mulVec_equiv_symm_cast L x

name: SRG266.Lattice.dotProduct_pdSqrtEquiv
statement:
theorem dotProduct_pdSqrtEquiv (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    dotProduct (pdSqrtEquiv L x) (pdSqrtEquiv L y) =
      Matrix.toBilin' (pdRealGram L) x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pdSqrtEquiv_apply, Matrix.toBilin'_apply']
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_mulVec,
    (pdSqrtGram_isSymm L).eq, pdSqrtGram_sq,
    ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.form_isSymm
statement: theorem form_isSymm : form.IsSymm
proof:
:=
  prodForm_isSymm (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2) (isSymm_smul_form (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2) 5)

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.form_posDef
statement: theorem form_posDef : ∀ x : Space, x ≠ 0 → 0 < form x x
proof:
:=
  prodForm_posDef (simplexRatForm_posDef 2)
    (posDef_smul_form (by norm_num) (simplexRatForm_posDef 2))

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.glueVector_norm
statement: theorem glueVector_norm : form glueVector glueVector = 4
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [form, rightForm, glueVector, prodForm_apply, simplexRatForm_apply,
    simplexWeight, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.lattice_isLattice
statement: theorem lattice_isLattice : IsLattice ℚ lattice
proof:
:=
  cyclicGlueLattice_isLattice (coordinateIntegerLattice_isLattice 2)
    (coordinateIntegerLattice_isLattice 2)

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.lattice_isIntegral
statement: theorem lattice_isIntegral : IsIntegral form lattice
proof:
:= by
  have hr : simplexWeight 2 ∈ rightForm.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 2) := by
    apply (mem_dual_smul_form_iff (B := simplexRatForm 2) (5 : ℚ) _).mpr
    have heq : (5 : ℚ) • simplexWeight 2 = (5 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 2 := by module
    rw [heq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ (5 : ℤ) (simplexWeight_mem_dual 2)
  apply cyclicGlueLattice_isIntegral (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2)
    (isSymm_smul_form (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2) 5)
    (simplexRatForm_isIntegral 2) (isIntegral_int_smul_form (simplexRatForm_isIntegral 2) 5)
    (simplexWeight_mem_dual 2) hr
  exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨4, glueVector_norm.symm⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.lattice_isEven
statement: theorem lattice_isEven : IsEven form lattice
proof:
:= by
  apply cyclicGlueLattice_isEven (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2)
    (isSymm_smul_form (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2) 5) lattice_isIntegral
    (simplexRatForm_isEven 2) (isEven_int_smul_form (simplexRatForm_isEven 2) 5)
  exact ⟨2, glueVector_norm.trans (by norm_num)⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.finrank_space
statement: theorem finrank_space : Module.finrank ℚ Space = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_prod]
  simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.rightFraction_pair
statement:
theorem rightFraction_pair (c : Fin 2 → ℤ) (z : Space) :
    form (rightFraction c) z = simplexRatForm 2 (intCoordsToRat c) z.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [form, rightFraction, prodForm_apply, rightForm, map_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.rightFraction_mem_dual
statement:
theorem rightFraction_mem_dual (c : Fin 2 → ℤ) :
    rightFraction c ∈ form.dualSubmodule lattice
proof:
:= by
  change lattice ≤ rightIntegral form (rightFraction c)
  refine sup_le (fun z hz => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · change form (rightFraction c) z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    rw [rightFraction_pair]
    exact simplexRatForm_isIntegral 2 (intCoordsToRat_mem c) z.2 hz.2
  · rintro _ (rfl : _ = glueVector)
    change form (rightFraction c) glueVector ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    rw [rightFraction_pair]
    change simplexRatForm 2 (intCoordsToRat c) (simplexWeight 2) ∈ _
    rw [(simplexRatForm_isSymm 2).eq, simplexWeight_pair]
    exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨∑ i, c i, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.five_smul_rightFraction_mem
statement:
theorem five_smul_rightFraction_mem (c : Fin 2 → ℤ) :
    (5 : ℤ) • rightFraction c ∈ lattice
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (5 : ℤ) • rightFraction c = (0, intCoordsToRat c) := by
    ext i <;> simp [rightFraction, zsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [heq]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨(coordinateIntegerLattice 2).zero_mem, intCoordsToRat_mem c⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.dualA_mem_dual
statement: theorem dualA_mem_dual : dualA ∈ form.dualSubmodule lattice
proof:
:=
  rightFraction_mem_dual _

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.dualB_mem_dual
statement: theorem dualB_mem_dual : dualB ∈ form.dualSubmodule lattice
proof:
:=
  rightFraction_mem_dual _

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.five_smul_dualA_mem
statement: theorem five_smul_dualA_mem : (5 : ℤ) • dualA ∈ lattice
proof: := five_smul_rightFraction_mem _

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.five_smul_dualB_mem
statement: theorem five_smul_dualB_mem : (5 : ℤ) • dualB ∈ lattice
proof: := five_smul_rightFraction_mem _

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.dualA_norm
statement: theorem dualA_norm : form dualA dualA = 2 / 5
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [form, rightForm, dualA, rightFraction, prodForm_apply, simplexRatForm_apply,
    intCoordsToRat_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.dualB_norm
statement: theorem dualB_norm : form dualB dualB = 24 / 5
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [form, rightForm, dualB, rightFraction, prodForm_apply, simplexRatForm_apply,
    intCoordsToRat_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.dualA_pair_dualB
statement: theorem dualA_pair_dualB : form dualA dualB = 0
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [form, rightForm, dualA, dualB, rightFraction, prodForm_apply, simplexRatForm_apply,
    intCoordsToRat_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.dual_independent
statement:
theorem dual_independent (a b : ℤ) (h : a • dualA + b • dualB ∈ lattice) :
    (5 : ℤ) ∣ a ∧ (5 : ℤ) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  have heq : a • dualA + b • dualB = (a : ℚ) • dualA + (b : ℚ) • dualB := by module
  have ha := dualA_mem_dual _ h
  have hb := dualB_mem_dual _ h
  have hba : form dualB dualA = 0 := by rw [form_isSymm.eq, dualA_pair_dualB]
  simp only [heq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, dualA_pair_dualB, mul_zero, add_zero] at ha
  simp only [heq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hba, mul_zero, zero_add] at hb
  exact ⟨norm_denominator_unit (p := 5) (r := 2) (k := 0) (by norm_num)
      ⟨1, -2, by norm_num⟩ (by simpa using dualA_norm) a ha,
    norm_denominator_unit (p := 5) (r := 4) (k := 2) (by norm_num)
      ⟨1, -1, by norm_num⟩ (by rw [dualB_norm]; norm_num) b hb⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.rightFraction_mem_extension
statement:
theorem rightFraction_mem_extension (c : Fin 2 → ℤ) :
    rightFraction c ∈ lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {dualA, dualB}
proof:
:= by
  let d : Fin 2 → ℤ := fun i => if i = 0 then 0 else c 1
  have hd : ((0 : Fin 2 → ℚ), intCoordsToRat d) ∈ lattice :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨(coordinateIntegerLattice 2).zero_mem, intCoordsToRat_mem d⟩
  have heq : rightFraction c = ((0 : Fin 2 → ℚ), intCoordsToRat d) +
      (c 0 - 2 * c 1) • dualA + (-(c 1)) • dualB := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp [rightFraction, dualA, dualB]
    · ext i
      fin_cases i <;>
        norm_num [rightFraction, dualA, dualB, d, intCoordsToRat_apply, zsmul_eq_mul] <;> ring
  have ha : dualA ∈ Submodule.span ℤ {dualA, dualB} := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  have hb : dualB ∈ Submodule.span ℤ {dualA, dualB} := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  rw [heq]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _
    (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left hd)
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha)))
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb))

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.lattice_dual
statement: theorem lattice_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice = lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {dualA, dualB}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hp : z ∈ (prodForm (simplexRatForm 2) rightForm).dualSubmodule
        ((coordinateIntegerLattice 2).prod (coordinateIntegerLattice 2)) :=
      fun w hw => hz w (Submodule.mem_sup_left hw)
    rw [dualSubmodule_prodForm] at hp
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hp
    have hy' := (mem_dual_smul_form_iff (B := simplexRatForm 2)
      (N := coordinateIntegerLattice 2) (5 : ℚ) z.2).mp hy
    rw [simplexRatForm_dual] at hx hy'
    obtain ⟨nx, hnx, rwgt, hrwgt, heqx⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨ny, hny, swgt, hswgt, heqy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy'
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hrwgt
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hswgt
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hnx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hny
    have hg : glueVector ∈ lattice :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have he : form z glueVector = (∑ i, (a i : ℚ)) + (∑ i, (b i : ℚ)) +
        ((r : ℚ) + s) * (2 / 3) := by
      have hr : r • simplexWeight 2 = (r : ℚ) • simplexWeight 2 := by module
      have hs : s • simplexWeight 2 = (s : ℚ) • simplexWeight 2 := by module
      have hscale : rightForm z.2 (simplexWeight 2) =
          simplexRatForm 2 ((5 : ℚ) • z.2) (simplexWeight 2) := by
        simp [rightForm]
      change simplexRatForm 2 z.1 (simplexWeight 2) +
        rightForm z.2 (simplexWeight 2) = _
      rw [hscale, ← heqx, ← heqy, hr, hs]
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [simplexWeight_norm, (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2).eq (intCoordsToRat a),
        (simplexRatForm_isSymm 2).eq (intCoordsToRat b)]
      simp only [simplexWeight_pair]
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, intCoordsToRat_apply]
      ring
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (hz glueVector hg)
    have hQ : (2 : ℚ) * ((r : ℚ) + s) =
        3 * ((t : ℚ) - (∑ i, a i : ℤ) - (∑ i, b i : ℤ)) := by
      rw [he] at ht
      push_cast
      linarith
    have hZ : 2 * (r + s) = 3 * (t - (∑ i, a i) - (∑ i, b i)) := by
      exact_mod_cast hQ
    have hrs : (3 : ℤ) ∣ r + s := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hrs
    let c : Fin 2 → ℤ := fun i => b i + k - 2 * r
    have hdecomp : z = ((intCoordsToRat a, (0 : Fin 2 → ℚ)) + r • glueVector) +
        rightFraction c := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · change z.1 = (intCoordsToRat a + r • simplexWeight 2) + 0
        simpa only [add_zero] using heqx.symm
      · ext i
        have hs : s • simplexWeight 2 = (s : ℚ) • simplexWeight 2 := by module
        rw [hs] at heqy
        have hi := congrFun heqy i
        change (b i : ℚ) + (s : ℚ) * simplexWeight 2 i = 5 * z.2 i at hi
        norm_num only [simplexWeight] at hi
        change z.2 i = (0 + r • simplexWeight 2 i) + (1 / 5 : ℚ) * (c i : ℚ)
        norm_num only [simplexWeight, zsmul_eq_mul]
        dsimp [c]
        push_cast
        have hkQ : (r : ℚ) + s = 3 * (k : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
        linarith
    have hn : (intCoordsToRat a, (0 : Fin 2 → ℚ)) ∈ lattice :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨intCoordsToRat_mem a, (coordinateIntegerLattice 2).zero_mem⟩
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left (lattice.add_mem hn (lattice.smul_mem r hg)))
      (rightFraction_mem_extension c)
  · refine sup_le lattice_isIntegral (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    intro z hz
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz :
      z = dualA ∨ z = dualB) with rfl | rfl
    · exact dualA_mem_dual
    · exact dualB_mem_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateUnit_not_mem_even
statement:
theorem coordinateUnit_not_mem_even {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) ∉ evenCoordinateLattice n
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hz, heq⟩
  have hzi : z = Pi.single i 1 := by
    funext j
    have hj := congrFun heq j
    change (z j : ℚ) = (Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) j at hj
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji] at hj ⊢ <;> exact_mod_cast hj
  change Even (∑ j, z j) at hz
  rw [hzi] at hz
  simp at hz

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateUnit_add_mem_even
statement:
theorem coordinateUnit_add_mem_even {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :
    Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) + Pi.single j 1 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
  refine ⟨Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext k
    by_cases hki : k = i <;> by_cases hkj : k = j <;>
      simp_all
    norm_num
  · simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateUnit_sub_mem_even
statement:
theorem coordinateUnit_sub_mem_even {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :
    Pi.single i (1 : ℚ) - Pi.single j 1 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
  refine ⟨Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext k
    by_cases hki : k = i <;> by_cases hkj : k = j <;>
      simp_all
  · simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: SRG266.Lattice.not_two_gramDivisibility_of_integral_root_projection
statement:
theorem not_two_gramDivisibility_of_integral_root_projection
    {ι W U : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W] [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℚ U]
    {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hD : ∀ a, (((0 : W), a), (0 : U)) ∈ L ↔ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n)
    (hproj : ∀ r ∈ L, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C r r = 2 →
      r.1.2 ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ) (hdiag : ∀ a, A a a = 2)
    (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hmem : ∀ z, φ z ∈ L)
    (hpair : ∀ z w, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C (φ z) (φ w) =
      (Matrix.toBilin' A z w : ℚ))
    (hcover : ∀ r ∈ L, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C r r = 2 →
      ∃ z, φ z = r) :
    ¬GramDivisibilityDescent 2 A
proof:
:= by
  intro hd
  let F := prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C
  let q : (W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U := ((0, Pi.single i 1), 0)
  let rp : (W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U := ((0, Pi.single i 1 + Pi.single j 1), 0)
  let rm : (W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U := ((0, Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single j 1), 0)
  have hrp : rp ∈ L := (hD _).mpr (coordinateUnit_add_mem_even i j)
  have hrm : rm ∈ L := (hD _).mpr (coordinateUnit_sub_mem_even i j)
  have hnp : F rp rp = 2 := by
    simpa [F, rp, prodForm_apply] using coordinateUnit_add_norm hij
  have hnm : F rm rm = 2 := by
    simpa [F, rm, prodForm_apply] using coordinateUnit_sub_norm hij
  obtain ⟨zp, hzp⟩ := hcover rp hrp hnp
  obtain ⟨zm, hzm⟩ := hcover rm hrm hnm
  have hz : φ (zp + zm) = (2 : ℚ) • q := by
    rw [map_add, hzp, hzm]
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Prod.ext
      · simp [rp, rm, q]
      · ext k
        change ((Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) k + (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℚ) k) +
          ((Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) k - (Pi.single j 1 : Fin n → ℚ) k) =
          2 * (Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) k
        ring
    · simp [rp, rm, q]
  have hqpair (a : ι) : ∃ k : ℤ, F (φ (Pi.single a 1)) q = (k : ℚ) := by
    have hn : F (φ (Pi.single a 1)) (φ (Pi.single a 1)) = 2 := by
      rw [hpair, Matrix.toBilin'_single, hdiag]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mp (hproj _ (hmem _) hn)
    refine ⟨v i, ?_⟩
    simpa [F, q, prodForm_apply, standardRatForm_apply, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
      using (hv i).symm
  have hqmem : q ∈ L := mem_of_gramDivisibilityDescent F L φ hmem A hpair
    (by norm_num) hd q (zp + zm) hz hqpair
  exact coordinateUnit_not_mem_even i ((hD _).mp hqmem)

name: SRG266.Lattice.levelOne_weight_fourteen_cusp_eq_zero

name: SRG266.Lattice.abs_harmonicQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem abs_harmonicQuadratic_le (x y v : V) :
    |harmonicQuadratic x y v| ≤
      ((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) + 1) * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℝ := Module.finrank ℝ V
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := by positivity
  have hvx := abs_real_inner_le_norm v x
  have hvy := abs_real_inner_le_norm v y
  have hxy := abs_real_inner_le_norm x y
  have hvv : |inner ℝ v v| = ‖v‖ * ‖v‖ := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
  calc
    |harmonicQuadratic x y v| ≤
        |d * inner ℝ v x * inner ℝ v y| +
          |inner ℝ x y * inner ℝ v v| := by
      simpa [harmonicQuadratic, d] using
        abs_sub (d * inner ℝ v x * inner ℝ v y)
          (inner ℝ x y * inner ℝ v v)
    _ = d * |inner ℝ v x| * |inner ℝ v y| +
        |inner ℝ x y| * (‖v‖ * ‖v‖) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hd, hvv]
    _ ≤ d * (‖v‖ * ‖x‖) * (‖v‖ * ‖y‖) +
        (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) * (‖v‖ * ‖v‖) := by
      gcongr
    _ = ((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) + 1) * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [d]
      ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_orthonormalBasis_inner_mul_inner
statement:
theorem sum_orthonormalBasis_inner_mul_inner
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V) (x y : V) :
    ∑ i, inner ℝ (b i) x * inner ℝ (b i) y = inner ℝ x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := b.repr.inner_map_map x y
  simpa only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial,
    OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, mul_comm] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_harmonicQuadratic_orthonormalBasis
statement:
theorem sum_harmonicQuadratic_orthonormalBasis
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V) (x y : V) :
    ∑ i, harmonicQuadratic x y (b i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [harmonicQuadratic, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hfirst :
      (∑ i, (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) * inner ℝ (b i) x *
        inner ℝ (b i) y) =
        (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) * inner ℝ x y := by
    simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_orthonormalBasis_inner_mul_inner b x y]
  have hself : ∀ i, inner ℝ (b i) (b i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, b.norm_eq_one]
    norm_num
  have hsecond :
      (∑ i, inner ℝ x y * inner ℝ (b i) (b i)) =
        (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) * inner ℝ x y := by
    simp_rw [hself]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      ← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b.toBasis]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.tripodGraph_connected
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
  refine ⟨none, ?_⟩
  intro x
  cases x with
  | none => exact .rfl
  | some x =>
      rcases x with i | x
      · let z₀ : Fin a := ⟨0, ha⟩
        have hz : (tripodGraph a b c).Adj none (some (.inl z₀)) := by
          rw [tripodGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
          exact ⟨by simp, Or.inl rfl⟩
        exact hz.reachable.trans
          ((SimpleGraph.pathGraph_preconnected a z₀ i).map (tripodArm0Hom a b c))
      · rcases x with i | i
        · let z₁ : Fin b := ⟨0, hb⟩
          have hz : (tripodGraph a b c).Adj none (some (.inr (.inl z₁))) := by
            rw [tripodGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
            exact ⟨by simp, Or.inl rfl⟩
          exact hz.reachable.trans
            ((SimpleGraph.pathGraph_preconnected b z₁ i).map (tripodArm1Hom a b c))
        · let z₂ : Fin c := ⟨0, hc⟩
          have hz : (tripodGraph a b c).Adj none (some (.inr (.inr z₂))) := by
            rw [tripodGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
            exact ⟨by simp, Or.inl rfl⟩
          exact hz.reachable.trans
            ((SimpleGraph.pathGraph_preconnected c z₂ i).map (tripodArm2Hom a b c))

name: SRG266.Lattice.tripodRel_map
statement:
theorem tripodRel_map {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {a b c : ℕ}
    (z : V) (f₀ : Fin a → V) (f₁ : Fin b → V) (f₂ : Fin c → V)
    (h₀ : ∀ {i j}, (pathGraph a).Adj i j → G.Adj (f₀ i) (f₀ j))
    (h₁ : ∀ {i j}, (pathGraph b).Adj i j → G.Adj (f₁ i) (f₁ j))
    (h₂ : ∀ {i j}, (pathGraph c).Adj i j → G.Adj (f₂ i) (f₂ j))
    (hz₀ : ∀ i, i.1 = 0 → G.Adj z (f₀ i))
    (hz₁ : ∀ i, i.1 = 0 → G.Adj z (f₁ i))
    (hz₂ : ∀ i, i.1 = 0 → G.Adj z (f₂ i))
    {x y : TripodVertex a b c} (hxy : tripodRel x y) :
    G.Adj (tripodVertexMap z f₀ f₁ f₂ x)
      (tripodVertexMap z f₀ f₁ f₂ y)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | none =>
      cases y with
      | none => simp [tripodRel] at hxy
      | some y =>
          rcases y with y | y
          · exact hz₀ y hxy
          · rcases y with y | y
            · exact hz₁ y hxy
            · exact hz₂ y hxy
  | some x =>
      cases y with
      | none => simp [tripodRel] at hxy
      | some y =>
          rcases x with x | x
          · rcases y with y | y
            · exact h₀ hxy
            · rcases y with y | y <;> simp [tripodRel, tripodArmRel] at hxy
          · rcases x with x | x
            · rcases y with y | y
              · simp [tripodRel, tripodArmRel] at hxy
              · rcases y with y | y
                · exact h₁ hxy
                · simp [tripodRel, tripodArmRel] at hxy
            · rcases y with y | y
              · simp [tripodRel, tripodArmRel] at hxy
              · rcases y with y | y
                · simp [tripodRel, tripodArmRel] at hxy
                · exact h₂ hxy

name: SRG266.Lattice.false_of_tripod_null_embedding
statement:
theorem false_of_tripod_null_embedding
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G)
    {a b c : ℕ} (f : TripodVertex a b c ↪ V)
    (hmap : ∀ {x y}, (tripodGraph a b c).Adj x y → G.Adj (f x) (f y))
    (w : TripodVertex a b c → ℤ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (henergy : graphCartanEnergy (tripodGraph a b c) w ≤ 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hle : tripodGraph a b c ≤ G.comap f := by
    intro x y hxy
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.comap_adj] using hmap hxy
  have hcomp : IsPositiveCartan (G.comap f) := hpos.comap f
  exact (not_isPositiveCartan_of_nonpositive_subgraph hle hw0 hw henergy) hcomp

name: SRG266.Lattice.false_of_orientedArm_tripod
statement:
theorem false_of_orientedArm_tripod
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) {z : V}
    (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩)
    (h₀₁ : A₀.component ≠ A₁.component)
    (h₀₂ : A₀.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₁₂ : A₁.component ≠ A₂.component)
    {a b c : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ A₀.length) (hb : b ≤ A₁.length)
    (hc : c ≤ A₂.length)
    (w : TripodVertex a b c → ℤ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (henergy : graphCartanEnergy (tripodGraph a b c) w ≤ 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f₀ := A₀.prefixEmbedding ha
  let f₁ := A₁.prefixEmbedding hb
  let f₂ := A₂.prefixEmbedding hc
  let f : TripodVertex a b c ↪ V := tripodVertexEmbedding z f₀ f₁ f₂
    (fun i ↦ A₀.prefixEmbedding_ne_center ha i)
    (fun i ↦ A₁.prefixEmbedding_ne_center hb i)
    (fun i ↦ A₂.prefixEmbedding_ne_center hc i)
    (fun i j ↦ A₀.prefixEmbedding_ne_of_component_ne A₁ h₀₁ ha hb i j)
    (fun i j ↦ A₀.prefixEmbedding_ne_of_component_ne A₂ h₀₂ ha hc i j)
    (fun i j ↦ A₁.prefixEmbedding_ne_of_component_ne A₂ h₁₂ hb hc i j)
  have hmap : ∀ {x y}, (tripodGraph a b c).Adj x y → G.Adj (f x) (f y) := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [tripodGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hxy
    rcases hxy.2 with hxy | hxy
    · exact tripodRel_map z f₀ f₁ f₂
        (fun h ↦ A₀.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj ha h)
        (fun h ↦ A₁.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj hb h)
        (fun h ↦ A₂.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj hc h)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₀.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero ha i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₁.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero hb i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₂.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero hc i hi) hxy
    · exact (tripodRel_map z f₀ f₁ f₂
        (fun h ↦ A₀.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj ha h)
        (fun h ↦ A₁.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj hb h)
        (fun h ↦ A₂.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj hc h)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₀.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero ha i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₁.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero hb i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₂.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero hc i hi) hxy).symm
  exact false_of_tripod_null_embedding hpos f hmap w hw0 hw henergy

name: SRG266.Lattice.not_all_three_arms_length_two
statement:
theorem not_all_three_arms_length_two
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) {z : V}
    (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩)
    (h₀₁ : A₀.component ≠ A₁.component)
    (h₀₂ : A₀.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₁₂ : A₁.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₀ : 2 ≤ A₀.length) (h₁ : 2 ≤ A₁.length) (h₂ : 2 ≤ A₂.length) :
    False
proof:
:=
  false_of_orientedArm_tripod hpos hconn A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂
    h₀ h₁ h₂ affineE6Weight affineE6Weight_ne_zero
    affineE6Weight_nonnegative affineE6_cartanEnergy_zero.le

name: SRG266.Lattice.not_arms_length_one_three_three
statement:
theorem not_arms_length_one_three_three
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) {z : V}
    (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩)
