    (h₀ : 1 ≤ A₀.length) (h₁ : 3 ≤ A₁.length) (h₂ : 3 ≤ A₂.length) :
    False
proof:

name: SRG266.Lattice.not_arms_length_one_two_five
statement:
theorem not_arms_length_one_two_five
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) {z : V}
    (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩)
    (h₀₁ : A₀.component ≠ A₁.component)
    (h₀₂ : A₀.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₁₂ : A₁.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₀ : 1 ≤ A₀.length) (h₁ : 2 ≤ A₁.length) (h₂ : 5 ≤ A₂.length) :
    False
proof:
:=
  false_of_orientedArm_tripod hpos hconn A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂
    h₀ h₁ h₂ affineE8Weight affineE8Weight_ne_zero
    affineE8Weight_nonnegative affineE8_cartanEnergy_zero.le

name: SRG266.Lattice.isEven_prod
statement:
theorem isEven_prod (hN : IsEven B N) (hM : IsEven C M) :
    IsEven (prodForm B C) (N.prod M)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hN z.1 hz.1
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hM z.2 hz.2
  refine ⟨i + j, ?_⟩
  rw [prodForm_apply, hi, hj]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueSystem.glue_isEven
statement:
theorem GlueSystem.glue_isEven (S : GlueSystem B C N M ι)
    (hN : IsEven B N) (hM : IsEven C M)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, B (S.y i) (S.y i) + C (S.m i) (S.m i) = 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    IsEven (prodForm B C) (glueLattice N M S.gen)
proof:
:= by
  refine isEven_sup_span (prodForm_isSymm S.symmB S.symmC) S.glue_isIntegral
    (isEven_prod hN hM) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact hdiag i

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_even_glue
statement:
theorem complete_even_glue [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (u : ι → W) (v : ι → U) (p : ι → ℤ)
    (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hsC : C.IsSymm)
    (hlN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hlM : IsLattice ℚ M)
    (hiN : IsIntegral B N) (hiM : IsIntegral C M)
    (heN : IsEven B N) (heM : IsEven C M)
    (hdN : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range u))
    (hdM : C.dualSubmodule M = M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v))
    (hpv : ∀ i, p i • v i ∈ M)
    (hcrossN : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → B (u i) (u j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hcrossM : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → C (v i) (v j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, B (u i) (u i) + C (v i) (v i) = 2 * (k : ℚ))
    (hunit : ∀ i (a : ℤ), (a : ℚ) * B (u i) (u i) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) → p i ∣ a) :
    IsLattice ℚ (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B C) (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))) ∧
      (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))) =
        glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))
proof:
:= by
  have hdiagInt (i : ι) : B (u i) (u i) + C (v i) (v i) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiag i
    exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨2 * k, by rw [hk]; push_cast; rfl⟩
  let S : GlueSystem B C N M ι := {
    y := u
    m := v
    pr := p
    symmB := hsB
    symmC := hsC
    intN := hiN
    intM := hiM
    dualN := hdN
    dualM := hdM
    smul_mem := hpv
    crossW := hcrossN
    crossU := hcrossM
    diag := hdiagInt
    unit := by
      intro i a b hab
      apply hunit i (a - b)
      have heq : ((a - b : ℤ) : ℚ) * B (u i) (u i) =
          ((a : ℚ) * B (u i) (u i) + (b : ℚ) * C (v i) (v i)) -
          (b : ℚ) * (B (u i) (u i) + C (v i) (v i)) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [heq]
      apply sub_mem hab
      simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem b (hdiagInt i) }
  exact ⟨S.glue_isLattice hlN hlM, S.glue_isEven heN heM hdiag, S.glue_dual_eq_self⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.normShell_finite
statement:
theorem normShell_finite {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (q : ℕ) :
    Finite (NormShell L q)
proof:
:= by
  let := L.moduleFree
  let := L.moduleFinite
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ L.carrier :=
    Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℤ L.carrier L.rank
  choose d hd using fun i : Fin n => L.unimodular.2 (b.coord i)
  let bound : Fin n → ℤ := fun i => (q : ℤ) * L.pairing (d i) (d i) + 1
  let BoxCoord : Fin n → Type := fun i =>
    {a : ℤ // a ∈ Set.Icc (-bound i) (bound i)}
  let (i : Fin n) : Fintype (BoxCoord i) :=
    (Set.finite_Icc (-bound i) (bound i)).fintype
  let encode : NormShell L q → (∀ i, BoxCoord i) := fun r i =>
    ⟨b.equivFun r.1 i, by
      have hcoord : b.equivFun r.1 i = L.pairing (d i) r.1 := by
        change b.coord i r.1 = L.pairing (d i) r.1
        exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (hd i) r.1).symm
      have hcs := L.pairing.apply_sq_le_of_symm
        (pairing_self_nonneg L)
        (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp L.symmetric) (d i) r.1
      rw [r.2] at hcs
      have hdnonneg := pairing_self_nonneg L (d i)
      have hqnonneg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le q)
      change -bound i ≤ b.equivFun r.1 i ∧
        b.equivFun r.1 i ≤ bound i
      dsimp only [bound]
      rw [hcoord]
      constructor <;> nlinarith⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective encode fun r s hrs => by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply b.equivFun.injective
    funext i
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hrs i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.binary_gram_reconstruction
statement:
theorem binary_gram_reconstruction
    (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (hself : ∀ x, C x x = 0 → x = 0)
    (s : κ → X) (hs : LinearIndependent ℚ s) (r : Fin 2 → X)
    (hr : ∀ i j, C (r i) (r j) = if i = j then 4 else 1)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, C (s i) (r j) = 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ X = Fintype.card κ+2)
    (t : X) (ht : ∀ i, C (s i) t = 0) :
    t = ((4*C (r 0) t-C (r 1) t)/15) • r 0+
      ((4*C (r 1) t-C (r 0) t)/15) • r 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hri : LinearIndependent ℚ r := by
    apply linearIndependent_of_gram_nondegenerate C r
    apply LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_toBilin'_of_det_ne_zero'
    have hg : (fun i j => C (r i) (r j)) = !![(4 : ℚ), 1; 1, 4] := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [hr]
    rw [hg]
    norm_num [Matrix.det_fin_two]
  let f : κ ⊕ Fin 2 → X := Sum.elim s r
  have hfi : LinearIndependent ℚ f := linearIndependent_sum_of_orthogonal C hself s r hs hri hcross
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range f) = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hfi, hdim]
    simp
  let q := ((4*C (r 0) t-C (r 1) t)/15) • r 0+
    ((4*C (r 1) t-C (r 0) t)/15) • r 1
  have hszero (i) : C (s i) (t-q) = 0 := by
    simp [q, ht, hcross]
  have hrzero (i : Fin 2) : C (r i) (t-q) = 0 := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp [q, hr] <;> ring
  have hker : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range f) ≤ (C.flip (t-q)).ker :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rcases i with i | i
      · exact hszero i
      · exact hrzero i)
  have hmem : t-q ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range f) := by rw [hspan]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hself _ (hker hmem))

name: SRG266.Lattice.binary_gram_norm_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem binary_gram_norm_of_orthogonal
    (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (hself : ∀ x, C x x = 0 → x = 0)
    (s : κ → X) (hs : LinearIndependent ℚ s) (r : Fin 2 → X)
    (hr : ∀ i j, C (r i) (r j) = if i = j then 4 else 1)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, C (s i) (r j) = 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ X = Fintype.card κ+2)
    (t : X) (ht : ∀ i, C (s i) t = 0) :
    C t t = (4*(C (r 0) t)^2+4*(C (r 1) t)^2-2*C (r 0) t*C (r 1) t)/15
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [binary_gram_reconstruction C hself s hs r hr hcross hdim t ht]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hr]
  norm_num
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.pathGraph_sum_adj_indicator
statement:
theorem pathGraph_sum_adj_indicator (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, if (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj i j then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
      (if 0 < i.1 then 1 else 0) + (if i.1 + 1 < n then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hleft :
      (∑ j : Fin n, if j.1 + 1 = i.1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
      if 0 < i.1 then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hi : 0 < i.1
    · let p : Fin n := ⟨i.1 - 1, by omega⟩
      have hiff (j : Fin n) : j.1 + 1 = i.1 ↔ j = p := by
        dsimp [p]
        simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
        omega
      simp [hiff, hi]
    · have hnot (j : Fin n) : ¬ j.1 + 1 = i.1 := by omega
      simp [hnot, hi]
  have hright :
      (∑ j : Fin n, if i.1 + 1 = j.1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
      if i.1 + 1 < n then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hi : i.1 + 1 < n
    · let p : Fin n := ⟨i.1 + 1, hi⟩
      have hiff (j : Fin n) : i.1 + 1 = j.1 ↔ j = p := by
        dsimp [p]
        simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
        omega
      simp [hiff, hi]
    · have hnot (j : Fin n) : ¬ i.1 + 1 = j.1 := by omega
      simp [hnot, hi]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n,
        ((if j.1 + 1 = i.1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) +
          (if i.1 + 1 = j.1 then 1 else 0)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hleft, hright]

name: SRG266.Lattice.doubleFork_cartan_mulVec_zero
statement:
theorem doubleFork_cartan_mulVec_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (graphCartanMatrix (doubleForkGraph n)) *ᵥ doubleForkWeight = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpath (i j : Fin n) :
      (doubleForkGraph n).Adj (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) ↔
        (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj i j := by
    simp only [doubleForkGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, doubleForkRel]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, h | h⟩
      · exact h
      · exact h.symm
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun heq => h.ne (Sum.inl.inj heq), Or.inl h⟩
  have hl (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 2) :
      (doubleForkGraph n).Adj (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j)) ↔ i.1 = 0 := by
    simp [doubleForkGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, doubleForkRel]
  have hr (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 2) :
      (doubleForkGraph n).Adj (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j)) ↔ i.1 + 1 = n := by
    simp [doubleForkGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj, doubleForkRel]
  have hweight : (doubleForkGraph n).adjMatrix ℤ *ᵥ doubleForkWeight =
      fun x => 2 * doubleForkWeight x := by
    funext x
    cases x with
    | inl i =>
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
          SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, hpath, hl, hr, doubleForkWeight,
          Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        simp only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
        have hp := pathGraph_sum_adj_indicator n i
        have hdouble :
            (∑ j : Fin n, if (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj i j then (2 : ℤ) else 0) =
            2 * (∑ j : Fin n, if (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj i j then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          split_ifs <;> norm_num
        rw [hdouble, hp]
        split_ifs <;> omega
    | inr x =>
        cases x with
        | inl j =>
            have hfirst (i : Fin n) : i.1 = 0 ↔ i = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
              simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
            simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
              SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, doubleForkGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj,
              doubleForkRel, doubleForkWeight, hfirst]
        | inr j =>
            have hlast (i : Fin n) : i.1 + 1 = n ↔ i = ⟨n-1, by omega⟩ := by
              simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
              omega
            simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
              SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, doubleForkGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj,
              doubleForkRel, doubleForkWeight, hlast]
  rw [graphCartanMatrix_eq_two_sub_adjMatrix, Matrix.sub_mulVec, hweight]
  ext x
  simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.doubleFork_cartanEnergy_zero_unbounded
statement:
theorem doubleFork_cartanEnergy_zero_unbounded (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    graphCartanEnergy (doubleForkGraph n) doubleForkWeight = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphCartanEnergy, Matrix.toBilin'_apply', doubleFork_cartan_mulVec_zero n hn]
  simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.doubleFork_cartanEnergy_zero
statement:
theorem doubleFork_cartanEnergy_zero (n : ℕ) (hnlo : 2 ≤ n) (_hnhi : n ≤ 15) :
    graphCartanEnergy (doubleForkGraph n) doubleForkWeight = 0
proof:
:=
  doubleFork_cartanEnergy_zero_unbounded n hnlo

name: SRG266.ratGramForm_zsmul_right
statement:
theorem ratGramForm_zsmul_right (x : V) (v w : ratGramSpace G x) (k : ℤ) :
    ratGramForm G x v (k • w) = (k : ℚ) * ratGramForm G x v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.ratGramForm_zsmul_left
statement:
theorem ratGramForm_zsmul_left (x : V) (v w : ratGramSpace G x) (k : ℤ) :
    ratGramForm G x (k • v) w = (k : ℚ) * ratGramForm G x v w
proof:
:= by
  calc ratGramForm G x (k • v) w
      = ratGramForm G x w (k • v) := (ratGramForm_isSymm G x).eq _ _
    _ = (k : ℚ) * ratGramForm G x w v := ratGramForm_zsmul_right G x w v k
    _ = (k : ℚ) * ratGramForm G x v w := by rw [(ratGramForm_isSymm G x).eq w v]

name: SRG266.ratGramSpace_mk_eq_sum_smul_generator
statement:
theorem ratGramSpace_mk_eq_sum_smul_generator (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℚ) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : ratGramSpace G x) =
      ∑ B, a B • toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ B, a B • Pi.single B (1 : ℚ)) = a := by
    funext C
    simp [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  calc (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : ratGramSpace G x)
      = (rationalGramKernel G x).mkQ (∑ B, a B • Pi.single B (1 : ℚ)) := by
        rw [hsum]; rfl
    _ = ∑ B, a B • toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B) := by
        rw [map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun B _ => ?_
        rw [map_smul, toRatSpace_generator]
        rfl

name: SRG266.eq_zero_of_ratPairing_generators_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_ratPairing_generators_eq_zero (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (v : ratGramSpace G x)
    (h : ∀ B, ratGramForm G x (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) v = 0) :
    v = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (ratGramForm_nondegenerate G hG x).2 v fun w => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ w
  rw [ratGramSpace_mk_eq_sum_smul_generator, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun B _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h B, mul_zero]

name: SRG266.gram_frame_identity
statement:
theorem gram_frame_identity (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∑ C, localGramMatrix G x B C • integralGramGenerator G x C =
      (45 : ℤ) • integralGramGenerator G x B + (6 : ℤ) • c
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_pairing_generators_eq_zero G hG x _ fun D => ?_)
  have hlhs :
      integralGramPairing G x
          (∑ C, localGramMatrix G x B C • integralGramGenerator G x C)
          (integralGramGenerator G x D) =
        ∑ C, localGramMatrix G x B C * localGramMatrix G x C D := by
    rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun C _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      integralGramPairing_generator_generator]
  have hrhs :
      integralGramPairing G x
          ((45 : ℤ) • integralGramGenerator G x B + (6 : ℤ) • c)
          (integralGramGenerator G x D) =
        45 * localGramMatrix G x B D + 6 * 15 := by
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      integralGramPairing_generator_generator,
      integral_centroid_pairing_generator G hG x c hc D]
  have hmul :
      (∑ C, localGramMatrix G x B C * localGramMatrix G x C D) =
        45 * localGramMatrix G x B D + 90 := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, localGramMatrix_sq_apply G hG x B D]
  rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hlhs, hrhs, hmul]
  ring

name: SRG266.ratGram_frame_identity
statement:
theorem ratGram_frame_identity (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∑ C, (localGramMatrix G x B C) •
        toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x C) =
      (45 : ℤ) • toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B) +
        (6 : ℤ) • toRatSpace G x c
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (toRatSpace G x) (gram_frame_identity G hG x c hc B)
  rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_sum] at h
  rw [← h]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun C _ => (map_smul _ _ _).symm

name: SRG266.gramLattice_isIntegral
statement:
theorem gramLattice_isIntegral (x : V) :
    Lattice.IsIntegral (ratGramForm G x) (gramLattice G x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lattice.isIntegral_iff_forall]
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  rw [toRatSpace_pairing]
  exact Submodule.mem_one.mpr ⟨integralGramPairing G x a b, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.gramLattice_le_dual
statement:
theorem gramLattice_le_dual (x : V) :
    gramLattice G x ≤ (ratGramForm G x).dualSubmodule (gramLattice G x)
proof:
:=
  gramLattice_isIntegral G x

name: SRG266.gramLattice_dual_isLattice
statement:
theorem gramLattice_dual_isLattice (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    Lattice.IsLattice ℚ ((ratGramForm G x).dualSubmodule (gramLattice G x))
proof:
:=
  Lattice.dual_isLattice (ratGramForm G x) (gramLattice_isLattice G x)
    (ratGramForm_nondegenerate G hG x)

name: SRG266.gram_dual_denominator
statement:
theorem gram_dual_denominator (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    ∀ y ∈ (ratGramForm G x).dualSubmodule (gramLattice G x),
      (225 : ℤ) • y ∈ gramLattice G x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_integral_centroid G hG x

  have hint : ∀ a : IntegralGramLattice G x,
      ∃ k : ℤ, (k : ℚ) = ratGramForm G x (toRatSpace G x a) y := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (hy _ (toRatSpace_mem_gramLattice G x a))
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [(ratGramForm_isSymm G x).eq]
    simpa using hk
  choose n hn using fun B => hint (integralGramGenerator G x B)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hint c
  set z : IntegralGramLattice G x := ∑ B, n B • integralGramGenerator G x B with hzdef

  have hrow : ∀ D, (∑ B, (localGramMatrix G x D B : ℚ) * (n B : ℚ)) =
      45 * (n D : ℚ) + 6 * (m : ℚ) := by
    intro D
    have hpair := congrArg (fun u => ratGramForm G x u y)
      (ratGram_frame_identity G hG x c hc D)
    simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
      ratGramForm_zsmul_left] at hpair
    simp only [← hn, ← hm] at hpair
    rw [hpair]
    norm_num

  have hz : ∀ D, ratGramForm G x (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x D))
      (toRatSpace G x z) = 45 * (n D : ℚ) + 6 * (m : ℚ) := by
    intro D
    have hcast :
        integralGramPairing G x (integralGramGenerator G x D)
            (∑ B, n B • integralGramGenerator G x B) =
          ∑ B, localGramMatrix G x D B * n B := by
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun B _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, integralGramPairing_generator_generator]
      ring
    rw [toRatSpace_pairing, hzdef, hcast]
    push_cast
    exact hrow D

  have hcent : ∀ D, ratGramForm G x (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x D))
      (toRatSpace G x c) = 15 := by
    intro D
    rw [toRatSpace_pairing,
      (integralGramPairing_isSymm G x).eq (integralGramGenerator G x D) c,
      integral_centroid_pairing_generator G hG x c hc D]
    norm_num

  refine ⟨(5 : ℤ) • z - (2 * m : ℤ) • c, ?_⟩
  have hkey : (225 : ℤ) • y -
      toRatSpace G x ((5 : ℤ) • z - (2 * m : ℤ) • c) = 0 := by
    refine eq_zero_of_ratPairing_generators_eq_zero G hG x _ fun D => ?_
    have hsplit : toRatSpace G x ((5 : ℤ) • z - (2 * m : ℤ) • c) =
        (5 : ℤ) • toRatSpace G x z - (2 * m : ℤ) • toRatSpace G x c := by
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul]
    rw [hsplit, map_sub, map_sub]
    simp only [ratGramForm_zsmul_right]
    rw [hz D, hcent D, ← hn D]
    push_cast
    ring
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hkey).symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_ternary_two
statement:
theorem complete_ternary_two (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hlN : IsLattice ℚ N)
    (hiN : IsIntegral B N) (heN : IsEven B N)
    (hdN : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u})
    (hnorm : ∃ k : ℤ, B u u = 2 / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    IsLattice ℚ (ternaryTwoLattice N u) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B E6Coordinates.form) (ternaryTwoLattice N u) ∧
      (prodForm B E6Coordinates.form).dualSubmodule (ternaryTwoLattice N u) =
        ternaryTwoLattice N u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hnorm
  apply complete_even_cyclic_glue hsB E6Coordinates.form_isSymm hlN E6Coordinates.lattice_isLattice
    hiN E6Coordinates.lattice_isIntegral heN E6Coordinates.lattice_isEven
    hdN E6Coordinates.lattice_dual E6Coordinates.three_smul_dualVector_mem
  · refine ⟨k + 2, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, E6Coordinates.dualVector_norm]
    push_cast
    ring
  · exact norm_denominator_unit (p := 3) (r := 2) (by norm_num)
      ⟨1, -1, by norm_num⟩ (by simpa using hk)

name: SRG266.Lattice.intDot_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem intDot_self_nonneg {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℤ) :
    0 ≤ intDot x x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (x i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.intDot_self_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem intDot_self_eq_zero_iff {m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℤ) :
    intDot x x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i
    have hi : x i * x i ≤ intDot x x :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_self_nonneg (x j))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [h] at hi
    have hs := mul_self_nonneg (x i)
    exact mul_self_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hi hs)
  · rintro rfl
    simp [intDot]

name: SRG266.Lattice.signedUnit_sq

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.intDot_self
statement:
theorem DRoot.intDot_self {m : ℕ} (r : DRoot m) :
    intDot r.vector r.vector = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show intDot r.vector r.vector =
      ∑ k, ((if k = r.i then 1 else 0) + if k = r.j then 1 else 0) by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    by_cases hi : k = r.i
    · subst k
      simp [DRoot.vector, signedUnit_sq, ne_of_lt r.lt]
    · by_cases hj : k = r.j
      · subst k
        simp [DRoot.vector, hi, signedUnit_sq]
      · simp [DRoot.vector, hi, hj]]
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.sum_vector
statement:
theorem DRoot.sum_vector {m : ℕ} (r : DRoot m) :
    (∑ i, r.vector i) = signedUnit r.si + signedUnit r.sj
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show (∑ i, r.vector i) =
      ∑ i, ((if i = r.i then signedUnit r.si else 0) +
        (if i = r.j then signedUnit r.sj else 0)) by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i = r.i
    · subst i
      simp [DRoot.vector, ne_of_lt r.lt]
    · by_cases hj : i = r.j
      · subst i
        simp [DRoot.vector, ne_of_gt r.lt]
      · simp [DRoot.vector, hi, hj]]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp

proof:
:= by

  cases r.si <;> cases r.sj
  · exact ⟨-1, by norm_num [signedUnit]⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by norm_num [signedUnit]⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by norm_num [signedUnit]⟩
  · exact ⟨1, by norm_num [signedUnit]⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.vector_j

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.vector_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem DRoot.vector_ne_zero_iff {m : ℕ} (r : DRoot m) (k : Fin m) :
    r.vector k ≠ 0 ↔ k = r.i ∨ k = r.j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : k = r.i
  · simp [hi]
  · by_cases hj : k = r.j
    · subst k
      simp [DRoot.vector, ne_of_gt r.lt]
    · simp [DRoot.vector, hi, hj]

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.vector_injective
statement:
theorem DRoot.vector_injective {m : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (@DRoot.vector m)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs
  have hi : r.i = s.i ∨ r.i = s.j :=
    (s.vector_ne_zero_iff r.i).mp (by
      rw [← hrs]
      show r.vector r.i ≠ 0
      rw [r.vector_i]
      exact signedUnit_ne_zero r.si)
  have hj : r.j = s.i ∨ r.j = s.j :=
    (s.vector_ne_zero_iff r.j).mp (by
      rw [← hrs]
      show r.vector r.j ≠ 0
      rw [r.vector_j]
      exact signedUnit_ne_zero r.sj)
  have hii : r.i = s.i := by
    rcases hi with hi | hi
    · exact hi
    · rcases hj with hj | hj
      · exfalso
        have hsr : s.i < r.i := by simpa [hi] using s.lt
        have hrs' : r.i < s.i := by simpa [hj] using r.lt
        exact lt_asymm hsr hrs'
      · exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) (ne_of_lt r.lt)
  have hjj : r.j = s.j := by
    rcases hj with hj | hj
    · exact absurd (hii.trans hj.symm) (ne_of_lt r.lt)
    · exact hj
  have hsi : r.si = s.si := by
    apply signedUnit_injective
    calc
      signedUnit r.si = r.vector r.i := r.vector_i.symm
      _ = s.vector r.i := congrFun hrs r.i
      _ = s.vector s.i := congrArg s.vector hii
      _ = signedUnit s.si := s.vector_i
  have hsj : r.sj = s.sj := by
    apply signedUnit_injective
    calc
      signedUnit r.sj = r.vector r.j := r.vector_j.symm
      _ = s.vector r.j := congrFun hrs r.j
      _ = s.vector s.j := congrArg s.vector hjj
      _ = signedUnit s.sj := s.vector_j
  cases r
  cases s
  simp_all

name: SRG266.Lattice.int_eq_zero_or_signedUnit_of_sq_le_two
statement:
theorem int_eq_zero_or_signedUnit_of_sq_le_two (z : ℤ) (hz : z * z ≤ 2) :
    z = 0 ∨ ∃ s : Bool, signedUnit s = z
proof:
:= by
  have hlo : -1 ≤ z := by
    by_contra h
    have : z ≤ -2 := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hhi : z ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have : 2 ≤ z := by omega
    nlinarith
  interval_cases z
  · exact Or.inr ⟨false, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr ⟨true, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.exists_vector_eq_of_intDot_self_eq_two
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let support : Finset (Fin m) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => z i ≠ 0
  have hle : ∀ i, z i * z i ≤ 2 := by
    intro i
    calc
      z i * z i ≤ ∑ j, z j * z j :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_self_nonneg (z j))
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
      _ = 2 := hz
  have hunit : ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ ∃ s : Bool, signedUnit s = z i := fun i =>
    int_eq_zero_or_signedUnit_of_sq_le_two (z i) (hle i)
  have hsumCard : (support.card : ℤ) = 2 := by
    calc
      (support.card : ℤ) = (∑ i ∈ support, (1 : ℤ)) := by simp
      _ = ∑ i, z i * z i := by
        calc
          (∑ i ∈ support, (1 : ℤ)) =
              ∑ i, if z i ≠ 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0 := by
            dsimp only [support]
            exact Finset.sum_filter (s := Finset.univ)
              (fun i => z i ≠ 0) (fun _ => (1 : ℤ))
          _ = ∑ i, z i * z i := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            by_cases hi : z i = 0
            · simp [hi]
            · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (hunit i).resolve_left hi
              simp [← hs, signedUnit_sq]
      _ = 2 := hz
  have hcard : support.card = 2 := by omega
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hsupp⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hcard
  have hi : z i ≠ 0 := by
    have : i ∈ support := by simp [hsupp]
    simpa [support] using this
  have hj : z j ≠ 0 := by
    have : j ∈ support := by simp [hsupp]
    simpa [support] using this
  obtain ⟨si, hsi⟩ := (hunit i).resolve_left hi
  obtain ⟨sj, hsj⟩ := (hunit j).resolve_left hj
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hijlt | hjilt
  · let r : DRoot m := ⟨i, j, hijlt, si, sj⟩
    refine ⟨r, funext fun k => ?_⟩
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      change (if i = i then signedUnit si else
        if i = j then signedUnit sj else 0) = z i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact hsi
    · by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst k
        change (if j = i then signedUnit si else
          if j = j then signedUnit sj else 0) = z j
        rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hijlt), if_pos rfl]
        exact hsj
      · have hknot : k ∉ support := by simp [hsupp, hki, hkj]
        have hkzero : z k = 0 := by simpa [support] using hknot
        simp [r, DRoot.vector, hki, hkj, hkzero]
  · let r : DRoot m := ⟨j, i, hjilt, sj, si⟩
    refine ⟨r, funext fun k => ?_⟩
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      change (if j = j then signedUnit sj else
        if j = i then signedUnit si else 0) = z j
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact hsj
    · by_cases hki : k = i
      · subst k
        change (if i = j then signedUnit sj else
          if i = i then signedUnit si else 0) = z i
        rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hjilt), if_pos rfl]
        exact hsi
      · have hknot : k ∉ support := by simp [hsupp, hki, hkj]
        have hkzero : z k = 0 := by simpa [support] using hknot
        simp [r, DRoot.vector, hki, hkj, hkzero]

name: SRG266.Lattice.card_eq_288_of_isolated_d7
statement:
theorem card_eq_288_of_isolated_d7
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (R : Finset ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hR : ∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ L ∧ prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r = 2)
    (hD7 : ∀ a, (((0 : W), a), (0 : U)) ∈ L ↔ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)
    (hsep : ∀ r ∈ R, r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0))
    (hm : ∀ x y, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R,
        prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r x *
          prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r y) =
        (R.card : ℚ) * prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C x y) :
    R.card = 288
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let embed : DRoot 7 → (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U := fun r => ((0, r.ratVector), 0)
  have hinj : Function.Injective embed := by
    intro r s h
    exact DRoot.ratVector_injective (congrArg (fun z => z.1.2) h)
  let D : Finset ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) := Finset.univ.map ⟨embed, hinj⟩
  have hD : D ⊆ R := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
    apply (hR _).mpr
    refine ⟨(hD7 _).mpr r.ratVector_mem_even, ?_⟩
    change B 0 0 + standardRatForm 7 r.ratVector r.ratVector + C 0 0 = 2
    simp only [map_zero, zero_add, add_zero, r.ratVector_norm]
  have hrest : ∀ r ∈ R, r ∉ D → (r.1.2 0) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨⟨y, a⟩, z⟩ hr hnot
    rcases hsep _ hr with ha | ⟨hy, hz⟩
    · change a = 0 at ha
      simp [ha]
    · change y = 0 at hy
      change z = 0 at hz
      subst y
      subst z
      obtain ⟨hrL, hrnorm⟩ := (hR _).mp hr
      have hanorm : standardRatForm 7 a a = 2 := by
        simpa only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add, add_zero] using hrnorm
      obtain ⟨r, heq⟩ := DRoot.exists_ratVector_of_norm_two ((hD7 a).mp hrL) hanorm
      exfalso
      apply hnot
      refine Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨r, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      change ((0, r.ratVector), 0) = ((0, a), 0)
      rw [heq]
  have hsum : (∑ r ∈ R, (r.1.2 0) ^ 2) = 24 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ r ∈ D, (r.1.2 0) ^ 2 := (Finset.sum_subset hD hrest).symm
      _ = ∑ r : DRoot 7, (r.ratVector 0) ^ 2 := by simp [D, embed]
      _ = 24 := (dRoot_rat_coordinate_zero_secondMoment 6).trans (by norm_num)
  let q : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U := ((0, Pi.single 0 1), 0)
  have hpair (r) : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r q = r.1.2 0 := by
    simp [q, prodForm_apply, standardRatForm_apply, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
  have hq : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C q q = 1 := by
    rw [hpair]
    simp [q]
  have h := hm q q
  rw [hq] at h
  simp only [hpair, ← pow_two, hsum, mul_one] at h
  have hc : (R.card : ℚ) = 288 := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast hc

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6D7Projection_single
statement:
theorem a11D7E6D7Projection_single (i : Fin 24) :

proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j; simp [a11D7E6D7Projection]
  · simp [a11D7E6D7Projection, h]

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_binary_scalar_of_sum_seven
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_binary_scalar_of_sum_seven (a : Fin 24 → ℚ)
    (hbinary : ∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ a i = 1)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, (adeGram a11D7E6Types).2 i j ≠ 0 → a i = a j)
    (hsum : (∑ i, a i) = 7) : ∀ i, a i = a11D7E6D7Scalar i
proof:
:= by
  let e := finADEBlockEquiv a11D7E6Types
  let b : Fin 11 ⊕ (Fin 7 ⊕ (Fin 6 ⊕ Empty)) → ℚ := fun i => a (e.symm i)
  have hbinaryB (i) : b i = 0 ∨ b i = 1 := hbinary (e.symm i)
  have hb (i j) (hij : adeBlockPairing a11D7E6Types i j ≠ 0) : b i = b j := by
    apply hpair
    simpa only [adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing, e, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hij
  have hA : ∀ i : Fin 11, b (Sum.inl i) = b (Sum.inl 0) :=
    gramA_scalar_constant 10 (fun i => b (Sum.inl i))
      (fun i j h => hb (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) h)
  have hD : ∀ i : Fin 7, b (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) = b (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0)) :=
    gramD_scalar_constant 3 (fun i => b (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))
      (fun i j h => hb (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j)) h)
  have hE : ∀ i : Fin 6, b (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))) =
      b (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0))) :=
    gramE_scalar_constant 2 (fun i => b (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))))
      (fun i j h => hb (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))
        (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j))) h)
  have hs : 11 * b (Sum.inl 0) + 7 * b (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0)) +
      6 * b (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0))) = 7 := by
    have h := (e.symm.sum_comp a).symm.trans hsum
    change (∑ i : Fin 11 ⊕ (Fin 7 ⊕ (Fin 6 ⊕ Empty)), b i) = 7 at h
    simpa only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, hA, hD, hE, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Fintype.sum_empty, add_zero,
      Nat.cast_ofNat, add_assoc] using h
  have hvalues : b (Sum.inl 0) = 0 ∧ b (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0)) = 1 ∧
      b (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0))) = 0 := by
    rcases hbinaryB (Sum.inl 0) with h0 | h1 <;>
      rcases hbinaryB (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0)) with h2 | h3 <;>
      rcases hbinaryB (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0))) with h4 | h5 <;>
      simp_all <;> norm_num at hs
  have hblock (i) : b i = a11D7E6D7BlockScalar i := by
    rcases i with i | (i | (i | i))
    · exact (hA i).trans hvalues.1
    · exact (hD i).trans hvalues.2.1
    · exact (hE i).trans hvalues.2.2
    · exact i.elim
  intro i
  simpa only [b, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, e, a11D7E6D7Scalar] using hblock (e i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_marked_projection_on_basis
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_marked_projection_on_basis
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin 24,
      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ (Pi.single i 1)) (ψ (Pi.single j 1)) =
        ((adeGram a11D7E6Types).2 i j : ℚ))
    (hsep : ∀ i, (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2 = 0 ∨
      ((ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.1 = 0 ∧ (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).2 = 0)) :
    ∀ i, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ (Pi.single i 1))) =
      a11D7E6D7Scalar i • ψ (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, hbinary, ha, hsum⟩ := separated_coordinate_eigenvalues ψ hsep
  have hconst (i j) (hij : (adeGram a11D7E6Types).2 i j ≠ 0) : a i = a j := by
    apply middleProjection_eigenvalues_eq_of_pairing_ne_zero B C (ha i) (ha j)
    rw [hpair]
    exact_mod_cast hij
  have heq := a11D7E6_binary_scalar_of_sum_seven a hbinary hconst hsum
  intro i
  simpa only [heq] using ha i

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_marked_projection
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_marked_projection
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin 24,
      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ (Pi.single i 1)) (ψ (Pi.single j 1)) =
        ((adeGram a11D7E6Types).2 i j : ℚ))
    (hsep : ∀ i, (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2 = 0 ∨
      ((ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.1 = 0 ∧ (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).2 = 0)) :
    ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)
proof:
:= by
  let P := (middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (W := W) (U := U)).comp
    (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (W := W) (U := U))
  have heq : P.comp ψ.toLinearMap = ψ.toLinearMap.comp a11D7E6D7Projection := by
    apply (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 24)).ext
    intro i
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply]
    change middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ (Pi.single i 1))) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection (Pi.single i 1))
    rw [a11D7E6D7Projection_single, map_smul]
    exact a11D7E6_marked_projection_on_basis B C ψ hpair hsep i
  exact fun u => LinearMap.congr_fun heq u

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueBasis.normalForm_three
statement:
theorem GlueBasis.normalForm_three (S : GlueBasis B N 3)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N) :
    HasPrimaryNormalForm B N 3 2
proof:
:= by
  have hR : S.rank = 0 ∨ S.rank = 1 ∨ S.rank = 2 := by
    have := S.rank_le
    omega
  rcases hR with hR | hR | hR
  · apply Or.inl
    rcases S with ⟨rank, hle, vec, hmem, hspan, hortho, hdiag, hind⟩
    dsimp at hR
    subst rank
    simpa using hspan
  · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
    rcases S with ⟨rank, hle, vec, hmem, hspan, hortho, hdiag, hind⟩
    dsimp at hR
    subst rank
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmq⟩ := hdiag 0
    have heven : Even m := even_numerator_of_odd_multiple (by decide : Odd (3 : ℤ)) he
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 0)).2 hmq
    obtain ⟨r, k, hr, hk⟩ := norm_mod_two_three heven hm hmq
    exact ⟨vec 0, r, k, hr, by simpa only [range_fin_one_eq_singleton] using hspan, hk⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (S.normalized_binary_three hR hs hmax he))

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueBasis.normalForm_five
statement:
theorem GlueBasis.normalForm_five (S : GlueBasis B N 5)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N) :
    HasPrimaryNormalForm B N 5 4
proof:
:= by
  have hR : S.rank = 0 ∨ S.rank = 1 ∨ S.rank = 2 := by
    have := S.rank_le
    omega
  rcases hR with hR | hR | hR
  · apply Or.inl
    rcases S with ⟨rank, hle, vec, hmem, hspan, hortho, hdiag, hind⟩
    dsimp at hR
    subst rank
    simpa using hspan
  · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
    rcases S with ⟨rank, hle, vec, hmem, hspan, hortho, hdiag, hind⟩
    dsimp at hR
    subst rank
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmq⟩ := hdiag 0
    have hp : (5 : ℤ) • vec 0 ∈ N := (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 0)).2
    have heven : Even m := even_numerator_of_odd_multiple (by decide : Odd (5 : ℤ)) he hp hmq
    obtain ⟨a, r, k, ha, hr, hk⟩ := normalized_norm_five heven hm hmq
    have hsp : N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {a • vec 0} = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {vec 0} := by
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · simp
      · exact sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout (p := 5) (b := 3) (k := -1) hp (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨a • vec 0, r, k, hr, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsp]
      simpa only [range_fin_one_eq_singleton] using hspan
    · have heq : a • vec 0 = (a : ℚ) • vec 0 := by module
      rw [heq]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      nlinarith [hk]
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (S.normalized_binary_five hR hs hmax he))

name: SRG266.Lattice.orthogonal_basis_pair_expansion
statement:
theorem orthogonal_basis_pair_expansion {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (b : Module.Basis κ ℚ X)
    (hb : B.IsOrthoᵢ b) (hdiag : ∀ i, B (b i) (b i) ≠ 0) (x y : X) :
    B x y = ∑ i, B (b i) x * B (b i) y / B (b i) (b i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = B (∑ i, b.repr x i • b i) y := by rw [b.sum_repr]
    _ = ∑ i, b.repr x i * B (b i) y := by
      simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [orthogonal_basis_pair_repr B b hb x i]
      field_simp [hdiag i]

name: SRG266.Lattice.rational_frame_mass_eq_quadratic_defect
statement:
theorem rational_frame_mass_eq_quadratic_defect [FiniteDimensional ℚ X]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (hB : B.IsSymm)
    (hpos : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < B x x) (v : ι → X) (u w : X) (a p q r : ℚ)
    (hidentity : ∀ y, (∑ i, (B y (v i))^2) =
      a*B y y-(p*(B y u)^2+q*(B y w)^2+r*(B y u)*(B y w))) :
    (∑ i, B (v i) (v i)) =
      a*(Module.finrank ℚ X : ℚ)-(p*B u u+q*B w w+r*B u w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Invertible (2 : ℚ) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := LinearMap.BilinForm.exists_orthogonal_basis hB
  have hdiag (j) : B (b j) (b j) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hpos (b j) (b.ne_zero j))
  have hsum (j) :
      (∑ i, (B (b j) (v i))^2/B (b j) (b j)) =
        a-(p*((B (b j) u)^2/B (b j) (b j))+
          q*((B (b j) w)^2/B (b j) (b j))+
          r*(B (b j) u*B (b j) w/B (b j) (b j))) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, hidentity]
    field_simp [hdiag j]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => orthogonal_basis_norm_expansion B b hb hdiag (v i)),
    Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hsum j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    ← orthogonal_basis_norm_expansion B b hb hdiag u,
    ← orthogonal_basis_norm_expansion B b hb hdiag w,
    ← orthogonal_basis_pair_expansion B b hb hdiag u w]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.H6Coordinates.lattice_dual
statement:
theorem lattice_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice =
    lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {dualThree, dualFive}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hp : z ∈ (prodForm (simplexRatForm 5) rightForm).dualSubmodule
        ((coordinateIntegerLattice 5).prod (coordinateIntegerLattice 1)) :=
      fun w hw => hz w (Submodule.mem_sup_left hw)
    rw [dualSubmodule_prodForm] at hp
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hp
    rw [simplexRatForm_dual] at hx
    obtain ⟨nx, hnx, bw, hbw, heqx⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hbw
    have hy' := (mem_dual_smul_form_iff (B := standardRatForm 1)
      (N := coordinateIntegerLattice 1) (10 : ℚ) z.2).mp hy
    rw [standardRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice] at hy'
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mp hy'
    have hy0 : z.2 0 = (d 0 : ℚ) / 10 := by
      have h := hd 0
      change (d 0 : ℚ) = 10 * z.2 0 at h
      linarith
    have hn : (nx, (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)) ∈ lattice :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨hnx, (coordinateIntegerLattice 1).zero_mem⟩
    have hg : glueVector ∈ lattice := Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have hng := lattice_isIntegral hn glueVector hg
    have hzg := hz glueVector hg
    have hleft : simplexRatForm 5 (simplexWeight 5) ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) = 5 / 2 := by
      norm_num [simplexWeight_pair, simplexWeight, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have he : form z glueVector = form (nx, 0) glueVector +
        (b : ℚ) * (5 / 2) + (d 0 : ℚ) / 2 := by
      change simplexRatForm 5 z.1 ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) + rightForm z.2 (simplexWeight 1) = _
      rw [← heqx]
      have hb : b • simplexWeight 5 = (b : ℚ) • simplexWeight 5 := by module
      rw [hb]
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, hleft, form, prodForm_apply, glueVector, E6Coordinates.glueVector]
      norm_num [rightForm, standardRatForm_apply, simplexWeight, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hy0]
      ring
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hng
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hzg
    have hQ : (5 : ℚ) * b + d 0 = 2 * ((t : ℚ) - r) := by
      rw [he, ← hr] at ht
      linarith
    have hZ : 5 * b + d 0 = 2 * (t - r) := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    have hd' : (2 : ℤ) ∣ d 0 - 5 * b := by omega
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hd'
    have hdecomp : z = ((nx, (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)) + b • glueVector) +
        ((-b) • dualThree + l • dualFive) := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · change z.1 = (nx + b • ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5)) +
          ((-b) • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) + l • (0 : Fin 5 → ℚ))
        rw [← heqx]
        module
      · ext i
        fin_cases i
        have h : (d 0 : ℚ) - 5 * (b : ℚ) = 2 * (l : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
        norm_num [glueVector, E6Coordinates.glueVector, dualThree, E6Coordinates.dualVector,
          dualFive, fifth, simplexWeight, hy0, zsmul_eq_mul]
        linarith
    rw [hdecomp]
    refine Submodule.add_mem_sup (lattice.add_mem hn (lattice.smul_mem b hg)) ?_
    exact Submodule.add_mem _
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ (-b) (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ l (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
  · refine sup_le lattice_isIntegral (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    intro z hz
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz :
      z = dualThree ∨ z = dualFive) with rfl | rfl
    · exact dualThree_mem_dual
    · exact dualFive_mem_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_of_gramDivisibilityDescent
statement:
theorem mem_of_gramDivisibilityDescent
    {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℚ E]
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ E) (L : Submodule ℤ E)
    (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] E) (hmem : ∀ z, φ z ∈ L)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    (hpair : ∀ z w, F (φ z) (φ w) = (Matrix.toBilin' A z w : ℚ))
    {p : ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hd : GramDivisibilityDescent p A)
    (q : E) (z : ι → ℤ) (hz : φ z = (p : ℚ) • q)
    (hq : ∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, F (φ (Pi.single i 1)) q = (k : ℚ)) :
    q ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv (i : ι) : p ∣ (A *ᵥ z) i := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hq i
    have hi := hpair (Pi.single i 1) z
    have hrow : Matrix.toBilin' A (Pi.single i 1) z = (A *ᵥ z) i := by
      simp [Matrix.toBilin'_apply', dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, ite_mul]
    rw [hrow, hz, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hk] at hi
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    exact_mod_cast hi.symm
  choose w hw using hd z hdiv
  have hzw : z = p • w := by
    funext i
    exact hw i
  have hφ : (p : ℚ) • φ w = (p : ℚ) • q := by
    calc
      _ = φ (p • w) := by simp only [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, map_zsmul]
      _ = φ z := congrArg φ hzw.symm
      _ = _ := hz
  have heq : φ w = q :=
    smul_right_injective E (by exact_mod_cast hp : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0) hφ
  exact heq ▸ hmem w

name: SRG266.Lattice.int_zero_sum_norm_two_endpoints
statement:
theorem int_zero_sum_norm_two_endpoints {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = 0) (hnorm : intDot z z = 2) :
    ∃ p q : Fin n, p ≠ q ∧ z = Pi.single p 1-Pi.single q 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨p, q, hpq, sp, sq⟩, hr⟩ := DRoot.exists_vector_eq_of_intDot_self_eq_two z hnorm
  have hs : signedUnit sp+signedUnit sq = 0 := by
    rw [← DRoot.sum_vector (⟨p, q, hpq, sp, sq⟩ : DRoot n), hr]
    exact hsum
  cases sp <;> cases sq <;> norm_num [signedUnit] at hs
  · refine ⟨q, p, ne_of_gt hpq, ?_⟩
    rw [← hr]
    ext i
    by_cases hip : i = p
    · subst i
      simp [DRoot.vector, signedUnit, ne_of_lt hpq]
    · by_cases hiq : i = q
      · subst i
        simp [DRoot.vector, signedUnit, ne_of_gt hpq]
      · simp [DRoot.vector, hip, hiq]
  · refine ⟨p, q, ne_of_lt hpq, ?_⟩
    rw [← hr]
    ext i
    by_cases hip : i = p
    · subst i
      simp [DRoot.vector, signedUnit, ne_of_lt hpq]
    · by_cases hiq : i = q
      · subst i
        simp [DRoot.vector, signedUnit, ne_of_gt hpq]
      · simp [DRoot.vector, hip, hiq]

name: SRG266.Lattice.rational_zero_sum_root_endpoints
statement:
theorem rational_zero_sum_root_endpoints {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hx : x ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n)
    (hsum : (∑ i, x i) = 0) (hnorm : standardRatForm n x x = 2) :
    ∃ p q : Fin n, p ≠ q ∧ x = Pi.single p 1-Pi.single q 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  simp only [standardRatForm_apply, intCoordsToRat_apply] at hsum hnorm
  have hzsum : (∑ i, z i) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hznorm : intDot z z = 2 := by
    change (∑ i, z i*z i) = 2
    exact_mod_cast hnorm
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, hz⟩ := int_zero_sum_norm_two_endpoints z hzsum hznorm
  refine ⟨p, q, hpq, ?_⟩
  rw [hz]
  ext i
  simp [intCoordsToRat_apply, Pi.single_apply]

proof:
:= by

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanA_integer_root_endpoints
statement:
theorem cartanA_integer_root_endpoints (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hu : u ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n) (hnorm : cartanARatForm n u u = 2) :
    ∃ p q : Fin (n+1), p ≠ q ∧
      cartanAZeroSum n u = Pi.single p 1-Pi.single q 1
proof:

    (cartanAZeroSum_sum n u)

name: SRG266.Lattice.hasFDerivAt_radialExp
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_radialExp (q : ℂ) (w : V) :
    HasFDerivAt (radialExp q)
      (Complex.exp (q * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) •
        (q • (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (2 • innerSL ℝ w)))) w
proof:
:= by
  unfold radialExp
  apply HasFDerivAt.cexp
  apply HasFDerivAt.const_mul
  exact Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp w
    (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq w).hasFDerivAt

name: SRG266.Lattice.fderiv_radialExp_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_radialExp_apply (q : ℂ) (w x : V) :
    fderiv ℝ (radialExp q) w x =
      Complex.exp (q * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) * q * (2 * inner ℝ w x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_radialExp q w).fderiv]
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: SRG266.Lattice.hasFDerivAt_radialExpFirst
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_radialExpFirst (q : ℂ) (y w : V) :
    HasFDerivAt (radialExpFirst q y)
      (radialExp q w •
          (q • (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (2 • innerSL ℝ y))) +
        (q * ((2 * inner ℝ w y : ℝ) : ℂ)) •
          (Complex.exp (q * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) •
            (q • (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (2 • innerSL ℝ w))))) w
proof:
:= by
  unfold radialExpFirst
  have hlin : HasFDerivAt (fun z : V => q * (2 * inner ℝ z y : ℝ))
      (q • (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (2 • innerSL ℝ y))) w := by
    convert (q • (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp (2 • innerSL ℝ y))).hasFDerivAt using 1
    ext z
    simp [real_inner_comm]
  apply ((hasFDerivAt_radialExp q w).mul hlin).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards with z
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.fderiv_radialExpFirst_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_radialExpFirst_apply (q : ℂ) (y w x : V) :
    fderiv ℝ (radialExpFirst q y) w x =
      Complex.exp (q * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) *
        (4 * q ^ 2 * inner ℝ w x * inner ℝ w y +
          2 * q * inner ℝ x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_radialExpFirst q y w).fderiv]
  simp [radialExp, real_inner_comm]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.iteratedFDeriv_two_radialExp_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_two_radialExp_apply (q : ℂ) (w x y : V) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (radialExp q) w ![x, y] =
      Complex.exp (q * (‖w‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)) *
        (4 * q ^ 2 * inner ℝ w x * inner ℝ w y +
          2 * q * inner ℝ x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (radialExp q : V → ℂ) := by
    unfold radialExp
    have hnorm : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun w : V => ‖w‖ ^ 2) := contDiff_norm_sq ℝ
    exact Complex.contDiff_exp.comp
      (contDiff_const.mul (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hnorm))
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (radialExp q : V → ℂ)) w :=
    ((hsmooth.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by simp)).differentiable (by norm_num)) w
  have happ :
      fderiv ℝ (fun z : V => fderiv ℝ (radialExp q) z y) w x =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (radialExp q)) w x y := by
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hc (differentiableAt_const (c := y))]
    simp
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at *
  rw [← happ]
  have heq : (fun z : V => fderiv ℝ (radialExp q) z y) = radialExpFirst q y := by
    funext z
    simpa [radialExpFirst, radialExp] using fderiv_radialExp_apply q z y
  rw [heq, fderiv_radialExpFirst_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.span_eq_top_of_bilinear_moment
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_of_bilinear_moment (R : Finset X) (a b : ℚ)
    (hpd : ∀ x : X, x ≠ 0 → 0 < F x x) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hm : ∀ x y, a * (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) = b * F x y) :
    Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set X) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  let S := Submodule.span ℚ (R : Set X)
  let v : X := a • (∑ r ∈ R, F r x • r) - b • x
  have hv (y : X) : F v y = 0 := by
    simp only [v, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hm x y)
  have hv0 : v = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hp := hpd v hne
    rw [hv] at hp
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hp
  have heq : a • (∑ r ∈ R, F r x • r) = b • x := sub_eq_zero.mp hv0
  have hsum : (∑ r ∈ R, F r x • r) ∈ S := by
    exact S.sum_mem fun r hr => S.smul_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span hr)
  have hbx : b • x ∈ S := heq ▸ S.smul_mem a hsum
  have hx := S.smul_mem b⁻¹ hbx
  simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul] using hx

name: SRG266.Lattice.linearIndependent_sum_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_sum_of_orthogonal
    (B : X →ₗ[R] X →ₗ[R] R) (hself : ∀ x, B x x = 0 → x = 0)
    (r : ι → X) (s : κ → X) (hr : LinearIndependent R r) (hs : LinearIndependent R s)
    (horth : ∀ i j, B (r i) (s j) = 0) : LinearIndependent R (Sum.elim r s)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft (j) : Submodule.span R (Set.range r) ≤ (B.flip (s j)).ker :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact horth i j)
  have hright : Submodule.span R (Set.range s) ≤
      (Submodule.span R (Set.range r)).orthogonalBilin B :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact fun x hx => hleft j hx)
  exact hr.sum_type hs (Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
    (fun x hx hy => hself x (hright hy x hx)))

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_complement_A4_coordinates
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_complement_A4_coordinates
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (r : Fin 4 → U)
    (hr : ∀ i, ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, C (r i) (r j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ))
    (hE : ∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i)) = 0) :
    let s := fun i => a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i))
    (∀ i, s i ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 11) ∧
      (∀ i j, cartanARatForm 11 (s i) (s j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ i (g : W) (d : Fin 7 → ℚ), cartanARatForm 11 (s i)
        (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm ((g, d), (0 : U)))) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => a11D7E6A11Part_mem_integer (hr i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    have hp := a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero B C ψ hpair hmarked
      ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r j) rfl
    rw [hE i, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] at hp
    have h := hp.symm.trans (show prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C
      ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r j) = C (r i) (r j) by
        simp only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, zero_add])
    exact h.trans (hgram i j)
  · intro i g d
    have hp := a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero B C ψ hpair hmarked
      ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r i) ((g, d), (0 : U)) rfl
    rw [hE i, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] at hp
    simpa only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using hp.symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.normalized_frame_counts_energy
statement:
theorem normalized_frame_counts_energy {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → ℤ) (δ : ℤ) (u : ι → (Fin 11 → ℚ)) (v : ι → (Fin 6 → ℚ))
    (htype : ∀ i, A11E6NormalizedType (a i) δ (u i) (v i))
    (hA : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 9)).card = 55)
    (hB : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 1)).card = 165) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => v i = 0)).card = 55 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => v i ≠ 0)).card = 165 ∧
      (∑ i, cartanARatForm 11 (u i) (u i)) = 275 ∧ (∑ i, E6Cartan.form (v i) (v i)) = 220
proof:
:= by
  have hzero (i : ι) : (a i = 9 ↔ v i = 0) ∧ (a i = 1 ↔ v i ≠ 0) := by
    rcases htype i with ⟨ha, _, hv⟩ | ⟨ha, _, hn, _⟩
    · simp [ha, hv]
    · have hv : v i ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [h, map_zero] at hn
        norm_num at hn
      simp [ha, hv]
  have hnot (i : ι) : (¬a i = 9) ↔ a i = 1 := by
    rw [(hzero i).1, (hzero i).2]
  have hnormA (i : ι) : cartanARatForm 11 (u i) (u i) =
      if a i = 9 then 9/4 else 11/12 := by
    rcases htype i with ⟨ha, hn, _⟩ | ⟨ha, hn, _⟩ <;> simpa [ha] using hn
  have hnormE (i : ι) : E6Cartan.form (v i) (v i) =
      if a i = 9 then 0 else 4/3 := by
    rcases htype i with ⟨ha, _, hv⟩ | ⟨ha, _, hn, _⟩
    · simp [ha, hv]
    · simpa [ha] using hn
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [funext (fun i => propext (hzero i).1)] using hA
  · simpa only [funext (fun i => propext (hzero i).2)] using hB
  · simp only [hnormA, Finset.sum_ite, hnot, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hA, hB]
    norm_num
  · simp only [hnormE, Finset.sum_ite, hnot, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hA, hB]
    norm_num

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11E6_short_trivial_class
statement:
theorem a11E6_short_trivial_class (a m t : ℤ) (A E : ℚ)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha11 : a ≤ 11)
    (hmin : (a : ℚ)*(12-a)/12 ≤ A) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)
    (hA : A = 11*(a : ℚ)^2/12+2*(m : ℚ)) (hE : E = 2*(t : ℚ))
    (hsum : A+E = 9/4) :
    (a = 3 ∨ a = 9) ∧ A = 9/4 ∧ E = 0
proof:
:= by
  have heqn : 11*a^2+24*(m+t) = 27 := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (11 : ℚ)*(a : ℚ)^2+24*((m : ℚ)+(t : ℚ)) = 27 by linarith)
  have ha : a = 3 ∨ a = 9 := by
    interval_cases a <;> norm_num at heqn ⊢ <;> omega
  have hlow : 9/4 ≤ A := by
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hmin ⊢ <;> linarith
  exact ⟨ha, by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11E6_short_nontrivial_class
statement:
theorem a11E6_short_nontrivial_class (a m t : ℤ) (A E : ℚ)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha11 : a ≤ 11)
    (hmin : (a : ℚ)*(12-a)/12 ≤ A) (hEmin : 4/3 ≤ E)
    (hA : A = 11*(a : ℚ)^2/12+2*(m : ℚ)) (hE : E = 4/3+2*(t : ℚ))
    (hsum : A+E = 9/4) :
    (a = 1 ∨ a = 11) ∧ A = 11/12 ∧ E = 4/3
proof:
:= by
  have heqn : 11*a^2+24*(m+t) = 11 := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (11 : ℚ)*(a : ℚ)^2+24*((m : ℚ)+(t : ℚ)) = 11 by linarith)
  have hclasses : a = 1 ∨ a = 5 ∨ a = 7 ∨ a = 11 := by
    interval_cases a <;> norm_num at heqn ⊢ <;> omega
  have ha : a = 1 ∨ a = 11 := by
    rcases hclasses with h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · subst a; norm_num at hmin; linarith
    · subst a; norm_num at hmin; linarith
    · exact Or.inr h
  have hlow : 11/12 ≤ A := by
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hmin ⊢ <;> linarith
  exact ⟨ha, by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11E6_short_type_of_energy
statement:
theorem a11E6_short_type_of_energy
    (u : Fin 11 → ℚ) (v : Fin 6 → ℚ) (a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha11 : a ≤ 11)
    (hmin : (a : ℚ)*(12-a)/12 ≤ cartanARatForm 11 u u)
    (heq : cartanARatForm 11 u u = (a : ℚ)*(12-a)/12 ↔ ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1)
    (hA : ∃ m : ℤ, cartanARatForm 11 u u = 11*(a : ℚ)^2/12+2*(m : ℚ))
    (hdual : v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hE0 : 0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v)
    (hsum : cartanARatForm 11 u u+E6Cartan.form v v = 9/4) :
    (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧ A11E6ShortType a u v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hA
  rcases E6Cartan.dual_norm_dichotomy hdual hE0 with ⟨_, t, ht⟩ | ⟨_, hEmin, c, t, hc, hw, ht⟩
  · obtain ⟨ha, hAn, hEn⟩ := a11E6_short_trivial_class a m t _ _ ha0 ha11 hmin hE0 hm ht hsum
    refine ⟨heq.mp ?_, Or.inl ⟨ha, hAn, hEn⟩⟩
    rw [hAn]
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  · obtain ⟨ha, hAn, hEn⟩ := a11E6_short_nontrivial_class a m t _ _ ha0 ha11 hmin hEmin hm ht hsum
    refine ⟨heq.mp ?_, Or.inr ⟨ha, hAn, hEn, c, hc, hw⟩⟩
    rw [hAn]
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplex_pair_delete_last
statement:
theorem simplex_pair_delete_last (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin (n+1) → ℚ)
    (hx : (∑ i, x i) = 0) (hy : (∑ i, y i) = 0) :
    simplexRatForm n (fun i => x i.castSucc) (fun i => y i.castSucc) =
      standardRatForm (n+1) x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at hx hy
  rw [simplexRatForm_apply, standardRatForm_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hx' : (∑ i : Fin n, x i.castSucc) = -x (Fin.last n) := by linarith
  have hy' : (∑ i : Fin n, y i.castSucc) = -y (Fin.last n) := by linarith
  rw [hx', hy']
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexSimpleRoot_mem
statement:
theorem simplexSimpleRoot_mem (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    simplexSimpleRoot n i ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mpr
    ⟨fun j => (if j.castSucc = i.castSucc then 1 else 0) -
      (if j.castSucc = i.succ then 1 else 0), ?_⟩
  intro j
  simp [simplexSimpleRoot, aSimpleVector, Pi.single_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexSimpleRoot_gram
statement:
theorem simplexSimpleRoot_gram (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :
    simplexRatForm n (simplexSimpleRoot n i) (simplexSimpleRoot n j) =
      (gramA n i j : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (simplex_pair_delete_last n (aSimpleVector i) (aSimpleVector j)
    (aSimpleVector_sum i) (aSimpleVector_sum j)).trans (aSimpleVector_gram i j)

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_rankSixKind

  · exact ⟨.ternary, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨.fifteenPlus, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨.fifteenMinus, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨.seventyFive, rfl, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSixBase_isLattice

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSixBase_dual

    (rankSixForm k).dualSubmodule (rankSixBase k) =

proof:

  · exact H6Coordinates.matchingVector_dual
  · exact mixedPrimary_dual .four .four

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_rankSix
statement:
theorem complete_rankSix (k : RankSixKind)
    (S : PrimaryFamily B N .three k.threeShape) (T : PrimaryFamily B N .five k.fiveShape)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hl : IsLattice ℚ N) (hi : IsIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N)
    (hd : B.dualSubmodule N = torsionPart B N 3 ⊔ torsionPart B N 5) :
    IsLattice ℚ (rankSixCompletionLattice k S T) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B (rankSixForm k)) (rankSixCompletionLattice k S T) ∧
      (prodForm B (rankSixForm k)).dualSubmodule (rankSixCompletionLattice k S T) =
        rankSixCompletionLattice k S T
proof:
:= by
  cases k
  · exact complete_mixed_primary S T hs hl hi he hd
  · exact complete_h6 S T hs hl hi he hd
  · exact complete_mixed_primary S T hs hl hi he hd
  · exact complete_a4Q15 S T hs hl hi he hd

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSixCompletion_finrank

name: SRG266.Lattice.ADEType.rankSum_nil

name: SRG266.Lattice.ADEType.rankSum_cons

    rankSum (t :: ts) = t.rank + rankSum ts
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeEntry_symm
statement: theorem adeEntry_symm : ∀ (ts : List ADEType) (i j : ℕ), adeEntry ts i j = adeEntry ts j i
proof:
| [], _, _ => rfl
  | t :: ts, i, j => by
      by_cases h₁ : i < t.rank ∧ j < t.rank
      · have h₁' : j < t.rank ∧ i < t.rank := ⟨h₁.2, h₁.1⟩
        simp only [adeEntry, if_pos h₁, if_pos h₁']
        exact t.gramEntry_symm i j
      · have h₁' : ¬ (j < t.rank ∧ i < t.rank) := fun h => h₁ ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
        by_cases h₂ : t.rank ≤ i ∧ t.rank ≤ j
        · have h₂' : t.rank ≤ j ∧ t.rank ≤ i := ⟨h₂.2, h₂.1⟩
          simp only [adeEntry, if_neg h₁, if_neg h₁', if_pos h₂, if_pos h₂']
          exact adeEntry_symm ts (i - t.rank) (j - t.rank)
        · have h₂' : ¬ (t.rank ≤ j ∧ t.rank ≤ i) := fun h => h₂ ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
          simp only [adeEntry, if_neg h₁, if_neg h₁', if_neg h₂, if_neg h₂']

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeGram_isSymm

proof:

  exact adeEntry_symm ts j.1 i.1

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeEntry_singleton

proof:

  have h : i < t.rank ∧ j < t.rank := ⟨hi, hj⟩
  simp only [adeEntry, if_pos h]

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSix_has_A5_chain
statement:
theorem rankSix_has_A5_chain (k : RankSixKind) (hk : k = .ternary ∨ k = .fifteenPlus) :
    ∃ r : Fin 5 → rankSixSpace k, (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA 5 i j : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with rfl | rfl
  · refine ⟨fun i => ((simplexSimpleRoot 5 i, 0), 0), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨simplexSimpleRoot_mem 5 i,
        (coordinateIntegerLattice 1).zero_mem⟩, (coordinateIntegerLattice 0).zero_mem⟩
    · intro i j
      simpa only [rankSixForm, mixedPrimaryForm, primaryModelForm, E6Coordinates.form,
        prodForm_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using simplexSimpleRoot_gram 5 i j
  · refine ⟨fun i => (simplexSimpleRoot 5 i, 0), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨simplexSimpleRoot_mem 5 i,
        (coordinateIntegerLattice 1).zero_mem⟩
    · intro i j
      simpa only [rankSixForm, H6Coordinates.form, prodForm_apply, map_zero,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using simplexSimpleRoot_gram 5 i j

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSix_has_large_A_chain
statement:
theorem rankSix_has_large_A_chain (k : RankSixKind) (hk : k ≠ .seventyFive) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (n = 0 ∨ n = 1) ∧ ∃ r : Fin (4+n) → rankSixSpace k,
      (∀ i, r i ∈ rankSixBase k) ∧
      (∀ i j, rankSixForm k (r i) (r j) = (gramA (4+n) i j : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  cases k
  · refine ⟨1, Or.inr rfl, fun i => ((simplexSimpleRoot 5 i, 0), 0), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨simplexSimpleRoot_mem 5 i,
        (coordinateIntegerLattice 1).zero_mem⟩, (coordinateIntegerLattice 0).zero_mem⟩
    · intro i j
      simpa only [rankSixForm, mixedPrimaryForm, primaryModelForm, E6Coordinates.form,
        prodForm_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using simplexSimpleRoot_gram 5 i j
  · refine ⟨1, Or.inr rfl, fun i => (simplexSimpleRoot 5 i, 0), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨simplexSimpleRoot_mem 5 i,
        (coordinateIntegerLattice 1).zero_mem⟩
    · intro i j
      simpa only [rankSixForm, H6Coordinates.form, prodForm_apply, map_zero,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using simplexSimpleRoot_gram 5 i j
  · refine ⟨0, Or.inl rfl, fun i => (0, simplexSimpleRoot 4 i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(coordinateIntegerLattice 2).zero_mem, simplexSimpleRoot_mem 4 i⟩
    · intro i j
      simpa only [rankSixForm, mixedPrimaryForm, primaryModelForm, prodForm_apply,
        map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add] using simplexSimpleRoot_gram 4 i j
  · exact (hk rfl).elim

name: SRG266.Lattice.constant_of_successive_eq
statement:
theorem constant_of_successive_eq {K : Type*} {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → K)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, a i.castSucc = a i.succ) : ∀ i, a i = a 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.induction with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih => exact (h i).symm.trans ih

name: SRG266.Lattice.constant_of_path_and_leaf
statement:
theorem constant_of_path_and_leaf {K : Type*} {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 2) → K)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, a i.castSucc.castSucc = a i.succ.castSucc)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) (hj : a (Fin.last (n + 1)) = a j.castSucc) :
    ∀ i, a i = a 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := constant_of_successive_eq (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => a i.castSucc) h
  intro i
  exact Fin.lastCases (hj.trans (hc j)) (fun k => hc k) i

name: SRG266.Lattice.gramA_scalar_constant
statement:
theorem gramA_scalar_constant {K : Type*} (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1) → K)
    (h : ∀ i j, gramA (n + 1) i j ≠ 0 → a i = a j) :
    ∀ i, a i = a 0
proof:
:= by
  apply constant_of_successive_eq
  intro i
  apply h
  simp [gramA, gramAEntry]

name: SRG266.Lattice.gramD_scalar_constant
statement:
theorem gramD_scalar_constant {K : Type*} (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 4) → K)
    (h : ∀ i j, gramD (n + 4) i j ≠ 0 → a i = a j) :
    ∀ i, a i = a 0
proof:
:= by
  refine constant_of_path_and_leaf a ?_ (⟨n + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 3)) ?_
  · intro i
    apply h
    simp [gramD, gramDEntry]
    omega
  · apply h
    simp [gramD, gramDEntry]

name: SRG266.Lattice.gramE_scalar_constant
statement:
theorem gramE_scalar_constant {K : Type*} (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 4) → K)
    (h : ∀ i j, gramE (n + 4) i j ≠ 0 → a i = a j) :
    ∀ i, a i = a 0
proof:
:= by
  refine constant_of_path_and_leaf a ?_ (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 3)) ?_
  · intro i
    apply h
    simp [gramE, gramEEntry]
    omega
  · apply h
    simp [gramE, gramEEntry]

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinate_root_pair
statement:
theorem coordinate_root_pair {n : ℕ} (p q : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℚ) :
    standardRatForm n (Pi.single p 1-Pi.single q 1) x = x p-x q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [standardRatForm_apply, Pi.single_apply, ite_mul]

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinate_root_pair_one
statement:
theorem coordinate_root_pair_one {n : ℕ} (p q r s : Fin n)
    (h : standardRatForm n (Pi.single p 1-Pi.single q 1)
      (Pi.single r 1-Pi.single s 1) = 1) :
    (p = r ∧ q ≠ s) ∨ (q = s ∧ p ≠ r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinate_root_pair] at h
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.single_apply] at h
  split_ifs at h <;> norm_num at h <;> aesop

name: SRG266.Lattice.pairwise_endpoints_star
statement:
theorem pairwise_endpoints_star {ι κ : Type*} (p q : ι → κ) (a b : ι)
    (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hpq : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (p i = p j ∧ q i ≠ q j) ∨ (q i = q j ∧ p i ≠ p j)) :
    ((∀ i, p i = p a) ∧ Function.Injective q) ∨
      ((∀ i, q i = q a) ∧ Function.Injective p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have common (p q : ι → κ)
      (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (p i = p j ∧ q i ≠ q j) ∨
        (q i = q j ∧ p i ≠ p j))
      (hp : p a = p b) (hq : q a ≠ q b) :
      (∀ i, p i = p a) ∧ Function.Injective q := by
    have hall (i : ι) : p i = p a := by
      by_contra hi
      have hia : i ≠ a := fun h => hi (congrArg p h)
      have hib : i ≠ b := fun h => hi ((congrArg p h).trans hp.symm)
      have hqa : q i = q a := (hpair i a hia).resolve_left (fun h => hi h.1) |>.1
      have hqb : q i = q b := (hpair i b hib).resolve_left
        (fun h => hi (h.1.trans hp.symm)) |>.1
      exact hq (hqa.symm.trans hqb)
    refine ⟨hall, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    rcases hpair i j hne with h | h
    · exact h.2 hij
    · exact h.2 ((hall i).trans (hall j).symm)
  rcases hpq a b hab with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (common p q hpq h.1 h.2)
  · exact Or.inr (common q p (fun i j hij => (hpq i j hij).symm) h.1 h.2)

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinate_root_star_equal_coordinates
statement:
theorem coordinate_root_star_equal_coordinates {m n : ℕ}
    (p q : Fin m → Fin n) (a b : Fin m) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hne : ∀ i, p i ≠ q i)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → standardRatForm n
      (Pi.single (p i) 1-Pi.single (q i) 1)
      (Pi.single (p j) 1-Pi.single (q j) 1) = 1) :
    ∃ f : Fin (m+1) ↪ Fin n, ∀ x : Fin n → ℚ,
      (∀ i, standardRatForm n (Pi.single (p i) 1-Pi.single (q i) 1) x = 0) →
      ∀ j, x (f j) = x (f 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have build (p q : Fin m → Fin n) (hneq : ∀ i, p i ≠ q i)
      (hp : ∀ i, p i = p a) (hq : Function.Injective q) :
      ∃ f : Fin (m+1) ↪ Fin n, ∀ x : Fin n → ℚ,
        (∀ i, x (p i) = x (q i)) → ∀ j, x (f j) = x (f 0) := by
    have hout : p a ∉ Set.range q := by
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact hneq i ((hp i).trans hi.symm)
    refine ⟨⟨Fin.cons (p a) q, Fin.cons_injective_of_injective hout hq⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · rfl
    · change x (q i) = x (p a)
      rw [← hx i, hp i]
  have hstar := pairwise_endpoints_star p q a b hab
    (fun i j hij => coordinate_root_pair_one _ _ _ _ (hpair i j hij))
  rcases hstar with ⟨hp, hq⟩ | ⟨hq, hp⟩
  · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := build p q hne hp hq
    refine ⟨f, fun x hx => hf x (fun i => ?_)⟩
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((coordinate_root_pair _ _ _).symm.trans (hx i))
  · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := build q p (fun i => (hne i).symm) hq hp
    refine ⟨f, fun x hx => hf x (fun i => ?_)⟩
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp ((coordinate_root_pair _ _ _).symm.trans (hx i))).symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.j_ne_zero
statement: theorem DRoot.j_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (r : DRoot (n + 1)) : r.j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hj
  have h := r.lt
  simp [hj] at h

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.coordinate_zero_sq
statement:
theorem DRoot.coordinate_zero_sq {n : ℕ} (r : DRoot (n + 1)) :
    (r.vector 0) ^ 2 = if r.i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : r.i = 0
  · simp [DRoot.vector, hi, pow_two]
  · simp [DRoot.vector, Ne.symm hi, Ne.symm r.j_ne_zero, hi]

name: SRG266.Lattice.dRoot_coordinate_zero_secondMoment
statement:
theorem dRoot_coordinate_zero_secondMoment (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ r : DRoot (n + 1), (r.vector 0) ^ 2) = 4 * (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (Fintype.card {r : DRoot (n + 1) // r.i = 0} : ℤ) := by
      simp only [DRoot.coordinate_zero_sq, Finset.sum_boole, Fintype.card_subtype]
    _ = 4 * (n : ℤ) := by
      rw [Fintype.card_congr (DRoot.zeroCoordinateEquiv n)]
      simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_mul,
        Nat.cast_ofNat]
      omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_norm_four_E6_values
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_norm_four_E6_values
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (hint : IsIntegral (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C) L)
    (hpos : ∀ r, 0 ≤ prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r)
    (r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) (hr : r ∈ L)
    (hnorm : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r = 4) (hrD : r.1.2 = 0) :
    let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
    E6Cartan.form v v = 0 ∨ E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3 ∨
      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 ∨ E6Cartan.form v v = 4
proof:
:= by
  apply a11E6_norm_four_E6_values (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)) _
  · exact a11D7E6_A11_simple_pair_integral _ L ψ hpair hmem hint hr
  · exact a11D7E6_E6_dual _ L ψ hpair hmem hint hr
  · exact a11D7E6_E6_nonneg _ ψ hpair hpos r
  · exact (a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero B C ψ hpair hmarked r r hrD).symm.trans hnorm

name: SRG266.Lattice.prod_sup_span_ranges
statement:
theorem prod_sup_span_ranges {ι κ : Type*} (N : Submodule ℤ W) (M : Submodule ℤ U)
    (u : ι → W) (v : κ → U) :
    (N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range u)).prod (M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v)) =
      N.prod M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
        (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => (u i, (0 : U))) (fun j => ((0 : W), v j))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.Sum.elim_range, Submodule.span_union]
  simp only [LinearMap.prod_eq_sup_map, Submodule.map_sup, Submodule.map_span,
    ← Set.range_comp]
  ac_rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimary_dual
statement:
theorem mixedPrimary_dual (s t : PrimaryShape) :
    (mixedPrimaryForm s t).dualSubmodule (mixedPrimaryBase s t) =
      mixedPrimaryBase s t ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (mixedPrimaryVector s t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixedPrimaryForm, mixedPrimaryBase, dualSubmodule_prodForm,
    primaryModel_dual, primaryModel_dual]
  exact prod_sup_span_ranges _ _ _ _

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimary_cross
statement:
theorem mixedPrimary_cross (s t : PrimaryShape) (i j : Fin s.arity ⊕ Fin t.arity) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    mixedPrimaryForm s t (mixedPrimaryVector s t i) (mixedPrimaryVector s t j) ∈
      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
  · simpa [mixedPrimaryForm, mixedPrimaryVector, prodForm_apply] using
      primaryModel_cross .three s i j (fun h => hij (congrArg Sum.inl h))
  · simp [mixedPrimaryForm, mixedPrimaryVector, prodForm_apply]
  · simp [mixedPrimaryForm, mixedPrimaryVector, prodForm_apply]
  · simpa [mixedPrimaryForm, mixedPrimaryVector, prodForm_apply] using
      primaryModel_cross .five t i j (fun h => hij (congrArg Sum.inr h))

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimary_period
statement:
theorem mixedPrimary_period (s t : PrimaryShape) (i : Fin s.arity ⊕ Fin t.arity) :
    mixedPrimaryPeriod s t i • mixedPrimaryVector s t i ∈ mixedPrimaryBase s t
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with i | i
  · exact ⟨primaryModel_period .three s i, by simp [mixedPrimaryVector, mixedPrimaryPeriod]⟩
  · exact ⟨by simp [mixedPrimaryVector, mixedPrimaryPeriod], primaryModel_period .five t i⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimary_finrank
statement:
theorem mixedPrimary_finrank (s t : PrimaryShape) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (mixedPrimarySpace s t) = primaryModelRank .three s + primaryModelRank .five t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_prod, primaryModel_finrank, primaryModel_finrank]

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimarySource_dual
statement:
theorem mixedPrimarySource_dual (S : PrimaryFamily B N .three s) (T : PrimaryFamily B N .five t)
    (h : B.dualSubmodule N = torsionPart B N 3 ⊔ torsionPart B N 5) :
    B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (mixedPrimarySource S T))
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, mixedPrimarySource, Set.Sum.elim_range, Submodule.span_union]
  rw [show torsionPart B N 3 = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range S.vec) from S.spans,
    show torsionPart B N 5 = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range T.vec) from T.spans]
  simp only [sup_assoc, sup_left_comm, sup_left_idem]

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimarySource_cross
statement:
theorem mixedPrimarySource_cross (S : PrimaryFamily B N .three s) (T : PrimaryFamily B N .five t)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (i j : Fin s.arity ⊕ Fin t.arity) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    B (mixedPrimarySource S T i) (mixedPrimarySource S T j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : IsCoprime (3 : ℤ) (5 : ℤ) := ⟨2, -1, by norm_num⟩
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
  · exact S.cross i j (fun h => hij (congrArg Sum.inl h))
  · exact inner_mem_one_of_coprime hs hcop (mem_torsionPart.mp (S.mem i)).1
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (S.mem i)).2 (mem_torsionPart.mp (T.mem j)).1
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (T.mem j)).2
  · exact inner_mem_one_of_coprime hs hcop.symm (mem_torsionPart.mp (T.mem i)).1
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (T.mem i)).2 (mem_torsionPart.mp (S.mem j)).1
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (S.mem j)).2
  · exact T.cross i j (fun h => hij (congrArg Sum.inr h))

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_mixed_primary
statement:
theorem complete_mixed_primary (S : PrimaryFamily B N .three s) (T : PrimaryFamily B N .five t)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hl : IsLattice ℚ N) (hi : IsIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N)
    (hd : B.dualSubmodule N = torsionPart B N 3 ⊔ torsionPart B N 5) :
    IsLattice ℚ (mixedPrimaryLattice S T) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B (mixedPrimaryForm s t)) (mixedPrimaryLattice S T) ∧
      (prodForm B (mixedPrimaryForm s t)).dualSubmodule (mixedPrimaryLattice S T) =
        mixedPrimaryLattice S T
proof:
:= by
  refine complete_even_glue (mixedPrimarySource S T) (mixedPrimaryVector s t) (mixedPrimaryPeriod s t)
    hs (prodForm_isSymm (primaryModel_isSymm .three s) (primaryModel_isSymm .five t))
    hl (isLattice_prod (primaryModel_isLattice .three s) (primaryModel_isLattice .five t))
    hi (isIntegral_prod (primaryModel_isIntegral .three s) (primaryModel_isIntegral .five t))
    he (isEven_prod (primaryModel_isEven .three s) (primaryModel_isEven .five t))
    (mixedPrimarySource_dual S T hd) (mixedPrimary_dual s t) (mixedPrimary_period s t)
    (mixedPrimarySource_cross S T hs) (mixedPrimary_cross s t) ?_ ?_
  · rintro (i | i)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := S.norm i
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := primaryModel_matched_norm .three s i
      refine ⟨k + l, ?_⟩
      simp only [mixedPrimarySource, mixedPrimaryVector, Sum.elim_inl, mixedPrimaryForm,
        prodForm_apply, map_zero, add_zero]
      rw [hk]
      push_cast
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := T.norm i
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := primaryModel_matched_norm .five t i
      refine ⟨k + l, ?_⟩
      simp only [mixedPrimarySource, mixedPrimaryVector, Sum.elim_inr, mixedPrimaryForm,
        prodForm_apply, map_zero, zero_add]
      rw [hk]
      push_cast
      linarith
  · rintro (i | i) a ha
    · exact S.unit i a ha
    · exact T.unit i a ha

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimaryLattice_posDef
statement:
theorem mixedPrimaryLattice_posDef (hpd : ∀ x : W, x ≠ 0 → 0 < B x x) :
    ∀ z : W × mixedPrimarySpace s t, z ≠ 0 → 0 < prodForm B (mixedPrimaryForm s t) z z
proof:
:=
  prodForm_posDef hpd (prodForm_posDef (primaryModel_posDef .three s) (primaryModel_posDef .five t))

name: SRG266.Lattice.mixedPrimaryLattice_finrank
statement:
theorem mixedPrimaryLattice_finrank [Module.Finite ℚ W] :

      Module.finrank ℚ W + primaryModelRank .three s + primaryModelRank .five t

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_mixedPrimaryLattice_left
statement:
