name: SRG266.Lattice.dvd_discNum_of_mem
statement:
theorem dvd_discNum_of_mem {y y' : W} (hy : y ∈ B.dualSubmodule Ñ) (hy' : y' ∈ Ñ) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ discNum B p y y'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (hy _ hy')
  exact ⟨n, discNum_eq_of_cast (by rw [← hn]; push_cast; ring)⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_one_of_dvd_discNum
statement:
theorem mem_one_of_dvd_discNum (hp : p ≠ 0) {y y' : W} (hy : y ∈ B.dualSubmodule Ñ)
    (hy' : (p : ℤ) • y' ∈ Ñ) (h : (p : ℤ) ∣ discNum B p y y') :
    B y y' ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  have hc := discNum_cast hy hy'
  rw [hm] at hc
  push_cast at hc
  have hp0 : ((p : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp
  exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨m, mul_left_cancel₀ hp0 hc⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.discGroup_nsmul_eq_zero
statement: theorem discGroup_nsmul_eq_zero (q : discGroup B Ñ p) : p • q = 0
proof:
:=
  quotient_nsmul_eq_zero (fun _ hy => (mem_torsionPart.mp hy).2) q

name: SRG266.Lattice.torsion_mem_dual
statement: theorem torsion_mem_dual (y : torsionPart B Ñ p) : (y : W) ∈ B.dualSubmodule Ñ
proof:
:=
  (mem_torsionPart.mp y.2).1

name: SRG266.Lattice.torsion_zsmul_mem
statement: theorem torsion_zsmul_mem (y : torsionPart B Ñ p) : (p : ℤ) • (y : W) ∈ Ñ
proof:
:=
  (mem_torsionPart.mp y.2).2

name: SRG266.Lattice.discGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem discGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff {y : torsionPart B Ñ p} :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk y : discGroup B Ñ p) = 0 ↔ (y : W) ∈ Ñ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.discGroup_finite
statement:
theorem discGroup_finite (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) (hN : IsLattice ℚ Ñ) :
    Module.Finite (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDfg : (B.dualSubmodule Ñ).FG := (dual_isLattice B hN hnd).fg
  have : IsNoetherian ℤ (B.dualSubmodule Ñ) :=
    isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian _ hDfg
  have hle : torsionPart B Ñ p ≤ B.dualSubmodule Ñ := torsionPart_le_dual Ñ p
  have hTfg : (torsionPart B Ñ p).FG := by
    have hcomap := IsNoetherian.noetherian
      ((torsionPart B Ñ p).comap (B.dualSubmodule Ñ).subtype)
    have hmap := hcomap.map (B.dualSubmodule Ñ).subtype
    rwa [Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.mpr hle] at hmap
  have : Module.Finite ℤ (torsionPart B Ñ p) := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hTfg
  have : Module.Finite ℤ (discGroup B Ñ p) := Module.Finite.quotient ℤ _
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := ℤ) (M := discGroup B Ñ p)
  refine ⟨⟨S, ?_⟩⟩
  refine top_unique fun q _ => ?_
  have hq : q ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (S : Set (discGroup B Ñ p)) := by
    rw [hS]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hq
  · exact fun y hy => Submodule.subset_span hy
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · exact fun y z _ _ hy hz => Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
  · intro a y _ hy
    rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (ZMod p) a y]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: SRG266.Lattice.torsionBilin_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem torsionBilin_apply (y y' : torsionPart B Ñ p) :
    torsionBilin B Ñ p y y' = ((discNum B p (y : W) (y' : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.torsionBilin_ker_right
statement:
theorem torsionBilin_ker_right (y : torsionPart B Ñ p) :
    Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype ≤ LinearMap.ker (torsionBilin B Ñ p y)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hzÑ : (z : W) ∈ Ñ := hz
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, torsionBilin_apply]
  exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mpr
    (dvd_discNum_of_mem (torsion_mem_dual y) hzÑ)

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairingRight_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem discPairingRight_mk (y y' : torsionPart B Ñ p) :
    discPairingRight B Ñ p y (Submodule.Quotient.mk y') =
      ((discNum B p (y : W) (y' : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairingAux_ker
statement:
theorem discPairingAux_ker (hsymm : B.IsSymm) :
    Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype ≤ LinearMap.ker (discPairingAux B Ñ p)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hzÑ : (z : W) ∈ Ñ := hz
  refine LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (LinearMap.ext fun d => ?_)
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ d
  show ((discNum B p (z : W) (y' : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 0
  rw [discNum_symm hsymm]
  exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mpr
    (dvd_discNum_of_mem (torsion_mem_dual y') hzÑ)

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairingInt_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem discPairingInt_mk (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (y y' : torsionPart B Ñ p) :
    discPairingInt B Ñ p hsymm (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y') =
      ((discNum B p (y : W) (y' : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairing_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem discPairing_mk (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (y y' : torsionPart B Ñ p) :
    discPairing B Ñ p hsymm (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y') =
      ((discNum B p (y : W) (y' : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p)
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairing_isSymm
statement: theorem discPairing_isSymm (hsymm : B.IsSymm) : (discPairing B Ñ p hsymm).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun d d' => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ d
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ d'
  rw [discPairing_mk, discPairing_mk, discNum_symm hsymm]

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairing_separatingLeft
statement:
theorem discPairing_separatingLeft (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (hnd : B.Nondegenerate)
    (hN : IsLattice ℚ Ñ) (hp : p ≠ 0) {q : ℕ} (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (hsplit : B.dualSubmodule Ñ = torsionPart B Ñ p ⊔ torsionPart B Ñ q) :
    (discPairing B Ñ p hsymm).SeparatingLeft
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ d
  rw [discGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff]
  have hyd : (y : W) ∈ B.dualSubmodule Ñ := torsion_mem_dual y
  have hcop : IsCoprime ((p : ℤ)) ((q : ℤ)) :=
    Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr (by simpa using hpq)

  have hTp : ∀ z ∈ torsionPart B Ñ p, B (y : W) z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz0 := hd (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨z, hz⟩)
    rw [discPairing_mk] at hz0
    exact mem_one_of_dvd_discNum hp hyd (mem_torsionPart.mp hz).2
      ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp hz0)

  have hTq : ∀ z ∈ torsionPart B Ñ q, B (y : W) z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzd : z ∈ B.dualSubmodule Ñ := (mem_torsionPart.mp hz).1
    have hqz : (q : ℤ) • z ∈ Ñ := (mem_torsionPart.mp hz).2
    have hpy : (p : ℤ) • (y : W) ∈ Ñ := torsion_zsmul_mem y
    have hp' : ((p : ℚ)) * B (y : W) z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
      have h := hzd _ hpy
      rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul] at h
      push_cast at h
      rwa [hsymm.eq z (y : W)] at h
    have hq' : ((q : ℚ)) * B (y : W) z ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
      have h := hyd _ hqz
      rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul] at h
      push_cast at h
      exact h
    exact mem_one_of_coprime hcop (by exact_mod_cast hp') (by exact_mod_cast hq')

  have hdd : (y : W) ∈ B.dualSubmodule (B.dualSubmodule Ñ) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hsplit] at hz
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, z₂, hz₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
    rw [map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hTp z₁ hz₁) (hTq z₂ hz₂)
  rwa [dual_dual B hN hnd hsymm] at hdd

name: SRG266.Lattice.discPairing_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem discPairing_nondegenerate (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (hnd : B.Nondegenerate)
    (hN : IsLattice ℚ Ñ) (hp : p ≠ 0) {q : ℕ} (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (hsplit : B.dualSubmodule Ñ = torsionPart B Ñ p ⊔ torsionPart B Ñ q) :
    (discPairing B Ñ p hsymm).Nondegenerate
proof:
:=
  ((discPairing_isSymm hsymm).isRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft).mpr
    (discPairing_separatingLeft hsymm hnd hN hp hpq hsplit)

name: SRG266.Lattice.bilin_sum_sum
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ w : W, B w (∑ j, a j • y j) = ∑ j, ((a j : ℤ) : ℚ) * B w (y j) := by
    intro w
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  have key₂ : ∀ w : W, B (∑ i, a i • y i) w = ∑ i, ((a i : ℤ) : ℚ) * B (y i) w := by
    intro w
    rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
      rw [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [key]
  simp_rw [key₂, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.disc_dim_le_two
statement:
theorem disc_dim_le_two [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hsymm : B.IsSymm) (hnd : B.Nondegenerate)
    (hN : IsLattice ℚ Ñ) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B Ñ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : NeZero p := ⟨hp.out.pos.ne'⟩
  have : Module.Finite (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p) := discGroup_finite hnd hN
  by_contra hcon

  have h3 : 3 ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p) := Nat.lt_of_not_le hcon
  set b := Module.finBasis (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p) with hb
  set f : Fin 3 → Fin (Module.finrank (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p)) :=
    fun i => ⟨i.1, lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 h3⟩ with hf
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val hij
    exact Fin.ext hval
  have hv : LinearIndependent (ZMod p) (fun i => b (f i)) :=
    b.linearIndependent.comp f hfinj

  choose y hy using fun i : Fin 3 => Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype) (b (f i))
  set c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod p :=
    fun i j => ((discNum B p (y i : W) (y j : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p) with hc

  set Q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p) :=
    ∑ i, ∑ j, MvPolynomial.C (c i j) * MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j with hQ
  have hdeg : Q.totalDegree < Fintype.card (Fin 3) := by
    have h2 : Q.totalDegree ≤ 2 := by
      refine MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le fun i _ => ?_
      refine MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le fun j _ => ?_
      refine le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
      have h1 : (MvPolynomial.C (c i j) * MvPolynomial.X i).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
        refine le_trans (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
        simp [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C, MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X]
      have h2 : (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
        simp [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X]
      omega
    simpa using Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h2 (by norm_num)
  have heval : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ZMod p,
      MvPolynomial.eval x Q = ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j * x i * x j := by
    intro x
    simp [hQ]
  have hzero : MvPolynomial.eval (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod p) Q = 0 := by
    rw [heval]
    simp
  have hcw := char_dvd_card_solutions (K := ZMod p) (σ := Fin 3) p hdeg
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card { x : Fin 3 → ZMod p // MvPolynomial.eval x Q = 0 } :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨⟨0, hzero⟩⟩
  have hcard : 1 < Fintype.card { x : Fin 3 → ZMod p // MvPolynomial.eval x Q = 0 } := by
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd hpos hcw
    have := hp.out.two_le
    omega
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxne⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card hcard ⟨0, hzero⟩
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hxne (Subtype.ext h)

  choose a ha using fun i : Fin 3 => ZMod.intCast_surjective (n := p) (x i)
  set z : torsionPart B Ñ p := ∑ i, a i • y i with hz
  have hzcoe : (z : W) = ∑ i, a i • (y i : W) := by
    rw [hz]
    push_cast
    rfl

  have hznot : (z : W) ∉ Ñ := by
    intro hmem
    have hmk : (Submodule.Quotient.mk z : discGroup B Ñ p) = 0 :=
      discGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff.mpr hmem
    have hsum : ∑ i, x i • b (f i) = 0 := by
      have hexp : (Submodule.Quotient.mk z : discGroup B Ñ p) = ∑ i, x i • b (f i) := by
        have hmkq : (Submodule.Quotient.mk z : discGroup B Ñ p) =
            (Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype).mkQ z := rfl
        rw [hmkq, hz, map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [map_smul]
        show a i • (Submodule.Quotient.mk (y i) : discGroup B Ñ p) = x i • b (f i)
        rw [hy i, ← ha i, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      rw [hexp] at hmk
      exact hmk
    have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hv x hsum
    exact hx0 (funext this)

  have hzz : B (z : W) (z : W) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    set N : ℤ := ∑ i, ∑ j, a i * a j * discNum B p (y i : W) (y j : W) with hN'
    have hNcast : ((N : ℤ) : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * B (z : W) (z : W) := by
      rw [hzcoe, bilin_sum_sum, hN']
      push_cast
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [discNum_cast (torsion_mem_dual (y i)) (torsion_zsmul_mem (y j))]
      ring
    have hx' : ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j * x i * x j = 0 := by rw [← heval x]; exact hx
    have hNdvd : (p : ℤ) ∣ N := by
      refine (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp ?_
      rw [hN']
      push_cast
      calc (∑ i, ∑ j, ((a i : ZMod p)) * ((a j : ZMod p)) *
              ((discNum B p (y i : W) (y j : W) : ℤ) : ZMod p))
          = ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j * x i * x j := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
            rw [hc, ha i, ha j]
            ring
        _ = 0 := hx'
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hNdvd
    have hp0 : ((p : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne p)
    refine mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have : ((p : ℚ)) * (k : ℚ) = (p : ℚ) * B (z : W) (z : W) := by
      rw [← hNcast, hk]
      push_cast
      ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hp0 this
  have hzv : ∀ v ∈ Ñ, B (z : W) v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := fun v hv => torsion_mem_dual z v hv
  have hsup := hmax.maximal (Ñ ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {(z : W)}) le_sup_left
    (isIntegral_sup_span_singleton B hsymm hmax.integral hzv hzz)
  have hmem : (z : W) ∈ Ñ ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {(z : W)} :=
    Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  rw [hsup] at hmem
  exact hznot hmem

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueBasis.exists_unit_diag
statement:
theorem GlueBasis.exists_unit_diag [Fact p.Prime] (S : GlueBasis B Ñ p) (i : Fin S.rank) :
    ∃ (u : (ZMod p)ˣ) (m : ℤ), ((m : ZMod p)) = (u : ZMod p) ∧
      ((p : ℚ)) * B (S.vec i) (S.vec i) = (m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hdvd, hm⟩ := S.diag i
  have hne : ((m : ZMod p)) ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    hdvd ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp h)
  exact ⟨(isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne).unit, m,
    ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne).unit_spec).symm, hm⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_orthogonal_glue_basis
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_glue_basis [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hsymm : B.IsSymm)
    (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) (hN : IsLattice ℚ Ñ) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B Ñ)
    {q : ℕ} (hpq : Nat.Coprime p q)
    (hsplit : B.dualSubmodule Ñ = torsionPart B Ñ p ⊔ torsionPart B Ñ q) :
    Nonempty (GlueBasis B Ñ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : NeZero p := ⟨hp.out.pos.ne'⟩
  have : Module.Finite (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p) := discGroup_finite hnd hN
  have : Invertible (2 : ZMod p) := by
    refine invertibleOfNonzero ?_
    intro h2
    have hcast : ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    have hdvd := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 p).mp hcast
    exact hp2 ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp.out Nat.prime_two).mp hdvd)
  have hsep : (discPairing B Ñ p hsymm).SeparatingLeft :=
    discPairing_separatingLeft hsymm hnd hN (NeZero.ne p) hpq hsplit
  have hsymmD : (discPairing B Ñ p hsymm).IsSymm := discPairing_isSymm hsymm
  obtain ⟨b, hortho⟩ := LinearMap.BilinForm.exists_orthogonal_basis
    (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp hsymmD)
  have hdiag : ∀ i, discPairing B Ñ p hsymm (b i) (b i) ≠ 0 := fun i =>
    hortho.not_isOrtho_basis_self_of_separatingLeft hsep i
  choose y hy using fun i => Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype) (b i)
  refine ⟨{
    rank := Module.finrank (ZMod p) (discGroup B Ñ p)
    rank_le := disc_dim_le_two hsymm hnd hN hmax
    vec := fun i => (y i : W)
    mem := fun i => (y i).2
    spans := ?_
    ortho := ?_
    diag := ?_
    indep := ?_ }⟩
  ·
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · intro w hw
      set d : discGroup B Ñ p := Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨w, hw⟩ with hd
      choose k hk using fun i => ZMod.intCast_surjective (n := p) (b.repr d i)
      have hrepr : d = ∑ i, (k i) • b i := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← b.sum_repr d]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← hk i, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      set t : torsionPart B Ñ p := ∑ i, k i • y i with ht
      have hmk : (Submodule.Quotient.mk t : discGroup B Ñ p) = d := by
        have hmkq : (Submodule.Quotient.mk t : discGroup B Ñ p) =
            (Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype).mkQ t := rfl
        rw [hmkq, ht, map_sum, hrepr]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [map_smul]
        show k i • (Submodule.Quotient.mk (y i) : discGroup B Ñ p) = k i • b i
        rw [hy i]
      have hsub : w - (t : W) ∈ Ñ := by
        have hzero : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨w, hw⟩ - t) : discGroup B Ñ p) = 0 := by
          have hmkq : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (⟨w, hw⟩ - t) : discGroup B Ñ p) =
              (Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype).mkQ (⟨w, hw⟩ - t) := rfl
          rw [hmkq, map_sub]
          show (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨w, hw⟩ : discGroup B Ñ p) -
            (Submodule.Quotient.mk t : discGroup B Ñ p) = 0
          rw [hmk, hd, sub_self]
        have hmem₀ := discGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero
        simpa using hmem₀
      have htmem : (t : W) ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range fun i => (y i : W)) := by
        rw [ht]
        push_cast
        refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hdecomp : w = (w - (t : W)) + (t : W) := by abel
      rw [hdecomp]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left hsub)
        (Submodule.mem_sup_right htmem)
    · refine sup_le (le_torsionPart hmax.integral p) ?_
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (y i).2
  ·
    intro i j hij
    have h0 : discPairing B Ñ p hsymm (b i) (b j) = 0 := hortho hij
    rw [← hy i, ← hy j, discPairing_mk] at h0
    exact mem_one_of_dvd_discNum (NeZero.ne p) (torsion_mem_dual (y i))
      (torsion_zsmul_mem (y j)) ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp h0)
  ·
    intro i
    refine ⟨discNum B p (y i : W) (y i : W), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hdvd
      refine hdiag i ?_
      rw [← hy i, discPairing_mk]
      exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mpr hdvd
    · exact (discNum_cast (torsion_mem_dual (y i)) (torsion_zsmul_mem (y i))).symm
  ·
    intro cf hmem i
    have hsum : ∑ i, ((cf i : ZMod p)) • b i = 0 := by
      have hmk : ((Ñ.comap (torsionPart B Ñ p).subtype).mkQ (∑ i, cf i • y i)) = 0 := by
        refine discGroup_mk_eq_zero_iff.mpr ?_
        have hco : ((∑ i, cf i • y i : torsionPart B Ñ p) : W) = ∑ i, cf i • (y i : W) := by
          push_cast
          rfl
        rw [hco]
        exact hmem
      rw [map_sum] at hmk
      rw [← hmk]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul]
      show ((cf i : ZMod p)) • b i = cf i • (Submodule.Quotient.mk (y i) : discGroup B Ñ p)
      rw [hy i, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp b.linearIndependent (fun i => ((cf i : ZMod p))) hsum i
    exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mp this

name: SRG266.Lattice.A11E6ShortType.exists_label
statement:
theorem A11E6ShortType.exists_label {a : ℤ} {u : Fin 11 → ℚ} {v : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (h : A11E6ShortType a u v)
    (hdual : v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, ShortFrameLabel a c ∧
      ∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+c • E6Cartan.weight
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨ha, _, hv0⟩ | ⟨ha, _, _, c, hc, hw⟩
  · rcases E6Cartan.dual_norm_dichotomy hdual (by rw [hv0]) with h | h
    · exact ⟨0, Or.inl ⟨ha, rfl⟩, v, h.1, by simp⟩
    · have hmin := h.2.1
      linarith
  · exact ⟨c, Or.inr ⟨ha, hc⟩, hw⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11_centered_orientation
statement:
theorem a11_centered_orientation (ε a : ℤ) (z : Fin 12 → ℤ)
    (hε : ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) (hz : (∑ i, z i) = a) (hbinary : ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) :
    (∑ i, orientedBinaryCoordinates ε z i) = orientedALabel ε a ∧
      (∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*((z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) =
        (orientedBinaryCoordinates ε z i : ℚ)-(orientedALabel ε a : ℚ)/12) ∧
      (∀ i, orientedBinaryCoordinates ε z i = 0 ∨ orientedBinaryCoordinates ε z i = 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hε with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [orientedBinaryCoordinates, orientedALabel, show (-1 : ℤ) ≠ 1 by omega, if_false]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hz]
      simp
    · intro i
      push_cast
      ring
    · intro i
      rcases hbinary i with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · simpa [orientedBinaryCoordinates, orientedALabel] using
      (show (∑ i, z i) = a ∧ (∀ i : Fin 12, True) ∧ (∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) from
        ⟨hz, fun _ => trivial, hbinary⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11E6_normalized_type
statement:
theorem a11E6_normalized_type {ε δ a c : ℤ} {u : Fin 11 → ℚ} {v : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (hδ : δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) (htype : A11E6ShortType a u v) (hlabel : ShortFrameLabel a c)
    (hcoset : ∃ w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = w+c • E6Cartan.weight)
    (hcompat : (orientedALabel ε a = 9 ∧ c = 0) ∨ (orientedALabel ε a = 1 ∧ c = δ))
    (hzero : E6Cartan.form v v = 0 → v = 0) :
    A11E6NormalizedType (orientedALabel ε a) δ u v
proof:
:= by
  rcases htype with ⟨ha, hAn, hEn⟩ | ⟨ha, hAn, hEn, _⟩
  · have hc : c = 0 := by
      rcases hlabel with h | h
      · exact h.2
      · rcases h.1 with h | h <;> omega
    rcases hcompat with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1, hAn, hzero hEn⟩
    · rcases hδ with hδ | hδ <;> omega
  · have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hlabel with h | h
      · rcases h.1 with h | h <;> omega
      · rcases h.2 with h | h <;> omega
    rcases hcompat with h | h
    · exact (hc h.2).elim
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.1, hAn, hEn, by simpa only [h.2] using hcoset⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_E6_zero
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_E6_zero
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hpd : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < F x x) (r : X)
    (hnorm : E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) = 0) :
    a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let v := a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)
  have hn : F (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v)) = 0 := by
    rwa [hpair, a11D7E6E6Lift_norm]
  have he : ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v) = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have hp := hpd _ h
    linarith
  have h0 : a11D7E6E6Lift v = (0 : Fin 24 → ℚ) := ψ.injective (by simpa using he)
  change v = 0
  rw [← a11D7E6E6Part_lift v, h0]
  ext i
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11_constant_block_coordinate
statement:
theorem a11_constant_block_coordinate (u : Fin 11 → ℚ) (ε a : ℤ)
    (z : Fin 12 → ℤ) (f : Fin 5 ↪ Fin 12)
    (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = a)
    (hcoord : ∀ i, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12)
    (hbinary : ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) (ha : a = 9 ∨ a = 1)
    (hconst : ∀ j, cartanAZeroSum 11 u (f j) = cartanAZeroSum 11 u (f 0)) :
    (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 u (f 0) = if a = 9 then 1/4 else -1/12
proof:
:= by
  have hz (j : Fin 5) : z (f j) = z (f 0) := by
    have h1 := hcoord (f j)
    have h0 := hcoord (f 0)
    rw [hconst j] at h1
    have heq : (z (f j) : ℚ) = z (f 0) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast heq
  have hb := binary_twelve_constant_block (by decide) z a (z (f 0)) f hsum hbinary hz ha
  have hc := hcoord (f 0)
  rcases hb with ⟨ha, ht⟩ | ⟨ha, ht⟩ <;> rw [ha, ht] at hc <;>
    norm_num [ha] at hc ⊢ <;> exact hc

name: SRG266.Lattice.two_type_first_moment_counts
statement:
theorem two_type_first_moment_counts {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : ∀ i, a i = 9 ∨ a i = 1) (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 220)
    (hfirst : (∑ i, if a i = 9 then (1/4 : ℚ) else -1/12) = 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 9)).card = 55 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 1)).card = 165
proof:
:= by
  have hnot (i : ι) : (¬a i = 9) ↔ a i = 1 := by rcases ha i with h | h <;> omega
  have htotal := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Finset.univ) (fun i => a i = 9)
  simp only [hnot, Finset.card_univ, hcard] at htotal
  have htotalQ : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 9)).card : ℚ)+
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 1)).card = 220 := by exact_mod_cast htotal
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite, hnot, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at hfirst
  have hfirstQ : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 9)).card : ℚ)/4-
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 1)).card/12 = 0 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := MomentBounds.shell_type_balance _ _ htotalQ hfirstQ
  exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hA, by exact_mod_cast hB⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11_A4_first_moment_counts
statement:
theorem a11_A4_first_moment_counts {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (u : ι → (Fin 11 → ℚ)) (ε : ℤ) (a : ι → ℤ) (z : ι → Fin 12 → ℤ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 220) (hfirst : (∑ i, u i) = 0)
    (hsum : ∀ i, (∑ j, z i j) = a i)
    (hcoord : ∀ i j, (ε : ℚ)*cartanAZeroSum 11 (u i) j = (z i j : ℚ)-(a i : ℚ)/12)
    (hbinary : ∀ i j, z i j = 0 ∨ z i j = 1) (ha : ∀ i, a i = 9 ∨ a i = 1)
    (r : Fin 4 → (Fin 11 → ℚ)) (hr : ∀ j, r j ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 11)
    (hgram : ∀ j k, cartanARatForm 11 (r j) (r k) = (gramA 4 j k : ℚ))
    (horth : ∀ j i, cartanARatForm 11 (r j) (u i) = 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 9)).card = 55 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a i = 1)).card = 165
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := cartanA_A4_equal_coordinates 11 r hr hgram
  have hc (i : ι) := a11_constant_block_coordinate (u i) ε (a i) (z i) f
    (hsum i) (hcoord i) (hbinary i) (ha i) (hf (u i) (fun j => horth j i))
  apply two_type_first_moment_counts a ha hcard
  rw [← Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hc i)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hz : (∑ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 (u i) (f 0)) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun v => cartanAZeroSum 11 v (f 0)) hfirst
    simpa only [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using h
  rw [hz, mul_zero]

name: SRG266.Lattice.standardCubeIoc_ae_eq_fundamentalDomain

name: SRG266.Lattice.mFourier_neg_eq_fourierChar_inner
statement:
theorem mFourier_neg_eq_fourierChar_inner {n : ℕ}
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i => (x i : UnitAddCircle)) =
      (𝐞 (-inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 x) (intVectorToReal m)) : Circle)

proof:
:= by

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinatePoissonKernel_integrable
statement:
theorem coordinatePoissonKernel_integrable {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ)) (hf : Integrable f)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    Integrable (coordinatePoissonKernel f m)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : coordinatePoissonKernel f m =
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        𝐞 (-inner ℝ y (intVectorToReal m)) • f y) ∘ WithLp.toLp 2 := by
    funext x
    rw [coordinatePoissonKernel, Function.comp_apply,
      mFourier_neg_eq_fourierChar_inner]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  apply (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin n)).integrable_comp_of_integrable
  exact (Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff (intVectorToReal m)).2 hf

name: SRG266.Lattice.summable_cube_integral_norm_coordinatePoissonKernel
statement:
theorem summable_cube_integral_norm_coordinatePoissonKernel {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ))
    (hf : LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates f)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    Summable fun z : Fin n → ℤ ↦
      ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
        ‖coordinatePoissonKernel f m
          (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
            standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)‖
proof:
:= by
  let K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
    ⟨closedUnitCubeEuclidean n, isCompact_closedUnitCubeEuclidean n⟩
  have hsup : Summable fun z : Fin n → ℤ ↦
      ‖(integerTranslate f z).restrict K‖ := hf K
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun z ↦ integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun z ↦ ?_)
    hsup
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤
      ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
        ‖coordinatePoissonKernel f m
          (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
            standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)‖ :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _
  calc
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
        ‖coordinatePoissonKernel f m
          (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
            standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)‖) =
        ‖∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          ‖coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
              standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)‖‖ :=
      (Real.norm_of_nonneg hnonneg).symm
    _ ≤ ‖(integerTranslate f z).restrict K‖ *
        volume.real (standardCubeIoc n) := by
      apply norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const
      · simp
      · intro x hx
        have hvec :
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
              standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) =
              fun i ↦ (z i : ℝ) + x i := by
          funext i
          rw [coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice]
          rfl
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), hvec,
          coordinatePoissonKernel, norm_smul, mFourier_add_int]
        have hphase :
            ‖UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle))‖ = 1 := by
          rw [mFourier_neg_eq_fourierChar_inner]
          exact Circle.norm_coe _
        rw [hphase, one_mul]
        have hxK : WithLp.toLp 2 x ∈ closedUnitCubeEuclidean n := by
          intro i
          exact ⟨le_of_lt (hx i).1, (hx i).2⟩
        have hbound := ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm
          ((integerTranslate f z).restrict K) ⟨WithLp.toLp 2 x, hxK⟩
        change ‖f (WithLp.toLp 2 x + intVectorToReal z)‖ ≤
          ‖(integerTranslate f z).restrict K‖ at hbound
        calc
          ‖f (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i ↦ (z i : ℝ) + x i)‖ =
              ‖f (WithLp.toLp 2 x + intVectorToReal z)‖ := by
            congr 2
            ext i
            simp [intVectorToReal, add_comm]
          _ ≤ ‖(integerTranslate f z).restrict K‖ := hbound
    _ = ‖(integerTranslate f z).restrict K‖ := by
      simp [measureReal_def, volume_standardCubeIoc]

name: SRG266.Lattice.integral_coordinatePoissonKernel_eq_tsum_cube
statement:
theorem integral_coordinatePoissonKernel_eq_tsum_cube {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ)) (hf : Integrable f)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, coordinatePoissonKernel f m x) =
      ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
              standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Countable (standardIntegerLattice n).toAddSubgroup := by
    change Countable (standardIntegerLattice n)
    infer_instance
  have hfd :=
    (ZSpan.isAddFundamentalDomain' (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)) volume).integral_eq_tsum''
      (coordinatePoissonKernel f m) (coordinatePoissonKernel_integrable f hf m)
  calc
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, coordinatePoissonKernel f m x) =
        ∑' v : (standardIntegerLattice n).toAddSubgroup,
          ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)),
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m (v + x) := by
      simpa only [AddSubgroup.vadd_def, vadd_eq_add] using hfd
    _ = ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)),
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerAddSubgroup n z :
              (standardIntegerLattice n).toAddSubgroup) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) := by
      exact ((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerAddSubgroup n).tsum_eq
          (fun v : (standardIntegerLattice n).toAddSubgroup ↦
            ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)),
              coordinatePoissonKernel f m (v + x))).symm
    _ = ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerAddSubgroup n z :
              (standardIntegerLattice n).toAddSubgroup) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro z
      apply setIntegral_congr_set
      exact (standardCubeIoc_ae_eq_fundamentalDomain n).symm
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerAddSubgroup,
        coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice]

name: SRG266.Lattice.tsum_cube_integral_coordinatePoissonKernel
statement:
theorem tsum_cube_integral_coordinatePoissonKernel {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ))
    (hf : LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates f)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
              standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)) =
      ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
        ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
              standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)
proof:
:= by
  apply MeasureTheory.integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm
  · intro z
    have hcont : Continuous fun x : Fin n → ℝ ↦
        coordinatePoissonKernel f m
          (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
            standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) := by
      exact (coordinatePoissonKernel_continuous f m).comp (by fun_prop)
    have hcompact : IsCompact
        {x : Fin n → ℝ | ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1} :=
      isCompact_pi_infinite fun _ ↦ isCompact_Icc
    apply (hcont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hcompact).mono_set
    intro x hx i
    exact ⟨le_of_lt (hx i).1, (hx i).2⟩
  · exact summable_cube_integral_norm_coordinatePoissonKernel f hf m

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinatePoissonKernel_add_int
statement:
theorem coordinatePoissonKernel_add_int {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ))
    (m z : Fin n → ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    coordinatePoissonKernel f m
        (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
          standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) =
      UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle)) •
        f (WithLp.toLp 2 x + intVectorToReal z)
proof:
:= by
  have hvec :
      (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
        standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) =
        fun i ↦ (z i : ℝ) + x i := by
    funext i
    rw [coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice]
    rfl
  rw [hvec, coordinatePoissonKernel, mFourier_add_int]
  congr 2
  ext i
  simp [intVectorToReal, add_comm]

name: SRG266.Lattice.tsum_coordinatePoissonKernel_add_int
statement:
theorem tsum_coordinatePoissonKernel_add_int {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ))
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
      coordinatePoissonKernel f m
        (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
          standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x)) =
      UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle)) •
        ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ, f (WithLp.toLp 2 x + intVectorToReal z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsum_congr fun z ↦ coordinatePoissonKernel_add_int f m z x]
  exact tsum_const_smul'' _

name: SRG266.Lattice.integral_mFourier_kernel_eq_fourier
statement:
theorem integral_mFourier_kernel_eq_fourier {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ)) (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ,
      UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i => (x i : UnitAddCircle)) •
        f (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) =
      𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.fourier_eq]
  rw [← (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin n)).integral_comp
    (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 _).measurableEmbedding]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [mFourier_neg_eq_fourierChar_inner]
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.torusPeriodization_mFourierCoeff
statement:
theorem torusPeriodization_mFourierCoeff {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ)) (hfint : Integrable f)
    (hflocal : LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates f)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff
        (torusPeriodization f hflocal) m =
      𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff_eq_integral _ m (0 : Fin n → ℝ)]
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_add]
  change (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
        UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle)) •
        torusPeriodization f hflocal
          (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle))) = _
  calc
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle)) •
          torusPeriodization f hflocal
            (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle))) =
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
            coordinatePoissonKernel f m
              (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
                standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with x
      change UnitAddTorus.mFourier (-m) (fun i ↦ (x i : UnitAddCircle)) •
          torusPeriodization f hflocal
            (euclideanToUnitTorus (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) = _
      rw [torusPeriodization_euclideanToUnitTorus]
      exact (tsum_coordinatePoissonKernel_add_int f m x).symm
    _ = ∑' z : Fin n → ℤ,
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ in standardCubeIoc n,
          coordinatePoissonKernel f m
            (((intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n z :
              standardIntegerLattice n) : Fin n → ℝ) + x) :=
      (tsum_cube_integral_coordinatePoissonKernel f hflocal m).symm
    _ = ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, coordinatePoissonKernel f m x :=
      (integral_coordinatePoissonKernel_eq_tsum_cube f hfint m).symm
    _ = 𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m) :=
      integral_mFourier_kernel_eq_fourier f m

name: SRG266.Lattice.continuous_piPoisson
statement:
theorem continuous_piPoisson {n : ℕ}
    (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ)) (hfint : Integrable f)
    (hflocal : LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates f)
    (hfdual : Summable fun m : Fin n → ℤ =>
      𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)) :
    (∑' z : Fin n → ℤ, f (intVectorToReal z)) =
      ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
        𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)
proof:
:=
  piPoisson_of_periodization
    (continuousPiPoissonPeriodizationData f hfint hflocal hfdual)

name: SRG266.Lattice.schwartz_piPoisson
statement:
theorem schwartz_piPoisson {n : ℕ}
    (f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ) :
    (∑' z : Fin n → ℤ, f (intVectorToReal z)) =
      ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
        𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)
proof:
:=
  piPoisson_of_periodization (schwartzPiPoissonPeriodizationData f)

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6A11Part_D7Projection
statement:
theorem a11D7E6A11Part_D7Projection (u : Fin 24 → ℚ) :
    a11D7E6A11Part (a11D7E6D7Projection u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [a11D7E6A11Part, a11D7E6D7Projection, a11D7E6D7Scalar, a11D7E6D7BlockScalar]

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6E6Part_D7Projection
statement:
theorem a11D7E6E6Part_D7Projection (u : Fin 24 → ℚ) :
    a11D7E6E6Part (a11D7E6D7Projection u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [a11D7E6E6Part, a11D7E6D7Projection, a11D7E6D7Scalar, a11D7E6D7BlockScalar]

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_common_marked_projection_zero
statement:
theorem sum_common_marked_projection_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) →ₗ[ℚ] Y) (g : ι → W) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, g i) = 0) (hP : P (middleCoordinateInclusion 7 s) = 0) :
    (∑ i, P ((g i, s), 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let I : W →ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) :=
    (LinearMap.inl ℚ (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) U).comp (LinearMap.inl ℚ W (Fin 7 → ℚ))
  have hsplit (i) : ((g i, s), (0 : U)) = I (g i)+middleCoordinateInclusion 7 s := by
    simp [I, middleCoordinateInclusion]
  simp_rw [hsplit, map_add, hP, add_zero]
  change (∑ i, (P.comp I) (g i)) = 0
  rw [← map_sum, hsum, map_zero]

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_parts_middle_zero
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_parts_middle_zero
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u)) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ) :
    a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm (middleCoordinateInclusion 7 s)) = 0 ∧
      a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm (middleCoordinateInclusion 7 s)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ψ.symm (middleCoordinateInclusion 7 s) =
      a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm (middleCoordinateInclusion 7 s)) := by
    apply ψ.injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← hmarked, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hu]
  exact ⟨a11D7E6A11Part_D7Projection _, a11D7E6E6Part_D7Projection _⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_frame_first_moments
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_frame_first_moments {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (g : ι → W) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ) (hsum : (∑ i, g i) = 0) :
    (∑ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U)))) = 0 ∧
      (∑ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U)))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz := a11D7E6_parts_middle_zero ψ hmarked s
  constructor
  · exact sum_common_marked_projection_zero
      (a11D7E6A11PartLinear.comp ψ.symm.toLinearMap) g s hsum hz.1
  · exact sum_common_marked_projection_zero
      (a11D7E6E6PartLinear.comp ψ.symm.toLinearMap) g s hsum hz.2

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_apply_same
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_apply_same (G : SimpleGraph V) (i : V) :
    graphCartanMatrix G i i = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [graphCartanMatrix]

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj {G : SimpleGraph V} {i j : V}
    (hij : G.Adj i j) : graphCartanMatrix G i j = -1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [graphCartanMatrix, hij.ne, hij]

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj {G : SimpleGraph V} {i j : V}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hadj : ¬ G.Adj i j) : graphCartanMatrix G i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [graphCartanMatrix, hij, hadj]

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_isSymm
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_isSymm (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    (graphCartanMatrix G).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  change graphCartanMatrix G j i = graphCartanMatrix G i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_same]
  · by_cases hadj : G.Adj i j
    · rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hadj.symm,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hadj]
    · have hadj' : ¬ G.Adj j i := fun h ↦ hadj h.symm
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj (Ne.symm hij) hadj',
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj hij hadj]

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_apply_iso
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_same, graphCartanMatrix_apply_same]
  · have heij : e i ≠ e j := fun h ↦ hij (e.injective h)
    by_cases hadj : G.Adj i j
    · have hHadj : H.Adj (e i) (e j) := e.map_rel_iff.mpr hadj
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hHadj,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hadj]
    · have hHnot : ¬ H.Adj (e i) (e j) := fun h ↦ hadj (e.map_rel_iff.mp h)
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj heij hHnot,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj hij hadj]

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_eq_two_sub_adjMatrix
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_eq_two_sub_adjMatrix [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    graphCartanMatrix G = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (2 : ℤ)) - G.adjMatrix ℤ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [graphCartanMatrix_apply_same]
  · by_cases hadj : G.Adj i j
    · simp [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hadj, hij, hadj]
    · simp [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj hij hadj, hij, hadj]

name: SRG266.Lattice.isPositiveCartan_iff_posDef
statement:
theorem isPositiveCartan_iff_posDef [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsPositiveCartan G ↔ (graphCartanMatrix G).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · simpa [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm] using graphCartanMatrix_isSymm G
    · intro x hx
      simpa [graphCartanEnergy, Matrix.toBilin'_apply'] using h x hx
  · intro h x hx
    simpa [graphCartanEnergy, Matrix.toBilin'_apply'] using h.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_comap
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_comap {W : Type*} [DecidableEq W] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (f : W ↪ V) :
    graphCartanMatrix (G.comap f) =
      (graphCartanMatrix G).submatrix f f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [graphCartanMatrix_apply_same]
  · by_cases hadj : (G.comap f).Adj i j
    · have hGadj : G.Adj (f i) (f j) := by simpa using hadj
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hadj,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hGadj]
    · have hGnot : ¬ G.Adj (f i) (f j) := by simpa using hadj
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj hij hadj,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj (fun h ↦ hij (f.injective h)) hGnot]

name: SRG266.Lattice.IsPositiveCartan.comap
statement:
theorem IsPositiveCartan.comap {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : IsPositiveCartan G) (f : W ↪ V) :
    IsPositiveCartan (G.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPositiveCartan_iff_posDef, graphCartanMatrix_comap]
  exact (isPositiveCartan_iff_posDef G).mp hG |>.submatrix f.injective

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanEnergy_antitone
statement:
theorem graphCartanEnergy_antitone [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {H G : SimpleGraph V} (hHG : H ≤ G) {x : V → ℤ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    graphCartanEnergy G x ≤ graphCartanEnergy H x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [graphCartanEnergy, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · simp [graphCartanMatrix, hij]
  · by_cases hHij : H.Adj i j
    · have hGij : G.Adj i j := hHG hHij
      simp [graphCartanMatrix, hij, hHij, hGij]
    · by_cases hGij : G.Adj i j
      · simp only [graphCartanMatrix, if_neg hij, if_pos hGij, if_neg hHij]
        nlinarith [hx i, hx j]
      · simp [graphCartanMatrix, hij, hHij, hGij]

name: SRG266.Lattice.not_isPositiveCartan_of_nonpositive_subgraph
statement:
theorem not_isPositiveCartan_of_nonpositive_subgraph [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {H G : SimpleGraph V} (hHG : H ≤ G) {x : V → ℤ}
    (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i)
    (henergy : graphCartanEnergy H x ≤ 0) :
    ¬ IsPositiveCartan G
proof:
:= by
  intro hpos
  have hGpos : 0 < graphCartanEnergy G x := hpos x hx0
  have hmono := graphCartanEnergy_antitone hHG hx
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanEnergy_one
statement:
theorem graphCartanEnergy_one [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    graphCartanEnergy G (fun _ ↦ 1) =
      2 * (Fintype.card V : ℤ) - 2 * (G.edgeFinset.card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphCartanEnergy, graphCartanMatrix_eq_two_sub_adjMatrix,
    Matrix.toBilin'_apply']
  simp only [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.sub_apply,
    dotProduct, one_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hrow (i : V) :
      (G.adjMatrix ℤ *ᵥ (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℤ))) i = (G.degree i : ℤ) := by
    convert SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_mulVec_const_apply
      (G := G) (α := ℤ) (a := (1 : ℤ)) (v := i) using 1 <;> simp
  rw [show ∑ i : V, (G.adjMatrix ℤ *ᵥ (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℤ))) i =
      ∑ i : V, (G.degree i : ℤ) by
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ hrow i)]
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.card_edgeFinset_cycleGraph
statement:
theorem card_edgeFinset_cycleGraph (k : ℕ) :
    (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph (k + 3)).edgeFinset.card = k + 3
proof:
:= by
  have hhand :=
    (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph (k + 3)).sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
  simp only [SimpleGraph.cycleGraph_degree_three_le, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hhand
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by norm_num : 0 < 2)
  calc
    2 * (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph (k + 3)).edgeFinset.card = (k + 3) * 2 := hhand.symm
    _ = 2 * (k + 3) := Nat.mul_comm _ _

name: SRG266.Lattice.IsPositiveCartan.isAcyclic
statement:
theorem IsPositiveCartan.isAcyclic [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : IsPositiveCartan G) : G.IsAcyclic
proof:
:= by
  rw [SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_free_cycleGraph]
  intro n hn hcopy
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 3 := by
    exact ⟨n - 3, by omega⟩
  rcases hcopy with ⟨f⟩
  let e : Fin (k + 3) ↪ V := f.toEmbedding
  let K : SimpleGraph (Fin (k + 3)) := G.comap e
  have hcycle_le : SimpleGraph.cycleGraph (k + 3) ≤ K := by
    intro i j hij
    exact f.toHom.map_rel' hij
  have hK : IsPositiveCartan K := hG.comap e
  have henergy :
      graphCartanEnergy (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph (k + 3)) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℤ)) = 0 := by
    rw [graphCartanEnergy_one, card_edgeFinset_cycleGraph]
    simp
  exact (not_isPositiveCartan_of_nonpositive_subgraph hcycle_le
    (by
      intro hzero
      have hvalue := congrFun hzero (0 : Fin (k + 3))
      norm_num at hvalue)
    (fun _ ↦ by norm_num) henergy.le) hK

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourStar_cartanEnergy
statement:
theorem fourStar_cartanEnergy :
    graphCartanEnergy (SimpleGraph.starGraph (none : Option (Fin 4)))
      (fun i ↦ match i with | none => (2 : ℤ) | some _ => 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [graphCartanEnergy, Matrix.toBilin'_apply, graphCartanMatrix,
    SimpleGraph.starGraph_adj, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  decide

name: SRG266.Lattice.IsPositiveCartan.degree_le_three
statement:
theorem IsPositiveCartan.degree_le_three [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : IsPositiveCartan G) (v : V) : G.degree v ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hdeg
  have hfour : 4 ≤ G.degree v := by omega
  obtain ⟨leaf, hleaf⟩ :=
    Function.Embedding.exists_of_card_le_finset
      (α := Fin 4) (s := G.neighborFinset v) hfour
  have hadj (i : Fin 4) : G.Adj v (leaf i) := by
    have hm : leaf i ∈ G.neighborFinset v := hleaf (Set.mem_range_self i)
    simpa using hm
  let e : Option (Fin 4) ↪ V :=
    ⟨fun i ↦ match i with | none => v | some j => leaf j, by
      intro i j hij
      cases i with
      | none =>
          cases j with
          | none => rfl
          | some j =>
              exfalso
              exact (hadj j).ne hij
      | some i =>
          cases j with
          | none =>
              exfalso
              exact (hadj i).ne hij.symm
          | some j =>
              simp only [Option.some.injEq]
              exact leaf.injective hij⟩
  let K : SimpleGraph (Option (Fin 4)) := G.comap e
  have hstar_le : SimpleGraph.starGraph (none : Option (Fin 4)) ≤ K := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [SimpleGraph.starGraph_adj] at hij
    rcases hij.2 with hi | hj
    · subst i
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hij.1 rfl).elim
      | some j => exact hadj j
    · subst j
      cases i with
      | none => exact (hij.1 rfl).elim
      | some i => exact (hadj i).symm
  have hK : IsPositiveCartan K := hG.comap e
  exact (not_isPositiveCartan_of_nonpositive_subgraph hstar_le
    (by
      intro hzero
      have hvalue := congrFun hzero (none : Option (Fin 4))
      norm_num at hvalue)
    (by intro i; cases i <;> norm_num) fourStar_cartanEnergy.le) hK

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanA_signed_centered_pair
statement:
theorem cartanA_signed_centered_pair (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin n → ℚ)
    (t : ℚ) (ht : t*t = 1) (z w : Fin (n+1) → ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (hz : (∑ i, z i) = a) (hw : (∑ i, w i) = b)
    (hu : ∀ i, t*cartanAZeroSum n u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1))
    (hv : ∀ i, t*cartanAZeroSum n v i = (w i : ℚ)-(b : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1)) :
    cartanARatForm n u v = ((∑ i, z i*w i : ℤ) : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)*b/((n : ℚ)+1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cartanA_centered_pair n (t • u) (t • v) z w a b hz hw
    (by simpa only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hu)
    (by simpa only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hv)
  simpa only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ht, one_mul] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.four_dvd_of_odd_mul_square_eq_eight_mul
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ a * m ^ 2 := ⟨4 * n, by linarith⟩
  have hsq : (2 : ℤ) ∣ m ^ 2 :=
    (Int.isCoprime_two_left.mpr haodd).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Int.Prime.dvd_pow' Nat.prime_two hsq
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  have hnext : a * b ^ 2 = 2 * n := by nlinarith [h]
  have hb2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ b ^ 2 :=
    (Int.isCoprime_two_left.mpr haodd).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ⟨n, hnext⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Int.Prime.dvd_pow' Nat.prime_two hb2
  exact ⟨d, by omega⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.zsmul_mem_iff_four_dvd_of_odd_quarter_norm
statement:
theorem zsmul_mem_iff_four_dvd_of_odd_quarter_norm
    {B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W} {P : Submodule ℤ W}
    (heven : IsEven B P) {u : W} {a : ℤ} (ha : Odd a) (hnorm : B u u = (a : ℚ) / 4)
    (hfour : (4 : ℤ) • u ∈ P) (m : ℤ) : m • u ∈ P ↔ 4 ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := heven _ hm
    have heqQ : (a : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) ^ 2 = 8 * (n : ℚ) := by
      simp only [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul, hnorm] at hn
      nlinarith [hn]
    have heq : a * m ^ 2 = 8 * n := by exact_mod_cast heqQ
    exact four_dvd_of_odd_mul_square_eq_eight_mul ha heq
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h : (4 * k) • u = k • ((4 : ℤ) • u) := by module
    rw [h]
    exact P.smul_mem k hfour

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_on_embedding_le_sum
statement:
theorem sum_on_embedding_le_sum {m n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) (f : Fin m ↪ Fin n) :
    (∑ i, z (f i)) ≤ ∑ j, z j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.image f, z j :=
      (Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ h => f.injective h)).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun j _ _ => hz j)

name: SRG266.Lattice.binary_constant_block_bounds
statement:
theorem binary_constant_block_bounds {m n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℤ)
    (a t : ℤ) (f : Fin m ↪ Fin n) (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = a)
    (hbinary : ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) (hconst : ∀ i, z (f i) = t) :
    (m : ℤ)*t ≤ a ∧ (m : ℤ)*(1-t) ≤ (n : ℤ)-a
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := sum_on_embedding_le_sum z (fun i => by rcases hbinary i with h | h <;> omega) f
  have hhigh := sum_on_embedding_le_sum (fun i => 1-z i)
    (fun i => by rcases hbinary i with h | h <;> omega) f
  simpa only [hconst, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum, mul_one] using And.intro hlow hhigh

name: SRG266.Lattice.binary_twelve_constant_block
statement:
theorem binary_twelve_constant_block {m : ℕ} (hm : 4 ≤ m)
    (z : Fin 12 → ℤ) (a t : ℤ) (f : Fin m ↪ Fin 12)
    (hsum : (∑ i, z i) = a) (hbinary : ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1)
    (hconst : ∀ i, z (f i) = t) (ha : a = 9 ∨ a = 1) :
    (a = 9 ∧ t = 1) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ t = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := hbinary (f ⟨0, by omega⟩)
  rw [hconst] at hb
  obtain ⟨hlow, hhigh⟩ := binary_constant_block_bounds z a t f hsum hbinary hconst
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
  all_goals omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.ratVector_mem_even

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.ratVector_norm
statement:
theorem DRoot.ratVector_norm {n : ℕ} (r : DRoot n) :
    standardRatForm n r.ratVector r.ratVector = 2
proof:

  change (∑ i, r.vector i * r.vector i) = 2 at h
  change (∑ i, (r.vector i : ℚ) * (r.vector i : ℚ)) = 2

name: SRG266.Lattice.DRoot.exists_ratVector_of_norm_two

name: SRG266.Lattice.eq_one_of_three_of_card_eq_three
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_three_of_card_eq_three
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (hcard : Fintype.card K = 3) {a b c : K}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) (x : K) :
    x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x = c
proof:
:= by
  have hs_card : ({a, b, c} : Finset K).card = 3 := by
    simp [hab, hac, hbc]
  have hs_univ : ({a, b, c} : Finset K) = Finset.univ := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.subset_univ _)
    simpa only [Finset.card_univ, hcard, hs_card] using (le_refl 3)
  have hx : x ∈ ({a, b, c} : Finset K) := by rw [hs_univ]; simp
  simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hx

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_tripodGraph_iso
statement:
theorem exists_tripodGraph_iso
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) {z : V}
    (hcomponents : Fintype.card (G.induce {x | x ≠ z}).ConnectedComponent = 3)
    (A₀ A₁ A₂ : OrientedPuncturedArm G z ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩)
    (h₀₁ : A₀.component ≠ A₁.component)
    (h₀₂ : A₀.component ≠ A₂.component)
    (h₁₂ : A₁.component ≠ A₂.component) :
    Nonempty (tripodGraph A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ≃g G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f₀ := A₀.prefixEmbedding (le_refl A₀.length)
  let f₁ := A₁.prefixEmbedding (le_refl A₁.length)
  let f₂ := A₂.prefixEmbedding (le_refl A₂.length)
  let f : TripodVertex A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ↪ V :=
    tripodVertexEmbedding z f₀ f₁ f₂
      (fun i ↦ A₀.prefixEmbedding_ne_center _ i)
      (fun i ↦ A₁.prefixEmbedding_ne_center _ i)
      (fun i ↦ A₂.prefixEmbedding_ne_center _ i)
      (fun i j ↦ A₀.prefixEmbedding_ne_of_component_ne A₁ h₀₁ _ _ i j)
      (fun i j ↦ A₀.prefixEmbedding_ne_of_component_ne A₂ h₀₂ _ _ i j)
      (fun i j ↦ A₁.prefixEmbedding_ne_of_component_ne A₂ h₁₂ _ _ i j)
  have hf_surj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro v
    by_cases hv : v = z
    · refine ⟨none, ?_⟩
      change z = v
      exact hv.symm
    · let rv : {x : V // x ≠ z} := ⟨v, hv⟩
      let C := (G.induce {x | x ≠ z}).connectedComponentMk rv
      rcases eq_one_of_three_of_card_eq_three hcomponents h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂ C with
        hC | hC | hC
      · have hmem : rv ∈ A₀.component := by
          change (G.induce {x | x ≠ z}).connectedComponentMk rv = A₀.component
          exact hC
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := A₀.coord.surjective ⟨rv, hmem⟩
        refine ⟨some (.inl i), ?_⟩
        change A₀.vertex (Fin.castLE (le_refl A₀.length) i) = v
        simpa only [Fin.castLE_refl, OrientedPuncturedArm.vertex] using
          congr_arg (fun y : A₀.component ↦ y.1.1) hi
      · have hmem : rv ∈ A₁.component := by
          change (G.induce {x | x ≠ z}).connectedComponentMk rv = A₁.component
          exact hC
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := A₁.coord.surjective ⟨rv, hmem⟩
        refine ⟨some (.inr (.inl i)), ?_⟩
        change A₁.vertex (Fin.castLE (le_refl A₁.length) i) = v
        simpa only [Fin.castLE_refl, OrientedPuncturedArm.vertex] using
          congr_arg (fun y : A₁.component ↦ y.1.1) hi
      · have hmem : rv ∈ A₂.component := by
          change (G.induce {x | x ≠ z}).connectedComponentMk rv = A₂.component
          exact hC
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := A₂.coord.surjective ⟨rv, hmem⟩
        refine ⟨some (.inr (.inr i)), ?_⟩
        change A₂.vertex (Fin.castLE (le_refl A₂.length) i) = v
        simpa only [Fin.castLE_refl, OrientedPuncturedArm.vertex] using
          congr_arg (fun y : A₂.component ↦ y.1.1) hi
  let e : TripodVertex A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length ≃ V :=
    Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨f.injective, hf_surj⟩
  let H : SimpleGraph V :=
    (tripodGraph A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length).map e
  have hmap : ∀ {x y},
      (tripodGraph A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length).Adj x y →
        G.Adj (e x) (e y) := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [tripodGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hxy
    rcases hxy.2 with hxy | hxy
    · exact tripodRel_map z f₀ f₁ f₂
        (fun h ↦ A₀.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj _ h)
        (fun h ↦ A₁.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj _ h)
        (fun h ↦ A₂.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj _ h)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₀.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero _ i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₁.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero _ i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₂.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero _ i hi) hxy
    · exact (tripodRel_map z f₀ f₁ f₂
        (fun h ↦ A₀.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj _ h)
        (fun h ↦ A₁.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj _ h)
        (fun h ↦ A₂.adj_prefixEmbedding_of_path_adj _ h)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₀.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero _ i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₁.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero _ i hi)
        (fun i hi ↦ A₂.adj_center_prefixEmbedding_of_val_eq_zero _ i hi) hxy).symm
  have hHG : H ≤ G := by
    intro x y hxy
    change ((tripodGraph A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length).map e).Adj x y at hxy
    rw [SimpleGraph.map_adj'] at hxy
    obtain ⟨_, i, j, hij, rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy
    exact hmap hij
  have hHconn : H.Connected := by
    exact (SimpleGraph.Iso.map e
      (tripodGraph A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length)).connected_iff.mp
        (tripodGraph_connected A₀.length_pos A₁.length_pos A₂.length_pos)
  have hHacyc : H.IsAcyclic := SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic.anti hHG hpos.isAcyclic
  let : DecidableRel H.Adj := Classical.decRel _
  have hHtree : H.IsTree := ⟨hHconn, hHacyc⟩
  have hGtree : G.IsTree := ⟨hconn, hpos.isAcyclic⟩
  have hedge_card : H.edgeFinset.card = G.edgeFinset.card := by
    have hHcard := hHtree.card_edgeFinset
    have hGcard := hGtree.card_edgeFinset
    omega
  have hedge : H.edgeFinset = G.edgeFinset := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_mono hHG)
    simpa only [hedge_card] using le_rfl
  have hH_eq_G : H = G := SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_inj.mp hedge
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  simpa only [H, hH_eq_G] using
    SimpleGraph.Iso.map e (tripodGraph A₀.length A₁.length A₂.length)

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_bound_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq
statement:
theorem exists_bound_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq (k : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ r : ℝ,
      |r| ^ k * Real.exp (-a * r ^ 2) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun r ↦ |r| ^ k * Real.exp (-a * r ^ 2)
  have ht : Tendsto h (cocompact ℝ) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [h, Real.rpow_natCast] using
      tendsto_rpow_abs_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq_cocompact ha (k : ℝ)
  have hcont : Continuous h := by
    dsimp only [h]
    fun_prop
  have hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range h) :=
    hcont.isBounded_range_iff_isBigO.mpr (ht.isBigO_one ℝ)
  rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le] at hbounded
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbounded
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun r ↦ ?_⟩
  have hr := hC (h r) ⟨r, rfl⟩
  have hh : 0 ≤ h r := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  exact (show h r ≤ C by simpa [Real.norm_of_nonneg hh] using hr).trans
    (le_max_left _ _)

name: SRG266.Lattice.integrable_norm_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_norm
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_norm (k : ℕ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable fun v : V ↦ ‖v‖ ^ k * Real.exp (-b * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := b / 2
  have ha : 0 < a := div_pos hb (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C, hCnonneg, hC⟩ := exists_bound_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq k ha
  have hbaseComplex := GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
    (V := V) (b := (a : ℂ)) (by simpa using ha) 0 0
  have hbase : Integrable fun v : V ↦ Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
    convert hbaseComplex.norm using 1
    funext v
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    have hre :
        (-((a : ℂ)) * (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 + 0 * (inner ℝ (0 : V) v : ℂ)).re =
          -a * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      have hpow : (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((‖v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        norm_cast
      rw [hpow]
      norm_num
      left
      norm_cast
    rw [hre]
  apply Integrable.mono' (hbase.const_mul C)
  · fun_prop
  · filter_upwards with v
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
    have hv := hC ‖v‖
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at hv
    have hbdiv : b = a + a := by
      dsimp only [a]
      ring
    rw [hbdiv]
    have hexp : -(a + a) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 =
        -a * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + -a * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hexp, Real.exp_add]
    calc
      ‖v‖ ^ k * (Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2) *
          Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) =
          (‖v‖ ^ k * Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) *
            Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
        gcongr

name: SRG266.Lattice.realGaussian_moment_integrable
statement:
theorem realGaussian_moment_integrable (k : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable fun v : V ↦ ‖v‖ ^ k * ‖realGaussian (V := V) t v‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := integrable_norm_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_norm
    (V := V) k (mul_pos Real.pi_pos ht)
  convert h using 1
  funext v
  rw [realGaussian, Complex.norm_exp]
  have hre :
      (-((Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ 2).re =
        -(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    norm_cast
  rw [hre]

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicGaussian_integrable
statement:
theorem harmonicGaussian_integrable {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x y : V) :
    Integrable (harmonicGaussian t x y)
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := ((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) + 1) * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
  have hmoment := integrable_norm_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_norm
    (V := V) 2 (mul_pos Real.pi_pos ht)
  apply Integrable.mono' (hmoment.const_mul C)
  · exact (harmonicGaussian_continuous t x y).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with v
    rw [harmonicGaussian, realGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
    have hre :
        (-((Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ 2).re =
          -(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      norm_cast
    rw [hre]
    have hp := abs_harmonicQuadratic_le x y v
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    change |harmonicQuadratic x y v| * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2) ≤
      C * (‖v‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2))
    calc
      |harmonicQuadratic x y v| * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2) ≤
          (C * ‖v‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ = C * (‖v‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * t) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) := by ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.separated_coordinate_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem separated_coordinate_eigenvalues
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ}
    (ψ : (ι → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hsep : ∀ i, (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2 = 0 ∨
      ((ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.1 = 0 ∧ (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).2 = 0)) :
    ∃ a : ι → ℚ, (∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ a i = 1) ∧
      (∀ i, middleCoordinateInclusion n (middleCoordinateProjection n (ψ (Pi.single i 1))) =
        a i • ψ (Pi.single i 1)) ∧ (∑ i, a i) = n
proof:
:= by
  let a : ι → ℚ := fun i => if (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2 = 0 then 0 else 1
  have ha (i) : a i = 0 ∨ a i = 1 := by
    dsimp only [a]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have heigen (i) : middleCoordinateInclusion n
      (middleCoordinateProjection n (ψ (Pi.single i 1))) = a i • ψ (Pi.single i 1) := by
    by_cases hz : (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2 = 0
    · change ((0, (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2), 0) = _
      simp [a, hz]
    · obtain ⟨hw, hu⟩ := (hsep i).resolve_left hz
      change ((0, (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.2), 0) = _
      simp only [a, if_neg hz, one_smul]
      exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext hw.symm rfl) hu.symm
  let f := (middleCoordinateProjection n (W := W) (U := U)).comp ψ.toLinearMap
  let g := ψ.symm.toLinearMap.comp (middleCoordinateInclusion n (W := W) (U := U))
  have hfg : f.comp g = LinearMap.id := by
    ext z i
    simp [f, g, middleCoordinateProjection, middleCoordinateInclusion]
  have hdiag (i) : g (f (Pi.single i 1)) = a i • Pi.single i 1 := by
    apply ψ.injective
    simpa [f, g] using heigen i
  refine ⟨a, ha, heigen, ?_⟩
  simpa using sum_coordinate_eigenvalues_of_split f g hfg a hdiag

name: SRG266.Lattice.middleProjection_pairing
statement:
theorem middleProjection_pairing {n : ℕ}
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (x y : (W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U) :
    prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C
        (middleCoordinateInclusion n (middleCoordinateProjection n x)) y =
      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C x
        (middleCoordinateInclusion n (middleCoordinateProjection n y))
proof:
:= by
  simp [middleCoordinateInclusion, middleCoordinateProjection, prodForm_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.middleProjection_eigenvalues_eq_of_pairing_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := middleProjection_pairing B C x y
  rw [hx, hy] at h
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hxy (by simpa only [mul_comm] using h)

name: SRG266.Lattice.finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd
    (t : ADEType) (ts : List ADEType) (i : Fin t.rank) :
    finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i) = Sum.inl i
proof:
:= by
  change (finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts)))
      (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i) = Sum.inl i
  simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.finADEBlockEquiv_cons_natAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finADEBlockEquiv_cons_natAdd
    (t : ADEType) (ts : List ADEType) (i : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts)) :
    finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank i) =
      Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts i)
proof:
:= by
  change (finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts)))
      (Fin.natAdd t.rank i) = Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts i)
  simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeEntry_eq_adeBlockPairing
statement:
theorem adeEntry_eq_adeBlockPairing : ∀ (ts : List ADEType)
    (i j : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts)),
    adeEntry ts i.1 j.1 =
      adeBlockPairing ts (finADEBlockEquiv ts i) (finADEBlockEquiv ts j)
proof:
| [], i, _ => Fin.elim0 i
  | t :: ts, i, j => by
      change Fin (t.rank + ADEType.rankSum ts) at i j
      generalize hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i = ei
      generalize hj : finSumFinEquiv.symm j = ej
      cases ei with
      | inl i0 =>
          cases ej with
          | inl j0 =>
              have hi' : i = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply i, hi]
                rfl
              have hj' : j = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) j0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply j, hj]
                rfl
              subst i
              subst j
              rw [finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd, finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd]
              simp [adeEntry, adeBlockPairing, ADEType.gram]
          | inr j0 =>
              have hi' : i = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply i, hi]
                rfl
              have hj' : j = Fin.natAdd t.rank j0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply j, hj]
                rfl
              subst i
              subst j
              have hbi : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts)
                  (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0) = Sum.inl i0 := by
                exact finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd t ts i0
              have hbj : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0) =
                  Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts j0) := by
                change (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts))
                    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0)) = _
                rw [hj]
                rfl
              calc
                adeEntry (t :: ts) _ _ = 0 := by simp [adeEntry, i0.isLt]
                _ = adeBlockPairing (t :: ts)
                    (finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0))
                    (finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0)) := by
                  rw [hbi, hbj]
                  rfl
      | inr i0 =>
          cases ej with
          | inl j0 =>
              have hi' : i = Fin.natAdd t.rank i0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply i, hi]
                rfl
              have hj' : j = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) j0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply j, hj]
                rfl
              subst i
              subst j
              have hbi : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank i0) =
                  Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts i0) := by
                change (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts))
                    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.natAdd t.rank i0)) = _
                rw [hi]
                rfl
              have hbj : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts)
                  (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) j0) = Sum.inl j0 := by
                exact finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd t ts j0
              calc
                adeEntry (t :: ts) _ _ = 0 := by simp [adeEntry, j0.isLt]
                _ = adeBlockPairing (t :: ts)
                    (finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank i0))
                    (finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) j0)) := by
                  rw [hbi, hbj]
                  rfl
          | inr j0 =>
              have hi' : i = Fin.natAdd t.rank i0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply i, hi]
                rfl
              have hj' : j = Fin.natAdd t.rank j0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply j, hj]
                rfl
              subst i
              subst j
              have hbi : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank i0) =
                  Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts i0) := by
                change (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts))
                    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.natAdd t.rank i0)) = _
                rw [hi]
                rfl
              have hbj : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0) =
                  Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts j0) := by
                change (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts))
                    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0)) = _
                rw [hj]
                rfl
              calc
                adeEntry (t :: ts) _ _ = adeEntry ts i0.1 j0.1 := by simp [adeEntry]
                _ = adeBlockPairing ts (finADEBlockEquiv ts i0)
                    (finADEBlockEquiv ts j0) := adeEntry_eq_adeBlockPairing ts i0 j0
                _ = adeBlockPairing (t :: ts)
                    (finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank i0))
                    (finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0)) := by
                  rw [hbi, hbj]
                  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing
statement:
theorem adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing (ts : List ADEType)
    (i j : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts)) :
    (adeGram ts).2 i j =
      adeBlockPairing ts (finADEBlockEquiv ts i) (finADEBlockEquiv ts j)
