name: SRG266.Lattice.toZLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toZLinearMap_apply {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    [Module ℤ A] [Module ℤ B] (f : A →+ B) (a : A) : toZLinearMap f a = f a
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplexRatForm_apply {n : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → ℚ) :
    simplexRatForm n x y = (∑ i, x i * y i) + (∑ i, x i) * ∑ i, y i
proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_isSymm
statement: theorem simplexRatForm_isSymm (n : ℕ) : (simplexRatForm n).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y
  simp only [simplexRatForm_apply]
  congr 1
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => mul_comm _ _)
  · exact mul_comm _ _

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_posDef
statement:
theorem simplexRatForm_posDef (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ x : Fin n → ℚ, x ≠ 0 → 0 < simplexRatForm n x x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (standardRatForm_posDef n x hx) (mul_self_nonneg _)

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_isIntegral
statement:
theorem simplexRatForm_isIntegral (n : ℕ) :
    IsIntegral (simplexRatForm n) (coordinateIntegerLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  apply mem_one_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨(∑ i, x i * y i) + (∑ i, x i) * ∑ i, y i, ?_⟩
  simp only [simplexRatForm_apply, intCoordsToRat_apply]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_isEven
statement:
theorem simplexRatForm_isEven (n : ℕ) :
    IsEven (simplexRatForm n) (coordinateIntegerLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hdiff : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (∑ i, z i * z i - ∑ i, z i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => ?_
    convert (Int.even_mul_pred_self (z i)).two_dvd using 1
    ring
  have hsum := (Int.even_mul_succ_self (∑ i, z i)).two_dvd
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := dvd_add hdiff hsum
  have heq : (∑ i, z i * z i) + (∑ i, z i) * (∑ i, z i) = 2 * k := by
    nlinarith [hk]
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  change (∑ i, (z i : ℚ) * (z i : ℚ)) +
    (∑ i, (z i : ℚ)) * (∑ i, (z i : ℚ)) = 2 * (k : ℚ)
  exact_mod_cast heq

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexWeight_pair
statement:
theorem simplexWeight_pair {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℚ) :
    simplexRatForm n (simplexWeight n) x = ∑ i, x i
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n : ℚ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simp only [simplexRatForm_apply, simplexWeight, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexWeight_norm
statement:
theorem simplexWeight_norm (n : ℕ) :
    simplexRatForm n (simplexWeight n) (simplexWeight n) = (n : ℚ) / ((n : ℚ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplexWeight_pair]
  simp [simplexWeight, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexWeight_mem_dual
statement:
theorem simplexWeight_mem_dual (n : ℕ) :
    simplexWeight n ∈ (simplexRatForm n).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  rw [simplexWeight_pair]
  exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨∑ i, z i, by simp⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem
statement:
theorem succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem (n : ℕ) :
    ((n : ℤ) + 1) • simplexWeight n ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mpr ⟨fun _ => 1, ?_⟩
  intro i
  change (1 : ℚ) = ((n : ℤ) + 1) • (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1))
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexWeight_zsmul_mem_iff
statement:
theorem simplexWeight_zsmul_mem_iff {n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin n) (m : ℤ) :
    m • simplexWeight n ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n ↔ (n : ℤ) + 1 ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mp hm
    have h := hz i₀
    change (z i₀ : ℚ) = m • (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1)) at h
    rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at h
    have hn : (n : ℚ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hQ : (m : ℚ) = ((n : ℚ) + 1) * (z i₀ : ℚ) := by
      field_simp at h
      linarith
    refine ⟨z i₀, ?_⟩
    exact_mod_cast hQ
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have heq : (((n : ℤ) + 1) * k) • simplexWeight n =
        k • (((n : ℤ) + 1) • simplexWeight n) := by module
    rw [heq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ k (succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem n)

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_int_single
statement:
private theorem simplexRatForm_int_single {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℚ) (i : Fin n) :
    simplexRatForm n x (intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1)) = x i + ∑ j, x j
proof:
:= by
  simp [simplexRatForm_apply, intCoordsToRat, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]

name: SRG266.Lattice.simplexRatForm_dual
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hz : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℚ) = x i + ∑ j, x j := by
      intro i
      have h := hx _ (intCoordsToRat_mem (Pi.single i 1))
      rw [simplexRatForm_int_single] at h
      exact mem_one_iff.mp h
    choose z hz using hz
    let a : ℤ := ∑ i, z i
    have ha : (a : ℚ) = ((n : ℚ) + 1) * ∑ i, x i := by
      change ((∑ i, z i : ℤ) : ℚ) = _
      push_cast
      simp_rw [hz]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hn : (n : ℚ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have heq : x = intCoordsToRat z + (-a) • simplexWeight n := by
      ext i
      change x i = (z i : ℚ) + (-a) • (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1))
      rw [zsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      rw [hz i, ha]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (intCoordsToRat_mem z)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · refine sup_le (simplexRatForm_isIntegral n) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = simplexWeight n)
    exact simplexWeight_mem_dual n

name: SRG266.Lattice.aFourPrefixes_gram
statement:
theorem aFourPrefixes_gram {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (r : Fin 4 → X)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, B (r i) (r j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ)) (i j : Fin 4) :
    B (aFourPrefixes r i) (aFourPrefixes r j) = if i = j then 2 else 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [aFourPrefixes, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hgram, gramA, gramAEntry]

name: SRG266.Lattice.aFourPrefixes_mem
statement:
theorem aFourPrefixes_mem {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ X]
    (L : Submodule ℤ X) (r : Fin 4 → X) (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ L) (i : Fin 4) :
    aFourPrefixes r i ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := L.add_mem (hr 0) (hr 1)
  have h012 := L.add_mem h01 (hr 2)
  have h0123 := L.add_mem h012 (hr 3)
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [aFourPrefixes] using hr 0
  · simpa [aFourPrefixes] using h01
  · simpa [aFourPrefixes] using h012
  · simpa [aFourPrefixes] using h0123

name: SRG266.Lattice.aFourPrefixes_orthogonal
statement:
theorem aFourPrefixes_orthogonal {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (r : Fin 4 → X) (x : X)
    (hr : ∀ i, B (r i) x = 0) (i : Fin 4) : B (aFourPrefixes r i) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [aFourPrefixes, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hr]

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanA_A4_equal_coordinates
statement:
theorem cartanA_A4_equal_coordinates (n : ℕ) (r : Fin 4 → (Fin n → ℚ))
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, cartanARatForm n (r i) (r j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ)) :
    ∃ f : Fin 5 ↪ Fin (n+1), ∀ u : Fin n → ℚ,
      (∀ i, cartanARatForm n (r i) u = 0) →
      ∀ j, cartanAZeroSum n u (f j) = cartanAZeroSum n u (f 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hend (i : Fin 4) := cartanA_integer_root_endpoints n (aFourPrefixes r i)
    (aFourPrefixes_mem _ r hr i)
    (by simpa using aFourPrefixes_gram (cartanARatForm n) r hgram i i)
  choose p q hne hend using hend
  have hpq (i j : Fin 4) (hij : i ≠ j) : standardRatForm (n+1)
      (Pi.single (p i) 1-Pi.single (q i) 1)
      (Pi.single (p j) 1-Pi.single (q j) 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← hend i, ← hend j, cartanAZeroSum_pair]
    simpa only [if_neg hij, cartanARatForm] using
      aFourPrefixes_gram (cartanARatForm n) r hgram i j
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := coordinate_root_star_equal_coordinates p q 0 1 (by decide) hne hpq
  refine ⟨f, fun u hu => hf (cartanAZeroSum n u) (fun i => ?_)⟩
  rw [← hend i, cartanAZeroSum_pair]
  exact aFourPrefixes_orthogonal (cartanARatForm n) r u hu i

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.pair_coset
statement:
theorem pair_coset (v w : Fin 6 → ℚ)
    (hv : v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6) (hw : w ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6)
    (c d : ℤ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, form (v+c • weight) (w+d • weight) = (m : ℚ)+4*(c : ℚ)*d/3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (form_isIntegral hv _ hw)
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (weight_mem_dual v hv)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (weight_mem_dual w hw)
  have hl' : form v weight = (l : ℚ) := (form_isSymm.eq v weight).trans hl.symm
  have hc : c • weight = (c : ℚ) • weight := by module
  have hd : d • weight = (d : ℚ) • weight := by module
  refine ⟨k+d*l+c*j, ?_⟩
  rw [hc, hd]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ← hk, hl', ← hj, weight_norm]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.pair_mod_integer
statement:
theorem pair_mod_integer {v w : Fin 6 → ℚ} {c d : ℤ}
    (hv : ∃ z ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, v = z+c • weight)
    (hw : ∃ z ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, w = z+d • weight) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, form v w = (m : ℚ)+4*(c : ℚ)*d/3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hw
  exact pair_coset z t hz ht c d

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.twice_glue_left_mem

  convert succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem 5 using 1
  module

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.mem_left_iff
statement:
theorem mem_left_iff (x : Fin 5 → ℚ) :
    (x, (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)) ∈ lattice ↔ x ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 5
proof:
:=
  cyclicGlueLattice_mem_left_iff twice_glue_left_mem
    (fun m => by simpa using simplexWeight_zsmul_mem_iff (0 : Fin 1) m) x

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.mem_right_iff
statement:
theorem mem_right_iff (y : Fin 1 → ℚ) :
    ((0 : Fin 5 → ℚ), y) ∈ lattice ↔ y ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 1
proof:
:= by
  apply cyclicGlueLattice_mem_right_iff (p := 2) ?_
    (by simpa using succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem 1)
  intro m
  have heq : m • ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) = (3 * m) • simplexWeight 5 := by module
  rw [heq, simplexWeight_zsmul_mem_iff (0 : Fin 5)]
  norm_num
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.dualVector_mem_dual
statement: theorem dualVector_mem_dual : dualVector ∈ form.dualSubmodule lattice
proof:
:= by
  change lattice ≤ rightIntegral form dualVector
  refine sup_le (fun z hz => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · have h := (simplexRatForm 5).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 5) |>.smul_mem
      (2 : ℤ) (simplexWeight_mem_dual 5)
    change simplexRatForm 5 ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) z.1 +
      simplexRatForm 1 0 z.2 ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    simpa only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] using h z.1 hz.1
  · rintro _ (rfl : _ = glueVector)
    exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨5, dualVector_pair_glueVector.symm⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.dualVector_order
statement: theorem dualVector_order (m : ℤ) : m • dualVector ∈ lattice ↔ 3 ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  change (m • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5), m • (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)) ∈ lattice ↔ _
  rw [smul_zero, mem_left_iff]
  have heq : m • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) = (2 * m) • simplexWeight 5 := by module
  rw [heq, simplexWeight_zsmul_mem_iff (0 : Fin 5)]
  norm_num
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.lattice_dual
statement:
theorem lattice_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice =
    lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {dualVector}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hp : z ∈ (prodForm (simplexRatForm 5) (simplexRatForm 1)).dualSubmodule
        ((coordinateIntegerLattice 5).prod (coordinateIntegerLattice 1)) :=
      fun w hw => hz w (Submodule.mem_sup_left hw)
    rw [dualSubmodule_prodForm] at hp
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hp
    rw [simplexRatForm_dual] at hx hy
    obtain ⟨nx, hnx, ax, hax, heqx⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨ny, hny, by', hby, heqy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hax
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hby
    have hn : (nx, ny) ∈ lattice := Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨hnx, hny⟩
    have hg : glueVector ∈ lattice :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have hng := lattice_isIntegral hn glueVector hg
    have hzg := hz glueVector hg
    have hleft : simplexRatForm 5 (simplexWeight 5) ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) = 5 / 2 := by
      norm_num [simplexWeight_pair, simplexWeight, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have hright : simplexRatForm 1 (simplexWeight 1) (simplexWeight 1) = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [simplexWeight_norm]
      norm_num
    have he : form z glueVector = form (nx, ny) glueVector +
        (a : ℚ) * (5 / 2) + (b : ℚ) * (1 / 2) := by
      change simplexRatForm 5 z.1 ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5) +
        simplexRatForm 1 z.2 (simplexWeight 1) = _
      rw [← heqx, ← heqy]
      have ha : a • simplexWeight 5 = (a : ℚ) • simplexWeight 5 := by module
      have hb : b • simplexWeight 1 = (b : ℚ) • simplexWeight 1 := by module
      rw [ha, hb]
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, hleft, hright, form, prodForm_apply, glueVector]
      ring
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hng
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hzg
    have hQ : (5 : ℚ) * a + b = 2 * ((t : ℚ) - r) := by
      rw [he, ← hr] at ht
      linarith
    have hZ : 5 * a + b = 2 * (t - r) := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    have hdiv : (2 : ℤ) ∣ a - 3 * b := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
    have hdecomp : z = ((nx, ny) + b • glueVector) + k • dualVector := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · change z.1 = (nx + b • ((3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5)) +
          k • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 5)
        rw [← heqx]
        have ha : a = 3 * b + 2 * k := by omega
        rw [ha]
        module
      · change z.2 = (ny + b • simplexWeight 1) + k • (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)
        simpa only [smul_zero, add_zero] using heqy.symm
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (Submodule.add_mem _ hn (Submodule.smul_mem _ b hg))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ k (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · refine sup_le lattice_isIntegral (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = dualVector)
    exact dualVector_mem_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Coordinates.three_smul_dualVector_mem
statement: theorem three_smul_dualVector_mem : (3 : ℤ) • dualVector ∈ lattice
proof:
:=
  (dualVector_order 3).mpr (dvd_refl 3)

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.dual_reduced
statement:
theorem dual_reduced {x : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (hx : x ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)) :
    ∃ (v : Fin 6 → ℚ) (_ : v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6) (c : ℤ),
      (-1 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 1) ∧ x = v + c • weight
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, k, hk⟩ := exists_dual_coordinates hx
  let c := (k+1) % 3-1
  refine ⟨intCoordsToRat z + ((k+1)/3) • ((3 : ℤ) • weight),
    (coordinateIntegerLattice 6).add_mem (intCoordsToRat_mem z)
      ((coordinateIntegerLattice 6).smul_mem _ three_smul_weight_mem),
    c, by dsimp [c]; omega, ?_⟩
  rw [hk]
  have heq : k = 3*((k+1)/3)+c := by dsimp [c]; omega
  conv_lhs => rw [heq]
  module

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.norm_coset
statement:
theorem norm_coset (v : Fin 6 → ℚ) (hv : v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6) (c : ℤ) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, form (v+c • weight) (v+c • weight) =
      4*(c : ℚ)^2/3+2*(k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := form_isEven v hv
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (weight_mem_dual v hv)
  have hl' : form v weight = (l : ℚ) := (form_isSymm.eq v weight).trans hl.symm
  refine ⟨b+c*l, ?_⟩
  have hc : c • weight = (c : ℚ) • weight := by module
  rw [hc]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, hb, hl', ← hl, weight_norm]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.dual_norm_dichotomy
statement:
theorem dual_norm_dichotomy {x : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (hx : x ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hnonneg : 0 ≤ form x x) :
    (x ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ ∃ k : ℤ, form x x = 2*(k : ℚ)) ∨
      (x ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ∧ 4/3 ≤ form x x ∧
        ∃ (c k : ℤ), (c = -1 ∨ c = 1) ∧
          (∃ v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, x = v+c • weight) ∧
          form x x = 4/3+2*(k : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, c, hc, heq⟩ := dual_reduced hx
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := norm_coset v hv c
  rw [← heq] at hk
  by_cases hc0 : c = 0
  · subst c
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at heq
    subst x
    exact Or.inl ⟨hv, form_isEven v hv⟩
  · have hc1 : c = -1 ∨ c = 1 := by omega
    have hsq : (c : ℚ)^2 = 1 := by rcases hc1 with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    rw [hsq] at hk
    norm_num at hk
    have hkgt : (-1 : ℚ) < k := by linarith
    have hkgtZ : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast hkgt
    have hkpos : (0 : ℚ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 ≤ k by omega)
    have hnot : x ∉ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 := by
      intro hxint
      have hcw : c • weight ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 := by
        have h := (coordinateIntegerLattice 6).sub_mem hxint hv
        simpa only [heq, add_sub_cancel_left] using h
      have hdiv := (weight_order c).mp hcw
      omega
    exact Or.inr ⟨hnot, by linarith, c, k, hc1, ⟨v, hv, heq⟩, hk⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.integral_of_dual_norm_two
proof:
:= by
  rcases dual_norm_dichotomy hx (by linarith) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, _, c, k, _, _, hk⟩
  · exact h
  · have h : (3 : ℚ)*k = 1 := by linarith
    have hZ : 3*k = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
    omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_dominant_moment
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_dominant_moment
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (hθ : 0 < f θ.1)
    (hdom : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, 0 < f r.1 → 0 ≤ L.pairing r.1 θ.1) :
    (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, (L.pairing r.1 θ.1) ^ 2) =
      2 * (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L with 0 < f r.1, L.pairing r.1 θ.1) + 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : NormTwoRoot L → ℤ := fun r => L.pairing r.1 θ.1
  have hneg :
      (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, if 0 < f r.1 then 0 else (p r) ^ 2) =
      (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, if 0 < f r.1 then (p r) ^ 2 else 0) := by
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.neg (NormTwoRoot L))
      (fun r => if 0 < f r.1 then 0 else (p r) ^ 2)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    have hr := hf r
    simp only [Equiv.neg_apply, NormTwoRoot.coe_neg, map_neg, p, LinearMap.neg_apply,
      neg_sq]
    by_cases h : 0 < f r.1
    · simp only [if_pos h, if_neg (show ¬ 0 < -f r.1 by omega)]
    · simp only [if_neg h, if_pos (show 0 < -f r.1 by omega)]
  have hsplit : (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, (p r) ^ 2) =
      2 * (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, if 0 < f r.1 then (p r) ^ 2 else 0) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, if 0 < f r.1 then (p r) ^ 2 else 0) +
          (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, if 0 < f r.1 then 0 else (p r) ^ 2) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r _
        split_ifs <;> simp
      _ = _ := by rw [hneg]; ring
  have hpoint (r : NormTwoRoot L) :
      (if 0 < f r.1 then (p r) ^ 2 else 0) =
      (if 0 < f r.1 then p r else 0) + (if r = θ then 2 else 0) := by
    by_cases heq : r = θ
    · subst r
      simp [p, θ.2, hθ]
    · have hne : r.1 - θ.1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        exact heq (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp h))
      have hb := L.positiveDefinite (r.1 - θ.1) hne
      have hs := L.symmetric.eq θ.1 r.1
      simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, r.2, θ.2, hs] at hb
      by_cases h : 0 < f r.1
      · have hn := hdom r h
        have hv : p r = 0 ∨ p r = 1 := by dsimp [p]; omega
        rcases hv with hv | hv <;> simp [h, heq, hv]
      · simp [h, heq]
  have hpos :
      (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, if 0 < f r.1 then (p r) ^ 2 else 0) =
      (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L with 0 < f r.1, p r) + 2 := by
    simp_rw [hpoint]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.sum_filter]
  change (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, (p r) ^ 2) = _
  rw [hsplit, hpos]
  dsimp [p]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_dominant_positive_sum
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_dominant_positive_sum
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (hθ : 0 < f θ.1)
    (hdom : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, 0 < f r.1 → 0 ≤ L.pairing r.1 θ.1)
    (c : ℤ)
    (hm : (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, (L.pairing r.1 θ.1) ^ 2) = 2 * c) :
    (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L with 0 < f r.1, L.pairing r.1 θ.1) = c - 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := normTwoRoot_dominant_moment L f hf θ hθ hdom
  rw [hm] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_toLinearMap
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_toLinearMap (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdEuclideanEquiv L :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) =
      Matrix.toEuclideanLin (pdSqrtGram L)
proof:
:= by

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_toLp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_toLp (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    pdEuclideanEquiv L (WithLp.toLp 2 x) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L) x)

:= by

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_det_eq_one (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    LinearMap.det (pdEuclideanEquiv L :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.det
      (Matrix.toLin (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ).toBasis
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ).toBasis (pdSqrtGram L)) = 1
  rw [LinearMap.det_toLin, pdSqrtGram_det_eq_one]

name: SRG266.Lattice.inner_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector
statement:
theorem inner_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (x y : Fin n → ℤ) :
    inner ℝ
        (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal x))
      (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal y)) =
      (L.pairing (pdCoordEquiv L x) (pdCoordEquiv L y) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change inner ℝ
      (pdEuclideanEquiv L (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (x i : ℝ))))
      (pdEuclideanEquiv L (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (y i : ℝ)))) = _
  rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_toLp, pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_toLp,
    PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [Real.inner_apply]
  change dotProduct
      (Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L) (fun i => (x i : ℝ)))
      (Matrix.mulVec (pdSqrtGram L) (fun i => (y i : ℝ))) = _
  change dotProduct
      (pdSqrtEquiv L (fun i => (x i : ℝ)))
      (pdSqrtEquiv L (fun i => (y i : ℝ))) = _
  rw [dotProduct_pdSqrtEquiv]
  have h := pdRatForm_intCoords L x y
  simp only [pdRatForm, Matrix.toBilin'_apply, pdRealGram_apply,
    intCoordsToRat_apply] at h ⊢
  exact_mod_cast h

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_sq_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector
statement:
theorem norm_sq_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    ‖pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal x)‖ ^ 2 =
      (L.pairing (pdCoordEquiv L x) (pdCoordEquiv L x) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℝ]
  simpa using inner_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector L x x

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_adjoint_eq
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_adjoint_eq (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdEuclideanEquiv L :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).adjoint =
      (pdEuclideanEquiv L :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : (pdSqrtGram L).conjTranspose = pdSqrtGram L := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial]
    exact (pdSqrtGram_isSymm L).apply i j
  have h := Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint (pdSqrtGram L)
  rw [hstar] at h
  simpa only [pdEuclideanEquiv_toLinearMap] using h.symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_symm_adjoint_eq
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_symm_adjoint_eq (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    ((pdEuclideanEquiv L).symm :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).adjoint =
      ((pdEuclideanEquiv L).symm :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  let A := pdEuclideanEquiv L
  have hsymm : (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).IsSymmetric := by
    intro x y
    calc
      inner ℝ (A x) y =
          inner ℝ x
            ((A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ]
              EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).adjoint y) :=
        (LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right
          (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ]
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) x y).symm
      _ = inner ℝ x (A y) := by
        dsimp only [A]
        rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_adjoint_eq]
        rfl
  apply LinearMap.IsSymmetric.adjoint_eq
  intro x y
  calc
    inner ℝ (A.symm x) y = inner ℝ (A.symm x) (A (A.symm y)) := by
      rw [A.apply_symm_apply]
    _ = inner ℝ (A (A.symm x)) (A.symm y) := (hsymm _ _).symm
    _ = inner ℝ x (A.symm y) := by rw [A.apply_symm_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_apply_inverseGram
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_apply_inverseGram
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    pdEuclideanEquiv L
        (pdEuclideanEquiv L
          (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x))) =
      intVectorToReal x
proof:
:= by
  change pdEuclideanEquiv L
      (pdEuclideanEquiv L
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x i : ℤ) : ℝ)))) =
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (x i : ℝ))
  rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_toLp, pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_toLp]
  exact congrArg (WithLp.toLp 2)
    (pdSqrtGram_mulVec_mulVec_equiv_symm_cast L x)

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_symm_adjoint_intVector
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_symm_adjoint_intVector
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) (x : Fin n → ℤ) :
    ((pdEuclideanEquiv L).symm :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).adjoint
        (intVectorToReal x) =
      pdEuclideanEquiv L
        (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_symm_adjoint_eq]
  change (pdEuclideanEquiv L).symm (intVectorToReal x) =
    pdEuclideanEquiv L
      (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm x))
  apply (pdEuclideanEquiv L).injective
  simpa using (pdEuclideanEquiv_apply_apply_inverseGram L x).symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.reflectNormTwoRoot_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reflectNormTwoRoot_val {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (a b : NormTwoRoot L) :
    (reflectNormTwoRoot L a b).1 =
      b.1 - (L.pairing b.1 a.1) • a.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.positiveRoot_mem_simpleRootClosure
statement:
theorem positiveRoot_mem_simpleRootClosure {n : ℕ}
    {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ)
    {r : NormTwoRoot L} (hr : 0 < f r.1) :
    r.1 ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRootSet,
    AddSubmonoid.closure_image_isAddIndecomposable_baseOf]
  exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_simpleRoot_pairing_pos
statement:
theorem exists_simpleRoot_pairing_pos {n : ℕ}
    {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ)
    {r : NormTwoRoot L} (hr : 0 < f r.1) :
    ∃ s : NormTwoRoot L, s ∈ simpleRootSet f ∧
      0 < L.pairing r.1 s.1
proof:
:= by
  have hrmem := positiveRoot_mem_simpleRootClosure f hr
  by_contra hnot
  push Not at hnot
  have hnonpos : L.pairing r.1 r.1 ≤ 0 := by
    have hclosure : ∀ x,
        x ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f) →
          L.pairing x r.1 ≤ 0 := by
      intro x hx
      induction hx using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
          obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hx
          rw [L.symmetric.eq]
          exact hnot s hs
      | zero => simp
      | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
          simpa only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] using add_nonpos hx hy
    exact hclosure r.1 hrmem
  rw [r.2] at hnonpos
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.sub_simpleRoot_positive
statement:
theorem sub_simpleRoot_positive {n : ℕ}
    {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ)
    (hf : ∀ u : NormTwoRoot L, f u.1 ≠ 0)
    {r s t : NormTwoRoot L} (hr : 0 < f r.1)
    (hs : s ∈ simpleRootSet f)
    (ht : r.1 - s.1 = t.1) :
    0 < f t.1
proof:
:= by
  have hspos : 0 < f s.1 :=
    (IsAddIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_pos normTwoRootVal f hs)
  have hft : f t.1 = f r.1 - f s.1 := by
    rw [← ht]
    exact map_sub f r.1 s.1
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hf t) with hneg | hpos
  · exfalso
    have hnegr : 0 < f (-t).1 := by simpa using neg_pos.mpr hneg
    have hsind := hs
    change IsAddIndecomposable normTwoRootVal
      {u | 0 < f (normTwoRootVal u)} s at hsind
    have hsum : s.1 = r.1 + (-t).1 := by
      rw [NormTwoRoot.coe_neg, ← ht]
      abel
    rcases hsind.2 r hr (-t) hnegr hsum with hzero | hzero
    · exact normTwoRootVal_ne_zero r hzero
    · exact normTwoRootVal_ne_zero (-t) hzero
  · exact hpos

name: SRG266.Lattice.pairing_eq_one_of_simple_step
proof:
:= by
  have hne : r.1 - s.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hrs (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp h))
  have hpos := L.positiveDefinite (r.1 - s.1) hne
  have hsym : L.pairing s.1 r.1 = L.pairing r.1 s.1 :=
    L.symmetric.eq _ _
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply] at hpos
  rw [r.2, s.2, hsym] at hpos
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.reflect_sub_simpleRoot
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [reflectNormTwoRoot_val, ← ht, map_sub,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, hpair, s.2]
  norm_num

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_reflection_induction
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_reflection_induction {n : ℕ}
    {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ)
    (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (P : NormTwoRoot L → Prop)
    (hneg : ∀ r, P r → P (-r))
    (hsimple : ∀ r, r ∈ simpleRootSet f → P r)
    (hreflect : ∀ r s, s ∈ simpleRootSet f →
      P r → P (reflectNormTwoRoot L s r)) :
    ∀ r, P r
proof:
:= by
  let rec positive (r : NormTwoRoot L) (hr : 0 < f r.1) : P r := by
    by_cases hrsimple : r ∈ simpleRootSet f
    · exact hsimple r hrsimple
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, hpair⟩ := exists_simpleRoot_pairing_pos f hr
      have hrs : r ≠ s := fun h => hrsimple (h ▸ hs)
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := sub_mem_normTwoRoots_of_pairing_pos hrs hpair
      have htpos : 0 < f t.1 :=
        sub_simpleRoot_positive f hf hr hs ht
      have hspos : 0 < f s.1 :=
        IsAddIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_pos normTwoRootVal f hs
      have hdecrease : (f (normTwoRootVal t)).toNat <
          (f (normTwoRootVal r)).toNat := by
        have hr' : 0 < f (normTwoRootVal r) := by
          simpa only [normTwoRootVal] using hr
        have hspos' : 0 < f (normTwoRootVal s) := by
          simpa only [normTwoRootVal] using hspos
        have hft : f (normTwoRootVal t) =
            f (normTwoRootVal r) - f (normTwoRootVal s) := by
          have hmap := congrArg f ht
          simpa only [map_sub] using hmap.symm
        omega
      have hrec : P t := positive t htpos
      have hpone := pairing_eq_one_of_simple_step hrs hpair
      rw [← reflect_sub_simpleRoot hpone ht]
      exact hreflect t s hs hrec
    termination_by (f (normTwoRootVal r)).toNat
  intro r
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hf r) with hnegf | hposf
  · have hp : P (-r) := positive (-r) (by simpa using neg_pos.mpr hnegf)
    simpa using hneg (-r) hp
  · exact positive r hposf

name: SRG266.Lattice.K4Coordinates.matchingVector_dual
statement:
theorem matchingVector_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice =
    lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range matchingVector)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range matchingVector = {(2 : ℤ) • dualA, (2 : ℤ) • dualB} := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [matchingVector]
    · intro hz
      rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz :
        z = (2 : ℤ) • dualA ∨ z = (2 : ℤ) • dualB) with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨0, by simp [matchingVector]⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by simp [matchingVector]⟩
  rw [hr, lattice_dual]
  have ha := sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout (p := 5) (a := 2) (b := 3) (k := -1)
    five_smul_dualA_mem (by norm_num)
  have hb := sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout (p := 5) (a := 2) (b := 3) (k := -1)
    five_smul_dualB_mem (by norm_num)
  have hpair (a b : Space) : lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {a, b} =
      (lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {a}) ⊔ (lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {b}) := by
    rw [show ({a, b} : Set Space) = {a} ∪ {b} by ext; simp [or_comm], Submodule.span_union]
    exact sup_sup_distrib_left _ _ _
  rw [hpair, hpair, ha, hb]

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_quinary_binary
statement:
theorem complete_quinary_binary (u : Fin 2 → W)
    (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hlN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hiN : IsIntegral B N) (heN : IsEven B N)
    (hdN : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range u))
    (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → B (u i) (u j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hnorm : ∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, B (u i) (u i) =
      (if i = 0 then 2 / 5 else 4 / 5) + 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    IsLattice ℚ (quinaryBinaryLattice N u) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B K4Coordinates.form) (quinaryBinaryLattice N u) ∧
      (prodForm B K4Coordinates.form).dualSubmodule (quinaryBinaryLattice N u) =
        quinaryBinaryLattice N u
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag (i : Fin 2) : ∃ k : ℤ,
      B (u i) (u i) + K4Coordinates.form (K4Coordinates.matchingVector i)
        (K4Coordinates.matchingVector i) = 2 * (k : ℚ) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hnorm i
    rw [hk, K4Coordinates.matchingVector_norm]
    split_ifs
    · refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
      push_cast
      ring
    · refine ⟨k + 10, ?_⟩
      push_cast
      ring
  refine complete_even_glue u K4Coordinates.matchingVector (fun _ => 5)
    hsB K4Coordinates.form_isSymm hlN K4Coordinates.lattice_isLattice
    hiN K4Coordinates.lattice_isIntegral heN K4Coordinates.lattice_isEven
    hdN K4Coordinates.matchingVector_dual K4Coordinates.matchingVector_five_smul_mem
    hcross ?_ hdiag ?_
  · intro i j hij
    rw [K4Coordinates.matchingVector_cross i j hij]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hnorm i
    split_ifs at hk
    · exact norm_denominator_unit (p := 5) (r := 2) (by norm_num) ⟨1, -2, by norm_num⟩ hk
    · exact norm_denominator_unit (p := 5) (r := 4) (by norm_num) ⟨1, -1, by norm_num⟩ hk

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_rational_simpleRoot_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_rational_simpleRoot_coordinates
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    {n : ℕ} (N : PDUnimodularLattice n) [Finite (NormTwoRoot N)]
    (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier)
    (hpairN : ∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v)
    {f : N.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    {ts : List ADEType} (coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
      (adeGram ts).2 i j)
    (R : Set X) (hR : ∀ r ∈ R, r ∈ L ∧ F r r = 2)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℚ R = ⊤)
    (hrank : Module.finrank ℚ X = ADEType.rankSum ts) :
    ∃ ψ : (Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X,
      (∀ z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ,
        ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) = (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z) : X)) ∧
      (∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) =
        Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) => ((adeGram ts).2 i j : ℚ)) u v)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : (Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] X :=
    L.subtype.comp (e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (coordinateRootMap coord))
  have hpair (z w) : F (φ z) (φ w) = (Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 z w : ℚ) := by
    have h := hpairN (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z)) (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord w))
    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm.trans (congrArg (fun a : ℤ => (a : ℚ))
      (coordinateRootMap_pairing hf coord (adeGram ts).2 hgram z w))
  have hcover (r) (hr : r ∈ R) : ∃ z, φ z = r := by
    obtain ⟨hrL, hrnorm⟩ := hR r hr
    have hnN : N.pairing (e ⟨r, hrL⟩) (e ⟨r, hrL⟩) = 2 := by
      have h := (hpairN ⟨r, hrL⟩ ⟨r, hrL⟩).trans hrnorm
      exact_mod_cast h
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots hf coord ⟨e ⟨r, hrL⟩, hnN⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    change (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z)).1 = r
    rw [hz, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, heq⟩ := exists_rationalCoordinateEquiv φ R hspan hcover (by simpa using hrank)
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, ?_⟩
  intro u v
  change F (ψ.toLinearMap u) (ψ.toLinearMap v) = _
  rw [heq]
  exact rationalCoordinateExtension_pairing φ F (adeGram ts).2 hpair u v

theorem a11D7E6_A11_simple_pair_integral
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (hint : IsIntegral F L) {r : X} (hr : r ∈ L) (i : Fin 11) :
    cartanARatForm 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)) (Pi.single i 1) ∈
      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : (Pi.single i 1 : Fin 11 → ℚ) = intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1) := by
    ext j
    simp [intCoordsToRat_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have hm : ψ (a11D7E6A11Lift (Pi.single i 1)) ∈ L := by
    rw [hcast, a11D7E6A11Lift_intCast]
    exact hmem _
  have h := hint hr _ hm
  have hp := hpair (ψ.symm r) (a11D7E6A11Lift (Pi.single i 1))

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_A11_minimum
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_A11_minimum
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (hint : IsIntegral F L) {r : X} (hr : r ∈ L) :
    let u := a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)
    ∃ a : ℤ, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 11 ∧ ∃ z : Fin 12 → ℤ,
      (∑ i, z i) = a ∧
      (∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12) ∧
      (a : ℚ)*(12-a)/12 ≤ cartanARatForm 11 u u ∧
      (cartanARatForm 11 u u = (a : ℚ)*(12-a)/12 ↔ ∀ i, z i = 0 ∨ z i = 1) ∧
      ∃ m : ℤ, cartanARatForm 11 u u = 11*(a : ℚ)^2/12+2*(m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := a11D7E6_A11_simple_pair_integral F L ψ hpair hmem hint hr
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha11, z, hz, hc, hmin, heq⟩ := cartanA_dual_minimum_coordinates 11 _ hd
  refine ⟨a, ha0, ha11, z, hz, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using hc
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using hmin
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using heq
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using
      cartanA_norm_congruence 11 _ a z hz hc

name: SRG266.Lattice.summable_intVector_norm_rpow
statement:
theorem summable_intVector_norm_rpow {n : ℕ} (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r < -(n : ℝ)) :
    Summable fun z : Fin n → ℤ => ‖intVectorToReal z‖ ^ r
proof:
:= by
  let L := standardIntegerLattice n
  let e := intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n
  let : DiscreteTopology L := ZSpan.discreteTopology_pi_basisFun
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℤ L = n := by
    rw [show L = standardIntegerLattice n by rfl]
    simpa using
      Module.finrank_eq_card_basis
        ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)).restrictScalars ℤ)
  have hL : Summable fun z : L => ‖z‖ ^ r :=
    ZLattice.summable_norm_rpow L r (by simpa [hrank] using hr)
  rw [← e.toEquiv.summable_iff] at hL
  have hsup : Summable fun z : Fin n → ℤ =>
      ‖(fun i => (z i : ℝ))‖ ^ r := by
    convert hL using 1
    funext z
    change ‖(fun i => (z i : ℝ))‖ ^ r =
      ‖((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ)‖ ^ r
    rw [show ((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ) = fun i => (z i : ℝ) by
      simpa [e, L] using coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice z]
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    (fun z => ?_) hsup
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    rw [intVectorToReal_zero]
    have hzero : ‖(fun i : Fin n => ((0 : Fin n → ℤ) i : ℝ))‖ = 0 := by
      rw [norm_eq_zero]
      ext i
      simp
    rw [norm_zero, hzero]
  · apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos
    · apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
      intro hcast
      apply hz
      funext i
      simpa using congrFun hcast i
    · rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
      intro i
      simpa [intVectorToReal] using PiLp.norm_apply_le (intVectorToReal z) i
    · exact (hr.trans_le (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n))).le

name: SRG266.Lattice.locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates_of_pow_decay
statement:
theorem locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates_of_pow_decay
    {n k : ℕ} (f : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ)) (hnk : n < k)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hdecay : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), u ≠ 0 →
      ‖f u‖ ≤ A / ‖u‖ ^ k) :
    LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := K.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall
    (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
  let R : ℝ := max 0 R₀
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hKR : (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ⊆
      Metric.closedBall 0 R :=
    hR₀.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_right _ _))
  let majorant : (Fin n → ℤ) → ℝ := fun z =>
    (A * 2 ^ k) * ‖intVectorToReal z‖ ^ (-(k : ℝ))
  have hk : (-(k : ℝ)) < -(n : ℝ) := by
    have hnkR : (n : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnk
    linarith
  have hmajorant : Summable majorant :=
    (summable_intVector_norm_rpow (-(k : ℝ)) hk).mul_left (A * 2 ^ k)
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually hmajorant
  let bad : Set (Fin n → ℤ) :=
    {z | ‖intVectorToReal z‖ ≤ 2 * R}
  have hbad : bad.Finite := by
    let L := standardIntegerLattice n
    let e := intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n
    have hfiniteL :
        (Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) (2 * R) ∩
          (L : Set (Fin n → ℝ))).Finite :=
      ZSpan.setFinite_inter (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))
        Metric.isBounded_closedBall
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image
      (f := fun z => ((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ))
      (hfiniteL.subset ?_) ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      constructor
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        change ‖((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ)‖ ≤ 2 * R
        rw [show ((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ) = fun i => (z i : ℝ) by
          simpa [e, L] using coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice z]
        refine (show ‖(fun i => (z i : ℝ))‖ ≤ ‖intVectorToReal z‖ by
          rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
          intro i
          simpa [intVectorToReal] using PiLp.norm_apply_le (intVectorToReal z) i).trans hz
      · exact SetLike.coe_mem _
    · intro z _ w _ h
      exact e.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  filter_upwards [hbad.compl_mem_cofinite] with z hz
  have hzlarge : 2 * R < ‖intVectorToReal z‖ := by
    simpa [bad] using hz
  have hznorm : 0 < ‖intVectorToReal z‖ :=
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hR).trans_lt hzlarge
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (by positivity)).2
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hKR hx
  let u := x + intVectorToReal z
  have hu_lower : ‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2 ≤ ‖u‖ := by
    have htri : ‖intVectorToReal z‖ - ‖x‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      simpa [u, add_comm] using norm_sub_norm_le (intVectorToReal z) (-x)
    calc
      ‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2 ≤ ‖intVectorToReal z‖ - R := by linarith
      _ ≤ ‖intVectorToReal z‖ - ‖x‖ := sub_le_sub_left hxR _
      _ ≤ ‖u‖ := htri
  have hu : 0 < ‖u‖ :=
    (div_pos hznorm (by norm_num)).trans_le hu_lower
  have hsem : ‖f u‖ ≤ A / ‖u‖ ^ k :=
    hdecay u (norm_pos_iff.mp hu)
  have hpow : (‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2) ^ k ≤ ‖u‖ ^ k := by
    gcongr
  have hdiv : A / ‖u‖ ^ k ≤ A / (‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2) ^ k :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (pow_pos (div_pos hznorm (by norm_num)) k) hpow
  calc
    ‖integerTranslate f z x‖ = ‖f u‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ A / ‖u‖ ^ k := hsem
    _ ≤ A / (‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2) ^ k := hdiv
    _ = majorant z := by
      dsimp only [majorant]
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (norm_nonneg _) k, Real.rpow_natCast]
      field_simp
      rw [div_pow]
      field_simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.SchwartzMap.locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates
statement:
theorem SchwartzMap.locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates {n : ℕ}
    (f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ) :
    LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates
      (⟨f, f.continuous⟩ : C(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K
  let k : ℕ := n + 1
  let A : ℝ := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k 0 f
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := apply_nonneg _ _
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := K.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall
    (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
  let R : ℝ := max 0 R₀
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hKR : (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) ⊆
      Metric.closedBall 0 R :=
    hR₀.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_right _ _))
  let majorant : (Fin n → ℤ) → ℝ := fun z =>
    (A * 2 ^ k) * ‖intVectorToReal z‖ ^ (-(k : ℝ))
  have hk : (-(k : ℝ)) < -(n : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [k]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hmajorant : Summable majorant :=
    (summable_intVector_norm_rpow (-(k : ℝ)) hk).mul_left (A * 2 ^ k)
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually hmajorant
  let bad : Set (Fin n → ℤ) :=
    {z | ‖intVectorToReal z‖ ≤ 2 * R}
  have hbad : bad.Finite := by
    let L := standardIntegerLattice n
    let e := intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice n
    have hfiniteL :
        (Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) (2 * R) ∩ (L : Set (Fin n → ℝ))).Finite :=
      ZSpan.setFinite_inter (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))
        Metric.isBounded_closedBall
    refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := fun z => ((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ))
      (hfiniteL.subset ?_) ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      constructor
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        change ‖((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ)‖ ≤ 2 * R
        rw [show ((e z : L) : Fin n → ℝ) = fun i => (z i : ℝ) by
          simpa [e, L] using coe_intVectorEquivStandardIntegerLattice z]
        refine (show ‖(fun i => (z i : ℝ))‖ ≤ ‖intVectorToReal z‖ by
          rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
          intro i
          simpa [intVectorToReal] using PiLp.norm_apply_le (intVectorToReal z) i).trans hz
      · exact SetLike.coe_mem _
    · intro z _ w _ h
      exact e.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  filter_upwards [hbad.compl_mem_cofinite] with z hz
  have hzlarge : 2 * R < ‖intVectorToReal z‖ := by
    simpa [bad] using hz
  have hznorm : 0 < ‖intVectorToReal z‖ :=
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hR).trans_lt hzlarge
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (by positivity)).2
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hKR hx
  let u := x + intVectorToReal z
  have hu_lower : ‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2 ≤ ‖u‖ := by
    have htri : ‖intVectorToReal z‖ - ‖x‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      simpa [u, add_comm] using norm_sub_norm_le (intVectorToReal z) (-x)
    calc
      ‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2 ≤ ‖intVectorToReal z‖ - R := by linarith
      _ ≤ ‖intVectorToReal z‖ - ‖x‖ := sub_le_sub_left hxR _
      _ ≤ ‖u‖ := htri
  have hu : 0 < ‖u‖ :=
    (div_pos hznorm (by norm_num)).trans_le hu_lower
  have hsem : ‖f u‖ ≤ A / ‖u‖ ^ k := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hu k)]
    simpa [A, mul_comm] using f.norm_pow_mul_le_seminorm ℝ k u
  have hpow : (‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2) ^ k ≤ ‖u‖ ^ k := by
    gcongr
  have hdiv : A / ‖u‖ ^ k ≤ A / (‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2) ^ k :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (pow_pos (div_pos hznorm (by norm_num)) k) hpow
  calc
    ‖integerTranslate (⟨f, f.continuous⟩ :
        ContinuousMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ) z x‖ = ‖f u‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ A / ‖u‖ ^ k := hsem
    _ ≤ A / (‖intVectorToReal z‖ / 2) ^ k := hdiv
    _ = majorant z := by
      dsimp only [majorant]
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (norm_nonneg _) k, Real.rpow_natCast]
      field_simp
      rw [div_pow]
      field_simp

name: SRG266.Lattice.SchwartzMap.summable_fourier_intVector
statement:
theorem SchwartzMap.summable_fourier_intVector {n : ℕ}
    (f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ) :
    Summable fun m : Fin n → ℤ =>
      𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)
proof:
:= by
  let F : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ := 𝓕 f
  have hlocal :=
    SRG266.Lattice.SchwartzMap.locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates F
  have hsum := summable_integerValues_of_locallyNormal
    (⟨F, F.continuous⟩ : ContinuousMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ) hlocal
  refine hsum.congr fun m => ?_
  change (𝓕 f : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℂ)
      (intVectorToReal m) =
    𝓕 (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℂ) (intVectorToReal m)
  exact congrFun (SchwartzMap.fourier_coe f) (intVectorToReal m)

name: SRG266.Lattice.cyclicGlueLattice_isLattice
statement:
theorem cyclicGlueLattice_isLattice (hN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hM : IsLattice ℚ M) :
    IsLattice ℚ (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.FG.sup (isLattice_prod hN hM).fg
    (Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_singleton _)), ?_⟩
  refine top_unique ?_
  rw [← (isLattice_prod hN hM).spans]
  exact Submodule.span_mono (fun _ hz => Submodule.mem_sup_left hz)

name: SRG266.Lattice.cyclicGlueLattice_isIntegral
statement:
theorem cyclicGlueLattice_isIntegral (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hsC : C.IsSymm)
    (hN : IsIntegral B N) (hM : IsIntegral C M)
    (hu : u ∈ B.dualSubmodule N) (hv : v ∈ C.dualSubmodule M)
    (hdiag : B u u + C v v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) :
    IsIntegral (prodForm B C) (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_sup_span (prodForm_isSymm hsB hsC) (isIntegral_prod hN hM) ?_ ?_
  · rintro z hz _ (rfl : _ = (u, v))
    rw [prodForm_apply, hsB.eq, hsC.eq]
    exact add_mem (hu z.1 hz.1) (hv z.2 hz.2)
  · rintro _ (rfl : _ = (u, v)) _ (rfl : _ = (u, v))
    exact hdiag

name: SRG266.Lattice.isEven_sup_span
statement:
theorem isEven_sup_span {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    {F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X} (hs : F.IsSymm) {P : Submodule ℤ X} {s : Set X}
    (hint : IsIntegral F (P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s)) (hP : IsEven F P)
    (he : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ a : ℤ, F x x = 2 * (a : ℚ)) :
    IsEven F (P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hP a ha
  have hspan : IsIntegral F (Submodule.span ℤ s) :=
    fun _ hz _ hw => hint (Submodule.mem_sup_right hz) _ (Submodule.mem_sup_right hw)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := isEven_of_span F hs hspan he b hb
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp
    (hint (Submodule.mem_sup_left ha) b (Submodule.mem_sup_right hb))
  refine ⟨i + j + k, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [hs.eq b a, hi, hj, ← hk]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.cyclicGlueLattice_isEven
statement:
theorem cyclicGlueLattice_isEven (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hsC : C.IsSymm)
    (hint : IsIntegral (prodForm B C) (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v))
    (hN : IsEven B N) (hM : IsEven C M)
    (hdiag : ∃ k : ℤ, B u u + C v v = 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    IsEven (prodForm B C) (cyclicGlueLattice N M u v)
proof:
:= by
  refine isEven_sup_span (prodForm_isSymm hsB hsC) hint ?_ ?_
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hN z.1 hz.1
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hM z.2 hz.2
    refine ⟨i + j, ?_⟩
    rw [prodForm_apply, hi, hj]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rintro _ (rfl : _ = (u, v))
    exact hdiag

name: SRG266.Lattice.cyclicGlueLattice_mem_left_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, heq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
    have hs := congrArg Prod.snd heq
    change a.2 + m • v = 0 at hs
    have hm : m • v ∈ M := by
      rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hs]
      exact M.neg_mem ha.2
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hv m).mp hm
    have hmu : m • u ∈ N := by
      have he : m • u = k • (p • u) := by rw [hk]; module
      rw [he]
      exact N.smul_mem k hu
    have hf := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    change a.1 + m • u = x at hf
    rw [← hf]
    exact N.add_mem ha.1 hmu
  · intro hx
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨hx, M.zero_mem⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.cyclicGlueLattice_mem_right_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, heq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
    have hf := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    change a.1 + m • u = 0 at hf
    have hm : m • u ∈ N := by
      rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hf]
      exact N.neg_mem ha.1
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hu m).mp hm
    have hmv : m • v ∈ M := by
      have he : m • v = k • (p • v) := by rw [hk]; module
      rw [he]
      exact M.smul_mem k hv
    have hs := congrArg Prod.snd heq
    change a.2 + m • v = y at hs
    rw [← hs]
    exact M.add_mem ha.2 hmv
  · intro hy
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨N.zero_mem, hy⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.marked_product_frame_second_moment
statement:
theorem marked_product_frame_second_moment {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (g : ι → W) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ) (a : ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ w, (∑ i, (B w (g i))^2) = a*B w w)
    (r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) (hr : r.1.2 = 0) :
    (∑ i, (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r ((g i, s), 0))^2) =
      a*(prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r-C r.2 r.2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [prodForm_apply, hr, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero,
    add_sub_cancel_right] using hm r.1.1

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_complement_pair_with_lift
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_complement_pair_with_lift
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (H : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y) (part : (Fin 24 → ℚ) → Y) (lift : Y → (Fin 24 → ℚ))
    (hlift : ∀ q y, adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types q (lift y) = H (part q) y)
    (t : U) (y : Y) :
    C t (ψ (lift y)).2 = H (part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), t))) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := hpair (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), t)) (lift y)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hlift] at h
  simpa only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_component_moment_defect
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_component_moment_defect {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hC : C.IsSymm)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (H : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y) (hH : H.IsSymm)
    (part : (Fin 24 → ℚ) → Y) (lift : Y → (Fin 24 → ℚ))
    (hpart : ∀ y, part (lift y) = y)
    (hlift : ∀ q y, adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types q (lift y) = H (part q) y)
    (hD : ∀ y, a11D7E6D7Projection (lift y) = 0)
    (g : ι → W) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ) (a : ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ w, (∑ i, (B w (g i))^2) = a*B w w) (y : Y) :
    (∑ i, (H y (part (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U)))))^2) =
      a*(H y y-C (ψ (lift y)).2 (ψ (lift y)).2)
proof:
:= by
  let F := prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C
  have hsym : F.IsSymm := prodForm_isSymm (prodForm_isSymm hB (standardRatForm_isSymm 7)) hC
  have hzero : (ψ (lift y)).1.2 = 0 := by
    have h := hmarked (lift y)
    rw [hD y, map_zero] at h
    exact congrArg (fun r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U => r.1.2) h
  have hp (i : ι) : F (ψ (lift y)) ((g i, s), (0 : U)) =
      H y (part (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U)))) := by
    rw [hsym.eq]
    have h := hpair (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U))) (lift y)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hlift, hH.eq] at h
    exact h
  have hn : F (ψ (lift y)) (ψ (lift y)) = H y y := by
    rw [hpair, hlift, hpart]
  have h := marked_product_frame_second_moment B C g s a hm (ψ (lift y)) hzero
  change (∑ i, (F (ψ (lift y)) ((g i, s), (0 : U)))^2) =
    a*(F (ψ (lift y)) (ψ (lift y))-C (ψ (lift y)).2 (ψ (lift y)).2) at h
  simpa only [hp, hn] using h

  refine sup_le (fun z hz => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · change simplexRatForm 7 0 z.1 + rightForm fifth z.2 ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)

name: SRG266.Lattice.K8Coordinates.dualVector_order
statement: theorem dualVector_order (m : ℤ) : m • dualVector ∈ lattice ↔ 5 ∣ m
proof:

  · intro hm
    apply norm_denominator_unit (p := 5) (r := 2) (k := 0) (by norm_num)
      ⟨1, -2, by norm_num⟩ (by simpa using dualVector_norm) m
    have h := dualVector_mem_dual _ hm
    have heq : m • dualVector = (m : ℚ) • dualVector := by module
    rwa [heq, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have heq : (5 * k) • dualVector = k • ((5 : ℤ) • dualVector) := by module
    rw [heq]
    exact lattice.smul_mem k five_smul_dualVector_mem

name: SRG266.Lattice.K8Coordinates.lattice_dual
statement: theorem lattice_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice = lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {dualVector}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hp : z ∈ (prodForm (simplexRatForm 7) rightForm).dualSubmodule
        ((coordinateIntegerLattice 7).prod (coordinateIntegerLattice 1)) :=
      fun w hw => hz w (Submodule.mem_sup_left hw)
    rw [dualSubmodule_prodForm] at hp
    obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hp
    rw [simplexRatForm_dual] at hx
    obtain ⟨nx, hnx, bw, hbw, heqx⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hbw
    have hy' := (mem_dual_smul_form_iff (B := standardRatForm 1)
      (N := coordinateIntegerLattice 1) (10 : ℚ) z.2).mp hy
    rw [standardRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice] at hy'
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mp hy'
    have hy0 : z.2 0 = (d 0 : ℚ) / 10 := by
      have h := hd 0
      change (d 0 : ℚ) = 10 * z.2 0 at h
      linarith
    have hn : (nx, (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)) ∈ lattice :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨hnx, (coordinateIntegerLattice 1).zero_mem⟩
    have hg : glueVector ∈ lattice :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have hng := lattice_isIntegral hn glueVector hg
    have hzg := hz glueVector hg
    have hleft : simplexRatForm 7 (simplexWeight 7) ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 7) = 7 / 4 := by
      norm_num [simplexWeight_pair, simplexWeight, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have he : form z glueVector = form (nx, 0) glueVector +
        (b : ℚ) * (7 / 4) + (d 0 : ℚ) / 2 := by
      change simplexRatForm 7 z.1 ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 7) + rightForm z.2 half = _
      rw [← heqx]
      have hb : b • simplexWeight 7 = (b : ℚ) • simplexWeight 7 := by module
      rw [hb]
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, hleft, form, prodForm_apply, glueVector]
      norm_num [rightForm, standardRatForm_apply, half, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hy0]
      ring
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hng
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hzg
    have hQ : (7 : ℚ) * b + 2 * d 0 = 4 * ((t : ℚ) - r) := by
      rw [he, ← hr] at ht
      linarith
    have hZ : 7 * b + 2 * d 0 = 4 * (t - r) := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    have hb : (2 : ℤ) ∣ b := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hb
    have hd' : (2 : ℤ) ∣ d 0 - 5 * k := by omega
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hd'
    have hdecomp : z = ((nx, (0 : Fin 1 → ℚ)) + k • glueVector) + l • dualVector := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · change z.1 = (nx + k • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 7)) + l • (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)
        rw [← heqx, hk]
        module
      · ext i
        fin_cases i
        change z.2 0 = (0 + k • (1 / 2 : ℚ)) + l • (1 / 5 : ℚ)
        simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, zero_add]
        rw [hy0]
        have h : (d 0 : ℚ) - 5 * (k : ℚ) = 2 * (l : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
        linarith
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (lattice.add_mem hn (lattice.smul_mem k hg))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ l (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · refine sup_le lattice_isIntegral (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = dualVector)
    exact dualVector_mem_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateRootMap_pos_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem coordinateRootMap_pos_of_nonneg
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f)
    (z : Fin m → ℤ) (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i) (hz0 : z ≠ 0) :
    0 < f (coordinateRootMap coord z)
proof:
:= by
  have hfpos (i : Fin m) : 0 < f (normTwoRootVal (coord i).1) :=
    IsAddIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_pos normTwoRootVal f (coord i).2
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 0 < z i := by
    by_contra h
    simp only [not_exists, not_lt] at h
    apply hz0
    funext i
    exact le_antisymm (h i) (hz i)
  change 0 < toZLinearMap f (coordinateRootMap coord z)
  simp only [coordinateRootMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum,
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul, toZLinearMap_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_pos'
    (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hz j) (hfpos j).le)
    ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, mul_pos hi (hfpos i)⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.dominant_vector_height_eq_of_coordinates
statement:
theorem dominant_vector_height_eq_of_coordinates
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℤ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) = A i j)
    (h : ℤ)
    (hheight : ∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (z : Fin m → ℤ),
      coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ L.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) → (∑ i, z i) = h)
    {k : ℤ} (hv : HasDominantVector A k) : k = h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hn, hd, hs⟩ := hv
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    subst z
    simp at hn
  let θ : NormTwoRoot L :=
    ⟨coordinateRootMap coord z, (coordinateRootMap_pairing hf coord A hA z z).trans hn⟩
  have hθ : 0 < f θ.1 := coordinateRootMap_pos_of_nonneg coord z hz hz0
  have hdom (i : Fin m) : 0 ≤ L.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1 := by
    have hij (j : Fin m) : L.pairing (coord i).1.1 (coord j).1.1 = A i j :=
      (graphCartanMatrix_simpleRootGraph f hf (coord i) (coord j)).symm.trans (hA i j)
    change 0 ≤ L.pairing (coord i).1.1 (coordinateRootMap coord z)
    simp only [coordinateRootMap, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul, normTwoRootVal]
    simp_rw [hij]
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using hd i
  exact hs.symm.trans (hheight θ z rfl hθ hdom)

name: SRG266.Lattice.ade_component_dominantHeight_eq
statement:
theorem ade_component_dominantHeight_eq
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    {ts : List ADEType} (hregular : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular)
    (coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
      (adeGram ts).2 i j)
    (h : ℤ)
    (hheight : ∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (z : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ),
      coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ L.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) → (∑ i, z i) = h) :
    ∀ t ∈ ts, t.dominantHeight = h
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  exact dominant_vector_height_eq_of_coordinates hf coord (adeGram ts).2 hgram
    h hheight (adeGram_hasDominantVector_of_mem ht (hregular t ht))

name: SRG266.Lattice.pairing_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem pairing_self_nonneg {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x : L.carrier) : 0 ≤ L.pairing x x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · exact (L.positiveDefinite x hx).le

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_finite
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_finite {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    Finite (NormTwoRoot L)
proof:
:= by
  let := L.moduleFree
  let := L.moduleFinite
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ L.carrier :=
    Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℤ L.carrier L.rank
  choose d hd using fun i : Fin n => L.unimodular.2 (b.coord i)
  let bound : Fin n → ℤ := fun i => 2 * L.pairing (d i) (d i) + 1
  let BoxCoord : Fin n → Type := fun i =>
    {a : ℤ // a ∈ Set.Icc (-bound i) (bound i)}
  let (i : Fin n) : Fintype (BoxCoord i) :=
    (Set.finite_Icc (-bound i) (bound i)).fintype
  let encode : NormTwoRoot L → (∀ i, BoxCoord i) := fun r i =>
    ⟨b.equivFun r.1 i, by
      have hcoord : b.equivFun r.1 i = L.pairing (d i) r.1 := by
        change b.coord i r.1 = L.pairing (d i) r.1
        exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (hd i) r.1).symm
      have hcs := L.pairing.apply_sq_le_of_symm
        (pairing_self_nonneg L)
        (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp L.symmetric) (d i) r.1
      rw [r.2] at hcs
      have hq := pairing_self_nonneg L (d i)
      change -bound i ≤ b.equivFun r.1 i ∧
        b.equivFun r.1 i ≤ bound i
      dsimp only [bound]
      rw [hcoord]
      constructor <;> nlinarith⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective encode fun r s hrs => by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply b.equivFun.injective
    funext i
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hrs i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6A11Lift_norm
statement:
theorem a11D7E6A11Lift_norm (u : Fin 11 → ℚ) :
    adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types (a11D7E6A11Lift u) (a11D7E6A11Lift u) =
      cartanARatForm 11 u u
proof:
:= by
  rw [a11D7E6A11Lift_pair, a11D7E6A11Part_lift]

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_component_forms_pos
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_component_forms_pos
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hpos : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < F x x) :
    (∀ u, u ≠ 0 → 0 < cartanARatForm 11 u u) ∧
      (∀ v, v ≠ 0 → 0 < E6Cartan.form v v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro u hu
    have hl : a11D7E6A11Lift u ≠ (0 : Fin 24 → ℚ) := by
      intro h
      apply hu
      rw [← a11D7E6A11Part_lift u, h]
      rfl
    have h := hpos (ψ (a11D7E6A11Lift u))
      (fun hz => hl (ψ.injective (by simpa only [map_zero] using hz)))
    rwa [hpair, a11D7E6A11Lift_norm] at h
  · intro v hv
    have hl : a11D7E6E6Lift v ≠ (0 : Fin 24 → ℚ) := by
      intro h
      apply hv
      rw [← a11D7E6E6Part_lift v, h]
      rfl
    have h := hpos (ψ (a11D7E6E6Lift v))
      (fun hz => hl (ψ.injective (by simpa only [map_zero] using hz)))
    rwa [hpair, a11D7E6E6Lift_norm] at h

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_A11_even_of_integer_coordinates
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_A11_even_of_integer_coordinates
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hpair : ∀ u v, F (ψ u) (ψ v) = adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L) (he : IsEven F L)
    {q : Fin 24 → ℚ} (hq : q ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, cartanARatForm 11 (a11D7E6A11Part q) (a11D7E6A11Part q) = 2*(m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : ψ (a11D7E6A11Lift (a11D7E6A11Part q)) ∈ L := by
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hq
    change ψ (a11D7E6A11Lift (intCoordsToRat (a11D7E6A11Part z))) ∈ L
    rw [a11D7E6A11Lift_intCast]
    exact hmem _
  simpa only [hpair, a11D7E6A11Lift_norm] using he _ hm

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (r s : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) (hrD : r.1.2 = 0) :
    prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r s =
      cartanARatForm 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) +
      E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm s))
proof:
:= by
  have hD : a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm r) = 0 := by
    apply ψ.injective
    rw [← hmarked, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero]
    change (((0 : W), r.1.2), (0 : U)) = 0
    rw [hrD]
    rfl
  have hp := hpair (ψ.symm r) (ψ.symm s)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    a11D7E6_pair_decomposition, hD] at hp
  erw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hp
  simpa only [add_zero] using hp

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_root_in_one_component
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_root_in_one_component
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (he : IsEven (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C) L)
    (hpos : ∀ r, r ≠ 0 → 0 < prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r)
    (r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) (hr : ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24)
    (hrnorm : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r = 2) (hrD : r.1.2 = 0) :
    a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r) = 0 ∨ a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpos' := a11D7E6_component_forms_pos _ ψ hpair hpos
  apply zero_or_zero_of_even_sum_two (cartanARatForm 11) E6Cartan.form
    hpos'.1 hpos'.2 _ _ (a11D7E6_A11_even_of_integer_coordinates _ L ψ hpair hmem he hr)
  exact (a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero B C ψ hpair hmarked r r hrD).symm.trans hrnorm

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_A_chain_in_one_component
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_A_chain_in_one_component
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (hmem : ∀ z : Fin 24 → ℤ, ψ (intCoordsToRat z) ∈ L)
    (he : IsEven (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C) L)
    (hpos : ∀ r, r ≠ 0 → 0 < prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r)
    (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (n+1) → (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U)
    (hr : ∀ i, ψ.symm (r i) ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 24) (hrD : ∀ i, (r i).1.2 = 0)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (r i) (r j) =
      (gramA (n+1) i j : ℚ)) :
    (∀ i, a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm (r i)) = 0) ∨
      (∀ i, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm (r i)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply A_chain_in_one_component (cartanARatForm 11) E6Cartan.form n
  · intro i
    apply a11D7E6_root_in_one_component B C L ψ hpair hmarked hmem he hpos
      (r i) (hr i) _ (hrD i)
    rw [hgram]
    norm_num [gramA, gramAEntry]
  · intro i j
    exact (a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero B C ψ hpair hmarked (r i) (r j) (hrD i)).symm.trans
      (hgram i j)

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_positive_sum_pairing_combination
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_positive_sum_pairing_combination
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ) :
    (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L with 0 < f r.1, L.pairing r.1 (simpleRootCombination f z)) =
      2 * (∑ s, z s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ s : simpleRootSet f, z s *
        (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L with 0 < f r.1, L.pairing r.1 s.1.1) := by
      simp only [simpleRootCombination, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum,
        map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ s : simpleRootSet f, z s * 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      rw [normTwoRoot_positive_sum_pairing_simple L f hf s.1 s.2]
    _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]; ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_scalar_eq_twice_dominant_height
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_scalar_eq_twice_dominant_height
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (hθ : 0 < f θ.1)
    (hdom : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, 0 < f r.1 → 0 ≤ L.pairing r.1 θ.1)
    (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ) (hz : simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1)
    (c : ℤ)
    (hm : (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, (L.pairing r.1 θ.1) ^ 2) = 2 * c) :
    c = 2 * ((∑ s, z s) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst := normTwoRoot_positive_sum_pairing_combination L f hf z
  rw [hz] at hfirst
  have hdomsum := normTwoRoot_dominant_positive_sum L f hf θ hθ hdom c hm
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_dominant_of_simple_pairings
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_dominant_of_simple_pairings
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (θ : NormTwoRoot L)
    (hdom : ∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ L.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) :
    ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, 0 < f r.1 → 0 ≤ L.pairing r.1 θ.1
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  have hclosure : ∀ x,
      x ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f) →
      0 ≤ L.pairing x θ.1 := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact hdom ⟨s, hs⟩
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
        simpa only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] using add_nonneg hx hy
  exact hclosure r.1 (positiveRoot_mem_simpleRootClosure f hr)

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_coordinate_eigenvalues_of_split
statement:
theorem sum_coordinate_eigenvalues_of_split
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (f : (ι → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (κ → ℚ)) (g : (κ → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (ι → ℚ))
    (hfg : f.comp g = LinearMap.id) (a : ι → ℚ)
    (ha : ∀ i, g (f (Pi.single i 1)) = a i • Pi.single i 1) :
    (∑ i, a i) = (Fintype.card κ : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : LinearMap.trace ℚ (ι → ℚ) (g.comp f) = ∑ i, a i := by
    rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace ℚ (Pi.basisFun ℚ ι)]
    simp [Matrix.trace, ha]
  have h := LinearMap.trace_comp_comm' f g
  rw [ht, hfg, LinearMap.trace_id] at h
  simpa using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.isEven_of_span
statement:
theorem isEven_of_span (hsymm : B.IsSymm) {s : Set W}
    (hint : IsIntegral B (Submodule.span ℤ s))
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ n : ℤ, B x x = 2 * (n : ℚ)) :
    IsEven B (Submodule.span ℤ s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact hs x hx
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ihx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ihy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (hint hx y hy)
    have hk' : (k : ℚ) = B x y := by simpa using hk
    refine ⟨a + b + k, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    rw [hsymm.eq y x, ha, hb, ← hk']
    push_cast
    ring
  | smul a x _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨a ^ 2 * k, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul, hk]
    push_cast
    ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.IsEven.of_odd_smul
statement:
theorem IsEven.of_odd_smul {N P : Submodule ℤ W} (hN : IsEven B N)
    (hP : IsIntegral B P) {m : ℤ} (hm : Odd m)
    (hsmul : ∀ x ∈ P, m • x ∈ N) : IsEven B P
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp (hP hx x hx)
  have hn' : (n : ℚ) = B x x := by simpa using hn
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hN _ (hsmul x hx)
  have heq : (m : ℚ) ^ 2 * (n : ℚ) = 2 * (a : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, zsmul_eq_mul, ← hn',
      pow_two, mul_assoc] using ha
  have hdiv : (2 : ℤ) ∣ m ^ 2 * n := ⟨a, by exact_mod_cast heq⟩
  have hdivn : (2 : ℤ) ∣ n :=
    (Int.isCoprime_two_left.mpr hm.pow).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdiv
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdivn
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  rw [← hn', hk]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_even_maximal_integral_overlattice_denominator
statement:
theorem exists_even_maximal_integral_overlattice_denominator
    (hnd : B.Nondegenerate) (hsymm : B.IsSymm)
    {N : Submodule ℤ W} (hN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hint : IsIntegral B N)
    (heven : IsEven B N) {k m : ℤ} {j : ℕ} (hkodd : Odd k)
    (hk : ∀ y ∈ B.dualSubmodule N, k • y ∈ N) (hdvd : k ∣ m ^ j) :
    ∃ P : Submodule ℤ W, N ≤ P ∧ IsLattice ℚ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral B P ∧
      IsEven B P ∧ ∀ y ∈ B.dualSubmodule P, m • y ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, hden⟩ :=
    exists_maximal_integral_overlattice_denominator B hnd hsymm hN hint hk hdvd
  refine ⟨P, hle, hlat, hmax, ?_, hden⟩
  exact heven.of_odd_smul B hmax.integral hkodd
    (fun x hx => hk x (le_dual_of_le B hle hmax.integral hx))
