name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6D7Projection_pair
statement:
theorem a11D7E6D7Projection_pair (u v : Fin 24 → ℚ) :
    adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types (a11D7E6D7Projection u) (a11D7E6D7Projection v) =
      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j : Fin 7 => (gramD 7 i j : ℚ))
        (fun i => u ((finADEBlockEquiv a11D7E6Types).symm (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))))
        (fun i => v ((finADEBlockEquiv a11D7E6Types).symm (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [adeRootRatForm_reindex]
  simp only [a11D7E6D7Projection, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    a11D7E6D7Scalar, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  erw [adeBlockRatForm_cons, adeBlockRatForm_cons, adeBlockRatForm_cons]
  simp only [a11D7E6D7BlockScalar, zero_mul, one_mul]
  erw [map_zero, map_zero, adeBlockRatForm_nil]
  simp only [zero_add, add_zero]
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_pair_decomposition
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_pair_decomposition (u v : Fin 24 → ℚ) :
    adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v =
      cartanARatForm 11 (a11D7E6A11Part u) (a11D7E6A11Part v) +
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types (a11D7E6D7Projection u) (a11D7E6D7Projection v) +
      E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part u) (a11D7E6E6Part v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [a11D7E6D7Projection_pair, adeRootRatForm_reindex]
  erw [adeBlockRatForm_cons, adeBlockRatForm_cons, adeBlockRatForm_cons,
    adeBlockRatForm_nil]
  simp only [add_zero, add_assoc]
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_remaining_energy
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_remaining_energy
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U)
    (hnorm : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r = 4)
    (hdnorm : standardRatForm 7 r.1.2 r.1.2 = 7/4) :
    let u := ψ.symm r
    cartanARatForm 11 (a11D7E6A11Part u) (a11D7E6A11Part u) +
      E6Cartan.form (a11D7E6E6Part u) (a11D7E6E6Part u) = 9/4
proof:
:= by
  have hd : adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types (a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm r))
      (a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm r)) = 7/4 := by
    rw [← hpair, ← hmarked, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simpa [middleCoordinateInclusion, middleCoordinateProjection, prodForm_apply] using hdnorm
  have h := hpair (ψ.symm r) (ψ.symm r)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hnorm, a11D7E6_pair_decomposition, hd] at h
  dsimp only
  linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.int_sq_ne_twenty
statement: theorem int_sq_ne_twenty (d : ℤ) : d^2 ≠ 20
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := Int.emod_nonneg d (show (3 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
  have h3 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos d (show (0 : ℤ) < 3 by norm_num)
  have hr : d%3 = 0 ∨ d%3 = 1 ∨ d%3 = 2 := by omega
  have hm := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z%3) h
  rw [pow_two, Int.mul_emod] at hm
  rcases hr with h | h | h <;> norm_num [h] at hm

name: SRG266.Lattice.rat_sq_ne_twenty
statement: theorem rat_sq_ne_twenty (d : ℚ) : d^2 ≠ 20
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsq : IsSquare (20 : ℚ) := ⟨d, by simpa only [pow_two] using h.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Rat.isSquare_intCast_iff.mp
    (show IsSquare ((20 : ℤ) : ℚ) from hsq)
  exact int_sq_ne_twenty z (by simpa only [pow_two] using hz.symm)

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.exists_gram_det_square
statement:
theorem exists_gram_det_square {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (e : ι ≃ Fin 6) (r : ι → Fin 6 → ℚ) :
    ∃ d : ℚ, Matrix.det (fun i j => form (r i) (r j)) = 3*d^2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := gram_det_square_reindex (fun i j => (gramE 6 i j : ℚ)) e r
  have hdet : Matrix.det (fun i j => (gramE 6 i j : ℚ)) = 3 := by
    change ((gramE 6).map (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℚ))).det = 3
    rw [← Int.cast_det, gramE_six_det]
    rfl
  exact ⟨d, by simpa only [form, hdet] using hd⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.no_rational_A4_twoA2
statement:
theorem no_rational_A4_twoA2 (r : Fin 4 → Fin 6 → ℚ) (u t : Fin 6 → ℚ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, form (r i) (r j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ))
    (hru : ∀ i, form (r i) u = 0) (hrt : ∀ i, form (r i) t = 0)
    (huu : form u u = 4) (htt : form t t = 4) (hut : form u t = -2) : False
proof:
:= by
  let rows : (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) → Fin 6 → ℚ := Sum.elim r ![u, t]
  have hgram : (fun i j => form (rows i) (rows j)) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (fun i j => (gramA 4 i j : ℚ)) 0 0 !![4, -2; -2, 4] := by
    ext i j
    rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
    · exact hA i j
    · fin_cases j
      · exact hru i
      · exact hrt i
    · fin_cases i
      · exact (form_isSymm.eq u (r j)).trans (hru j)
      · exact (form_isSymm.eq t (r j)).trans (hrt j)
    · fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · exact huu
      · exact hut
      · exact (form_isSymm.eq t u).trans hut
      · exact htt
  have hdet : Matrix.det (fun i j => form (rows i) (rows j)) = 60 := by
    rw [hgram, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
    change ((gramA 4).map (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℚ))).det * (!![4, -2; -2, 4] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℚ).det = 60
    rw [← Int.cast_det, gramA_four_det]
    norm_num [Matrix.det_fin_two]
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_gram_det_square
    (finSumFinEquiv : (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ≃ Fin 6) rows
  exact rat_sq_ne_twenty d (by linarith)

name: SRG266.Lattice.HasDominantVector.reindex
statement:
theorem HasDominantVector.reindex
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {B : Matrix κ κ ℤ} {h : ℤ}
    (hv : HasDominantVector A h) (e : κ ≃ ι)
    (hB : ∀ i j, B i j = A (e i) (e j)) : HasDominantVector B h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hn, hd, hs⟩ := hv
  have hrow (i : κ) : (B *ᵥ (fun j => z (e j))) i = (A *ᵥ z) (e i) := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hB]
    exact Equiv.sum_comp e (fun j => A (e i) j * z j)
  refine ⟨fun i => z (e i), fun i => hz (e i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.toBilin'_apply'] at hn ⊢
    simp only [dotProduct] at hn ⊢
    simp_rw [hrow]
    exact (Equiv.sum_comp e (fun i => z i * (A *ᵥ z) i)).trans hn
  · intro i
    rw [hrow]
    exact hd (e i)
  · exact (Equiv.sum_comp e z).trans hs

name: SRG266.Lattice.HasDominantVector.blockLeft
statement:
theorem HasDominantVector.blockLeft
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℤ} (B : Matrix κ κ ℤ) {h : ℤ}
    (hv : HasDominantVector A h) :
    HasDominantVector (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hn, hd, hs⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨Sum.elim z (fun _ => 0), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro (i | i)
    · exact hz i
    · exact le_rfl
  · simpa [Matrix.toBilin'_apply', Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks] using hn
  · rintro (i | i)
    · simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
        Matrix.fromBlocks] using hd i
    · simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks]
  · simpa [Fintype.sum_sum_type] using hs

name: SRG266.Lattice.HasDominantVector.blockRight
statement:
theorem HasDominantVector.blockRight
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ) {B : Matrix κ κ ℤ} {h : ℤ}
    (hv : HasDominantVector B h) :
    HasDominantVector (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B) h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hn, hd, hs⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) z, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro (i | i)
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact hz i
  · simpa [Matrix.toBilin'_apply', Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks] using hn
  · rintro (i | i)
    · simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.fromBlocks]
    · simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
        Matrix.fromBlocks] using hd i
  · simpa [Fintype.sum_sum_type] using hs

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeBlock_hasDominantVector_of_mem
statement:
theorem adeBlock_hasDominantVector_of_mem
    {t : ADEType} {ts : List ADEType} {h : ℤ}
    (ht : t ∈ ts) (hv : HasDominantVector t.gram h) :
    HasDominantVector (adeBlockPairing ts) h
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with
  | nil => simp at ht
  | cons s ts ih =>
      have hM : adeBlockPairing (s :: ts) =
          Matrix.fromBlocks s.gram 0 0 (adeBlockPairing ts) := by
        ext (i | i) (j | j) <;> rfl
      rw [hM]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ht with rfl | ht
      · exact hv.blockLeft _
      · exact (ih ht).blockRight _

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeGram_hasDominantVector_of_mem
statement:
theorem adeGram_hasDominantVector_of_mem
    {t : ADEType} {ts : List ADEType} (ht : t ∈ ts) (hregular : t.IsRegular) :
    HasDominantVector (adeGram ts).2 t.dominantHeight
proof:
:=
  (adeBlock_hasDominantVector_of_mem ht (t.hasDominantVector hregular)).reindex
    (finADEBlockEquiv ts) (adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing ts)

name: SRG266.Lattice.SchwartzMap.summable_zlattice
statement:
theorem SchwartzMap.summable_zlattice
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [ProperSpace E]
    (L : Submodule ℤ E) [DiscreteTopology L]
    (f : 𝓢(E, ℂ)) : Summable fun z : L => f z
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := -(Module.finrank ℤ L : ℝ) - 1
  have hr : r < -(Module.finrank ℤ L : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [r]
    linarith
  have hclosed : IsClosed (L : Set E) :=
    @AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_discrete E _ _ _ _ L.toAddSubgroup
      (inferInstanceAs (DiscreteTopology L))
  have htend : Tendsto ((↑) : L → E) cofinite (cocompact E) :=
    hclosed.tendsto_coe_cofinite_of_isDiscrete DiscreteTopology.isDiscrete
  exact summable_of_isBigO (ZLattice.summable_norm_rpow L r hr)
    ((f.isBigO_cocompact_rpow r).comp_tendsto htend)

name: SRG266.Lattice.piPoisson_of_periodization
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeffSummable :
      Summable (UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff P.periodization) :=
    P.fourierSummable.congr fun m => (P.fourierCoeff m).symm
  have hseries := UnitAddTorus.hasSum_mFourier_series_apply_of_summable
    hcoeffSummable (0 : UnitAddTorus (Fin n))
  have hcoeffSeries :
      HasSum (UnitAddTorus.mFourierCoeff P.periodization)
        (P.periodization 0) := by
    refine hseries.congr_fun fun m => ?_
    simp [UnitAddTorus.mFourier]
  have hfourierSeries :
      HasSum (fun m : Fin n → ℤ => 𝓕 f (intVectorToReal m))
        (P.periodization 0) :=
    hcoeffSeries.congr_fun fun m => (P.fourierCoeff m).symm
  calc
    (∑' z : Fin n → ℤ, f (intVectorToReal z)) =
        P.periodization 0 := P.periodization_zero.symm
    _ = ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ, 𝓕 f (intVectorToReal m) :=
      hfourierSeries.tsum_eq.symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex
statement:
theorem connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex :
    ∀ (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent) (i : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf)),
      G.connectedComponentMk (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i) ∈ cs
proof:
| [], i => nomatch i
  | c :: cs, Sum.inl i => by
      simp only [componentBlockToVertex, List.mem_cons]
      left
      exact (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c (coord c i).1).mp (coord c i).2
  | c :: cs, Sum.inr i => by
      simp only [componentBlockToVertex, List.mem_cons]
      exact Or.inr (connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex cs i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.componentBlockToVertex_injective
statement:
theorem componentBlockToVertex_injective :
    ∀ {cs : List G.ConnectedComponent}, cs.Nodup →
      Function.Injective (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs)
proof:
| [], _, i, _ => nomatch i
  | c :: cs, hnodup, i, j => by
      have hcnot : c ∉ cs := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).1
      have htail : cs.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).2
      cases i with
      | inl i =>
          cases j with
          | inl j =>
              intro hij
              have hcoord : coord c i = coord c j := Subtype.ext hij
              have : i = j := (coord c).injective hcoord
              subst j
              rfl
          | inr j =>
              intro hij
              have hcomp := congrArg G.connectedComponentMk hij
              have hleft : G.connectedComponentMk (coord c i).1 = c :=
                (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c (coord c i).1).mp (coord c i).2
              have hright : G.connectedComponentMk
                  (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j) ∈ cs :=
                connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j
              exact (hcnot (hleft ▸ hcomp ▸ hright)).elim
      | inr i =>
          cases j with
          | inl j =>
              intro hij
              have hcomp := congrArg G.connectedComponentMk hij
              have hleft : G.connectedComponentMk
                  (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i) ∈ cs :=
                connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i
              have hright : G.connectedComponentMk (coord c j).1 = c :=
                (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c (coord c j).1).mp (coord c j).2
              exact (hcnot (hright ▸ hcomp.symm ▸ hleft)).elim
          | inr j =>
              intro hij
              have : i = j := componentBlockToVertex_injective htail hij
              subst j
              rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_componentBlockToVertex_eq
statement:
theorem exists_componentBlockToVertex_eq :
    ∀ (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent) (v : V),
      G.connectedComponentMk v ∈ cs →
        ∃ i : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf),
          componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i = v
proof:
| [], _, h => by simp at h
  | c :: cs, v, h => by
      rw [List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · have hv : v ∈ c := (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c v).mpr h
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (coord c).surjective ⟨v, hv⟩
        exact ⟨Sum.inl i, congrArg Subtype.val hi⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_componentBlockToVertex_eq cs v h
        exact ⟨Sum.inr i, hi⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.componentBlockToVertex_surjective
statement:
theorem componentBlockToVertex_surjective
    (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent)
    (hcover : ∀ c : G.ConnectedComponent, c ∈ cs) :
    Function.Surjective (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  exact exists_componentBlockToVertex_eq G typeOf coord cs v
    (hcover (G.connectedComponentMk v))

name: SRG266.Lattice.componentBlockEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentBlockEquiv_apply
    (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent) (hnodup : cs.Nodup)
    (hcover : ∀ c : G.ConnectedComponent, c ∈ cs)
    (i : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf)) :
    componentBlockEquiv G typeOf coord cs hnodup hcover i =
      componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_component
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_component
    (c : G.ConnectedComponent) (u v : c) :
    graphCartanMatrix G u.1 v.1 = graphCartanMatrix c.toSimpleGraph u v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · subst v
    rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_same, graphCartanMatrix_apply_same]
  · have huvval : u.1 ≠ v.1 := fun h => huv (Subtype.ext h)
    by_cases hadj : G.Adj u.1 v.1
    · have hcadj : c.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v :=
        (ConnectedComponent.toSimpleGraph_adj c u.2 v.2).mpr hadj
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hadj,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj hcadj]
    · have hcnot : ¬c.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v := fun h =>
        hadj ((ConnectedComponent.toSimpleGraph_adj c u.2 v.2).mp h)
      rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj huvval hadj,
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj huv hcnot]

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_eq_zero_of_components_ne
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_eq_zero_of_components_ne
    {u v : V} (huv : G.connectedComponentMk u ≠ G.connectedComponentMk v) :
    graphCartanMatrix G u v = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj
  · intro h
    exact huv (congrArg G.connectedComponentMk h)
  · intro h
    exact huv (ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj h)

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_componentBlock
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_componentBlock :
    ∀ (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent), cs.Nodup →
      (∀ c i j, graphCartanMatrix c.toSimpleGraph (coord c i) (coord c j) =
        (typeOf c).gram i j) →
      ∀ i j : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf),
        graphCartanMatrix G
            (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i)
            (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j) =
          adeBlockPairing (cs.map typeOf) i j
proof:
| [], _, _, i, _ => nomatch i
  | c :: cs, hnodup, hgram, i, j => by
      have hcnot : c ∉ cs := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).1
      have htail : cs.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup).2
      cases i with
      | inl i =>
          cases j with
          | inl j =>
              change graphCartanMatrix G (coord c i).1 (coord c j).1 = _
              rw [graphCartanMatrix_component G c (coord c i) (coord c j), hgram]
              rfl
          | inr j =>
              change graphCartanMatrix G (coord c i).1
                (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j) = 0
              apply graphCartanMatrix_eq_zero_of_components_ne G
              have hleft : G.connectedComponentMk (coord c i).1 = c :=
                (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c (coord c i).1).mp (coord c i).2
              have hright : G.connectedComponentMk
                  (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j) ∈ cs :=
                connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j
              intro heq
              exact hcnot (hleft ▸ heq ▸ hright)
      | inr i =>
          cases j with
          | inl j =>
              change graphCartanMatrix G
                (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i) (coord c j).1 = 0
              apply graphCartanMatrix_eq_zero_of_components_ne G
              have hleft : G.connectedComponentMk
                  (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i) ∈ cs :=
                connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i
              have hright : G.connectedComponentMk (coord c j).1 = c :=
                (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c (coord c j).1).mp (coord c j).2
              intro heq
              exact hcnot (hright ▸ heq.symm ▸ hleft)
          | inr j =>
              exact graphCartanMatrix_componentBlock cs htail hgram i j

name: SRG266.Lattice.positiveCartan_ADECoordinates_unbounded
statement:
theorem positiveCartan_ADECoordinates_unbounded
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) :
    ADECoordinates G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let typeOf : G.ConnectedComponent → ADEType :=
    componentADEType_unbounded G hpos
  let coordOf : ∀ c : G.ConnectedComponent, Fin (typeOf c).rank ≃ c :=
    componentADECoord_unbounded G hpos
  let cs : List G.ConnectedComponent := Finset.univ.toList
  let ts : List ADEType := cs.map typeOf
  have hnodup : cs.Nodup := by
    exact Finset.nodup_toList Finset.univ
  have hcover : ∀ c : G.ConnectedComponent, c ∈ cs := by
    intro c
    simp [cs]
  let blockEquiv : ADEBlockIndex ts ≃ V :=
    componentBlockEquiv G typeOf coordOf cs hnodup hcover
  let totalEquiv : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ V :=
    (finADEBlockEquiv ts).trans blockEquiv
  refine ⟨ts, ?_, ?_, totalEquiv, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    rw [List.mem_map] at ht
    obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := ht
    exact componentADEType_isRegular_unbounded G hpos c
  · have hcardEquiv := Fintype.card_congr totalEquiv
    simpa using hcardEquiv
  · intro i j
    change graphCartanMatrix G
      (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coordOf cs (finADEBlockEquiv ts i))
      (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coordOf cs (finADEBlockEquiv ts j)) = _
    calc
      _ = adeBlockPairing ts (finADEBlockEquiv ts i) (finADEBlockEquiv ts j) := by
        apply graphCartanMatrix_componentBlock G typeOf coordOf cs hnodup
        intro c a b
        exact componentADECoord_gram_unbounded G hpos c a b
      _ = (adeGram ts).2 i j :=
        (adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing ts i j).symm

    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (_hcard : Fintype.card V ≤ 15) :
    ADECoordinates G
proof:
:=
  positiveCartan_ADECoordinates_unbounded hpos

name: SRG266.Lattice.sup_span_pair
statement:
theorem sup_span_pair (N : Submodule ℤ W) (u v : W) :
    N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u, v} =
      (N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u}) ⊔ (N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {v})
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ({u, v} : Set W) = {u} ∪ {v} by ext; simp [or_comm], Submodule.span_union]
  exact sup_sup_distrib_left _ _ _

name: SRG266.Lattice.sup_span_pair_smul_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_span_pair, sup_span_pair,
    sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout hu ha, sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout hv hd]

name: SRG266.Lattice.sup_span_pair_hadamard_eq
proof:
:= by
  let E := N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u + v, u - v}
  have hplus : u + v ∈ E := Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
  have hminus : u - v ∈ E := Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
  have h2u : (2 : ℤ) • u ∈ E := by
    rw [show (2 : ℤ) • u = (u + v) + (u - v) by module]
    exact E.add_mem hplus hminus
  have h2v : (2 : ℤ) • v ∈ E := by
    rw [show (2 : ℤ) • v = (u + v) - (u - v) by module]
    exact E.sub_mem hplus hminus
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hp
  have hmem (w : W) (h2w : (2 : ℤ) • w ∈ E) (hpw : p • w ∈ N) : w ∈ E := by
    have heq : w = a • ((2 : ℤ) • w) + b • (p • w) := by
      calc
        w = (a * 2 + b * p) • w := by rw [hab, one_smul]
        _ = _ := by module
    rw [heq]
    exact E.add_mem (E.smul_mem a h2w) (Submodule.mem_sup_left (N.smul_mem b hpw))
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hu' : u ∈ N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u, v} :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
    have hv' : v ∈ N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u, v} :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
    refine sup_le le_sup_left (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    intro z hz
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz :
      z = u + v ∨ z = u - v) with rfl | rfl
    · exact Submodule.add_mem _ hu' hv'
    · exact Submodule.sub_mem _ hu' hv'
  · refine sup_le le_sup_left (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    intro z hz
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz :
      z = u ∨ z = v) with hz | hz
    · subst z
      exact hmem u h2u hu
    · subst z
      exact hmem v h2v hv

name: SRG266.Lattice.prod_sup_span_singletons
statement:
theorem prod_sup_span_singletons {U : Type*} [AddCommGroup U]
    (N : Submodule ℤ W) (M : Submodule ℤ U) (u : W) (v : U) :
    (N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u}).prod (M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {v}) =
      N.prod M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {(u, (0 : U)), ((0 : W), v)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ({(u, (0 : U)), ((0 : W), v)} : Set (W × U)) =
    {(u, 0)} ∪ {(0, v)} by ext; simp [or_comm], Submodule.span_union]
  simp only [LinearMap.prod_eq_sup_map, Submodule.map_sup, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  ac_rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.gram_rows_eq_mul
statement:

proof:

    ∃ d : R, Matrix.det (fun i j => Matrix.toBilin' C (v i) (v j)) = C.det*d^2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨v.det, ?_⟩
  rw [gram_rows_eq_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]

name: SRG266.Lattice.gram_det_square_reindex
statement:
theorem gram_det_square_reindex (C : Matrix ι ι R) (e : κ ≃ ι) (v : Matrix κ ι R) :
    ∃ d : R, Matrix.det (fun i j => Matrix.toBilin' C (v i) (v j)) = C.det*d^2
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix ι ι R := fun i j => v (e.symm i) j
  have h : (fun i j => Matrix.toBilin' C (v i) (v j) : Matrix κ κ R) =
      Matrix.submatrix (fun i j => Matrix.toBilin' C (M i) (M j)) e e := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, M, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [h, Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]
  exact gram_det_square C M

name: SRG266.Lattice.reflectNormTwoRoot_simple_positive
statement:
theorem reflectNormTwoRoot_simple_positive {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n}
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    {a r : NormTwoRoot L} (ha : a ∈ simpleRootSet f)
    (hr : 0 < f r.1) (hne : r ≠ a) :
    0 < f (reflectNormTwoRoot L a r).1
proof:
:= by
  have hapos : 0 < f a.1 :=
    IsAddIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_pos normTwoRootVal f ha
  by_cases hp : 0 < L.pairing r.1 a.1
  · have hone := pairing_eq_one_of_simple_step hne hp
    apply sub_simpleRoot_positive f hf hr ha
    simp only [reflectNormTwoRoot_val, hone, one_zsmul]
  · have hn : L.pairing r.1 a.1 ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hp
    simp only [reflectNormTwoRoot_val, map_sub, map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_id]
    nlinarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_positive_sum_pairing_simple
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_positive_sum_pairing_simple
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (a : NormTwoRoot L) (ha : a ∈ simpleRootSet f) :
    (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L with 0 < f r.1, L.pairing r.1 a.1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : Finset (NormTwoRoot L) := Finset.univ.filter fun r => 0 < f r.1
  let S := P.erase a
  have hapos : 0 < f a.1 :=
    IsAddIndecomposable.baseOf_subset_pos normTwoRootVal f ha
  have haP : a ∈ P := by simp [P, hapos]
  have hkeep : ∀ r ∈ S, reflectNormTwoRoot L a r ∈ S := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨hne, hrP⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hr
    have hrpos : 0 < f r.1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hrP).2
    apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
    constructor
    · intro heq
      have hroot : r = -a := by
        calc
          r = reflectNormTwoRoot L a (reflectNormTwoRoot L a r) :=
            (reflectNormTwoRoot_involutive L a r).symm
          _ = reflectNormTwoRoot L a a := congrArg (reflectNormTwoRoot L a) heq
          _ = -a := reflectNormTwoRoot_self L a
      have hfr : f r.1 = -f a.1 := by simp [hroot]
      omega
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        reflectNormTwoRoot_simple_positive f hf ha hrpos hne⟩
  have hcancel :
      (∑ r ∈ S, L.pairing r.1 a.1) = ∑ r ∈ S, -L.pairing r.1 a.1 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nbij' (reflectNormTwoRoot L a) (reflectNormTwoRoot L a)
      hkeep hkeep
      (fun r _ => reflectNormTwoRoot_involutive L a r)
      (fun r _ => reflectNormTwoRoot_involutive L a r)
    intro r _
    rw [reflectNormTwoRoot_pairing, neg_neg]
  have hzero : (∑ r ∈ S, L.pairing r.1 a.1) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at hcancel
    omega
  have hsum := Finset.sum_erase_add P (fun r => L.pairing r.1 a.1) haP
  change (∑ r ∈ S, L.pairing r.1 a.1) + L.pairing a.1 a.1 =
    ∑ r ∈ P, L.pairing r.1 a.1 at hsum
  rw [hzero, a.2, zero_add] at hsum
  exact hsum.symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateRootMap_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateRootMap_injective
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateRootMap coord)
proof:
:= by
  have hli := simpleRootSet_linearIndepOn f hf
  change LinearIndependent ℤ
    (fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1) at hli
  have hli' : LinearIndependent ℤ
      (fun i : Fin m => normTwoRootVal (coord i).1) :=
    hli.comp coord coord.injective
  intro x y hxy
  change (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ
    (fun i : Fin m => normTwoRootVal (coord i).1)) x =
      (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ
        (fun i : Fin m => normTwoRootVal (coord i).1)) y at hxy
  exact hli'.fintypeLinearCombination_injective hxy

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateRootMap_pairing
statement:
theorem coordinateRootMap_pairing
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℤ)
    (hA : ∀ i j,
      graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) = A i j)
    (x y : Fin m → ℤ) :
    L.pairing (coordinateRootMap coord x) (coordinateRootMap coord y) =
      Matrix.toBilin' A x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinateRootMap, bilinForm_fintypeLinearCombination, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [← hA i j, graphCartanMatrix_simpleRootGraph f hf]
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots
statement:
theorem coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) (r : NormTwoRoot L) :
    ∃ x : Fin m → ℤ, coordinateRootMap coord x = r.1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r.1 ∈ normTwoRootSpan L :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩
  rw [← span_simpleRoots_eq_normTwoRootSpan f hf] at hr
  have hrange :
      Set.range (fun i : Fin m => normTwoRootVal (coord i).1) =
        Set.range (fun s : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal s.1) := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨coord i, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨coord.symm s, by simp⟩
  rw [← hrange, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hr
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hr
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  change (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ
    (fun i : Fin m => normTwoRootVal (coord i).1)) x = r.1
  simpa only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply] using hx

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateRootMap_eq_simpleRootCombination
statement:
theorem coordinateRootMap_eq_simpleRootCombination
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) (z : Fin m → ℤ) :
    coordinateRootMap coord z =
      simpleRootCombination f (fun s => z (coord.symm s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [coordinateRootMap, simpleRootCombination, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  convert! Equiv.sum_comp coord
    (fun s : simpleRootSet f => z (coord.symm s) • (s.1.1 : L.carrier)) using 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, normTwoRootVal]
    exact int_smul_eq_zsmul _ _ _
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact int_smul_eq_zsmul _ _ _

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateRootMap_dominant_height
statement:
theorem coordinateRootMap_dominant_height
    {n m : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    {f : L.carrier →+ ℤ} (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) (h : ℤ)
    (hheight : ∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
      simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
      (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ L.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
      (∑ s, z s) = h)
    (θ : NormTwoRoot L) (z : Fin m → ℤ)
    (hz : coordinateRootMap coord z = θ.1) (hθ : 0 < f θ.1)
    (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ L.pairing (coord i).1.1 θ.1) :
    (∑ i, z i) = h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hz' : simpleRootCombination f (fun s => z (coord.symm s)) = θ.1 :=
    (coordinateRootMap_eq_simpleRootCombination coord z).symm.trans hz
  have hd' (s : simpleRootSet f) : 0 ≤ L.pairing s.1.1 θ.1 := by
    simpa using hd (coord.symm s)
  have hh := hheight θ (fun s => z (coord.symm s)) hz' hθ hd'
  have he := Equiv.sum_comp coord (fun s => z (coord.symm s))
  simpa using he.trans hh

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoots_haveADECoordinates_unbounded
statement:
theorem normTwoRoots_haveADECoordinates_unbounded
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (hrank : Set.finrank ℤ (Set.range (@normTwoRootVal n L)) = n) :
    ∃ ts : List ADEType,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
      ADEType.rankSum ts = n ∧
      ∃ coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f,
        ∀ i j,
          graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord i) (coord j) =
            (adeGram ts).2 i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G := simpleRootGraph f
  have hpos : IsPositiveCartan G := simpleRootGraph_isPositiveCartan f hf
  obtain ⟨ts, hregular, htscard, coord, hgram⟩ :=
    positiveCartan_ADECoordinates_unbounded hpos
  have hts : ADEType.rankSum ts = n := by
    rw [htscard, card_simpleRootSet_eq_of_fullRank f hf hrank]
  exact ⟨ts, hregular, hts, coord, hgram⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoots_areADE_unbounded
statement:
theorem normTwoRoots_areADE_unbounded
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (hrank : Set.finrank ℤ (Set.range (@normTwoRootVal n L)) = n) :
    ∃ ts : List ADEType,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, t.IsRegular) ∧
      ADEType.rankSum ts = n ∧ IsRootADEEmbedding L ts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ts, hregular, hts, coord, hgram⟩ :=
    normTwoRoots_haveADECoordinates_unbounded L f hf hrank
  refine ⟨ts, hregular, hts, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨coordinateRootMap coord,
    coordinateRootMap_injective hf coord, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    exact coordinateRootMap_pairing hf coord (adeGram ts).2 hgram x y
  · intro r hr
    exact coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots hf coord ⟨r, hr⟩

name: SRG266.allOnes_mulVec
statement:
theorem allOnes_mulVec (a : ι → R) :
    (allOnesMatrix : Matrix ι ι R) *ᵥ a = fun _ => ∑ i, a i
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  show (∑ j, (1 : R) * a j) = ∑ i, a i
  simp

name: SRG266.dotProduct_allOnes_mulVec
statement:
theorem dotProduct_allOnes_mulVec (a : ι → R) :
    a ⬝ᵥ ((allOnesMatrix : Matrix ι ι R) *ᵥ a) = (∑ i, a i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [allOnes_mulVec]
  show (∑ i, a i * ∑ j, a j) = (∑ i, a i) ^ 2
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sq]

name: SRG266.dotProduct_mulVec_sos
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_sos {L P : Matrix ι ι R}
    (hP : P = (11 : R) • L - (6 : R) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix ι ι R))
    (hPP : P * P = (495 : R) • P) (hPsym : P.IsSymm) (a : ι → R) :
    5445 * (a ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ a)) =
      (P *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a) + 2970 * (∑ i, a i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hswap : P *ᵥ a = a ᵥ* P := (vecMul_eq_mulVec_of_isSymm hPsym a).symm
  have hsq : (P *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a) = 495 * (a ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a)) := by
    calc (P *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a)
        = ((P *ᵥ a) ᵥ* P) ⬝ᵥ a := Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec _ _ _
      _ = ((a ᵥ* P) ᵥ* P) ⬝ᵥ a := by rw [← hswap]
      _ = (a ᵥ* (P * P)) ⬝ᵥ a := by rw [Matrix.vecMul_vecMul]
      _ = a ⬝ᵥ ((P * P) *ᵥ a) := (Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec _ _ _).symm
      _ = a ⬝ᵥ (((495 : R) • P) *ᵥ a) := by rw [hPP]
      _ = 495 * (a ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a)) := by
          rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hlin : a ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a) =
      11 * (a ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ a)) - 6 * (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hP, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      dotProduct_allOnes_mulVec]
  rw [hsq, hlin]
  ring

name: SRG266.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg {L P : Matrix ι ι R}
    (hP : P = (11 : R) • L - (6 : R) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix ι ι R))
    (hPP : P * P = (495 : R) • P) (hPsym : P.IsSymm) (a : ι → R) :
    0 ≤ a ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ a)
proof:
:= by
  have hsos := dotProduct_mulVec_sos hP hPP hPsym a
  have h1 : (0 : R) ≤ (P *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  have h2 : (0 : R) ≤ (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  linarith

name: SRG266.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero {L P : Matrix ι ι R}
    (hP : P = (11 : R) • L - (6 : R) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix ι ι R))
    (hPP : P * P = (495 : R) • P) (hPsym : P.IsSymm) (a : ι → R)
    (ha : a ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ a) = 0) : L *ᵥ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsos := dotProduct_mulVec_sos hP hPP hPsym a
  rw [ha, mul_zero] at hsos
  have h1 : (0 : R) ≤ (P *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  have h2 : (0 : R) ≤ (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hsum : (∑ i, a i) = 0 := by
    have : (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp this
  have hzero : (P *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ a) = 0 := by linarith
  have hPa : P *ᵥ a = 0 := by
    funext i
    have hterm : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι), (P *ᵥ a) j * (P *ᵥ a) j = 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ => mul_self_nonneg _).mp hzero
    have := hterm i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simpa using mul_self_eq_zero.mp this
  have hexp : P *ᵥ a = (11 : R) • (L *ᵥ a) - (6 : R) • (fun _ : ι => ∑ i, a i) := by
    rw [hP, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, allOnes_mulVec]
  rw [hexp] at hPa
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun hPa i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply, hsum,
    mul_zero, sub_zero] at hi
  show (L *ᵥ a) i = 0
  linarith

name: SRG266.localSupportNumerator_eq_zsmul
statement:
theorem localSupportNumerator_eq_zsmul (x : V) :
    localSupportNumerator G x =
      (11 : ℤ) • localGramMatrix G x -
        (6 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix :
          Matrix (SecondSubconstituent G x) (SecondSubconstituent G x) ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext B C
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, allOnesMatrix_apply,
    mul_one]
  rfl

name: SRG266.localSupportNumerator_sq_zsmul
statement:
theorem localSupportNumerator_sq_zsmul (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    localSupportNumerator G x * localSupportNumerator G x =
      (495 : ℤ) • localSupportNumerator G x
proof:
:= by
  ext B C
  rw [localSupportNumerator_sq_apply G hG x B C, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.localSupportNumerator_isSymm
statement: theorem localSupportNumerator_isSymm (x : V) : (localSupportNumerator G x).IsSymm
proof:
:=
  Matrix.IsSymm.ext fun B C => by
    simp only [localSupportNumerator, localGramMatrix_comm G x C B]

name: SRG266.localSupportNumeratorRat_eq_smul
statement:
theorem localSupportNumeratorRat_eq_smul (x : V) :
    localSupportNumeratorRat G x =
      (11 : ℚ) • localGramMatrixRat G x -
        (6 : ℚ) • (allOnesMatrix :
          Matrix (SecondSubconstituent G x) (SecondSubconstituent G x) ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  ext B C
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, allOnesMatrix_apply,
    mul_one]
  show ((11 * localGramMatrix G x B C - 6 : ℤ) : ℚ) =
    11 * ((localGramMatrix G x B C : ℤ) : ℚ) - 6
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.localSupportNumeratorRat_sq
statement:
theorem localSupportNumeratorRat_sq (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    localSupportNumeratorRat G x * localSupportNumeratorRat G x =
      (495 : ℚ) • localSupportNumeratorRat G x
proof:
:= by
  ext B C
  have h := localSupportNumerator_sq_apply G hG x B C
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at h
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  show (∑ D, ((localSupportNumerator G x B D : ℤ) : ℚ) *
      ((localSupportNumerator G x D C : ℤ) : ℚ)) =
    495 * ((localSupportNumerator G x B C : ℤ) : ℚ)
  rw [show (∑ D, ((localSupportNumerator G x B D : ℤ) : ℚ) *
        ((localSupportNumerator G x D C : ℤ) : ℚ)) =
      ((∑ D, localSupportNumerator G x B D * localSupportNumerator G x D C : ℤ) : ℚ) by
    push_cast; rfl]
  rw [h]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.localSupportNumeratorRat_isSymm
statement:
theorem localSupportNumeratorRat_isSymm (x : V) :
    (localSupportNumeratorRat G x).IsSymm
proof:
:=
  Matrix.IsSymm.ext fun B C => by
    show ((localSupportNumerator G x C B : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      ((localSupportNumerator G x B C : ℤ) : ℚ)
    simp only [localSupportNumerator, localGramMatrix_comm G x C B]

name: SRG266.localGram_sos
statement:
theorem localGram_sos (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :
    5445 * (a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrix G x *ᵥ a)) =
      (localSupportNumerator G x *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (localSupportNumerator G x *ᵥ a) +
        2970 * (∑ B, a B) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_mulVec_sos (localSupportNumerator_eq_zsmul G x)
    (localSupportNumerator_sq_zsmul G hG x) (localSupportNumerator_isSymm G x) a

name: SRG266.localGramRat_sos
statement:
theorem localGramRat_sos (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℚ) :
    5445 * (a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrixRat G x *ᵥ a)) =
      (localSupportNumeratorRat G x *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (localSupportNumeratorRat G x *ᵥ a) +
        2970 * (∑ B, a B) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_mulVec_sos (localSupportNumeratorRat_eq_smul G x)
    (localSupportNumeratorRat_sq G hG x) (localSupportNumeratorRat_isSymm G x) a

name: SRG266.localGram_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem localGram_quadratic_nonneg (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :
    0 ≤ a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrix G x *ᵥ a)
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (localSupportNumerator_eq_zsmul G x)
    (localSupportNumerator_sq_zsmul G hG x) (localSupportNumerator_isSymm G x) a

name: SRG266.localGram_quadratic_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem localGram_quadratic_eq_zero_iff (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :
    a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrix G x *ᵥ a) = 0 ↔ localGramMatrix G x *ᵥ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by rw [h, dotProduct_zero]⟩
  exact dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero (localSupportNumerator_eq_zsmul G x)
    (localSupportNumerator_sq_zsmul G hG x) (localSupportNumerator_isSymm G x) a h

name: SRG266.localGramRat_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem localGramRat_quadratic_nonneg (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℚ) :
    0 ≤ a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrixRat G x *ᵥ a)
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (localSupportNumeratorRat_eq_smul G x)
    (localSupportNumeratorRat_sq G hG x) (localSupportNumeratorRat_isSymm G x) a

name: SRG266.localGramRat_quadratic_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem localGramRat_quadratic_eq_zero_iff (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℚ) :
    a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrixRat G x *ᵥ a) = 0 ↔ localGramMatrixRat G x *ᵥ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by rw [h, dotProduct_zero]⟩
  exact dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero (localSupportNumeratorRat_eq_smul G x)
    (localSupportNumeratorRat_sq G hG x) (localSupportNumeratorRat_isSymm G x) a h

name: SRG266.integralGramPairing_mk
statement:
theorem integralGramPairing_mk (x : V) (a b : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :
    integralGramPairing G x (Submodule.Quotient.mk a) (Submodule.Quotient.mk b) =
      a ⬝ᵥ (localGramMatrix G x *ᵥ b)
proof:
:=
  Matrix.toBilin'_apply' _ _ _

name: SRG266.integralGramPairing_isSymm
statement: theorem integralGramPairing_isSymm (x : V) : (integralGramPairing G x).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro v w
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ w
  exact (integralGramForm_isSymm G x).eq v w

name: SRG266.integralGramPairing_nonneg
statement:
theorem integralGramPairing_nonneg (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (v : IntegralGramLattice G x) : 0 ≤ integralGramPairing G x v v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  rw [integralGramPairing_mk]
  exact localGram_quadratic_nonneg G hG x a

name: SRG266.integralGramPairing_posDef
statement:
theorem integralGramPairing_posDef (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (v : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < integralGramPairing G x v v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  rw [integralGramPairing_mk]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (localGram_quadratic_nonneg G hG x a) with h | h
  · exact h
  · refine absurd ?_ hv
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← integralGramKernel_eq_relations]
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      ((localGram_quadratic_eq_zero_iff G hG x a).mp h.symm)

name: SRG266.integralGramPairing_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem integralGramPairing_nondegenerate (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    (integralGramPairing G x).Nondegenerate
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff' (integralGramPairing G x)
      (integralGramPairing_nonneg G hG x)
      (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp (integralGramPairing_isSymm G x))).mpr
    (integralGramPairing_posDef G hG x)

name: SRG266.finrank_integralGramLattice
statement:
theorem finrank_integralGramLattice (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (IntegralGramLattice G x) = 12
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      Module.finrank ℤ (IntegralGramLattice G x) +
          Module.finrank ℤ (integralGramRelations G x) =
        Module.finrank ℤ (SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :=
    (integralGramRelations G x).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hker : Module.finrank ℤ (integralGramRelations G x) = 208 := by
    rw [← integralGramKernel_eq_relations]
    exact integralGramKernel_finrank G hG x
  rw [hker, Module.finrank_pi ℤ, secondSubconstituent_card G hG x] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.mk_eq_sum_smul_generator
statement:
theorem mk_eq_sum_smul_generator (x : V) (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : IntegralGramLattice G x) =
      ∑ B, a B • integralGramGenerator G x B
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ B, a B • Pi.single B (1 : ℤ)) = a := by
    funext C
    simp [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  calc (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      = (integralGramRelations G x).mkQ (∑ B, a B • Pi.single B (1 : ℤ)) := by
        rw [hsum]; rfl
    _ = ∑ B, a B • integralGramGenerator G x B := by
        rw [map_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun B _ => by rw [map_smul]; rfl

name: SRG266.integralGramPairing_apply_mk_right
statement:
theorem integralGramPairing_apply_mk_right (x : V)
    (v : IntegralGramLattice G x) (a : SecondSubconstituent G x → ℤ) :
    integralGramPairing G x v (Submodule.Quotient.mk a) =
      ∑ B, a B * integralGramPairing G x v (integralGramGenerator G x B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_sum_smul_generator G x a, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun B _ => by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.eq_zero_of_pairing_generators_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_pairing_generators_eq_zero (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (v : IntegralGramLattice G x)
    (h : ∀ B, integralGramPairing G x v (integralGramGenerator G x B) = 0) :
    v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  have hzero :
      integralGramPairing G x (Submodule.Quotient.mk a)
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk a) = 0 := by
    rw [integralGramPairing_apply_mk_right]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun B _ => by rw [h B, mul_zero]
  by_contra hv
  exact (integralGramPairing_posDef G hG x _ hv).ne' hzero

name: SRG266.ratGramForm_nonneg
statement:
theorem ratGramForm_nonneg (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) (v : ratGramSpace G x) :
    0 ≤ ratGramForm G x v v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  rw [ratGramForm_mk]
  exact localGramRat_quadratic_nonneg G hG x a

name: SRG266.ratGramForm_posDef
statement:
theorem ratGramForm_posDef (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (v : ratGramSpace G x) (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < ratGramForm G x v v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ v
  rw [ratGramForm_mk]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (localGramRat_quadratic_nonneg G hG x a) with h | h
  · exact h
  · refine absurd ?_ hv
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      ((localGramRat_quadratic_eq_zero_iff G hG x a).mp h.symm)

name: SRG266.ratGramForm_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem ratGramForm_nondegenerate (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :
    (ratGramForm G x).Nondegenerate
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff' (ratGramForm G x)
      (ratGramForm_nonneg G hG x)
      (LinearMap.BilinForm.isSymm_iff.mp (ratGramForm_isSymm G x))).mpr
    (ratGramForm_posDef G hG x)

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_fin_ite_val_eq
statement:
theorem sum_fin_ite_val_eq (n k : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, if j.1 = k then w j else 0) =
      if h : k < n then w ⟨k, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < n
  · have he (j : Fin n) : j.1 = k ↔ j = ⟨k, hk⟩ := by
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
    simp [he, hk]
  · have he (j : Fin n) : j.1 ≠ k := by omega
    simp [he, hk]

name: SRG266.Lattice.gramDEntry_sparse
statement:
theorem gramDEntry_sparse {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) :
    gramDEntry n i.1 j.1 =
      (if j = i then 2 else 0) -
      (if i.1 + 3 ≤ n then (if j.1 = i.1 + 1 then 1 else 0) else 0) -
      (if 0 < i.1 ∧ i.1 + 2 ≤ n then (if j.1 = i.1 - 1 then 1 else 0) else 0) -
      (if i.1 + 3 = n then (if j.1 = n - 1 then 1 else 0) else 0) -
      (if i.1 + 1 = n then (if j.1 = n - 3 then 1 else 0) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gramDEntry, Fin.ext_iff]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.gramD_mulVec_dDominantVector
statement:
theorem gramD_mulVec_dDominantVector (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    (gramD n *ᵥ dDominantVector n) i = if i.1 = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, gramD]
  simp_rw [gramDEntry_sparse hn, sub_mul, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_irrel]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  simp_rw [sum_fin_ite_val_eq]
  have hp : i.1 - 1 < n := by omega
  have hl : n - 1 < n := by omega
  have hf : n - 3 < n := by omega
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, dif_pos hp, dif_pos hl, dif_pos hf]
  simp only [dDominantVector]
  repeat' first | omega | split

name: SRG266.Lattice.sum_dDominantVector
statement:
theorem sum_dDominantVector (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (∑ i, dDominantVector n i) = 2 * (n : ℤ) - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hformula (i : Fin n) : dDominantVector n i =
      2 - (if i.1 = 0 then 1 else 0) -
        (if i.1 = n - 2 then 1 else 0) -
        (if i.1 = n - 1 then 1 else 0) := by
    simp only [dDominantVector]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  simp_rw [hformula, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_fin_ite_val_eq]
  have h0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have h2 : n - 2 < n := by omega
  have h1 : n - 1 < n := by omega
  simp only [dif_pos h0, dif_pos h2, dif_pos h1, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.dDominantVector_norm_two
statement:
theorem dDominantVector_norm_two (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    Matrix.toBilin' (gramD n) (dDominantVector n) (dDominantVector n) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.toBilin'_apply']
  simp only [dotProduct]
  simp_rw [gramD_mulVec_dDominantVector n hn, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [sum_fin_ite_val_eq]
  have h1 : 1 < n := by omega
  have h3 : ¬ n ≤ 3 := by omega
  norm_num [h1, dDominantVector, h3]

name: SRG266.Lattice.not_all_E6_of_integral_root_projection
statement:
theorem not_all_E6_of_integral_root_projection
    {W U : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W] [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℚ U]
    {n d : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hD : ∀ a, (((0 : W), a), (0 : U)) ∈ L ↔ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n)
    (hproj : ∀ r ∈ L, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C r r = 2 →
      r.1.2 ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n)
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice d) [Finite (NormTwoRoot N)]
    (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier)
    (hpairN : ∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C u v)
    {f : N.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    {ts : List ADEType} (coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f)
    (hgram : ∀ a b, graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) (coord a) (coord b) =
      (adeGram ts).2 a b) :
    ¬(∀ t ∈ ts, t = .E6)
proof:
:= by
  intro hall
  let F := prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C
  let φ : (Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U) :=
    L.subtype.comp (e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (coordinateRootMap coord))
  have hmem (z) : φ z ∈ L := (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z)).2
  have hdiag (a) : (adeGram ts).2 a a = 2 :=
    (hgram a a).symm.trans (graphCartanMatrix_apply_same _ _)
  have hpair (z w) : F (φ z) (φ w) = (Matrix.toBilin' (adeGram ts).2 z w : ℚ) := by
    have h := hpairN (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z)) (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord w))
    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm.trans (congrArg (fun a : ℤ => (a : ℚ))
      (coordinateRootMap_pairing hf coord (adeGram ts).2 hgram z w))
  have hcover (r) (hr : r ∈ L) (hn : F r r = 2) : ∃ z, φ z = r := by
    have hnN : N.pairing (e ⟨r, hr⟩) (e ⟨r, hr⟩) = 2 := by
      have h := (hpairN ⟨r, hr⟩ ⟨r, hr⟩).trans hn
      exact_mod_cast h
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots hf coord ⟨e ⟨r, hr⟩, hnN⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    change (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z)).1 = r
    rw [hz, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact not_two_gramDivisibility_of_integral_root_projection i j hij B C L hD hproj
    (adeGram ts).2 hdiag φ hmem hpair hcover (adeGram_two_divisibility_of_all_E6 ts hall)

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_four_split_values
statement:
theorem norm_four_split_values (a e : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hsum : a+e = 4) (hgap : a ≠ 2/3)
    (hclass : (∃ m : ℤ, e = 2*(m : ℚ)) ∨ (∃ m : ℤ, e = 4/3+2*(m : ℚ))) :
    e = 0 ∨ e = 4/3 ∨ e = 2 ∨ e = 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases hclass with ⟨m, hm⟩ | ⟨m, hm⟩
  · have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ m by linarith)
    have hm2 : m ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast (show (m : ℚ) ≤ 2 by linarith)
    have hcases : m = 0 ∨ m = 1 ∨ m = 2 := by omega
    rcases hcases with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hm <;> aesop
  · have hmlo : -4 ≤ 6*m := by
      exact_mod_cast (show (-4 : ℚ) ≤ 6*(m : ℚ) by linarith)
    have hmhi : 6*m ≤ 8 := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 6*(m : ℚ) ≤ 8 by linarith)
    have hcases : m = 0 ∨ m = 1 := by omega
    rcases hcases with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by norm_num at hm; exact hm))
    · exact (hgap (by norm_num at hm; linarith)).elim

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11E6_norm_four_E6_values
statement:
theorem a11E6_norm_four_E6_values (u : Fin 11 → ℚ) (v : Fin 6 → ℚ)
    (hA : ∀ i, cartanARatForm 11 u (Pi.single i 1) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hE : v ∈ E6Cartan.form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hEnonneg : 0 ≤ E6Cartan.form v v)
    (hsum : cartanARatForm 11 u u+E6Cartan.form v v = 4) :
    E6Cartan.form v v = 0 ∨ E6Cartan.form v v = 4/3 ∨
      E6Cartan.form v v = 2 ∨ E6Cartan.form v v = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hAnonneg : 0 ≤ cartanARatForm 11 u u := by
    rw [cartanA_norm_zeroSum]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  apply norm_four_split_values _ _ hAnonneg hEnonneg hsum (a11_dual_norm_ne_two_thirds u hA)
  rcases E6Cartan.dual_norm_dichotomy hE hEnonneg with ⟨_, hm⟩ | ⟨_, _, c, m, _, _, hm⟩
  · exact Or.inl hm
  · exact Or.inr ⟨m, hm⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.three_smul_mem_of_dual
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, c, rfl⟩ := exists_dual_coordinates hv
  rw [smul_add, show (3 : ℤ) • (c • weight) = c • ((3 : ℤ) • weight) by module]
  exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ 3 (intCoordsToRat_mem z))
    (Submodule.smul_mem _ c three_smul_weight_mem)

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.three_mul_pair_integral
statement:
theorem three_mul_pair_integral {v w : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (hv : v ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hw : w ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)) :
    3*form v w ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hw _ (three_smul_mem_of_dual hv)
  rw [form_isSymm.eq, show (3 : ℤ) • v = (3 : ℚ) • v by module] at h
  simpa only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.exists_scaled_dual_pair
statement:
theorem exists_scaled_dual_pair {v w : Fin 6 → ℚ}
    (hv : v ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hw : w ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, 3*form v w = (z : ℚ) ∧
      (form v v = 2 → form w w = 2 → 3 ∣ z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (three_mul_pair_integral hv hw)
  refine ⟨z, hz.symm, ?_⟩
  intro hv2 hw2
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp
    (form_isIntegral (integral_of_dual_norm_two hv hv2) _ (integral_of_dual_norm_two hw hw2))
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  exact_mod_cast (show (z : ℚ) = 3*(m : ℚ) by rw [hz, hm])

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.exists_scaled_norm_value
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨0, by norm_num, Or.inl rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨4, by norm_num, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
  · exact ⟨6, by norm_num, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩
  · exact ⟨12, by norm_num, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.projectionArithmetic_of_norm_values
statement:
theorem projectionArithmetic_of_norm_values (v w : Fin 6 → ℚ)
    (hv : v ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hw : w ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6))
    (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ form u u)
    (hnv : form v v = 0 ∨ form v v = 4/3 ∨ form v v = 2 ∨ form v v = 4)
    (hnw : form w w = 0 ∨ form w w = 4/3 ∨ form w w = 2 ∨ form w w = 4) :
    Q15ProjectionArithmetic v w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxval⟩ := exists_scaled_norm_value _ hnv
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyval⟩ := exists_scaled_norm_value _ hnw
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hroots⟩ := exists_scaled_dual_pair hv hw
  refine ⟨x, y, z, hx, hy, hz, hxval, hyval, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcs := form.apply_sq_le_of_symm hpos ⟨form_isSymm.eq⟩ v w
    have hQ : (z : ℚ)^2 ≤ (x : ℚ)*(y : ℚ) := by
      rw [← hx, ← hy, ← hz]
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hQ
  · intro hx6 hy6
    exact hroots (by rw [hx6] at hx; norm_num at hx; linarith)
      (by rw [hy6] at hy; norm_num at hy; linarith)

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_binary_complement_frame_mass
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_binary_complement_frame_mass
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hC : C.IsSymm) (hself : ∀ t, C t t = 0 → t = 0)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (H : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y) (hH : H.IsSymm) (hHpos : ∀ y, y ≠ 0 → 0 < H y y)
    (part : (Fin 24 → ℚ) → Y) (lift : Y → (Fin 24 → ℚ))
    (hpart : ∀ y, part (lift y) = y)
    (hlift : ∀ q y, adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types q (lift y) = H (part q) y)
    (hD : ∀ y, a11D7E6D7Projection (lift y) = 0)
    (g : ι → W) (spin : Fin 7 → ℚ) (a : ℚ)
    (hm : ∀ t, (∑ i, (B t (g i))^2) = a*B t t)
    (s : κ → U) (hs : LinearIndependent ℚ s) (r : Fin 2 → U)
    (hr : ∀ i j, C (r i) (r j) = if i = j then 4 else 1)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, C (s i) (r j) = 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℚ U = Fintype.card κ+2)
    (hzero : ∀ i, part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), s i)) = 0) :
    let f := fun i => part (ψ.symm ((g i, spin), (0 : U)))
    let u := part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r 0))
    let w := part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r 1))
    (∑ i, H (f i) (f i)) =
      a*(Module.finrank ℚ Y : ℚ)-(a/15)*(4*H u u+4*H w w-2*H u w)
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun i => part (ψ.symm ((g i, spin), (0 : U)))
  let u := part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r 0))
  let w := part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), r 1))
  change (∑ i, H (f i) (f i)) =
    a*(Module.finrank ℚ Y : ℚ)-(a/15)*(4*H u u+4*H w w-2*H u w)
  have hcomp (t : U) (y : Y) :
      C t (ψ (lift y)).2 = H y (part (ψ.symm ((0 : W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)), t))) :=
    (a11D7E6_complement_pair_with_lift B C ψ hpair H part lift hlift t y).trans (hH.eq _ _)
  have hpoint (y : Y) : (∑ i, (H y (f i))^2) =
      a*H y y-((4*a/15)*(H y u)^2+(4*a/15)*(H y w)^2+(-2*a/15)*(H y u)*(H y w)) := by
    have horth (i) : C (s i) (ψ (lift y)).2 = 0 := by
      rw [hcomp, hzero, map_zero]
    have hn := binary_gram_norm_of_orthogonal C hself s hs r hr hcross hdim _ horth
    rw [hcomp (r 0) y, hcomp (r 1) y] at hn
    have h := a11D7E6_component_moment_defect B C hB hC ψ hpair hmarked
      H hH part lift hpart hlift hD g spin a hm y
    rw [hn] at h
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have h := rational_frame_mass_eq_quadratic_defect H ⟨hH.eq⟩ hHpos f u w a
    (4*a/15) (4*a/15) (-2*a/15) hpoint
  rw [h]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.form_apply
statement:
theorem form_apply (x y : Fin 6 → ℚ) :
    form x y = 2 * (x 0*y 0+x 1*y 1+x 2*y 2+x 3*y 3+x 4*y 4+x 5*y 5) -
      (x 0*y 1+x 1*y 0+x 1*y 2+x 2*y 1+x 2*y 3+x 3*y 2+
        x 3*y 4+x 4*y 3+x 2*y 5+x 5*y 2)
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [form, Matrix.toBilin'_apply, gramE, gramEEntry, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Fin.succ, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  simp only [show (⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 6) = 2 from rfl,
    show (⟨3, by decide⟩ : Fin 6) = 3 from rfl,
    show (⟨4, by decide⟩ : Fin 6) = 4 from rfl,
    show (⟨5, by decide⟩ : Fin 6) = 5 from rfl]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.form_isSymm
statement: theorem form_isSymm : form.IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y
  rw [form_apply, form_apply]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.weight_pair
statement: theorem weight_pair (x : Fin 6 → ℚ) : form weight x = x 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [form_apply]
  simp only [show weight 0 = 4/3 from rfl, show weight 1 = 5/3 from rfl,
    show weight 2 = 2 from rfl, show weight 3 = 4/3 from rfl,
    show weight 4 = 2/3 from rfl, show weight 5 = 1 from rfl]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.weight_norm
statement: theorem weight_norm : form weight weight = 4/3
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight_pair]
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.form_isIntegral
statement: theorem form_isIntegral : IsIntegral form (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩ _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  apply mem_one_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨Matrix.toBilin' (gramE 6) z w, ?_⟩
  simp only [form, Matrix.toBilin'_apply, intCoordsToRat_apply]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.form_isEven
statement: theorem form_isEven : IsEven form (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨z 0*z 0+z 1*z 1+z 2*z 2+z 3*z 3+z 4*z 4+z 5*z 5-
    (z 0*z 1+z 1*z 2+z 2*z 3+z 3*z 4+z 2*z 5), ?_⟩
  rw [form_apply]
  simp only [intCoordsToRat_apply]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.weight_mem_dual
statement: theorem weight_mem_dual : weight ∈ form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  rw [weight_pair]
  exact mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨z 0, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.three_smul_weight_mem
statement: theorem three_smul_weight_mem : (3 : ℤ) • weight ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mpr ⟨![4, 5, 6, 4, 2, 3], ?_⟩
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [weight, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.weight_order
statement:
theorem weight_order (m : ℤ) :
    m • weight ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ↔ 3 ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_coordinateIntegerLattice.mp h
    have h := hz 0
    change (z 0 : ℚ) = m • (4/3 : ℚ) at h
    rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at h
    have heq : (3 : ℚ) * z 0 = 4 * m := by linarith
    have heqZ : 3 * z 0 = 4 * m := by exact_mod_cast heq
    omega
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h : (3*k) • weight = k • ((3 : ℤ) • weight) := by module
    rw [h]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ k three_smul_weight_mem

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.exists_dual_coordinates
proof:
:= by
  have hd (i : Fin 6) : ∃ d : ℤ, (d : ℚ) = form x (intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1)) :=
    mem_one_iff.mp (hx _ (intCoordsToRat_mem (Pi.single i 1)))
  choose d hd using hd
  have h0 := hd 0
  have h1 := hd 1
  have h2 := hd 2
  have h3 := hd 3
  have h4 := hd 4
  have h5 := hd 5
  norm_num [form_apply, intCoordsToRat_apply, Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff] at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  let c : ℤ := d 0-d 1+d 3-d 4
  let z : Fin 6 → ℤ := ![
    3*d 1+2*d 2+2*d 4+d 5,
    5*d 1+4*d 2+d 3+3*d 4+2*d 5,
    6*d 1+6*d 2+2*d 3+4*d 4+3*d 5,
    4*d 1+4*d 2+2*d 3+3*d 4+2*d 5,
    2*d 1+2*d 2+d 3+2*d 4+d 5,
    3*d 1+3*d 2+d 3+2*d 4+2*d 5]
  refine ⟨z, c, ?_⟩
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [z, c, weight, intCoordsToRat_apply, zsmul_eq_mul] <;>
    push_cast <;> linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.E6Cartan.lattice_dual
statement:
theorem lattice_dual : form.dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 6) =
    coordinateIntegerLattice 6 ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {weight}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, c, rfl⟩ := exists_dual_coordinates hx
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (intCoordsToRat_mem z)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
  · refine sup_le form_isIntegral (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = weight)
    exact weight_mem_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.form_isSymm

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.space_finrank
