name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_dual
statement:
theorem matchingVector_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice =
    lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range matchingVector)
proof:
:= by
  let u : Fin 1 → (Fin 4 → ℚ) := fun _ => (2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4
  let v : Fin 2 → Q15Coordinates.Space := ![Q15Coordinates.dualThree,
    (2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive]
  have hu : (simplexRatForm 4).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 4) =
      coordinateIntegerLattice 4 ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range u) := by
    rw [range_fin_one_eq_singleton]
    exact a4_twice_weight_dual
  have hv : Q15Coordinates.form.dualSubmodule Q15Coordinates.lattice =
      Q15Coordinates.lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v) := by
    rw [range_fin_two_eq_pair]
    change Q15Coordinates.form.dualSubmodule Q15Coordinates.lattice =
      Q15Coordinates.lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
        {Q15Coordinates.dualThree, (2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive}
    rw [Q15Coordinates.lattice_dual, sup_span_pair, sup_span_pair,
      sup_span_smul_eq_of_bezout (b := 3) (k := -1)
        Q15Coordinates.five_smul_dualFive_mem (by norm_num)]
  have hr : Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => (u i, (0 : Q15Coordinates.Space)))
      (fun j => ((0 : Fin 4 → ℚ), v j))) = Set.range matchingVector := by
    simp only [matchingVector, Set.Sum.elim_range, range_fin_one_eq_singleton,
      range_fin_two_eq_pair]
    ext z
    simp [u, v, or_left_comm, or_comm]
  rw [form, lattice, dualSubmodule_prodForm, hu, hv, prod_sup_span_ranges, hr]

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_period
statement:
theorem matchingVector_period (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) :
    mixedPrimaryPeriod .four .binary i • matchingVector i ∈ lattice
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive) ∈ Q15Coordinates.lattice := by
    rw [show (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive) =
      (2 : ℤ) • ((5 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive) by module]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ 2 Q15Coordinates.five_smul_dualFive_mem
  have hA : (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 4 := by
    rw [show (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) =
      (2 : ℤ) • ((5 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) by module]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ 2 (by simpa using succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem 4)
  rcases i with i | i
  · exact ⟨by simp [matchingVector, mixedPrimaryPeriod], Q15Coordinates.three_smul_dualThree_mem⟩
  · fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨by simp [matchingVector, mixedPrimaryPeriod], hQ⟩
    · exact ⟨hA, by simp [matchingVector, mixedPrimaryPeriod]⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_norm_three
statement:
theorem matchingVector_norm_three (i : Fin 1) :
    form (matchingVector (.inl i)) (matchingVector (.inl i)) = 2/3
proof:
:= by
  simpa [matchingVector, form, prodForm_apply] using Q15Coordinates.dualThree_norm

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_norm_five
statement:
theorem matchingVector_norm_five (i : Fin 2) :
    form (matchingVector (.inr i)) (matchingVector (.inr i)) =
      if i = 0 then 8/5 else 16/5
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Q15Coordinates.form ((2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive)
      ((2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive) = 8/5 := by
    rw [show (2 : ℤ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive = (2 : ℚ) • Q15Coordinates.dualFive by module]
    norm_num [Q15Coordinates.dualFive_norm]
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [matchingVector, form, prodForm_apply] using hQ
  · simpa [matchingVector, form, prodForm_apply] using a4_twice_weight_norm

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_cross
statement:
theorem matchingVector_cross (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    form (matchingVector i) (matchingVector j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
  · exact (hij (congrArg Sum.inl (Subsingleton.elim i j))).elim
  · fin_cases j <;> norm_num [matchingVector, form, prodForm_apply,
      Q15Coordinates.form_apply, Q15Coordinates.dualThree, Q15Coordinates.dualFive]
  · fin_cases i <;> norm_num [matchingVector, form, prodForm_apply,
      Q15Coordinates.form_apply, Q15Coordinates.dualThree, Q15Coordinates.dualFive]
  · fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp_all [matchingVector, form, prodForm_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.A4Q15Coordinates.has_A4_chain
statement:
theorem has_A4_chain : ∃ r : Fin 4 → Space,
    (∀ i, r i ∈ lattice) ∧
    (∀ i j, form (r i) (r j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => (simplexSimpleRoot 4 i, 0), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact ⟨simplexSimpleRoot_mem 4 i, zero_mem _⟩
  · intro i j
    simpa [form, prodForm_apply] using simplexSimpleRoot_gram 4 i j

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_a4Q15
statement:
theorem complete_a4Q15 (S : PrimaryFamily B N .three .four)
    (T : PrimaryFamily B N .five .binary)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hl : IsLattice ℚ N) (hi : IsIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N)
    (hd : B.dualSubmodule N = torsionPart B N 3 ⊔ torsionPart B N 5) :
    IsLattice ℚ (a4Q15CompletionLattice S T) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B A4Q15Coordinates.form) (a4Q15CompletionLattice S T) ∧
      (prodForm B A4Q15Coordinates.form).dualSubmodule (a4Q15CompletionLattice S T) =
        a4Q15CompletionLattice S T
proof:
:= by
  refine complete_even_glue (mixedPrimarySource S T) A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector
    (mixedPrimaryPeriod .four .binary) hs A4Q15Coordinates.form_isSymm
    hl A4Q15Coordinates.lattice_isLattice hi A4Q15Coordinates.lattice_isIntegral
    he A4Q15Coordinates.lattice_isEven (mixedPrimarySource_dual S T hd)
    A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_dual A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_period
    (mixedPrimarySource_cross S T hs) A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_cross ?_ ?_
  · rintro (i | i)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := S.norm i
      refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
      change B (S.vec i) (S.vec i) +
        A4Q15Coordinates.form (A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector (.inl i))
          (A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector (.inl i)) = _
      rw [hk, A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_norm_three]
      norm_num [primaryFraction, primaryNumerator, SmallOddPrime.modulus]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := T.norm i
      change ∃ n : ℤ, B (T.vec i) (T.vec i) +
        A4Q15Coordinates.form (A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector (.inr i))
          (A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector (.inr i)) = 2*(n : ℚ)
      rw [hk, A4Q15Coordinates.matchingVector_norm_five]
      fin_cases i
      · refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
        norm_num [primaryFraction, primaryNumerator, SmallOddPrime.modulus,
          SmallOddPrime.binaryNumerator]
        ring
      · refine ⟨k+2, ?_⟩
        norm_num [primaryFraction, primaryNumerator, SmallOddPrime.modulus,
          SmallOddPrime.binaryNumerator]
        ring
  · rintro (i | i) a ha
    · exact S.unit i a ha
    · exact T.unit i a ha

name: SRG266.Lattice.mem_evenCoordinateLattice
statement:
theorem mem_evenCoordinateLattice {n : ℕ} {v : Fin n → ℚ} :
    v ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n ↔
      ∃ z : Fin n → ℤ, intCoordsToRat z = v ∧ Even (∑ i, z i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩
    exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.evenCoordinateLattice_le
statement:
theorem evenCoordinateLattice_le (n : ℕ) :
    evenCoordinateLattice n ≤ coordinateIntegerLattice n
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
  exact intCoordsToRat_mem z

name: SRG266.Lattice.two_smul_mem_evenCoordinateLattice
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) • z, ?_, map_zsmul intCoordsToRat 2 z⟩
  change Even (∑ i, (2 : ℤ) • z i)
  simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  exact even_two_mul _

name: SRG266.Lattice.evenCoordinateLattice_isLattice
statement:
theorem evenCoordinateLattice_isLattice (n : ℕ) :
    IsLattice ℚ (evenCoordinateLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (coordinateIntegerLattice_isLattice n).fg.of_le (evenCoordinateLattice_le n)
  · refine top_unique ?_
    rw [← (coordinateIntegerLattice_isLattice n).spans]
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    intro v hv
    have h := Submodule.subset_span (R := ℚ) (two_smul_mem_evenCoordinateLattice hv)
    have h' := (Submodule.span ℚ (evenCoordinateLattice n : Set (Fin n → ℚ))).smul_mem
      (1 / 2 : ℚ) h
    have heq : (1 / 2 : ℚ) • (2 : ℤ) • v = v := by
      ext i
      simp [zsmul_eq_mul]
    rwa [heq] at h'

name: SRG266.Lattice.evenCoordinateLattice_isIntegral
statement:
theorem evenCoordinateLattice_isIntegral (n : ℕ) :
    IsIntegral (standardRatForm n) (evenCoordinateLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' := evenCoordinateLattice_le n hx
  rw [← standardRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice] at hx'
  exact hx' y (evenCoordinateLattice_le n hy)

name: SRG266.Lattice.evenCoordinateLattice_isEven
statement:
theorem evenCoordinateLattice_isEven (n : ℕ) :
    IsEven (standardRatForm n) (evenCoordinateLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩ := mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mp hv
  have hdiff : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (∑ i, z i * z i - ∑ i, z i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => ?_
    convert (Int.even_mul_pred_self (z i)).two_dvd using 1
    ring
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := dvd_add hdiff hz.two_dvd
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  have hk' : (∑ i, z i * z i) = 2 * k := by simpa using hk
  change (∑ i, (z i : ℚ) * (z i : ℚ)) = 2 * (k : ℚ)
  exact_mod_cast hk'

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateSpinor_norm
statement:
theorem coordinateSpinor_norm (n : ℕ) :
    standardRatForm n (coordinateSpinor n) (coordinateSpinor n) = (n : ℚ) / 4
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardRatForm_apply, coordinateSpinor]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateSpinor_mem_dual
statement:
theorem coordinateSpinor_mem_dual (n : ℕ) :
    coordinateSpinor n ∈ (standardRatForm n).dualSubmodule (evenCoordinateLattice n)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨z, rfl, k, hk⟩ := mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mp hv
  apply mem_one_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  simp only [standardRatForm_apply, coordinateSpinor, intCoordsToRat_apply,
    ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hk' : (∑ i, (z i : ℚ)) = (k : ℚ) + k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  rw [hk']
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.four_smul_coordinateSpinor_mem
statement:
theorem four_smul_coordinateSpinor_mem (n : ℕ) :
    (4 : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor n ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
  refine ⟨fun _ => 2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i
    norm_num [coordinateSpinor, zsmul_eq_mul]
  · simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact even_two.mul_left _

name: SRG266.Lattice.d7_spinor_order
statement:
theorem d7_spinor_order (m : ℤ) :
    m • coordinateSpinor 7 ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7 ↔ 4 ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  exact zsmul_mem_iff_four_dvd_of_odd_quarter_norm
    (evenCoordinateLattice_isEven 7) (by decide : Odd (7 : ℤ))
    (by simpa using coordinateSpinor_norm 7) (four_smul_coordinateSpinor_mem 7) m

name: SRG266.Lattice.dot_int_single
statement:
private theorem dot_int_single {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℚ) (i : Fin n) (a : ℤ) :
    standardRatForm n x (intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i a)) = x i * (a : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [standardRatForm_apply, intCoordsToRat, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]

name: SRG266.Lattice.odd_evenCoordinateLattice_dual
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hdiff : ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℚ) = x i - x i₀ := by
      intro i
      have hv : intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1 - Pi.single i₀ 1) ∈
          evenCoordinateLattice n := by
        apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have h := hx _ hv
      simp only [map_sub, dot_int_single, Int.cast_one, mul_one] at h
      exact mem_one_iff.mp h
    choose z hz using hdiff
    have htwice : ∃ k : ℤ, (k : ℚ) = 2 * x i₀ := by
      have hv : intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i₀ 2) ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n := by
        apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
        exact ⟨_, rfl, by simp⟩
      have h := hx _ hv
      simpa only [dot_int_single, Int.cast_ofNat, mul_comm] using mem_one_iff.mp h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := htwice
    let t : ℤ := ∑ i, z i
    let w : Fin n → ℤ := fun i => z i - t
    have hw : intCoordsToRat w ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n := by
      apply mem_evenCoordinateLattice.mpr
      refine ⟨w, rfl, ?_⟩
      have hn' : Odd (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have heven := (odd_one.sub_odd hn').mul_right t
      have heq : (∑ i, w i) = (1 - (n : ℤ)) * t := by
        simp only [w, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
          Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        change t - (n : ℤ) * t = _
        ring
      rwa [heq]
    have heq : x = intCoordsToRat w + (k + 2 * t) • coordinateSpinor n := by
      ext i
      change x i = ((z i - t : ℤ) : ℚ) + (k + 2 * t) • (1 / 2 : ℚ)
      rw [zsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      rw [hz i, hk]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup hw
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  · refine sup_le (evenCoordinateLattice_isIntegral n) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = coordinateSpinor n)
    exact coordinateSpinor_mem_dual n

name: SRG266.Lattice.d7_dual
proof:
:=
  odd_evenCoordinateLattice_dual (by decide) 0

name: SRG266.Lattice.IsPositiveCartan.eq_of_degree_eq_three_unbounded
statement:
theorem IsPositiveCartan.eq_of_degree_eq_three_unbounded
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected)
    {a b : V}
    (ha : G.degree a = 3) (hb : G.degree b = 3) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hab
  have hacyc : G.IsAcyclic := hG.isAcyclic
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath a b
  have hp_not_nil : ¬ p.Nil := by
    simpa [hp.nil_iff_eq] using hab
  have hsnd_mem : p.snd ∈ G.neighborFinset a := by
    simpa using p.adj_snd hp_not_nil
  have hpen_mem : p.penultimate ∈ G.neighborFinset b := by
    simpa using (p.adj_penultimate hp_not_nil).symm
  let leftSet : Finset V := (G.neighborFinset a).erase p.snd
  let rightSet : Finset V := (G.neighborFinset b).erase p.penultimate
  have hleft_card : leftSet.card = 2 := by
    change ((G.neighborFinset a).erase p.snd).card = 2
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hsnd_mem]
    change G.degree a - 1 = 2
    omega
  have hright_card : rightSet.card = 2 := by
    change ((G.neighborFinset b).erase p.penultimate).card = 2
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hpen_mem]
    change G.degree b - 1 = 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨left, hleft_range⟩ :=
    Function.Embedding.exists_of_card_le_finset
      (α := Fin 2) (s := leftSet) (by simp [hleft_card])
  obtain ⟨right, hright_range⟩ :=
    Function.Embedding.exists_of_card_le_finset
      (α := Fin 2) (s := rightSet) (by simp [hright_card])
  have hleft_mem (i : Fin 2) : left i ∈ leftSet :=
    hleft_range (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have hright_mem (i : Fin 2) : right i ∈ rightSet :=
    hright_range (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have hleft_adj (i : Fin 2) : G.Adj a (left i) := by
    simpa using (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hleft_mem i)).2
  have hright_adj (i : Fin 2) : G.Adj b (right i) := by
    simpa using (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hright_mem i)).2
  have hleft_ne_snd (i : Fin 2) : left i ≠ p.snd := by
    exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hleft_mem i)).1
  have hright_ne_pen (i : Fin 2) : right i ≠ p.penultimate := by
    exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (hright_mem i)).1
  have hleft_not_support (i : Fin 2) : left i ∉ p.support := by
    intro hm
    exact hleft_ne_snd i (hacyc.eq_snd_of_adj_start hp (hleft_adj i) hm)
  have hright_not_support (i : Fin 2) : right i ∉ p.support := by
    intro hm
    exact hright_ne_pen i (hacyc.eq_penultimate_of_adj_end hp (hright_adj i) hm)
  have hleft_right_ne (i j : Fin 2) : left i ≠ right j := by
    intro hij
    have hleft_ne_b : left i ≠ b := by
      intro hib
      exact hleft_not_support i (hib ▸ p.end_mem_support)
    let q : G.Walk a b :=
      .cons (hleft_adj i) (.cons (hij ▸ (hright_adj j).symm) .nil)
    have hq : q.IsPath := by
      simp [q, hab, hleft_ne_b, (hleft_adj i).ne]
    have hpq : p = q :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ((hacyc.subsingleton_path a b).elim ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩)
    apply hleft_not_support i
    rw [hpq]
    simp [q]
  let n := p.length + 1
  have hnlo : 2 ≤ n := by
    have hlen : 0 < p.length := by
      simpa [Walk.not_nil_iff_lt_length] using hp_not_nil
    simp [n]
    omega
  let pathEmb : Fin n ↪ V :=
    ⟨fun i ↦ p.getVert i.1, by
      intro i j hij
      apply Fin.ext
      exact hp.getVert_injOn
        (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; have := i.2; simp [n] at this; omega)
        (by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]; have := j.2; simp [n] at this; omega) hij⟩
  let e : Fin n ⊕ (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ↪ V :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ match x with
      | Sum.inl i => pathEmb i
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => left i
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inr i) => right i, by
      intro x y hxy
      cases x with
      | inl i =>
          cases y with
          | inl j => exact congrArg Sum.inl (pathEmb.injective hxy)
          | inr y =>
              cases y with
              | inl j =>
                  exfalso
                  change pathEmb i = left j at hxy
                  apply hleft_not_support j
                  rw [← hxy]
                  simp [pathEmb]
              | inr j =>
                  exfalso
                  change pathEmb i = right j at hxy
                  apply hright_not_support j
                  rw [← hxy]
                  simp [pathEmb]
      | inr x =>
          cases x with
          | inl i =>
              cases y with
              | inl j =>
                  exfalso
                  change left i = pathEmb j at hxy
                  apply hleft_not_support i
                  rw [hxy]
                  simp [pathEmb]
              | inr y =>
                  cases y with
                  | inl j => exact congrArg (Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inl) (left.injective hxy)
                  | inr j => exact (hleft_right_ne i j hxy).elim
          | inr i =>
              cases y with
              | inl j =>
                  exfalso
                  change right i = pathEmb j at hxy
                  apply hright_not_support i
                  rw [hxy]
                  simp [pathEmb]
              | inr y =>
                  cases y with
                  | inl j => exact (hleft_right_ne j i hxy.symm).elim
                  | inr j => exact congrArg (Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inr) (right.injective hxy)⟩
  let K : SimpleGraph (Fin n ⊕ (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)) := G.comap e
  have hdir : ∀ x y, doubleForkRel n x y → G.Adj (e x) (e y) := by
    intro x y hxy
    unfold doubleForkRel at hxy
    cases x with
    | inl i =>
        cases y with
        | inl j =>
            change (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj i j at hxy
            rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj] at hxy
            rcases hxy with hij | hji
            · have hadj := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := i.1) (by
                have := j.2
                simp [n] at this
                omega)
              simpa [e, pathEmb, hij] using hadj
            · have hadj := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := j.1) (by
                have := i.2
                simp [n] at this
                omega)
              simpa [e, pathEmb, hji] using hadj.symm
        | inr y =>
            cases y with
            | inl j =>
                change i.1 = 0 at hxy
                have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext hxy
                subst i
                simpa [e, pathEmb] using hleft_adj j
            | inr j =>
                change i.1 + 1 = n at hxy
                have hi : i.1 = p.length := by simp [n] at hxy ⊢; omega
                have hval : pathEmb i = b := by simp [pathEmb, hi]
                simpa [e, hval] using hright_adj j
    | inr x => cases x <;> simp at hxy
  have hfork_le : doubleForkGraph n ≤ K := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [doubleForkGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj] at hxy
    rcases hxy.2 with hxy | hyx
    · exact hdir x y hxy
    · exact (hdir y x hyx).symm
  have hK : IsPositiveCartan K := hG.comap e
  exact (not_isPositiveCartan_of_nonpositive_subgraph hfork_le
    (by
      intro hzero
      have hvalue := congrFun hzero (Sum.inl (0 : Fin n))
      norm_num [doubleForkWeight] at hvalue)
    (by intro x; cases x <;> norm_num [doubleForkWeight])
    (doubleFork_cartanEnergy_zero_unbounded n hnlo).le) hK

name: SRG266.Lattice.primaryModel_dual
statement:
theorem primaryModel_dual (p : SmallOddPrime) (s : PrimaryShape) :
    (primaryModelForm p s).dualSubmodule (primaryModelLattice p s) =
      primaryModelLattice p s ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (primaryModelVector p s))
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> cases s
  · change (standardRatForm 0).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 0) =
      coordinateIntegerLattice 0 ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → (Fin 0 → ℚ)))
    simp [standardRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice]
  · change E6Coordinates.form.dualSubmodule E6Coordinates.lattice =
      E6Coordinates.lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => E6Coordinates.dualVector))
    rw [Set.range_const]
    exact E6Coordinates.lattice_dual
  · change (simplexRatForm 2).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 2) =
      coordinateIntegerLattice 2 ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => simplexWeight 2))
    rw [Set.range_const]
    exact simplexRatForm_dual 2
  · exact A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector_dual
  · change (standardRatForm 0).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 0) =
      coordinateIntegerLattice 0 ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → (Fin 0 → ℚ)))
    simp [standardRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice]
  · change K8Coordinates.form.dualSubmodule K8Coordinates.lattice =
      K8Coordinates.lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
        (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (2 : ℤ) • K8Coordinates.dualVector))
    rw [Set.range_const]
    exact k8_twice_dualVector_dual
  · change (simplexRatForm 4).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice 4) =
      coordinateIntegerLattice 4 ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
        (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4))
    rw [Set.range_const]
    exact a4_twice_weight_dual
  · exact K4Coordinates.matchingVector_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.primaryModel_period
statement:
theorem primaryModel_period (p : SmallOddPrime) (s : PrimaryShape) (i : Fin s.arity) :
    (p.modulus : ℤ) • primaryModelVector p s i ∈ primaryModelLattice p s
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> cases s
  · exact Fin.elim0 i
  · exact E6Coordinates.three_smul_dualVector_mem
  · change (3 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 2 ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 2
    simpa using succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem 2
  · exact A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector_three_smul_mem i
  · exact Fin.elim0 i
  · change (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • K8Coordinates.dualVector) ∈ K8Coordinates.lattice
    rw [show (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • K8Coordinates.dualVector) =
      (2 : ℤ) • ((5 : ℤ) • K8Coordinates.dualVector) by module]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ (2 : ℤ) K8Coordinates.five_smul_dualVector_mem
  · change (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 4
    rw [show (5 : ℤ) • ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) =
      (2 : ℤ) • ((5 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) by module]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ (2 : ℤ) (by simpa using succ_smul_simplexWeight_mem 4)
  · exact K4Coordinates.matchingVector_five_smul_mem i

      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:

  · exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
  · change A2SquareCoordinates.form (A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector i)
      (A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    rw [A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector_cross i j hij]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact Fin.elim0 i
  · exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
  · exact (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j)).elim
  · change K4Coordinates.form (K4Coordinates.matchingVector i)
      (K4Coordinates.matchingVector j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
    rw [K4Coordinates.matchingVector_cross i j hij]
    exact zero_mem _

name: SRG266.Lattice.primaryModel_matched_norm
statement:
theorem primaryModel_matched_norm (p : SmallOddPrime) (s : PrimaryShape) (i : Fin s.arity) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, primaryFraction p s i +
      primaryModelForm p s (primaryModelVector p s i) (primaryModelVector p s i) = 2 * (k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  cases p <;> cases s
  · exact Fin.elim0 i
  · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
    change 2 / 3 + E6Coordinates.form E6Coordinates.dualVector E6Coordinates.dualVector = 2 * (2 : ℚ)
    rw [E6Coordinates.dualVector_norm]
    norm_num
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change 4 / 3 + simplexRatForm 2 (simplexWeight 2) (simplexWeight 2) = 2 * (1 : ℚ)
    rw [simplexWeight_norm]
    norm_num
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change 2 / 3 + A2SquareCoordinates.form (A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector i)
      (A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector i) = 2 * (1 : ℚ)
    rw [A2SquareCoordinates.matchingVector_norm]
    norm_num
  · exact Fin.elim0 i
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change 2 / 5 + K8Coordinates.form ((2 : ℤ) • K8Coordinates.dualVector)
      ((2 : ℤ) • K8Coordinates.dualVector) = 2 * (1 : ℚ)
    rw [k8_twice_dualVector_norm]
    norm_num
  · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
    change 4 / 5 + simplexRatForm 4 ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4)
      ((2 : ℤ) • simplexWeight 4) = 2 * (2 : ℚ)
    rw [a4_twice_weight_norm]
    norm_num
  · fin_cases i
    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      change 2 / 5 + K4Coordinates.form (K4Coordinates.matchingVector 0)
        (K4Coordinates.matchingVector 0) = 2 * (1 : ℚ)
      rw [K4Coordinates.matchingVector_norm]
      norm_num
    · refine ⟨10, ?_⟩
      change 4 / 5 + K4Coordinates.form (K4Coordinates.matchingVector 1)
        (K4Coordinates.matchingVector 1) = 2 * (10 : ℚ)
      rw [K4Coordinates.matchingVector_norm]
      norm_num

name: SRG266.Lattice.shortFrameLabel_compatible_B
statement:
theorem shortFrameLabel_compatible_B {a b c d : ℤ}
    (ha : ShortFrameLabel a c) (hb : b = 1 ∨ b = 11) (hd : d = -1 ∨ d = 1)
    (hdiv : 12 ∣ 21-a*b+16*c*d) :
    (orientedALabel (if b = 1 then 1 else -1) a = 9 ∧ c = 0) ∨
      (orientedALabel (if b = 1 then 1 else -1) a = 1 ∧ c = d)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ⟨ha, rfl⟩ | ⟨ha, hc⟩
  · rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases hd with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hdiv <;> norm_num [orientedALabel]
  · rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hd with rfl | rfl <;>
      norm_num at hdiv <;> norm_num [orientedALabel]

name: SRG266.Lattice.shortFrameLabel_compatible_A
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hdiv <;> rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.shortFrameLabel_global_orientation
statement:
theorem shortFrameLabel_global_orientation {ι : Type*} (anchor : ι) (a c : ι → ℤ)
    (hlabel : ∀ i, ShortFrameLabel (a i) (c i))
    (hpair : ∀ i j, 12 ∣ 21-a i*a j+16*c i*c j) :
    ∃ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = -1 ∨ ε = 1) ∧ (δ = -1 ∨ δ = 1) ∧
      ∀ i, (orientedALabel ε (a i) = 9 ∧ c i = 0) ∨
        (orientedALabel ε (a i) = 1 ∧ c i = δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hB : ∃ i, c i ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hB
    have hBj : (a j = 1 ∨ a j = 11) ∧ (c j = -1 ∨ c j = 1) :=
      (hlabel j).resolve_left (fun h => hj h.2)
    refine ⟨if a j = 1 then 1 else -1, c j, ?_, hBj.2, ?_⟩
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · intro i
      exact shortFrameLabel_compatible_B (hlabel i) hBj.1 hBj.2 (hpair i j)
  · have hc (i) : c i = 0 := by
      by_contra hi
      exact hB ⟨i, hi⟩
    have ha (i) : a i = 3 ∨ a i = 9 := by
      rcases hlabel i with h | ⟨_, h⟩
      · exact h.1
      · rw [hc i] at h
        omega
    have heq (i) : a i = a anchor := by
      apply shortFrameLabel_compatible_A (ha i) (ha anchor)
      simpa only [hc, mul_zero, add_zero] using hpair i anchor
    refine ⟨if a anchor = 9 then 1 else -1, 1, ?_, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · intro i
      refine Or.inl ⟨?_, hc i⟩
      rw [heq i]
      rcases ha anchor with h | h <;> simp [h, orientedALabel]

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRatForm_intCoords
statement:
theorem pdRatForm_intCoords (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (x y : Fin n → ℤ) :
    pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat x) (intCoordsToRat y) =
      ((L.pairing (pdCoordEquiv L x) (pdCoordEquiv L y) : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.BilinForm.dotProduct_toMatrix_mulVec
    (b := pdFinBasis L) L.pairing x y
  simp only [pdRatForm, Matrix.toBilin'_apply, pdGram, pdCoordEquiv]
  rw [← h]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
  push_cast
  simp only [intCoordsToRat_apply]
  ring_nf

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRatForm_isSymm
statement:
theorem pdRatForm_isSymm (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRatForm L).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y
  simp only [pdRatForm, Matrix.toBilin'_apply, pdGram]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_apply]
  rw [L.symmetric.eq (pdFinBasis L j) (pdFinBasis L i)]

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_intCoords_multiple
statement:
theorem exists_intCoords_multiple (v : Fin n → ℚ) :
    ∃ d : nonZeroDivisors ℤ, ∃ z : Fin n → ℤ,
      ∀ i, (z i : ℚ) = (d.1 : ℚ) * v i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exist_integer_multiples_of_finite
    (nonZeroDivisors ℤ) (Algebra.linearMap ℤ ℚ) v
  refine ⟨d, fun i => (hd i).choose, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact (hd i).choose_spec

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRatForm_posDef
statement:
theorem pdRatForm_posDef (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    ∀ v : Fin n → ℚ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < pdRatForm L v v
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨d, z, hz⟩ := exists_intCoords_multiple v
  have hd0 : (d.1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero d
  have hzfun : intCoordsToRat z = (d.1 : ℚ) • v := by
    funext i
    exact hz i
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hv
    funext i
    have hi := hz i
    rw [hzero] at hi
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, Int.cast_zero] at hi
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi.symm).resolve_left hd0
  have he0 : pdCoordEquiv L z ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using (pdCoordEquiv L).injective.ne hz0
  have hposZ := L.positiveDefinite (pdCoordEquiv L z) he0
  have hratZ : 0 < pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z) (intCoordsToRat z) := by
    rw [pdRatForm_intCoords]
    exact_mod_cast hposZ
  rw [hzfun] at hratZ
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hratZ
  have hdpos : 0 < (d.1 : ℚ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hd0
  nlinarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice
statement:
theorem pdRatForm_dual_coordinateIntegerLattice (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    (pdRatForm L).dualSubmodule (coordinateIntegerLattice n) =
      coordinateIntegerLattice n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    let coeff : Fin n → ℤ := fun i =>
      (mem_one_iff.mp (hv (intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1))
        (intCoordsToRat_mem (Pi.single i 1)))).choose
    have hcoeff : ∀ i,
        ((coeff i : ℤ) : ℚ) =
          pdRatForm L v (intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1)) := by
      intro i
      exact (mem_one_iff.mp (hv (intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1))
        (intCoordsToRat_mem (Pi.single i 1)))).choose_spec
    let psi : (Fin n → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ :=
      { toFun := fun x => ∑ i, x i * coeff i
        map_add' := by
          intro x y
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        map_smul' := by
          intro a x
          simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
          ring }
    have hpsi : ∀ x : Fin n → ℤ,
        ((psi x : ℤ) : ℚ) = pdRatForm L v (intCoordsToRat x) := by
      intro x
      have hxsum : intCoordsToRat x =
          ∑ i, (x i : ℚ) • (Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) := by
        calc
          intCoordsToRat x = intCoordsToRat (∑ i, Pi.single i (x i)) :=
            congrArg intCoordsToRat (Finset.univ_sum_single x).symm
          _ = ∑ i, intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i (x i)) := by rw [map_sum]
          _ = ∑ i, (x i : ℚ) • (Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            funext j
            by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [intCoordsToRat, hji]
      rw [hxsum, map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      change (((∑ i, x i * coeff i : ℤ)) : ℚ) =
        ∑ i, (x i : ℚ) * pdRatForm L v (Pi.single i 1)
      push_cast
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [hcoeff]
      congr 2
      funext j
      by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji]
    let phi : L.carrier →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ :=
      psi.comp (pdFinBasis L).equivFun.toLinearMap
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := L.unimodular.2 phi
    let z : Fin n → ℤ := (pdFinBasis L).equivFun y
    have hpair : ∀ x : Fin n → ℤ,
        pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z) (intCoordsToRat x) =
          pdRatForm L v (intCoordsToRat x) := by
      intro x
      have hleft := pdRatForm_intCoords L z x
      have hyx : L.pairing y (pdCoordEquiv L x) = psi x := by
        have := LinearMap.congr_fun hy (pdCoordEquiv L x)
        simpa [phi, psi, pdCoordEquiv, z] using this
      calc
        pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z) (intCoordsToRat x) =
            ((L.pairing (pdCoordEquiv L z) (pdCoordEquiv L x) : ℤ) : ℚ) := hleft
        _ = ((psi x : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
          rw [show pdCoordEquiv L z = y by simp [pdCoordEquiv, z], hyx]
        _ = pdRatForm L v (intCoordsToRat x) := hpsi x
    have heq : intCoordsToRat z = v := by
      have hzero : ∀ x : Fin n → ℤ,
          pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z - v) (intCoordsToRat x) = 0 := by
        intro x
        rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hpair x, sub_self]
      have hcoords : ∀ i,
          pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z - v) (Pi.single i 1) = 0 := by
        intro i
        have hsingle : intCoordsToRat (Pi.single i 1) =
            (Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → ℚ) := by
          funext j
          by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [intCoordsToRat, hji]
        rw [← hsingle]
        exact hzero (Pi.single i 1)
      have hall : pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z - v) = 0 := by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro q
        rw [show q = ∑ i, Pi.single i (q i) from (Finset.univ_sum_single q).symm,
          map_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i _
        rw [show (Pi.single i (q i) : Fin n → ℚ) =
            q i • Pi.single i 1 by
          funext j
          by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji]]
        rw [map_smul, hcoords]
        simp
      have hnorm : pdRatForm L (intCoordsToRat z - v)
          (intCoordsToRat z - v) = 0 := by rw [hall]; rfl
      by_contra hne
      have := pdRatForm_posDef L (intCoordsToRat z - v) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
      rw [hnorm] at this
      exact lt_irrefl 0 this
    rw [← heq]
    exact intCoordsToRat_mem z
  · intro v hv w hw
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hv
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [pdRatForm_intCoords]
    exact mem_one_iff.mpr
      ⟨L.pairing (pdCoordEquiv L x) (pdCoordEquiv L y), rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_root_finset_and_moment
statement:
theorem exists_root_finset_and_moment
    (hs : F.IsSymm) (hpd : ∀ x : X, x ≠ 0 → 0 < F x x)
    (hrank : Module.finrank ℚ X = 24) (hl : IsLattice ℚ H)
    (hself : F.dualSubmodule H = H) (he : IsEven F H) :
    ∃ R : Finset X,
      (∀ z, z ∈ R ↔ z ∈ H ∧ F z z = 2) ∧
      (∀ x y : X, 12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) = (R.card : ℚ) * F x y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, e, hpair⟩ := exists_pdUnimodularLattice hs hpd hrank hl hself
  have heL : ∀ z : L.carrier, Even (L.pairing z z) := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := he (e.symm z : X) (e.symm z).property
    have hQ : ((L.pairing z z : ℤ) : ℚ) = 2 * (k : ℚ) := by
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hk] using hpair (e.symm z) (e.symm z)
    have hZ : L.pairing z z = 2 * k := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
  let value : NormTwoRoot L → X := fun r => (e.symm r.1 : X)
  have hinj : Function.Injective value := by
    intro r s h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply e.symm.injective
    exact Subtype.ext h
  let R : Finset X := Finset.univ.map ⟨value, hinj⟩
  have hp (r : NormTwoRoot L) (x : H) :
      ((L.pairing r.1 (e x) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F (value r) x := by
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hpair (e.symm r.1) x
  have hcomplete (z : X) : z ∈ R ↔ z ∈ H ∧ F z z = 2 := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
      refine ⟨(e.symm r.1).property, ?_⟩
      change F (e.symm r.1 : X) (e.symm r.1 : X) = 2
      have h := hpair (e.symm r.1) (e.symm r.1)
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, r.2, Int.cast_ofNat] using h.symm
    · rintro ⟨hz, hn⟩
      have hnorm : L.pairing (e ⟨z, hz⟩) (e ⟨z, hz⟩) = 2 := by
        have hQ := (hpair ⟨z, hz⟩ ⟨z, hz⟩).trans hn
        exact_mod_cast hQ
      refine Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨e ⟨z, hz⟩, hnorm⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      simp [value]
  have hlocal (x y : H) :
      12 * (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) = (R.card : ℚ) * F x y := by
    have h := harmonicRootIdentity L heL (e x) (e y)
    have hQ : (24 : ℚ) * (∑ r : NormTwoRoot L,
        ((L.pairing r.1 (e x) : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((L.pairing r.1 (e y) : ℤ) : ℚ)) =
        2 * (Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot L) : ℚ) * F x y := by
      rw [← hpair x y]
      exact_mod_cast h
    simp_rw [hp] at hQ
    have hsum : (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) =
        ∑ r : NormTwoRoot L, F (value r) x * F (value r) y := by simp [R]
    rw [hsum, show (R.card : ℚ) = (Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot L) : ℚ) by simp [R]]
    linarith
  let M : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X :=
    (12 : ℚ) • (∑ r ∈ R, (F r).smulRight (F r)) - (R.card : ℚ) • F
  have hMlocal (x y : H) : M x y = 0 := by
    simp only [M, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hlocal x y)
  have hleft (x : H) : M (x : X) = 0 := by
    have hk : Submodule.span ℚ (H : Set X) ≤ (M (x : X)).ker :=
      Submodule.span_le.mpr fun y hy => hMlocal x ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [hl.spans] at hk
    ext y
    exact hk (Submodule.mem_top)
  have hk : Submodule.span ℚ (H : Set X) ≤ M.ker :=
    Submodule.span_le.mpr fun x hx => hleft ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [hl.spans] at hk
  refine ⟨R, hcomplete, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  have hx : M x = 0 := hk Submodule.mem_top
  have hxy : M x y = 0 := by rw [hx]; rfl
  simp only [M, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hxy
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hxy

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_harmonicGaussian_comp_linearEquiv_pow_decay
statement:
theorem exists_harmonicGaussian_comp_linearEquiv_pow_decay
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (k : ℕ) (A : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V) (x y : V) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : V, u ≠ 0 →
      ‖harmonicGaussian t x y (A u)‖ ≤ C / ‖u‖ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hdecay⟩ := exists_harmonicGaussian_pow_decay ht k x y
  let D : ℝ :=
    ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap‖
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := norm_nonneg _
  refine ⟨C * D ^ k, mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg hD k), fun u hu => ?_⟩
  have hAu : A u ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using A.injective.ne hu
  have hnu : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
  have hnAu : 0 < ‖A u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hAu
  have hbase := hdecay (A u) hAu
  have hmass :
      ‖harmonicGaussian t x y (A u)‖ * ‖A u‖ ^ k ≤ C :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hnAu k)).mp hbase
  have hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ D * ‖A u‖ := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ = ‖A.symm (A u)‖ := by rw [A.symm_apply_apply]
      _ ≤ D * ‖A u‖ :=
        A.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (A u)
  have hpow : ‖u‖ ^ k ≤ D ^ k * ‖A u‖ ^ k := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ k ≤ (D * ‖A u‖) ^ k :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm k
      _ = D ^ k * ‖A u‖ ^ k := mul_pow D ‖A u‖ k
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hnu k)]
  calc
    ‖harmonicGaussian t x y (A u)‖ * ‖u‖ ^ k ≤
        ‖harmonicGaussian t x y (A u)‖ * (D ^ k * ‖A u‖ ^ k) := by
      gcongr
    _ = D ^ k *
        (‖harmonicGaussian t x y (A u)‖ * ‖A u‖ ^ k) := by ring
    _ ≤ D ^ k * C := by gcongr
    _ = C * D ^ k := by ring

        ∑' z : Fin 24 → ℤ,

proof:
:= by
  have hp := continuous_piPoisson
    (latticeHarmonicGaussianContinuous L t x y)
    (latticeHarmonicGaussian_integrable L ht x y)
    (latticeHarmonicGaussian_locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates
      L ht x y)

  change (∑' z : Fin 24 → ℤ,
      harmonicGaussian t x y
        (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal z))) =
    ∑' m : Fin 24 → ℤ,
      𝓕 (fun u => harmonicGaussian t x y (pdEuclideanEquiv L u))
        (intVectorToReal m) at hp
  rw [hp]
  calc
    (∑' m : Fin 24 → ℤ,
      𝓕 (fun u => harmonicGaussian t x y (pdEuclideanEquiv L u))
        (intVectorToReal m)) =
      ∑' m : Fin 24 → ℤ,
        -((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 14 *
          harmonicGaussian t⁻¹ x y
            (pdEuclideanEquiv L
              (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm m))) := by
        apply tsum_congr
        exact fourier_latticeHarmonicGaussian_rank24 L ht x y
    _ = -((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 14 *
        ∑' m : Fin 24 → ℤ,
          harmonicGaussian t⁻¹ x y
            (pdEuclideanEquiv L
              (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm m))) := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left]
    _ = -((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 14 *
        ∑' z : Fin 24 → ℤ,
          harmonicGaussian t⁻¹ x y
            (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal z)) := by
        congr 1
        exact (pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm.toEquiv.tsum_eq
          (fun z : Fin 24 → ℤ =>
            harmonicGaussian t⁻¹ x y
              (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal z)))

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_harmonicGaussian_pow_decay
statement:
theorem exists_harmonicGaussian_pow_decay {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (k : ℕ) (x y : V) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ u : V, u ≠ 0 →
      ‖harmonicGaussian t x y u‖ ≤ A / ‖u‖ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  let a := Real.pi * t
  have ha : 0 < a := mul_pos Real.pi_pos ht
  obtain ⟨B, hB0, hB⟩ := exists_bound_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq (k + 2) ha
  let C : ℝ := ((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) + 1) * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
  refine ⟨C * B, mul_nonneg hC hB0, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  have hunorm : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hunorm k)]
  rw [harmonicGaussian, realGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp,
    Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hre :
      (-((Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (‖u‖ : ℂ) ^ 2).re =
        -a * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [a]
    norm_cast
  rw [hre]
  have hp := abs_harmonicQuadratic_le x y u
  have hbound := hB ‖u‖
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at hbound
  calc
    |harmonicQuadratic x y u| * Real.exp (-a * ‖u‖ ^ 2) * ‖u‖ ^ k ≤
        (C * ‖u‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-a * ‖u‖ ^ 2) * ‖u‖ ^ k := by
      gcongr
    _ = C * (‖u‖ ^ (k + 2) * Real.exp (-a * ‖u‖ ^ 2)) := by
      rw [pow_add]
      ring
    _ ≤ C * B := by gcongr

    _ = -((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 14 *

name: SRG266.Lattice.d7_root_separation_of_frame
statement:
theorem d7_root_separation_of_frame
    (u : ι → W) (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U)) (bound : ℚ)
    (hB : ∀ y : W, y ≠ 0 → 0 < B y y) (hC : ∀ z : U, z ≠ 0 → 0 < C z z)
    (hi : IsIntegral (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C) L)
    (hD7 : ∀ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7, ((0, a), (0 : U)) ∈ L)
    (hframe : ∀ i, ((u i, coordinateSpinor 7), (0 : U)) ∈ L)
    (hbound : ∀ y, ∑ i, (B y (u i)) ^ 2 ≤ bound * B y y)
    (hbound0 : 0 ≤ bound) (hmass : 4 * bound < Fintype.card ι)
    {r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U} (hr : r ∈ L)
    (hnorm : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r = 2) :
    r.1.2 = 0 ∨ (r.1.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with ⟨⟨y, a⟩, z⟩
  change a = 0 ∨ (y = 0 ∧ z = 0)
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · exact Or.inl ha0
  right
  have ha : 0 < standardRatForm 7 a a := standardRatForm_posDef 7 a ha0
  have hBy : 0 ≤ B y y := by
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · simp [hy]
    · exact (hB y hy).le
  have hCz : 0 ≤ C z z := by
    by_cases hz : z = 0
    · simp [hz]
    · exact (hC z hz).le
  change B y y + standardRatForm 7 a a + C z z = 2 at hnorm
  have htwo : standardRatForm 7 a a = 2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hsmall : standardRatForm 7 a a < 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (by linarith) hne
    have hadual : a ∈ (standardRatForm 7).dualSubmodule (evenCoordinateLattice 7) := by
      intro b hb
      have hp := hi hr ((0, b), 0) (hD7 b hb)
      simpa only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, zero_add, add_zero] using hp
    have hgap (i) : (2 - standardRatForm 7 a a) / 4 ≤ (B y (u i)) ^ 2 := by
      apply d7_short_dual_gap hadual ha hsmall
      have hp := hi hr ((u i, coordinateSpinor 7), 0) (hframe i)
      simpa only [prodForm_apply, map_zero, add_zero] using hp
    have hupper : ∑ i, (B y (u i)) ^ 2 ≤ bound * (2 - standardRatForm 7 a a) :=
      (hbound y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hbound0)
    have hc := MomentBounds.card_le_four_mul_bound Finset.univ
      (fun i => B y (u i)) (2 - standardRatForm 7 a a) bound (by linarith)
      (fun i _ => hgap i) hupper
    simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hc
    exact (not_le_of_gt hmass) hc
  constructor
  · by_contra hy
    have hp := hB y hy
    linarith
  · by_contra hz
    have hp := hC z hz
    linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.centered_integer_pair_identity
statement:
theorem centered_integer_pair_identity {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (z w : ι → ℤ) (a b : ℤ) (hz : (∑ i, z i) = a) (hw : (∑ i, w i) = b) :
    (∑ i, ((z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)*
      ((w i : ℚ)-(b : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)) =
      ((∑ i, z i*w i : ℤ) : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)*b/Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (Fintype.card ι : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hzQ : (∑ i, (z i : ℚ)) = (a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hz
  have hwQ : (∑ i, (w i : ℚ)) = (b : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hw
  have hp (s t : ℚ) : (s-(a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)*(t-(b : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι) =
      s*t-((b : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)*s-((a : ℚ)/Fintype.card ι)*t+
        (a : ℚ)*b/(Fintype.card ι)^2 := by ring
  simp_rw [hp]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [hzQ, hwQ, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanA_centered_pair
statement:
theorem cartanA_centered_pair (n : ℕ) (u v : Fin n → ℚ)
    (z w : Fin (n+1) → ℤ) (a b : ℤ) (hz : (∑ i, z i) = a) (hw : (∑ i, w i) = b)
    (hu : ∀ i, cartanAZeroSum n u i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1))
    (hv : ∀ i, cartanAZeroSum n v i = (w i : ℚ)-(b : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1)) :
    cartanARatForm n u v = ((∑ i, z i*w i : ℤ) : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)*b/((n : ℚ)+1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartanARatForm, ← cartanAZeroSum_pair, standardRatForm_apply]
  simp_rw [hu, hv]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
    centered_integer_pair_identity z w a b hz hw

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_adeBlock_equiv_of_perm
statement:
theorem exists_adeBlock_equiv_of_perm {ts us : List ADEType} (p : ts.Perm us) :
    ∃ e : ADEBlockIndex ts ≃ ADEBlockIndex us,
      ∀ i j, adeBlockPairing ts i j = adeBlockPairing us (e i) (e j)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact ⟨Equiv.refl _, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  | cons t _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) e, ?_⟩
      intro i j
      cases i with
      | inl i => cases j <;> rfl
      | inr i =>
          cases j with
          | inl j => rfl
          | inr j => exact he i j
  | swap t u ts =>
      let e : Fin u.rank ⊕ (Fin t.rank ⊕ ADEBlockIndex ts) ≃
          Fin t.rank ⊕ (Fin u.rank ⊕ ADEBlockIndex ts) :=
        (Equiv.sumAssoc _ _ _).symm |>.trans
          ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm _ _) (Equiv.refl _)).trans
            (Equiv.sumAssoc _ _ _))
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      intro i j
      rcases i with i | i | i <;> rcases j with j | j | j <;> rfl
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ih₁
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ih₂
      exact ⟨e.trans f, fun i j => (he i j).trans (hf (e i) (e j))⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_adeGram_equiv_of_perm
statement:
theorem exists_adeGram_equiv_of_perm {ts us : List ADEType} (p : ts.Perm us) :
    ∃ e : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ Fin (ADEType.rankSum us),
      ∀ i j, (adeGram ts).2 i j = (adeGram us).2 (e i) (e j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_adeBlock_equiv_of_perm p
  let f := (finADEBlockEquiv ts).trans (e.trans (finADEBlockEquiv us).symm)
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  rw [adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing, adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing]
  simpa [f] using he (finADEBlockEquiv ts i) (finADEBlockEquiv ts j)

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartan_coordinates_of_ADE_perm
statement:
theorem graphCartan_coordinates_of_ADE_perm
    {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) {ts us : List ADEType} (p : ts.Perm us)
    (coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ V)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix G (coord i) (coord j) = (adeGram ts).2 i j) :
    ∃ coord' : Fin (ADEType.rankSum us) ≃ V,
      ∀ i j, graphCartanMatrix G (coord' i) (coord' j) = (adeGram us).2 i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_adeGram_equiv_of_perm p
  refine ⟨e.symm.trans coord, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have h := (hgram (e.symm i) (e.symm j)).trans (he (e.symm i) (e.symm j))
  simpa using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanA_dual_positive_norm_lower
statement:
theorem cartanA_dual_positive_norm_lower (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ i, cartanARatForm n u (Pi.single i 1) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hpos : 0 < cartanARatForm n u u) :
    (n : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1) ≤ cartanARatForm n u u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, han, z, hz, hc, hmin, _⟩ := cartanA_dual_minimum_coordinates n u hd
  have hden : 0 < (n : ℚ)+1 := by positivity
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := cartanA_norm_congruence n u a z hz hc
    norm_num [ha] at hm
    have hmpos : (0 : ℚ) < m := by linarith
    have hmposZ : 0 < m := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
    have hmone : (1 : ℚ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ m by omega)
    have hunit : (n : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1) ≤ 1 :=
      (div_le_one hden).mpr (by linarith)
    linarith
  · have ha1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ a by omega)
    have hanQ : (a : ℚ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast han
    have hprod := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hanQ)
    have hm := (div_le_iff₀ hden).mp hmin
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr
    nlinarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11_dual_norm_ne_two_thirds
statement:
theorem a11_dual_norm_ne_two_thirds (u : Fin 11 → ℚ)

    cartanARatForm 11 u u ≠ 2/3
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hl := cartanA_dual_positive_norm_lower 11 u hd (by rw [h]; norm_num)
  norm_num [h] at hl

name: SRG266.Lattice.no_A11_mass_275_orthogonal_A2_A4
statement:
theorem no_A11_mass_275_orthogonal_A2_A4 {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hpos : ∀ u, u ≠ 0 → 0 < cartanARatForm 11 u u) (v : ι → (Fin 11 → ℚ))
    (hm : ∀ y, (∑ i, (cartanARatForm 11 y (v i))^2) ≤ 45*cartanARatForm 11 y y)
    (hmass : (∑ i, cartanARatForm 11 (v i) (v i)) = 275)
    (r : Fin 2 → (Fin 11 → ℚ)) (s : Fin 4 → (Fin 11 → ℚ))
    (hr : ∀ i j, cartanARatForm 11 (r i) (r j) = (gramA 2 i j : ℚ))
    (hs : ∀ i j, cartanARatForm 11 (s i) (s j) = (gramA 4 i j : ℚ))
    (hrs : ∀ i j, cartanARatForm 11 (r i) (s j) = 0)
    (hrv : ∀ j i, cartanARatForm 11 (r j) (v i) = 0)
    (hsv : ∀ j i, cartanARatForm 11 (s j) (v i) = 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hri : LinearIndependent ℚ r :=
    linearIndependent_of_gram_nondegenerate (cartanARatForm 11) r (by
      simp only [hr]
      exact cartanA_two_nondegenerate)
  have hsi : LinearIndependent ℚ s :=
    linearIndependent_of_gram_nondegenerate (cartanARatForm 11) s (by
      simp only [hs]
      exact cartanA_four_nondegenerate)
  have hself (x) (hx : cartanARatForm 11 x x = 0) : x = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hp := hpos x hne
    linarith
  have hi := linearIndependent_sum_of_orthogonal (cartanARatForm 11) hself r s hri hsi hrs
  have ho (j : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 4) (i : ι) : cartanARatForm 11 (Sum.elim r s j) (v i) = 0 := by
    rcases j with j | j
    · exact hrv j i
    · exact hsv j i
  have h := rational_frame_mass_le_orthogonal_rank (cartanARatForm 11)
    ⟨(cartanARatForm_isSymm 11).eq⟩ hpos v 45 (by norm_num) hm (Sum.elim r s) hi ho
  rw [hmass] at h
  norm_num at h

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwo_integer_coordinates
statement:
theorem normTwo_integer_coordinates
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℚ X]
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (L : Submodule ℤ X)
    {n m : ℕ} (N : PDUnimodularLattice n) [Finite (NormTwoRoot N)]
    (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier)
    (hpairN : ∀ u v : L, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F u v)
    {f : N.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (coord : Fin m ≃ simpleRootSet f) (ψ : (Fin m → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X)
    (hψ : ∀ z : Fin m → ℤ, ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) =
      (e.symm (coordinateRootMap coord z) : X))
    {r : X} (hr : r ∈ L) (hnorm : F r r = 2) :
    ψ.symm r ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice m
proof:
:= by
  have hnN : N.pairing (e ⟨r, hr⟩) (e ⟨r, hr⟩) = 2 := by
    have h := (hpairN ⟨r, hr⟩ ⟨r, hr⟩).trans hnorm
    exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := coordinateRootMap_covers_normTwoRoots hf coord ⟨e ⟨r, hr⟩, hnN⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  apply ψ.injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change ψ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) = r
  rw [hψ, hz, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordSum_mem_span
statement:

proof:

    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordSum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coordSum_eq_zero {b : Fin n → X} (hli : LinearIndependent ℚ b) {v : Fin n → ℤ}
    (h : coordSum b v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have hz := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli (fun i => (v i : ℚ)) h i
  exact_mod_cast hz

name: SRG266.Lattice.toBilin'_coordSum
statement:
theorem toBilin'_coordSum {F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X} (b : Fin n → X)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (hA : ∀ i j, ((A i j : ℤ) : ℚ) = F (b i) (b j))
    (v w : Fin n → ℤ) :
    ((Matrix.toBilin' A v w : ℤ) : ℚ) = F (coordSum b v) (coordSum b w)
proof:
:= by
  have hRHS : F (coordSum b v) (coordSum b w)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, (v i : ℚ) * ((w j : ℚ) * F (b i) (b j)) := by
    rw [show coordSum b v = ∑ i, (v i : ℚ) • b i from rfl, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      show coordSum b w = ∑ j, (w j : ℚ) • b j from rfl, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hRHS, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  push_cast
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [← hA i j]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_A11_pair_of_E6_middle_zero
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_A11_pair_of_E6_middle_zero
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (r s : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U)
    (hrE : a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = 0) (hrD : r.1.2 = 0) :
    cartanARatForm 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)) (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) =
      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r s
proof:
:= by
  have h := a11D7E6_pair_of_middle_zero B C ψ hpair hmarked r s hrD
  rw [hrE, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.rank24HarmonicThetaModularity

    Rank24HarmonicThetaModularityInput

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicThetaCoefficient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem harmonicThetaCoefficient_eq_zero
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) (k : ℕ) :
    harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := rank24HarmonicThetaModularity N heven x y
  have hfzero : f = 0 := levelOne_weight_fourteen_cusp_eq_zero f
  have hseries : harmonicThetaSeries N x y = 0 := by
    rw [← hf, hfzero]
    simpa using UpperHalfPlane.qExpansion_zero (1 : ℝ)
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun s : PowerSeries ℂ => s.coeff k) hseries
  have hcoeff' : (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k : ℂ) = 0 := by
    simpa using hcoeff
  exact_mod_cast hcoeff'

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicRootIdentity
statement:
theorem harmonicRootIdentity
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) :
    24 * (∑ r : NormTwoRoot N,
      N.pairing r.1 x * N.pairing r.1 y) =
      2 * (Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) : ℤ) * N.pairing x y
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := harmonicThetaCoefficient_eq_zero N heven x y 1
  change (∑ r : NormTwoRoot N,
    (24 * N.pairing r.1 x * N.pairing r.1 y -
      N.pairing x y * N.pairing r.1 r.1)) = 0 at hzero
  have hexpand :
      (∑ r : NormTwoRoot N,
        (24 * N.pairing r.1 x * N.pairing r.1 y -
          N.pairing x y * N.pairing r.1 r.1)) =
        24 * (∑ r : NormTwoRoot N,
          N.pairing r.1 x * N.pairing r.1 y) -
          2 * (Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) : ℤ) * N.pairing x y := by
    simp_rw [show ∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, N.pairing r.1 r.1 = 2 from fun r => r.2]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    congr 1
    · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      ring
    · rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
  rw [hexpand] at hzero
  linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_pair_congruence
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_pair_congruence
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (r s : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U)
    (hrs : prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r s ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hdpair : standardRatForm 7 r.1.2 s.1.2 = 7/4)
    (a b c d : ℤ) (z w : Fin 12 → ℤ)
    (hz : (∑ i, z i) = a) (hw : (∑ i, w i) = b)
    (hrcoord : ∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r)) i =
      (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/12)
    (hscoord : ∀ i, cartanAZeroSum 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) i =
      (w i : ℚ)-(b : ℚ)/12)
    (hrE : ∃ v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm r) = v+c • E6Cartan.weight)
    (hsE : ∃ v ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice 6, a11D7E6E6Part (ψ.symm s) = v+d • E6Cartan.weight) :
    12 ∣ 21-a*b+16*c*d
proof:
:= by
  have hA := cartanA_centered_pair 11 (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm r))
    (a11D7E6A11Part (ψ.symm s)) z w a b hz hw
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using hrcoord)
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, show (11 : ℚ)+1 = 12 by norm_num] using hscoord)
  norm_num only at hA
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := E6Cartan.pair_mod_integer hrE hsE
  have hD : adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types (a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm r))
      (a11D7E6D7Projection (ψ.symm s)) = 7/4 := by
    rw [← hpair, ← hmarked, ← hmarked, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simpa [middleCoordinateInclusion, middleCoordinateProjection, prodForm_apply] using hdpair
  have hp := hpair (ψ.symm r) (ψ.symm s)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    a11D7E6_pair_decomposition, hA, hD, hm] at hp
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hrs
  refine ⟨k-(∑ i, z i*w i)-m, ?_⟩
  have hQ : (21 : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)*b+16*(c : ℚ)*d =
      12*((k : ℚ)-((∑ i, z i*w i : ℤ) : ℚ)-m) := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast hQ

name: SRG266.Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral.not_integral_norm_add_smul
statement:
theorem IsMaximalIntegral.not_integral_norm_add_smul
    (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N) (hs : B.IsSymm)
    (hu : u ∈ B.dualSubmodule N) (hv : v ∈ B.dualSubmodule N)
    (hcross : B u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hunit : B u u ∉ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) (a : ℤ) :
    B (u + a • v) (u + a • v) ∉ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  intro hnorm
  have hm := hmax.mem_of_dual_of_integral_norm hs
    ((B.dualSubmodule N).add_mem hu ((B.dualSubmodule N).smul_mem a hv)) hnorm
  have hpair := hu _ hm
  have heq : a • v = (a : ℚ) • v := by module
  rw [map_add, heq, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hpair
  have hc : (a : ℚ) * B u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem a hcross
  exact hunit ((congrArg (fun q : ℚ => q ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (add_sub_cancel_right (B u u) ((a : ℚ) * B u v))).mp (sub_mem hpair hc))

name: SRG266.Lattice.unit_norm_not_integral
statement:
private theorem unit_norm_not_integral {p r k : ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hpn : ¬ p ∣ 1) (hcop : IsCoprime p r)
    (hn : B u u = (r : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) + 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    B u u ∉ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hpn (norm_denominator_unit hp hcop hn 1 (by simpa using h))

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_add_smul
proof:
:= by
  have heq : a • v = (a : ℚ) • v := by module
  rw [heq]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hs.eq v u]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.normalized_three_pair
statement:
theorem normalized_three_pair (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N)
    (hu : u ∈ B.dualSubmodule N) (hv : v ∈ B.dualSubmodule N)
    (hpu : (3 : ℤ) • u ∈ N) (hpv : (3 : ℤ) • v ∈ N)
    (hcross : B u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hnu : ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧ B u u = (r : ℚ) / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
    (hnv : ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧ B v v = (r : ℚ) / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    ∃ x y : W, N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {x, y} = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u, v} ∧
      B x y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B x x = 2 / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B y y = 2 / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, k, hr, hru⟩ := hnu
  obtain ⟨s, l, hS, hsv⟩ := hnv
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hcross
  have hcop : IsCoprime (3 : ℤ) r := by
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, -1, by norm_num⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, 1, by norm_num⟩
  have hnot := hmax.not_integral_norm_add_smul hs hu hv hcross
    (unit_norm_not_integral (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcop hru) 1
  have hrs : r = s := by
    by_contra hne
    have hrS : r + s = 6 := by omega
    have hrSQ : (r : ℚ) + s = 6 := by exact_mod_cast hrS
    apply hnot
    refine mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨2 + 2 * k + 2 * l + 2 * c, ?_⟩
    rw [norm_add_smul hs, hru, hsv, ← hc]
    push_cast
    norm_num
    linarith
  subst s
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨u, v, rfl, hcross, ⟨k, hru⟩, ⟨l, hsv⟩⟩
  · refine ⟨u + v, u - v,
      sup_span_pair_hadamard_eq ⟨-1, 1, by norm_num⟩ hpu hpv, ?_,
      ⟨k + l + c + 1, ?_⟩, ⟨k + l - c + 1, ?_⟩⟩
    · refine mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨2 * (k - l), ?_⟩
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub]
      rw [hs.eq v u, hru, hsv]
      push_cast
      ring
    · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [hs.eq v u, hru, hsv, ← hc]
      push_cast
      ring
    · simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
      rw [hs.eq v u, hru, hsv, ← hc]
      push_cast
      ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.normalized_five_pair_of_unary
statement:
theorem normalized_five_pair_of_unary (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N)
    (hu : u ∈ B.dualSubmodule N) (hv : v ∈ B.dualSubmodule N)
    (hcross : B u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hnu : ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧ B u u = (r : ℚ) / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
    (hnv : ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧ B v v = (r : ℚ) / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) :
    ∃ x y : W, N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {x, y} = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u, v} ∧
      B x y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B x x = 2 / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B y y = 4 / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, k, hr, hru⟩ := hnu
  obtain ⟨s, l, hS, hsv⟩ := hnv
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hcross
  have hcop : IsCoprime (5 : ℤ) r := by
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, -2, by norm_num⟩
    · exact ⟨1, -1, by norm_num⟩
  have hnot := hmax.not_integral_norm_add_smul hs hu hv hcross
    (unit_norm_not_integral (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcop hru) 2
  have hrs : r ≠ s := by
    intro hrs
    subst s
    apply hnot
    refine mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨r + 2 * k + 8 * l + 4 * c, ?_⟩
    rw [norm_add_smul hs, hru, hsv, ← hc]
    push_cast
    ring
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl
  · have hs4 : s = 4 := by omega
    subst s
    exact ⟨u, v, rfl, hcross, ⟨k, hru⟩, ⟨l, hsv⟩⟩
  · have hs2 : s = 2 := by omega
    subst s
    exact ⟨v, u, by rw [Set.pair_comm v u], by rwa [hs.eq], ⟨l, hsv⟩, ⟨k, hru⟩⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.normalized_five_pair
statement:
theorem normalized_five_pair (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N)
    (hu : u ∈ B.dualSubmodule N) (hv : v ∈ B.dualSubmodule N)
    (hpu : (5 : ℤ) • u ∈ N) (hpv : (5 : ℤ) • v ∈ N)
    (hcross : B u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hnu : ∃ m : ℤ, Even m ∧ ¬ (5 : ℤ) ∣ m ∧ 5 * B u u = (m : ℚ))
    (hnv : ∃ m : ℤ, Even m ∧ ¬ (5 : ℤ) ∣ m ∧ 5 * B v v = (m : ℚ)) :
    ∃ x y : W, N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {x, y} = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {u, v} ∧
      B x y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B x x = 2 / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B y y = 4 / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmu, hmq⟩ := hnu
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hnu, hnq⟩ := hnv
  obtain ⟨a, r, k, ha, hr, hru⟩ := normalized_norm_five hm hmu hmq
  obtain ⟨b, s, l, hb, hS, hsv⟩ := normalized_norm_five hn hnu hnq
  have hau : a • u = (a : ℚ) • u := by module
  have hbv : b • v = (b : ℚ) • v := by module
  have hnormu : B (a • u) (a • u) = (r : ℚ) / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ) := by
    rw [hau]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith [hru]
  have hnormv : B (b • v) (b • v) = (s : ℚ) / 5 + 2 * (l : ℚ) := by
    rw [hbv]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith [hsv]
  have hcross' : B (a • u) (b • v) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    rw [hau, hbv]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using
      (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem b ((1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).smul_mem a hcross)
  obtain ⟨x, y, hspan, hxy, hxx, hyy⟩ := normalized_five_pair_of_unary hs hmax
    ((B.dualSubmodule N).smul_mem a hu) ((B.dualSubmodule N).smul_mem b hv)
    hcross' ⟨r, k, hr, hnormu⟩ ⟨s, l, hS, hnormv⟩
  refine ⟨x, y, hspan.trans ?_, hxy, hxx, hyy⟩
  have haB : ∃ d e : ℤ, a * d + 5 * e = 1 := by
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, 0, by norm_num⟩
    · exact ⟨3, -1, by norm_num⟩
  have hbB : ∃ d e : ℤ, b * d + 5 * e = 1 := by
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨1, 0, by norm_num⟩
    · exact ⟨3, -1, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨d, e, hde⟩ := haB
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg⟩ := hbB
  exact sup_span_pair_smul_eq hpu hpv hde hfg

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueBasis.normalized_binary_three
statement:
theorem GlueBasis.normalized_binary_three (S : GlueBasis B N 3) (hR : S.rank = 2)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N) :
    ∃ x y : W, torsionPart B N 3 = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {x, y} ∧
      B x y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B x x = 2 / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B y y = 2 / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases S with ⟨rank, hle, vec, hmem, hspan, hortho, hdiag, hind⟩
  dsimp at hR
  subst rank
  have hn (i : Fin 2) : ∃ r k : ℤ, (r = 2 ∨ r = 4) ∧
      B (vec i) (vec i) = (r : ℚ) / 3 + 2 * (k : ℚ) := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmq⟩ := hdiag i
    have heven : Even m := even_numerator_of_odd_multiple (by decide : Odd (3 : ℤ)) he
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem i)).2 hmq
    exact norm_mod_two_three heven hm hmq
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxyspan, hxy, hxx, hyy⟩ := normalized_three_pair hs hmax
    (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 0)).1 (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 1)).1
    (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 0)).2 (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 1)).2
    (hortho 0 1 (by decide)) (hn 0) (hn 1)
  refine ⟨x, y, ?_, hxy, hxx, hyy⟩
  rw [hxyspan]
  simpa only [range_fin_two_eq_pair] using hspan

name: SRG266.Lattice.GlueBasis.normalized_binary_five
statement:
theorem GlueBasis.normalized_binary_five (S : GlueBasis B N 5) (hR : S.rank = 2)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hmax : IsMaximalIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N) :
    ∃ x y : W, torsionPart B N 5 = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {x, y} ∧
      B x y ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B x x = 2 / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, B y y = 4 / 5 + 2 * (k : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases S with ⟨rank, hle, vec, hmem, hspan, hortho, hdiag, hind⟩
  dsimp at hR
  subst rank
  have hn (i : Fin 2) : ∃ m : ℤ, Even m ∧ ¬ (5 : ℤ) ∣ m ∧
      5 * B (vec i) (vec i) = (m : ℚ) := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmq⟩ := hdiag i
    exact ⟨m, even_numerator_of_odd_multiple (by decide : Odd (5 : ℤ)) he
      (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem i)).2 hmq, hm, hmq⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxyspan, hxy, hxx, hyy⟩ := normalized_five_pair hs hmax
    (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 0)).1 (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 1)).1
    (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 0)).2 (mem_torsionPart.mp (hmem 1)).2
    (hortho 0 1 (by decide)) (hn 0) (hn 1)
  refine ⟨x, y, ?_, hxy, hxx, hyy⟩
  rw [hxyspan]
  simpa only [range_fin_two_eq_pair] using hspan

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_centered_integer_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_centered_integer_coordinates (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n+1) → ℚ)
    (hsum : (∑ i, x i) = 0)
    (hdiff : ∀ i : Fin n, x i.castSucc-x i.succ ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ n ∧ ∃ z : Fin (n+1) → ℤ,
      (∑ i, z i) = a ∧ ∀ i, x i = (z i : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ∀ i, x i-x 0 ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) := by
    intro i
    induction i using Fin.induction with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i ih =>
        have h := (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ).sub_mem ih (hdiff i)
        convert h using 1
        ring
  choose d hd using (fun i => mem_one_iff.mp (hbase i))
  let s : ℤ := ∑ i, d i
  let c : ℤ := s/((n : ℤ)+1)
  let a : ℤ := s%((n : ℤ)+1)
  let z : Fin (n+1) → ℤ := fun i => d i-c
  have hnZ : 0 < (n : ℤ)+1 := by omega
  have ha : 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ n := by
    have h0 := Int.emod_nonneg s (ne_of_gt hnZ)
    have h1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos s hnZ
    change 0 ≤ s%((n : ℤ)+1) ∧ s%((n : ℤ)+1) ≤ n
    omega
  have hs : s = ((n : ℤ)+1)*c+a := (Int.mul_ediv_add_emod s ((n : ℤ)+1)).symm
  have hsQ : (s : ℚ) = -((n : ℚ)+1)*x 0 := by
    change ((∑ i, d i : ℤ) : ℚ) = _
    push_cast
    simp_rw [hd]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum]
    simp
    ring
  have heQ : (s : ℚ) = ((n : ℚ)+1)*(c : ℚ)+(a : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hn : (n : ℚ)+1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  refine ⟨a, ha.1, ha.2, z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [z]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    change s-((n : ℤ)+1)*c = a
    omega
  · intro i
    change x i = ((d i-c : ℤ) : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1)
    push_cast
    rw [hd i]
    field_simp
    nlinarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.centered_coordinates_adjacent_integral
statement:
theorem centered_coordinates_adjacent_integral {n : ℕ} (z : Fin (n+1) → ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (i : Fin n) :
    ((z i.castSucc : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1))-
      ((z i.succ : ℚ)-(a : ℚ)/((n : ℚ)+1)) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_one_iff.mpr ⟨z i.castSucc-z i.succ, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.d7_dual_reduced
statement:
theorem d7_dual_reduced {a : Fin 7 → ℚ}
    (ha : a ∈ (standardRatForm 7).dualSubmodule (evenCoordinateLattice 7)) :
    ∃ (v : Fin 7 → ℚ) (_ : v ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) (m : Fin 4),
      a = v + (m.val : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7
proof:
:= by
  rw [d7_dual] at ha
  obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, heq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp ha
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
  let m : Fin 4 := ⟨(k % 4).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hm : (m.val : ℤ) = k % 4 := by dsimp [m]; omega
  refine ⟨v + (k / 4) • ((4 : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7),
    (evenCoordinateLattice 7).add_mem hv
      ((evenCoordinateLattice 7).smul_mem _ (four_smul_coordinateSpinor_mem 7)), m, ?_⟩
  rw [← heq, hm]
  have hk : k = 4 * (k / 4) + k % 4 := by omega
  conv_lhs => rw [hk]
  module

name: SRG266.Lattice.scalar_short_gap
statement:
private theorem scalar_short_gap (m : Fin 4) (b n : ℤ) (d t : ℚ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hd2 : d < 2)
    (hnorm : d = 7 * (m.val : ℚ) ^ 2 / 4 + 2 * (b : ℚ))
    (hpair : t + 7 * (m.val : ℚ) / 4 = n) :
    (2 - d) / 4 ≤ t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases m
  · norm_num at hnorm hpair
    have hb0 : (0 : ℚ) < b := by linarith
    have hb1 : (b : ℚ) < 1 := by linarith
    have hb0' : 0 < b := by exact_mod_cast hb0
    have hb1' : b < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hb1
    omega
  · norm_num at hnorm hpair
    have hlo : (-1 : ℚ) < b := by linarith
    have hhi : (b : ℚ) < 1 := by linarith
    have hlo' : -1 < b := by exact_mod_cast hlo
    have hhi' : b < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hhi
    have hb : b = 0 := by omega
    subst b
    norm_num at hnorm
    have hn : n ≤ 1 ∨ 2 ≤ n := by omega
    rcases hn with hn | hn
    · have hnQ : (n : ℚ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have ht : t ≤ -1 / 4 := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t + 1 / 4)]
    · have hnQ : (2 : ℚ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have ht : 1 / 4 ≤ t := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1 / 4)]
  · norm_num at hnorm hpair
    have hlo : (-4 : ℚ) < b := by linarith
    have hhi : (b : ℚ) < -2 := by linarith
    have hlo' : -4 < b := by exact_mod_cast hlo
    have hhi' : b < -2 := by exact_mod_cast hhi
    have hb : b = -3 := by omega
    subst b
    norm_num at hnorm
    have hn : n ≤ 3 ∨ 4 ≤ n := by omega
    rcases hn with hn | hn
    · have hnQ : (n : ℚ) ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have ht : t ≤ -1 / 2 := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t + 1 / 2)]
    · have hnQ : (4 : ℚ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have ht : 1 / 2 ≤ t := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1 / 2)]
  · norm_num at hnorm hpair
    have hlo : (-8 : ℚ) < b := by linarith
    have hhi : (b : ℚ) < -6 := by linarith
    have hlo' : -8 < b := by exact_mod_cast hlo
    have hhi' : b < -6 := by exact_mod_cast hhi
    have hb : b = -7 := by omega
    subst b
    norm_num at hnorm
    have hn : n ≤ 5 ∨ 6 ≤ n := by omega
    rcases hn with hn | hn
    · have hnQ : (n : ℚ) ≤ 5 := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have ht : t ≤ -1 / 4 := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t + 1 / 4)]
    · have hnQ : (6 : ℚ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have ht : 1 / 4 ≤ t := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1 / 4)]

name: SRG266.Lattice.d7_short_dual_gap
statement:
theorem d7_short_dual_gap {a : Fin 7 → ℚ}
    (ha : a ∈ (standardRatForm 7).dualSubmodule (evenCoordinateLattice 7))
    (hpos : 0 < standardRatForm 7 a a) (hsmall : standardRatForm 7 a a < 2)
    {t : ℚ} (hint : t + standardRatForm 7 a (coordinateSpinor 7) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ)) :
    (2 - standardRatForm 7 a a) / 4 ≤ t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, m, rfl⟩ := d7_dual_reduced ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := evenCoordinateLattice_isEven 7 v hv
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp (coordinateSpinor_mem_dual 7 v hv)
  have hl' : standardRatForm 7 v (coordinateSpinor 7) = (l : ℚ) := by
    rw [(standardRatForm_isSymm 7).eq]
    exact hl.symm
  have hsm : (m.val : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7 = (m.val : ℚ) • coordinateSpinor 7 := by module
  have hnorm : standardRatForm 7 (v + (m.val : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7)
      (v + (m.val : ℤ) • coordinateSpinor 7) =
      7 * (m.val : ℚ) ^ 2 / 4 + 2 * ((b + (m.val : ℤ) * l : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hsm]
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hb, hl', ← hl, coordinateSpinor_norm]
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp hint
  have hpair : t + 7 * (m.val : ℚ) / 4 = ((n - l : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [hsm] at hn
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hl', coordinateSpinor_norm] at hn
    push_cast
    linarith
  exact scalar_short_gap m (b + (m.val : ℤ) * l) (n - l) _ t hpos hsmall hnorm hpair

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinatePolynomial_coeff
statement:
theorem coordinatePolynomial_coeff {n : ℕ}
    {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ L.carrier)
    (x : L.carrier) (i : Fin n) :
    (coordinatePolynomial b x).coeff i = b.coord i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [coordinatePolynomial, ← Fin.ext_iff]

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinatePolynomial_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  have hcoords : ∀ i : Fin n, b.coord i x = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [← coordinatePolynomial_coeff b x i, hp, coeff_zero]
  apply hx
  apply b.equivFun.injective
  ext i
  simpa using hcoords i

name: SRG266.Lattice.coordinateEvaluation_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateEvaluation_apply {n : ℕ}
    {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ L.carrier)
    (a : ℤ) (x : L.carrier) :
    coordinateEvaluation b a x = (coordinatePolynomial b x).eval a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [coordinateEvaluation, coordinatePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, mul_comm]

name: SRG266.Lattice.rootAvoidancePolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rootAvoidancePolynomial_ne_zero {n : ℕ}
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ L.carrier) :
    rootAvoidancePolynomial L b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro r _
  exact coordinatePolynomial_ne_zero b (normTwoRootVal_ne_zero r)

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_rootSeparatingFunctional
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := L.moduleFree
  let := L.moduleFinite
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ L.carrier :=
    Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℤ L.carrier L.rank
  let p := rootAvoidancePolynomial L b
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := rootAvoidancePolynomial_ne_zero L b
  obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := Set.infinite_univ.exists_notMem_finite
    (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp)
  refine ⟨(coordinateEvaluation b a).toAddMonoidHom, ?_⟩
  intro r
  change coordinateEvaluation b a r.1 ≠ 0
  rw [coordinateEvaluation_apply]
  intro hr
  apply ha
  change (rootAvoidancePolynomial L b).eval a = 0
  rw [rootAvoidancePolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ r) hr

name: SRG266.Lattice.cartanARatForm_isSymm
statement: theorem cartanARatForm_isSymm (n : ℕ) : (cartanARatForm n).IsSymm
proof:
:= by

  exact (cartanAZeroSum_pair n u v).symm.trans
    (((standardRatForm_isSymm (n+1)).eq _ _).trans (cartanAZeroSum_pair n v u))

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6D7Projection_A11Lift
statement:
theorem a11D7E6D7Projection_A11Lift (u : Fin 11 → ℚ) :

proof:
:= by

    a11D7E6D7Scalar, a11D7E6A11Lift, Pi.zero_apply]

statement:
theorem a11D7E6D7Projection_E6Lift (u : Fin 6 → ℚ) :
