name: SRG266.Lattice.marked_product_frame_moment_bound
statement:
theorem marked_product_frame_moment_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (g : ι → W) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ) (a : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hC : ∀ u, 0 ≤ C u u) (hm : ∀ w, (∑ i, (B w (g i))^2) ≤ a*B w w)
    (r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U) (hr : r.1.2 = 0) :
    (∑ i, (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r ((g i, s), 0))^2) ≤
      a*prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C r r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prodForm_apply, hr, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
  have h := hm r.1.1
  have hp := mul_nonneg ha (hC r.2)
  linarith

name: SRG266.Lattice.a11D7E6_component_moment_bound
statement:
theorem a11D7E6_component_moment_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (hB : B.IsSymm) (hC : C.IsSymm)
    (ψ : (Fin 24 → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] ((W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U))
    (hpair : ∀ u v, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C (ψ u) (ψ v) =
      adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types u v)
    (hmarked : ∀ u, middleCoordinateInclusion 7 (middleCoordinateProjection 7 (ψ u)) =
      ψ (a11D7E6D7Projection u))
    (H : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ Y) (hH : H.IsSymm)
    (part : (Fin 24 → ℚ) → Y) (lift : Y → (Fin 24 → ℚ))
    (hpart : ∀ y, part (lift y) = y)
    (hlift : ∀ q y, adeRootRatForm a11D7E6Types q (lift y) = H (part q) y)
    (hD : ∀ y, a11D7E6D7Projection (lift y) = 0)
    (g : ι → W) (s : Fin 7 → ℚ) (a : ℚ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hnonneg : ∀ u, 0 ≤ C u u) (hm : ∀ w, (∑ i, (B w (g i))^2) ≤ a*B w w) (y : Y) :
    (∑ i, (H y (part (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U)))))^2) ≤ a*H y y
proof:
:= by
  let F := prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C
  have hsym : F.IsSymm := prodForm_isSymm (prodForm_isSymm hB (standardRatForm_isSymm 7)) hC
  have hzero : (ψ (lift y)).1.2 = 0 := by
    have h := hmarked (lift y)
    rw [hD y, map_zero] at h
    exact congrArg (fun r : (W × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) × U => r.1.2) h
  have hp (i : ι) : F (ψ (lift y)) ((g i, s), (0 : U)) =
      H y (part (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U)))) := by
    rw [hsym.eq]
    have h := hpair (ψ.symm ((g i, s), (0 : U))) (lift y)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hlift, hH.eq] at h
    exact h
  have hn : F (ψ (lift y)) (ψ (lift y)) = H y y := by
    rw [hpair, hlift, hpart]
  have h := marked_product_frame_moment_bound B C g s a ha hnonneg hm (ψ (lift y)) hzero
  change (∑ i, (F (ψ (lift y)) ((g i, s), (0 : U)))^2) ≤
    a*F (ψ (lift y)) (ψ (lift y)) at h
  simpa only [hp, hn] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.bilinear_family_gram
statement:
theorem bilinear_family_gram {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (r : κ → X) (z w : κ → ℚ) :
    B (∑ i, z i • r i) (∑ j, w j • r j) =
      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j => B (r i) (r j)) z w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.linearIndependent_of_gram_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_of_gram_nondegenerate {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (r : κ → X)
    (hgram : (Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j => B (r i) (r j))).Nondegenerate) :
    LinearIndependent ℚ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro z hz i
  have hzero : z = 0 := hgram.1 z (fun w => by
    rw [← bilinear_family_gram, hz, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply])
  exact congrFun hzero i

name: SRG266.Lattice.finrank_orthogonal_span_le
statement:
theorem finrank_orthogonal_span_le [FiniteDimensional ℚ X]
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X)
    (hpos : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < B x x) (r : κ → X) (hr : LinearIndependent ℚ r) :
    Module.finrank ℚ ((Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range r)).orthogonalBilin B) ≤
      Module.finrank ℚ X-Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  let P := Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range r)
  let Q := P.orthogonalBilin B
  have hd : Disjoint P Q := Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr (fun x hx hq => by
    by_contra hne
    have h := hpos x hne
    have hz : B x x = 0 := hq x hx
    linarith)
  have hf := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq P Q
  rw [hd.eq_bot, finrank_bot, add_zero] at hf
  have hle := Submodule.finrank_le (P ⊔ Q)
  have hP : Module.finrank ℚ P = Fintype.card κ := finrank_span_eq_card hr
  change Module.finrank ℚ Q ≤ _
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.rational_frame_mass_le_orthogonal_rank
statement:
theorem rational_frame_mass_le_orthogonal_rank [FiniteDimensional ℚ X]
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X) (hB : LinearMap.IsSymm B)
    (hpos : ∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < B x x) (v : ι → X) (C : ℚ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ y, (∑ i, (B y (v i))^2) ≤ C*B y y)
    (r : κ → X) (hr : LinearIndependent ℚ r) (horth : ∀ j i, B (r j) (v i) = 0) :
    (∑ i, B (v i) (v i)) ≤ C*((Module.finrank ℚ X-Fintype.card κ : ℕ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range r)
  have hv (i) : v i ∈ P.orthogonalBilin B := by
    have hker : P ≤ (B.flip (v i)).ker := Submodule.span_le.mpr (by
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact horth j i)
    exact fun x hx => hker hx
  have hmass := rational_frame_mass_le_submodule_finrank B hB hpos v C hbound _ hv
  have hrank := finrank_orthogonal_span_le B hpos r hr
  exact hmass.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hrank) hC)

name: SRG266.Lattice.normTwoRoot_mem_or_neg_mem_simple_closure
statement:
theorem normTwoRoot_mem_or_neg_mem_simple_closure
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (r : NormTwoRoot L) :
    normTwoRootVal r ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f) ∨
      -normTwoRootVal r ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [simpleRootSet] using
    (IsAddIndecomposable.mem_or_neg_mem_closure_baseOf normTwoRootVal f r (hf r) (by simp))

name: SRG266.Lattice.sub_mem_normTwoRoots_of_pairing_pos
statement:
theorem sub_mem_normTwoRoots_of_pairing_pos
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} {r s : NormTwoRoot L}
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hpos : 0 < L.pairing r.1 s.1) :
    ∃ t : NormTwoRoot L, normTwoRootVal r - normTwoRootVal s = normTwoRootVal t
proof:
:= by
  have hne : r.1 - s.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hrs
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hqpos := L.positiveDefinite (r.1 - s.1) hne
  have hsym : L.pairing s.1 r.1 = L.pairing r.1 s.1 := L.symmetric.eq _ _
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply] at hqpos
  rw [r.2, s.2, hsym] at hqpos
  have hnorm : L.pairing (r.1 - s.1) (r.1 - s.1) = 2 := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    rw [r.2, s.2, hsym]
    omega
  exact ⟨⟨r.1 - s.1, hnorm⟩, rfl⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRootSet_pairwise_pairing_nonpos
statement:
theorem simpleRootSet_pairwise_pairing_nonpos
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n}
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0) :
    (simpleRootSet f).Pairwise fun r s => L.pairing r.1 s.1 ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := IsAddIndecomposable.pairwise_baseOf_sub_notMem
    normTwoRootVal (fun r => by simp) f hf
  intro r hr s hs hrs
  by_contra hnot
  have hpos : 0 < L.pairing r.1 s.1 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := sub_mem_normTwoRoots_of_pairing_pos hrs hpos
  exact hsub hr hs hrs ⟨t, ht.symm⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRootSet_linearIndepOn
statement:
theorem simpleRootSet_linearIndepOn
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n}
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndepOn ℤ normTwoRootVal (simpleRootSet f)
proof:
:= by
  change LinearIndependent ℤ (fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1)
  apply LinearMap.BilinForm.linearIndependent_of_pairwise_le_zero L.pairing
    L.positiveDefinite (toZLinearMap f)
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    change IsAddIndecomposable normTwoRootVal
      {i | 0 < f (normTwoRootVal i)} r at hr
    exact hr.1
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩ ⟨s, hs⟩ hrs
    exact simpleRootSet_pairwise_pairing_nonpos f hf hr hs (by simpa using hrs)

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRootGraph_adj_iff
statement:
theorem simpleRootGraph_adj_iff
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ)
    (r s : simpleRootSet f) :
    (simpleRootGraph f).Adj r s ↔
      r ≠ s ∧ L.pairing r.1.1 s.1.1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simpleRootGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hrs, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨hrs, h⟩
    · exact ⟨hrs, L.symmetric.eq _ _ ▸ h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hrs, h⟩
    exact ⟨hrs, Or.inl h⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRoot_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem simpleRoot_add_ne_zero
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n}
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) {r s : simpleRootSet f} :
    r.1.1 + s.1.1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hrs
  have hrpos : 0 < f r.1.1 := by
    have hr := r.2
    change IsAddIndecomposable normTwoRootVal
      {i | 0 < f (normTwoRootVal i)} r.1 at hr
    exact hr.1
  have hspos : 0 < f s.1.1 := by
    have hs := s.2
    change IsAddIndecomposable normTwoRootVal
      {i | 0 < f (normTwoRootVal i)} s.1 at hs
    exact hs.1
  have := congrArg f hrs
  simp only [map_add, map_zero] at this
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRoot_pairing_eq_zero_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem simpleRoot_pairing_eq_zero_or_neg_one
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n}
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    {r s : simpleRootSet f} (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    L.pairing r.1.1 s.1.1 = 0 ∨ L.pairing r.1.1 s.1.1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hrs' : r.1 ≠ s.1 := fun h => hrs (Subtype.ext h)
  have hnonpos := simpleRootSet_pairwise_pairing_nonpos f hf r.2 s.2
    hrs'
  have hpos := L.positiveDefinite (r.1.1 + s.1.1) (simpleRoot_add_ne_zero f)
  have hsym : L.pairing s.1.1 r.1.1 = L.pairing r.1.1 s.1.1 := L.symmetric.eq _ _
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at hpos
  rw [r.1.2, s.1.2, hsym] at hpos
  omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanMatrix_simpleRootGraph
statement:
theorem graphCartanMatrix_simpleRootGraph
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n}
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (r s : simpleRootSet f) :
    graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f) r s = L.pairing r.1.1 s.1.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hrs : r = s
  · subst s
    rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_same, r.1.2]
  · rcases simpleRoot_pairing_eq_zero_or_neg_one f hf hrs with hzero | hneg
    · rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_not_adj hrs]
      · exact hzero.symm
      · rw [simpleRootGraph_adj_iff]
        simp [hrs, hzero]
    · rw [graphCartanMatrix_apply_of_adj]
      · exact hneg.symm
      · rw [simpleRootGraph_adj_iff]
        exact ⟨hrs, hneg⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRootCombination_injective
statement:
theorem simpleRootCombination_injective
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (simpleRootCombination f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hli := simpleRootSet_linearIndepOn f hf
  change LinearIndependent ℤ (fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1) at hli
  change (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ
    (fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1)) x =
      (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ
        (fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1)) y at hxy
  exact hli.fintypeLinearCombination_injective hxy

name: SRG266.Lattice.bilinForm_fintypeLinearCombination
statement:
theorem bilinForm_fintypeLinearCombination
    {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℤ M) (v : ι → M) (x y : ι → ℤ) :
    B (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ v x) (Fintype.linearCombination ℤ v y) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, x i * B (v i) (v j) * y j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanBilin_simpleRootGraph
statement:
theorem graphCartanBilin_simpleRootGraph
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) [DecidableEq (simpleRootSet f)]
    (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (x y : simpleRootSet f → ℤ) :
    Matrix.toBilin' (graphCartanMatrix (simpleRootGraph f)) x y =
      L.pairing (simpleRootCombination f x) (simpleRootCombination f y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  simp_rw [graphCartanMatrix_simpleRootGraph f hf]
  symm
  exact bilinForm_fintypeLinearCombination L.pairing
    (fun r : simpleRootSet f => (r.1.1 : L.carrier)) x y

name: SRG266.Lattice.graphCartanEnergy_simpleRootGraph
statement:
theorem graphCartanEnergy_simpleRootGraph
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) [DecidableEq (simpleRootSet f)]
    (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (x : simpleRootSet f → ℤ) :
    graphCartanEnergy (simpleRootGraph f) x =
      L.pairing (simpleRootCombination f x) (simpleRootCombination f x)
proof:
:= by
  exact graphCartanBilin_simpleRootGraph f hf x x

name: SRG266.Lattice.simpleRootGraph_isPositiveCartan
statement:
theorem simpleRootGraph_isPositiveCartan
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) [DecidableEq (simpleRootSet f)]
    (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0) :
    IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [graphCartanEnergy_simpleRootGraph f hf]
  apply L.positiveDefinite
  intro hcomb
  have hxeq : x = 0 := simpleRootCombination_injective f hf (by simpa using hcomb)
  exact hx hxeq

name: SRG266.Lattice.span_simpleRoots_eq_normTwoRootSpan
statement:
theorem span_simpleRoots_eq_normTwoRootSpan
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0) :
    Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1) =
      normTwoRootSpan L
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨r.1, rfl⟩
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    let S := Submodule.span ℤ
      (Set.range fun s : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal s.1)
    have hgenerator : normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f ⊆ S := by
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, rfl⟩
    have hclosure : AddSubmonoid.closure (normTwoRootVal '' simpleRootSet f) ≤
        S.toAddSubmonoid :=
      AddSubmonoid.closure_le.mpr hgenerator
    rcases normTwoRoot_mem_or_neg_mem_simple_closure f hf r with hr | hr
    · exact hclosure hr
    · exact neg_mem_iff.mp (hclosure hr)

name: SRG266.Lattice.card_simpleRootSet_eq_of_fullRank
statement:
theorem card_simpleRootSet_eq_of_fullRank
    {n : ℕ} {L : PDUnimodularLattice n} [Finite (NormTwoRoot L)]
    (f : L.carrier →+ ℤ) (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot L, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    (hrank : Set.finrank ℤ (Set.range (@normTwoRootVal n L)) = n) :
    Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hli := simpleRootSet_linearIndepOn f hf
  change LinearIndependent ℤ
    (fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1) at hli
  calc
    Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) =
        Set.finrank ℤ (Set.range fun r : simpleRootSet f => normTwoRootVal r.1) :=
      (finrank_span_eq_card hli).symm
    _ = Set.finrank ℤ (Set.range (@normTwoRootVal n L)) := by
      unfold Set.finrank
      rw [span_simpleRoots_eq_normTwoRootSpan f hf]
      rfl
    _ = n := hrank

name: SRG266.Lattice.rationalCoordinateExtension_intCast
statement:
theorem rationalCoordinateExtension_intCast (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] X) (z : ι → ℤ) :
    rationalCoordinateExtension φ (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) = φ z
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (∑ i, (z i) • (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ)) = z := by
    ext j
    simp [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, (z i) • φ (Pi.single i 1) := by
      simp only [rationalCoordinateExtension, Fintype.linearCombination_apply,
        Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    _ = φ (∑ i, (z i) • (Pi.single i 1 : ι → ℤ)) := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_zsmul]
    _ = φ z := congrArg φ hz

name: SRG266.Lattice.rationalCoordinateExtension_pairing
statement:
theorem rationalCoordinateExtension_pairing
    (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] X) (F : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ X)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    (hpair : ∀ z w, F (φ z) (φ w) = (Matrix.toBilin' A z w : ℚ))
    (x y : ι → ℚ) :
    F (rationalCoordinateExtension φ x) (rationalCoordinateExtension φ y) =
      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j => (A i j : ℚ)) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hb (i j : ι) : F (φ (Pi.single i 1)) (φ (Pi.single j 1)) = (A i j : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.toBilin'_single] using hpair (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  simp only [rationalCoordinateExtension, Fintype.linearCombination_apply,
    map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hb]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.rationalCoordinateExtension_surjective
statement:
theorem rationalCoordinateExtension_surjective
    (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] X) (R : Set X)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℚ R = ⊤) (hcover : ∀ r ∈ R, ∃ z, φ z = r) :
    Function.Surjective (rationalCoordinateExtension φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  apply top_unique
  rw [← hspan]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hcover r hr
  exact ⟨fun i => (z i : ℚ), (rationalCoordinateExtension_intCast φ z).trans hz⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_rationalCoordinateEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_rationalCoordinateEquiv
    (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] X) (R : Set X)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℚ R = ⊤) (hcover : ∀ r ∈ R, ∃ z, φ z = r)
    (hrank : Module.finrank ℚ X = Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ e : (ι → ℚ) ≃ₗ[ℚ] X,
      (∀ z : ι → ℤ, e (fun i => (z i : ℚ)) = φ z) ∧
      e.toLinearMap = rationalCoordinateExtension φ
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj := rationalCoordinateExtension_surjective φ R hspan hcover
  let : Module.Finite ℚ X := Module.Finite.of_surjective _ hsurj
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (ι → ℚ) = Module.finrank ℚ X := by
    simpa using hrank.symm
  have hinj := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mpr hsurj
  let e := LinearEquiv.ofBijective (rationalCoordinateExtension φ) ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  exact ⟨e, rationalCoordinateExtension_intCast φ, rfl⟩

          N.pairing (pdCoordEquiv N z) (pdCoordEquiv N z) : ℤ)

name: SRG266.Lattice.tsum_evenNormFiber_harmonicQuadratic
statement:
theorem tsum_evenNormFiber_harmonicQuadratic
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) (q : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑' z : {z : Fin 24 → ℤ //
        z ∈ evenNormIndex N heven ⁻¹' ({k} : Set ℕ)},
      (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
        (pdLatticePoint N z.1) : ℂ) *
          q ^ evenNormIndex N heven z.1) =
      (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k : ℂ) * q ^ k
proof:
:= by
  let e := evenNormFiberEquiv N heven k
  let g : {z : Fin 24 → ℤ //
      z ∈ evenNormIndex N heven ⁻¹' ({k} : Set ℕ)} → ℂ := fun z =>
    (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
      (pdLatticePoint N z.1) : ℂ) * q ^ evenNormIndex N heven z.1
  calc
    (∑' z : {z : Fin 24 → ℤ //
        z ∈ evenNormIndex N heven ⁻¹' ({k} : Set ℕ)}, g z) =
        ∑' v : NormShell N (2 * k), g (e.symm v) := by
      simpa [e, g] using
        e.tsum_eq (fun v : NormShell N (2 * k) => g (e.symm v))
    _ = (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k : ℂ) * q ^ k := by
      rw [tsum_fintype]
      simp only [harmonicThetaCoefficient, Int.cast_sum, g]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v _
      change
        (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
          (pdLatticePoint N ((pdFinBasis N).equivFun v.1)) : ℂ) *
            q ^ evenNormIndex N heven ((pdFinBasis N).equivFun v.1) =
          ((24 * N.pairing v.1 x * N.pairing v.1 y -
            N.pairing x y * N.pairing v.1 v.1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * q ^ k
      rw [harmonicQuadratic_pdLatticePoint]
      simp only [pdCoordEquiv_finBasis_equivFun, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul]
      have hindex : evenNormIndex N heven ((pdFinBasis N).equivFun v.1) = k := by
        have h := pairing_pdCoordEquiv_eq_two_evenNormIndex
          N heven ((pdFinBasis N).equivFun v.1)
        rw [pdCoordEquiv_finBasis_equivFun, v.2] at h
        omega
      rw [hindex]
      norm_cast

name: SRG266.Lattice.norm_harmonicTheta_coordinate_term
statement:
theorem norm_harmonicTheta_coordinate_term
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) (τ : ℍ) (z : Fin 24 → ℤ) :
    ‖(harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
        (pdLatticePoint N z) : ℂ) *
      𝕢 1 τ ^ evenNormIndex N heven z‖ =
    ‖harmonicGaussian τ.im (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
      (pdLatticePoint N z)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Function.Periodic.norm_qParam,
    div_one, harmonicGaussian, realGaussian, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
  have hre :
      (-((Real.pi * τ.im : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (‖pdLatticePoint N z‖ : ℂ) ^ 2).re =
        -(Real.pi * τ.im) * ‖pdLatticePoint N z‖ ^ 2 := by
    norm_cast
  rw [hre, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [show ‖pdLatticePoint N z‖ ^ 2 =
      (N.pairing (pdCoordEquiv N z) (pdCoordEquiv N z) : ℝ) by
    simpa [pdLatticePoint] using norm_sq_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector N z]
  rw [pairing_pdCoordEquiv_eq_two_evenNormIndex N heven z]
  push_cast
  simp only [UpperHalfPlane.coe_im]
  ring_nf

name: SRG266.Lattice.summable_harmonicTheta_coordinate_term
statement:
theorem summable_harmonicTheta_coordinate_term
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) (τ : ℍ) :
    Summable fun z : Fin 24 → ℤ =>
      (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
        (pdLatticePoint N z) : ℂ) *
          𝕢 1 τ ^ evenNormIndex N heven z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← summable_norm_iff]
  exact (summable_harmonicGaussian_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector
    N τ.im_pos (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)).norm.congr
      (fun z => by
        simpa [pdLatticePoint] using
          (norm_harmonicTheta_coordinate_term N heven x y τ z).symm)

name: SRG266.Lattice.hasSum_harmonicTheta_coefficients
statement:
theorem hasSum_harmonicTheta_coefficients
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) (τ : ℍ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ =>
      (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k : ℂ) * 𝕢 1 τ ^ k)
      (∑' z : Fin 24 → ℤ,
        (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
          (pdLatticePoint N z) : ℂ) *
            𝕢 1 τ ^ evenNormIndex N heven z)
proof:
:= by
  let g : (Fin 24 → ℤ) → ℂ := fun z =>
    (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
      (pdLatticePoint N z) : ℂ) *
        𝕢 1 τ ^ evenNormIndex N heven z
  have hsum : Summable g :=
    summable_harmonicTheta_coordinate_term N heven x y τ
  have hfiber := hsum.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise (evenNormIndex N heven)
  have hfun :
      (fun k : ℕ =>
        (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k : ℂ) * 𝕢 1 τ ^ k) =
      (fun k : ℕ =>
        ∑' z : {z : Fin 24 → ℤ //
          z ∈ evenNormIndex N heven ⁻¹' ({k} : Set ℕ)}, g z) := by
    funext k
    simpa only [g] using
      (tsum_evenNormFiber_harmonicQuadratic
        N heven x y (𝕢 1 τ) k).symm
  rw [hfun]
  simpa only [g, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hfiber

name: SRG266.Lattice.summable_harmonicTheta_coefficients
statement:
theorem summable_harmonicTheta_coefficients
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)

name: SRG266.Lattice.summable_harmonicTheta_coeff_mul_pow_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_harmonicTheta_coeff_mul_pow_of_norm_lt_one
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    Summable fun k : ℕ =>
      (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y k : ℂ) * q ^ k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq0 : q = 0
  · subst q
    simpa +contextual [zero_pow_eq] using
      (hasSum_ite_eq 0 (harmonicThetaCoefficient N x y 0 : ℂ)).summable
  · let τ : ℍ := ⟨Function.Periodic.invQParam 1 q,
      Function.Periodic.im_invQParam_pos_of_norm_lt_one one_pos hq hq0⟩
    have hparam : 𝕢 1 (τ : ℂ) = q :=
      Function.Periodic.qParam_right_inv one_ne_zero hq0
    simpa only [hparam] using
      summable_harmonicTheta_coefficients N heven x y τ

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicThetaFSeries_one_le_radius
statement:
theorem harmonicThetaFSeries_one_le_radius
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)

  apply FormalMultilinearSeries.le_radius_of_summable_norm
  have hs := (summable_harmonicTheta_coeff_mul_pow_of_norm_lt_one
    N heven x y (q := (r : ℂ)) (by simpa using hr)).norm
  simpa only [harmonicThetaFSeries, FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_norm,
    norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg r.2,
    NNReal.norm_eq] using hs

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicThetaFunction_eq_fseriesSum

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicThetaFunction_mdifferentiable
statement:
theorem harmonicThetaFunction_mdifferentiable
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) :
    MDiff (harmonicThetaFunction N x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiable_iff]
  intro z hz
  let p := harmonicThetaFSeries N x y
  have hq : ‖𝕢 1 z‖ < 1 :=
    Function.Periodic.norm_qParam_lt_one one_pos hz
  have hmem : 𝕢 1 z ∈ Metric.eball 0 p.radius := by
    apply mem_eball_zero_iff.2
    have hq' : (↑‖𝕢 1 z‖₊ : ENNReal) < 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hq
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa only [enorm_eq_nnnorm] using hq')
      (harmonicThetaFSeries_one_le_radius N heven x y)
  have hp : AnalyticAt ℂ p.sum (𝕢 1 z) :=
    p.analyticOnNhd _ hmem
  have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => p.sum (𝕢 1 w)) z :=
    hp.differentiableAt.comp z (by
      unfold Function.Periodic.qParam
      fun_prop)
  apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  refine hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards [isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos hw]
  rw [harmonicThetaFunction_eq_fseriesSum]

name: SRG266.Lattice.positiveImaginaryPoint_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem positiveImaginaryPoint_coe (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :

proof: := rfl

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicTheta_coordinate_term_positiveImaginary
statement:
theorem harmonicTheta_coordinate_term_positiveImaginary
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (z : Fin 24 → ℤ) :
    (harmonicQuadratic (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
        (pdLatticePoint N z) : ℂ) *
      𝕢 1 (positiveImaginaryPoint t ht) ^ evenNormIndex N heven z =
    harmonicGaussian t (pdCarrierPoint N x) (pdCarrierPoint N y)
      (pdLatticePoint N z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold harmonicGaussian realGaussian Function.Periodic.qParam
  rw [positiveImaginaryPoint_coe]
  norm_num only [ofReal_one, div_one]
  rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [← ofReal_pow]
  rw [show ‖pdLatticePoint N z‖ ^ 2 =
      (N.pairing (pdCoordEquiv N z) (pdCoordEquiv N z) : ℝ) by
    simpa [pdLatticePoint] using norm_sq_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector N z]
  rw [pairing_pdCoordEquiv_eq_two_evenNormIndex N heven z]
  push_cast
  congr 1
  ring_nf
  rw [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.modular_S_smul_positiveImaginaryPoint
statement:
theorem modular_S_smul_positiveImaginaryPoint
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ModularGroup.S • positiveImaginaryPoint t ht =
      positiveImaginaryPoint t⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ht)
proof:
:= by
  apply UpperHalfPlane.coe_injective
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.modular_S_smul]
  simp only [positiveImaginaryPoint_coe]

name: SRG266.Lattice.harmonicThetaFunction_S_positiveImaginary
statement:
theorem harmonicThetaFunction_S_positiveImaginary
    (N : PDUnimodularLattice 24)
    (heven : ∀ z : N.carrier, Even (N.pairing z z))
    (x y : N.carrier) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    harmonicThetaFunction N x y
        (ModularGroup.S • positiveImaginaryPoint t ht) =
      ((positiveImaginaryPoint t ht : ℂ) ^ 14) *
        harmonicThetaFunction N x y (positiveImaginaryPoint t ht)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modular_S_smul_positiveImaginaryPoint ht]
  have hp := harmonicThetaFunction_poisson_positiveImaginary
    N heven x y ht
  have ht0 : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ht.ne'
  calc
    harmonicThetaFunction N x y
        (positiveImaginaryPoint t⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ht)) =
      -(t : ℂ) ^ 14 * harmonicThetaFunction N x y
        (positiveImaginaryPoint t ht) := by
          calc
            _ = -(t : ℂ) ^ 14 *
                (-((t : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 14 *
                  harmonicThetaFunction N x y
                    (positiveImaginaryPoint t⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ht))) := by
                field_simp
            _ = -(t : ℂ) ^ 14 *
                harmonicThetaFunction N x y
                  (positiveImaginaryPoint t ht) := by rw [hp]
    _ = ((positiveImaginaryPoint t ht : ℂ) ^ 14) *
        harmonicThetaFunction N x y (positiveImaginaryPoint t ht) := by
      rw [positiveImaginaryPoint_coe, mul_pow]
      have hI14 : Complex.I ^ 14 = -1 := by
        rw [show 14 = 2 * 7 by norm_num, pow_mul, Complex.I_sq]
        norm_num
      rw [hI14]
      ring

    Function.comp_def]
  have hr : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ))

      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_integral_simple_root_data
statement:
theorem exists_integral_simple_root_data {n : ℕ}
    (hs : F.IsSymm) (hpd : ∀ x : X, x ≠ 0 → 0 < F x x)
    (hrank : Module.finrank ℚ X = n) (hl : IsLattice ℚ H)
    (hself : F.dualSubmodule H = H)
    (R : Finset X) (hR : ∀ r, r ∈ R ↔ r ∈ H ∧ F r r = 2)
    (c : ℤ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hm : ∀ x y : X, (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) = (c : ℚ) * F x y) :
    ∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice n) (e : H ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
      (∀ u v : H, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F (u : X) (v : X)) ∧
      Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = R.card ∧
      RootSecondMomentIdentity N c ∧
      (∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
        (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
        Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = n ∧
        IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
        (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
          simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
          (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
          c = 2 * ((∑ s, z s) + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, e, hpair⟩ := exists_pdUnimodularLattice hs hpd hrank hl hself
  let value : NormTwoRoot N → X := fun r => (e.symm r.1 : X)
  have hinj : Function.Injective value := by
    intro r s h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply e.symm.injective
    exact Subtype.ext h
  let R' : Finset X := Finset.univ.map ⟨value, hinj⟩
  have hcomplete (x : X) : x ∈ R' ↔ x ∈ H ∧ F x x = 2 := by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hx
      refine ⟨(e.symm r.1).property, ?_⟩
      change F (e.symm r.1 : X) (e.symm r.1 : X) = 2
      have h := hpair (e.symm r.1) (e.symm r.1)
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, r.2, Int.cast_ofNat] using h.symm
    · rintro ⟨hx, hn⟩
      have hnorm : N.pairing (e ⟨x, hx⟩) (e ⟨x, hx⟩) = 2 := by
        have hQ := (hpair ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩).trans hn
        exact_mod_cast hQ
      refine Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨e ⟨x, hx⟩, hnorm⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      simp [value]
  have hRR : R' = R := Finset.ext fun x => (hcomplete x).trans (hR x).symm
  have hcard : Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = R.card := by
    rw [← hRR]
    simp [R']
  have hp (r : NormTwoRoot N) (x : N.carrier) :
      ((N.pairing r.1 x : ℤ) : ℚ) = F (value r) (e.symm x : X) := by
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hpair (e.symm r.1) (e.symm x)
  have hsum (x y : X) : (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) =
      ∑ r : NormTwoRoot N, F (value r) x * F (value r) y := by
    rw [← hRR]
    simp [R']
  have hmoment : RootSecondMomentIdentity N c := by
    intro x y
    have h := hm (e.symm x : X) (e.symm y : X)
    rw [hsum, ← hpair (e.symm x) (e.symm y)] at h
    simp_rw [← hp] at h
    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_rootSeparatingFunctional N
  have hfull := normTwoRoots_fullRank_of_secondMoment N hc hmoment
  refine ⟨N, e, hpair, hcard, hmoment, f, hf,
    card_simpleRootSet_eq_of_fullRank f hf hfull, simpleRootGraph_isPositiveCartan f hf, ?_⟩
  intro θ z hz hθ hd
  apply normTwoRoot_scalar_eq_twice_dominant_height N f hf θ hθ
    (normTwoRoot_dominant_of_simple_pairings N f θ hd) z hz c
  have h := hmoment θ.1 θ.1
  simpa only [← pow_two, θ.2, mul_comm] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.complete_h6
statement:
theorem complete_h6 (S : PrimaryFamily B N .three .two) (T : PrimaryFamily B N .five .two)
    (hs : B.IsSymm) (hl : IsLattice ℚ N) (hi : IsIntegral B N) (he : IsEven B N)
    (hd : B.dualSubmodule N = torsionPart B N 3 ⊔ torsionPart B N 5) :
    IsLattice ℚ (h6CompletionLattice S T) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B H6Coordinates.form) (h6CompletionLattice S T) ∧
      (prodForm B H6Coordinates.form).dualSubmodule (h6CompletionLattice S T) =
        h6CompletionLattice S T
proof:
:= by
  refine complete_even_glue (mixedPrimarySource S T) H6Coordinates.matchingVector
    (mixedPrimaryPeriod .two .two) hs H6Coordinates.form_isSymm hl H6Coordinates.lattice_isLattice
    hi H6Coordinates.lattice_isIntegral he H6Coordinates.lattice_isEven
    (mixedPrimarySource_dual S T hd) H6Coordinates.matchingVector_dual
    H6Coordinates.matchingVector_period (mixedPrimarySource_cross S T hs)
    H6Coordinates.matchingVector_cross ?_ ?_
  · rintro (i | i)
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := S.norm i
      refine ⟨k + 2, ?_⟩
      change B (S.vec i) (S.vec i) + H6Coordinates.form H6Coordinates.dualThree H6Coordinates.dualThree = _
      rw [hk, H6Coordinates.dualThree_norm]
      norm_num [primaryFraction, primaryNumerator, SmallOddPrime.modulus]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := T.norm i
      refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
      change B (T.vec i) (T.vec i) + H6Coordinates.form ((2 : ℤ) • H6Coordinates.dualFive)
        ((2 : ℤ) • H6Coordinates.dualFive) = _
      rw [hk, H6Coordinates.twice_dualFive_norm]
      norm_num [primaryFraction, primaryNumerator, SmallOddPrime.modulus]
      ring
  · rintro (i | i) a ha
    · exact S.unit i a ha
    · exact T.unit i a ha

:= by

name: SRG266.Lattice.Q15Coordinates.lattice_dual
statement:
theorem lattice_dual : form.dualSubmodule lattice =
    lattice ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ {dualThree, dualFive}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm'⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp
      (hx (intCoordsToRat ![1, 0]) (intCoordsToRat_mem ![1, 0]))
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := mem_one_iff.mp
      (hx (intCoordsToRat ![0, 1]) (intCoordsToRat_mem ![0, 1]))
    have hm : 4*x 0+x 1 = (m : ℚ) := by simpa [form_apply] using hm'.symm
    have hn : x 0+4*x 1 = (n : ℚ) := by simpa [form_apply] using hn'.symm
    have he : x = intCoordsToRat ![-n, -m]+(n-m) • dualThree+(3*(m+n)) • dualFive := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> norm_num [intCoordsToRat, dualThree, dualFive,
        Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, zsmul_eq_mul] <;> linarith
    have h3 : dualThree ∈ Submodule.span ℤ {dualThree, dualFive} := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    have h5 : dualFive ∈ Submodule.span ℤ {dualThree, dualFive} := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    rw [he]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _
      (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left (intCoordsToRat_mem ![-n, -m]))
        (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ (n-m) h3)))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ (3*(m+n)) h5))
  · refine sup_le lattice_isIntegral (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    intro x hx
    rcases (by simpa only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hx :
      x = dualThree ∨ x = dualFive) with rfl | rfl
    · exact dualThree_mem_dual
    · exact dualFive_mem_dual

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_complexGaussian_pow_decay
statement:
theorem exists_complexGaussian_pow_decay {n k : ℕ} {z : ℂ}
    (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), v ≠ 0 →
      ‖complexGaussian z v‖ ≤ A / ‖v‖ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := Real.pi * z.re
  have ha : 0 < a := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hz
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_bound_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq k (a := a) ha
  refine ⟨A, hA, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  have hvnorm : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hvnorm k)]
  have hnorm : ‖complexGaussian z v‖ =
      Real.exp (-a * ‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
    unfold complexGaussian
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    congr 1
    dsimp only [a]
    have hcast : (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((‖v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    ring
  rw [hnorm, mul_comm]
  simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v)] using hbound ‖v‖

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_complexGaussian_comp_linearEquiv_pow_decay
statement:
theorem exists_complexGaussian_comp_linearEquiv_pow_decay
    {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] {n k : ℕ} {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re)
    (A : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : V, u ≠ 0 →
      ‖complexGaussian z (A u)‖ ≤ C / ‖u‖ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hdecay⟩ :=
    exists_complexGaussian_pow_decay (n := n) (k := k) hz
  let D : ℝ := ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap‖
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := norm_nonneg _
  refine ⟨C * D ^ k, mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg hD k), fun u hu => ?_⟩
  have hAu : A u ≠ 0 := by simpa using A.injective.ne hu
  have hnu : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu
  have hnAu : 0 < ‖A u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hAu
  have hbase := hdecay (A u) hAu
  have hmass : ‖complexGaussian z (A u)‖ * ‖A u‖ ^ k ≤ C :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hnAu k)).mp hbase
  have hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ D * ‖A u‖ := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ = ‖A.symm (A u)‖ := by rw [A.symm_apply_apply]
      _ ≤ D * ‖A u‖ :=
        A.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (A u)
  have hpow : ‖u‖ ^ k ≤ D ^ k * ‖A u‖ ^ k := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ k ≤ (D * ‖A u‖) ^ k :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hnorm k
      _ = D ^ k * ‖A u‖ ^ k := mul_pow D ‖A u‖ k
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hnu k)]
  calc
    ‖complexGaussian z (A u)‖ * ‖u‖ ^ k ≤
        ‖complexGaussian z (A u)‖ * (D ^ k * ‖A u‖ ^ k) := by
      gcongr
    _ = D ^ k * (‖complexGaussian z (A u)‖ * ‖A u‖ ^ k) := by ring
    _ ≤ D ^ k * C := by gcongr
    _ = C * D ^ k := by ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.latticeComplexGaussian_locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates
statement:
theorem latticeComplexGaussian_locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates
    {n : ℕ} (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    LocallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates
      (latticeComplexGaussianContinuous L z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hdecay⟩ :=
    exists_complexGaussian_comp_linearEquiv_pow_decay
      (n := n) (k := n + 1) hz (pdEuclideanEquiv L)
  exact locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates_of_pow_decay
    (latticeComplexGaussianContinuous L z) (Nat.lt_succ_self n) hC hdecay

name: SRG266.Lattice.pdEuclideanEquiv_measurePreserving_generic
statement:
theorem pdEuclideanEquiv_measurePreserving_generic {n : ℕ}
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) :
    MeasurePreserving
      (pdEuclideanEquiv L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (pdEuclideanEquiv L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.measurable
  · have hdet : LinearMap.det (pdEuclideanEquiv L :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_det_eq_one]
      norm_num
    have hmap := MeasureTheory.Measure.map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar
      volume hdet
    rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_det_eq_one] at hmap
    simpa using hmap

name: SRG266.Lattice.latticeComplexGaussian_integrable
statement:
theorem latticeComplexGaussian_integrable {n : ℕ}
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Integrable fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
      complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L u)
proof:
:= by
  change Integrable
    (complexGaussian z ∘ (pdEuclideanEquiv L :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
  apply (pdEuclideanEquiv_measurePreserving_generic L).integrable_comp_of_integrable
  unfold complexGaussian
  have hb : 0 < ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z).re := by
    simpa only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero] using mul_pos Real.pi_pos hz
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero] using
    (GaussianFourier.integrable_cexp_neg_mul_sq_norm_add
      (V := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) hb 0 0)

name: SRG266.Lattice.inv_re_pos_of_re_pos
statement: theorem inv_re_pos_of_re_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) : 0 < z⁻¹.re
proof:
:= by

  exact div_pos hz (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr fun h => by simpa [h] using hz.ne')

name: SRG266.Lattice.fourier_latticeComplexGaussian
statement:
theorem fourier_latticeComplexGaussian {n : ℕ}
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re)
    (m : Fin n → ℤ) :
    𝓕 (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L u)) (intVectorToReal m) =
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) / ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z)) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2) *
        complexGaussian z⁻¹
          (pdEuclideanEquiv L
            (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm m)))
proof:
:= by
  change 𝓕 (complexGaussian z ∘ pdEuclideanEquiv L)
      (intVectorToReal m) = _
  rw [fourier_comp_linearEquiv, pdEuclideanEquiv_det_eq_one]
  simp only [abs_one, inv_one, one_smul]
  rw [pdEuclideanEquiv_symm_adjoint_intVector]
  unfold complexGaussian
  have hb : 0 < ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z).re := by
    simpa only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero] using mul_pos Real.pi_pos hz
  change 𝓕 (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
      Complex.exp (-((Real.pi : ℂ) * z) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)) _ = _
  rw [fourier_gaussian_innerProductSpace hb]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · congr 1
    field_simp [Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero,
      ne_of_gt hz]

name: SRG266.Lattice.summable_fourier_latticeComplexGaussian
statement:
theorem summable_fourier_latticeComplexGaussian {n : ℕ}
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    Summable fun m : Fin n → ℤ =>
      𝓕 (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L u)) (intVectorToReal m)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :=
    (summable_complexGaussian_pdEuclideanEquiv_intVector L
      (inv_re_pos_of_re_pos hz)).comp_injective
        (pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm.injective
  have hscaled := hsum.mul_left
    (((Real.pi : ℂ) / ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z)) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2))
  exact hscaled.congr fun m => (fourier_latticeComplexGaussian L hz m).symm

name: SRG266.Lattice.complexGaussian_latticePoisson
statement:
theorem complexGaussian_latticePoisson {n : ℕ}
    (L : PDUnimodularLattice n) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) :
    (∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
      complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal m))) =
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) / ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z)) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2) *
        ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
          complexGaussian z⁻¹
            (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal m))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := continuous_piPoisson
    (latticeComplexGaussianContinuous L z)
    (latticeComplexGaussian_integrable L hz)
    (latticeComplexGaussian_locallyNormallySummableIntegerTranslates L hz)
    (summable_fourier_latticeComplexGaussian L hz)
  change (∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
      complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal m))) =
    ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
      𝓕 (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L u)) (intVectorToReal m) at hp
  rw [hp]
  calc
    (∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
      𝓕 (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
        complexGaussian z (pdEuclideanEquiv L u)) (intVectorToReal m)) =
        ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
          ((Real.pi : ℂ) / ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z)) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2) *
            complexGaussian z⁻¹
              (pdEuclideanEquiv L
                (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm m))) := by
          apply tsum_congr
          exact fourier_latticeComplexGaussian L hz
    _ = ((Real.pi : ℂ) / ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z)) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2) *
        ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
          complexGaussian z⁻¹
            (pdEuclideanEquiv L
              (intVectorToReal ((pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm m))) := by
          rw [tsum_mul_left]
    _ = ((Real.pi : ℂ) / ((Real.pi : ℂ) * z)) ^ ((n : ℂ) / 2) *
        ∑' m : Fin n → ℤ,
          complexGaussian z⁻¹
            (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal m)) := by
          congr 1
          exact (pdGramCoordEquiv L).symm.toEquiv.tsum_eq
            (fun m : Fin n → ℤ =>
              complexGaussian z⁻¹
                (pdEuclideanEquiv L (intVectorToReal m)))

name: SRG266.Lattice.connectedADECoordinates_of_dTripodIso
statement:
theorem connectedADECoordinates_of_dTripodIso
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (g : tripodGraph 1 1 t ≃g G) :
    ConnectedADECoordinates G
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (t + 3) ≃ V := (dTripodEquiv t ht).trans g.toEquiv
  refine ⟨.D (t + 3), by simp only [ADEType.IsRegular]; omega, ?_, e, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [ADEType.rank, Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_congr e
  · intro i j
    change graphCartanMatrix G (e i) (e j) = gramD (t + 3) i j
    calc
      _ = graphCartanMatrix (tripodGraph 1 1 t)
          (dTripodEquiv t ht i) (dTripodEquiv t ht j) :=
        graphCartanMatrix_apply_iso g _ _
      _ = gramD (t + 3) i j := graphCartanMatrix_dTripod t ht i j

name: SRG266.Lattice.positiveCartan_connected_ADE_unbounded
statement:
theorem positiveCartan_connected_ADE_unbounded
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected) : ConnectedADECoordinates G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbranch : ∃ z, G.degree z = 3
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hbranch
    obtain ⟨A₀, A₁, A₂, h₀₁, h₀₂, h₁₂, hshape⟩ :=
      exists_orientedArms_D_or_E_unbounded hpos hconn hz
    have hcomponents := card_puncturedComponents_eq_three hpos hconn hz
    rcases hshape with hD | hE6 | hE7 | hE8
    · unfold IsDArmTriple at hD
      rcases hD with ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ | ⟨h₀, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      · obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents
          A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂
        rw [h₀, h₁] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_dTripodIso A₂.length_pos g
      · obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents
          A₀ A₂ A₁ h₀₂ h₀₁ h₁₂.symm
        rw [h₀, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_dTripodIso A₁.length_pos g
      · obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents
          A₁ A₂ A₀ h₁₂ h₀₁.symm h₀₂.symm
        rw [h₁, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_dTripodIso A₀.length_pos g
    · unfold IsE6ArmTriple at hE6
      rcases hE6 with ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₀, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₂, h₀, h₁⟩
      · obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents
          A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂
        rw [h₀, h₁, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e6TripodIso g
      · obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents
          A₁ A₀ A₂ h₀₁.symm h₁₂ h₀₂
        rw [h₁, h₀, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e6TripodIso g
      · obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents
          A₂ A₀ A₁ h₀₂.symm h₁₂.symm h₀₁
        rw [h₂, h₀, h₁] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e6TripodIso g
    · unfold IsE7ArmTriple at hE7
      rcases hE7 with h | h | h | h | h | h
      · rcases h with ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂
        rw [h₀, h₁, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e7TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₀, h₂, h₁⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₀ A₂ A₁ h₀₂ h₀₁ h₁₂.symm
        rw [h₀, h₂, h₁] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e7TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₀, h₂⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₁ A₀ A₂ h₀₁.symm h₁₂ h₀₂
        rw [h₁, h₀, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e7TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₂, h₀⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₁ A₂ A₀ h₁₂ h₀₁.symm h₀₂.symm
        rw [h₁, h₂, h₀] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e7TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₂, h₀, h₁⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₂ A₀ A₁ h₀₂.symm h₁₂.symm h₀₁
        rw [h₂, h₀, h₁] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e7TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₂, h₁, h₀⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₂ A₁ A₀ h₁₂.symm h₀₂.symm h₀₁.symm
        rw [h₂, h₁, h₀] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e7TripodIso g
    · unfold IsE8ArmTriple at hE8
      rcases hE8 with h | h | h | h | h | h
      · rcases h with ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₀ A₁ A₂ h₀₁ h₀₂ h₁₂
        rw [h₀, h₁, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e8TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₀, h₂, h₁⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₀ A₂ A₁ h₀₂ h₀₁ h₁₂.symm
        rw [h₀, h₂, h₁] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e8TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₀, h₂⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₁ A₀ A₂ h₀₁.symm h₁₂ h₀₂
        rw [h₁, h₀, h₂] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e8TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₂, h₀⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₁ A₂ A₀ h₁₂ h₀₁.symm h₀₂.symm
        rw [h₁, h₂, h₀] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e8TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₂, h₀, h₁⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₂ A₀ A₁ h₀₂.symm h₁₂.symm h₀₁
        rw [h₂, h₀, h₁] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e8TripodIso g
      · rcases h with ⟨h₂, h₁, h₀⟩
        obtain ⟨g⟩ := exists_tripodGraph_iso hpos hconn hcomponents A₂ A₁ A₀ h₁₂.symm h₀₂.symm h₀₁.symm
        rw [h₂, h₁, h₀] at g
        exact connectedADECoordinates_of_e8TripodIso g
  · have hdeg : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2 := by
      intro v
      have hle := hpos.degree_le_three v
      have hne : G.degree v ≠ 3 := fun h ↦ hbranch ⟨v, h⟩
      omega
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_A_coordinates_of_degree_le_two
      hconn hpos.isAcyclic hdeg
    let : Nonempty V := hconn.nonempty
    refine ⟨.A (Fintype.card V), ?_, rfl, e, ?_⟩
    · simp only [ADEType.IsRegular]
      exact Fintype.card_pos
    intro i j
    change graphCartanMatrix G (e i) (e j) = gramA (Fintype.card V) i j
    exact he i j

name: SRG266.Lattice.positiveCartan_connected_ADE
statement:
theorem positiveCartan_connected_ADE
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hpos : IsPositiveCartan G) (hconn : G.Connected)
    (_hcard : Fintype.card V ≤ 15) : ConnectedADECoordinates G
proof:
:=
  positiveCartan_connected_ADE_unbounded hpos hconn

name: SRG266.Lattice.rankSum_eq_three_counts
statement:
theorem rankSum_eq_three_counts {ts : List ADEType}
    (htypes : ∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) :
    ADEType.rankSum ts =
      11 * ts.count (.A 11) + 7 * ts.count (.D 7) + 6 * ts.count .E6
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with
  | nil => simp [ADEType.rankSum]
  | cons t ts ih =>
      have htail : ∀ s ∈ ts, s = .A 11 ∨ s = .D 7 ∨ s = .E6 :=
        fun s hs => htypes s (List.mem_cons_of_mem t hs)
      have hi := ih htail
      rcases htypes t (by simp) with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
        simp [ADEType.rankSum_cons, ADEType.rank] <;> omega

name: SRG266.Lattice.ade_rank24_height_eleven_layouts
statement:
theorem ade_rank24_height_eleven_layouts {ts : List ADEType}
    (hrank : ADEType.rankSum ts = 24)
    (htypes : ∀ t ∈ ts, t = .A 11 ∨ t = .D 7 ∨ t = .E6) :
    ts.Perm [.E6, .E6, .E6, .E6] ∨ ts.Perm [.A 11, .D 7, .E6]
proof:
:= by
  have hc := rankSum_eq_three_counts htypes
  have hcases :
      (ts.count (.A 11) = 0 ∧ ts.count (.D 7) = 0 ∧ ts.count .E6 = 4) ∨
      (ts.count (.A 11) = 1 ∧ ts.count (.D 7) = 1 ∧ ts.count .E6 = 1) := by
    have ha : ts.count (.A 11) ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hb : ts.count (.D 7) ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hdiv : (6 : ℤ) ∣ (ts.count (.A 11) : ℤ) - ts.count (.D 7) := by
      refine ⟨2 * (ts.count (.A 11) : ℤ) + ts.count (.D 7) + ts.count .E6 - 4, ?_⟩
      omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
    have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
    omega
  rcases hcases with ⟨ha, hd, he⟩ | ⟨ha, hd, he⟩
  · left
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro t
    by_cases hA : t = .A 11
    · subst t; simpa using ha
    by_cases hD : t = .D 7
    · subst t; simpa using hd
    by_cases hE : t = .E6
    · subst t; simpa using he
    have hnot : t ∉ ts := by
      intro ht
      rcases htypes t ht with h | h | h <;> contradiction
    rw [List.count_eq_zero.mpr hnot]
    symm
    apply List.count_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa using hE
  · right
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro t
    by_cases hA : t = .A 11
    · subst t; simpa using ha
    by_cases hD : t = .D 7
    · subst t; simpa using hd
    by_cases hE : t = .E6
    · subst t; simpa using he
    have hnot : t ∉ ts := by
      intro ht
      rcases htypes t ht with h | h | h <;> contradiction
    rw [List.count_eq_zero.mpr hnot]
    symm
    apply List.count_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa using not_or.mpr ⟨hA, not_or.mpr ⟨hD, hE⟩⟩

name: SRG266.Lattice.torsionPart_eq_sup_map_of_dual_transport
statement:
theorem torsionPart_eq_sup_map_of_dual_transport (J : W →ₗ[ℤ] U)
    (hiM : IsIntegral C M)
    (hdual : C.dualSubmodule M = M ⊔ (B.dualSubmodule N).map J)
    (hclass : ∀ v ∈ B.dualSubmodule N, J v ∈ M ↔ v ∈ N) (p : ℕ) :
    torsionPart C M p = M ⊔ (torsionPart B N p).map J
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzd, hzp⟩ := mem_torsionPart.mp hz
    rw [hdual] at hzd
    obtain ⟨m, hm, jv, hjv, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hzd
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hjv
    have hjp : (p : ℤ) • J v ∈ M := by
      have heq : (p : ℤ) • J v = (p : ℤ) • (m + J v) - (p : ℤ) • m := by module
      rw [heq]
      exact M.sub_mem hzp (M.smul_mem _ hm)
    have hvp : (p : ℤ) • v ∈ N := by
      apply (hclass _ ((B.dualSubmodule N).smul_mem (p : ℤ) hv)).mp
      simpa only [map_smul] using hjp
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup hm ⟨v, mem_torsionPart.mpr ⟨hv, hvp⟩, rfl⟩
  · refine sup_le (le_torsionPart hiM p) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hvd, hvp⟩ := mem_torsionPart.mp hv
    refine mem_torsionPart.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hdual]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨v, hvd, rfl⟩
    · have h := (hclass _ ((B.dualSubmodule N).smul_mem (p : ℤ) hvd)).mpr hvp
      simpa only [map_smul] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.sup_map_eq_sup_span_image
statement:
theorem sup_map_eq_sup_span_image (J : W →ₗ[ℤ] U) (hmap : N.map J ≤ M)
    {P : Submodule ℤ W} {s : Set W} (hP : P = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ s) :
    M ⊔ P.map J = M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (J '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP, Submodule.map_sup, Submodule.map_span, ← sup_assoc, sup_eq_left.mpr hmap]

name: SRG266.Lattice.HasPrimaryNormalForm.map
statement:
theorem HasPrimaryNormalForm.map (J : W →ₗ[ℤ] U) (hmap : N.map J ≤ M)
    {p : ℕ} {r : ℤ}
    (hprimary : torsionPart C M p = M ⊔ (torsionPart B N p).map J)
    (hnorm : ∀ u ∈ torsionPart B N p,
      ∃ n : ℤ, C (J u) (J u) = B u u + 2 * (n : ℚ))
    (hcross : ∀ u ∈ torsionPart B N p, ∀ v ∈ torsionPart B N p,
      B u v ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) → C (J u) (J v) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (h : HasPrimaryNormalForm B N p r) : HasPrimaryNormalForm C M p r
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with hzero | ⟨u, a, k, ha, hsp, hu⟩ | ⟨u, v, hsp, huv, ⟨k, hu⟩, ⟨l, hv⟩⟩
  · apply Or.inl
    rw [hprimary, hzero, sup_eq_left.mpr hmap]
  · have hut : u ∈ torsionPart B N p := by
      rw [hsp]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnorm u hut
    refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨J u, a, k + n, ha, ?_, ?_⟩)
    · rw [hprimary, sup_map_eq_sup_span_image J hmap hsp, Set.image_singleton]
    · rw [hn, hu]
      push_cast
      ring
  · have hut : u ∈ torsionPart B N p := by
      rw [hsp]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
    have hvt : v ∈ torsionPart B N p := by
      rw [hsp]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnorm u hut
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hnorm v hvt
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨J u, J v, ?_, hcross u hut v hvt huv,
      ⟨k + n, ?_⟩, ⟨l + m, ?_⟩⟩)
    · rw [hprimary, sup_map_eq_sup_span_image J hmap hsp, Set.image_pair]
    · rw [hn, hu]
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [hm, hv]
      push_cast
      ring

name: SRG266.Lattice.matrixRatForm_reindex
statement:
theorem matrixRatForm_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix κ κ ℚ) (e : ι ≃ κ) (x y : ι → ℚ) :
    Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j => A (e i) (e j)) x y =
      Matrix.toBilin' A (fun i => x (e.symm i)) (fun i => y (e.symm i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j : κ, x i*A (e i) j*y (e.symm j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        e.sum_comp (fun j => x i*A (e i) j*y (e.symm j))
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        e.sum_comp (fun i => ∑ j, x (e.symm i)*A i j*y (e.symm j))

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeRootRatForm_reindex
statement:
theorem adeRootRatForm_reindex (ts : List ADEType)
    (x y : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) → ℚ) :
    adeRootRatForm ts x y = adeBlockRatForm ts
      (fun i => x ((finADEBlockEquiv ts).symm i))
      (fun i => y ((finADEBlockEquiv ts).symm i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := matrixRatForm_reindex (fun i j => (adeBlockPairing ts i j : ℚ))
    (finADEBlockEquiv ts) x y
  simpa only [adeRootRatForm, adeBlockRatForm, adeGram_apply_eq_adeBlockPairing] using h

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeBlockRatForm_cons
statement:
theorem adeBlockRatForm_cons (t : ADEType) (ts : List ADEType)
    (x y : ADEBlockIndex (t :: ts) → ℚ) :
    adeBlockRatForm (t :: ts) x y =
      Matrix.toBilin' (fun i j => (t.gram i j : ℚ))
        (fun i => x (Sum.inl i)) (fun i => y (Sum.inl i)) +
      adeBlockRatForm ts (fun i => x (Sum.inr i)) (fun i => y (Sum.inr i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adeBlockRatForm, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  change (∑ i : Fin t.rank ⊕ ADEBlockIndex ts, ∑ j : Fin t.rank ⊕ ADEBlockIndex ts,
    x i * (adeBlockPairing (t :: ts) i j : ℚ) * y j) = _
  simp [Fintype.sum_sum_type, adeBlockPairing]

name: SRG266.Lattice.adeBlockRatForm_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeBlockRatForm_nil (x y : ADEBlockIndex [] → ℚ) :
    adeBlockRatForm [] x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adeBlockRatForm, Matrix.toBilin'_apply]
  change (∑ i : Empty, ∑ j : Empty, x i * (adeBlockPairing [] i j : ℚ) * y j) = 0
  simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_mono
statement:
theorem neighborCount_mono {T U : Finset V} (hTU : T ⊆ U) (x : V) :
    D.neighborCount T x ≤ D.neighborCount U x
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hTU)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.class_zero_side_counts
statement:
theorem class_zero_side_counts {S : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0) :
    D.neighborCount S x = 0 ∧ D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 x).mp hx |>.2
  rw [D.biclique_neighborCount_split] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.outside_non_one_side_even
statement:
theorem outside_non_one_side_even {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S)
    (hnot1 : x ∉ D.bicliqueClass S 1) : Even (D.neighborCount S x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hcard hI hx
  change D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ≤ 2 at hb
  have hn : D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ≠ 1 :=
    fun h => hnot1 ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S 1 x).mpr ⟨hx,h⟩)
  have hc : D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 0 ∨
      D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 2 := by omega
  rcases hc with h0 | h2
  · have hs := D.neighborCount_mono (Finset.subset_union_left : S ⊆ S ∪ D.commonTo S) x
    have hz : D.neighborCount S x = 0 := by omega
    simp [hz]
  · have hx2 := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mpr ⟨hx,h2⟩
    rcases D.bicliqueClass_two_sides hx2 with h | h <;> simp [h]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.class_zero_common_one_eq
statement:
theorem class_zero_common_one_eq {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x y +
      2 * D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x y = 6
proof:
:= by
  have hc := D.commonCount_biclique_partition hcard hI x y
  rw [D.commonCount_univ hxy hn] at hc
  have hzero : D.commonCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y = 0 := by
    have hle := D.commonCount_le_neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y
    have ht := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 x).mp hx |>.2
    omega
  have hU := D.commonCount_union (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0) x y
  have hgram := D.bicliqueCubicLeft_common hcard hI
    (Finset.mem_union_right _ hx) (Finset.mem_union_right _ hy) hxy hn
  change D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y = _ at hU
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.class_zero_common_le_two
statement:
theorem class_zero_common_le_two {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x y ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y
  · rw [D.commonCount_of_adj _ hn]
    omega
  · by_contra hgt
    have hmass := D.class_zero_common_one_eq hcard hI hx hy hxy hn
    have hnone : D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x y = 0 := by omega
    have hxD := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 x).mp hx |>.1
    have hyD := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 y).mp hy |>.1
    have hxS : x ∉ S := fun h => hxD (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
    have hyS : y ∉ S := fun h => hyD (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
    have hxside := (D.class_zero_side_counts hx).1
    have hyside := (D.class_zero_side_counts hy).1
    have hcommonS : D.commonCount S x y = 0 := by
      have hle := D.commonCount_le_neighborCount S x y
      omega
    have ht := D.commonTrace_subset S hxy hn
    rw [hcard, hxside, hyside, hcommonS, if_neg hxS, if_neg hyS] at ht
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] at ht
    have heven (z : V) : Even (D.kreinMatrix x z * D.kreinMatrix y z *
        (D.neighborCount S z : ℤ)) := by
      by_cases hxz : D.kreinGraph.Adj x z
      · by_cases hyz : D.kreinGraph.Adj y z
        · have hzD : z ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S := by
            intro hz
            have hpos : 0 < D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x :=
              Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨z, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hz,hxz⟩⟩
            have hzero := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 x).mp hx |>.2
            omega
          have hz1 : z ∉ D.bicliqueClass S 1 := by
            intro hz
            have hpos : 0 < D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x y :=
              Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨z, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hz,hxz,hyz⟩⟩
            omega
          exact (D.outside_non_one_side_even hcard hI hzD hz1).mul_left _
        · simp [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, hyz]
      · simp [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, hxz]
    have hsum : Even (∑ z, D.kreinMatrix x z * D.kreinMatrix y z *
        (D.neighborCount S z : ℤ)) := Finset.even_sum _ (fun z _ => heven z)
    rw [ht] at hsum
    obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hsum
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.no_biclique_in_class_zero
statement:
theorem no_biclique_in_class_zero {S R : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hR : R.card = 3) (hRI : D.IndependentSet R) :
    ¬ R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hsub
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,hab,_,_,hReq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hR
  have ha : a ∈ R := by rw [hReq]; simp
  have hb : b ∈ R := by rw [hReq]; simp
  have habound := D.class_zero_common_le_two hS hSI
    (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)) (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ hb)) hab
  have hCsub : D.commonTo R ⊆ (D.bicliqueClass S 0).filter
      (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj a z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj b z) := by
    intro z hz
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hz),
      (D.mem_commonTo R z).mp hz a ha, (D.mem_commonTo R z).mp hz b hb⟩
  have h := Finset.card_le_card hCsub
  change (D.commonTo R).card ≤ D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) a b at h
  rw [D.commonTo_card hR hRI] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem neighborCount_weighted_sum (T : Finset V) (x : V) :
    (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount T y : ℤ)) =
      45 * (if x ∈ T then 1 else 0) + 12 * T.card - 12 * D.neighborCount T x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [D.neighborCount_cast, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, D.kreinMatrix_square_apply]
  simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.triangle_neighbor_moment_zero
statement:
theorem triangle_neighbor_moment_zero {x a b : V} (hxa : D.kreinGraph.Adj x a) :
    (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a * D.kreinMatrix y b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro y _
  rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix]
  simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hxy : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y
  · have hay : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj y a := by
      intro hya
      exact D.no_triangle hxa hxy ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y a).mp hya)
    simp [hay]
  · simp [hxy]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independent_pair_neighbor_moment
statement:
theorem independent_pair_neighbor_moment {x a b : V}
    (hxa : x ≠ a) (hxb : x ≠ b) (hab : a ≠ b) (hI : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj a b) :
    (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a * D.kreinMatrix y b) =
      if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x b then 3 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : D.kreinGraph.Adj x a
  · rw [D.triangle_neighbor_moment_zero ha]
    simp [ha]
  · by_cases hb : D.kreinGraph.Adj x b
    · have hz := D.triangle_neighbor_moment_zero (b := a) hb
      have heq : (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a * D.kreinMatrix y b) =
          ∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y b * D.kreinMatrix y a := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y _
        ring
      rw [heq, hz]
      simp [hb]
    · simpa only [ha, hb, not_false_eq_true, and_self, if_true,
        D.kreinMatrix_comm a, D.kreinMatrix_comm b] using
        D.independent_triple_neighbor_moment x a b hxa hxb hab ha hb hI

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independentSet_weighted_square
statement:
theorem independentSet_weighted_square (T : Finset V) (hI : D.IndependentSet T)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∉ T) :
    (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount T y : ℤ)^2) =
      12 * T.card - 12 * D.neighborCount T x +
      3 * (((T.filter fun a => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a).card : ℤ)^2 -
        (T.filter fun a => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a).card)
proof:
:= by
  have hentry (a) (ha : a ∈ T) (b) (hb : b ∈ T) :
      (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a * D.kreinMatrix y b) =
        (if a = b then 12 - 12 * D.kreinMatrix x a else 0) +
        3 * (if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x b then 1 else 0) -
        3 * (if a = b ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a then 1 else 0) := by
    have hxa : x ≠ a := fun h => hx (h ▸ ha)
    have hxb : x ≠ b := fun h => hx (h ▸ hb)
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b
      have hi (y) : D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a * D.kreinMatrix y a =
          D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a := by
        rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix]
        simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => hi y), ← Matrix.mul_apply,
        D.kreinMatrix_square_apply]
      simp [hxa]
    · rw [D.independent_pair_neighbor_moment hxa hxb hab (hI a ha b hb hab)]
      simp only [hab, if_false, false_and, zero_add]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ T, ∑ b ∈ T, ∑ y,
        D.kreinMatrix x y * D.kreinMatrix y a * D.kreinMatrix y b := by
      simp_rw [D.neighborCount_cast, pow_two, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      simp_rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      have heq := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a ha =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => hentry a ha b hb))
      rw [heq]
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hdiag : (∑ a ∈ T, ∑ b ∈ T, if a = b then 12 - 12 * D.kreinMatrix x a else 0) =
          12 * T.card - 12 * D.neighborCount T x := by
        simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, D.neighborCount_cast, mul_comm]
      rw [hdiag]
      have hoff : (∑ a ∈ T, ∑ b ∈ T,
          if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x b then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
          ((T.filter fun a => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a).card : ℤ)^2 := by
        have hf (a b) : (if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x b then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
            (if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a then 1 else 0) * (if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x b then 1 else 0) := by
          by_cases ha : D.kreinGraph.Adj x a <;>
            by_cases hb : D.kreinGraph.Adj x b <;> simp [ha, hb]
        simp_rw [hf, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_boole, pow_two]
      have hdiag2 : (∑ a ∈ T, ∑ b ∈ T,
          if a = b ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
          (T.filter fun a => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a).card := by
        have hi (a) (ha : a ∈ T) : (∑ b ∈ T,
            if a = b ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
            if ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a then 1 else 0 := by
          by_cases h : D.kreinGraph.Adj x a <;> simp [h, ha]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hi]
        simp only [Finset.sum_boole]
      rw [hoff, hdiag2]
      ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independentTriple_weighted_square
statement:
theorem independentTriple_weighted_square {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ S) :
    (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount S y : ℤ)^2) =
      54 - 27 * D.neighborCount S x + 3 * (D.neighborCount S x : ℤ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.independentSet_weighted_square S hI x hx
  have hc : ((S.filter fun a => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a).card : ℤ) =
      3 - D.neighborCount S x := by
    have hpart := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := S) (p := fun a => D.kreinGraph.Adj x a)
    change D.neighborCount S x + (S.filter fun a => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x a).card = S.card at hpart
    omega
  rw [h, hcard, hc]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_neighborCount_split
statement:
theorem biclique_neighborCount_split (S : Finset V) (x : V) :
    D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = D.neighborCount S x + D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [neighborCount, Finset.filter_union]
  exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
    ((D.disjoint_commonTo S).mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (Finset.filter_subset _ _))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_neighborCount_product_zero
statement:
theorem biclique_neighborCount_product_zero (S : Finset V) (x : V) :
    (D.neighborCount S x : ℤ) * D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hS : D.neighborCount S x = 0
  · simp [hS]
  · have hC : D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x = 0 := by
      by_contra hC
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < D.neighborCount S x)
      obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x)
      obtain ⟨haS,hxa⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
      obtain ⟨hbC,hxb⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
      exact D.no_triangle hxa hxb ((D.mem_commonTo S b).mp hbC a haS)
    simp [hC]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_weighted_square
statement:
theorem biclique_weighted_square {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
    (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ)^2) =
      108 - 27 * D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x +
        3 * (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x : ℤ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hL := D.independentTriple_weighted_square hcard hI
    (fun h => hx (Finset.mem_union_left _ h))
  have hR := D.independentTriple_weighted_square (D.commonTo_card hcard hI)
    (D.commonTo_independent (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < S.card)))
    (fun h => hx (Finset.mem_union_right _ h))
  have heq (y) : D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ)^2 =
      D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount S y : ℤ)^2 +
        D.kreinMatrix x y * (D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) y : ℤ)^2 := by
    rw [D.biclique_neighborCount_split, Nat.cast_add]
    have hz := D.biclique_neighborCount_product_zero S y
    linear_combination 2 * D.kreinMatrix x y * hz
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => heq y), Finset.sum_add_distrib, hL, hR,
    D.biclique_neighborCount_split, Nat.cast_add]
  have hz := D.biclique_neighborCount_product_zero S x
  nlinarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum
statement:
theorem bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum (S : Finset V) (x : V) (f : V → ℤ) (c : ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ y ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S, f y = c) :
    (∑ y ∈ D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x, f y) =
      (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y * f y) - c * D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x
proof:
:= by
  let T := S ∪ D.commonTo S
  have hi : (∑ y ∈ T, D.kreinMatrix x y * f y) = c * D.neighborCount T x := by
    rw [D.neighborCount_cast, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    rw [hc y hy, mul_comm]
  have ho : (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ \ T, D.kreinMatrix x y * f y) =
      ∑ y ∈ D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x, f y := by
    simp [bicliqueOutsideNeighbors, bicliqueOutside, T, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix,
      SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, Finset.sum_filter]
  have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ T) (f := fun y => D.kreinMatrix x y * f y)
  rw [hi, ho] at h
  dsimp [T] at h
  linarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_moments
statement:
theorem bicliqueOutside_neighbor_moments {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
    ((D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x).card : ℤ) =
      57 - D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ∧
    (∑ y ∈ D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x, (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ)) =
      72 - 15 * D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ∧
    (∑ y ∈ D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x, (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ)^2) =
      108 - 36 * D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x +
        3 * (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x : ℤ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hin (y) (hy : y ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
      (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ) = 3 := by
    rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hy]
    norm_num
  have h0 := D.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum S x (fun _ => 1) 1 (by simp)
  have h1 := D.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum S x (fun y => D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y) 3 hin
  have h2 := D.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum S x (fun y => (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ)^2) 9
    (by intro y hy; rw [hin y hy]; norm_num)
  simp only [mul_one, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, D.kreinMatrix_row_sum, one_mul] at h0
  rw [D.neighborCount_weighted_sum, if_neg hx, D.biclique_card hcard hI] at h1
  rw [D.biclique_weighted_square hcard hI hx] at h2
  norm_num at h1
  refine ⟨h0, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors_fiber_card
statement:
theorem bicliqueOutsideNeighbors_fiber_card (S : Finset V) (x : V) (i : ℕ) :
    ((D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x).filter fun y => D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y = i).card =
      D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S i) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold bicliqueOutsideNeighbors neighborCount bicliqueClass
  congr 1
  ext y
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
  tauto

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_local_degrees
statement:
theorem biclique_local_degrees {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x =
      (if D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 0 then 3 else
        if D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 1 then 8 else 16) ∧
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x =
      (if D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 1 then 39 else 36) ∧
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x =
      (if D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 0 then 18 else
        if D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 1 then 9 else 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ y ∈ D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x, D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y ≤ 2 := by
    intro y hy
    exact D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hcard hI
      ((D.mem_bicliqueOutside S y).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1)
  have h := boundedTwo_fiber_moments (D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x)
    (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S)) hle
  simp only [D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors_fiber_card] at h
  have hm := D.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_moments hcard hI hx
  have hbound := D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hcard hI hx
  change D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ≤ 2 at hbound
  have hcases : D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 0 ∨
      D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 1 ∨ D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · norm_num [h0] at hm ⊢
    omega
  · norm_num [h1] at hm ⊢
    omega
  · norm_num [h2] at hm ⊢
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_zero_degree_self
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_zero_degree_self {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0) :
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxout,h0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
  have h := D.biclique_local_degrees hcard hI ((D.mem_bicliqueOutside S x).mp hxout)
  simpa only [h0, if_true] using h.1

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_two_degree_self
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_two_degree_self {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) :
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hxout,h2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
  have h := D.biclique_local_degrees hcard hI ((D.mem_bicliqueOutside S x).mp hxout)
  simpa [h2] using h.2.2

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_inside_degrees
statement:
theorem biclique_inside_degrees {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x = 0 ∧
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x = 36 ∧
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x = 18
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x = 0 := by
    apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
    apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hy0,hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
    have h0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy0).2
    have hpos : 0 < D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y := Finset.card_pos.mpr
      ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp hxy⟩⟩
    omega
  have hin (y) (hy : y ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
