      (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y : ℤ) = 3 := by
    rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hy]
    norm_num
  have hm0 := D.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum S x (fun _ => 1) 1 (by simp)
  have hm1 := D.bicliqueOutside_neighbor_sum S x (fun y => D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y) 3 hin
  rw [D.neighborCount_weighted_sum, if_pos hx, D.biclique_card hcard hI] at hm1
  simp only [mul_one, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, D.kreinMatrix_row_sum, one_mul] at hm0
  rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hx] at hm0 hm1
  norm_num at hm0 hm1
  have hle : ∀ y ∈ D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x, D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y ≤ 2 := by
    intro y hy
    exact D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hcard hI
      ((D.mem_bicliqueOutside S y).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1)
  have hf := boundedTwo_fiber_moments (D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x)
    (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S)) hle
  simp only [D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors_fiber_card] at hf
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.no_steinerQuadruple_on12
statement:
theorem no_steinerQuadruple_on12 {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (X : Finset α) (hX : X.card = 12) (blocks : Finset (Finset α))
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B.card = 4)
    (hinside : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B ⊆ X)
    (htriple : ∀ T : Finset α, T ⊆ X → T.card = 3 →
      (blocks.filter fun B => T ⊆ B).card = 1) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,haX⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < X.card)
  let through := blocks.filter fun B => a ∈ B
  let pairs := (X.erase a).powersetCard 2
  have hpairs : pairs.card = 55 := by
    rw [Finset.card_powersetCard,Finset.card_erase_of_mem haX,hX]
    decide
  have hleft : ∀ B ∈ through, (pairs.filter fun T => T ⊆ B).card = 3 := by
    intro B hB
    have hb := Finset.mem_filter.mp hB
    have heq : pairs.filter (fun T => T ⊆ B) = (B.erase a).powersetCard 2 := by
      ext T
      simp only [pairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hT, hcard⟩, hsub⟩
        refine ⟨?_, hcard⟩
        intro x hx
        exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp (hT hx)).1, hsub hx⟩
      · rintro ⟨hT, hcard⟩
        refine ⟨⟨?_, hcard⟩, ?_⟩
        · intro x hx
          exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp (hT hx)).1,
            hinside B hb.1 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (hT hx))⟩
        · intro x hx
          exact Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (hT hx)
    rw [heq, Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hb.2, hsize B hb.1]
    decide
  have hright : ∀ T ∈ pairs, (through.filter fun B => T ⊆ B).card = 1 := by
    intro T hT
    have ht := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hT
    have ha : a ∉ T := by
      intro ha
      exact Finset.notMem_erase a X (ht.1 ha)
    have hi : (insert a T).card = 3 := by
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha, ht.2]
    have hiX : insert a T ⊆ X := Finset.insert_subset_iff.mpr
      ⟨haX,fun _ hx => Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (ht.1 hx)⟩
    have h := htriple (insert a T) hiX hi
    have heq : through.filter (fun B => T ⊆ B) =
        blocks.filter (fun B => insert a T ⊆ B) := by
      ext B
      simp [through, Finset.insert_subset_iff, and_assoc]
    rw [heq]
    exact h
  have hcount := Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow
    (s := through) (t := pairs) (fun B T => T ⊆ B)
  simp only [Finset.bipartiteAbove, Finset.bipartiteBelow] at hcount
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hleft, Finset.sum_congr rfl hright] at hcount
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, hpairs] at hcount
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.no_steinerQuadruple12
statement:
theorem no_steinerQuadruple12
    (blocks : Finset (Finset (Fin 12)))
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B.card = 4)
    (htriple : ∀ T : Finset (Fin 12), T.card = 3 →
      (blocks.filter fun B => T ⊆ B).card = 1) : False
proof:
:=
  no_steinerQuadruple_on12 Finset.univ (by decide) blocks hsize
    (fun _ _ => Finset.subset_univ _) (fun T _ hT => htriple T hT)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_triple_sum
statement:
theorem incidence_triple_sum (p q r : P) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.incidence r e) =
      2 + 9 * (if p = q then 1 else 0) + 9 * (if p = r then 1 else 0) +
        9 * (if q = r then 1 else 0) + 27 * (if p = q ∧ p = r then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.incidence r e) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun e => p ∈ D.block e ∧ q ∈ D.block e ∧ r ∈ D.block e).card : ℤ) := by
    simp only [incidence, ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, one_mul, Finset.sum_boole, and_assoc]
  rw [hsum]
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    by_cases hpr : p = r
    · subst r
      simp [D.replication]
    · simp [hpr, D.point_pair p r hpr]
  · by_cases hpr : p = r
    · subst r
      have heq : (Finset.univ.filter fun e => p ∈ D.block e ∧ q ∈ D.block e ∧ p ∈ D.block e) =
          Finset.univ.filter fun e => p ∈ D.block e ∧ q ∈ D.block e := by
        ext e
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1,h.2,h.1⟩⟩
      rw [heq, D.point_pair p q hpq]
      simp [hpq, Ne.symm hpq]
    · by_cases hqr : q = r
      · subst r
        simp [hpq, D.point_pair p q hpq]
      · rw [D.point_triple p q r hpq hpr hqr]
        simp [hpq, hpr, hqr]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.subsetTrace_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem subsetTrace_singleton (p : P) (e : B) :
    D.subsetTrace {p} e = D.incidence p e
proof: := by simp [subsetTrace]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.subsetTrace_block
statement:
theorem subsetTrace_block (b e : B) :
    D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e = ((D.block b ∩ D.block e).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [subsetTrace, incidence]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.triple_subsetTrace_expand
statement:
theorem triple_subsetTrace_expand (S T U : Finset P) :
    (∑ e, D.subsetTrace S e * D.subsetTrace T e * D.subsetTrace U e) =
      ∑ p ∈ S, ∑ q ∈ T, ∑ r ∈ U,
        (2 + 9 * (if p = q then 1 else 0) + 9 * (if p = r then 1 else 0) +
          9 * (if q = r then 1 else 0) + 27 * (if p = q ∧ p = r then 1 else 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hprod (e : B) : D.subsetTrace S e * D.subsetTrace T e * D.subsetTrace U e =
      ∑ p ∈ S, ∑ q ∈ T, ∑ r ∈ U, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.incidence r e := by
    simp only [subsetTrace, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := U) (t := T)]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := U) (t := S)]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := T) (t := S)]
  simp_rw [hprod]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => D.incidence_triple_sum p q r

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.triple_subsetTrace_sum
statement:
theorem triple_subsetTrace_sum (S T U : Finset P) :
    (∑ e, D.subsetTrace S e * D.subsetTrace T e * D.subsetTrace U e) =
      2 * (S.card : ℤ) * T.card * U.card +
        9 * ((S ∩ T).card * (U.card : ℤ) + (S ∩ U).card * (T.card : ℤ) +
          (T ∩ U).card * (S.card : ℤ)) + 27 * (S ∩ T ∩ U).card
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag : (∑ p ∈ S, ∑ q ∈ T, ∑ r ∈ U,
      (if p = q ∧ p = r then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) = (S ∩ T ∩ U).card := by
    simp only [ite_and, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp only [← ite_and, Finset.sum_boole]
    congr 2
    ext p
    simp
  rw [D.triple_subsetTrace_expand]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hdiag]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
    Finset.sum_boole, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.block_intersection_three
statement:
theorem block_intersection_three {b c : B} (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hnot : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card ≠ 0) : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3
proof:
:=
  (D.block_intersections b c hbc).resolve_left hnot

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_point_block_moment
statement:
theorem point_point_block_moment {p q : P} {b : B} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : q ∉ D.block b) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e) = 24
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.triple_subsetTrace_sum {p} {q} (D.block b)
  simpa [hpq, hp, hq, D.block_size] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_block_block_moment
statement:
theorem point_block_block_moment {p : P} {b c : B}
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : p ∉ D.block c)
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e * D.subsetTrace (D.block c) e) = 315
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.triple_subsetTrace_sum {p} (D.block b) (D.block c)
  simpa [hp, hq, hbc, D.block_size] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.block_block_block_moment
statement:
theorem block_block_block_moment {b c d : B}
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3)
    (hbd : (D.block b ∩ D.block d).card = 3)
    (hcd : (D.block c ∩ D.block d).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e * D.subsetTrace (D.block c) e *
      D.subsetTrace (D.block d) e) = 4428 + 27 * (D.block b ∩ D.block c ∩ D.block d).card
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.triple_subsetTrace_sum (D.block b) (D.block c) (D.block d)
  simpa [hbc, hbd, hcd, D.block_size] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.subsetTrace_block_affine
statement:
theorem subsetTrace_block_affine (b e : B) :
    D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e = 3 - 3 * D.disjointness b e + 9 * (if e = b then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.subsetTrace_block]
  have h := congrFun (congrFun D.incidence_block_gram b) e
  rw [D.incidence_block_gram_apply] at h
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    allOnesMatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
  by_cases heb : e = b
  · subst e
    simp only [if_true] at h ⊢
    omega
  · simp only [if_neg heb, if_neg (Ne.symm heb), mul_zero, add_zero] at h ⊢
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_mul_disjointness_sum
statement:
theorem incidence_mul_disjointness_sum (p : P) (b : B) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.disjointness b e) = 12 - 12 * D.incidence p b
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun D.incidence_mul_disjointness p) b
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, D.disjointness_comm b, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Matrix.sub_apply, allOnesMatrix, mul_sub] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_pair_sum
statement:
theorem disjointness_pair_sum {b c : B} (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hnot : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card ≠ 0) :
    (∑ e, D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e) = 9
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun D.disjointness_square b) c
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, if_neg hbc,
    allOnesMatrix_apply] at h
  have hA : D.disjointness b c = 0 := by simp [disjointness, hnot]
  rw [hA] at h
  simpa only [← D.disjointness_comm c, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, zero_add] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_point_disjoint_triple
statement:
theorem point_point_disjoint_triple {p q : P} {b : B} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : q ∉ D.block b) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.disjointness b e) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.point_point_block_moment hpq hp hq
  have hG := D.incidence_point_gram_apply p q
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, if_neg hpq] at hG
  have hentry (e : B) : D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e =
      3 * (D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e) -
        3 * (D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.disjointness b e) := by
    rw [D.subsetTrace_block_affine]
    by_cases heb : e = b
    · subst e
      simp [incidence, hp]
    · simp only [if_neg heb, mul_zero, add_zero]
      ring
  simp_rw [hentry] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hG] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_disjoint_disjoint_triple
statement:
theorem point_disjoint_disjoint_triple {p : P} {b c : B}
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : p ∉ D.block c)
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.point_block_block_moment hp hq hbc
  have hentry (e : B) : D.incidence p e * D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e *
      D.subsetTrace (D.block c) e =
      9 * D.incidence p e - 9 * (D.incidence p e * D.disjointness b e) -
        9 * (D.incidence p e * D.disjointness c e) +
          9 * (D.incidence p e * D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e) := by
    rw [D.subsetTrace_block_affine, D.subsetTrace_block_affine]
    by_cases heb : e = b
    · subst e
      simp [incidence, hp]
    by_cases hec : e = c
    · subst e
      simp [incidence, hq]
    simp only [if_neg heb, if_neg hec, mul_zero, add_zero]
    ring
  simp_rw [hentry] at h
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  rw [D.incidence_row_sum, D.incidence_mul_disjointness_sum,
    D.incidence_mul_disjointness_sum] at h
  have hpb : D.incidence p b = 0 := by simp [incidence, hp]
  have hpc : D.incidence p c = 0 := by simp [incidence, hq]
  rw [hpb,hpc] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.three_disjoint_triple_complement
statement:
theorem three_disjoint_triple_complement {b c d : B}
    (hbcne : b ≠ c) (hbdne : b ≠ d) (hcdne : c ≠ d)
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3)
    (hbd : (D.block b ∩ D.block d).card = 3)
    (hcd : (D.block c ∩ D.block d).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e * D.disjointness d e) +
      (D.block b ∩ D.block c ∩ D.block d).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.block_block_block_moment hbc hbd hcd
  have hbc0 : D.disjointness b c = 0 := by simp [disjointness,hbc]
  have hbd0 : D.disjointness b d = 0 := by simp [disjointness,hbd]
  have hcd0 : D.disjointness c d = 0 := by simp [disjointness,hcd]
  have hcb0 : D.disjointness c b = 0 := (D.disjointness_comm c b).trans hbc0
  have hdb0 : D.disjointness d b = 0 := (D.disjointness_comm d b).trans hbd0
  have hdc0 : D.disjointness d c = 0 := (D.disjointness_comm d c).trans hcd0
  have hentry (e : B) : D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e * D.subsetTrace (D.block c) e *
      D.subsetTrace (D.block d) e =
      27 * (1 - D.disjointness b e - D.disjointness c e - D.disjointness d e +
        D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e + D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness d e +
        D.disjointness c e * D.disjointness d e -
          D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e * D.disjointness d e) +
      81 * ((if e = b then 1 else 0) + (if e = c then 1 else 0) +
        (if e = d then 1 else 0)) := by
    simp only [D.subsetTrace_block_affine]
    by_cases heb : e = b
    · subst e
      simp [D.disjointness_diag,hcb0,hdb0,hbcne,hbdne]
    by_cases hec : e = c
    · subst e
      simp [D.disjointness_diag,hbc0,hdc0,Ne.symm hbcne,hcdne]
    by_cases hed : e = d
    · subst e
      simp [D.disjointness_diag,hbd0,hcd0,Ne.symm hbdne,Ne.symm hcdne]
    simp only [if_neg heb, if_neg hec, if_neg hed, mul_zero, add_zero]
    ring
  simp_rw [hentry] at h
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ, D.index_card,
    D.disjointness_row_sum, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true] at h
  rw [D.disjointness_pair_sum hbcne (by omega),
    D.disjointness_pair_sum hbdne (by omega),
    D.disjointness_pair_sum hcdne (by omega)] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independent_triple_neighbor_moment
statement:
theorem independent_triple_neighbor_moment (x y z : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B))
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z)
    (nxy : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) (nxz : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x z)
    (nyz : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z) :
    (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * D.kreinMatrix z w) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with _ | (p | b) <;> rcases y with _ | (q | c) <;> rcases z with _ | (r | d)
  all_goals try exact (hxy rfl).elim
  all_goals try exact (hxz rfl).elim
  all_goals try exact (hyz rfl).elim
  all_goals simp only [kreinGraph, kreinAdj, not_true_eq_false] at nxy nxz nyz
  all_goals simp only [ne_eq, Option.some.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq] at hxy hxz hyz
  all_goals rw [Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  all_goals simp only [kreinMatrix, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, one_mul,
    zero_add, add_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · change (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) c d = 3
    rw [D.incidence_block_gram_apply, D.block_intersection_three hyz nyz]
    norm_num
  · rw [D.incidence_triple_sum]
    simp [hxy,hxz,hyz]
  · exact D.point_point_disjoint_triple hxy nxz nyz
  · simpa only [mul_right_comm] using D.point_point_disjoint_triple hxz nxy nyz
  · exact D.point_disjoint_disjoint_triple nxy nxz (D.block_intersection_three hyz nyz)
  · change (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) b d = 3
    rw [D.incidence_block_gram_apply, D.block_intersection_three hxz nxz]
    norm_num
  · simpa only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using D.point_point_disjoint_triple hyz nxy nxz
  · simpa only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      D.point_disjoint_disjoint_triple nxy nyz (D.block_intersection_three hxz nxz)
  · change (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) b c = 3
    rw [D.incidence_block_gram_apply, D.block_intersection_three hxy nxy]
    norm_num
  · simpa only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      D.point_disjoint_disjoint_triple nxz nyz (D.block_intersection_three hxy nxy)
  · have hinc : (∑ p, D.incidence p b * D.incidence p c * D.incidence p d) =
        ((D.block b ∩ D.block c ∩ D.block d).card : ℤ) := by
      simp [incidence, Finset.inter_comm, Finset.inter_assoc]
    rw [hinc,add_comm]
    exact D.three_disjoint_triple_complement hxy hxz hyz
      (D.block_intersection_three hxy nxy) (D.block_intersection_three hxz nxz)
      (D.block_intersection_three hyz nyz)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independent_triple_commonNeighbors
statement:
theorem independent_triple_commonNeighbors (x y z : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B))
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z)
    (nxy : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) (nxz : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x z)
    (nyz : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun w => D.kreinGraph.Adj x w ∧
      D.kreinGraph.Adj y w ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj z w).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.independent_triple_neighbor_moment x y z hxy hxz hyz nxy nxz nyz
  rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix] at h
  simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, ite_zero_mul_ite_zero,
    one_mul, Finset.sum_boole, and_assoc] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_pairNeighborhood
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_pairNeighborhood (a u x : V) :
    x ∈ D.pairNeighborhood a u ↔ D.kreinGraph.Adj a x ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj u x
proof: := by simp [pairNeighborhood]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.pairNeighborhood_card
statement:
theorem pairNeighborhood_card {a u : V} (hne : a ≠ u) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj a u) :
    (D.pairNeighborhood a u).card = 12
proof: := D.commonCount_univ hne hn

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.pairNeighborhood_independent
statement: theorem pairNeighborhood_independent (a u : V) : D.IndependentSet (D.pairNeighborhood a u)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy _ hxy
  exact D.no_triangle ((D.mem_pairNeighborhood a u x).mp hx).1
    ((D.mem_pairNeighborhood a u y).mp hy).1 hxy

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_crownSlice
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_crownSlice (W : Finset V) (a u x : V) :
    x ∈ D.crownSlice W a u ↔ x ∈ W ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj a x ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj u x
proof:
:= by
  simp [crownSlice]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownSlice_card_of_triple
statement:
theorem crownSlice_card_of_triple {W T : Finset V} {a u : V} (hW : D.IsCrown W)
    (hT : T.card = 3) (hTW : T ⊆ W) (hTX : T ⊆ D.pairNeighborhood a u) (hne : a ≠ u) :
    (D.crownSlice W a u).card = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hTI := D.independentSet_mono hTX (D.pairNeighborhood_independent a u)
  have ha : a ∈ D.commonTo T := (D.mem_commonTo T a).mpr (by
    intro x hx
    exact (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm a x).mp ((D.mem_pairNeighborhood a u x).mp (hTX hx)).1)
  have hu : u ∈ D.commonTo T := (D.mem_commonTo T u).mpr (by
    intro x hx
    exact (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm u x).mp ((D.mem_pairNeighborhood a u x).mp (hTX hx)).2)
  obtain ⟨L,R,h,rfl⟩ := hW
  change D.commonCount (L ∪ R) a u = 4
  rcases D.crown_independent_triple_one_part h hT hTI hTW with hTL | hTR
  · rw [D.crown_commonTo_triple h hT hTL] at ha hu
    simpa only [Finset.union_comm] using D.crown_commonCount_pair (D.crownParts_symm h)
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).1 (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hu).1 hne
  · rw [D.crown_commonTo_triple (D.crownParts_symm h) hT hTR] at ha hu
    exact D.crown_commonCount_pair h (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).1 (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hu).1 hne

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_steinerBlocks
statement:
theorem mem_steinerBlocks (a u : V) (Q : Finset V) :
    Q ∈ D.steinerBlocks a u ↔ (Q ⊆ D.pairNeighborhood a u ∧ Q.card = 4) ∧
      ∃ W : Finset V, D.IsCrown W ∧ Q = D.crownSlice W a u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [steinerBlocks]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.steinerBlocks_triple
statement:
theorem steinerBlocks_triple {a u : V} (hne : a ≠ u) (T : Finset V)
    (hTX : T ⊆ D.pairNeighborhood a u) (hT : T.card = 3) :
    ((D.steinerBlocks a u).filter fun Q => T ⊆ Q).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hTI := D.independentSet_mono hTX (D.pairNeighborhood_independent a u)
  obtain ⟨W,hW,hTW⟩ := D.exists_crown_of_independent_triple hT hTI
  let Q := D.crownSlice W a u
  have hQcard : Q.card = 4 := D.crownSlice_card_of_triple hW hT hTW hTX hne
  have hQX : Q ⊆ D.pairNeighborhood a u := by
    intro x hx
    exact (D.mem_pairNeighborhood a u x).mpr ((D.mem_crownSlice W a u x).mp hx).2
  have hTQ : T ⊆ Q := by
    intro x hx
    exact (D.mem_crownSlice W a u x).mpr ⟨hTW hx,(D.mem_pairNeighborhood a u x).mp (hTX hx)⟩
  have hQmem : Q ∈ D.steinerBlocks a u := (D.mem_steinerBlocks a u Q).mpr
    ⟨⟨hQX,hQcard⟩,W,hW,rfl⟩
  have heq : (D.steinerBlocks a u).filter (fun B => T ⊆ B) = {Q} := by
    ext B
    constructor
    · intro hB
      obtain ⟨hBmem,hTB⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hB
      obtain ⟨_,Z,hZ,hBeq⟩ := (D.mem_steinerBlocks a u B).mp hBmem
      have hTZ : T ⊆ Z := by
        intro x hx
        have hxb := hTB hx
        rw [hBeq] at hxb
        exact ((D.mem_crownSlice Z a u x).mp hxb).1
      have hZW := D.crowns_eq_of_containing_triple hZ hW hT hTI hTZ hTW
      have hBQ : B = Q := by rw [hBeq,hZW]
      simp [hBQ]
    · intro hB
      have hBQ := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hB
      subst B
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hQmem,hTQ⟩
  rw [heq]
  simp

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.contradiction_of_nonadjacent_pair
statement:
theorem contradiction_of_nonadjacent_pair {a u : V} (hne : a ≠ u)
    (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj a u) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply no_steinerQuadruple_on12 (D.pairNeighborhood a u) (D.pairNeighborhood_card hne hn)
    (D.steinerBlocks a u)
  · intro Q hQ
    exact ((D.mem_steinerBlocks a u Q).mp hQ).1.2
  · intro Q hQ
    exact ((D.mem_steinerBlocks a u Q).mp hQ).1.1
  · intro T hTX hT
    exact D.steinerBlocks_triple hne T hTX hT

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.no_tripleDesign57
statement: theorem no_tripleDesign57 (D : TripleDesign57 P B) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hSI⟩ := D.exists_independent_three none
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,hab,_,_,hSeq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hS
  have ha : a ∈ S := by rw [hSeq]; simp
  have hb : b ∈ S := by rw [hSeq]; simp
  exact D.contradiction_of_nonadjacent_pair hab (hSI a ha b hb hab)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.no_concreteQSD56
statement: theorem no_concreteQSD56 (Q : ConcreteQSD56) : False
proof: := Q.toTripleDesign57.no_tripleDesign57

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.no_quasi_symmetric_design
statement: theorem no_quasi_symmetric_design : NoQuasiSymmetricDesign56.{u}
proof:
:=
  noQuasiSymmetricDesign56_of_concrete ⟨ConcreteQSD56.no_concreteQSD56⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_row_sum
statement: theorem incidence_row_sum (p : P) : ∑ b, D.incidence p b = 56
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidence, Finset.sum_boole, D.replication]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_column_sum
statement: theorem incidence_column_sum (b : B) : ∑ p, D.incidence p b = 12
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidence, D.block_size]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_point_gram_apply
statement:
theorem incidence_point_gram_apply (p q : P) :
    (D.incidence * D.incidence.transpose) p q = if p = q then 56 else 11
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, incidence,
    ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, one_mul, Finset.sum_boole]
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    simp [D.replication]
  · rw [D.point_pair p q hpq, if_neg hpq]
    norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_point_gram
statement:
theorem incidence_point_gram :
    D.incidence * D.incidence.transpose =
      (45 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix P P ℤ) + (11 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext p q
  rw [D.incidence_point_gram_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, allOnesMatrix_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, mul_one]
  by_cases hpq : p = q <;> simp [hpq]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_block_gram_apply
statement:
theorem incidence_block_gram_apply (b c : B) :
    (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) b c = (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, incidence, Finset.inter_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_diag
statement: theorem disjointness_diag (b : B) : D.disjointness b b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [disjointness, D.block_size]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_comm
statement: theorem disjointness_comm (b c : B) : D.disjointness b c = D.disjointness c b
proof:
:= by
  simp [disjointness, Finset.inter_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_block_gram
statement:
theorem incidence_block_gram :
    D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence =
      (9 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix B B ℤ) + (3 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix -
        (3 : ℤ) • D.disjointness
proof:
:= by
  ext b c
  rw [D.incidence_block_gram_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    allOnesMatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply, mul_one]
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst c
    simp [D.disjointness_diag, D.block_size]
  · rcases D.block_intersections b c hbc with hz | ht
    · simp [hz, disjointness, hbc]
    · simp [ht, disjointness, hbc]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_mul_ones
statement:
theorem incidence_mul_ones :
    D.incidence * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) =
      (56 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext p b
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix] using D.incidence_row_sum p

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.ones_mul_incidence
statement:
theorem ones_mul_incidence :
    (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P P ℤ) * D.incidence =
      (12 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext p b
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix] using D.incidence_column_sum b

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_transpose_mul_rect_ones
statement:
theorem incidence_transpose_mul_rect_ones :
    D.incidence.transpose * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ) =
      (12 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext b c
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix] using D.incidence_column_sum b

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_row_sum
statement: theorem disjointness_row_sum (b : B) : ∑ c, D.disjointness b c = 45
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) *
      (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) = (672 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, D.incidence_mul_ones, Matrix.mul_smul,
      D.incidence_transpose_mul_rect_ones]
    module
  rw [D.incidence_block_gram] at hgram
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hgram b) b
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, allOnesMatrix_apply, mul_one, Matrix.one_apply,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h
  simp [D.index_card] at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_mul_ones
statement:
theorem disjointness_mul_ones : D.disjointness * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) =
    (45 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext b c
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix] using D.disjointness_row_sum b

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.ones_mul_disjointness
statement:
theorem ones_mul_disjointness : (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) * D.disjointness =
    (45 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext b c
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix, D.disjointness_comm c] using D.disjointness_row_sum c

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_mul_disjointness
statement:
theorem incidence_mul_disjointness : D.incidence * D.disjointness =
    (12 : ℤ) • ((allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ) - D.incidence)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.mul_assoc D.incidence D.incidence.transpose D.incidence
  rw [D.incidence_point_gram, D.incidence_block_gram] at h
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_sub,
    Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, D.ones_mul_incidence,
    D.incidence_mul_ones] at h
  ext p b
  have he := congrFun (congrFun h p) b
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, allOnesMatrix_apply] at he ⊢
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.block_gram_square
statement:
theorem block_gram_square :
    (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) * (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) =
      (45 : ℤ) • (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) +
        (1584 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have houter : D.incidence.transpose * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P P ℤ) * D.incidence =
      (144 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, D.ones_mul_incidence, Matrix.mul_smul,
      D.incidence_transpose_mul_rect_ones]
    module
  calc
    _ = D.incidence.transpose * (D.incidence * D.incidence.transpose) * D.incidence := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [D.incidence_point_gram, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul,
        Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, houter]
      module

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_square
statement:
theorem disjointness_square : D.disjointness * D.disjointness =
    (36 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix B B ℤ) - (9 : ℤ) • D.disjointness +
      (9 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  let S := D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence
  let A := D.disjointness
  let J : Matrix B B ℤ := allOnesMatrix
  have htarget : S = (9 : ℤ) • 1 + (3 : ℤ) • J - (3 : ℤ) • A := D.incidence_block_gram
  have hSS : S * S = (45 : ℤ) • S + (1584 : ℤ) • J := D.block_gram_square
  have hAJ : A * J = (45 : ℤ) • J := D.disjointness_mul_ones
  have hJA : J * A = (45 : ℤ) • J := D.ones_mul_disjointness
  have hJJ : J * J = (266 : ℤ) • J := by
    ext b c
    simp [J, Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix, D.index_card]
  have hscaled : (9 : ℤ) • (A * A) - (324 : ℤ) • 1 +
      (81 : ℤ) • A - (81 : ℤ) • J = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = S * S - (45 : ℤ) • S - (1584 : ℤ) • J := by
        rw [htarget]
        noncomm_ring [hAJ, hJA, hJJ]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hSS]; module
  ext b c
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hscaled b) c
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] at h ⊢
  change (A * A) b c = 36 * (1 : Matrix B B ℤ) b c - 9 * A b c + 9 * J b c
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinGraph_adjMatrix
statement: theorem kreinGraph_adjMatrix : D.kreinGraph.adjMatrix ℤ = D.kreinMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  rcases x with _ | (p | b) <;> rcases y with _ | (q | c) <;>
    simp [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, kreinGraph, kreinAdj, kreinMatrix, incidence, disjointness]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinMatrix_square_apply
statement:
theorem kreinMatrix_square_apply (x y : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B)) :
    (D.kreinMatrix * D.kreinMatrix) x y =
      45 * (if x = y then 1 else 0) + 12 - 12 * D.kreinMatrix x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  rcases x with _ | (p | b) <;> rcases y with _ | (q | c)
  all_goals simp only [kreinMatrix, mul_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, one_mul,
    zero_add, add_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · simp [D.point_card]
  · simp
  · simpa using D.incidence_column_sum c
  · simp
  · have h := D.incidence_point_gram_apply p q
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
    rw [h]
    by_cases hpq : p = q <;> simp [hpq]
  · have h := congrFun (congrFun D.incidence_mul_disjointness p) c
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Matrix.sub_apply, allOnesMatrix, mul_sub] using h
  · simpa using D.incidence_column_sum b
  · have h := congrFun (congrFun D.incidence_mul_disjointness q) b
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Matrix.sub_apply, allOnesMatrix, mul_sub, D.disjointness_comm b, mul_comm] using h
  · have hG := congrFun (congrFun D.incidence_block_gram b) c
    have hA := congrFun (congrFun D.disjointness_square b) c
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, allOnesMatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply] at hG hA
    rw [hG, hA]
    by_cases hbc : b = c <;> simp [hbc] <;> ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinMatrix_square_commonNeighbors
statement:
theorem kreinMatrix_square_commonNeighbors (x y : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B)) :
    (D.kreinMatrix * D.kreinMatrix) x y =
      (Fintype.card (D.kreinGraph.commonNeighbors x y) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hsym : ∀ z, D.kreinGraph.Adj z y ↔ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z :=
    fun z => D.kreinGraph.adj_comm z y
  simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, hsym, ite_zero_mul_ite_zero,
    one_mul, Finset.sum_boole]
  norm_cast
  rw [← Set.toFinset_card]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp [SimpleGraph.mem_commonNeighbors]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinGraph_degree
statement:
theorem kreinGraph_degree (x : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B)) :
    D.kreinGraph.degree x = 57
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.kreinMatrix_square_apply x x
  rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_mul_self_apply_self] at h
  simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, SimpleGraph.irrefl, if_false,
    if_true, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinGraph_isSRGWith
statement:
theorem kreinGraph_isSRGWith : D.kreinGraph.IsSRGWith 324 57 0 12 where
  card
proof:
:= by simp [KreinVertex, D.point_card, D.index_card]
  regular := D.kreinGraph_degree
  of_adj := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hne := D.kreinGraph.ne_of_adj hxy
    have hM : D.kreinMatrix x y = 1 := by
      rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, if_pos hxy]
    have h := D.kreinMatrix_square_apply x y
    rw [D.kreinMatrix_square_commonNeighbors, if_neg hne, hM] at h
    have hi : (Fintype.card (D.kreinGraph.commonNeighbors x y) : ℤ) = 0 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hi
  of_not_adj := by
    intro x y hne hxy
    have hM : D.kreinMatrix x y = 0 := by
      rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, if_neg hxy]
    have h := D.kreinMatrix_square_apply x y
    rw [D.kreinMatrix_square_commonNeighbors, if_neg hne, hM] at h
    have hi : (Fintype.card (D.kreinGraph.commonNeighbors x y) : ℤ) = 12 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hi

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.kreinGraph_isSRGWith
statement:
theorem kreinGraph_isSRGWith (Q : ConcreteQSD56) :
    Q.toTripleDesign57.kreinGraph.IsSRGWith 324 57 0 12
proof:
:=
  Q.toTripleDesign57.kreinGraph_isSRGWith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownParts_symm
statement: theorem crownParts_symm {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) : D.CrownParts R L
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.right_card,h.left_card,h.disjoint.symm,h.right_independent,h.left_independent,
    h.right_degree,h.left_degree⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_left_missing
statement:
theorem crown_left_missing {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ L) : (R.filter fun y => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := R) (p := fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y)
  change D.neighborCount R x + (R.filter fun y => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y).card = R.card at hsum
  rw [h.left_degree x hx, h.right_card] at hsum
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_missing_exists
statement:
theorem crown_missing_exists {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ L) : ∃ y, y ∈ R ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y
proof:
:= by
  have hc := D.crown_left_missing h hx
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (R.filter fun y => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y).card)
  exact ⟨y,(Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1,(Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownMate_spec
statement:
theorem crownMate_spec {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ L) :
    D.crownMate h x ∈ R ∧ ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x (D.crownMate h x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [crownMate, dif_pos hx]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (D.crown_missing_exists h hx)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownMate_unique
statement:
theorem crownMate_unique {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ L) (hy : y ∈ R) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) : y = D.crownMate h x
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (R.filter fun z => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x z).card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [D.crown_left_missing h hx]
  exact Finset.card_le_one.mp hc y (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy,hn⟩)
    (D.crownMate h x) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr (D.crownMate_spec h hx))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownMate_injOn
statement:
theorem crownMate_injOn {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) :
    Set.InjOn (D.crownMate h) L
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy heq
  have hmx := D.crownMate_spec h hx
  have hmy := D.crownMate_spec h hy
  rw [← heq] at hmy
  have hc : (L.filter fun z => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj (D.crownMate h x) z).card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [D.crown_left_missing (D.crownParts_symm h) hmx.1]
  exact Finset.card_le_one.mp hc x
    (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx,fun ha => hmx.2 ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm _ _).mp ha)⟩) y
    (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy,fun ha => hmy.2 ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm _ _).mp ha)⟩)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownMate_image_subset
statement:
theorem crownMate_image_subset {L R T : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) (hTL : T ⊆ L) :
    T.image (D.crownMate h) ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
  exact (D.crownMate_spec h (hTL hx)).1

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownMate_image_card
statement:
theorem crownMate_image_card {L R T : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) (hTL : T ⊆ L) :
    (T.image (D.crownMate h)).card = T.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_image_of_injOn (fun _ hx _ hy heq => D.crownMate_injOn h (hTL hx) (hTL hy) heq)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownMate_image_all
statement:
theorem crownMate_image_all {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) :
    L.image (D.crownMate h) = R
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (D.crownMate_image_subset h Finset.Subset.rfl)
  rw [D.crownMate_image_card h Finset.Subset.rfl, h.left_card, h.right_card]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_adj_iff
statement:
theorem crown_adj_iff {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) {x y : V}
    (hx : x ∈ L) (hy : y ∈ R) : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y ↔ y ≠ D.crownMate h x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha heq
    exact (D.crownMate_spec h hx).2 (heq ▸ ha)
  · intro hne
    by_contra hn
    exact hne (D.crownMate_unique h hx hy hn)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_commonTo_triple
statement:
theorem crown_commonTo_triple {L R T : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R)
    (hT : T.card = 3) (hTL : T ⊆ L) :
    D.commonTo T = R \ T.image (D.crownMate h)
proof:
:= by
  have hTI := D.independentSet_mono hTL h.left_independent
  have hc : (R \ T.image (D.crownMate h)).card = 3 := by
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (D.crownMate_image_subset h hTL),
      h.right_card, D.crownMate_image_card h hTL, hT]
  have hsub : R \ T.image (D.crownMate h) ⊆ D.commonTo T := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hyR,hyF⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
    apply (D.mem_commonTo T y).mpr
    intro x hx
    apply (D.crown_adj_iff h (hTL hx) hyR).mpr
    intro heq
    exact hyF (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x,hx,heq.symm⟩)
  exact (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [D.commonTo_card hT hTI, hc])).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_commonCount_pair
statement:
theorem crown_commonCount_pair {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ L) (hy : y ∈ L) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    D.commonCount (L ∪ R) x y = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hmxy : D.crownMate h x ≠ D.crownMate h y := fun heq => hxy (D.crownMate_injOn h hx hy heq)
  have hsub : {D.crownMate h x,D.crownMate h y} ⊆ R := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · rw [hz]; exact (D.crownMate_spec h hx).1
    · rw [hz]; exact (D.crownMate_spec h hy).1
  have heq : (L ∪ R).filter (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z) =
      R \ {D.crownMate h x,D.crownMate h y} := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨hzW,hxz,hyz⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hz
      have hzR : z ∈ R := by
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hzW with hzL | hzR
        · exact (h.left_independent x hx z hzL (D.kreinGraph.ne_of_adj hxz) hxz).elim
        · exact hzR
      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hzR,?_⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or]
      exact ⟨(D.crown_adj_iff h hx hzR).mp hxz,(D.crown_adj_iff h hy hzR).mp hyz⟩
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨hzR,hznot⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hz
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] at hznot
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_union_right _ hzR,
        (D.crown_adj_iff h hx hzR).mpr hznot.1,(D.crown_adj_iff h hy hzR).mpr hznot.2⟩
  rw [commonCount, heq, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub, h.right_card]
  simp [hmxy]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_union
statement:
theorem neighborCount_union (T U : Finset V) (hd : Disjoint T U) (x : V) :
    D.neighborCount (T ∪ U) x = D.neighborCount T x + D.neighborCount U x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [neighborCount, Finset.filter_union]
  exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
    (hd.mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (Finset.filter_subset _ _))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubicLeft_card
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubicLeft_card {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) : (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S).card = 54
proof:
:= by
  rw [bicliqueCubicLeft, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0),
    D.biclique_card hcard hI, (D.bicliqueClass_card hcard hI).1]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubicLeft_degrees
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubicLeft_degrees {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) :
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x = 3 ∧ D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x = 18
proof:
:= by
  have hu := D.neighborCount_union (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0) x
  change D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x = _ at hu
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxD | hx0
  · have hd := D.biclique_inside_degrees hcard hI hxD
    have ht := D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hxD
    omega
  · obtain ⟨hxD,ht⟩ := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 x).mp hx0
    have hd := D.biclique_local_degrees hcard hI hxD
    simp only [ht, if_true, zero_ne_one, if_false] at hd
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubicRight_degrees
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubicRight_degrees {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) :
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x = 3 ∧ D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x = 18
proof:
:= by
  have hu := D.neighborCount_union (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0) x
  change D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x = _ at hu
  obtain ⟨hxD,ht⟩ := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp hx
  have hd := D.biclique_local_degrees hcard hI hxD
  norm_num [ht] at hd
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_square
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_square (T : Finset V) (x y : T) :
    (D.setAdjMatrix T * D.setAdjMatrix T) x y = D.commonCount T x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, setAdjMatrix]
  simp_rw [D.kreinMatrix_comm _ (y : V)]
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort T (fun w : V => D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w)]
  exact (D.commonCount_cast T x y).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crossAdjMatrix_gram_left
statement:
theorem crossAdjMatrix_gram_left (T U : Finset V) (x y : T) :
    (D.crossAdjMatrix T U * (D.crossAdjMatrix T U).transpose) x y = D.commonCount U x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, crossAdjMatrix]
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort U (fun w : V => D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w)]
  exact (D.commonCount_cast U x y).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crossAdjMatrix_transpose
statement:
theorem crossAdjMatrix_transpose (T U : Finset V) :
    (D.crossAdjMatrix T U).transpose = D.crossAdjMatrix U T
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  exact D.kreinMatrix_comm y x

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_of_adj
statement:
theorem commonCount_of_adj (T : Finset V) {x y : V} (hxy : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.commonCount T x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨_, hxw, hyw⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hw
  exact D.no_triangle hxy hxw hyw

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crossAdjMatrix_gram_of_common
statement:
theorem crossAdjMatrix_gram_of_common (T U : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3 ∧ D.neighborCount U x = 18)
    (hcom : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, x ≠ y → ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y →
      D.commonCount U x y = 6 + D.commonCount T x y) :
    D.crossAdjMatrix T U * (D.crossAdjMatrix T U).transpose =
      (D.setAdjMatrix T - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (D.setAdjMatrix T - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix =
      D.setAdjMatrix T * D.setAdjMatrix T - (6 : ℤ) • D.setAdjMatrix T +
        (9 : ℤ) • 1 + (6 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix := by noncomm_ring
  rw [hp]
  ext x y
  rw [D.crossAdjMatrix_gram_left]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Matrix.one_apply, allOnesMatrix_apply, D.setAdjMatrix_square, setAdjMatrix]
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    rw [D.commonCount_self, D.commonCount_self, (hdeg x x.property).1,
      (hdeg x x.property).2]
    simp [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  · have hval : (x : V) ≠ (y : V) := fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h)
    by_cases ha : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y
    · rw [D.commonCount_of_adj U ha, D.commonCount_of_adj T ha]
      simp [hxy, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, ha]
    · rw [hcom x x.property y y.property hval ha]
      simp [hxy, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, ha, add_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubic_gram_left
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubic_gram_left {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    D.crossAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) (D.bicliqueClass S 2) *
      (D.crossAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) (D.bicliqueClass S 2)).transpose =
    (D.setAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  apply D.crossAdjMatrix_gram_of_common
  · intro x hx
    exact D.bicliqueCubicLeft_degrees hcard hI hx
  · intro x hx y hy hxy hn
    exact D.bicliqueCubicLeft_common hcard hI hx hy hxy hn

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubic_gram_right
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubic_gram_right {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    (D.crossAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) (D.bicliqueClass S 2)).transpose *
      D.crossAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) (D.bicliqueClass S 2) =
    (D.setAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueClass S 2) - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.crossAdjMatrix_gram_of_common (D.bicliqueClass S 2) (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S)
    (fun x hx => D.bicliqueCubicRight_degrees hcard hI hx)
    (fun x hx y hy hxy hn => D.bicliqueCubicRight_common hcard hI hx hy hxy hn)
  simpa only [D.crossAdjMatrix_transpose] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_independent_triple_one_part
statement:
theorem crown_independent_triple_one_part {L R T : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R)
    (hT : T.card = 3) (hTI : D.IndependentSet T) (hsub : T ⊆ L ∪ R) : T ⊆ L ∨ T ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hTL : T ⊆ L
  · exact Or.inl hTL
  · by_cases hTR : T ⊆ R
    · exact Or.inr hTR
    · obtain ⟨x,hxT,hxR⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hTR
      obtain ⟨y,hyT,hyL⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hTL
      have hxL : x ∈ L := (Finset.mem_union.mp (hsub hxT)).resolve_right hxR
      have hyR : y ∈ R := (Finset.mem_union.mp (hsub hyT)).resolve_left hyL
      have hLsub : T ∩ L ⊆ L.filter (fun z => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z) := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hzT,hzL⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hz
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzL,fun ha => hTI y hyT z hzT (D.kreinGraph.ne_of_adj ha) ha⟩
      have hRsub : T ∩ R ⊆ R.filter (fun z => ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hzT,hzR⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hz
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzR,fun ha => hTI x hxT z hzT (D.kreinGraph.ne_of_adj ha) ha⟩
      have hLc := Finset.card_le_card hLsub
      have hRc := Finset.card_le_card hRsub
      rw [D.crown_left_missing (D.crownParts_symm h) hyR] at hLc
      rw [D.crown_left_missing h hxL] at hRc
      have heq : T = (T ∩ L) ∪ (T ∩ R) := by
        ext z
        have hz := @hsub z
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter] at hz ⊢
        tauto
      have hdis : Disjoint (T ∩ L) (T ∩ R) := h.disjoint.mono Finset.inter_subset_right Finset.inter_subset_right
      have hc := congrArg Finset.card heq
      rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdis] at hc
      omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_degree
statement:
theorem crown_degree {L R : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ L ∪ R) :
    D.neighborCount (L ∪ R) x = 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.neighborCount_union _ _ h.disjoint]
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxL | hxR
  · rw [D.independent_neighborCount_zero h.left_independent hxL,h.left_degree x hxL]
  · rw [D.independent_neighborCount_zero h.right_independent hxR,h.right_degree x hxR]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_decomposition_left
statement:
theorem crown_decomposition_left {L R T : Finset V} (h : D.CrownParts L R)
    (hT : T.card = 3) (hTL : T ⊆ L) : ∃ B : Finset V,
      D.IsBiclique B ∧ B ⊆ D.bicliqueClass T 2 ∧ L ∪ R = (T ∪ D.commonTo T) ∪ B
proof:
:= by
  let F := T.image (D.crownMate h)
  let U := L \ T
  have hFsub : F ⊆ R := D.crownMate_image_subset h hTL
  have hFcard : F.card = 3 := (D.crownMate_image_card h hTL).trans hT
  have hUcard : U.card = 3 := by rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hTL,h.left_card,hT]
  have hUI : D.IndependentSet U := D.independentSet_mono Finset.sdiff_subset h.left_independent
  have hCT : D.commonTo T = R \ F := D.crown_commonTo_triple h hT hTL
  have hFU : F ⊆ D.commonTo U := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    apply (D.mem_commonTo U (D.crownMate h a)).mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxL,hxT⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx
    apply (D.crown_adj_iff h hxL (D.crownMate_spec h (hTL ha)).1).mpr
    intro heq
    have hax := D.crownMate_injOn h (hTL ha) hxL heq
    exact hxT (hax ▸ ha)
  have hCU : D.commonTo U = F :=
    (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hFU (by rw [D.commonTo_card hUcard hUI,hFcard])).symm
  have hcover : (T ∪ D.commonTo T) ∪ (U ∪ D.commonTo U) = L ∪ R := by
    rw [hCT,hCU]
    ext z
    have ht : z ∈ T → z ∈ L := fun hz => hTL hz
    have hf : z ∈ F → z ∈ R := fun hz => hFsub hz
    simp only [U,Finset.mem_union,Finset.mem_sdiff]
    tauto
  have hdis : Disjoint (T ∪ D.commonTo T) (U ∪ D.commonTo U) := by
    rw [hCT,hCU]
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz0 hz1
    have ht : z ∈ T → z ∈ L := fun hz => hTL hz
    have hf : z ∈ F → z ∈ R := fun hz => hFsub hz
    have hn : ¬ (z ∈ L ∧ z ∈ R) := fun hz => Finset.disjoint_left.mp h.disjoint hz.1 hz.2
    simp only [U,Finset.mem_union,Finset.mem_sdiff] at hz0 hz1
    tauto
  have hsub : U ∪ D.commonTo U ⊆ D.bicliqueClass T 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ L ∪ R := hcover ▸ Finset.mem_union_right _ hx
    have hd := D.crown_degree h hxW
    rw [← hcover,D.neighborCount_union _ _ hdis,D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hUcard hUI hx] at hd
    apply (D.mem_bicliqueClass T 2 x).mpr
    exact ⟨fun hxT => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis hxT hx,by omega⟩
  exact ⟨U ∪ D.commonTo U,⟨U,hUcard,hUI,rfl⟩,hsub,hcover.symm⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crown_decomposition
statement:
theorem crown_decomposition {W T : Finset V} (hW : D.IsCrown W)
    (hT : T.card = 3) (hTI : D.IndependentSet T) (hsub : T ⊆ W) : ∃ B : Finset V,
      D.IsBiclique B ∧ B ⊆ D.bicliqueClass T 2 ∧ W = (T ∪ D.commonTo T) ∪ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L,R,h,rfl⟩ := hW
  rcases D.crown_independent_triple_one_part h hT hTI hsub with hTL | hTR
  · exact D.crown_decomposition_left h hT hTL
  · simpa only [Finset.union_comm] using D.crown_decomposition_left (D.crownParts_symm h) hT hTR

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crowns_eq_of_containing_triple
statement:
theorem crowns_eq_of_containing_triple {W Z T : Finset V} (hW : D.IsCrown W)
    (hZ : D.IsCrown Z) (hT : T.card = 3) (hTI : D.IndependentSet T)
    (hTW : T ⊆ W) (hTZ : T ⊆ Z) : W = Z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hBX,hWeq⟩ := D.crown_decomposition hW hT hTI hTW
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hCX,hZeq⟩ := D.crown_decomposition hZ hT hTI hTZ
  have hBC := D.bicliques_in_class_two_eq hT hTI hB hC hBX hCX
  rw [hWeq,hZeq,hBC]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.exists_unique_crown_of_independent_triple
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W,hW,hTW⟩ := D.exists_crown_of_independent_triple hT hTI
  refine ⟨W,⟨hW,hTW⟩,?_⟩
  intro Z hZ
  exact D.crowns_eq_of_containing_triple hZ.1 hW hT hTI hZ.2 hTW

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_le_neighborCount
statement:
theorem commonCount_le_neighborCount (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :
    D.commonCount T x y ≤ D.neighborCount T x
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨hzT,hxz,_⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hz
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzT,hxz⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_mono
statement:
theorem commonCount_mono {T U : Finset V} (hTU : T ⊆ U) (x y : V) :
    D.commonCount T x y ≤ D.commonCount U x y
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hTU)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_eq_inter
statement:
theorem commonCount_eq_inter (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :
    D.commonCount T x y =
      ((T.filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) ∩ (T.filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj y z)).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold commonCount
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_inter]
  tauto

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighbor_pair_count_bound
statement:
theorem neighbor_pair_count_bound (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :
    D.neighborCount T x + D.neighborCount T y ≤ T.card + D.commonCount T x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter
    (T.filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) (T.filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj y z)
  have hb : ((T.filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) ∪
      (T.filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj y z)).card ≤ T.card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (Finset.union_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (Finset.filter_subset _ _))
  rw [← D.commonCount_eq_inter] at h
  change _ + D.commonCount T x y = D.neighborCount T x + D.neighborCount T y at h
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_two_sides
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_two_sides {S : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) :
    (D.neighborCount S x = 2 ∧ D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x = 0) ∨
    (D.neighborCount S x = 0 ∧ D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) x = 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp hx |>.2
  rw [D.biclique_neighborCount_split] at hs
  have hp := D.biclique_neighborCount_product_zero S x
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with hl | hr <;> omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hxy : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.neighborCount S x + D.neighborCount S y = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hL := D.neighbor_pair_count_bound S x y
  have hR := D.neighbor_pair_count_bound (D.commonTo S) x y
  rw [D.commonCount_of_adj S hxy, hcard] at hL
  rw [D.commonCount_of_adj (D.commonTo S) hxy, D.commonTo_card hcard hI] at hR
  rcases D.bicliqueClass_two_sides hx with hxl | hxr <;>
    rcases D.bicliqueClass_two_sides hy with hyl | hyr <;> omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_two_common_delta_pos
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_two_common_delta_pos {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hp : 0 < D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y) :
    0 < D.commonCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hp
  obtain ⟨hf2,hxf,hyf⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
  have heX := D.bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces hcard hI hx hf2 hxf
  have heY := D.bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces hcard hI hy hf2 hyf
  have hsY := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 y).mp hy |>.2
  rw [D.biclique_neighborCount_split] at hsY
  rcases D.bicliqueClass_two_sides hx with hl | hr
  · have hb := D.neighbor_pair_count_bound S x y
    rw [hcard] at hb
    have hm := D.commonCount_mono (Finset.subset_union_left : S ⊆ S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y
    omega
  · have hb := D.neighbor_pair_count_bound (D.commonTo S) x y
    rw [D.commonTo_card hcard hI] at hb
    have hm := D.commonCount_mono
      (Finset.subset_union_right : D.commonTo S ⊆ S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.zeroNeighborUnion_count
statement:
theorem zeroNeighborUnion_count {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    (D.zeroNeighborUnion S x y).card + (6 + D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y) =
      32 + D.commonCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hc := D.bicliqueCubicRight_common hcard hI hx hy hxy hn
  have hu := D.commonCount_union (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0) x y
  change D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y = _ at hu
  have hxD := D.biclique_local_degrees hcard hI ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp hx).1
  have hyD := D.biclique_local_degrees hcard hI ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 y).mp hy).1
  norm_num [(D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp hx |>.2] at hxD
  norm_num [(D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 y).mp hy |>.2] at hyD
  have hcount := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter
    ((D.bicliqueClass S 0).filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z)
    ((D.bicliqueClass S 0).filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj y z)
  rw [← D.commonCount_eq_inter] at hcount
  change (D.zeroNeighborUnion S x y).card + D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x y =
    D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x + D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) y at hcount
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.two_common_of_square
statement:
theorem two_common_of_square {S : Finset V} {x y f g : V}
    (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hxf : D.kreinGraph.Adj x f) (hxg : D.kreinGraph.Adj x g)
    (hyf : D.kreinGraph.Adj y f) (hyg : D.kreinGraph.Adj y g) :
    2 ≤ D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) f g
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : {x,y} ⊆ (D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter
      (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj f z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj g z) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · subst z
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x f).mp hxf,
        (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x g).mp hxg⟩
    · subst z
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy, (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y f).mp hyf,
        (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y g).mp hyg⟩
  have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  simpa [hxy, commonCount] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_two_common_three
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_two_common_three {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (hcommon : 2 ≤ D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y) :
    D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hupper := D.commonCount_le_neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y
  rw [D.bicliqueClass_two_degree_self hcard hI hx] at hupper
  by_contra hnot3
  have ht : D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y = 2 := by omega
  have hcardF : 1 < ((D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter
      fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z).card := by
    change 1 < D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y
    omega
  obtain ⟨f,hf,g,hg,hfg⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hcardF
  obtain ⟨hf2,hxf,hyf⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
  obtain ⟨hg2,hxg,hyg⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hg
  have hfgcount := D.two_common_of_square hx hy hxy hxf hxg hyf hyg
  have hfgu := D.commonCount_le_neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) f g
  rw [D.bicliqueClass_two_degree_self hcard hI hf2] at hfgu
  have hdx := D.bicliqueClass_two_common_delta_pos hcard hI hx hy (by omega)
  have hdf := D.bicliqueClass_two_common_delta_pos hcard hI hf2 hg2 (by omega)
  have hnxy : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y := fun h => D.no_triangle h hxf hyf
  have hnfg : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj f g := fun h => D.no_triangle hxf hxg h
  have hux := D.zeroNeighborUnion_count hcard hI hx hy hxy hnxy
  have huf := D.zeroNeighborUnion_count hcard hI hf2 hg2 hfg hnfg
  have hdis : Disjoint (D.zeroNeighborUnion S x y) (D.zeroNeighborUnion S f g) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hzl hzr
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hzl with hzx | hzy <;>
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hzr with hzf | hzg
    · exact D.no_triangle hxf (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzx).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzf).2
    · exact D.no_triangle hxg (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzx).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzg).2
    · exact D.no_triangle hyf (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzy).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzf).2
    · exact D.no_triangle hyg (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzy).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hzg).2
  have hsub (a b : V) : D.zeroNeighborUnion S a b ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 0 :=
    Finset.union_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have htotal := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.union_subset (hsub x y) (hsub f g))
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdis, (D.bicliqueClass_card hcard hI).1] at htotal
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.exists_biclique_in_class_two
statement:
theorem exists_biclique_in_class_two {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) : ∃ R : Finset V,
      R.card = 3 ∧ D.IndependentSet R ∧ R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,hxy,hc⟩ := D.bicliqueCubic_right_square hcard hI
  let R := (D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z
  have hR : R.card = 3 := D.bicliqueClass_two_common_three hcard hI hx hy hxy hc
  have hRI : D.IndependentSet R := by
    intro f hf g hg _ hfg
    exact D.no_triangle (Finset.mem_filter.mp hf).2.1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hg).2.1 hfg
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < R.card)
  obtain ⟨hf2,hxf,hyf⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hf
  let E := (D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj f z
  have hE : E.card = 3 := D.bicliqueClass_two_degree_self hcard hI hf2
  have hcross (g) (hg : g ∈ R) : ∀ e ∈ E, D.kreinGraph.Adj g e := by
    obtain ⟨hg2,hxg,hyg⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hg
    by_cases hfg : f = g
    · subst g
      intro e he
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
    · have hfgcount := D.two_common_of_square hx hy hxy hxf hxg hyf hyg
      have hthree := D.bicliqueClass_two_common_three hcard hI hf2 hg2 hfg hfgcount
      have hsub : (D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter
          (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj f z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj g z) ⊆ E := by
        intro e he
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).1,(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2.1⟩
      have heq : (D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter
          (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj f z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj g z) = E :=
        Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by change E.card ≤ D.commonCount _ f g; omega)
      intro e he
      have he' := heq.symm ▸ he
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp he').2.2
  have hsub : E ⊆ D.commonTo R := by
    intro e he
    exact (D.mem_commonTo R e).mpr (fun g hg => hcross g hg e he)
  have heq : E = D.commonTo R :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by rw [D.commonTo_card hR hRI, hE])
  refine ⟨R,hR,hRI,Finset.union_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_⟩
  rw [← heq]
  exact Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_set_card
statement: theorem biclique_set_card {T : Finset V} (hT : D.IsBiclique T) : T.card = 6
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRI,rfl⟩ := hT
  exact D.biclique_card hR hRI

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_in_class_two_closed
statement:
theorem biclique_in_class_two_closed {S T : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hT : D.IsBiclique T) (hsub : T ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ T) (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hxy : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) : y ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRI,rfl⟩ := hT
  have hsmall := D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hR hRI hx
  have hlarge := D.bicliqueClass_two_degree_self hS hSI (hsub hx)
  have hs : (R ∪ D.commonTo R).filter (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) ⊆
      (D.bicliqueClass S 2).filter (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) :=
    Finset.filter_subset_filter _ hsub
  have heq := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hs (by
    change D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x ≤ D.neighborCount (R ∪ D.commonTo R) x
    omega)
  have hmem := heq.symm ▸ Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy,hxy⟩
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).1

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_subset_of_closed
statement:
theorem biclique_subset_of_closed {R A W : Finset V} (hR : R.card = 3)
    (hRI : D.IndependentSet R) (hsub : R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ W)
    (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ W, D.kreinGraph.Adj x y → y ∈ A)
    {z : V} (hzA : z ∈ A) (hzR : z ∈ R ∪ D.commonTo R) : R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  have hRpos : R.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hCpos : (D.commonTo R).Nonempty :=
    Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [D.commonTo_card hR hRI]; omega)
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hzR with hzL | hzC
  · have hCA : D.commonTo R ⊆ A := by
      intro y hy
      exact hclosed z hzA y (hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hy)) ((D.mem_commonTo R y).mp hy z hzL)
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hCpos
    apply Finset.union_subset _ hCA
    intro y hy
    exact hclosed b (hCA hb) y (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ hy))
      ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y b).mp ((D.mem_commonTo R b).mp hb y hy))
  · have hRA : R ⊆ A := by
      intro y hy
      exact hclosed z hzA y (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ hy))
        ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y z).mp ((D.mem_commonTo R z).mp hzC y hy))
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hRpos
    apply Finset.union_subset hRA
    intro y hy
    exact hclosed a (hRA ha) y (hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hy))
      ((D.mem_commonTo R y).mp hy a ha)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliques_in_class_two_eq
statement:
theorem bicliques_in_class_two_eq {S T U : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hT : D.IsBiclique T) (hU : D.IsBiclique U)
    (hsubT : T ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hsubU : U ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2) : T = U
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2, D.kreinGraph.Adj x y → y ∈ T :=
    fun _ hx _ hy hxy => D.biclique_in_class_two_closed hS hSI hT hsubT hx hy hxy
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRI,hTeq⟩ := hT
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hQI,hUeq⟩ := hU
  by_cases hdis : Disjoint T U
  · have hUX0 : U ⊆ D.bicliqueClass R 0 := by
      intro x hxU
      have hxT : x ∉ T := fun hxT => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis hxT hxU
      have hzero : D.neighborCount T x = 0 := by
        apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
        apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
        intro y hy
        obtain ⟨hyT,hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
        exact hxT (hclosed y hyT x (hsubU hxU) ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp hxy))
      apply (D.mem_bicliqueClass R 0 x).mpr
      rw [← hTeq]
      exact ⟨hxT,hzero⟩
    have hno := D.no_biclique_in_class_zero hR hRI hQ hQI
    rw [← hUeq] at hno
    exact (hno hUX0).elim
  · simp only [Finset.disjoint_left] at hdis
    push Not at hdis
    obtain ⟨z,hzT,hzU⟩ := hdis
    have hUT : U ⊆ T := by
      rw [hUeq] at hsubU hzU ⊢
      exact D.biclique_subset_of_closed hQ hQI hsubU hclosed hzT hzU
    have hTcard : T.card = 6 := by rw [hTeq]; exact D.biclique_card hR hRI
    have hUcard : U.card = 6 := by rw [hUeq]; exact D.biclique_card hQ hQI
    exact (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hUT (by omega)).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.exists_unique_biclique_companion
statement:
theorem exists_unique_biclique_companion {S : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    ∃! T : Finset V, D.IsBiclique T ∧ T ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRI,hsub⟩ := D.exists_biclique_in_class_two hS hSI
  have hB : D.IsBiclique (R ∪ D.commonTo R) := ⟨R,hR,hRI,rfl⟩
  refine ⟨R ∪ D.commonTo R,⟨hB,hsub⟩,?_⟩
  intro T hT
  exact D.bicliques_in_class_two_eq hS hSI hT.1 hB hT.2 hsub

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_cross_sum
statement:
theorem neighborCount_cross_sum (T U : Finset V) :
    (∑ x ∈ T, (D.neighborCount U x : ℤ)) = ∑ y ∈ U, (D.neighborCount T y : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [D.neighborCount_cast]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  exact D.kreinMatrix_comm x y

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_companion_reciprocal
statement:
theorem biclique_companion_reciprocal {S R : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hR : R.card = 3) (hRI : D.IndependentSet R)
    (hsub : R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2) :
    S ∪ D.commonTo S ⊆ D.bicliqueClass R 2
proof:
:= by
  let T := S ∪ D.commonTo S
  let U := R ∪ D.commonTo R
  have hxout (x) (hx : x ∈ T) : x ∉ U := by
    intro hxU
    exact ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp (hsub hxU)).1 hx
  have hle (x) (hx : x ∈ T) : D.neighborCount U x ≤ 2 :=
    D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hR hRI (hxout x hx)
  have hUcard : U.card = 6 := D.biclique_card hR hRI
  have hTcard : T.card = 6 := D.biclique_card hS hSI
  have hsum : (∑ x ∈ T, (D.neighborCount U x : ℤ)) = 12 := by
    rw [D.neighborCount_cross_sum]
    have hy (y) (hyU : y ∈ U) : (D.neighborCount T y : ℤ) = 2 := by
      have h := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 y).mp (hsub hyU) |>.2
      rw [h]
      norm_num
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hy]
    simp [hUcard]
  intro x hx
  have htwo : D.neighborCount U x = 2 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hlt : (D.neighborCount U x : ℤ) < 2 := by have h := hle x hx; omega
    have hsumlt := Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun y hy => (by exact_mod_cast hle y hy :
      (D.neighborCount U y : ℤ) ≤ 2)) ⟨x,hx,hlt⟩
    have hc : (∑ _y ∈ T, (2 : ℤ)) = 12 := by simp [hTcard]
    rw [hsum, hc] at hsumlt
    omega
  exact (D.mem_bicliqueClass R 2 x).mpr ⟨hxout x hx,htwo⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_cast
statement:
theorem commonCount_cast (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :
    (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ) = ∑ w ∈ T, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commonCount, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
    ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, one_mul, Finset.sum_boole]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_self
statement:
theorem commonCount_self (T : Finset V) (x : V) :
    D.commonCount T x x = D.neighborCount T x
proof: := by simp [commonCount, neighborCount]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinMatrix_common_sum
statement:
theorem kreinMatrix_common_sum (x y : V) :
    (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w) =
      45 * (if x = y then 1 else 0) + 12 - 12 * D.kreinMatrix x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, D.kreinMatrix_comm y] using D.kreinMatrix_square_apply x y

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_univ
statement:
theorem commonCount_univ {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.commonCount Finset.univ x y = 12
proof:
:= by
  have h : (D.commonCount Finset.univ x y : ℤ) = 12 := by
    rw [D.commonCount_cast, D.kreinMatrix_common_sum]
    simp [hxy, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, hn]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonTriple_moment
statement:
theorem commonTriple_moment {x y : V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) (z : V) :
    (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * D.kreinMatrix z w) =
      3 * (1 - D.kreinMatrix x z - D.kreinMatrix y z +
        D.kreinMatrix x z * D.kreinMatrix y z) +
      9 * (if z = x then 1 else 0) + 9 * (if z = y then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag (a b : V) : (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix a w * D.kreinMatrix b w * D.kreinMatrix a w) =
      ∑ w, D.kreinMatrix a w * D.kreinMatrix b w := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro w _
    rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix]
    simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  by_cases hzx : z = x
  · subst z
    rw [hdiag, D.kreinMatrix_common_sum]
    simp [hxy, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
      hn, D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y x]
  · by_cases hzy : z = y
    · subst z
      have heq : (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * D.kreinMatrix y w) =
          ∑ w, D.kreinMatrix y w * D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro w _
        ring
      rw [heq, hdiag, D.kreinMatrix_common_sum]
      simp [Ne.symm hxy, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
        hn, D.kreinGraph.adj_comm y x]
    · have h := D.independent_pair_neighbor_moment hzx hzy hxy hn
      have heq : (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * D.kreinMatrix z w) =
          ∑ w, D.kreinMatrix z w * D.kreinMatrix w x * D.kreinMatrix w y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro w _
        rw [D.kreinMatrix_comm w x, D.kreinMatrix_comm w y]
        ring
      rw [heq, h]
      simp only [hzx, hzy, if_false, mul_zero, add_zero]
      rw [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix]
      simp only [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply, D.kreinGraph.adj_comm z x,
        D.kreinGraph.adj_comm z y]
      by_cases hxz : D.kreinGraph.Adj x z <;>
        by_cases hyz : D.kreinGraph.Adj y z <;> simp [hxz, hyz]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonTrace_subset
statement:
theorem commonTrace_subset (T : Finset V) {x y : V}
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * (D.neighborCount T w : ℤ)) =
      3 * T.card - 3 * D.neighborCount T x - 3 * D.neighborCount T y +
      3 * D.commonCount T x y + 9 * (if x ∈ T then 1 else 0) +
        9 * (if y ∈ T then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [D.neighborCount_cast, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [D.kreinMatrix_comm _ _, D.commonTriple_moment hxy hn]
  simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    ← D.neighborCount_cast, ← D.commonCount_cast, mul_comm]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_cast_indicator
statement:
theorem commonCount_cast_indicator (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :
    (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ) =
      ∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * (if w ∈ T then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.commonCount_cast]
  simp [mul_ite]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_bicliqueClass
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bicliqueClass (S : Finset V) (i : ℕ) (x : V) :
    x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S i ↔ x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S ∧
      D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = i
proof:
:= by
  simp [bicliqueClass]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_partition_indicators
statement:
theorem biclique_partition_indicators {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) (x : V) :
    (1 : ℤ) = (if x ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S then 1 else 0) +
      (if x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 0 then 1 else 0) +
      (if x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 1 then 1 else 0) +
      (if x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2 then 1 else 0) ∧
    (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x : ℤ) =
      3 * (if x ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S then 1 else 0) +
      (if x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 1 then 1 else 0) +
      2 * (if x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S
  · have ht := D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hx
    simp [hx, ht]
  · have hb := D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hcard hI hx
    change D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ≤ 2 at hb
    have hc : D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 0 ∨
        D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 1 ∨ D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 2 := by omega
    rcases hc with h | h | h <;> simp [hx, h]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_biclique_partition
statement:
theorem commonCount_biclique_partition {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) (x y : V) :
    (D.commonCount Finset.univ x y : ℤ) = D.commonCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y +
      D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 0) x y + D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x y +
      D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun w _ =>
    congrArg (fun z : ℤ => D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * z)
      (D.biclique_partition_indicators hcard hI w).1)
  simpa only [mul_one, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← D.commonCount_cast,
    ← D.commonCount_cast_indicator] using h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonTrace_biclique_partition
statement:
theorem commonTrace_biclique_partition {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) (x y : V) :
    (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) w : ℤ)) =
      3 * D.commonCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x y +
      D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 1) x y + 2 * D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ w, (3 * (D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w *
          (if w ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S then 1 else 0)) +
        D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * (if w ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 1 then 1 else 0) +
        2 * (D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * (if w ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2 then 1 else 0))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro w _
      rw [(D.biclique_partition_indicators hcard hI w).2]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
