      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← D.commonCount_cast_indicator]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjoint_biclique_class
statement:
theorem disjoint_biclique_class (S : Finset V) (i : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hi
  exact ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S i x).mp hi).1 hx

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_union
statement:
theorem commonCount_union (T U : Finset V) (hd : Disjoint T U) (x y : V) :
    D.commonCount (T ∪ U) x y = D.commonCount T x y + D.commonCount U x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commonCount, Finset.filter_union]
  exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
    (hd.mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (Finset.filter_subset _ _))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubicLeft_trace
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubicLeft_trace {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) :
    (3 : ℤ) * D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x =
      9 * (if x ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxD | hx0
  · rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hxD, if_pos hxD]
    norm_num
  · obtain ⟨hxD,h0⟩ := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 0 x).mp hx0
    rw [h0, if_neg hxD]
    norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubicLeft_common
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubicLeft_common {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueCubicLeft S)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y = 6 + D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y
proof:
:= by
  have ht := D.commonTrace_subset (S ∪ D.commonTo S) hxy hn
  have hp := D.commonTrace_biclique_partition hcard hI x y
  have hc := D.commonCount_biclique_partition hcard hI x y
  have hu := D.commonCount_union (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0) x y
  have htx := D.bicliqueCubicLeft_trace hcard hI hx
  have hty := D.bicliqueCubicLeft_trace hcard hI hy
  rw [D.biclique_card hcard hI] at ht
  rw [D.commonCount_univ hxy hn] at hc
  change D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y = _ at hu
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubicRight_common
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubicRight_common {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hy : y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hn : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y = 6 + D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y
proof:
:= by
  have ht := D.commonTrace_subset (S ∪ D.commonTo S) hxy hn
  have hp := D.commonTrace_biclique_partition hcard hI x y
  have hc := D.commonCount_biclique_partition hcard hI x y
  have hu := D.commonCount_union (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S 0)
    (D.disjoint_biclique_class S 0) x y
  obtain ⟨hxD,h2x⟩ := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨hyD,h2y⟩ := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 y).mp hy
  rw [D.biclique_card hcard hI, h2x, h2y, if_neg hxD, if_neg hyD] at ht
  rw [D.commonCount_univ hxy hn] at hc
  change D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y = _ at hu
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_commonTo
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_commonTo (S : Finset V) (w : V) :
    w ∈ D.commonTo S ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, D.kreinGraph.Adj x w
proof: := by simp [commonTo]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.no_triangle
statement:
theorem no_triangle {x y z : V} (hxy : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y)
    (hxz : D.kreinGraph.Adj x z) (hyz : D.kreinGraph.Adj y z) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := D.kreinGraph_isSRGWith.of_adj x y hxy
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card (D.kreinGraph.commonNeighbors x y) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨⟨z, (D.kreinGraph.mem_commonNeighbors).mpr ⟨hxz,hyz⟩⟩⟩
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonTo_card
statement:
theorem commonTo_card {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3) (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    (D.commonTo S).card = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,hab,hac,hbc,rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hcard
  have h := D.independent_triple_commonNeighbors a b c hab hac hbc
    (hI a (by simp) b (by simp) hab)
    (hI a (by simp) c (by simp) hac)
    (hI b (by simp) c (by simp) hbc)
  have heq : D.commonTo {a,b,c} = Finset.univ.filter fun w =>
      D.kreinGraph.Adj a w ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj b w ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj c w := by
    ext w
    simp [commonTo]
  rw [heq]
  exact h

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonTo_independent
statement:
theorem commonTo_independent {S : Finset V} (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    D.IndependentSet (D.commonTo S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hS
  intro x hx y hy _ hxy
  exact D.no_triangle ((D.mem_commonTo S x).mp hx a ha)
    ((D.mem_commonTo S y).mp hy a ha) hxy

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjoint_commonTo
statement: theorem disjoint_commonTo (S : Finset V) : Disjoint S (D.commonTo S)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hxC
  exact D.kreinGraph.irrefl ((D.mem_commonTo S x).mp hxC x hx)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonTo_involution
statement:
theorem commonTo_involution {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) : D.commonTo (D.commonTo S) = S
proof:
:= by
  have hSpos : S.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  have hCcard := D.commonTo_card hcard hI
  have hCCcard := D.commonTo_card hCcard (D.commonTo_independent hSpos)
  have hsub : S ⊆ D.commonTo (D.commonTo S) := by
    intro x hx
    apply (D.mem_commonTo _ x).mpr
    intro y hy
    exact (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp ((D.mem_commonTo S y).mp hy x hx)
  exact (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_card
statement:
theorem biclique_card {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3) (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    (S ∪ D.commonTo S).card = 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (D.disjoint_commonTo S), hcard, D.commonTo_card hcard hI]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighbor_trace_le_two
statement:
theorem neighbor_trace_le_two {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∉ D.commonTo S) : (S.filter fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hgt
  have heq : S.filter (fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) = S :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (by omega)
  apply hx
  apply (D.mem_commonTo S x).mpr
  intro y hy
  have hmem : y ∈ S.filter fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y := heq.symm ▸ hy
  exact (D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_outside_degree_le_two
proof:
:= by
  have hxS : x ∉ S := fun h => hx (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
  have hxC : x ∉ D.commonTo S := fun h => hx (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)
  by_cases hleft : ∃ a ∈ S, D.kreinGraph.Adj x a
  · obtain ⟨a,ha,hxa⟩ := hleft
    have hsub : ((S ∪ D.commonTo S).filter fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) ⊆
        S.filter fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨hyU,hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hyU with hyS | hyC
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hyS,hxy⟩
      · exact (D.no_triangle hxa hxy ((D.mem_commonTo S y).mp hyC a ha)).elim
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (D.neighbor_trace_le_two hcard hxC)
  · have hsub : ((S ∪ D.commonTo S).filter fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) ⊆
        (D.commonTo S).filter fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨hyU,hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hyU with hyS | hyC
      · exact (hleft ⟨y,hyS,hxy⟩).elim
      · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hyC,hxy⟩
    have hxCC : x ∉ D.commonTo (D.commonTo S) := by
      rw [D.commonTo_involution hcard hI]
      exact hxS
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
      (D.neighbor_trace_le_two (D.commonTo_card hcard hI) hxCC)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.exists_independent_three
statement:
theorem exists_independent_three (p : V) : ∃ S : Finset V,
    S.card = 3 ∧ D.IndependentSet S
proof:
:= by
  have hle : 3 ≤ (D.kreinGraph.neighborFinset p).card := by
    change 3 ≤ D.kreinGraph.degree p
    rw [D.kreinGraph_degree]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨S,hsub,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hle
  refine ⟨S,hcard,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy _ hxy
  exact D.no_triangle ((D.kreinGraph.mem_neighborFinset p x).mp (hsub hx))
    ((D.kreinGraph.mem_neighborFinset p y).mp (hsub hy)) hxy

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_row_sum
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_row_sum (T : Finset V) (x : T) :
    (∑ y, D.setAdjMatrix T x y) = D.neighborCount T x
proof:
:= by
  unfold setAdjMatrix
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort T (fun y : V => D.kreinMatrix x y)]
  exact (D.neighborCount_cast T x).symm

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_comm
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_comm (T : Finset V) (x y : T) :
    D.setAdjMatrix T x y = D.setAdjMatrix T y x
proof: := D.kreinMatrix_comm x y

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_trace
statement: theorem setAdjMatrix_trace (T : Finset V) : Matrix.trace (D.setAdjMatrix T) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, setAdjMatrix, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_square_trace
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_square_trace (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) :
    Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^2) = (3 : ℤ) * T.card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, pow_two, D.setAdjMatrix_square, D.commonCount_self]
  have h (x : T) : (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ) = 3 := by rw [hdeg x x.property]; norm_num
  simp_rw [h]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_cube_trace
statement: theorem setAdjMatrix_cube_trace (T : Finset V) : Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^3) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x _
  change ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^3) x x = 0
  rw [pow_succ, pow_two, Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro y _
  by_cases hxy : D.kreinGraph.Adj x y
  · rw [D.setAdjMatrix_square, D.commonCount_of_adj T hxy]
    simp
  · simp [setAdjMatrix, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
      D.kreinGraph.adj_comm (y : V) (x : V), hxy]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_mul_ones
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_mul_ones (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) :
    D.setAdjMatrix T * allOnesMatrix = (3 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix_apply, mul_one, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    D.setAdjMatrix_row_sum]
  rw [hdeg x x.property]
  norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.ones_mul_setAdjMatrix
statement:
theorem ones_mul_setAdjMatrix (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) :
    allOnesMatrix * D.setAdjMatrix T = (3 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix_apply, one_mul, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    D.setAdjMatrix_comm T _ y, D.setAdjMatrix_row_sum]
  rw [hdeg y y.property]
  norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.cubicGram_polynomial_trace
statement:
theorem cubicGram_polynomial_trace (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) :
    Matrix.trace (((D.setAdjMatrix T - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix)^2) =
      Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^4) + 243 * T.card + 36 * (T.card : ℤ)^2
proof:
:= by
  let H := D.setAdjMatrix T
  let J : Matrix T T ℤ := allOnesMatrix
  have hHJ : H * J = (3 : ℤ) • J := D.setAdjMatrix_mul_ones T hdeg
  have hJH : J * H = (3 : ℤ) • J := D.ones_mul_setAdjMatrix T hdeg
  have hJJ : J * J = (T.card : ℤ) • J := by
    ext x y
    simp [J, Matrix.mul_apply, allOnesMatrix]
  have hJHH : J * (H * H) = (9 : ℤ) • J := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hJH, Matrix.smul_mul, hJH, smul_smul]
    norm_num
  have heq : ((H - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • J)^2 =
      H^4 - (12 : ℤ) • H^3 + (54 : ℤ) • H^2 - (108 : ℤ) • H +
        (81 : ℤ) • 1 + (36 * T.card : ℤ) • J := by
    noncomm_ring [hHJ, hJH, hJJ, hJHH]
    module
  change Matrix.trace (((H - (3 : ℤ) • 1)^2 + (6 : ℤ) • J)^2) = _
  rw [heq]
  simp only [Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have ht : Matrix.trace H = 0 := D.setAdjMatrix_trace T
  have ht2 : Matrix.trace (H^2) = (3 : ℤ) * T.card := D.setAdjMatrix_square_trace T hdeg
  have ht3 : Matrix.trace (H^3) = 0 := D.setAdjMatrix_cube_trace T
  have htJ : Matrix.trace J = T.card := by simp [J, allOnesMatrix, Matrix.trace]
  rw [ht, ht2, ht3, htJ, Matrix.trace_one]
  simp only [Fintype.card_coe]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.rectangular_gram_square_trace
statement:
theorem rectangular_gram_square_trace {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (M : Matrix α β ℤ) :
    Matrix.trace ((M * M.transpose)^2) = Matrix.trace ((M.transpose * M)^2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_two, Matrix.mul_assoc] using
    (Matrix.trace_mul_comm M (M.transpose * M * M.transpose))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubic_fourth_trace
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubic_fourth_trace {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S))^4) =
      Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueClass S 2))^4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := rectangular_gram_square_trace
    (D.crossAdjMatrix (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) (D.bicliqueClass S 2))
  rw [D.bicliqueCubic_gram_left hcard hI, D.bicliqueCubic_gram_right hcard hI] at h
  rw [D.cubicGram_polynomial_trace (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S)
      (fun x hx => (D.bicliqueCubicLeft_degrees hcard hI hx).1),
    D.cubicGram_polynomial_trace (D.bicliqueClass S 2)
      (fun x hx => (D.bicliqueCubicRight_degrees hcard hI hx).1),
    D.bicliqueCubicLeft_card hcard hI, (D.bicliqueClass_card hcard hI).2.2] at h
  linarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_comm
statement:
theorem commonCount_comm (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :
    D.commonCount T x y = D.commonCount T y x
proof: := by simp [commonCount, and_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_fourth_trace_sum
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_fourth_trace_sum (T : Finset V) :
    Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^4) =
      ∑ x : T, ∑ y : T, (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (D.setAdjMatrix T)^4 =
      (D.setAdjMatrix T * D.setAdjMatrix T) * (D.setAdjMatrix T * D.setAdjMatrix T) := by noncomm_ring
  rw [hp]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  rw [D.setAdjMatrix_square, D.setAdjMatrix_square, D.commonCount_comm T (y : V) x]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.setAdjMatrix_square_row_sum
statement:
theorem setAdjMatrix_square_row_sum (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) (x : T) :
    (∑ y : T, (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)) = 9
proof:
:= by
  have hr (y : T) : (D.neighborCount T y : ℤ) = 3 := by rw [hdeg y y.property]; norm_num
  calc
    _ = ∑ z : T, D.setAdjMatrix T x z * (∑ y : T, D.setAdjMatrix T z y) := by
      simp_rw [← D.setAdjMatrix_square, Matrix.mul_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [D.setAdjMatrix_row_sum, hr]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, D.setAdjMatrix_row_sum, hr]
      norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.cubic_fourth_trace_surplus
statement:
theorem cubic_fourth_trace_surplus (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) :
    Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^4) = (15 : ℤ) * T.card +
      ∑ x : T, ∑ y : T, if x = y then 0 else
        (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)^2 - D.commonCount T x y
proof:
:= by
  have htotal : (∑ x : T, ∑ y : T, (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)) = 9 * T.card := by
    simp_rw [D.setAdjMatrix_square_row_sum T hdeg]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hdelta : (∑ x : T, ∑ y : T, if x = y then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = T.card := by simp
  have he (x y : T) : (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)^2 =
      (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ) + 6 * (if x = y then 1 else 0) +
        (if x = y then 0 else (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)^2 - D.commonCount T x y) := by
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · subst y
      rw [D.commonCount_self, hdeg x x.property]
      norm_num
    · simp only [hxy, if_false, mul_zero, add_zero]
      ring
  rw [D.setAdjMatrix_fourth_trace_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => he x y))]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [htotal, hdelta]
  ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.natCast_square_sub_nonneg
statement: theorem natCast_square_sub_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (n : ℤ)^2 - n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n = 0
  · simp [h]
  · have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ n := by omega
    nlinarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.cubic_fourth_trace_of_no_square
statement:
theorem cubic_fourth_trace_of_no_square (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3)
    (hno : ∀ x : T, ∀ y : T, x ≠ y → D.commonCount T x y ≤ 1) :
    Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^4) = (15 : ℤ) * T.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.cubic_fourth_trace_surplus T hdeg]
  have hz : (∑ x : T, ∑ y : T, if x = y then (0 : ℤ) else
      (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)^2 - D.commonCount T x y) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro y _
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · simp [hxy]
    · have hc := hno x y hxy
      have hv : D.commonCount T x y = 0 ∨ D.commonCount T x y = 1 := by omega
      rcases hv with h | h <;> simp [hxy, h]
  rw [hz, add_zero]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.cubic_fourth_trace_gt_of_square
statement:
theorem cubic_fourth_trace_gt_of_square (T : Finset V)
    (hdeg : ∀ x ∈ T, D.neighborCount T x = 3) (x y : T)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hc : 2 ≤ D.commonCount T x y) :
    (15 : ℤ) * T.card < Matrix.trace ((D.setAdjMatrix T)^4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.cubic_fourth_trace_surplus T hdeg]
  have hn (a b : T) : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (if a = b then 0 else
      (D.commonCount T a b : ℤ)^2 - D.commonCount T a b) := by
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · exact natCast_square_sub_nonneg _
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) < (if x = y then 0 else
      (D.commonCount T x y : ℤ)^2 - D.commonCount T x y) := by
    rw [if_neg hxy]
    have hc' : (2 : ℤ) ≤ D.commonCount T x y := by exact_mod_cast hc
    nlinarith
  have hs : (0 : ℤ) < ∑ a : T, ∑ b : T, if a = b then 0 else
      (D.commonCount T a b : ℤ)^2 - D.commonCount T a b := by
    apply Finset.sum_pos' (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hn a b))
    refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun b _ => hn x b) ⟨y, Finset.mem_univ _, hp⟩
  linarith

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubic_left_square
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubic_left_square {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    ∃ x y : D.bicliqueCubicLeft S, x ≠ y ∧
      2 ≤ D.commonCount (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,hab,_,_,hS⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hcard
  have ha : a ∈ S := by rw [hS]; simp
  have hb : b ∈ S := by rw [hS]; simp
  let x : D.bicliqueCubicLeft S := ⟨a, Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)⟩
  let y : D.bicliqueCubicLeft S := ⟨b, Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ hb)⟩
  refine ⟨x,y,fun h => hab (congrArg Subtype.val h),?_⟩
  have hsub : D.commonTo S ⊆ (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S).filter
      (fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj a z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj b z) := by
    intro z hz
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ hz),?_,?_⟩
    · exact (D.mem_commonTo S z).mp hz a ha
    · exact (D.mem_commonTo S z).mp hz b hb
  have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [D.commonTo_card hcard hI] at h
  change 2 ≤ ((D.bicliqueCubicLeft S).filter
      fun z => D.kreinGraph.Adj a z ∧ D.kreinGraph.Adj b z).card
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueCubic_right_square
statement:
theorem bicliqueCubic_right_square {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    ∃ x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2, ∃ y ∈ D.bicliqueClass S 2, x ≠ y ∧
      2 ≤ D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hno (x y : D.bicliqueClass S 2) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
      D.commonCount (D.bicliqueClass S 2) x y ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hgt
    apply hnone
    refine ⟨x,x.property,y,y.property,?_,by omega⟩
    exact fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h)
  have hr := D.cubic_fourth_trace_of_no_square (D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (fun x hx => (D.bicliqueCubicRight_degrees hcard hI hx).1) hno
  obtain ⟨x,y,hxy,hc⟩ := D.bicliqueCubic_left_square hcard hI
  have hl := D.cubic_fourth_trace_gt_of_square (D.bicliqueCubicLeft S)
    (fun z hz => (D.bicliqueCubicLeft_degrees hcard hI hz).1) x y hxy hc
  rw [D.bicliqueCubic_fourth_trace hcard hI, hr, D.bicliqueCubicLeft_card hcard hI,
    (D.bicliqueClass_card hcard hI).2.2] at hl
  exact (lt_irrefl _ hl)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independentSet_mono
statement:
theorem independentSet_mono {T U : Finset V} (hTU : T ⊆ U) (hI : D.IndependentSet U) :
    D.IndependentSet T
proof: := fun x hx y hy hxy => hI x (hTU hx) y (hTU hy) hxy

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independent_neighborCount_zero
statement:
theorem independent_neighborCount_zero {T : Finset V} (hI : D.IndependentSet T)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ T) : D.neighborCount T x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨hyT,hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
  exact hI x hx y hyT (D.kreinGraph.ne_of_adj hxy) hxy

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.not_adj_of_neighborCount_zero
statement:
theorem not_adj_of_neighborCount_zero {T : Finset V} {x y : V}
    (hzero : D.neighborCount T x = 0) (hy : y ∈ T) : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy
  have hp : 0 < D.neighborCount T x := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨y,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy,hxy⟩⟩
  omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independentSet_union
statement:
theorem independentSet_union {T U : Finset V} (hT : D.IndependentSet T)
    (hU : D.IndependentSet U) (hcross : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ U, ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) :
    D.IndependentSet (T ∪ U)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy ha
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxT | hxU <;> rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hyT | hyU
  · exact hT x hxT y hyT hxy ha
  · exact hcross x hxT y hyU ha
  · exact hcross y hyT x hxU ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp ha)
  · exact hU x hxU y hyU hxy ha

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.companions_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hxS hxR
  exact ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp (hsub hxR)).1 hxS

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.companion_side_traces
statement:
theorem companion_side_traces {S R : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hR : R.card = 3) (hRI : D.IndependentSet R)
    (hsub : R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2) :
    ((∀ x ∈ R, D.neighborCount S x = 0) ∧ (∀ x ∈ D.commonTo R, D.neighborCount S x = 2)) ∨
    ((∀ x ∈ R, D.neighborCount S x = 2) ∧ (∀ x ∈ D.commonTo R, D.neighborCount S x = 0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < R.card)
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [D.commonTo_card hR hRI]; omega : 0 < (D.commonTo R).card)
  have hab := D.bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces hS hSI
    (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)) (hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hb))
    ((D.mem_commonTo R b).mp hb a ha)
  have hleft (x) (hx : x ∈ R) : D.neighborCount S x = D.neighborCount S a := by
    have h := D.bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces hS hSI
      (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)) (hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hb))
      ((D.mem_commonTo R b).mp hb x hx)
    omega
  have hright (y) (hy : y ∈ D.commonTo R) : D.neighborCount S a + D.neighborCount S y = 2 :=
    D.bicliqueClass_two_adj_traces hS hSI
      (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)) (hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hy))
      ((D.mem_commonTo R y).mp hy a ha)
  rcases D.bicliqueClass_two_sides (hsub (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)) with h2 | h0
  · right
    exact ⟨fun x hx => by have h := hleft x hx; omega,
      fun y hy => by have h := hright y hy; omega⟩
  · left
    exact ⟨fun x hx => by have h := hleft x hx; omega,
      fun y hy => by have h := hright y hy; omega⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.exists_oriented_companion
statement:
theorem exists_oriented_companion {S : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) : ∃ R : Finset V,
      R.card = 3 ∧ D.IndependentSet R ∧ R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ R, D.neighborCount S x = 0) ∧ (∀ x ∈ D.commonTo R, D.neighborCount S x = 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRI,hsub⟩ := D.exists_biclique_in_class_two hS hSI
  rcases D.companion_side_traces hS hSI hR hRI hsub with hgood | hswap
  · exact ⟨R,hR,hRI,hsub,hgood⟩
  · refine ⟨D.commonTo R,D.commonTo_card hR hRI,
      D.commonTo_independent (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < R.card)),?_,hswap.2,?_⟩
    · rw [D.commonTo_involution hR hRI, Finset.union_comm]
      exact hsub
    · rw [D.commonTo_involution hR hRI]
      exact hswap.1

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.companion_union_degrees
statement:
theorem companion_union_degrees {S R : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hR : R.card = 3) (hRI : D.IndependentSet R)
    (hsub : R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2) :
    ∀ x ∈ (S ∪ D.commonTo S) ∪ (R ∪ D.commonTo R),
      D.neighborCount ((S ∪ D.commonTo S) ∪ (R ∪ D.commonTo R)) x = 5
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := D.biclique_companion_reciprocal hS hSI hR hRI hsub
  intro x hx
  rw [D.neighborCount_union _ _ (D.companions_disjoint hsub)]
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxS | hxR
  · rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hS hSI hxS,
      ((D.mem_bicliqueClass R 2 x).mp (hrec hxS)).2]
  · rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hR hRI hxR,
      ((D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 x).mp (hsub hxR)).2]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.crownParts_of_oriented_companion
statement:
theorem crownParts_of_oriented_companion {S R : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) (hR : R.card = 3) (hRI : D.IndependentSet R)
    (hsub : R ∪ D.commonTo R ⊆ D.bicliqueClass S 2)
    (hleft : ∀ x ∈ R, D.neighborCount S x = 0)
    (hright : ∀ x ∈ D.commonTo R, D.neighborCount S x = 2) :
    D.CrownParts (S ∪ R) (D.commonTo S ∪ D.commonTo R)
proof:
:= by
  have hdis := D.companions_disjoint hsub
  have hSR : Disjoint S R := hdis.mono Finset.subset_union_left Finset.subset_union_left
  have hCC : Disjoint (D.commonTo S) (D.commonTo R) :=
    hdis.mono Finset.subset_union_right Finset.subset_union_right
  have hbig : Disjoint (S ∪ R) (D.commonTo S ∪ D.commonTo R) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hxL hxBigR
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxL with hxS | hxR <;> rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hxBigR with hxCS | hxCR
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.disjoint_commonTo S) hxS hxCS
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis (Finset.mem_union_left _ hxS) (Finset.mem_union_right _ hxCR)
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis (Finset.mem_union_right _ hxCS) (Finset.mem_union_left _ hxR)
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.disjoint_commonTo R) hxR hxCR
  have hIL : D.IndependentSet (S ∪ R) := D.independentSet_union hSI hRI (by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    exact D.not_adj_of_neighborCount_zero (hleft y hy) hx ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp hxy))
  have hIR : D.IndependentSet (D.commonTo S ∪ D.commonTo R) := D.independentSet_union
    (D.commonTo_independent (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < S.card)))
    (D.commonTo_independent (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < R.card))) (by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      have h2 := (D.mem_bicliqueClass S 2 y).mp (hsub (Finset.mem_union_right _ hy)) |>.2
      rw [D.biclique_neighborCount_split, hright y hy] at h2
      have hzero : D.neighborCount (D.commonTo S) y = 0 := by omega
      exact D.not_adj_of_neighborCount_zero hzero hx ((D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y).mp hxy))
  have heq : (S ∪ D.commonTo S) ∪ (R ∪ D.commonTo R) =
      (S ∪ R) ∪ (D.commonTo S ∪ D.commonTo R) := by ac_rfl
  have hd := D.companion_union_degrees hS hSI hR hRI hsub
  rw [heq] at hd
  refine ⟨?_,?_,hbig,hIL,hIR,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hSR, hS, hR]
  · rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hCC, D.commonTo_card hS hSI, D.commonTo_card hR hRI]
  · intro x hx
    have h := hd x (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)
    rw [D.neighborCount_union _ _ hbig, D.independent_neighborCount_zero hIL hx] at h
    omega
  · intro x hx
    have h := hd x (Finset.mem_union_right _ hx)
    rw [D.neighborCount_union _ _ hbig, D.independent_neighborCount_zero hIR hx] at h
    omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.exists_crown_of_independent_triple
statement:
theorem exists_crown_of_independent_triple {S : Finset V} (hS : S.card = 3)
    (hSI : D.IndependentSet S) : ∃ W : Finset V, D.IsCrown W ∧ S ⊆ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRI,hsub,hleft,hright⟩ := D.exists_oriented_companion hS hSI
  refine ⟨(S ∪ R) ∪ (D.commonTo S ∪ D.commonTo R),
    ⟨S ∪ R,D.commonTo S ∪ D.commonTo R,
      D.crownParts_of_oriented_companion hS hSI hR hRI hsub hleft hright,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  exact Finset.subset_union_left.trans Finset.subset_union_left

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_cast
statement:
theorem neighborCount_cast (T : Finset V) (x : V) :
    (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ) = ∑ y ∈ T, D.kreinMatrix x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [neighborCount, ← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinMatrix_comm
statement: theorem kreinMatrix_comm (x y : V) : D.kreinMatrix x y = D.kreinMatrix y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← D.kreinGraph_adjMatrix, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply,
    D.kreinGraph.adj_comm x y]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinMatrix_row_sum
statement: theorem kreinMatrix_row_sum (x : V) : (∑ y, D.kreinMatrix x y) = 57
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.neighborCount_cast]
  have heq : D.neighborCount Finset.univ x = D.kreinGraph.degree x := by
    simp [neighborCount, SimpleGraph.degree, SimpleGraph.neighborFinset_eq_filter]
  rw [heq, D.kreinGraph_degree]
  norm_num

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_sum
statement:
theorem neighborCount_sum (T : Finset V) :
    (∑ x, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)) = 57 * T.card
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [D.neighborCount_cast]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [D.kreinMatrix_comm, D.kreinMatrix_row_sum]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_square_sum
statement:
theorem neighborCount_square_sum (T : Finset V) :
    (∑ x, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)^2) =
      45 * T.card + 12 * (T.card : ℤ)^2 - 12 * ∑ x ∈ T, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair (a b : V) : (∑ x, D.kreinMatrix x a * D.kreinMatrix x b) =
      45 * (if a = b then 1 else 0) + 12 - 12 * D.kreinMatrix a b := by
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, D.kreinMatrix_comm a] using D.kreinMatrix_square_apply a b
  calc
    _ = ∑ a ∈ T, ∑ b ∈ T, ∑ x, D.kreinMatrix x a * D.kreinMatrix x b := by
      simp_rw [D.neighborCount_cast, pow_two, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [hpair, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← Finset.mul_sum, ← D.neighborCount_cast]
      simp
      ring

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_neighbors_of_mem_side
statement:
theorem biclique_neighbors_of_mem_side {S : Finset V} (hI : D.IndependentSet S)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    (S ∪ D.commonTo S).filter (fun y => D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) = D.commonTo S
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨hyU,hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hyU with hyS | hyC
    · exact (hI x hx y hyS (D.kreinGraph.ne_of_adj hxy) hxy).elim
    · exact hyC
  · intro hy
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_union_right _ hy, (D.mem_commonTo _ _).mp hy x hx⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem
statement:
theorem neighborCount_biclique_of_mem {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ S ∪ D.commonTo S) :
    D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = 3
proof:
:= by
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hxS | hxC
  · rw [neighborCount, D.biclique_neighbors_of_mem_side hI hxS, D.commonTo_card hcard hI]
  · have hC := D.biclique_neighbors_of_mem_side
      (D.commonTo_independent (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < S.card))) hxC
    rw [D.commonTo_involution hcard hI, Finset.union_comm] at hC
    rw [neighborCount, hC, hcard]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_bicliqueOutside
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bicliqueOutside (S : Finset V) (x : V) :
    x ∈ D.bicliqueOutside S ↔ x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S
proof: := by simp [bicliqueOutside]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueOutside_card
statement:
theorem bicliqueOutside_card {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) : (D.bicliqueOutside S).card = 318
proof:
:= by
  rw [bicliqueOutside, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ _), Finset.card_univ,
    D.kreinGraph_isSRGWith.card, D.biclique_card hcard hI]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueOutside_trace_moments
statement:
theorem bicliqueOutside_trace_moments {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    (∑ x ∈ D.bicliqueOutside S, (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x : ℤ)) = 324 ∧
    (∑ x ∈ D.bicliqueOutside S, (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x : ℤ)^2) = 432
proof:
:= by
  let T := S ∪ D.commonTo S
  have hT : T.card = 6 := D.biclique_card hcard hI
  have hin : ∀ x ∈ T, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ) = 3 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [D.neighborCount_biclique_of_mem hcard hI hx]
    norm_num
  have hs := D.neighborCount_sum T
  have hss := D.neighborCount_square_sum T
  have hins : (∑ x ∈ T, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)) = 18 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hin]
    simp [hT]
  have hinss : (∑ x ∈ T, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)^2) = 54 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z^2) (hin x hx))
    rw [h]
    simp [hT]
  have htotal := Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ T) (f := fun x => (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ))
  have htotal2 := Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ T) (f := fun x => (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)^2)
  simp only [hT, hins] at hs hss
  change (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ \ T, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)) = 324 ∧
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ \ T, (D.neighborCount T x : ℤ)^2) = 432
  constructor <;> omega

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.boundedTwo_fiber_moments
statement:
theorem boundedTwo_fiber_moments {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (U : Finset α)
    (f : α → ℕ) (hle : ∀ x ∈ U, f x ≤ 2) :
    (U.card : ℤ) = (U.filter fun x => f x = 0).card +
      (U.filter fun x => f x = 1).card + (U.filter fun x => f x = 2).card ∧
    (∑ x ∈ U, (f x : ℤ)) = (U.filter fun x => f x = 1).card +
      2 * (U.filter fun x => f x = 2).card ∧
    (∑ x ∈ U, (f x : ℤ)^2) = (U.filter fun x => f x = 1).card +
      4 * (U.filter fun x => f x = 2).card
proof:
:= by
  have hp (x) (hx : x ∈ U) :
      (1 : ℤ) = (if f x = 0 then 1 else 0) + (if f x = 1 then 1 else 0) +
        (if f x = 2 then 1 else 0) ∧
      (f x : ℤ) = (if f x = 1 then 1 else 0) + 2 * (if f x = 2 then 1 else 0) ∧
      (f x : ℤ)^2 = (if f x = 1 then 1 else 0) + 4 * (if f x = 2 then 1 else 0) := by
    have h := hle x hx
    have hcases : f x = 0 ∨ f x = 1 ∨ f x = 2 := by omega
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2 <;> simp_all
  have h0 := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => (hp x hx).1)
  have h1 := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => (hp x hx).2.1)
  have h2 := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => (hp x hx).2.2)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_boole,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h0 h1 h2
  exact ⟨h0,h1,h2⟩

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueClass_card
statement:
theorem bicliqueClass_card {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3)
    (hI : D.IndependentSet S) :
    (D.bicliqueClass S 0).card = 48 ∧ (D.bicliqueClass S 1).card = 216 ∧
      (D.bicliqueClass S 2).card = 54
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ x ∈ D.bicliqueOutside S, D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x ≤ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    exact D.biclique_outside_degree_le_two hcard hI ((D.mem_bicliqueOutside S x).mp hx)
  have h := boundedTwo_fiber_moments (D.bicliqueOutside S)
    (D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S)) hle
  have hm := D.bicliqueOutside_trace_moments hcard hI
  have hc := D.bicliqueOutside_card hcard hI
  change (D.bicliqueOutside S).card = ((D.bicliqueClass S 0).card : ℤ) +
    (D.bicliqueClass S 1).card + (D.bicliqueClass S 2).card ∧
    _ = ((D.bicliqueClass S 1).card : ℤ) + 2 * (D.bicliqueClass S 2).card ∧
    _ = ((D.bicliqueClass S 1).card : ℤ) + 4 * (D.bicliqueClass S 2).card at h
  omega
